gloss_zh: 维斯廷；对应英语 Augustine 的男性名

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male given name corresponding to Augustine in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他语男性名字，英语对应名为 Augustine，中文可按英语对应名理解为“奥古斯丁”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għal Augustine bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.en_definition: a male given name from Sicilian [in turn from Latin], equivalent to English Augustine
sense_translations.zh_definition: 源自西西里语、并进一步源自拉丁语的男性名字，对应英语 Augustine（奥古斯丁）。

formal.mt: Wistin se jippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Wistin will present the report during tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: 维斯廷将在明天的会议上介绍这份报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jismu l-ġar il-ġdid? Lara: Jismu Wistin. Trid niltaqgħu miegħu?
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the new neighbour's name? Lara: His name is Wistin. Shall we go and meet him?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新邻居叫什么名字？拉拉：他叫维斯廷。我们去认识一下他，好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 新邻居叫什么名字？
messages.en: What's the new neighbour's name?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他叫维斯廷。我们去认识一下他，好吗？
messages.en: His name is Wistin. Shall we go and meet him?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Wistin 写在人物姓名卡上，旁边标注 Augustine；再用 jismu Wistin“他叫维斯廷”整句记忆，注意人名首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A peg used to hold or secure something in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于固定物体的小桩或橛子，例如插入地面后用来系住绳子的桩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa li tiddaħħal fl-art jew f'wiċċ ieħor biex iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于固定东西的小桩、橛子。

collocations.en: drive a peg into the ground
tie the rope to the peg

formal.mt: Daħħal il-wited sew fl-art qabel torbot il-ħabel miegħu.
formal.en: Drive the peg firmly into the ground before tying the rope to it.
formal.zh: 先把桩牢牢打进地里，再把绳子系在上面。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek wited ieħor għat-tinda? Lara: Iva, hawn wieħed. Daħħlu ħdejn dik il-ħabel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have another peg for the tent? Lara: Yes, here's one. Put it in beside that rope.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你还有一根帐篷桩吗？拉拉：有，这里有一根。把它插在那根绳子旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (露营伙伴)
messages.zh: 你还有一根帐篷桩吗？
messages.en: Do you have another peg for the tent?

messages.speaker: Lara (露营伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed. Daħħlu ħdejn dik il-ħabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed. Daħħlu ħdejn dik il-ħabel.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一根。把它插在那根绳子旁边。
messages.en: Yes, here's one. Put it in beside that rope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搭帐篷时把一根 wited 插进地里，再把绳子系上；用“桩入地、绳系桩”的动作画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of making a surface level or even.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把地面或其他表面弄平的作业或过程；另有“益处”的义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol biex wiċċ jew art isiru ndaqs; jista' jfisser ukoll ġid jew vantaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平整、整平的行为或作业，即使某个表面变得平坦。
益处；好处；有利的作用或结果。

formal.mt: Il-witi tal-art għandu jitlesta qabel ma jibda t-tqegħid tal-madum.
formal.en: The levelling of the ground must be completed before the laying of the tiles begins.
formal.zh: 地面平整作业必须在开始铺砖之前完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nibdew inqiegħdu l-madum? Mark: Għad le. L-ewwel irridu nlestu l-witi tal-art.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we start laying the tiles? Mark: Not yet. First we need to finish levelling the ground.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们可以开始铺砖了吗？马克：还不行。我们得先完成地面的平整。

messages.speaker: Maja (屋主)
messages.zh: 我们可以开始铺砖了吗？
messages.en: Can we start laying the tiles?

messages.speaker: Mark (施工人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad le. L-ewwel irridu nlestu l-witi tal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Għad le. L-ewwel irridu nlestu l-witi tal-art.
messages.zh: 还不行。我们得先完成地面的平整。
messages.en: Not yet. First we need to finish levelling the ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 witi 做两张义项卡：一张画地面被整平，另一张写“带来益处”；靠上下文分辨，不把两个义项强行解释成同一来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One instance of making a surface level or even.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次具体的平整或整平作业，强调某一次把表面弄平的操作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba waħda li fiha ssir ħidma biex wiċċ jew art isiru ndaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次平整或整平的操作。

collocations.en: an instance of levelling the ground

formal.mt: Saret witja tal-art qabel it-tqegħid tal-madum.
formal.en: The ground was given a levelling before the tiles were laid.
formal.zh: 铺砖之前，对地面进行了一次平整。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-biċċa art għadha mhix lixxa. Mark: Nagħtiha witja oħra, u mbagħad inkunu lesti.
colloquial.en: Lara: This patch of ground still isn't smooth. Mark: I'll give it another levelling, and then we'll be ready.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块地还不平。马克：我再平整一次，然后我们就准备好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-biċċa art għadha mhix lixxa.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-biċċa art għadha mhix lixxa.
messages.zh: 这块地还不平。
messages.en: This patch of ground still isn't smooth.

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħtiha witja oħra, u mbagħad inkunu lesti.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħtiha witja oħra, u mbagħad inkunu lesti.
messages.zh: 我再平整一次，然后我们就准备好了。
messages.en: I'll give it another levelling, and then we'll be ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 witja 记成施工记录里的一次操作：今天做“一次平整”，需要时再做“另一次”；用次数感区别于泛指平整过程的 witi。

gloss_zh: 蜥蜴，尤指壁虎或蜥蜴科动物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lizards, especially geckos or members of the lacertid family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指蜥蜴这一类动物，实际使用中尤其指壁虎或蜥蜴科动物；本词条表达复数或集合意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali bħal gremxul, speċjalment wiżgħat jew membri tal-familja Lacertidae, imsemmija flimkien.

sense_translations.en_definition: lizards (in practice especially geckos or lacertids)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜥蜴；实际使用中尤其指壁虎或蜥蜴科动物，具有复数或集合意义。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-ġnien, l-istudenti osservaw il-wiżagħ mingħajr ma messewhom.
formal.en: During the garden visit, the students observed the lizards without touching them.
formal.zh: 参观花园时，学生们观察了这些蜥蜴，没有触碰它们。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm wiżagħ fuq il-ħajt! Lino: Iva, narahom. Ejja nħalluhom bi kwiethom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there are lizards on the wall! Lino: Yes, I can see them. Let's leave them alone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，墙上有蜥蜴！利诺：是的，我看见它们了。我们别打扰它们。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 看，墙上有蜥蜴！
messages.en: Look, there are lizards on the wall!

messages.speaker: Lino (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, narahom. Ejja nħalluhom bi kwiethom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, narahom. Ejja nħalluhom bi kwiethom.
messages.zh: 是的，我看见它们了。我们别打扰它们。
messages.en: Yes, I can see them. Let's leave them alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象墙上出现几只壁虎，把整个画面标为 wiżagħ；连同“它们”一起记忆，提醒自己这里是复数或集合意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The goose species called the greylag goose, scientifically named Anser anser.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类名称“灰雁”，学名为 Anser anser；整个词组指一个特定物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' wiżża magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Anser anser.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰雁，学名 Anser anser。

collocations.en: a photograph of a greylag goose

formal.mt: Il-gwida tidentifika l-għasfur fir-ritratt bħala wiżża griża, Anser anser.
formal.en: The guide identifies the bird in the photograph as a greylag goose, Anser anser.
formal.zh: 这本指南将照片中的鸟鉴定为灰雁，学名 Anser anser。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Mark: Dik wiżża griża. Hawn isimha taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this bird in the photograph called? Mark: That's a greylag goose. Its name is here under the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这种鸟叫什么？马克：那是灰雁。照片下面这里写着它的名字。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What's this bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik wiżża griża. Hawn isimha taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Dik wiżża griża. Hawn isimha taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 那是灰雁。照片下面这里写着它的名字。
messages.en: That's a greylag goose. Its name is here under the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 griża“灰色的”与中文“灰雁”的“灰”对应，再将整个 wiżża griża 和学名 Anser anser 放在同一张物种卡上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species called the Egyptian goose, scientifically named Alopochen aegyptiaca.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类名称“埃及雁”，学名为 Alopochen aegyptiaca；整个词组是特定物种的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa bħala wiżża tal-Eġittu, bl-isem xjentifiku Alopochen aegyptiaca.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 埃及雁，学名 Alopochen aegyptiaca。

collocations.en: a photograph of an Egyptian goose

formal.mt: It-tabella ħdejn ir-ritratt tagħti l-isem wiżża tal-Eġittu u l-isem xjentifiku Alopochen aegyptiaca.
formal.en: The sign beside the photograph gives the name Egyptian goose and the scientific name Alopochen aegyptiaca.
formal.zh: 照片旁的标牌列出了名称“埃及雁”及其学名 Alopochen aegyptiaca。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan ritratt ta' wiżża tal-Eġittu? Maja: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tabella. Ejja naqraw aktar dwarha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this a photograph of an Egyptian goose? Maja: Yes, that's what the sign says. Let's read more about it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这是一张埃及雁的照片吗？玛雅：是的，标牌上是这样写的。我们再读一点关于它的介绍吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (参观者)
messages.zh: 这是一张埃及雁的照片吗？
messages.en: Is this a photograph of an Egyptian goose?

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tabella. Ejja naqraw aktar dwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tabella. Ejja naqraw aktar dwarha.
messages.zh: 是的，标牌上是这样写的。我们再读一点关于它的介绍吧。
messages.en: Yes, that's what the sign says. Let's read more about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Eġittu 与“埃及”对应，用 tal-Eġittu 这段帮助回忆“埃及雁”；整组连读，并注意正文中的地名 Eġittu 首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bean goose, a goose species with the scientific name Anser fabalis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 豆雁，一种学名为 Anser fabalis 的雁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' wiżża bl-isem xjentifiku Anser fabalis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 豆雁（学名 Anser fabalis）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a bean goose

formal.mt: Il-gwida tidentifika l-għasfur fir-ritratt bħala wiżża tal-ful, Anser fabalis.
formal.en: The guide identifies the bird in the photograph as a bean goose, Anser fabalis.
formal.zh: 指南将照片中的鸟辨认为豆雁，学名 Anser fabalis。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-wiżża fir-ritratt? Mark: Wiżża tal-ful. Ejja nfittxu isimha fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this goose in the photograph called? Mark: A bean goose. Let's look up its name in the guide.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这种雁叫什么？马克：豆雁。我们在指南里查查它的名字吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种雁叫什么？
messages.en: What's this goose in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Wiżża tal-ful. Ejja nfittxu isimha fil-gwida.
messages.mt_standard: Wiżża tal-ful. Ejja nfittxu isimha fil-gwida.
messages.zh: 豆雁。我们在指南里查查它的名字吧。
messages.en: A bean goose. Let's look up its name in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词与一张标着“豆雁”的鸟类卡片绑定记忆，再用“豆雁的照片”练习整组提取。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The white-fronted goose, a goose species with the scientific name Anser albifrons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白额雁，一种学名为 Anser albifrons 的雁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' wiżża bl-isem xjentifiku Anser albifrons.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白额雁（学名 Anser albifrons）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a white-fronted goose

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi ritratt ta' wiżża tal-maskra u jagħti l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Anser albifrons.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a photograph of a white-fronted goose and gives its scientific name, Anser albifrons.
formal.zh: 目录收录了一张白额雁的照片，并注明其学名 Anser albifrons。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din ukoll wiżża tal-ful? Pawlu: Le, din wiżża tal-maskra. Ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a bean goose too? Pawlu: No, this is a white-fronted goose. Look at the name below the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这也是豆雁吗？保罗：不是，这是白额雁。看看照片下面的名字。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这也是豆雁吗？
messages.en: Is this a bean goose too?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, din wiżża tal-maskra. Ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Le, din wiżża tal-maskra. Ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 不是，这是白额雁。看看照片下面的名字。
messages.en: No, this is a white-fronted goose. Look at the name below the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将本词与“白额雁”配成一张卡片，再与“豆雁”卡片交替辨认，练习区分两个完整鸟名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The goose species called the red-breasted goose, scientifically named Branta ruficollis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类名称“红胸黑雁”，学名为 Branta ruficollis；应将整个词组作为物种名称学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' wiżża magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Branta ruficollis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红胸黑雁，学名 Branta ruficollis。

collocations.en: a photograph of a red-breasted goose

formal.mt: Il-katalgu juri ritratt ta' wiżża ħamra u jagħti l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Branta ruficollis.
formal.en: The catalogue shows a photograph of a red-breasted goose and gives its scientific name, Branta ruficollis.
formal.zh: 这本图录展示了一张红胸黑雁的照片，并列出了它的学名 Branta ruficollis。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema ritratt għażilt għall-proġett? Lara: Għażilt dan ta' wiżża ħamra. Issa nikteb isimha taħtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which photograph did you choose for the project? Lara: I chose this one of a red-breasted goose. Now I'll write its name underneath.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为这次课题选了哪张照片？拉拉：我选了这张红胸黑雁的照片。现在我要把它的名字写在下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为这次课题选了哪张照片？
messages.en: Which photograph did you choose for the project?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għażilt dan ta' wiżża ħamra. Issa nikteb isimha taħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Għażilt dan ta' wiżża ħamra. Issa nikteb isimha taħtu.
messages.zh: 我选了这张红胸黑雁的照片。现在我要把它的名字写在下面。
messages.en: I chose this one of a red-breasted goose. Now I'll write its name underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 ħamra“红色的”连接英文 red-breasted 和中文“红胸”，再把完整名称 wiżża ħamra 对应到“红胸黑雁”来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce an abundant yield, said of a crop or harvest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指作物产量丰富、收成丰盛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti prodott abbundanti, meta jingħad dwar il-ħsad jew l-uċuħ tar-raba'.

sense_translations.en_definition: to yield abundantly (used of a harvest)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 丰产，获得丰盛的收成；用于描述作物或收获。

collocations.en: the barley yielded abundantly this year

formal.mt: Ir-rapport agrikolu jinnota li l-qamħ wiżżen din is-sena u li l-ħsad kien abbundanti.
formal.en: The agricultural report notes that the wheat yielded abundantly this year and that the harvest was plentiful.
formal.zh: 农业报告指出，今年小麦丰产，收成丰盛。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif mar il-qamħ din is-sena? Toni: Wiżżen! Kellna ħsad tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did the wheat do this year? Toni: It yielded abundantly! We had a very good harvest.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今年小麦收成怎么样？托尼：丰收了！我们的收成非常好。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 今年小麦收成怎么样？
messages.en: How did the wheat do this year?

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.zh: 丰收了！我们的收成非常好。
messages.en: It yielded abundantly! We had a very good harvest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象麦田收获后粮袋装得满满的，用“今年小麦丰产了”这一动作画面记住动词 wiżżen。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tendency to weigh heavily or to be heavy in weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指容易压得很重或分量偏重的性质、倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tendenza li xi ħaġa tiżen ħafna jew tkun tqila fil-piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易压得很重、分量偏重的性质或倾向。

collocations.en: the word wiżżien in the glossary
collocations.zh: 词汇表中的 wiżżien 一词

formal.mt: Il-glossarju jispjega wiżżien bħala tendenza li xi ħaġa tiżen ħafna.
formal.en: The glossary explains wiżżien as a tendency for something to weigh heavily.
formal.zh: 词汇表将 wiżżien 解释为某物容易压得很重的倾向。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser wiżżien hawn? Mark: Tirreferi għat-tendenza li xi ħaġa tiżen ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does wiżżien mean here? Mark: It refers to the tendency for something to weigh heavily.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 wiżżien 是什么意思？马克：它指某物容易压得很重的倾向。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 wiżżien 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does wiżżien mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tirreferi għat-tendenza li xi ħaġa tiżen ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Tirreferi għat-tendenza li xi ħaġa tiżen ħafna.
messages.zh: 它指某物容易压得很重的倾向。
messages.en: It refers to the tendency for something to weigh heavily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只装上东西就容易压沉的袋子，把“容易分量重的倾向”作为本条名词义的记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to weigh something; also describing a harvest that yields abundantly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有称重能力的；也可形容收成丰盛、产量丰富的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jiżen; ukoll, meta jingħad dwar ħsad, li jagħti prodott abbundanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有称量重量的能力的；能称重的。
丰产的，收成丰盛的；用于描述收获。

formal.mt: Il-manwal jiddeskrivi apparat wiżżieni li jintuża biex jitkejjel il-piż tal-prodotti.
formal.en: The manual describes equipment capable of weighing that is used to measure the weight of products.
formal.zh: 手册介绍了一种具有称重能力、用于测量产品重量的设备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex sejjaħtlu ħsad wiżżieni? Toni: Għax kellna prodott abbundanti din is-sena.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you call it an abundant harvest? Toni: Because we had a plentiful yield this year.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么用 wiżżieni 来形容这次收成？托尼：因为今年我们的产量很丰富。

messages.speaker: Sara (农民的朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么用 wiżżieni 来形容这次收成？
messages.en: Why did you call it an abundant harvest?

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kellna prodott abbundanti din is-sena.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kellna prodott abbundanti din is-sena.
messages.zh: 因为今年我们的产量很丰富。
messages.en: Because we had a plentiful yield this year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 准备两个并列画面：设备正在称重量，田里收成十分丰富；分别记住“能称重的”和“丰产的”两个形容词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small cockroach; the diminutive form of the Maltese word wirdiena.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小蟑螂；马耳他语 wirdiena 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wirdiena żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' wirdiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小蟑螂；wirdiena 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small cockroach in the kitchen

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstabet wrejdna taħt l-armarju tal-kċina.
formal.en: During the inspection, a small cockroach was found beneath the kitchen cupboard.
formal.zh: 检查时，在厨房橱柜下面发现了一只小蟑螂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm wrejdna ħdejn il-bieb! Mark: Rajtha. Se nnaddaf hawn minnufih.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a small cockroach by the door! Mark: I saw it. I'll clean here right away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门边有一只小蟑螂！马克：我看到了。我马上把这里打扫一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 门边有一只小蟑螂！
messages.en: There's a small cockroach by the door!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我看到了。我马上把这里打扫一下。
messages.en: I saw it. I'll clean here right away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wirdiena 和 wrejdna 写在大小两张蟑螂图片下，用图片尺寸记住 wrejdna 是指小形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An interrogative pronoun meaning what, written with an apostrophe and joined to the following word.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“什么”的疑问代词形式，书写时带撇号并与后面的词相连。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pronom interrogattiv li jfisser xi ħaġa li wieħed irid ikun jaf, miktub b'appostrofu u magħqud mal-kelma ta' warajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 什么；用于询问事物、内容或所发生的事情。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega x'għandu jsir qabel ma jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The report explains what must be done before the work begins.
formal.zh: 报告说明了工作开始之前必须做些什么。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tixtieq tixrob? Mark: Nixtieq tazza ilma, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Sara: What would you like to drink? Mark: I'd like a glass of water, please.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想喝什么？马克：请给我一杯水。

messages.speaker: Sara (服务员)
messages.zh: 你想喝什么？
messages.en: What would you like to drink?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一杯水。
messages.en: I'd like a glass of water, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 x' 看作紧贴后词的小问号，看到 x'ġara 就整句提取“发生了什么”，同时记住撇号后不留空格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question used to ask one person what their name is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向一个人询问姓名时使用的问句，意思是“你叫什么名字？”
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mistoqsija li tuża biex issir taf l-isem tal-persuna li qed tkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你叫什么名字？

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tal-intervista, l-intervistatur staqsa lill-parteċipant: "X'jismek, jekk jogħġbok?"
formal.en: At the start of the interview, the interviewer asked the participant, "What's your name, please?"
formal.zh: 访谈开始时，访谈员问参与者：“请问你叫什么名字？”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Bonġu! X'jismek? Mark: Jisimni Mark. U int? Maja: Jisimni Maja. Għandi pjaċir!
colloquial.en: Maja: Hi! What's your name? Mark: My name is Mark. And you? Maja: My name is Maja. Nice to meet you!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你好！你叫什么名字？马克：我叫马克。你呢？玛雅：我叫玛雅。很高兴认识你！

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 你好！你叫什么名字？
messages.en: Hi! What's your name?

messages.speaker: Mark (新同学)
messages.zh: 我叫马克。你呢？
messages.en: My name is Mark. And you?

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 我叫玛雅。很高兴认识你！
messages.en: My name is Maja. Nice to meet you!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 X'jismek? 和回答 Jisimni 加姓名配成问答卡片，见面时整句提取，比逐字翻译更容易记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of having eaten enough to feel full; also an excessive quantity of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃够之后感到饱足的状态；也指某种东西过多、超出所需的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' min ikun kiel biżżejjed u ma jibqax bil-ġuħ; ukoll kwantità żejda ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饱足，已经吃饱而不再饥饿的状态。
某物过量的数量；多得过头的一大堆。

formal.mt: Fid-djarju tiegħu, l-istudent iddeskriva sens ta' xaba wara l-ikla.
formal.en: In his diary, the student described a feeling of satiety after the meal.
formal.zh: 这名学生在日记中描述了饭后的饱足感。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi xaba xogħol illum. Maja: Nista' ngħinek wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Mark: I've got far too much work today. Maja: I can help you this afternoon.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我今天的工作多得过头了。玛雅：我下午可以帮你。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我今天的工作多得过头了。
messages.en: I've got far too much work today.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我下午可以帮你。
messages.en: I can help you this afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分别记义：饭后摸肚子表示“饱足”，桌上工作堆满表示“数量过多”，不要把两义混成一种情绪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To satisfy someone's hunger, or to make someone feel they have had enough of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人吃饱，或使某人对某事达到已经受够的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel lil xi ħadd iħossu mimli bl-ikel, jew li twasslu biex iħoss li kellu biżżejjed minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使吃饱；使饥饿得到充分满足。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bring someone to the point where they have had enough
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人受够；使某人达到不想再接受或忍受的程度。

collocations.en: made everyone fed up with his talking
collocations.zh: 说个不停，让大家都受够了

formal.mt: L-ikel li tqassam waqt l-attività xabba' lit-tfal kollha.
formal.en: The food distributed during the activity satisfied all the children's hunger.
formal.zh: 活动期间分发的食物让所有孩子都吃饱了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-ikel xabba' lil kulħadd? Lara: Iva, kien hemm biżżejjed u ħadd ma baqa' bil-ġuħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the food fill everyone up? Lara: Yes, there was enough, and nobody was left hungry.
colloquial.zh: Maja：大家都吃饱了吗？Lara：是的，食物够吃，没有人还饿着。

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.zh: 大家都吃饱了吗？
messages.en: Did the food fill everyone up?

messages.speaker: Lara (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien hemm biżżejjed u ħadd ma baqa' bil-ġuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien hemm biżżejjed u ħadd ma baqa' bil-ġuħ.
messages.zh: 是的，食物够吃，没有人还饿着。
messages.en: Yes, there was enough, and nobody was left hungry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上两个画面记忆：饭菜让人吃饱，唠叨让人受够；共同提示是“已经够了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make or help someone climb onto or up something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人攀爬，或帮助某人爬上某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġġiegħel jew tgħin lil xi ħadd jitla' fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使攀爬；让某人爬上某物。
将人或物悬持在边缘外侧。

collocations.en: made the boy climb onto a chair
helped the girl climb onto a low wall

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, l-għalliem xabbat lit-tifla fuq ħajt baxx u għenha żżomm il-bilanċ.
formal.en: During the exercise, the teacher helped the girl climb onto a low wall and helped her keep her balance.
formal.zh: 练习时，老师帮助女孩爬上矮墙，并帮助她保持平衡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min xabbat lil Ben fuq is-siġġu? Lara: Missieru, biex ikun jista' jara aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who helped Ben climb onto the chair? Lara: His father, so he could see better.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁帮Ben爬到椅子上了？Lara：他爸爸，好让他看得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (亲友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min xabbat lil Ben fuq is-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Min xabbat lil Ben fuq is-siġġu?
messages.zh: 谁帮Ben爬到椅子上了？
messages.en: Who helped Ben climb onto the chair?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieru, biex ikun jista' jara aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Missieru, biex ikun jista' jara aħjar.
messages.zh: 他爸爸，好让他看得更清楚。
messages.en: His father, so he could see better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“有人帮助孩子往上爬”的画面记主要义；另做一张“悬在边缘外”的卡片，分开复习第二义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pomelo (Citrus maxima), a large citrus fruit with a thick rind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 柚子，学名 Citrus maxima，是一种果皮较厚的大型柑橘类水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta taċ-ċitru kbira b'qoxra ħoxna, magħrufa xjentifikament bħala Citrus maxima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柚子（Citrus maxima）。

formal.mt: Għall-insalata tal-frott, qaxxar ix-xadokk u neħħi ż-żerriegħa.
formal.en: For the fruit salad, peel the pomelo and remove the seeds.
formal.zh: 制作水果沙拉时，给柚子去皮并去掉籽。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek xadokk illum? Rita: Iva, trid wieħed kbir jew wieħed iżgħar?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have pomelos today? Rita: Yes, would you like a large one or a smaller one?
colloquial.zh: Mark：今天有柚子吗？Rita：有，你要一个大的，还是小一点的？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有柚子吗？
messages.en: Do you have pomelos today?

messages.speaker: Rita (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid wieħed kbir jew wieħed iżgħar?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid wieħed kbir jew wieħed iżgħar?
messages.zh: 有，你要一个大的，还是小一点的？
messages.en: Yes, would you like a large one or a smaller one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在柚子图片旁写上 xadokk，再把“剥厚皮、分果肉、榨果汁”三个动作连成购物记忆场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shudder, with a sudden shaking movement of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体突然颤抖一下；打颤或打寒战。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġismek jitriegħed għal għarrieda, bħal meta tħoss il-bard jew il-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打颤；身体突然颤抖。
刺；用尖锐物刺入。

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-ħoss qawwi, it-tifel xaf bil-biża'.
formal.en: When he heard the loud noise, the boy shuddered with fear.
formal.zh: 听到巨响时，男孩吓得打了个颤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex xaf Mark? Lara: Xaf bil-bard meta ħareġ mill-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark shudder? Lara: He shuddered from the cold when he came out of the water.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么打了个颤？Lara：他从水里出来时冷得打了个寒战。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么打了个颤？
messages.en: Why did Mark shudder?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他从水里出来时冷得打了个寒战。
messages.en: He shuddered from the cold when he came out of the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“出水后一哆嗦”记打颤义；刺的义项另配动作图，靠句中语境区分，不把两义强行连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sharpen something or form a cutting edge on it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体磨得锋利，或在其边缘加工出刀刃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel xi ħaġa taqta' aħjar, jew li tagħmlilha xifer li jaqta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨利；使更加锋利。
制作刃口；给物体开刃。

formal.mt: Il-kok xaffar is-sikkina qabel beda jaqta' l-ħaxix.
formal.en: The cook sharpened the knife before starting to cut the vegetables.
formal.zh: 厨师开始切蔬菜之前，先磨利了刀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min xaffar is-sikkina? Lara: Pawlu. Issa taqta' ħafna aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who sharpened the knife? Lara: Pawlu did. It cuts much better now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁磨了这把刀？Lara：Pawlu磨的。现在好切多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁磨了这把刀？
messages.en: Who sharpened the knife?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: Pawlu磨的。现在好切多了。
messages.en: Pawlu did. It cuts much better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钝刀经过打磨，刃口变得锋利；用同一幅前后对比图记住“磨利”和“开刃”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Occurring every month, or calculated or paid for each month.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 每个月发生的，或以一个月为单位计算、支付的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir kull xahar, jew li jiġi kkalkulat jew imħallas għal kull xahar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每月的；按月发生、计算或支付的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport xahri jiġbor l-attivitajiet kollha li saru matul ix-xahar.
formal.en: The monthly report brings together all the activities carried out during the month.
formal.zh: 月度报告汇总了该月开展的全部活动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħlas huwa xahri? Rita: Iva, tħallas darba kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this payment monthly? Rita: Yes, you pay once every month.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这笔费用是按月付的吗？Rita：是的，每个月付一次。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这笔费用是按月付的吗？
messages.en: Is this payment monthly?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务人员)
messages.zh: 是的，每个月付一次。
messages.en: Yes, you pay once every month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xahri 写在日历每个月的同一天，再配上付款和交报告的图标，记住它表示“每月的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To curse someone or something by invoking the devil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在咒骂某人或某事时，提及或借用魔鬼之名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisħet lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa billi jsejjaħ lix-xitan.

sense_translations.en_definition: to curse by invoking the devil
sense_translations.zh_definition: 借魔鬼之名进行咒骂。

collocations.en: he cursed in anger, invoking the devil
collocations.zh: 他愤怒地借魔鬼之名咒骂

collocations.en: he cursed during the quarrel, invoking the devil
collocations.zh: 他在争吵时借魔鬼之名咒骂

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel xajtan meta sema' l-aħbar ħażina, iżda wara talab skuża għal kliemu.
formal.en: In the story, the man cursed by invoking the devil when he heard the bad news, but later apologized for his words.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个男人听到坏消息时借魔鬼之名咒骂，但后来为自己的言辞道了歉。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex telqet Anna? Pawlu: Għax Toni xajtan waqt il-ġlieda, u hi ma riditx tisma' kliem bħal dak.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Anna leave? Pawlu: Because Toni cursed during the quarrel, invoking the devil, and she didn't want to hear language like that.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：安娜为什么走了？保罗：因为托尼争吵时借魔鬼之名咒骂，她不想听那样的话。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 安娜为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Anna leave?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Toni xajtan waqt il-ġlieda, u hi ma riditx tisma' kliem bħal dak.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Toni xajtan waqt il-ġlieda, u hi ma riditx tisma' kliem bħal dak.
messages.zh: 因为托尼争吵时借魔鬼之名咒骂，她不想听那样的话。
messages.en: Because Toni cursed during the quarrel, invoking the devil, and she didn't want to hear language like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个人生气时把魔鬼挂在嘴边的场景记忆；此处是表示咒骂动作的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of cursing by invoking the devil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在咒骂中提及或借用魔鬼之名的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jisħet billi jsejjaħ lix-xitan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借魔鬼之名进行的咒骂；这种咒骂行为。

collocations.en: words of cursing that invoke the devil
collocations.zh: 借魔鬼之名咒骂的话语

collocations.en: cursing that invokes the devil during an argument
collocations.zh: 争论时借魔鬼之名的咒骂

formal.mt: L-awtur juża kliem ta' xajtin fid-djalogu biex juri r-rabja tal-karattru.
formal.en: The author uses words of cursing that invoke the devil in the dialogue to show the character's anger.
formal.zh: 作者在对话中使用借魔鬼之名咒骂的话语，以表现人物的愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'kien dak il-kliem ta' xajtin li smajt? Ben: Toni kien irrabjat, imma issa kkalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was that cursing invoking the devil that I heard? Ben: Toni was angry, but he's calmed down now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我刚才听见的那些借魔鬼之名咒骂的话是怎么回事？本：托尼刚才很生气，不过现在已经平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak il-kliem ta' xajtin li smajt?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak il-kliem ta' xajtin li smajt?
messages.zh: 我刚才听见的那些借魔鬼之名咒骂的话是怎么回事？
messages.en: What was that cursing invoking the devil that I heard?

messages.speaker: Ben (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni kien irrabjat, imma issa kkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Toni kien irrabjat, imma issa kkalma.
messages.zh: 托尼刚才很生气，不过现在已经平静下来了。
messages.en: Toni was angry, but he's calmed down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记作给咒骂行为贴上的名词标签：重点是借魔鬼之名说出的咒骂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wander from place to place like a tramp, without a settled destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像流浪汉一样从一个地方游荡到另一个地方，没有固定目的地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idur minn post għal ieħor bħal vagabond, bla destinazzjoni fissa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像流浪汉一样四处游荡。

collocations.en: he wandered aimlessly like a tramp
collocations.zh: 他像流浪汉一样漫无目的地游荡

collocations.en: he wandered like a tramp from village to village
collocations.zh: 他像流浪汉一样在村庄之间辗转游荡

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist xal minn raħal għal ieħor, bla dar fissa u bla destinazzjoni.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist wandered like a tramp from village to village, with no fixed home or destination.
formal.zh: 小说中，主人公像流浪汉一样在村庄之间辗转游荡，既无固定住所，也无目的地。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'għamel il-karattru wara li telaq mid-dar? David: Xal minn post għal ieħor għal xhur sħaħ.
colloquial.en: Lina: What did the character do after leaving home? David: He wandered like a tramp from place to place for months.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：那个人物离家后做了什么？戴维：他像流浪汉一样四处游荡了好几个月。

messages.speaker: Lina (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel il-karattru wara li telaq mid-dar?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel il-karattru wara li telaq mid-dar?
messages.zh: 那个人物离家后做了什么？
messages.en: What did the character do after leaving home?

messages.speaker: David (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xal minn post għal ieħor għal xhur sħaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Xal minn post għal ieħor għal xhur sħaħ.
messages.zh: 他像流浪汉一样四处游荡了好几个月。
messages.en: He wandered like a tramp from place to place for months.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象背着小包、没有固定去处的人在村庄之间游荡，用这个画面记住动词含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a very enjoyable time and enjoy oneself thoroughly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某次活动或经历中玩得非常开心，尽情享受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu gost ħafna u jgawdi ruħu bis-sħiħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩得很开心；度过非常愉快的时光。
尽情享受；玩得十分尽兴。

collocations.en: he had a great time with friends
collocations.zh: 他和朋友们玩得很开心

collocations.en: he thoroughly enjoyed himself at the celebration
collocations.zh: 他在庆祝活动中玩得十分尽兴

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara, Pawlu xala mal-ħbieb tiegħu u ħa sehem fl-attivitajiet kollha.
formal.en: During the visit, Pawlu had a great time with his friends and took part in all the activities.
formal.zh: 到访期间，保罗和朋友们玩得很开心，并参加了所有活动。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif mar Pawlu fil-festa? Rita: Xala! Baqa' jiżfen sal-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did Pawlu get on at the party? Rita: He had a great time! He kept dancing until the end.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗在聚会上玩得怎么样？丽塔：他玩得可痛快了！一直跳舞到最后。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在聚会上玩得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get on at the party?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他玩得可痛快了！一直跳舞到最后。
messages.en: He had a great time! He kept dancing until the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和聚会上笑着跳舞到最后的画面相连，记住这个动词强调玩得开心又尽兴。

gloss_zh: 出游；尽兴玩乐；欢乐活动；主保圣人庆节次日的村民出游

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outing or occasion of lively enjoyment; also a village outing traditionally held the day after a patron saint's feast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次出游或尽兴玩乐的欢乐活动；也指传统上在主保圣人庆节次日举行的村民出游。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħarġa jew okkażjoni ta' gost kbir; ukoll ħarġa tar-raħal li tradizzjonalment issir l-għada tal-festa tal-qaddis patrun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次外出游玩；出游活动。
一番尽情玩乐或纵情享受。
一次令人愉快的活动或场合。
一段极其愉快、玩得十分尽兴的时光。

sense_translations.en_definition: a village outing traditionally held on the day following a patron saint's feast
sense_translations.zh_definition: 传统上在主保圣人庆节次日举行的村民出游活动。

collocations.en: the traditional outing after the patron saint's feast
collocations.zh: 主保圣人庆节后的传统出游

collocations.en: an enjoyable outing by the sea

formal.mt: L-għada tal-festa tal-qaddis patrun, ir-residenti organizzaw xalata ħdejn il-baħar għall-familji tar-raħal.
formal.en: On the day after the patron saint's feast, the residents organized a seaside outing for the village families.
formal.zh: 主保圣人庆节次日，居民们为村里的家庭组织了一次海边出游。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Tiġi magħna għal xalata ħdejn il-baħar nhar il-Ħadd? Ġanni: Iva! Inġib xi ikel biex naqsmuh bejnietna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are you coming with us for a seaside outing on Sunday? Ġanni: Yes! I'll bring some food for us to share.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：星期天你和我们一起去海边玩吗？詹尼：去！我带点吃的，大家一起分享。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiġi magħna għal xalata ħdejn il-baħar nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Tiġi magħna għal xalata ħdejn il-baħar nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 星期天你和我们一起去海边玩吗？
messages.en: Are you coming with us for a seaside outing on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Inġib xi ikel biex naqsmuh bejnietna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Inġib xi ikel biex naqsmuh bejnietna.
messages.zh: 去！我带点吃的，大家一起分享。
messages.en: Yes! I'll bring some food for us to share.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一群人带着食物开心出游的画面串联各义；遇到庆节语境，再联想到节日次日的村民出游。

gloss_zh: 享乐者；玩得尽兴的人；放纵无度的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who seeks or enjoys pleasure; in a disapproving sense, someone whose conduct is licentious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 追求享乐或玩得尽兴的人；在贬义语境中，也指行为放荡、放纵无度的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfittex il-pjaċir jew tgawdi ruħha; f'sens ta' ċanfira, persuna ta' mġiba bla rażan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 享乐主义者；把追求快乐和享受看得很重要的人。
玩得开心、尽情享受的人。
行为放荡、不受道德约束的人；含贬义。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-awtur jippreżenta lill-karattru bħala xalatur li jqiegħed il-pjaċir qabel ir-responsabbiltà.
formal.en: In the novel, the author presents the character as a hedonist who puts pleasure before responsibility.
formal.zh: 小说中，作者把这个人物描写成一个将享乐置于责任之前的享乐主义者。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif kien Toni fil-festa? Mark: Xalatur kif nafuh! Għadda l-lejl jiżfen u jidħak.
colloquial.en: Nina: What was Toni like at the party? Mark: Enjoying himself as usual! He spent the night dancing and laughing.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：托尼在聚会上怎么样？马克：还是我们熟悉的那个爱玩的人！他整晚又跳舞又大笑。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼在聚会上怎么样？
messages.en: What was Toni like at the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xalatur kif nafuh! Għadda l-lejl jiżfen u jidħak.
messages.mt_standard: Xalatur kif nafuh! Għadda l-lejl jiżfen u jidħak.
messages.zh: 还是我们熟悉的那个爱玩的人！他整晚又跳舞又大笑。
messages.en: Enjoying himself as usual! He spent the night dancing and laughing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给聚会上尽兴玩乐的人贴上这个人物标签；结合上下文判断是普通爱玩、追求享乐，还是贬义的放荡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Xam is another name for Damasku, Damascus, the capital city of Syria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Xam 是 Damasku 的同义地名，指叙利亚首都大马士革。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xam huwa isem ieħor għal Damasku, il-belt kapitali tas-Sirja.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of Damasku: Damascus (the capital city of Syria)
sense_translations.zh_definition: Damasku 的同义地名：大马士革，叙利亚的首都。

formal.mt: Fit-test, l-isem Xam jirreferi għal Damasku, il-belt kapitali tas-Sirja.
formal.en: In the text, the name Xam refers to Damascus, the capital city of Syria.
formal.zh: 文中，Xam 这个名称指的是叙利亚首都大马士革。

colloquial.mt: Lea: Fejn hi Xam fuq il-mappa? Samwel: Fis-Sirja. Hija l-istess belt li nsejħulha Damasku.
colloquial.en: Lea: Where is Xam on the map? Samwel: In Syria. It's the same city we call Damasku.
colloquial.zh: 莱娅：Xam 在地图上的哪里？萨姆韦尔：在叙利亚。它就是我们称作 Damasku 的大马士革。

messages.speaker: Lea (学生)
messages.zh: Xam 在地图上的哪里？
messages.en: Where is Xam on the map?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-Sirja. Hija l-istess belt li nsejħulha Damasku.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-Sirja. Hija l-istess belt li nsejħulha Damasku.
messages.zh: 在叙利亚。它就是我们称作 Damasku 的大马士革。
messages.en: In Syria. It's the same city we call Damasku.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在同一个地图标记旁写下 Xam、Damasku 和大马士革，记住三个名称指向同一座城市；地名首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 大马士革的；大马士革人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Damascus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自大马士革的，或与大马士革有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Damasku jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Damasku.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of Damaskin: Damascene (of, from or relating to Damascus)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 Damaskin 同义：大马士革的、来自大马士革的，或与大马士革有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of Damaskin: Damascene (native or inhabitant of Damascus)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 Damaskin 同义：大马士革本地人或居民。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jippreżenta artist Xami u jiddeskrivi r-rabta tiegħu ma' Damasku.
formal.en: The catalogue presents a Damascene artist and describes his connection with Damascus.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了一位大马士革艺术家，并说明了他与大马士革的联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-artist Xami? Mark: Iva, ġej minn Damasku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this artist Damascene? Mark: Yes, he comes from Damascus.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这位艺术家是大马士革人吗？Mark：是的，他来自大马士革。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这位艺术家是大马士革人吗？
messages.en: Is this artist Damascene?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.zh: 是的，他来自大马士革。
messages.en: Yes, he comes from Damascus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Xami 放在一张写有“大马士革”的城市名片上：修饰艺术家或风格时表示“大马士革的”，单独作名词时表示当地人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of smelling; also a slight indication or hint of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用鼻子闻一下的动作；也可指某事的一丝迹象或暗示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xxomm xi ħaġa; ukoll ħjiel żgħir ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次嗅闻；用鼻子闻一下的动作。
一丝迹象、暗示或苗头。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tar-rapport hemm xamma ta' bidla fil-politika tal-organizzazzjoni.
formal.en: At the end of the report, there is a hint of a change in the organisation's policy.
formal.zh: 报告末尾透露出该组织政策可能改变的一丝迹象。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-fjura tfuħ? Toni: Agħtiha xamma u għidli x'taħseb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this flower smell nice? Toni: Give it a sniff and tell me what you think.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这朵花香吗？Toni：闻一下，再告诉我你觉得怎么样。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这朵花香吗？
messages.en: Does this flower smell nice?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 闻一下，再告诉我你觉得怎么样。
messages.en: Give it a sniff and tell me what you think.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先把鼻子凑近花朵“闻一下”，再从细微线索中“闻出变化的苗头”；用这两个画面连接嗅闻和暗示两义。

gloss_zh: 从事广播的；爱泄露私事的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Employed in broadcasting, or inclined to reveal private information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以广播工作为职业的；也指倾向于把私人信息说出去的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xogħlu hu fix-xandir; jew li għandu ħabta jikxef informazzjoni privata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事广播工作的；以广播为职业的。
爱把私人信息透露出去的；容易泄露他人私事的。

collocations.en: an employee whose job is broadcasting
collocations.zh: 一名从事广播工作的雇员

collocations.en: a person inclined to reveal private information

formal.mt: L-impjegat xandari għandu jivverifika l-informazzjoni qabel ix-xandira.
formal.en: The employee working in broadcasting should verify the information before the broadcast.
formal.zh: 从事广播工作的雇员应在播出前核实信息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' ngħid sigriet lil Pawlu? Sara: Aħjar le; hu xandari u jista' jgħidu lil ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I tell Pawlu a secret? Sara: Better not; he tends to reveal private information and might tell someone else.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我能把秘密告诉 Pawlu 吗？Sara：最好别；他爱泄露私事，可能会告诉别人。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能把秘密告诉 Pawlu 吗？
messages.en: Can I tell Pawlu a secret?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le; hu xandari u jista' jgħidu lil ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le; hu xandari u jista' jgħidu lil ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 最好别；他爱泄露私事，可能会告诉别人。
messages.en: Better not; he tends to reveal private information and might tell someone else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个教学画面记忆：一个人在广播台工作，另一个人把秘密说给大家听。两者帮助区分职业义和爱泄露私事义，不表示广播从业者都爱泄密。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of broadcasting, or the media considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 播送节目或信息的活动；也可统称媒体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li jixxandru programmi jew informazzjoni; ukoll il-mezzi tal-komunikazzjoni b'mod ġenerali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 广播；向公众播送节目或信息的活动。
媒体的统称。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina r-rwol tax-xandir fit-tixrid tal-informazzjoni lill-pubbliku.
formal.en: The report examines the role of broadcasting in disseminating information to the public.
formal.zh: 该报告探讨广播在向公众传播信息方面的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm xandir dirett tal-logħba llejla? Mark: Iva, jibda fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there a live broadcast of the match tonight? Mark: Yes, it starts at eight.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚有比赛直播吗？Mark：有，八点开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷)
messages.zh: 今晚有比赛直播吗？
messages.en: Is there a live broadcast of the match tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，八点开始。
messages.en: Yes, it starts at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象节目从一个播送台传向许多听众：关注播送活动时记作“广播”，把提供信息的传播渠道合起来看时记作“媒体”。

gloss_zh: 筋骨草属植物；特指 Ajuga iva 或匍匐筋骨草

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant of the genus Ajuga, especially Ajuga iva or Ajuga reptans.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 筋骨草属的植物，尤其指 Ajuga iva 或匍匐筋骨草 Ajuga reptans。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ġeneru Ajuga, speċjalment Ajuga iva jew Ajuga reptans.

sense_translations.en_definition: carpet bugle (Ajuga gen. et spp., or particularly Ajuga iva and Ajuga reptans)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 筋骨草属及其种类的植物；尤指 Ajuga iva 和匍匐筋骨草 Ajuga reptans。

collocations.en: the leaves of an Ajuga plant

formal.mt: Il-gwida botanika tuża l-isem xantkura għal pjanti tal-ġeneru Ajuga, fosthom Ajuga iva u Ajuga reptans.
formal.en: The botanical guide uses the name xantkura for plants of the genus Ajuga, including Ajuga iva and Ajuga reptans.
formal.zh: 这本植物指南用 xantkura 称呼筋骨草属植物，其中包括 Ajuga iva 和 Ajuga reptans。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Toni: Xantkura; ejja nfittxuha fil-gwida tal-pjanti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this plant called? Toni: Xantkura; let's look it up in the plant guide.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这株植物叫什么？Toni：叫 xantkura；我们去植物指南里查查吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 叫 xantkura；我们去植物指南里查查吧。
messages.en: Xantkura; let's look it up in the plant guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张植物识别卡，正面写 xantkura，背面写“筋骨草属 Ajuga”，再并列标出 iva 和 reptans，帮助记住这个名称的指称范围。

gloss_zh: 大量涂洒液体；用水浇湿；浸蘸；爱浸蘸食物的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply a liquid generously to a surface, douse something with water, or dunk bread or biscuits in a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体大量涂洒在表面上，用水浇湿某物，或把面包、饼干浸蘸在液体中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Japplika likwidu bil-kotra fuq wiċċ, ixarrab xi ħaġa bl-ilma, jew jgħaddas ħobż jew gallettini f'likwidu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to apply generously (used of liquids on a surface)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把液体大量涂洒在某个表面上。
用水浇湿或泼湿。

sense_translations.en_definition: to dunk (used of biscuits or bread)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把饼干或面包放入液体中浸蘸。
喜欢把饼干或面包浸蘸在液体中吃的人。

collocations.en: he applied oil generously to the surface
collocations.zh: 他在表面上涂了大量油

collocations.en: he doused the shirt with water
he dunked the biscuit in the tea
collocations.zh: 他把饼干放进茶里浸了一下

formal.mt: Qabel it-tindif, il-ħaddiem xappap il-wiċċ bl-ilma.
formal.en: Before cleaning, the worker doused the surface with water.
formal.zh: 清洁之前，工人用水把表面浇湿了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-gallettina ta' Mark kollha mxarrba? Lara: Għax xappap il-gallettina fit-te.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Mark's biscuit all wet? Lara: Because he dunked the biscuit in the tea.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 的饼干怎么全湿了？Lara：因为他把饼干放进茶里浸过了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-gallettina ta' Mark kollha mxarrba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-gallettina ta' Mark kollha mxarrba?
messages.zh: Mark 的饼干怎么全湿了？
messages.en: Why is Mark's biscuit all wet?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他把饼干放进茶里浸过了。
messages.en: Because he dunked the biscuit in the tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅液体接触物体的画面记动词：表面大量涂油、衬衫被水浇湿、饼干浸入茶中；另给爱蘸饼干的人画个人像，单独记住名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Habitually dunking bread or biscuits in a drink or another liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 习惯把面包或饼干浸蘸在饮料等液体中吃的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-drawwa jgħaddas ħobż jew gallettini f'xarba jew f'likwidu ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有把面包或饼干浸蘸在液体中吃的习惯的。

collocations.en: a boy who habitually dunks his food
collocations.zh: 一个习惯把食物浸蘸着吃的男孩

collocations.en: a man who habitually dunks his food
collocations.zh: 一个习惯把食物浸蘸着吃的男人

formal.mt: It-tifel xappapi jgħaddas il-gallettini fil-ħalib kull filgħodu.
formal.en: The boy who habitually dunks his food dips his biscuits in milk every morning.
formal.zh: 这个习惯浸蘸食物的男孩每天早晨都把饼干蘸在牛奶里吃。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark dejjem jgħaddas il-ħobż fil-kafè? Nina: Iva, hu xappapi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does Mark always dunk his bread in coffee? Nina: Yes, he is a habitual dunker.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 总是把面包蘸在咖啡里吃吗？Nina：对，他有这个习惯。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 总是把面包蘸在咖啡里吃吗？
messages.en: Does Mark always dunk his bread in coffee?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，他有这个习惯。
messages.en: Yes, he is a habitual dunker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人每天早餐都把饼干蘸进杯子：xappapi 描述的是这个人的惯常习惯，记忆重点放在“经常这样吃”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wish for something or want a particular situation to come about.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希望得到某物，或希望某种情况发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu xewqa għal xi ħaġa jew jixtieq li sseħħ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；怀有愿望。

collocations.en: he wished to see his family

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, Pawlu xaq li jerġa' jara lil familtu.
formal.en: In his letter, Pawlu expressed a wish to see his family again.
formal.zh: Pawlu 在信中表达了希望再次见到家人的愿望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xaq li jirritorna Pawlu? Mark: Iva, ried jerġa' jara lil familtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu wish to return? Mark: Yes, he wanted to see his family again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 希望回来吗？Mark：是的，他想再见见家人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 希望回来吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu wish to return?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ried jerġa' jara lil familtu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ried jerġa' jara lil familtu.
messages.zh: 是的，他想再见见家人。
messages.en: Yes, he wanted to see his family again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xaq 写在一张愿望卡上，旁边画出“回家”和“见家人”两个画面；用想要实现某件事的心情记住它的动词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A leaning or inclination, describing a tilted position or a tendency towards something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾斜的状态，也可指朝向某事物的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' inklinazzjoni lejn naħa, jew tendenza lejn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾斜；向一侧偏斜的状态。
倾向；朝某一方向偏移的趋势或偏好。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi x-xaqlib tal-ħajt lejn it-triq u jirrakkomanda spezzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the wall's leaning towards the road and recommends an inspection.
formal.zh: 报告描述了墙体朝道路倾斜的情况，并建议进行检查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara x-xaqlib ta' din l-ixkaffa? Mark: Iva, qed tmil lejn il-lemin. Ejja nneħħu l-kotba minn fuqha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see the lean of this shelf? Mark: Yes, it's leaning to the right. Let's take the books off it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到这个架子歪了吗？马克：看到了，它往右倾斜。我们把上面的书拿下来吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara x-xaqlib ta' din l-ixkaffa?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara x-xaqlib ta' din l-ixkaffa?
messages.zh: 你看到这个架子歪了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the lean of this shelf?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed tmil lejn il-lemin. Ejja nneħħu l-kotba minn fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed tmil lejn il-lemin. Ejja nneħħu l-kotba minn fuqha.
messages.zh: 看到了，它往右倾斜。我们把上面的书拿下来吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's leaning to the right. Let's take the books off it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个向右歪的书架，用 xaqlib 记住“倾斜”；再把画面换成心意偏向艺术，连接“倾向”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slope, or one side or part of a place such as a village or town.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 斜坡，也可指村庄、城镇等地方的某一侧或某一片区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art imżerżqa, jew naħa ta' post bħal raħal jew belt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斜坡；呈倾斜状态的一段地面。

sense_translations.en_definition: one side of a place (e.g. a village or town)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某地的一侧或一片区域，例如村庄或城镇的某一边。

collocations.en: the western side of the village

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi xaqliba wieqfa fix-xaqliba tat-tramuntana tar-raħal.
formal.en: The map shows a steep slope on the northern side of the village.
formal.zh: 地图显示，村庄北侧有一处陡坡。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn toqgħod in-nanna tiegħek? Pawlu: Fix-xaqliba tal-punent tar-raħal, ħdejn il-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where does your grandmother live? Pawlu: On the western side of the village, near the garden.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你奶奶住在哪里？保罗：在村庄西侧，花园附近。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你奶奶住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your grandmother live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在村庄西侧，花园附近。
messages.en: On the western side of the village, near the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一张村庄地图：先圈出一段斜坡，再圈出村庄西侧；两个位置都可帮助记住 xaqliba 的不同义项。

gloss_zh: 翻飞鸽的（用于指定鸽类的短语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used in the expressions 'ħamiem xaqliban' and 'ħamiem tax-xaqliban' to identify tumbler pigeons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于 ħamiem xaqliban 或 ħamiem tax-xaqliban 这类短语，指称翻飞鸽这一类鸽子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża fil-frażijiet 'ħamiem xaqliban' u 'ħamiem tax-xaqliban' biex jindika tip ta' ħamiem.

sense_translations.en_definition: Occurring in the phrase 'ħamiem xaqliban/ħamiem tax-xaqliban', tumbler (king of pigeon)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于 ħamiem xaqliban 或 ħamiem tax-xaqliban 短语，指翻飞鸽这一类鸽子。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-wirja jinkludi taqsima dwar il-ħamiem xaqliban.
formal.en: The exhibition catalogue includes a section on tumbler pigeons.
formal.zh: 展览目录中设有介绍翻飞鸽的部分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tip ta' ħamiem hu dan? Toni: Dan hu ħamiem xaqliban. Ejja naraw il-bqija tal-wirja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What kind of pigeons are these? Toni: These are tumbler pigeons. Let's see the rest of the exhibition.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些是什么品种的鸽子？托尼：这些是翻飞鸽。我们去看看展览的其他部分吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 这些是什么品种的鸽子？
messages.en: What kind of pigeons are these?

messages.speaker: Toni (参观同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu ħamiem xaqliban. Ejja naraw il-bqija tal-wirja.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu ħamiem xaqliban. Ejja naraw il-bqija tal-wirja.
messages.zh: 这些是翻飞鸽。我们去看看展览的其他部分吧。
messages.en: These are tumbler pigeons. Let's see the rest of the exhibition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħamiem xaqliban 整组写在一张鸽类展览标签上，联想“翻飞鸽”；按固定短语记忆，比单独猜测形容词含义更稳妥。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tends to knock or topple things over.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常或容易把东西碰倒、弄翻的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha t-tendenza twaqqa' jew taqleb l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who tends to topple things over
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易把东西弄翻或碰倒的人。

collocations.en: someone who tends to topple things over

collocations.mt: xaqlieb li dejjem iwaqqa' xi ħaġa
collocations.en: a person who is always knocking something over

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-karattru ewlieni huwa xaqlieb li spiss iwaqqa' l-oġġetti minn fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is someone who tends to topple things over and often knocks objects off the table.
formal.zh: 故事中的主角是个容易碰翻东西的人，常常把桌上的物品碰落。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien xaqlieb; erġajt waqqajt il-flixkun. Maja: Ejja npoġġuh fin-nofs tal-mejda, fejn hemm aktar spazju.
colloquial.en: Mark: I tend to knock things over; I've knocked the bottle over again. Maja: Let's put it in the middle of the table, where there's more room.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我就是容易碰翻东西，又把瓶子碰倒了。玛雅：我们把它放到桌子中间吧，那里空间大些。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我就是容易碰翻东西，又把瓶子碰倒了。
messages.en: I tend to knock things over; I've knocked the bottle over again.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja npoġġuh fin-nofs tal-mejda, fejn hemm aktar spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja npoġġuh fin-nofs tal-mejda, fejn hemm aktar spazju.
messages.zh: 我们把它放到桌子中间吧，那里空间大些。
messages.en: Let's put it in the middle of the table, where there's more room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人转身时总把桌边瓶子碰倒，把 xaqlieb 贴在这个人物旁；记住它是指“人”的名词。

gloss_zh: 容易弄翻东西的；偏爱某事的；倾向某观点的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prone to toppling things over, or inclined towards a particular activity, thing, or view.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容易把东西弄翻，也可表示偏爱某事物，或倾向某种观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jwaqqa' jew jaqleb l-affarijiet, jew li jxaqleb lejn xi ħaġa jew opinjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易把东西弄翻或碰倒的。
偏爱某事物的；对某事有特别爱好的。

sense_translations.en_definition: holding a preference for a particular view
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向或偏好某种特定观点的。

collocations.en: prone to toppling things over when carrying trays
collocations.zh: 端托盘时容易弄翻东西的

collocations.en: inclined in favour of this view

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tiegħu, l-awtur jidher xaqliebi favur il-fehma li l-edukazzjoni għandha tingħata prijorità.
formal.en: In his analysis, the author appears inclined towards the view that education should be given priority.
formal.zh: 在分析中，作者似乎倾向于认为教育应获优先考虑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tippreferi l-mużika jew l-isport? Pawlu: Jien xaqliebi lejn il-mużika; inħobb indoqq il-kitarra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you prefer music or sport? Pawlu: I'm inclined towards music; I like playing the guitar.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你更喜欢音乐还是运动？保罗：我偏爱音乐，我喜欢弹吉他。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你更喜欢音乐还是运动？
messages.en: Do you prefer music or sport?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien xaqliebi lejn il-mużika; inħobb indoqq il-kitarra.
messages.mt_standard: Jien xaqliebi lejn il-mużika; inħobb indoqq il-kitarra.
messages.zh: 我偏爱音乐，我喜欢弹吉他。
messages.en: I'm inclined towards music; I like playing the guitar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画记 xaqliebi：手把瓶子碰倒、心偏向音乐、意见偏向某方；它是描述这些倾向的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break clay into separate shards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把陶土打碎，使其成为一片片碎块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kisser it-tafal f'biċċiet jew fi xquq żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把陶土打成碎片或碎块。

collocations.en: broke a piece of dry clay into shards
collocations.zh: 把一块干陶土打成了碎片

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliem xaqqaf biċċa tafal niexef u qiegħed il-biċċiet fuq trej.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the teacher broke a piece of dry clay into shards and placed the pieces on a tray.
formal.zh: 演示时，老师把一块干陶土打成碎片，并将碎片放在托盘上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel l-għalliem bit-tafal? Toni: Xaqqaf it-tafal u wriena l-biċċiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the teacher do with the clay? Toni: He broke the clay into shards and showed us the pieces.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：老师把陶土怎么处理了？托尼：他把陶土打成碎片，给我们看了那些碎片。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 老师把陶土怎么处理了？
messages.en: What did the teacher do with the clay?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 他把陶土打成碎片，给我们看了那些碎片。
messages.en: He broke the clay into shards and showed us the pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把记忆画面定格在“整块陶土变成许多碎片”的动作上：xaqqaf 强调打碎的动作，学习时连同 it-tafal 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shard: a broken fragment, for example a piece of pottery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 碎片，指物体破碎后留下的一片，例如陶器碎片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa minn oġġett miksur, bħal biċċa fuħħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碎片；破碎物的一片，如陶片。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tħaffir instabet xaqqufa tal-fuħħar, li mbagħad ġiet irreġistrata u fotografata.
formal.en: A pottery shard was found during the excavation and was then recorded and photographed.
formal.zh: 发掘过程中发现了一片陶片，随后对其进行了登记和拍照。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'sibt ħdejn il-borma miksura? Mark: Xaqqufa żgħira. Se niġborha bil-pala.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you find beside the broken pot? Mark: A small shard. I'll pick it up with the dustpan.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在破盆旁边发现了什么？马克：一小片碎片。我用簸箕把它收起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你在破盆旁边发现了什么？
messages.en: What did you find beside the broken pot?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 一小片碎片。我用簸箕把它收起来。
messages.en: A small shard. I'll pick it up with the dustpan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象破陶盆旁单独放着一小片陶片，在旁边写 xaqqufa；用“眼前这一片”记住它指具体碎片的名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obtain something by paying money for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支付金钱以取得某物，即购买。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiseb xi ħaġa billi ħallas il-flus għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 买；支付金钱以取得商品或其他物品。

formal.mt: Il-mużew xara ktieb antik għall-kollezzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum bought an old book for its collection.
formal.zh: 博物馆购入了一本旧书，作为馆藏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min xara l-ħobż? Pawlu: Mark xara l-ħobż dalgħodu u ħallieh fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who bought the bread? Pawlu: Mark bought the bread this morning and left it in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁买了面包？保罗：马克今天早上买了面包，放在厨房里了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁买了面包？
messages.en: Who bought the bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark xara l-ħobż dalgħodu u ħallieh fil-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Mark xara l-ħobż dalgħodu u ħallieh fil-kċina.
messages.zh: 马克今天早上买了面包，放在厨房里了。
messages.en: Mark bought the bread this morning and left it in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象马克付钱后把面包带回厨房，用 Mark xara l-ħobż 整句记忆，把 xara 与“付钱买到东西”的动作相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To plunder a place or devastate it through destructive action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 劫掠某处的财物，或对某地进行严重破坏，使之满目疮痍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisraq il-ġid minn post bil-vjolenza jew jagħmel ħerba minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 劫掠；以暴力抢走某处的财物。
蹂躏；大肆毁坏某地，使其荒废或满目疮痍。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-eżerċtu xarrak ir-raħal u ħalla ħafna djar meqruda.
formal.en: In the account, the army laid waste to the village and left many houses destroyed.
formal.zh: 在这段记述中，军队蹂躏了村庄，许多房屋遭到毁坏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel il-kmandant fl-istorja? Pawlu: Xarrak ir-raħal u ħa kull ħaġa ta' valur.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the commander do in the story? Pawlu: He pillaged the village and took everything of value.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：故事里的指挥官做了什么？保罗：他劫掠了村庄，拿走了所有值钱的东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的指挥官做了什么？
messages.en: What did the commander do in the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xarrak ir-raħal u ħa kull ħaġa ta' valur.
messages.mt_standard: Xarrak ir-raħal u ħa kull ħaġa ta' valur.
messages.zh: 他劫掠了村庄，拿走了所有值钱的东西。
messages.en: He pillaged the village and took everything of value.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把村庄遭劫的画面分成两步：财物被抢走、房屋被毁坏，分别记住“劫掠”和“蹂躏”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a dairy product to produce or release whey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指乳制品产生或析出乳清，即从乳制品中分离出液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipproduċi jew joħroġ ix-xorrox, meta jingħad għal prodott tal-ħalib.

sense_translations.en_definition: to produce whey (used of dairy products)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生或析出乳清，用于描述乳制品。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, il-ġobon xarrax u l-likwidu nġabar fil-qiegħ tal-kontenitur.
formal.en: During the observation, the cheese released whey, and the liquid collected at the bottom of the container.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，奶酪析出了乳清，液体积聚在容器底部。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhu dan il-likwidu fuq il-jogurt? Toni: Huwa xorrox; il-jogurt xarrax.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is this liquid on top of the yogurt? Toni: It's whey; the yogurt has released whey.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：酸奶上面这层液体是什么？托尼：是乳清；酸奶析出乳清了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 酸奶上面这层液体是什么？
messages.en: What is this liquid on top of the yogurt?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 是乳清；酸奶析出乳清了。
messages.en: It's whey; the yogurt has released whey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开酸奶盒，看见上面析出一层乳清；把这幅画面与 xarrax 一起记，注意动作主体是乳制品。

gloss_zh: 使歪斜；使不对称或不平整

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something skewed, asymmetrical, or uneven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体偏斜，或使其形状、位置或表面变得不对称、不均整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa mgħawġa, asimmetrika jew mhux indaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使歪斜；使物体偏离原本端正的位置或方向。
使不对称或不均整；使两边、各部分或表面失去均衡。

collocations.zh: 使陶土表面变得不平整

formal.mt: Il-piż fuq naħa waħda xatar il-qafas, u għalhekk il-kejl kellu jiġi ċċekkjat mill-ġdid.
formal.en: The weight on one side skewed the frame, so the measurements had to be checked again.
formal.zh: 一侧的重量使框架发生歪斜，因此必须重新核对尺寸。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-qafas mhuwiex dritt? Mark: Il-piż fuq din in-naħa xatar il-qafas.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why isn't the frame straight? Mark: The weight on this side made the frame skew.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：框架为什么不正？马克：这一侧的重量把框架压歪了。

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 框架为什么不正？
messages.en: Why isn't the frame straight?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-piż fuq din in-naħa xatar il-qafas.
messages.mt_standard: Il-piż fuq din in-naħa xatar il-qafas.
messages.zh: 这一侧的重量把框架压歪了。
messages.en: The weight on this side made the frame skew.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个端正方框，再把一边推歪：方向歪了是“使歪斜”，两边不齐则帮助记住“不对称、不均整”。

gloss_zh: 新婚夫妇传统上置于床中、据说可吸收或容纳屁味的长干葫芦

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long dried gourd traditionally put in newlyweds' bed, supposedly to absorb or contain the smell of flatulence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种长形干葫芦，传统上由新婚夫妇放在床中，据说用于吸收或容纳屁味；此处描述的是民俗说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qargħa twila u mnixxfa li tradizzjonalment titqiegħed fis-sodda tal-miżżewġin ġodda, allegatament biex tassorbi jew iżżomm fiha r-riħa tal-gassijiet intestinali.

sense_translations.en_definition: A long dried gourd traditionally placed in bed by newlyweds, purportedly used to absorb or contain the odor of flatulence.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种长形干葫芦，传统上由新婚夫妇放在床中，据说用于吸收或容纳屁味。

collocations.en: the xatrambatra gourd in the newlyweds' bed
collocations.zh: 新婚夫妇床中的 xatrambatra 葫芦

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi x-xatrambatra bħala qargħa twila u mnixxfa li titqiegħed fis-sodda tal-miżżewġin ġodda, allegatament biex tassorbi jew iżżomm fiha r-riħa tal-gassijiet intestinali.
formal.en: The text describes the xatrambatra as a long dried gourd placed in newlyweds' bed, supposedly to absorb or contain the smell of flatulence.
formal.zh: 文章将 xatrambatra 描述为一种放在新婚夫妇床中的长形干葫芦，据说用于吸收或容纳屁味。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi xatrambatra? Ġużeppi: Qargħa twila u mnixxfa li l-miżżewġin ġodda kienu jqiegħdu fis-sodda; jingħad li kienet tassorbi jew iżżomm fiha r-riħa tal-gassijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's a xatrambatra? Ġużeppi: A long dried gourd that newlyweds used to put in bed; it was said to absorb or contain the smell of flatulence.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：xatrambatra 是什么？朱塞佩：一种长形干葫芦，以前新婚夫妇会把它放在床中，据说能吸收或容纳屁味。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: xatrambatra 是什么？
messages.en: What's a xatrambatra?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qargħa twila u mnixxfa li l-miżżewġin ġodda kienu jqiegħdu fis-sodda; jingħad li kienet tassorbi jew iżżomm fiha r-riħa tal-gassijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Qargħa twila u mnixxfa li l-miżżewġin ġodda kienu jqiegħdu fis-sodda; jingħad li kienet tassorbi jew iżżomm fiha r-riħa tal-gassijiet.
messages.zh: 一种长形干葫芦，以前新婚夫妇会把它放在床中，据说能吸收或容纳屁味。
messages.en: A long dried gourd that newlyweds used to put in bed; it was said to absorb or contain the smell of flatulence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“长干葫芦、新婚床铺、据说收气味”三个画面记词义；“据说”也要一起记住，避免把民俗用途当作实际功效。

gloss_zh: 使歪斜或不对称；裁成不对称形状

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something skewed or asymmetrical, including by cutting fabric or another material into an asymmetrical shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体歪斜或不对称；也指通过裁剪布料等材料，使成品呈不对称形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa mgħawġa jew asimmetrika, jew jaqta' drapp jew materjal ieħor biex il-prodott finali jkun asimmetriku.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause to be skewed or asymmetrical
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使歪斜或不对称。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cut fabric or other material such that the final product is asymmetrical
sense_translations.zh_definition: 将布料或其他材料裁剪成使成品不对称的形状。

collocations.en: made the frame skewed or asymmetrical
cut the fabric to produce an asymmetrical shape
collocations.zh: 把布料裁成不对称形状

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat xattar id-drapp skont id-disinn, sabiex il-falda tkun itwal fuq naħa waħda.
formal.en: The tailor cut the fabric asymmetrically according to the design, so that the skirt would be longer on one side.
formal.zh: 裁缝按设计将布料裁成不对称形状，使裙子的一侧更长。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-falda hija itwal fuq naħa waħda? David: Il-ħajjat xattar id-drapp apposta; hekk kien id-disinn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is the skirt longer on one side? David: The tailor deliberately cut the fabric asymmetrically; that was the design.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：裙子为什么一边更长？戴维：裁缝特意把布料裁成不对称形状，设计就是这样的。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-falda hija itwal fuq naħa waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-falda hija itwal fuq naħa waħda?
messages.zh: 裙子为什么一边更长？
messages.en: Why is the skirt longer on one side?

messages.speaker: David (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħajjat xattar id-drapp apposta; hekk kien id-disinn.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħajjat xattar id-drapp apposta; hekk kien id-disinn.
messages.zh: 裁缝特意把布料裁成不对称形状，设计就是这样的。
messages.en: The tailor deliberately cut the fabric asymmetrically; that was the design.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裁缝剪出一边长、一边短的裙摆，用这个不对称成品记住 xattar 的裁剪义，再联系一般的“使歪斜”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To place something where it can be seen and examined as a display.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品摆放出来供人观看或查看，即陈列、展示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed xi ħaġa għall-wiri biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jarawha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把物品陈列出来，供人观看。

collocations.en: put the products on display in the shop window
put the books on display on the table

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ xawwar il-prodotti fil-vetrina sabiex il-klijenti jkunu jistgħu jarawhom mit-triq.
formal.en: The seller put the products on display in the shop window so that customers could see them from the street.
formal.zh: 商家把产品陈列在橱窗里，让顾客从街上就能看到。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn huma l-kotba l-ġodda? Mario: Il-bejjiegħ xawwar il-kotba fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are the new books? Mario: The seller put the books on display on the table by the door.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：新书在哪里？马里奥：店主把书摆在门边的桌子上展示了。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 新书在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the new books?

messages.speaker: Mario (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bejjiegħ xawwar il-kotba fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bejjiegħ xawwar il-kotba fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 店主把书摆在门边的桌子上展示了。
messages.en: The seller put the books on display on the table by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xawwar 配上一幅布置橱窗的画面：物品摆到显眼位置，让经过的人看见，就能记住“陈列展示”。

gloss_zh: 燎焦；烤焦，灼焦；使皮肤发炎

teaching_sense.en_definition: To singe or scorch something, or to cause skin to become inflamed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体表面被燎焦、烤焦或灼焦；也可指使皮肤发炎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħraq xi ħaġa minn barra jew bis-sħana, jew iġiegħel il-ġilda tinfjamma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燎焦；使毛发或物体表面受到短暂烧灼。
烤焦，灼焦；使物体因受热而焦损。
使皮肤发炎，出现红肿或刺激反应。

collocations.en: caused the skin to become inflamed

formal.mt: Il-ħadid jaħraq xawwat id-drapp u ħalla marka kannella fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: The hot iron scorched the fabric and left a brown mark on its surface.
formal.zh: 高温熨斗把布料烫焦了，在表面留下了一块棕色痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Klara: X'ġara lid-drapp? Ben: Il-ħadid xawwat id-drapp; ħallejtu fuqu wisq.
colloquial.en: Klara: What happened to the fabric? Ben: The iron scorched it; I left it on there too long.
colloquial.zh: 克拉拉：布料怎么了？本：被熨斗烫焦了，我把熨斗放在上面太久了。

messages.speaker: Klara (室友)
messages.zh: 布料怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the fabric?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħadid xawwat id-drapp; ħallejtu fuqu wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħadid xawwat id-drapp; ħallejtu fuqu wisq.
messages.zh: 被熨斗烫焦了，我把熨斗放在上面太久了。
messages.en: The iron scorched it; I left it on there too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 依次联想头发被燎、布料焦黄、皮肤红肿三个画面，帮助区分“燎焦”“灼焦”和“使皮肤发炎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage something or spoil it so badly that it is ruined.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物受损，或严重破坏某物，使其无法正常使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel ħsara lil xi ħaġa jew tħassarha għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 损坏；使受到损伤。
毁坏；使彻底损毁或失去用途。

formal.mt: L-ilma li daħal mill-bejt xaħat l-għamara tal-kamra.
formal.en: The water that came in through the roof ruined the room's furniture.
formal.zh: 从屋顶漏进来的水毁坏了房间里的家具。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lill-karta? Lara: L-ilma xaħat il-karta; issa ma nistax naqra dak li hemm miktub.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the paper? Lara: The water damaged it; now I can't read what's written on it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张纸怎么了？Lara：被水弄坏了，现在上面写的东西我都看不清了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这张纸怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the paper?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma xaħat il-karta; issa ma nistax naqra dak li hemm miktub.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma xaħat il-karta; issa ma nistax naqra dak li hemm miktub.
messages.zh: 被水弄坏了，现在上面写的东西我都看不清了。
messages.en: The water damaged it; now I can't read what's written on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象漏水先弄坏纸张，再毁掉家具；沿着损坏程度加重的画面，记住“损坏”和“毁坏”。

gloss_zh: 一块脂肪；安静而无助的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of fat, such as a piece attached to meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块脂肪，例如附着在肉上的一块肥脂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa xaħam, bħal dik li tkun imwaħħla mal-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块脂肪；一块肥脂。
安静而无助的人；不大作声、无力应对处境的人。

collocations.en: a piece of fat attached to the meat
collocations.zh: 附着在肉上的一块脂肪

formal.mt: Qabel issajjar il-laħam, neħħi x-xaħma li hemm mat-tarf.
formal.en: Before cooking the meat, remove the piece of fat along the edge.
formal.zh: 烹调这块肉之前，先去掉边缘的那块肥脂。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tridni nneħħi din ix-xaħma? Omm: Iva, neħħiha qabel tqatta' l-laħam.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you want me to remove this piece of fat? Mum: Yes, remove it before you cut up the meat.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：要我把这块肥脂去掉吗？妈妈：要，切肉之前先把它去掉。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 要我把这块肥脂去掉吗？
messages.en: Do you want me to remove this piece of fat?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 要，切肉之前先把它去掉。
messages.en: Yes, remove it before you cut up the meat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用切肉时去掉的一块肥脂记住本义；另把“安静而无助的人”单独记作人物义，避免混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A skink, a type of lizard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 石龙子，一类蜥蜴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li huwa tip ta' gremxula, magħruf ukoll bħala xaħmet l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石龙子，一类蜥蜴。

collocations.zh: 石块之间的一只石龙子

formal.mt: L-istudent inkluda ritratt ta' xaħmet fir-rapport tiegħu dwar l-annimali li osserva.
formal.en: The student included a photograph of a skink in his report about the animals he observed.
formal.zh: 这名学生在有关所观察动物的报告中放入了一张石龙子的照片。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'rajt fost il-ġebel? Toni: Rajt xaħmet, imma ma lħaqtx ħadt ritratt.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did you see among the stones? Toni: I saw a skink, but I didn't manage to take a photo.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在石块之间看见了什么？托尼：我看见了一只石龙子，可惜没来得及拍照。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在石块之间看见了什么？
messages.en: What did you see among the stones?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt xaħmet, imma ma lħaqtx ħadt ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt xaħmet, imma ma lħaqtx ħadt ritratt.
messages.zh: 我看见了一只石龙子，可惜没来得及拍照。
messages.en: I saw a skink, but I didn't manage to take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xaħmet 写在石龙子图片旁，再配上“拍一张照片”的短语，用动物图像与观察情景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A skink, a type of lizard, named here by the full expression xaħmet l-art.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 石龙子，一类蜥蜴；此处用完整名称 xaħmet l-art 表示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' gremxula li jissejjaħ ukoll xaħmet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石龙子，一类蜥蜴。

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħarġa edukattiva, il-grupp għamel osservazzjoni ta' xaħmet l-art mingħajr ma mess l-annimal.
formal.en: During the educational outing, the group observed a skink without touching the animal.
formal.zh: 在教学出游期间，小组观察了一只石龙子，没有触碰它。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Rajt xaħmet l-art ħdejn il-ħajt! Anna: Fejn? Irrid naraha wkoll, imma ejja ma nmissuhiex.
colloquial.en: Luca: I saw a skink beside the wall! Anna: Where? I want to see it too, but let's not touch it.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我在墙边看见了一只石龙子！安娜：在哪里？我也想看看，不过我们别碰它。

messages.speaker: Luca (同学)
messages.zh: 我在墙边看见了一只石龙子！
messages.en: I saw a skink beside the wall!

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn? Irrid naraha wkoll, imma ejja ma nmissuhiex.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn? Irrid naraha wkoll, imma ejja ma nmissuhiex.
messages.zh: 在哪里？我也想看看，不过我们别碰它。
messages.en: Where? I want to see it too, but let's not touch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xaħmet l-art 当作一个完整的动物名称记忆，与较短的 xaħmet 配对，两者都对应石龙子。

gloss_zh: 舒舒服服地安顿下来；把人安顿上床并盖好

teaching_sense.en_definition: To settle comfortably, or to settle someone in bed and tuck them in.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 舒舒服服地安顿下来，或把某人安顿在床上并盖好被子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qagħad komdu, jew poġġa lil xi ħadd fis-sodda u għattieh sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舒舒服服地安顿下来；让自己处于温暖舒适的状态。
把某人安顿上床并盖好被子。

collocations.zh: 舒舒服服地坐进扶手椅
把男孩安顿上床并盖好被子

formal.mt: Qabel ħareġ mill-kamra, il-missier xaħxaħ lit-tifel fis-sodda u qralu storja qasira.
formal.en: Before leaving the room, the father tucked the boy into bed and read him a short story.
formal.zh: 离开房间之前，父亲把男孩安顿上床、盖好被子，并给他读了一个小故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar in-nannu? Ben: Xaħxaħ fil-pultruna bil-kutra u qed jara t-televixin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Grandpa go? Ben: He settled comfortably in the armchair with the blanket and is watching television.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：爷爷去哪儿了？本：他裹着毯子舒舒服服地坐在扶手椅里，正在看电视。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Grandpa go?

messages.speaker: Ben (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Xaħxaħ fil-pultruna bil-kutra u qed jara t-televixin.
messages.mt_standard: Xaħxaħ fil-pultruna bil-kutra u qed jara t-televixin.
messages.zh: 他裹着毯子舒舒服服地坐在扶手椅里，正在看电视。
messages.en: He settled comfortably in the armchair with the blanket and is watching television.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一条温暖的毯子串起两个义项：自己裹好是舒适安顿，给孩子盖好是安顿上床。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A poppy plant or its flower.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 罂粟植物，或这种植物的花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-peprin jew il-fjura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罂粟；罂粟花。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-arti, kull student għamel tpinġija ta' xaħxieħa u kiteb l-isem tal-fjura taħtha.
formal.en: In the art lesson, each student drew a poppy and wrote the flower's name underneath it.
formal.zh: 美术课上，每名学生都画了一朵罂粟花，并在下方写上花的名称。

colloquial.mt: Ella: X'fjura qed tpinġi? Sam: Xaħxieħa. Trid tagħtini l-lapes aħmar?
colloquial.en: Ella: What flower are you drawing? Sam: A poppy. Could you pass me the red pencil?
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：你在画什么花？萨姆：罂粟花。能把红色铅笔递给我吗？

messages.speaker: Ella (同学)
messages.zh: 你在画什么花？
messages.en: What flower are you drawing?

messages.speaker: Sam (同学)
messages.zh: 罂粟花。能把红色铅笔递给我吗？
messages.en: A poppy. Could you pass me the red pencil?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画一朵罂粟花，旁边完整写出 xaħxieħa，用花朵图像记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 令人困倦的；催人入睡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to make someone feel drowsy or fall asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使人感到困倦或入睡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss in-ngħas jew jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易令人困倦的；有使人昏昏欲睡的倾向的。
催人入睡的；使人昏昏欲睡的。

formal.mt: Il-qari b'ton baxx u xaħxieħi kellu effett li ġiegħel lil xi semmiegħa jħossu n-ngħas.
formal.en: The reading in a low, soporific tone made some listeners feel drowsy.
formal.zh: 朗读者低沉而催人入睡的语调让一些听众感到困倦。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed tagħlaq għajnejk? Karl: Il-vuċi tiegħu għandha effett xaħxieħi; qed inħoss in-ngħas.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you closing your eyes? Karl: His voice has a soporific effect; I'm feeling sleepy.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么闭上眼睛了？卡尔：他的声音有催眠般的效果，我听得困了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么闭上眼睛了？
messages.en: Why are you closing your eyes?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-vuċi tiegħu għandha effett xaħxieħi; qed inħoss in-ngħas.
messages.mt_standard: Il-vuċi tiegħu għandha effett xaħxieħi; qed inħoss in-ngħas.
messages.zh: 他的声音有催眠般的效果，我听得困了。
messages.en: His voice has a soporific effect; I'm feeling sleepy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听着某种语调，眼皮渐渐合上：xaħxieħi 描写的是声音等事物让人犯困的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of sleepiness that makes it difficult to stay fully awake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想睡觉、难以保持清醒的困倦状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' ngħas li tagħmilha diffiċli li wieħed jibqa' mqajjem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困倦；睡意。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikel, l-istudent ħass xaħxiħ u sabha diffiċli biex jibqa' attent waqt il-lezzjoni.
