formal.en: After the meal, the student felt drowsy and found it difficult to remain attentive during the lesson.
formal.zh: 饭后，这名学生感到困倦，上课时很难保持专注。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed inħoss xaħxiħ wara l-ikel. Mark: Trid tistrieħ ftit qabel noħorġu?
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm feeling drowsy after eating. Mark: Do you want to rest a little before we go out?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：吃完饭我有点犯困。马克：我们出门前，你想先休息一下吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 吃完饭我有点犯困。
messages.en: I'm feeling drowsy after eating.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们出门前，你想先休息一下吗？
messages.en: Do you want to rest a little before we go out?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与饭后眼皮渐渐变沉的画面联系起来，记住它表示困倦和睡意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take away something that someone needs or has a right to have.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拿走某人需要或有权享有的东西，使其失去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċaħħad lil xi ħadd minn xi ħaġa li għandu bżonn jew li għandu dritt għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥夺；使某人失去某物。

collocations.mt: xaħħat lil xi ħadd minn dritt
collocations.zh: 剥夺了某人的一项权利

collocations.mt: xaħħat lil xi ħadd minn opportunità
collocations.zh: 使某人失去了一次机会

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, dan ir-regolament xaħħat lil xi studenti mill-opportunità li jipparteċipaw.
formal.en: According to the report, this regulation deprived some students of the opportunity to participate.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这项规定剥夺了部分学生参与的机会。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Pawlu ma setax jieħu sehem? David: Il-limitu tal-età xaħħat lil Pawlu mill-opportunità li jipparteċipa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why couldn't Pawlu take part? David: The age limit deprived Pawlu of the opportunity to participate.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗为什么不能参加？戴维：年龄限制让保罗失去了参与的机会。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma setax jieħu sehem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma setax jieħu sehem?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不能参加？
messages.en: Why couldn't Pawlu take part?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-limitu tal-età xaħħat lil Pawlu mill-opportunità li jipparteċipa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-limitu tal-età xaħħat lil Pawlu mill-opportunità li jipparteċipa.
messages.zh: 年龄限制让保罗失去了参与的机会。
messages.en: The age limit deprived Pawlu of the opportunity to participate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xaħħat 放进“某人失去了机会”的情景中记忆，重点联想剥夺之后留下的空缺。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be very economical, taking great care to spend little or use very little.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十分节俭，尽量少花钱或少消耗资源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li toqgħod attent ħafna biex tonfoq ftit jew tuża mill-inqas riżorsi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十分节俭；在开支或资源使用方面非常节省。

collocations.en: was very economical in using water

formal.mt: Matul ix-xahar, Pawlu xaħħaħ fl-ispejjeż biex ifaddal parti mid-dħul tiegħu.
formal.en: Throughout the month, Pawlu was very economical with his spending so that he could save part of his income.
formal.zh: 整个月里，Pawlu在开支上十分节省，以便存下一部分收入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu xaħħaħ ħafna din il-ġimgħa. Lara: Iva, ħa l-ikel mid-dar u ma xtara xejn bla bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu was very economical this week. Lara: Yes, he brought food from home and didn't buy anything unnecessary.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu这周特别节省。Lara：是啊，他从家里带饭，也没买任何不需要的东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu这周特别节省。
messages.en: Pawlu was very economical this week.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħa l-ikel mid-dar u ma xtara xejn bla bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħa l-ikel mid-dar u ma xtara xejn bla bżonn.
messages.zh: 是啊，他从家里带饭，也没买任何不需要的东西。
messages.en: Yes, he brought food from home and didn't buy anything unnecessary.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上自带午饭、少买东西、及时关水三个画面，记住它描述“做事非常节省”的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is very unwilling to spend money or share what they have.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极不愿意花钱或与别人分享自己所有之物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tkunx trid tonfoq flus jew taqsam dak li għandha ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吝啬鬼；舍不得花钱或分享东西的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ix-xaħħieħ iżomm il-flus kollha għalih u jirrifjuta li jgħin lill-ġirien.
formal.en: In the story, the miser keeps all the money for himself and refuses to help his neighbours.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个吝啬鬼把所有的钱都留给自己，拒绝帮助邻居。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu xaħħieħ? Mark: Għax qatt ma jrid iħallas sehmu, anki meta jista'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you calling him a miser? Mark: Because he never wants to pay his share, even when he can.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么叫他吝啬鬼？马克：因为他从来不愿意付自己那份钱，即使付得起也不愿意。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他吝啬鬼？
messages.en: Why are you calling him a miser?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qatt ma jrid iħallas sehmu, anki meta jista'.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qatt ma jrid iħallas sehmu, anki meta jista'.
messages.zh: 因为他从来不愿意付自己那份钱，即使付得起也不愿意。
messages.en: Because he never wants to pay his share, even when he can.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把钱包紧紧捂住，连自己应付的份额也舍不得付，用这个画面记住 xaħħieħ。

gloss_zh: 教母；生母与教母之间的互称；女性朋友；情妇

teaching_sense.en_definition: A godmother; also a mutual form of address between a child's mother and godmother, or a female friend, sometimes a man's mistress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指教母，也用作孩子生母与教母之间的互称；还可指女性朋友，而涉及男子时也常指其婚外或不正当性关系中的女伴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tkun parrina ta' tifel jew tifla; ukoll indirizz reċiproku bejn l-omm u l-parrina, jew ħabiba, li fir-rigward ta' raġel spiss tkun sieħba f'relazzjoni sesswali illeċita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教母；在孩子受洗时担任女性代父母的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: An address used mutually between the biological mother and godmother of a child.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 孩子的生母与教母之间相互使用的称呼。

sense_translations.en_definition: female friend; (with regard to a man often) mistress (illicit sexual partner)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 女性朋友；涉及男子时，也常指其情妇，即与其有不正当性关系的女性。

collocations.en: Thank you, xbina! (address between the child's mother and godmother)
collocations.zh: 谢谢你，xbina！（孩子生母与教母之间的称呼）

collocations.en: his female friend or, depending on context, his mistress
collocations.zh: 他的女性朋友；依语境也可指他的情妇

formal.mt: Fl-istedina għall-magħmudija, Elena tissemma bħala x-xbina tat-tifel.
formal.en: In the invitation to the baptism, Elena is named as the boy's godmother.
formal.zh: 洗礼邀请函上注明，埃莱娜是这个男孩的教母。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xbina, ġejja għall-festa tat-tifel? Elena: Iva, xbina, żgur li ġejja!
colloquial.en: Marija: Xbina, are you coming to the boy's party? Elena: Yes, xbina, of course I'm coming!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：教母，你来参加孩子的聚会吗？埃莱娜：来呀，孩子妈妈，我当然来！

messages.speaker: Marija (孩子的生母)
messages.zh: 教母，你来参加孩子的聚会吗？
messages.en: Xbina, are you coming to the boy's party?

messages.speaker: Elena (孩子的教母)
messages.zh: 来呀，孩子妈妈，我当然来！
messages.en: Yes, xbina, of course I'm coming!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记生母与教母互相叫 xbina 的场景，再另记女性朋友或情妇的语境义；判断人物关系后再选中文译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have eaten enough and feel full; also, to have had enough of something and feel fed up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃得足够而感到饱；也可表示对某事已经受够、感到厌烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiel biżżejjed u ħassu mimli; ukoll, kellu biżżejjed minn xi ħaġa u ddejjaq biha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be satiated, to be full, to have enough food
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃饱，因食物充足而感到满足。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be fed up, to have enough
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受够了，对某人或某事感到厌烦。

collocations.en: he was full after the meal
he was fed up with the noise

formal.mt: Wara li kiel is-soppa u l-ħobż, it-tifel xeba' u ma talabx aktar ikel.
formal.en: After eating the soup and bread, the boy was full and did not ask for more food.
formal.zh: 喝了汤、吃了面包后，男孩吃饱了，没有再要食物。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid aktar għaġin? Mark: Le, grazzi, xbajt. Kien tajjeb ħafna!
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like more pasta? Mark: No, thank you, I'm full. It was delicious!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：还要意大利面吗？马克：不了，谢谢，我吃饱了。真好吃！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 还要意大利面吗？
messages.en: Would you like more pasta?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi, xbajt. Kien tajjeb ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi, xbajt. Kien tajjeb ħafna!
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢，我吃饱了。真好吃！
messages.en: No, thank you, I'm full. It was delicious!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“肚子装够了”和“耐心用够了”连起来记：食物够了是吃饱，噪声听够了是受够。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone enough food or enough of something; also, to annoy someone or get on their nerves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人足够的食物或其他东西，使其满足；也可表示使某人厌烦、惹人心烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta lil xi ħadd biżżejjed ikel jew biżżejjed minn xi ħaġa; ukoll, dejjaq lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to satiate; to give somebody enough of (especially food)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使吃饱；给某人足够的东西，尤其指食物。
惹某人心烦，使某人厌烦。

collocations.en: he gave the children enough to eat
he annoyed everyone with his questions
collocations.zh: 他问个不停，惹得大家心烦

formal.mt: Il-kok xebba' lill-mistednin kollha b'ikla sħuna u abbundanti.
formal.en: The cook gave all the guests enough to eat with a generous hot meal.
formal.zh: 厨师准备了一顿丰盛的热饭，让所有客人都吃饱了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex tlaqt mill-kamra? Pawlu: Għax Mark xebbani bl-istess storja!
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you leave the room? Pawlu: Because Mark got on my nerves with the same story!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么离开房间？保罗：因为马克反复讲同一个故事，把我烦透了！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开房间？
messages.en: Why did you leave the room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为马克反复讲同一个故事，把我烦透了！
messages.en: Because Mark got on my nerves with the same story!

cognitive_memory_aid: 与 xeba' 对照记：前者自己吃饱或受够，xebba' 则让别人吃饱或心烦；用双写 b 提醒自己关注受影响的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reach puberty, the stage when a child's body begins to mature sexually.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入青春期，即儿童身体开始出现性成熟变化的阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħal fil-pubertà, il-fażi meta l-ġisem tat-tifel jew tat-tifla jibda jimmatura sesswalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进入青春期，开始出现性成熟的身体变化。

collocations.en: he reached puberty later than his siblings
collocations.zh: 他比兄弟姐妹更晚进入青春期

formal.mt: Fit-test edukattiv, it-tifel xebbeb u beda jinnota bidliet f'ġismu.
formal.en: In the educational text, the boy reached puberty and began noticing changes in his body.
formal.zh: 在这篇教育读物中，男孩进入了青春期，开始注意到身体的变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser li tifel xebbeb? Għalliem: Tfisser li daħal fil-pubertà u ġismu beda jinbidel.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does it mean to say that a boy has reached puberty? Teacher: It means he has entered puberty and his body has begun to change.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：说一个男孩 xebbeb 是什么意思？老师：意思是他进入了青春期，身体开始发生变化。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 说一个男孩 xebbeb 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to say that a boy has reached puberty?

messages.speaker: Għalliem (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li daħal fil-pubertà u ġismu beda jinbidel.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li daħal fil-pubertà u ġismu beda jinbidel.
messages.zh: 意思是他进入了青春期，身体开始发生变化。
messages.en: It means he has entered puberty and his body has begun to change.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象成长记录本翻到“青春期开始”这一页，把 xebbeb 与“进入新发育阶段”的画面绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To weave a net, or to put a net in position for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将线绳编织成网；也指把网布置到使用的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Niseġ xibka, jew qiegħed xibka f'postha biex tintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编网，把线绳交织成网。
布网，把网安置或铺设好。

collocations.en: he laid a net in the water

formal.mt: Is-sajjied xebbek xibka ġdida b'ħajt b'saħħtu biex jużaha waqt is-sajd.
formal.en: The fisherman wove a new net with strong thread to use while fishing.
formal.zh: 渔夫用结实的线编了一张新网，准备捕鱼时使用。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn xebbek ix-xibka n-nannu? Toni: Ħdejn il-blat, fejn l-ilma huwa baxx.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where did Grandpa lay the net? Toni: Near the rocks, where the water is shallow.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：爷爷把网布在哪里了？托尼：在岩石旁边，水比较浅的地方。

messages.speaker: Rita (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷把网布在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did Grandpa lay the net?

messages.speaker: Toni (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-blat, fejn l-ilma huwa baxx.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-blat, fejn l-ilma huwa baxx.
messages.zh: 在岩石旁边，水比较浅的地方。
messages.en: Near the rocks, where the water is shallow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用捕鱼的两个连续镜头记忆：先在岸上编网，再到水中布网；xebbek 可以对应这两种动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To serve as someone's godfather, taking that role at their baptism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 担任某人的教父，在其洗礼中承担这一身份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kien il-parrinu ta' xi ħadd fil-magħmudija.

sense_translations.en_definition: to act as godfather for sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 担任某人的教父。

collocations.en: he acted as godfather at the baptism
he acted as godfather for the first time

formal.mt: Pawlu xebben fil-magħmudija tat-tifel u ffirma bħala parrinu.
formal.en: Pawlu acted as godfather at the boy's baptism and signed as the godfather.
formal.zh: 保罗在男孩的洗礼中担任教父，并以教父身份签了名。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min xebben fil-magħmudija ta' ibnek? David: Ħija Pawlu; kien ferħan ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who acted as godfather at your son's baptism? David: My brother Pawlu; he was very happy.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你儿子的洗礼是谁担任教父的？戴维：我兄弟保罗；他特别高兴。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你儿子的洗礼是谁担任教父的？
messages.en: Who acted as godfather at your son's baptism?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.zh: 我兄弟保罗；他特别高兴。
messages.en: My brother Pawlu; he was very happy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象洗礼合影里站在孩子身旁的教父，把 xebben 记成“承担教父这个角色”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Full after eating enough; satiated, with the same meaning as xebgħan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃得足够、已经饱了的；与 xebgħan 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li kiel biżżejjed u ma għandux aktar ġuħ; bl-istess tifsira bħal xebgħan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 xebgħan 同义，表示吃饱的、已经不饿的。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, Mark kien xebgħani u ma xtaqx aktar ikel.
formal.en: After the meal, Mark was full and did not want any more food.
formal.zh: 饭后，马克已经吃饱，不想再吃东西了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid biċċa kejk? Mark: Le, grazzi, jien diġà xebgħani.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like a piece of cake? Mark: No, thank you, I'm already full.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：要来一块蛋糕吗？马克：不了，谢谢，我已经吃饱了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 要来一块蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢，我已经吃饱了。
messages.en: No, thank you, I'm already full.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xebgħani 放进“谢谢，我已经吃饱了”的整句里记；它描述饱腹状态，可与同义词 xebgħan 配对复习。

gloss_zh: 摊开四肢躺着；植物蔓延铺展

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sprawl with the body spread out; of a plant, to spread across a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或四肢舒展开来躺着；用于植物时，指沿某个表面蔓延、铺展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imtedd b'ġismu u b'riġlejh mifruxa; dwar pjanta, infirex fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摊开身体或四肢躺着。

sense_translations.en_definition: to spread over a surface (used of plants such as wall-climbers)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿表面蔓延铺展，用于攀墙植物等植物。

collocations.zh: 他摊开四肢躺在沙发上

collocations.en: the plant spread over the wall

formal.mt: Il-pjanta xeblket mal-ħajt tal-ġnien u għattiet parti kbira minnu.
formal.en: The plant spread over the garden wall and covered a large part of it.
formal.zh: 这株植物沿花园围墙蔓延，覆盖了墙面的大部分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu Toni? Marija: Xeblek fuq is-sufan wara l-mixja; għadu hemm jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is Toni? Marija: He sprawled on the sofa after the walk; he's still there resting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：托尼在哪里？玛丽亚：散步回来后，他就摊躺在沙发上；现在还在那里休息。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Toni?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xeblek fuq is-sufan wara l-mixja; għadu hemm jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Xeblek fuq is-sufan wara l-mixja; għadu hemm jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 散步回来后，他就摊躺在沙发上；现在还在那里休息。
messages.en: He sprawled on the sofa after the walk; he's still there resting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“展开占住一片表面”串联两义：人把四肢展开躺在沙发上，藤蔓把枝叶展开铺在墙上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who braids strands or intertwines them with one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把多股材料编成辫状或相互交织的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel nisġiet billi tqassam u ddaħħal ħjut jew friegħi wieħed fl-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编辫或把材料相互交织的人。

collocations.en: the work of someone who braids or intertwines

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, ix-xebliek għaqqad tliet ħbula rqaq f'nisġa waħda.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the braider combined three thin ropes into a single braid.
formal.zh: 在演示中，编绳者把三根细绳编成了一条辫状绳。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu r-raġel li qed jgħaqqad dawk il-ħbula? Mark: Hu xebliek; ara kif idaħħal waħda fl-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the man joining those ropes together? Mark: He's a braider; look how he interlaces them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个把绳子编在一起的人是谁？马克：他是编绳的人；看，他正把绳子相互交编。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu r-raġel li qed jgħaqqad dawk il-ħbula?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu r-raġel li qed jgħaqqad dawk il-ħbula?
messages.zh: 那个把绳子编在一起的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the man joining those ropes together?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu xebliek; ara kif idaħħal waħda fl-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hu xebliek; ara kif idaħħal waħda fl-oħra.
messages.zh: 他是编绳的人；看，他正把绳子相互交编。
messages.en: He's a braider; look how he interlaces them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位手艺人把三股绳交叉编起，把 xebliek 贴在“做交编的人”身上，提醒自己这是指人的名词。

gloss_zh: 相互交织的；编成辫状的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intertwining with one another or arranged in a braided form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彼此交错缠绕的，或像辫子一样编织在一起的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitħabblu ma' xulxin jew ikunu magħmulin f'għamla ta' nisġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 彼此交错缠绕的；相互交织的。
编织成辫状的；交叉编结而成的。

formal.mt: Il-pannell dekorattiv juri fili xeblieki li flimkien joħolqu disinn wieħed.
formal.en: The decorative panel shows intertwining threads that together create a single design.
formal.zh: 这块装饰板呈现出相互交织的线，共同组成一个图案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn il-ħbula xeblieki għamilthom int? Lara: Iva, għaqqadt tliet ħbula rqaq biex nagħmel waħda eħxen.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you make these braided ropes? Lara: Yes, I joined three thin ropes to make a thicker one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些辫状编绳是你做的吗？拉拉：是的，我把三根细绳编在一起，做成一根更粗的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些辫状编绳是你做的吗？
messages.en: Did you make these braided ropes?

messages.speaker: Lara (手工爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għaqqadt tliet ħbula rqaq biex nagħmel waħda eħxen.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għaqqadt tliet ħbula rqaq biex nagħmel waħda eħxen.
messages.zh: 是的，我把三根细绳编在一起，做成一根更粗的。
messages.en: Yes, I joined three thin ropes to make a thicker one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xeblieki 配上一幅三根线交叉编辫的图：线正在交织，成品呈辫状，同时记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 不规则的伸展；杂乱蔓延

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spreading or extending of something over an area in an irregular or untidy way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物向周围不规则地伸展、铺开或蔓延的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tifrix jew it-twessigħ ta' xi ħaġa fuq medda, b'mod irregolari jew bla ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向四周不规则地伸展或杂乱蔓延的现象。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi x-xeblik tal-bini madwar ir-raħal u l-effett tiegħu fuq l-għelieqi.
formal.en: The report describes the sprawling of buildings around the village and its effect on the fields.
formal.zh: 报告描述了村庄周围建筑物的蔓延，以及这一现象对农田的影响。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed tara x-xeblik tal-fergħat fuq il-mogħdija? Nina: Iva, irridu niżbruhom ftit biex inkunu nistgħu ngħaddu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you see how the branches are sprawling over the path? Nina: Yes, we need to prune them a little so we can get through.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你看见枝条四散伸到小路上了吗？妮娜：看见了，我们得稍微修剪一下，才能走过去。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara x-xeblik tal-fergħat fuq il-mogħdija?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara x-xeblik tal-fergħat fuq il-mogħdija?
messages.zh: 你看见枝条四散伸到小路上了吗？
messages.en: Do you see how the branches are sprawling over the path?

messages.speaker: Nina (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu niżbruhom ftit biex inkunu nistgħu ngħaddu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu niżbruhom ftit biex inkunu nistgħu ngħaddu.
messages.zh: 看见了，我们得稍微修剪一下，才能走过去。
messages.en: Yes, we need to prune them a little so we can get through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象树枝越长越散、伸满小路，把这整片杂乱伸展的现象标成名词 xeblik。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put clothing on one's body or to have it on as something one is wearing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣物穿到身上，或身上穿着某件衣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqiegħed ilbies fuq ġismu jew ikollu dak l-ilbies fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿上；把衣物穿到身上，侧重穿衣的动作。
穿着；身上有某件衣物，侧重穿着的状态。
使长期便秘；使持续出现排便困难。

formal.mt: Qabel ħareġ fil-kesħa, ir-raġel xedded il-kowt u għalaq il-bieb.
formal.en: Before going out into the cold, the man put on his coat and closed the door.
formal.zh: 出门走进寒冷的室外之前，那名男子穿上大衣，关上了门。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu xedded il-ġakketta qabel ħareġ? Rita: Iva, barra hemm ħafna riħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu put on his jacket before going out? Rita: Yes, it is very windy outside.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗出去之前穿上夹克了吗？丽塔：穿了，外面风很大。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 保罗出去之前穿上夹克了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu put on his jacket before going out?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 穿了，外面风很大。
messages.en: Yes, it is very windy outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用穿大衣的动作记 xedded，再用穿着大衣的定格画面记状态；另把使长期便秘一义单列卡片记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A professional cook, especially one who prepares dishes or leads the cooking in a restaurant kitchen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以烹饪为职业的人，尤指在餐厅厨房制作菜肴或主持烹饪工作的厨师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssajjar bħala xogħol, speċjalment f'ristorant, u li tista' tmexxi t-tisjir fil-kċina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厨师；尤指餐厅中负责烹饪或主持厨房工作的主厨。

formal.mt: Ix-xeff tar-ristorant ħejja menu ġdid li juża ħaxix frisk tal-istaġun.
formal.en: The restaurant's chef prepared a new menu using fresh seasonal vegetables.
formal.zh: 餐厅的厨师拟定了一份采用新鲜时令蔬菜的新菜单。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min sajjar din is-soppa? Tina: Ix-xeff tagħna; illum għamilha bil-qargħa ħamra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who made this soup? Tina: Our chef; today he made it with pumpkin.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这汤是谁做的？蒂娜：我们的厨师，今天他做的是南瓜汤。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这汤是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this soup?

messages.speaker: Tina (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xeff tagħna; illum għamilha bil-qargħa ħamra.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xeff tagħna; illum għamilha bil-qargħa ħamra.
messages.zh: 我们的厨师，今天他做的是南瓜汤。
messages.en: Our chef; today he made it with pumpkin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给餐厅厨房里掌勺的人贴上 xeff 标签，再把整句 ix-xeff tar-ristorant 连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To push the lips forward, often to show displeasure or disappointment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把嘴唇向前撅起，常用来表示不高兴或失望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ xofftejh 'il quddiem, spiss biex juri li mhux kuntent jew li hu diżappuntat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 噘嘴；把嘴唇向前撅起，常表示不满或失望。

formal.mt: Meta sar jaf li l-logħba kienet tħassret, it-tifel xeffef u baqa' sieket għal ftit.
formal.en: When he learned that the game had been cancelled, the boy pouted and remained silent for a while.
formal.zh: 得知比赛取消后，男孩噘起了嘴，沉默了一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex xeffef Pawlu? Lara: Ried jilgħab barra, iżda bdiet ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Pawlu pout? Lara: He wanted to play outside, but it started raining.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗为什么噘嘴？拉拉：他想去外面玩，可是下雨了。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么噘嘴？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu pout?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jilgħab barra, iżda bdiet ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jilgħab barra, iżda bdiet ix-xita.
messages.zh: 他想去外面玩，可是下雨了。
messages.en: He wanted to play outside, but it started raining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 xeffef 时配一个失望噘嘴的小表情，把词和嘴唇向前突出的动作一起记住。

gloss_zh: 在地平线上的；在天际的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated or visible on the horizon, where the sky appears to meet the land or sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于或显现在地平线上的，即天空与陆地或海面看似相接之处的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab jew jidher fuq ix-xefaq, fejn is-sema jidher li jiltaqa' mal-art jew mal-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在地平线上的；显现在天际的。

formal.mt: Il-pittura turi dawl xefqi li jdawwal il-baħar qabel tlugħ ix-xemx.
formal.en: The painting shows light on the horizon illuminating the sea before sunrise.
formal.zh: 这幅画呈现出日出前地平线上的光照亮海面的景象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara dak id-dawl xefqi? Mark: Iva, jidher eżatt fejn il-baħar jiltaqa' mas-sema.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see that light on the horizon? Mark: Yes, it is visible right where the sea meets the sky.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见地平线上那道光了吗？马克：看见了，就在海天相接的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见地平线上那道光了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that light on the horizon?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher eżatt fejn il-baħar jiltaqa' mas-sema.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher eżatt fejn il-baħar jiltaqa' mas-sema.
messages.zh: 看见了，就在海天相接的地方。
messages.en: Yes, it is visible right where the sea meets the sky.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条海天相接的横线，把远处的光圈出来并标上 xefqi，记住它说明在地平线上的位置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of moisture, including a prolonged period with too little rain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺少水分的干燥状态，也指长期降雨不足造成的干旱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' umdità jew ilma, jew perjodu twil li fih tinżel ftit wisq xita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干燥；水分或湿度不足的状态。
干旱；长时间降雨不足、水分短缺的状况。

formal.mt: Wara perjodu twil ta' xegħit, il-ħamrija kienet niexfa u l-bdiewa kienu qed jistennew ix-xita.
formal.en: After a long period of drought, the soil was dry and the farmers were waiting for rain.
formal.zh: 经历一段漫长的干旱期后，土壤十分干燥，农民们正盼望下雨。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ara x-xegħit tal-ħamrija f'din il-borma. Mark: Iva, ilha ma tissaqqa; se nġib ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Look how dry the soil is in this pot. Mark: Yes, it has not been watered for a while; I will get some water.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：看看这盆里的土有多干。马克：是啊，好一阵子没浇水了，我去拿点水。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 看看这盆里的土有多干。
messages.en: Look how dry the soil is in this pot.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilha ma tissaqqa; se nġib ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilha ma tissaqqa; se nġib ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 是啊，好一阵子没浇水了，我去拿点水。
messages.en: Yes, it has not been watered for a while; I will get some water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅缺水图记 xegħit：一盆干土对应干燥，一大片久不下雨的农田对应干旱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong wish or longing for something, including strong sexual desire in a sexual context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事物的强烈愿望或渴求；在性相关语境中，也指强烈的性欲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa jew ħerqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa; f'kuntest sesswali, xewqa sesswali qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欲望；渴望；对某事物的强烈愿望。
强烈的性欲；情欲。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru jesprimi xehi qawwi għal ħajja aktar ħielsa.
formal.en: In the novel, the character expresses a strong desire for a freer life.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，人物表达了对更加自由的生活的强烈渴望。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta l-awtur jgħid 'xehi', dejjem ifisser xewqa sesswali? Maja: Le, hawn qed jitkellem dwar ix-xehi tal-karattru għal-libertà.
colloquial.en: Lara: When the author says 'xehi', does it always mean sexual desire? Maja: No, here he is talking about the character's desire for freedom.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：作者用 xehi 时，总是指性欲吗？玛雅：不是，这里说的是人物对自由的渴望。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta l-awtur jgħid 'xehi', dejjem ifisser xewqa sesswali?
messages.mt_standard: Meta l-awtur jgħid 'xehi', dejjem ifisser xewqa sesswali?
messages.zh: 作者用 xehi 时，总是指性欲吗？
messages.en: When the author says 'xehi', does it always mean sexual desire?

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn qed jitkellem dwar ix-xehi tal-karattru għal-libertà.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn qed jitkellem dwar ix-xehi tal-karattru għal-libertà.
messages.zh: 不是，这里说的是人物对自由的渴望。
messages.en: No, here he is talking about the character's desire for freedom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xehi 放在一张写着强烈想要的卡片上：想要自由是渴望，涉及性吸引的语境则读作情欲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A desire or strong wish for something or for something to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想要得到某物或希望某事发生的愿望、渴望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa li wieħed ikollu xi ħaġa jew li tiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愿望；渴望。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-istudenta esprimiet xehja kbira li tkompli tistudja.
formal.en: In her letter, the student expressed a strong desire to continue studying.
formal.zh: 这名女学生在信中表达了继续学习的强烈愿望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi xehja kbira li nitgħallem inpitter. Lara: Ejja nibdew b'kors qasir flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I really want to learn to paint. Lara: Let's start with a short course together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我特别想学画画。拉拉：我们一起先上个短期课程吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi xehja kbira li nitgħallem inpitter.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi xehja kbira li nitgħallem inpitter.
messages.zh: 我特别想学画画。
messages.en: I really want to learn to paint.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们一起先上个短期课程吧。
messages.en: Let's start with a short course together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“渴望学习画画”的场景中记忆，重点联想心里很想实现的愿望。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Desire with a negative overtone, especially sexual desire or lust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有贬义的欲望，尤其指性欲或色欲；另有“胎记”这一独立义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa b'sens negattiv, speċjalment xewqa sesswali.

sense_translations.en_definition: desire (with a negative overtone and especially sexual); lust, lustfulness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 带贬义的欲望，尤指性欲、色欲或好色。
胎记；出生时已有的皮肤印记。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ix-xehwa tal-karattru twasslu biex jittratta lill-oħrajn mingħajr rispett.
formal.en: In the novel, the character's lust leads him to treat others without respect.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，这个人物因色欲而不尊重他人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dik il-marka fuq driegħek ilha hemm? Maja: Iva, dik xehwa; twelidt biha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has that mark on your arm always been there? Maja: Yes, it's a birthmark; I was born with it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你手臂上那个印记一直都有吗？玛雅：对，那是胎记，我生下来就有。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik il-marka fuq driegħek ilha hemm?
messages.mt_standard: Dik il-marka fuq driegħek ilha hemm?
messages.zh: 你手臂上那个印记一直都有吗？
messages.en: Has that mark on your arm always been there?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，那是胎记，我生下来就有。
messages.en: Yes, it's a birthmark; I was born with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两个场景记忆：小说人物的色欲，以及手臂上的胎记；见到这个词先用上下文判断义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone's hair turn grey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人的头发变成灰白色，可用来描述忧虑等带来的影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel ix-xagħar ta' xi ħadd isir griż jew abjad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人的头发变灰白；使人愁白了头。

collocations.en: worry turned my father's hair grey
collocations.zh: 忧虑使父亲的头发变灰白了

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont, l-inkwiet kontinwu xejjeb lill-missier qabel iż-żmien.
formal.en: According to the story, constant worry turned the father's hair grey prematurely.
formal.zh: 故事中，持续的忧虑让这位父亲过早地白了头。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għandu ħafna xagħar griż issa. Maja: Jgħid li l-inkwiet xejjeb lilu!
colloquial.en: Lara: Mark has a lot of grey hair now. Maja: He says worry turned his hair grey!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克现在有好多灰白头发。玛雅：他说都是操心愁白的！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għandu ħafna xagħar griż issa.
messages.mt_standard: Mark għandu ħafna xagħar griż issa.
messages.zh: 马克现在有好多灰白头发。
messages.en: Mark has a lot of grey hair now.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他说都是操心愁白的！
messages.en: He says worry turned his hair grey!

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想汉语“愁白了头”：把忧虑和头发逐渐灰白的画面连在一起，记住使头发变灰白。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a hole in something using an awl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锥子在某物上刺出或打出孔洞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel toqba f'xi ħaġa permezz ta' xifa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a hole in sth. with an awl
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锥子在某物上打孔。

collocations.en: made a hole in the leather with an awl
collocations.zh: 用锥子在皮革上打了孔

collocations.en: made a hole in the belt with an awl
collocations.zh: 用锥子在腰带上打了孔

formal.mt: L-artiġjan xejjef il-ġilda b'xifa qabel għadda l-ħajta mit-toqba.
formal.en: The craftsperson made a hole in the leather with an awl before passing the thread through it.
formal.zh: 工匠先用锥子在皮革上打孔，再把线穿过孔洞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għamel dik it-toqba fiċ-ċinturin? Mark: Xejjef iċ-ċinturin b'xifa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he make that hole in the belt? Mark: He made it with a small awl.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他怎么在腰带上打出那个孔的？马克：他用一把小锥子打的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 他怎么在腰带上打出那个孔的？
messages.en: How did he make that hole in the belt?

messages.speaker: Mark (工匠)
messages.zh: 他用一把小锥子打的。
messages.en: He made it with a small awl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象修腰带时用尖锥刺出一个小孔，把“锥子、皮革、孔洞”三个画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To card fibres such as flax or cotton, separating and arranging them before further processing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 梳理亚麻、棉花等纤维，使纤维分开并排列整齐，以便进一步加工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred u jirranġa l-fibri ta' materjal bħall-kittien jew il-qoton billi jimxathom.

sense_translations.en_definition: to card (used of materials such as flax, cotton etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳理亚麻、棉花等材料的纤维；梳棉。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-artiġjan xejjet il-qoton biex jifred u jirranġa l-fibri qabel l-għażil.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the craftsperson carded the cotton to separate and arrange the fibres before spinning.
formal.zh: 演示时，工匠梳理棉花，将纤维分开并排列整齐，为纺纱做准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel bil-qoton qabel beda jagħżel? Mark: Xejjet il-qoton biex il-fibri ma jibqgħux imħabblin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did he do with the cotton before he started spinning? Mark: He carded it so the fibres would no longer be tangled.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：开始纺纱之前，他对棉花做了什么？马克：他把棉花梳理了一遍，让纤维不再缠在一起。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 开始纺纱之前，他对棉花做了什么？
messages.en: What did he do with the cotton before he started spinning?

messages.speaker: Mark (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Xejjet il-qoton biex il-fibri ma jibqgħux imħabblin.
messages.mt_standard: Xejjet il-qoton biex il-fibri ma jibqgħux imħabblin.
messages.zh: 他把棉花梳理了一遍，让纤维不再缠在一起。
messages.en: He carded it so the fibres would no longer be tangled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一团纠缠的棉花梳头，把纤维梳开、排顺，再拿去纺纱，由此记住梳理纤维。

gloss_zh: 用尖器穿孔；收紧钓线的松弛部分

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pierce something with a sharp instrument, or to take up the slack in a fishing line.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用尖锐工具把物体刺穿或打出孔；也指收起钓线中松弛的部分，使线绷紧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Itaqqab xi ħaġa b'għodda bil-ponta, jew jiġbed ix-xlief tas-sajd biex ma jibqax maħlul.

sense_translations.en_definition: to perforate with a sharp instrument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用尖锐工具刺穿或穿孔。

sense_translations.en_definition: to draw in the slack of a fishing line
sense_translations.zh_definition: 收起钓线中松弛的部分，把钓线收紧。

collocations.en: pierced the paper with a needle
perforated the leather with a pointed tool
collocations.zh: 用尖头工具给皮革穿孔

collocations.en: took up the slack in the fishing line

formal.mt: Waqt it-tħejjija tal-mudell, l-istudent xekk il-karta b'labra biex jgħaddi ħajta mit-toqba.
formal.en: While preparing the model, the student pierced the paper with a needle so that a thread could pass through the hole.
formal.zh: 制作模型时，学生用针在纸上穿了一个孔，好让线从孔里穿过去。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ġibed ix-xlief? Pawlu: Kien maħlul, u Mark xekk ix-xlief biex jerġa' jkun issikkat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark pull in the fishing line? Pawlu: It was slack, and Mark took up the slack to make it taut again.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么把钓线往回收？保罗：线松了，马克收起了松弛的部分，让它重新绷紧。

messages.speaker: Lara (钓友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么把钓线往回收？
messages.en: Why did Mark pull in the fishing line?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (钓友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien maħlul, u Mark xekk ix-xlief biex jerġa' jkun issikkat.
messages.mt_standard: Kien maħlul, u Mark xekk ix-xlief biex jerġa' jkun issikkat.
messages.zh: 线松了，马克收起了松弛的部分，让它重新绷紧。
messages.en: It was slack, and Mark took up the slack to make it taut again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项画成两幅学习小图：一幅是针穿纸孔，一幅是手收松钓线；看到工具或钓线，就切换到相应含义。

gloss_zh: 用尖器穿孔；干涉别人的事情

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pierce something with a sharp instrument, or to interfere in another person's affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用尖锐工具刺穿物体或给物体穿孔；也指插手、干涉别人的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Itaqqab xi ħaġa b'għodda bil-ponta, jew jindaħal fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to perforate with a sharp instrument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用尖锐工具刺穿或穿孔。

sense_translations.en_definition: to interfer in other people's affairs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 插手或干涉别人的事情。

collocations.en: perforated the paper with a needle

formal.mt: Matul il-workshop, l-artiġjan xekkek biċċa ġilda b'għodda bil-ponta biex joħloq ringiela ta' toqob.
formal.en: During the workshop, the craftsperson perforated a piece of leather with a pointed tool to create a row of holes.
formal.zh: 在手工工作坊中，工匠用尖头工具给一块皮革穿孔，做出了一排小孔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Anna rrabjat ma' Mark? Lara: Għax Mark xekkek fl-affarijiet tagħha mingħajr ma staqsieha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Anna get angry with Mark? Lara: Because Mark interfered in her affairs without asking her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：安娜为什么生马克的气？拉拉：因为马克没问过她，就插手了她的事情。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 安娜为什么生马克的气？
messages.en: Why did Anna get angry with Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Mark xekkek fl-affarijiet tagħha mingħajr ma staqsieha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Mark xekkek fl-affarijiet tagħha mingħajr ma staqsieha.
messages.zh: 因为马克没问过她，就插手了她的事情。
messages.en: Because Mark interfered in her affairs without asking her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“穿孔”和“插手”两张情景卡记忆：前者有针和材料，后者有人和私事。这只是辨义联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to feel sudden surprise or fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人突然受到惊吓，或让某人感到害怕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibeżża' jew jaħsad lil xi ħadd għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使突然受惊；使害怕。

collocations.en: frightened his sister with a shout
collocations.zh: 用一声喊叫吓到了妹妹或姐姐

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi tal-allarm xekxek lill-istudenti li kienu qed jaqraw fis-skiet.
formal.en: The loud sound of the alarm startled the students who were reading quietly.
formal.zh: 响亮的警报声把正在安静阅读的学生们吓了一跳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qabżet Anna? Mark: Il-bieb ħabat f'daqqa u xekxek lil Anna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Anna jump? Mark: The door suddenly banged and startled Anna.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：安娜怎么突然跳了一下？马克：门突然砰地响了一声，把她吓了一跳。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 安娜怎么突然跳了一下？
messages.en: Why did Anna jump?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb ħabat f'daqqa u xekxek lil Anna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb ħabat f'daqqa u xekxek lil Anna.
messages.zh: 门突然砰地响了一声，把她吓了一跳。
messages.en: The door suddenly banged and startled Anna.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安静读书时门突然砰响，人猛地一跳；把整段动作配给 xekxek，记住它表示“使人受惊”的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making someone feel sudden surprise or fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人突然受到惊吓的行为或举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih xi ħadd ibeżża' jew jaħsad lil persuna oħra għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人突然受惊的行为。

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega li x-xekxik apposta ta' studenti oħra jista' jfixkel il-konċentrazzjoni tagħhom.
formal.en: The teacher explained that deliberately startling other students can disrupt their concentration.
formal.zh: 老师解释说，故意惊吓其他学生可能会打断他们的注意力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab magħhom? Maja: Għax ma jogħġobnix ix-xekxik waqt il-logħob; nippreferi logħba aktar kalma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you want to play with them? Maja: Because I don't like people startling others during play; I prefer a calmer game.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不想跟他们玩？玛雅：因为我不喜欢玩耍时吓人的举动，我更喜欢安静一点的游戏。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想跟他们玩？
messages.en: Why don't you want to play with them?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma jogħġobnix ix-xekxik waqt il-logħob; nippreferi logħba aktar kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma jogħġobnix ix-xekxik waqt il-logħob; nippreferi logħba aktar kalma.
messages.zh: 因为我不喜欢玩耍时吓人的举动，我更喜欢安静一点的游戏。
messages.en: Because I don't like people startling others during play; I prefer a calmer game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“吓人”这段动作装进一个标着“行为”的盒子：xekxik 是盒子里的名词，表示惊吓别人的举动，而不是受惊的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To invent a story, explanation, or detail rather than report an existing fact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凭想象编出故事、解释或细节，而非陈述已有事实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jivvinta storja, spjegazzjoni jew dettall minflok jirrakkonta fatt li ġara tassew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编造或虚构某事，例如故事、理由或细节。

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju tal-kitba kreattiva, l-istudent xell storja dwar raħal żgħir ħdejn il-baħar.
formal.en: For the creative writing exercise, the student made up a story about a small village by the sea.
formal.zh: 在创意写作练习中，学生编了一个关于海边小村庄的故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik l-istorja ġrat tassew? Mark: Le, Pawlu xell storja biex idaħħakna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did that story really happen? Mark: No, Pawlu made up a story to make us laugh.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个故事真的发生过吗？马克：没有，保罗编了个故事逗我们笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个故事真的发生过吗？
messages.en: Did that story really happen?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Pawlu xell storja biex idaħħakna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Pawlu xell storja biex idaħħakna.
messages.zh: 没有，保罗编了个故事逗我们笑。
messages.en: No, Pawlu made up a story to make us laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面前原本是一张白纸，人物和情节都是刚编出来的；用“从空白编出故事”的画面记住 xell。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use one's left hand to perform an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用自己的左手完成某个动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża l-id tax-xellug biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用左手做某事。

collocations.en: used his left hand while writing
used his left hand to catch the ball
used his left hand to pick up the spoon

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, l-istudent xelleg biex jiġbor il-kuċċarina minn fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: During the exercise, the student used his left hand to pick up the spoon from the table.
formal.zh: 练习时，学生用左手拿起了桌上的勺子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: B'liema id qabad il-ballun Mark? Pawlu: Xelleg biex jaqbdu; uża l-id tax-xellug.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which hand did Mark use to catch the ball? Pawlu: He used his left hand to catch it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克用哪只手接住了球？保罗：他用左手接住的，用的是左手。

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.zh: 马克用哪只手接住了球？
messages.en: Which hand did Mark use to catch the ball?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xelleg biex jaqbdu; uża l-id tax-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Xelleg biex jaqbdu; uża l-id tax-xellug.
messages.zh: 他用左手接住的，用的是左手。
messages.en: He used his left hand to catch it; it was his left hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 xelleg 时实际抬一下左手，再做拿笔或接球的动作；把这个词和“使用左手”的动作绑定，不必推断这个人的惯用手。

gloss_zh: 疏缝；说谎；壳类（名词复数）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join fabric temporarily with loose stitches, or to say something one knows is untrue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用临时的疏针脚把布料缝在一起；也指明知不实而说谎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad id-drapp b'punti temporanji u laxki, jew jgħid xi ħaġa li jaf li mhix vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疏缝；用临时的大针脚固定布料。
说谎；故意说出不真实的话。
壳；壳类的复数，如贝壳。

collocations.en: tacked two pieces of fabric together

formal.mt: Qabel il-ħjata finali, il-ħajjat xellel iż-żewġ biċċiet drapp biex iżommhom f'posthom.
formal.en: Before the final stitching, the tailor tacked the two pieces of fabric together to hold them in place.
formal.zh: 正式缝合之前，裁缝先把两块布疏缝在一起，以固定它们的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark qal li kien id-dar, imma rajtu fil-belt. Lara: Mela xellel dwar fejn kien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark said he was at home, but I saw him in town. Lara: Then he lied about where he was.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克说他在家，可我在城里看见他了。拉拉：那他就是在自己当时在哪里这件事上说了谎。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark qal li kien id-dar, imma rajtu fil-belt.
messages.mt_standard: Mark qal li kien id-dar, imma rajtu fil-belt.
messages.zh: 马克说他在家，可我在城里看见他了。
messages.en: Mark said he was at home, but I saw him in town.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那他就是在自己当时在哪里这件事上说了谎。
messages.en: Then he lied about where he was.

cognitive_memory_aid: 准备三张独立词义卡：“针线疏缝”“开口说谎”“沙上贝壳”。前两张标动词，最后一张标名词复数，按语境选择，不把三个意思硬连成词源故事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using the left hand by preference, or relating to the political left wing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 惯于优先使用左手的；也指与政治左翼有关或属于政治左翼的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża l-aktar l-id tax-xellug, jew li għandu x'jaqsam max-xellug politiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 左撇子的；惯用左手的。

sense_translations.en_definition: of or belonging to the political left wing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 政治左翼的；属于政治左翼的。

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-lezzjoni, il-partit xellugi ppreżenta proposta dwar is-servizzi pubbliċi.
formal.en: In the lesson's example, the left-wing party presented a proposal concerning public services.
formal.zh: 在课堂例子中，左翼政党提出了一项有关公共服务的建议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark jikteb b'idu tax-xellug? Lara: Iva, hu xellugi u dejjem jagħżel dik l-id biex jikteb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Mark write with his left hand? Lara: Yes, he is left-handed and always chooses that hand for writing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克用左手写字吗？拉拉：对，他是左撇子，写字总是用那只手。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马克用左手写字吗？
messages.en: Does Mark write with his left hand?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu xellugi u dejjem jagħżel dik l-id biex jikteb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu xellugi u dejjem jagħżel dik l-id biex jikteb.
messages.zh: 对，他是左撇子，写字总是用那只手。
messages.en: Yes, he is left-handed and always chooses that hand for writing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅“左”的学习图记忆：人物左手写字对应“左撇子的”，政治光谱左侧对应“左翼的”。先看修饰对象，再选含义，勿由惯用手推断政治立场。

gloss_zh: 向人揩油索取；设法讨取

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obtain something by asking or relying on other people, often without offering anything in return.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 靠向别人讨要或占别人便宜来获得东西，往往不作回报。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikseb xi ħaġa mingħand ħaddieħor billi titlob jew tiddependi fuqu, spiss mingħajr ma tagħti xejn lura.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sponge on sb. to obtain sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为得到某物而依赖、揩油或占某人的便宜。
向别人讨取或设法弄到所需之物。

collocations.en: scrounged a meal off his friend
collocations.zh: 从朋友那里蹭了一顿饭

collocations.en: scrounged some money off his friends

formal.mt: Għal diversi ġimgħat, ir-raġel xemaq ikel u flus mingħand il-ġirien mingħajr ma offra xejn lura.
formal.en: For several weeks, the man scrounged food and money off his neighbours without offering anything in return.
formal.zh: 连续几个星期，这名男子向邻居们蹭吃讨钱，却没有作出任何回报。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu reġa' xemaq ikla mingħandek? Rita: Iva, kiel magħna u telaq mingħajr lanqas biss qal grazzi.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did Pawlu scrounge another meal off you? Rita: Yes, he ate with us and left without even saying thank you.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗又到你那里蹭饭了？丽塔：是啊，他和我们一起吃完就走了，连谢谢也没说。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗又到你那里蹭饭了？
messages.en: Did Pawlu scrounge another meal off you?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kiel magħna u telaq mingħajr lanqas biss qal grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kiel magħna u telaq mingħajr lanqas biss qal grazzi.
messages.zh: 是啊，他和我们一起吃完就走了，连谢谢也没说。
messages.en: Yes, he ate with us and left without even saying thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xemaq 放进“又来蹭饭、又来讨钱”的小故事里，记住向别人索取而少有回报的意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A candle with a wick that can be lit, or the wax material used to make candles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以点燃烛芯照明的蜡烛，也指制作蜡烛所用的蜡这种材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett tax-xama' b'ftila li tinxtegħel biex tagħti d-dawl, jew il-materjal tax-xama' nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜡烛；带有烛芯、点燃后可以发光的物件。
蜡；可用于制作蜡烛等物品的材料。

formal.mt: Matul l-attività, kull parteċipant xegħel xemgħa u qegħedha f'post sigur fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: During the activity, each participant lit a candle and placed it in a safe position on the table.
formal.zh: 活动期间，每位参与者都点燃了一支蜡烛，并把它放在桌上安全的位置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek xemgħa? Mar id-dawl. David: Iva, hemm waħda fil-kexxun. Se nġibha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a candle? The power has gone out. David: Yes, there's one in the drawer. I'll get it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有蜡烛吗？停电了。戴维：有，抽屉里有一支。我去拿。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你有蜡烛吗？停电了。
messages.en: Do you have a candle? The power has gone out.

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda fil-kexxun. Se nġibha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda fil-kexxun. Se nġibha.
messages.zh: 有，抽屉里有一支。我去拿。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in the drawer. I'll get it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一支点燃的 xemgħa 慢慢融成蜡：完整时记“蜡烛”，融化后记“蜡”，把两个义项连起来。

gloss_zh: 闪米特的；闪米特语族的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Semitic peoples or to the Semitic family of languages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与闪米特诸民族有关的，或属于闪米特语族、具有该语族相关特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-popli Semitiċi jew mal-familja tal-ilsna Semitiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪米特的；与闪米特诸民族或闪米特语族有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ntalbu jagħżlu ilsien xemi u jiddeskrivu xi wħud mill-karatteristiċi tiegħu.
formal.en: The students were asked to choose a Semitic language and describe some of its features.
formal.zh: 学生们被要求选择一种闪米特语族语言，并描述它的一些特征。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'xemi' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Hawn ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-familja tal-ilsna Semitiċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'xemi' mean in this sentence? Mark: Here it means relating to the Semitic family of languages.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这个句子里的 xemi 是什么意思？马克：这里的意思是与闪米特语族有关的。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 xemi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'xemi' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-familja tal-ilsna Semitiċi.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-familja tal-ilsna Semitiċi.
messages.zh: 这里的意思是与闪米特语族有关的。
messages.en: Here it means relating to the Semitic family of languages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xemi 写在语言家族分类图的“闪米特语族”标签旁，练习用它描述一种语言或一个语言成分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes or sells candles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作或售卖蜡烛的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel jew tbigħ ix-xemgħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜡烛制造者或蜡烛商；以制作或售卖蜡烛为业的人。

collocations.zh: 一位手艺娴熟的蜡烛匠

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-ħanut, ix-xemmiegħ spjega kif jagħżel il-ftila u kif jimla l-forom bix-xama'.
formal.en: During the shop visit, the candle maker explained how he chooses the wick and fills the moulds with wax.
formal.zh: 参观店铺时，蜡烛匠讲解了他如何挑选烛芯，以及如何把蜡灌入模具。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Minn fejn xtrajt dawn ix-xemgħat? Ġorġ: Mingħand ix-xemmiegħ ħdejn il-pjazza. Jagħmilhom hu stess.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you buy these candles? Ġorġ: From the candle maker near the square. He makes them himself.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这些蜡烛你在哪里买的？乔治：在广场旁边那位蜡烛匠那里买的，都是他亲手做的。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些蜡烛你在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy these candles?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mingħand ix-xemmiegħ ħdejn il-pjazza. Jagħmilhom hu stess.
messages.mt_standard: Mingħand ix-xemmiegħ ħdejn il-pjazza. Jagħmilhom hu stess.
messages.zh: 在广场旁边那位蜡烛匠那里买的，都是他亲手做的。
messages.en: From the candle maker near the square. He makes them himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一位正在灌蜡、摆卖蜡烛的店主，把 xemmiegħ 标在人身上，记住它指制作或售卖蜡烛的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sell something at a reduced price, or to judge or present it as worth less than it really is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以降低后的价格出售某物；也指把某物的价值估得过低，或加以贬低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbigħ xi ħaġa bi prezz imnaqqas, jew tqis jew tippreżenta xi ħaġa bħala li tiswa inqas milli tassew tiswa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 降低价格出售；以减价后的价格售卖。
低估某物的价值；把它看得过低或加以贬低。

collocations.en: sold the goods at reduced prices

collocations.zh: 低估了他人的工作价值

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-istaġun, il-bejjiegħ xemnaq il-merkanzija li kien għad fadallu biex jagħmel spazju għal prodotti ġodda.
formal.en: At the end of the season, the seller sold his remaining goods at reduced prices to make room for new products.
formal.zh: 季末时，卖家把剩余货物降价出售，为新产品腾出空间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif marret il-laqgħa? Toni: Ħażin. Il-maniġer xemnaq ix-xogħol tagħna u qal li ma kien jiswa kważi xejn.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did the meeting go? Toni: Badly. The manager undervalued our work and said it was worth almost nothing.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：会议开得怎么样？托尼：很糟。经理贬低了我们的工作，说它几乎毫无价值。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 会议开得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting go?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħażin. Il-maniġer xemnaq ix-xogħol tagħna u qal li ma kien jiswa kważi xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Ħażin. Il-maniġer xemnaq ix-xogħol tagħna u qal li ma kien jiswa kważi xejn.
messages.zh: 很糟。经理贬低了我们的工作，说它几乎毫无价值。
messages.en: Badly. The manager undervalued our work and said it was worth almost nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xemnaq 配两幅图：一幅把商品价格往下调，一幅把别人的价值看得过低，分别记住降价与低估。

gloss_zh: 贬低事物的人；对事物表示轻蔑的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who belittles something or shows contempt for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贬低某事物，或对它表现出轻蔑态度的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tnaqqas mill-valur ta' xi ħaġa jew turi disprezz lejha.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who depreciates or displays contempt for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 贬低某事物的价值，或对某事物表示轻蔑的人。

collocations.en: a person who disparages other people's work

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kritiku jidher bħala xemnieq tal-arti, għax iwarrab kull xogħol mingħajr ma jipprova jifhmu.
formal.en: In the story, the critic comes across as someone who belittles art, because he dismisses every work without trying to understand it.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这位评论家显得是个贬低艺术的人，因为他不尝试理解任何作品，就一概予以否定。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex sejjaħtlu xemnieq? Pietru: Għax kull darba li nuruh xi ħaġa li għamilna, jgħid li ma tiswa xejn.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you call him someone who belittles things? Pietru: Because every time we show him something we've made, he says it's worthless.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么说他是个爱贬低事物的人？彼得：因为每次我们给他看自己做的东西，他都说一文不值。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个爱贬低事物的人？
messages.en: Why did you call him someone who belittles things?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li nuruh xi ħaġa li għamilna, jgħid li ma tiswa xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li nuruh xi ħaġa li għamilna, jgħid li ma tiswa xejn.
messages.zh: 因为每次我们给他看自己做的东西，他都说一文不值。
messages.en: Because every time we show him something we've made, he says it's worthless.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个总说“这有什么价值”的人，把 xemnieq 写在他的人物卡上，记住这个名词指贬低事物的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing contempt or a belief that someone or something deserves little respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出轻蔑或鄙视的，认为某人或某事物不值得尊重的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri disprezz jew li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa ma jistħoqqlux rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻蔑的；流露出鄙视、不屑或看不起的态度的。

collocations.zh: 一句带有轻蔑意味的评论

formal.mt: Il-kumment xemnieqi dwar il-proposta ma għenx lid-diskussjoni, għax esprima disprezz mingħajr ma ta raġunijiet ċari.
formal.en: The contemptuous comment about the proposal did not help the discussion, because it expressed disdain without giving clear reasons.
formal.zh: 那句针对提案的轻蔑评论无助于讨论，因为它只表达了鄙视，却没有给出清楚的理由。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tlaqt minn mal-mejda? Luqa: Ma għoġobnix it-ton xemnieqi tiegħu meta tkellem dwar ix-xogħol tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you leave the table? Luqa: I didn't like his contemptuous tone when he talked about my work.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么离开餐桌了？卢卡：他谈到我的工作时，语气很轻蔑，我不喜欢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开餐桌了？
messages.en: Why did you leave the table?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma għoġobnix it-ton xemnieqi tiegħu meta tkellem dwar ix-xogħol tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ma għoġobnix it-ton xemnieqi tiegħu meta tkellem dwar ix-xogħol tiegħi.
messages.zh: 他谈到我的工作时，语气很轻蔑，我不喜欢。
messages.en: I didn't like his contemptuous tone when he talked about my work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xemnieqi 配上撇嘴、冷笑的表情，再读 ton xemnieqi“轻蔑的语气”，用声音和表情一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice or act of selling goods at reduced prices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以降低后的价格出售商品的行为或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bejgħ ta' oġġetti bi prezzijiet imnaqqsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 削价销售；以低于原价或通常价格的价格出售商品的行为。

collocations.en: cut-price selling at the end of the season

formal.mt: Ix-xemniq tal-merkanzija fl-aħħar tal-istaġun għen lill-ħanut inaqqas l-istokk u jagħmel spazju għal prodotti ġodda.
formal.en: Selling goods at reduced prices at the end of the season helped the shop reduce its stock and make room for new products.
formal.zh: 季末降价出售货物，帮助这家店减少了库存，并为新产品腾出了空间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm dan ix-xemniq kollu fil-ħanut? Elena: Qed ibiegħu l-affarijiet tal-istaġun li għadda bi prezzijiet aktar baxxi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is there so much cut-price selling in the shop? Elena: They're selling last season's items at lower prices.
colloquial.zh: 马克：店里怎么有这么多降价销售？埃莱娜：他们正把上一季的商品降价卖掉。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dan ix-xemniq kollu fil-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dan ix-xemniq kollu fil-ħanut?
messages.zh: 店里怎么有这么多降价销售？
messages.en: Why is there so much cut-price selling in the shop?

messages.speaker: Elena (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed ibiegħu l-affarijiet tal-istaġun li għadda bi prezzijiet aktar baxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed ibiegħu l-affarijiet tal-istaġun li għadda bi prezzijiet aktar baxxi.
messages.zh: 他们正把上一季的商品降价卖掉。
messages.en: They're selling last season's items at lower prices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xemniq 写在季末促销场景的标题上：价签变低、货物售出，记住它是“降价销售”这一行为的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a sound while drawing breath in, especially of a donkey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在吸气时发出声音，尤其用于描述驴的叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss waqt li jieħu n-nifs 'il ġewwa, speċjalment meta jingħad għal ħmar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a sound while inhaling (said esp. of donkeys)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸气时发出声音，尤其指驴。

collocations.en: the donkey made a sound while inhaling

collocations.mt: xenaq waqt li ħa n-nifs 'il ġewwa
collocations.en: made a sound while drawing breath in

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, il-ħmar xenaq: il-ħoss instema' meta ħa n-nifs 'il ġewwa.
formal.en: During the observation, the donkey made a sound while inhaling: the sound was heard as it drew breath in.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，驴吸气时发出了声音：声音出现在它吸入气息的时候。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Iva, il-ħmar xenaq waqt li ħa n-nifs 'il ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that sound? Pawlu: Yes, the donkey made it while drawing breath in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那个声音了吗？保罗：听到了，是驴吸气时发出的声音。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħmar xenaq waqt li ħa n-nifs 'il ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħmar xenaq waqt li ħa n-nifs 'il ġewwa.
messages.zh: 听到了，是驴吸气时发出的声音。
messages.en: Yes, the donkey made it while drawing breath in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一头驴吸入空气时同时发声，把“吸气”和“出声”两个动作连起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of a dwarf form, with a much shorter stature or smaller size than the usual form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈矮小形态的，比通常的同类明显矮小；可用于描述矮生植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' għamla baxxa jew żgħira ħafna meta mqabbel ma' oħrajn tal-istess tip.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矮小的；矮生的。

formal.mt: Għal dan il-ġnien żgħir intgħażel arbuxxell xendi, għax jibqa' baxx meta jikber.
formal.en: A dwarf shrub was chosen for this small garden because it stays low as it grows.
formal.zh: 这座小花园选用了矮生灌木，因为它长大后仍然比较低矮。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-arbuxxell se jikber ħafna? Mark: Le, huwa tip xendi u jibqa' baxx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Will this shrub grow very tall? Mark: No, it is a dwarf type and stays low.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这棵灌木会长得很高吗？马克：不会，这是矮生类型，会保持低矮。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这棵灌木会长得很高吗？
messages.en: Will this shrub grow very tall?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa tip xendi u jibqa' baxx.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa tip xendi u jibqa' baxx.
messages.zh: 不会，这是矮生类型，会保持低矮。
messages.en: No, it is a dwarf type and stays low.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把普通灌木和矮生灌木并排想象，给较矮的一棵贴上 xendi，记住它描述矮小形态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sway from side to side or lean towards one side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或物体向两侧摇摆，或向某一侧倾斜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq minn naħa għal oħra jew imejjel lejn naħa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇摆；来回晃动。
倾斜；向一侧偏过去。

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, ir-raġel xengel minn naħa għal oħra u mbagħad xengel lejn il-lemin.
formal.en: During the exercise, the man swayed from side to side and then leaned to the right.
formal.zh: 练习过程中，这名男子先左右摇摆，随后向右倾斜。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qabad mal-mejda? Toni: Xengel lejn il-ġenb u kważi waqa'.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did he grab the table? Toni: He leaned to one side and almost fell.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他为什么抓住桌子？托尼：他向旁边一歪，差点摔倒。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么抓住桌子？
messages.en: Why did he grab the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xengel lejn il-ġenb u kważi waqa'.
messages.mt_standard: Xengel lejn il-ġenb u kważi waqa'.
messages.zh: 他向旁边一歪，差点摔倒。
messages.en: He leaned to one side and almost fell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用身体演示两幅画面：左右来回是“摇摆”，偏向一边是“倾斜”，都与 xengel 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tilts from side to side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体向左右两侧歪摆的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmejjel ġisimha minn naħa għal oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who tilts from side to side
sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体左右歪摆的人。

collocations.en: a person walking along the street while tilting from side to side
collocations.zh: 在街上走路时身体左右歪摆的人

collocations.en: the role of a person who tilts from side to side
collocations.zh: 身体左右歪摆者的角色

formal.mt: F'din ix-xena, l-attur għandu r-rwol ta' xengiel u jmejjel ġismu minn naħa għal oħra.
formal.en: In this scene, the actor plays a person who tilts from side to side and moves his body accordingly.
formal.zh: 在这一幕中，演员扮演一个身体左右歪摆的人，并相应地向两侧倾斜身体。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se turi li l-karattru huwa xengiel? Luqa: Se nimxi bil-mod u nmejjel ġismi minn naħa għal oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: How will you show that the character tilts from side to side? Luqa: I will walk slowly and tilt my body from side to side.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你准备怎样表现这个左右歪摆的角色？卢卡：我会慢慢走，让身体向左右两侧倾斜。

messages.speaker: Nina (导演)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se turi li l-karattru huwa xengiel?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se turi li l-karattru huwa xengiel?
messages.zh: 你准备怎样表现这个左右歪摆的角色？
messages.en: How will you show that the character tilts from side to side?

messages.speaker: Luqa (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nimxi bil-mod u nmejjel ġismi minn naħa għal oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Se nimxi bil-mod u nmejjel ġismi minn naħa għal oħra.
messages.zh: 我会慢慢走，让身体向左右两侧倾斜。
messages.en: I will walk slowly and tilt my body from side to side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舞台上一个身体左右歪摆的角色，记住 xengiel 指“这样的人”，而不是摇摆动作本身。

gloss_zh: 容易摇摆的；容易踉跄的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to swing from side to side or to stagger when moving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易左右摆动的，或移动时容易踉跄的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jitbandal minn naħa għal oħra jew jitfixkel waqt il-mixi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易摆动的；有摇摆倾向的。
容易踉跄的；走动时容易摇晃失稳的。

collocations.en: a movement tending to swing from side to side

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tat-teatru, l-istudent wera pass xengieli, b'ġismu jitbandal u saqajh jitħawdu.
formal.en: In the theatre exercise, the student demonstrated a staggering step, with his body swaying and his feet becoming tangled.
formal.zh: 在戏剧练习中，学生展示了容易踉跄的步态，身体左右摇摆，脚步也变得凌乱。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-pass tiegħi jidher xengieli biżżejjed għax-xena? David: Iva, imma agħmlu aktar bil-mod biex ma taqax.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does my step look sufficiently unsteady for the scene? David: Yes, but do it more slowly so you do not fall.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我的步子看起来够踉跄，能符合这一幕的要求吗？戴维：够了，不过动作再慢一点，免得摔倒。

messages.speaker: Rita (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pass tiegħi jidher xengieli biżżejjed għax-xena?
messages.mt_standard: Il-pass tiegħi jidher xengieli biżżejjed għax-xena?
messages.zh: 我的步子看起来够踉跄，能符合这一幕的要求吗？
messages.en: Does my step look sufficiently unsteady for the scene?

messages.speaker: David (导演)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma agħmlu aktar bil-mod biex ma taqax.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma agħmlu aktar bil-mod biex ma taqax.
messages.zh: 够了，不过动作再慢一点，免得摔倒。
messages.en: Yes, but do it more slowly so you do not fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xengieli 想成动作的特点标签：东西容易摆，脚步容易踉跄，重点记住“有这种倾向”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of swaying from side to side or the act of leaning to one side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 左右摇摆的动作，或向一侧倾斜的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment minn naħa għal oħra jew l-att li wieħed imejjel lejn naħa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇摆；左右晃动的动作。
倾斜；向一侧偏斜的动作。

formal.mt: L-għalliem osserva xengil tal-ġisem minn naħa għal oħra waqt l-eżerċizzju tal-bilanċ.
formal.en: The teacher observed swaying of the body from side to side during the balance exercise.
formal.zh: 在平衡练习中，老师观察到了身体左右摇摆的动作。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Għaliex qed iżżomm mas-siġġu? Ben: Biex innaqqas ix-xengil ta' ġismi waqt dan l-eżerċizzju.
colloquial.en: Emma: Why are you holding onto the chair? Ben: To reduce the swaying of my body during this exercise.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：你为什么扶着椅子？本：为了减少做这个练习时身体的摇摆。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么扶着椅子？
messages.en: Why are you holding onto the chair?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex innaqqas ix-xengil ta' ġismi waqt dan l-eżerċizzju.
messages.mt_standard: Biex innaqqas ix-xengil ta' ġismi waqt dan l-eżerċizzju.
messages.zh: 为了减少做这个练习时身体的摇摆。
messages.en: To reduce the swaying of my body during this exercise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给左右晃动或向旁边倾斜的动作画箭头，箭头代表 xengil，记住这个名词指动作本身。

gloss_zh: 摇晃不稳的；站立不稳的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unsteady on one's feet, for example because of drunkenness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脚下不稳、身体摇晃的，例如因醉酒而站立或行走不稳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx sod fuq saqajh u jitbandal, pereżempju minħabba s-sokor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇晃不稳的，尤指因醉酒等原因而站立或行走不稳。

collocations.en: a man who is unsteady on his feet

formal.mt: Ir-raġel kien xenguli minħabba s-sokor, u ħabibu għenu joqgħod bilqiegħda.
formal.en: The man was unsteady because of drunkenness, and his friend helped him sit down.
formal.zh: 这名男子因醉酒而摇晃不稳，朋友扶他坐了下来。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int xenguli; ejja oqgħod bilqiegħda. Pietru: Iva, għinni nasal sas-siġġu, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: You are unsteady; come and sit down. Pietru: Yes, help me get to the chair, please.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你站不稳了，来坐下吧。彼得：好，请扶我走到椅子那里。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你站不稳了，来坐下吧。
messages.en: You are unsteady; come and sit down.

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għinni nasal sas-siġġu, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għinni nasal sas-siġġu, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好，请扶我走到椅子那里。
messages.en: Yes, help me get to the chair, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个脚下不稳、需要扶住椅子的人，用 xenguli 给他的状态贴标签，重点是“失去稳定”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to scenery or the visual setting of a performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与布景或演出的视觉场景有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut max-xenarju jew mad-dehra viżiva ta' spettaklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布景的；与场景或舞台景观有关的。

formal.mt: Id-disinn xeniku tal-produzzjoni juża pannelli miżbugħa u dawl artab biex joħloq l-atmosfera ta' ġnien.
formal.en: The production's scenic design uses painted panels and soft lighting to create the atmosphere of a garden.
formal.zh: 这部演出的舞台布景设计采用彩绘板和柔和的灯光，营造花园的氛围。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Jogħġbok id-disinn xeniku tad-dramm? Karl: Iva, is-siġar u d-dawl jagħmlu l-palk jidher bħal ġnien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you like the play's scenic design? Karl: Yes, the trees and lighting make the stage look like a garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你喜欢这部戏的舞台布景设计吗？卡尔：喜欢，树木和灯光让舞台看起来像一座花园。

messages.speaker: Marija (观众)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部戏的舞台布景设计吗？
messages.en: Do you like the play's scenic design?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-siġar u d-dawl jagħmlu l-palk jidher bħal ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-siġar u d-dawl jagħmlu l-palk jidher bħal ġnien.
messages.zh: 喜欢，树木和灯光让舞台看起来像一座花园。
messages.en: Yes, the trees and lighting make the stage look like a garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舞台上的树木、背景板和灯光，把 xeniku 与“布景呈现的视觉场景”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone crave something or feel a strong desire for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人很想得到某物；勾起食欲或其他强烈欲望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem f'xi ħadd xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使产生强烈渴望；使馋。
唤起欲望；使人产生想要某物的念头。

collocations.zh: 用糖果把孩子们馋起来

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt tal-ħobż frisk xennaq lill-qarrejja biex iduquh.
formal.en: The photograph of the fresh bread made the readers want to taste it.
formal.zh: 新鲜面包的照片勾起了读者品尝它的欲望。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex kulħadd irid biċċa kejk issa? Mark: Ir-ritratt li bgħatt xennaq lil kulħadd!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does everyone want a piece of cake now? Mark: The photo you sent made everyone crave it!
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么现在大家都想吃一块蛋糕？Mark：你发的照片把大家都馋到了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd irid biċċa kejk issa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd irid biċċa kejk issa?
messages.zh: 为什么现在大家都想吃一块蛋糕？
messages.en: Why does everyone want a piece of cake now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-ritratt li bgħatt xennaq lil kulħadd!
messages.mt_standard: Ir-ritratt li bgħatt xennaq lil kulħadd!
messages.zh: 你发的照片把大家都馋到了！
messages.en: The photo you sent made everyone crave it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蛋糕照片一出现，大家立刻想吃：用这个画面记住它表示“勾起别人的欲望”。

gloss_zh: 易生根的倾向；成串结果的倾向

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tendency to take root or to produce fruit in bunches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物容易生根或容易成串结果的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tendenza ta' pjanta li taqbad l-għeruq jew li tagħmel il-frott f'għenieqed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易生根的倾向或特性。

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to produce fruit in bunches
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易成串结果的倾向或特性。

collocations.en: the plant's tendency to take root
a tendency to produce fruit in bunches

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, ix-xenxiel tal-pjanta ġie deskritt bħala tendenza li taqbad l-għeruq faċilment.
formal.en: In the report, the plant's xenxiel was described as a tendency to take root easily.
formal.zh: 报告将这种植物的 xenxiel 描述为容易生根的倾向。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser xenxiel hawn? Pawlu: Ifisser li l-pjanta għandha tendenza taqbad l-għeruq faċilment.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does xenxiel mean here? Pawlu: It means that the plant tends to take root easily.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 xenxiel 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是这种植物容易生根。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 xenxiel 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does xenxiel mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-pjanta għandha tendenza taqbad l-għeruq faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-pjanta għandha tendenza taqbad l-għeruq faċilment.
messages.zh: 意思是这种植物容易生根。
messages.en: It means that the plant tends to take root easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在植物卡片上画两幅图：一幅根须容易长出，一幅果实成串；用两图记住这个名词的两种倾向。

gloss_zh: 易成串出现的；易生根的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to occur in bunches or, of plants, to take root readily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于成串、成簇出现的；也指植物容易生根的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jidher f'għenieqed jew, fil-każ tal-pjanti, jaqbad l-għeruq faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易成串或成簇出现的。
容易生根的；倾向于扎根的。

collocations.en: fruit that tends to occur in bunches
plants that tend to take root readily

formal.mt: Dawn il-pjanti huma xenxieli u jaqbdu l-għeruq faċilment f'ħamrija niedja.
formal.en: These plants tend to take root readily and establish roots easily in moist soil.
formal.zh: 这些植物容易生根，在湿润的土壤里很容易长出根来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dawn il-pjanti jaqbdu l-għeruq malajr? Toni: Iva, huma xenxieli; żomm il-ħamrija niedja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do these plants take root quickly? Toni: Yes, they root readily; keep the soil moist.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些植物生根快吗？Toni：快，它们容易生根；让土壤保持湿润。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这些植物生根快吗？
messages.en: Do these plants take root quickly?

messages.speaker: Toni (花店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma xenxieli; żomm il-ħamrija niedja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma xenxieli; żomm il-ħamrija niedja.
messages.zh: 快，它们容易生根；让土壤保持湿润。
messages.en: Yes, they root readily; keep the soil moist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它写在植物图片旁作为形容词标签：“容易生根的”；换成果实图片，就记“容易成串的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The growth of roots; in a separate sense, excessive showiness or affected behavior.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根的生长或生根过程；另一个义项指过分炫耀、装腔作势或矫饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkabbir tal-għeruq; f'tifsira oħra, tiżjin żejjed jew imġiba artifiċjali biex wieħed jidher.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 根的生长；生根的过程。
过分炫耀、矫饰或装腔作势。

collocations.en: the growing of roots in plants

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw ix-xenxil tal-pjanti u rreġistraw it-tul tal-għeruq kull ġimgħa.
formal.en: The students observed the plants' root growth and recorded the length of the roots every week.
formal.zh: 学生们观察植物的生根过程，并每周记录根的长度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbok id-diskors? David: Kellu wisq xenxil; kien ikun aħjar bi kliem sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you like the speech? David: There was too much affectation; it would have been better in simple language.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你喜欢那篇演讲吗？David：太装腔作势了；用简单的话说会更好。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那篇演讲吗？
messages.en: Did you like the speech?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu wisq xenxil; kien ikun aħjar bi kliem sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu wisq xenxil; kien ikun aħjar bi kliem sempliċi.
messages.zh: 太装腔作势了；用简单的话说会更好。
messages.en: There was too much affectation; it would have been better in simple language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立记忆卡区分义项：一张画正在长根的植物，一张画说话矫揉造作的人，不必把两义硬连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of disgust toward something unpleasant or repulsive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对令人不快或反感的事物时产生的强烈厌恶感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens qawwi ta' stmerrija lejn xi ħaġa li tqanqal ripugnanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厌恶；嫌恶；恶心感。

formal.mt: Ir-riħa tal-ikel imħassar qajmet sens ta' xenxila fost dawk li daħlu fil-kamra.
formal.en: The smell of the spoiled food aroused a feeling of disgust among those who entered the room.
formal.zh: 变质食物的气味让走进房间的人产生了厌恶感。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'riħa ħażina! Ben: Tqajjem xenxila. Ejja niftħu t-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Anna: What an awful smell! Ben: It makes you feel disgusted. Let's open the window.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这气味真难闻！Ben：闻着就恶心。我们把窗户打开吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 这气味真难闻！
messages.en: What an awful smell!

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 闻着就恶心。我们把窗户打开吧。
messages.en: It makes you feel disgusted. Let's open the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闻到变质食物后立刻皱眉、捂鼻的表情，把这个词和“强烈厌恶感”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of sharing something with other people, such as sharing a post or video.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物分享给他人的一次行为，例如分享或转发帖子、视频。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li bih wieħed jaqsam xi ħaġa ma' ħaddieħor, bħal meta jaqsam messaġġ jew filmat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分享；转发，指一次分享或转发行为。

collocations.zh: 对这条消息的一次转发

formal.mt: Kull xer tal-avviż jgħin biex l-informazzjoni tasal għand aktar nies.
formal.en: Every share of the announcement helps the information reach more people.
formal.zh: 每一次转发公告，都有助于让更多人收到这条信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-filmat il-ġdid? Luke: Iva! Agħmel xer tiegħu fil-grupp.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the new video? Luke: Yes! Share it in the group.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看过那个新视频了吗？Luke：看过了！把它转发到群里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过那个新视频了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the new video?

messages.speaker: Luke (朋友)
messages.zh: 看过了！把它转发到群里吧。
messages.en: Yes! Share it in the group.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xer 和手机上的“分享”按钮放在同一张记忆卡上，再用 agħmel xer 练习“转发一下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut something open along its length, especially a fish, or to dissect it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿物体的长度方向剖开，尤其用于鱼；也指解剖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiftaħ xi ħaġa billi jaqtagħha mit-tul, speċjalment ħuta, jew jiftaħha biex jeżamina l-partijiet ta' ġewwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cut along the length (used especially of fish)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿长度方向剖开，尤其指剖开鱼。
解剖；剖开以观察内部结构。

formal.mt: Il-kok xeraħ il-ħuta mit-tul u neħħa l-għadam qabel sajjarha.
formal.en: The chef cut the fish open lengthwise and removed the bones before cooking it.
formal.zh: 厨师将鱼沿长度方向剖开，去骨后再烹调。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif ħejja l-ħuta l-kok? Sam: Xeraħ il-ħuta mit-tul u mbagħad neħħa l-għadam.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did the chef prepare the fish? Sam: He cut the fish open lengthwise and then removed the bones.
colloquial.zh: Rita：厨师是怎么处理这条鱼的？Sam：他把鱼纵向剖开，然后去掉鱼骨。

messages.speaker: Rita (烹饪学生)
messages.zh: 厨师是怎么处理这条鱼的？
messages.en: How did the chef prepare the fish?

messages.speaker: Sam (烹饪同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xeraħ il-ħuta mit-tul u mbagħad neħħa l-għadam.
messages.mt_standard: Xeraħ il-ħuta mit-tul u mbagħad neħħa l-għadam.
messages.zh: 他把鱼纵向剖开，然后去掉鱼骨。
messages.en: He cut the fish open lengthwise and then removed the bones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刀沿着鱼身从头向尾划开，用这条纵向路线记住“沿长度剖开”，再联系检查内部的“解剖”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Staining a surface or smearing a substance across it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使表面沾上污渍，或把某种物质涂抹、抹散在表面上的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħammeġ wiċċ bi tbajja' jew iferrex fuqu sustanza billi jidlikha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沾污；使表面留下污渍。
涂抹；把某种物质抹开或抹散。

collocations.en: staining or smearing on the wall

formal.mt: Ix-xermid taż-żebgħa fuq il-ħġieġ ħalla tbajja' li kellhom jitnaddfu wara x-xogħol.
formal.en: The smearing of paint on the glass left marks that had to be cleaned after the work.
formal.zh: 油漆涂抹到玻璃上留下了污迹，完工后必须清理。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Minn fejn ġie dan ix-xermid fuq il-mejda? Noel: Miż-żebgħa fuq idejja. Se nnaddfu issa.
colloquial.en: Ella: Where did this smearing on the table come from? Noel: From the paint on my hands. I'll clean it up now.
colloquial.zh: Ella：桌上这些抹痕是怎么来的？Noel：是我手上的颜料弄的。我现在就清理。

messages.speaker: Ella (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġie dan ix-xermid fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġie dan ix-xermid fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌上这些抹痕是怎么来的？
messages.en: Where did this smearing on the table come from?

messages.speaker: Noel (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Miż-żebgħa fuq idejja. Se nnaddfu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Miż-żebgħa fuq idejja. Se nnaddfu issa.
messages.zh: 是我手上的颜料弄的。我现在就清理。
messages.en: From the paint on my hands. I'll clean it up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沾着颜料的手在桌面拖过：颜料被“抹开”，桌面也被“沾污”，同一画面帮助区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person wearing stained clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身上穿着沾有污渍的衣服的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun liebsa ħwejjeġ imtebbgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿着有污渍衣服的人。

collocations.en: a person in stained clothes in the garage
collocations.zh: 车库里穿着有污渍衣服的人

collocations.en: a person in stained clothes after work
collocations.zh: 干完活后衣服上沾着污渍的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħaddiem jidher bħala xermied, bi tbajja' taż-żebgħa fuq il-qmis.
formal.en: In the story, the worker appears as a person in stained clothes, with paint stains on his shirt.
formal.zh: 故事中的工人穿着有污渍的衣服，衬衫上沾着油漆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed issejjaħli xermied? Mark: Għax għandek il-qmis kollu tbajja' taż-żebgħa!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you calling me a person in stained clothes? Mark: Because your shirt is covered in paint stains!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么说我是个穿着脏衣服的人？Mark：因为你的衬衫上全是油漆渍啊！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说我是个穿着脏衣服的人？
