messages.en: Why are you calling me a person in stained clothes?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandek il-qmis kollu tbajja' taż-żebgħa!
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandek il-qmis kollu tbajja' taż-żebgħa!
messages.zh: 因为你的衬衫上全是油漆渍啊！
messages.en: Because your shirt is covered in paint stains!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个刚刷完墙、衬衫满是油漆点的人，用 xermied 给这个人贴标签；记住它指人，不是污渍本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Spattered with blood, with blood spots visible on the surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面溅有血点或血迹的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fuqu jkun hemm titjir ta' demm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溅有血迹的；被血溅到的。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher fardal xermiedi mdendel ħdejn il-mejda tal-biċċier.
formal.en: The photograph shows a blood-spattered apron hanging beside the butcher's table.
formal.zh: 照片中，一条溅有血迹的围裙挂在屠夫的工作台旁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-fardal xermiedi? Toni: Iva, tferrex ftit demm fuqu waqt ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this apron spattered with blood? Toni: Yes, a little blood splashed onto it during work.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这条围裙上溅了血吗？Toni：是的，干活时有一点血溅到了上面。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 这条围裙上溅了血吗？
messages.en: Is this apron spattered with blood?

messages.speaker: Toni (屠夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tferrex ftit demm fuqu waqt ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tferrex ftit demm fuqu waqt ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 是的，干活时有一点血溅到了上面。
messages.en: Yes, a little blood splashed onto it during work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xermiedi 和围裙上散落的红色血点一起记，重点是物体表面溅有血迹这一状态。

gloss_zh: 衣服常沾血的人；不擅长解剖的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose clothes tend to be bloodstained, typically a butcher or slaughterer; also, a person who is poor at dissecting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指衣服经常沾有血迹的人，通常是屠夫或屠宰者；也可指不擅长解剖的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li spiss ikollha d-demm fuq ħwejjiġha, tipikament biċċier jew persuna li tbiċċer l-annimali; ukoll persuna li ma tkunx tajba fid-dissezzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who tends to have bloodstains on their clothes (typically a butcher or slaughterer)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣服上经常沾有血迹的人，通常指屠夫或屠宰者。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is bad at dissecting
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不擅长解剖的人；解剖手法笨拙的人。

collocations.en: a person whose clothes tend to be bloodstained in the butcher's shop
collocations.zh: 肉铺里衣服常沾血的人

collocations.en: a person who is poor at dissecting

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-istudent jissejjaħ xermud għax ma jkunx kapaċi jagħmel dissezzjoni bir-reqqa.
formal.en: In the story, the student is called a poor dissector because he cannot carry out a dissection carefully.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名学生因为无法细致地完成解剖，被称为解剖手法笨拙的人。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex fir-rakkont isejħulu xermud? Lara: Għax huwa biċċier u spiss ikollu tbajja' tad-demm fuq ħwejġu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why do they call him a person whose clothes tend to be bloodstained in the story? Lara: Because he is a butcher and often has bloodstains on his clothes.
colloquial.zh: Mark：故事里为什么称他为衣服常沾血的人？Lara：因为他是屠夫，衣服上经常有血迹。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 故事里为什么称他为衣服常沾血的人？
messages.en: Why do they call him a person whose clothes tend to be bloodstained in the story?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa biċċier u spiss ikollu tbajja' tad-demm fuq ħwejġu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa biċċier u spiss ikollu tbajja' tad-demm fuq ħwejġu.
messages.zh: 因为他是屠夫，衣服上经常有血迹。
messages.en: Because he is a butcher and often has bloodstains on his clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xermud 准备两张人物卡：一张是衣服经常沾血的屠夫，一张是解剖手法笨拙的学生；按上下文选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wearing clothes that are stained with blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人穿着沾有血迹的衣服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun liebes ħwejjeġ imtebbgħin bid-demm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿着沾有血迹的衣服的。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi biċċier xermudi li jneħħi l-fardal qabel joħroġ mill-ħanut.
formal.en: The story describes a butcher wearing bloodstained clothes who removes his apron before leaving the shop.
formal.zh: 故事描写了一名穿着沾血衣服的屠夫，他在离开店铺前脱下了围裙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Toni għadu xermudi wara x-xogħol? Mark: Iva, għadu ma bidilx il-ħwejjeġ imtebbgħin bid-demm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Toni still wearing bloodstained clothes after work? Mark: Yes, he hasn't changed out of his bloodstained clothes yet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Toni 下班后还穿着沾血的衣服吗？Mark：是啊，他还没把沾血的衣服换下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni 下班后还穿着沾血的衣服吗？
messages.en: Is Toni still wearing bloodstained clothes after work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu ma bidilx il-ħwejjeġ imtebbgħin bid-demm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu ma bidilx il-ħwejjeġ imtebbgħin bid-demm.
messages.zh: 是啊，他还没把沾血的衣服换下来。
messages.en: Yes, he hasn't changed out of his bloodstained clothes yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 xermudi 时把镜头对准穿衣服的人：衣服沾着血，人仍穿着它；用这个画面记住形容对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Choking, with something caught in the throat and interfering with normal breathing or swallowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因东西卡在喉咙或呛入而影响正常呼吸或吞咽的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu xi ħaġa mwaħħla fi griżmejh u qed isibha diffiċli jieħu n-nifs jew jibla'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 噎着的；呛着的；喉咙受阻而呼吸或吞咽困难的。

collocations.zh: 一个呛着或噎着的男人

formal.mt: Fix-xena, it-tifel ikun xerqan wara li biċċa ikel teħel fi griżmejh.
formal.en: In the scene, the boy is choking after a piece of food gets stuck in his throat.
formal.zh: 这一幕中，一块食物卡在男孩喉咙里，他噎住了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fil-film, għaliex Mark ma setax jitkellem? Pawlu: Għax kien xerqan; biċċa ikel kienet weħlitlu fi griżmejh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why couldn't Mark speak in the film? Pawlu: Because he was choking; a piece of food had got stuck in his throat.
colloquial.zh: Lara：电影里 Mark 为什么说不出话？Pawlu：因为他噎住了，一块食物卡在了喉咙里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-film, għaliex Mark ma setax jitkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-film, għaliex Mark ma setax jitkellem?
messages.zh: 电影里 Mark 为什么说不出话？
messages.en: Why couldn't Mark speak in the film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien xerqan; biċċa ikel kienet weħlitlu fi griżmejh.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien xerqan; biċċa ikel kienet weħlitlu fi griżmejh.
messages.zh: 因为他噎住了，一块食物卡在了喉咙里。
messages.en: Because he was choking; a piece of food had got stuck in his throat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xerqan 记成描述状态的字幕：人物被食物噎住，暂时说不出话；重点记住它是形容词。

gloss_zh: 使呛着或噎住；使如鲠在喉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to choke; figuratively, to stick in someone's throat and be difficult to accept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人呛着或噎住；比喻某事令人难以接受，仿佛堵在喉咙里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jifga b'xi ħaġa fi griżmejh; b'mod figurattiv, ikun diffiċli għal xi ħadd li jaċċettah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使呛着；使噎住；引起喉咙受阻的反应。
比喻使人如鲠在喉、难以接受或咽下这口气。

collocations.en: the food made the boy choke
the words stuck in Pawlu's throat figuratively
collocations.zh: 那些话让 Pawlu 如鲠在喉

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kliem inġust xerraq lil Pawlu, li sabha diffiċli jaċċetta dik l-akkuża.
formal.en: In the story, the unfair words stuck in Pawlu's throat: he found the accusation difficult to accept.
formal.zh: 故事中，那些不公的话让 Pawlu 如鲠在喉，他难以接受那项指责。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil Toni waqt l-ikla? Mark: Ftit ilma xerraq lil Toni u beda jisgħol, imma mbagħad għaddielu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to Toni during the meal? Mark: A little water made Toni choke and he started coughing, but then it passed.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Toni 吃饭时怎么了？Mark：他喝水呛了一下，开始咳嗽，不过后来就好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni 吃饭时怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Toni during the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit ilma xerraq lil Toni u beda jisgħol, imma mbagħad għaddielu.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit ilma xerraq lil Toni u beda jisgħol, imma mbagħad għaddielu.
messages.zh: 他喝水呛了一下，开始咳嗽，不过后来就好了。
messages.en: A little water made Toni choke and he started coughing, but then it passed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文的两个喉咙画面记 xerraq：水让人呛住，委屈的话让人如鲠在喉；前者是实义，后者是比喻义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut food into small cubes, or to dissect a body or specimen to examine its parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物切成小方块；或为观察内部构造而解剖身体或标本。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' l-ikel f'kubi żgħar, jew jagħmel dissezzjoni ta' ġisem jew kampjun biex jeżamina l-partijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把食材切成小方块；切丁。
解剖；切开身体或标本以观察其内部构造。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tal-bijoloġija, l-għalliem xerraħ il-kampjun biex juri l-organi interni lill-istudenti.
formal.en: During the biology lesson, the teacher dissected the specimen to show the students its internal organs.
formal.zh: 生物课上，教师解剖了标本，向学生展示其内部器官。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min xerraħ il-patata għas-soppa? Toni: Jien, qtajtha f'kubi żgħar biex tissajjar malajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who diced the potatoes for the soup? Toni: I did; I cut them into small cubes so they would cook quickly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把煮汤用的土豆切成丁了？Toni：我切的，切成小方块熟得快。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 谁把煮汤用的土豆切成丁了？
messages.en: Who diced the potatoes for the soup?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, qtajtha f'kubi żgħar biex tissajjar malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, qtajtha f'kubi żgħar biex tissajjar malajr.
messages.zh: 我切的，切成小方块熟得快。
messages.en: I did; I cut them into small cubes so they would cook quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张操作台画面记 xerraħ：厨房里把土豆切丁，实验室里解剖标本；看宾语判断是哪一种动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause something to emerge or become visible by bringing it out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物从里面露出来或探出来，变得可见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel xi ħaġa toħroġ jew tidher billi joħroġha minn fejn tkun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使露出；使探出；使某物显露出来。

collocations.en: poked his head out of the window
poked his head out through the doorway

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-ħoss fit-triq, ir-raġel xerref rasu mit-tieqa biex jara x'kien qed jiġri.
formal.en: When he heard the noise in the street, the man poked his head out of the window to see what was happening.
formal.zh: 听到街上的响声后，那名男子把头探出窗外，看看发生了什么。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajtu lil Pawlu? Toni: Iva, għadu kemm xerref rasu mill-bieb u staqsa għalik.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen Pawlu? Toni: Yes, he just poked his head through the doorway and asked for you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你见到 Pawlu 了吗？Toni：见到了，他刚从门口探出头来找你。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你见到 Pawlu 了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu kemm xerref rasu mill-bieb u staqsa għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu kemm xerref rasu mill-bieb u staqsa għalik.
messages.zh: 见到了，他刚从门口探出头来找你。
messages.en: Yes, he just poked his head through the doorway and asked for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人从门后把头探出来，用 xerref rasu 记住这个动作：使原本藏在里面的东西露出来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To associate with someone or join someone as a partner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人建立联系、交往，或与某人结成合作伙伴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħaqad ma' xi ħadd jew jidħol fi sħubija miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与……交往；与……建立联系。
结成伙伴；搭档合作。

formal.mt: Għal dan il-proġett, Mark xerrek ma' kollega li għandu esperjenza fil-qasam.
formal.en: For this project, Mark partnered with a colleague who has experience in the field.
formal.zh: 在这个项目中，马克与一位在该领域有经验的同事结成了合作伙伴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal dan ix-xogħol, xerrek ma' Lina. Mark: Tajjeb, naħdem magħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Partner with Lina for this task. Mark: All right, I'll work with her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这项任务你和莉娜搭档吧。马克：好，我和她一起做。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal dan ix-xogħol, xerrek ma' Lina.
messages.mt_standard: Għal dan ix-xogħol, xerrek ma' Lina.
messages.zh: 这项任务你和莉娜搭档吧。
messages.en: Partner with Lina for this task.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我和她一起做。
messages.en: All right, I'll work with her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人把各自的任务卡并在一起：先建立联系，再结成搭档，帮助记住这个动词的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作家族姓氏的专名，书写时首字母大写为 Xerri。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala isem tal-familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏；家族名称。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Xerri se tattendi l-laqgħa bħala rappreżentanta tal-iskola.
formal.en: Ms Xerri will attend the meeting as a representative of the school.
formal.zh: Xerri 女士将作为学校代表出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu l-kunjom tiegħek? Mark: Xerri. Tridni niktbu?
colloquial.en: Lina: What's your surname? Mark: Xerri. Would you like me to write it down?
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你姓什么？马克：Xerri。要我写下来吗？

messages.speaker: Lina (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: Xerri。要我写下来吗？
messages.en: Xerri. Would you like me to write it down?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Xerri 放进登记表的姓氏栏，并圈出大写字母 X，记住它是姓氏专名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attitude of doubting claims or questioning whether they are true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种说法是否真实持怀疑、审慎质疑的态度；也可指怀疑主义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attitudni ta' dubju dwar jekk stqarrija hijiex vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀疑态度；对说法或主张的真实性提出质疑；怀疑主义。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jesprimi xettiċiżmu dwar il-wegħdiet, għax ma ġewx ippreżentati provi biżżejjed.
formal.en: The report expresses scepticism about the promises because insufficient evidence has been presented.
formal.zh: 报告对这些承诺表示怀疑，因为所提供的证据不足。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan ix-xettiċiżmu kollu? Mark: Għax irrid nara l-provi l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why all this scepticism? Mark: Because I want to see the evidence first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么这么怀疑？马克：因为我想先看看证据。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么怀疑？
messages.en: Why all this scepticism?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为我想先看看证据。
messages.en: Because I want to see the evidence first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在一条未经证实的消息旁画上问号，再写下“先看证据”，把这个名词与怀疑态度联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sharp thorn on a plant, a fishbone, or figuratively a troublesome person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物上的尖刺或鱼刺；比喻义指难相处、令人头疼的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti iebsa u bil-ponta ta' pjanta, għadma rqiqa ta' ħuta, jew, b'mod figurattiv, persuna li toħloq l-inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物上的刺；尖刺。
鱼刺；鱼体内细而尖的骨头。
难相处或惹麻烦的人；令人头疼的人。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tal-ġnien, il-ħaddiem sab xewka fil-kmiem tal-ġakketta tiegħu.
formal.en: While cleaning the garden, the worker found a thorn in the sleeve of his jacket.
formal.zh: 清理花园时，工人在自己的夹克袖子里发现了一根刺。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Oqgħod attent, hemm xewka fil-ħuta. Mark: Rajtha, se nneħħiha.
colloquial.en: Lina: Be careful, there's a bone in the fish. Mark: I've seen it; I'll remove it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：小心，鱼里有根刺。马克：看到了，我把它挑出来。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 小心，鱼里有根刺。
messages.en: Be careful, there's a bone in the fish.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，我把它挑出来。
messages.en: I've seen it; I'll remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面串记：玫瑰上的刺、盘中的鱼刺、让人头疼的难缠人物。第三个是比喻用法，别当作实物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having thorns or covered with sharp plant spines.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长有尖刺的，或表面布满植物刺的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x-xewk jew li hu miksi bix-xewk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带刺的；多刺的。

formal.mt: Arbuxxell xewki jikber ħdejn il-ħajt tal-ġnien.
formal.en: A thorny shrub grows beside the garden wall.
formal.zh: 花园围墙旁长着一丛多刺的灌木。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' naqbad dan iz-zokk? Mark: Oqgħod attenta, huwa xewki.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I hold this stem? Mark: Be careful, it's thorny.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我能握住这根茎吗？马克：小心，它有刺。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能握住这根茎吗？
messages.en: Can I hold this stem?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 小心，它有刺。
messages.en: Be careful, it's thorny.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xewka 的“一根刺”和 xewki 的“带刺状态”并排画出来：前者指东西，后者描述东西的特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who throws objects violently or with great force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猛烈地或用很大力气投掷物体的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titfa' oġġetti b'qawwa kbira jew b'mod vjolenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猛烈投掷东西的人；猛掷者。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lir-raġel bħala xewlieħ tal-ġebel li għamel ħsara lit-twieqi.
formal.en: The report describes the man as a stone hurler who damaged the windows.
formal.zh: 报告将该男子描述为一名猛掷石块、损坏窗户的人。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Min kisser it-tieqa? Mark: Dak ix-xewlieħ hemmhekk; rajtu jitfa' ġebla.
colloquial.en: Lina: Who broke the window? Mark: That hurler over there; I saw him throw a stone.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：谁打破了窗户？马克：那边那个乱扔东西的人；我看见他扔了一块石头。

messages.speaker: Lina (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁打破了窗户？
messages.en: Who broke the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ix-xewlieħ hemmhekk; rajtu jitfa' ġebla.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ix-xewlieħ hemmhekk; rajtu jitfa' ġebla.
messages.zh: 那边那个乱扔东西的人；我看见他扔了一块石头。
messages.en: That hurler over there; I saw him throw a stone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人物卡上写 xewlieħ，画出一个用力投掷的人，重点记住这个名词指“做动作的人”。

gloss_zh: 能用力投掷的；投掷有力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of throwing objects with considerable force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有用较大力气投掷物体的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jitfa' oġġetti b'qawwa kbira.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the capacity to throw forcefully
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有强力投掷能力的；能用力投掷的。

collocations.en: a player capable of throwing forcefully
a man capable of throwing forcefully
collocations.zh: 具有强力投掷能力的男子

formal.mt: Il-kowċ għażel plejer xewlieħi għall-eżerċizzju li kien jeħtieġ tfigħ b'qawwa kbira.
formal.en: The coach chose a player capable of throwing forcefully for the exercise that required powerful throws.
formal.zh: 教练为需要强力投掷的练习选了一名投掷有力的运动员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jwaddab il-ballun daqshekk 'il bogħod? Mark: Pawlu huwa xewlieħi; jista' jagħmel dan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can throw the ball that far? Mark: Pawlu can throw forcefully; he can do it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁能把球扔那么远？马克：保罗投掷有力，他能做到。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jwaddab il-ballun daqshekk 'il bogħod?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jwaddab il-ballun daqshekk 'il bogħod?
messages.zh: 谁能把球扔那么远？
messages.en: Who can throw the ball that far?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu huwa xewlieħi; jista' jagħmel dan.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu huwa xewlieħi; jista' jagħmel dan.
messages.zh: 保罗投掷有力，他能做到。
messages.en: Pawlu can throw forcefully; he can do it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xewlieħi 写在运动员的能力标签上，配上“能投得有力”，记住它描述能力，不表示已经完成一次投掷。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of throwing, chucking, or hurling objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体投出、抛扔或猛力掷出的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed jitfa' jew iwaddab oġġetti, kultant b'qawwa kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投掷；把物体扔出的动作。
抛扔；随手或较随意地扔东西。
猛掷；用很大力气把物体掷出。

formal.mt: Ix-xewliħ ta' oġġetti lejn il-palk jista' jweġġa' lill-artisti.
formal.en: Throwing objects towards the stage can injure the performers.
formal.zh: 朝舞台投掷物品可能使表演者受伤。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu dan ix-xewliħ kollu? Mark: Skużani, se nqiegħed il-ġugarelli fil-kaxxa bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lina: What's all this throwing about? Mark: Sorry, I'll put the toys into the box gently.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：怎么这样乱扔东西？马克：对不起，我会把玩具轻轻放进箱子里。

messages.speaker: Lina (母亲)
messages.zh: 怎么这样乱扔东西？
messages.en: What's all this throwing about?

messages.speaker: Mark (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, se nqiegħed il-ġugarelli fil-kaxxa bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, se nqiegħed il-ġugarelli fil-kaxxa bil-mod.
messages.zh: 对不起，我会把玩具轻轻放进箱子里。
messages.en: Sorry, I'll put the toys into the box gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xewliħ 写在投掷动作的箭头旁，再与指人的 xewlieħ 对照：一个记动作，一个记做动作的人，注意字母顺序。

gloss_zh: 使人产生愿望；勾起向往

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone wish for something or want to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人对某物产生向往，或产生做某事的愿望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jixtieq xi ħaġa jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to induce a wish in sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人产生愿望；勾起某人的向往。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqajjem xewqa f'xi ħadd.

collocations.en: made the children want to travel abroad
collocations.zh: 勾起了孩子们出国旅行的愿望

collocations.en: made Marija long for a holiday
collocations.zh: 让玛丽娅向往起度假来

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont tal-vjaġġ xewwaq lill-istudenti biex iżuru Malta.
formal.en: The account of the journey made the students want to visit Malta.
formal.zh: 这篇旅行记勾起了学生们去马耳他游览的愿望。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex trid tmur ħdejn il-baħar? Pawlu: Ir-ritratt li bgħattli xewwaqni għal ġurnata fuq il-bajja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you want to go to the seaside? Pawlu: The photo you sent me made me long for a day at the beach.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么想去海边？保罗：你发给我的照片让我很想去沙滩待上一天。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么想去海边？
messages.en: Why do you want to go to the seaside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-ritratt li bgħattli xewwaqni għal ġurnata fuq il-bajja.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-ritratt li bgħattli xewwaqni għal ġurnata fuq il-bajja.
messages.zh: 你发给我的照片让我很想去沙滩待上一天。
messages.en: The photo you sent me made me long for a day at the beach.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面记成“看到旅行照片，心里冒出愿望”：xewwaq 强调某件事勾起了某人的向往。

gloss_zh: 长刺；使人感到刺痒；雏鸟开始长羽毛

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow thorns; to cause a prickly feeling, especially through coarse clothing; or, of a young bird, to begin growing feathers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物长刺、粗糙衣物等使人产生刺痒感，或雏鸟开始长出羽毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ ix-xewk; jagħti sensazzjoni ta' tingiż, speċjalment meta jingħad għal ħwejjeġ ħorox; jew jibda joħroġ ir-rix, meta jingħad għal ferħ ta' għasfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出刺。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Joħroġ ix-xewk.

sense_translations.en_definition: to produce a prickly sensation (used especially of coarse clothing)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人产生刺痒或扎皮肤的感觉，尤用于粗糙衣物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti sensazzjoni ta' tingiż, speċjalment meta jingħad għal ħwejjeġ ħorox.

sense_translations.en_definition: to start growing feathers (used of fledgling birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始长出羽毛，用于雏鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibda joħroġ ir-rix, meta jingħad għal ferħ ta' għasfur.

collocations.en: the young bird began growing feathers

formal.mt: L-arbuxxell xewwek, u għalhekk il-ġardinar libes l-ingwanti qabel ma mess il-friegħi.
formal.en: The shrub grew thorns, so the gardener put on gloves before touching its branches.
formal.zh: 灌木长出了刺，因此园丁先戴上手套，再去碰它的枝条。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex neħħejt il-ġerżì? Mark: Għax xewwek; se nilbes wieħed aktar artab.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you take off the sweater? Mark: Because it felt prickly; I'll put on a softer one.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么把毛衣脱了？马克：因为穿着扎人；我要换一件更柔软的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把毛衣脱了？
messages.en: Why did you take off the sweater?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xewwek; se nilbes wieħed aktar artab.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xewwek; se nilbes wieħed aktar artab.
messages.zh: 因为穿着扎人；我要换一件更柔软的。
messages.en: Because it felt prickly; I'll put on a softer one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅小画分别记忆：灌木冒刺、毛衣扎人、雏鸟冒羽毛；共同联想只作记忆提示，不代表词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To throw something away or force someone to leave a place or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西扔掉，或强行让某人离开某个地方或团体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jarmi xi ħaġa jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd joħroġ minn post jew jitlaq minn grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扔掉；丢弃。
驱逐；开除；强制逐出。
赶出去；撵走。

formal.mt: Wara diversi twissijiet, il-kumitat xeħet barra lill-membru li kiser ir-regoli.
formal.en: After several warnings, the committee expelled the member who had broken the rules.
formal.zh: 多次警告之后，委员会开除了那名违反规定的成员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn huma l-kaxxi vojta? Mark: Paul xeħet barra l-kaxxi lbieraħ meta naddaf il-garaxx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are the empty boxes? Mark: Paul threw the boxes away yesterday when he cleaned the garage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那些空箱子在哪儿？马克：保罗昨天打扫车库时把箱子扔掉了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那些空箱子在哪儿？
messages.en: Where are the empty boxes?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Paul xeħet barra l-kaxxi lbieraħ meta naddaf il-garaxx.
messages.mt_standard: Paul xeħet barra l-kaxxi lbieraħ meta naddaf il-garaxx.
messages.zh: 保罗昨天打扫车库时把箱子扔掉了。
messages.en: Paul threw the boxes away yesterday when he cleaned the garage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把东西或人移到外面的画面：东西对应扔掉，人对应驱逐或赶出去。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Greed: an excessive desire to have more, especially money or possessions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过度想要获得更多东西的贪婪，尤指对金钱或财物的贪求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa żejda li wieħed ikollu dejjem aktar, speċjalment flus jew ġid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪婪；贪心，与 xeħħa 同义。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont juri kif ix-xeħħ għall-flus jista' jeqred il-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb.
formal.en: The story shows how greed for money can destroy trust between friends.
formal.zh: 这个故事展示了对金钱的贪欲如何破坏朋友之间的信任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħa kollox għalih? Lara: Minħabba x-xeħħ; lanqas ħalla biċċa għall-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he take everything for himself? Lara: Because of greed; he didn't even leave a piece for the others.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么把所有东西都拿走了？拉拉：因为贪心呗，连一块都没给别人留。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么把所有东西都拿走了？
messages.en: Why did he take everything for himself?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba x-xeħħ; lanqas ħalla biċċa għall-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba x-xeħħ; lanqas ħalla biċċa għall-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 因为贪心呗，连一块都没给别人留。
messages.en: Because of greed; he didn't even leave a piece for the others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“已经拿了很多，还想全部占有”的画面记住贪婪；这个词表示贪心这种状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to throw something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人做出投掷动作，让某人把某物扔出去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jixħet xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使投掷；使某人扔出某物。

collocations.en: made the player throw the ball
made the boy throw the stone

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, il-kowċ xeħħet lill-plejer il-ballun lejn il-mira.
formal.en: During training, the coach made the player throw the ball towards the target.
formal.zh: 训练时，教练让球员朝目标投球。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min xeħħet lil Paul il-ballun daqshekk 'il bogħod? Mark: Il-kowċ; ried jara sa fejn seta' jwasslu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made Paul throw the ball so far? Mark: The coach; he wanted to see how far Paul could send it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁让保罗把球扔那么远的？马克：教练，他想看看保罗能扔多远。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min xeħħet lil Paul il-ballun daqshekk 'il bogħod?
messages.mt_standard: Min xeħħet lil Paul il-ballun daqshekk 'il bogħod?
messages.zh: 谁让保罗把球扔那么远的？
messages.en: Who made Paul throw the ball so far?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kowċ; ried jara sa fejn seta' jwasslu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kowċ; ried jara sa fejn seta' jwasslu.
messages.zh: 教练，他想看看保罗能扔多远。
messages.en: The coach; he wanted to see how far Paul could send it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“教练让球员投球”的两个人物：一个促使动作发生，另一个实际把球扔出。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of sadness or dissatisfaction about something one did, failed to do, or wishes had happened differently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因做过某事、错过某事，或希望事情当初有所不同时产生的后悔与懊悔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' dispjaċir għal xi ħaġa li wieħed għamel jew naqas milli jagħmel, jew li xtaq li ġrat mod ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 后悔；对过去的行为、疏漏或结果感到懊悔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispjaċir għal dak li sar jew li ma sarx.

formal.mt: Wara li tilef l-opportunità li jitlob skuża, Ġużeppi ħass xgħif kbir.
formal.en: After missing the opportunity to apologise, Ġużeppi felt deep regret.
formal.zh: 错过道歉的机会后，朱塞佩感到深深的懊悔。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek taħseb dwar dak li għedt? Toni: Iva, inħoss xgħif għax weġġajtu bi kliemi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you still thinking about what you said? Toni: Yes, I feel regret because I hurt him with my words.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你还在想自己说过的话吗？托尼：是的，我很后悔，因为我的话伤害了他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek taħseb dwar dak li għedt?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek taħseb dwar dak li għedt?
messages.zh: 你还在想自己说过的话吗？
messages.en: Are you still thinking about what you said?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inħoss xgħif għax weġġajtu bi kliemi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inħoss xgħif għax weġġajtu bi kliemi.
messages.zh: 是的，我很后悔，因为我的话伤害了他。
messages.en: Yes, I feel regret because I hurt him with my words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象说完重话后心里反复出现“早知道就不说了”，把这种回头懊悔的感觉与名词 xgħif 联系起来。

gloss_zh: 引火物；点火或点亮的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material used to start a fire, or the act of lighting a fire, lamp, or other source of light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于生火的引火物，或点燃火焰、点亮灯等的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jintuża biex jibda n-nar, jew l-att li wieħed iqabbad nar jew jixgħel lampa jew dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引火物；用于帮助生火的易燃材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal li jintuża biex jibda n-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点燃、点亮的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iqabbad jew jixgħel xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: Qabel ix-xgħil tan-nar, il-parteċipanti ġabru xgħil niexef u poġġewh taħt il-ħatab.
formal.en: Before lighting the fire, the participants gathered dry kindling and placed it under the firewood.
formal.zh: 点火之前，参与者收集了干燥的引火物，并将其放在木柴下面。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandna biżżejjed xgħil għan-nar? Ben: Iva, hawn ftit friegħi niexfa fil-qoffa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do we have enough kindling for the fire? Ben: Yes, there are some dry twigs here in the basket.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们有足够的引火物来生火吗？本：有，篮子里这里有一些干树枝。

messages.speaker: Rita (露营同伴)
messages.zh: 我们有足够的引火物来生火吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough kindling for the fire?

messages.speaker: Ben (露营同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn ftit friegħi niexfa fil-qoffa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn ftit friegħi niexfa fil-qoffa.
messages.zh: 有，篮子里这里有一些干树枝。
messages.en: Yes, there are some dry twigs here in the basket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“先拿引火物，再做点火动作”这两个画面：xgħil 既可指生火材料，也可指点燃或点亮这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, painful swelling on the eyelid, usually near the eyelashes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 眼睑上通常靠近睫毛处出现的疼痛小肿块，即麦粒肿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nefħa żgħira u bl-uġigħ fuq il-kappell tal-għajn, ġeneralment qrib ix-xagħar tal-għajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麦粒肿；眼睑上疼痛的小肿块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nefħa żgħira u bl-uġigħ fuq il-kappell tal-għajn.

formal.mt: It-tabib eżamina x-xgħira fuq il-kappell tal-għajn tax-xellug tal-pazjent.
formal.en: The doctor examined the stye on the patient's left eyelid.
formal.zh: 医生检查了患者左眼眼睑上的麦粒肿。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'għandek fuq il-kappell ta' għajnek? David: Għandi xgħira, u tweġġagħni meta nteptep.
colloquial.en: Marta: What's that on your eyelid? David: I have a stye, and it hurts when I blink.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你眼皮上长了什么？戴维：我长了麦粒肿，眨眼时会痛。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你眼皮上长了什么？
messages.en: What's that on your eyelid?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi xgħira, u tweġġagħni meta nteptep.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi xgħira, u tweġġagħni meta nteptep.
messages.zh: 我长了麦粒肿，眨眼时会痛。
messages.en: I have a stye, and it hurts when I blink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象眼皮边缘鼓起一颗小包，眨眼就疼；把这个具体位置和感觉与 xgħira“麦粒肿”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or experience of seeing an event happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亲眼看到事件发生这一行为或经历。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-esperjenza li wieħed jara ġrajja sseħħ quddiemu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 见证；亲眼目睹某件事发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed jara xi ħaġa sseħħ quddiemu.

formal.mt: Ix-xhid tal-inċident ħalla impressjoni qawwija fuq l-istudent, li wara kiteb dwar dak li ra.
formal.en: Witnessing the accident left a strong impression on the student, who later wrote about what he had seen.
formal.zh: 亲眼目睹事故给这名学生留下了深刻印象，他后来写下了自己的所见。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int rajt dak li ġara? Luqa: Iva, u x-xhid ta' dik ix-xena ħallieni bla kliem.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you see what happened? Luqa: Yes, and witnessing that scene left me speechless.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你看到发生的事了吗？卢卡：看到了，亲眼目睹那一幕让我说不出话来。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到发生的事了吗？
messages.en: Did you see what happened?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u x-xhid ta' dik ix-xena ħallieni bla kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u x-xhid ta' dik ix-xena ħallieni bla kliem.
messages.zh: 看到了，亲眼目睹那一幕让我说不出话来。
messages.en: Yes, and witnessing that scene left me speechless.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“事情就在眼前发生，我亲眼看见”来记 xhid；本条是目睹这一行为或经历的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crying with repeated catches in the breath, or loud, prolonged crying expressing distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伴随呼吸断续的抽泣，或表达痛苦、悲伤的持续大声哭号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biki b'nifs imقطع jew biki qawwi u fit-tul li jesprimi niket jew tbatija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽泣；伴随呼吸断续的哭泣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biki b'nifs imقطع.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哀号；因悲伤或痛苦而持续大声哭喊。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biki qawwi u fit-tul minħabba niket jew tbatija.

collocations.zh: 传来了抽泣声或哀号声

formal.mt: Fis-silenzju tal-kamra, ix-xhir tat-tifel kien jinstema' bejn kelma u oħra.
formal.en: In the silence of the room, the boy's sobbing could be heard between his words.
formal.zh: 房间一片寂静，男孩说话的间隙可以听见他的抽泣声。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Qed tisma' dak ix-xhir? Mario: Iva, ġej mill-kamra ta' ħdejna; ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi ħadd li għandu bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Elena: Can you hear that sobbing? Mario: Yes, it's coming from the room next door; let's see whether someone needs help.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你听见那阵抽泣声了吗？马里奥：听见了，是隔壁房间传来的；我们去看看有没有人需要帮助。

messages.speaker: Elena (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听见那阵抽泣声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that sobbing?

messages.speaker: Mario (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-kamra ta' ħdejna; ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi ħadd li għandu bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-kamra ta' ħdejna; ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi ħadd li għandu bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 听见了，是隔壁房间传来的；我们去看看有没有人需要帮助。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the room next door; let's see whether someone needs help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xhir 配上两种哭声：一声一顿的是抽泣，拖长放大的是哀号；用声音强度帮助区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: On some occasions, but not always.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事在部分时候发生，而不是每次都发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'ċerti okkażjonijiet, iżda mhux dejjem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有时；偶尔；在某些时候。

collocations.zh: 有时事情就是这样发生的

formal.mt: Xi drabi l-istudenti jkollhom bżonn aktar ħin biex itemmu dan l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: Sometimes students need more time to complete this exercise.
formal.zh: 学生有时需要更多时间来完成这项练习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dejjem tmur għax-xogħol bil-karozza? Pawlu: Le, xi drabi mmur bil-mixi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you always drive to work? Pawlu: No, sometimes I walk.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你总是开车上班吗？Pawlu：不是，我有时步行去。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你总是开车上班吗？
messages.en: Do you always drive to work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 不是，我有时步行去。
messages.en: No, sometimes I walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一周日历中只有几天画了圆圈，用 xi drabi 表示“有些时候”，并与“总是”区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dill, an aromatic herb used to flavour food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 莳萝，一种用于给食物调味的芳香草本植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa aromatika li tintuża biex tagħti t-togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 莳萝；可用于烹饪调味的香草。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li jiżdied ftit xibt frisk maz-zalza qabel ma tiġi servuta.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a little fresh dill to be added to the sauce before it is served.
formal.zh: 食谱要求在上桌前往酱汁中加入少许新鲜莳萝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi din il-ħaxixa ħdejn il-ħut? Mark: Dak xibt. Trid ftit mal-ħut tiegħek?
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this herb next to the fish? Mark: That's dill. Would you like some with your fish?
colloquial.zh: Maja：鱼旁边的这种香草是什么？Mark：那是莳萝。你的鱼要配一点吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 鱼旁边的这种香草是什么？
messages.en: What's this herb next to the fish?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak xibt. Trid ftit mal-ħut tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Dak xibt. Trid ftit mal-ħut tiegħek?
messages.zh: 那是莳萝。你的鱼要配一点吗？
messages.en: That's dill. Would you like some with your fish?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xibt 和鱼盘旁的一小撮莳萝联系起来，再用 xibt frisk“新鲜莳萝”整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become white or grey, especially when referring to a person's hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成白色或灰白色，尤其可用来描述人的头发变白。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir abjad jew griż, speċjalment meta wieħed jitkellem dwar ix-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变白；变成灰白色，尤指头发。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt il-ġdid jidher li xagħru xieb ħafna matul is-snin.
formal.en: The new photograph shows that his hair has gone much greyer over the years.
formal.zh: 从新照片中可以看出，这些年来他的头发变白了许多。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan missierek fir-ritratt? Toni: Iva, imma issa xagħru xieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this your father in the photograph? Toni: Yes, but his hair has gone grey now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：照片里这个人是你爸爸吗？Toni：是，不过他现在头发已经灰白了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里这个人是你爸爸吗？
messages.en: Is this your father in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是，不过他现在头发已经灰白了。
messages.en: Yes, but his hair has gone grey now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xieb 配上一张头发由黑变白的连续照片，记住它强调自身颜色发生变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To resemble someone or something, or to be similar in appearance or character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人或某物相像，或在外貌、特征等方面相似。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun jixbah lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa fid-dehra jew fil-karattru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与……相像；具有相似的外貌或特征。
像……；在性质、表现等方面与……相似。

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt li pinġa l-artist xiebah ħafna lill-mudell.
formal.en: The portrait painted by the artist closely resembled the model.
formal.zh: 画家绘制的肖像与模特十分相像。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lil min xiebah it-tifel f'dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Xiebah ħafna lil missieru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who did the boy resemble in this photograph? Mark: He looked a lot like his father.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张照片里的男孩像谁？Mark：他很像他的父亲。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min xiebah it-tifel f'dan ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min xiebah it-tifel f'dan ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 这张照片里的男孩像谁？
messages.en: Who did the boy resemble in this photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他很像他的父亲。
messages.en: He looked a lot like his father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把父子照片并排比较，指着相似的五官说 xiebah lil missieru，整句记住“像父亲”。

gloss_zh: 变干；遭虫啃食；虫害遍布

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dry, or, of plants, to be nibbled by pests or become infested with caterpillars.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变干；也用于植物，表示遭害虫啃食，或长满毛毛虫、遭受严重虫害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinxef, jew, fil-każ tal-pjanti, li jittiekel ftit ftit minn organiżmi li jagħmlu l-ħsara jew jimtela bil-larvi li jieklu l-weraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变干；失去水分而干枯。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be nibbled (used especially of plants when nibbled by parasites, such as caterpillars)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭啃食，尤指植物被毛毛虫等寄生害虫一点点啃咬。
长满毛毛虫；遭毛毛虫严重侵害。

collocations.en: the cabbage became infested with larvae

formal.mt: Il-kaboċċ xiegħet minħabba l-larvi li kielu l-weraq tiegħu.
formal.en: The cabbage plant was nibbled by larvae that fed on its leaves.
formal.zh: 这棵卷心菜遭到以其叶片为食的幼虫啃食。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan ix-xitel sar kannella? Pawlu: Xiegħet għax baqa' bla ilma għal ħafna jiem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why has this young plant turned brown? Pawlu: It dried out because it went without water for many days.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这株幼苗为什么变褐色了？Pawlu：它好多天没水，干枯了。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这株幼苗为什么变褐色了？
messages.en: Why has this young plant turned brown?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Xiegħet għax baqa' bla ilma għal ħafna jiem.
messages.mt_standard: Xiegħet għax baqa' bla ilma għal ħafna jiem.
messages.zh: 它好多天没水，干枯了。
messages.en: It dried out because it went without water for many days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xiegħet 配两幅植物图：一幅缺水干枯，一幅叶片被虫啃；靠上下文判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something grey or give it a grey appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变成灰色，或使其外观看起来发灰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel lil xi ħaġa griża jew jagħtiha dehra griża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变灰；使某物呈现灰色。

collocations.en: the dust made the table look grey
collocations.zh: 灰尘使桌子显得灰蒙蒙

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, it-trab xieheb il-wiċċ tal-istatwa.
formal.en: Over time, the dust turned the surface of the statue grey.
formal.zh: 随着时间推移，灰尘使雕像表面变灰了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-mejda tidher griża? Toni: It-trab xieheb il-mejda. Ejja nimsaħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the table look grey? Toni: The dust made it grey. Let me wipe it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：桌子怎么看起来灰蒙蒙的？Toni：灰尘让它变灰了。我来擦一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子怎么看起来灰蒙蒙的？
messages.en: Why does the table look grey?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 灰尘让它变灰了。我来擦一下。
messages.en: The dust made it grey. Let me wipe it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象灰尘落在桌面上，把桌子“弄灰”；用“原因＋xieheb＋物体”记住使动含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force someone to give evidence or testimony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强迫某人提供证言或出庭作证。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħti x-xhieda tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to force sb. to give evidence
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫某人作证；迫使某人提供证言。

collocations.en: forced the man to give evidence before the court
collocations.zh: 强迫该男子在法庭上作证

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-imħallef xiehed lir-raġel minkejja li dan ma riedx jitkellem.
formal.en: In the story, the judge forced the man to give evidence even though he did not want to speak.
formal.zh: 在故事中，尽管那名男子不愿开口，法官仍强迫他作证。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fir-rakkont, ix-xhud tkellem minn jeddu? Mark: Le, l-imħallef xiehed lix-xhud.
colloquial.en: Maja: In the story, did the witness speak voluntarily? Mark: No, the judge forced the witness to testify.
colloquial.zh: Maja：故事里的证人是自愿开口的吗？Mark：不是，是法官强迫他作证的。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 故事里的证人是自愿开口的吗？
messages.en: In the story, did the witness speak voluntarily?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 不是，是法官强迫他作证的。
messages.en: No, the judge forced the witness to testify.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xiehed 记成一个施压场景：有人不愿开口，却被迫提供证言；重点记牢“强迫作证”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To impose exile on a criminal or outlaw, forcing them to leave a country or territory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对罪犯或法外之徒施以放逐，迫使其离开某个国家或地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jimponi l-eżilju fuq kriminal jew persuna mfittxija mill-liġi u jġegħelha titlaq mill-pajjiż jew mit-territorju.

sense_translations.en_definition: to banish (used in the case of imposition of exile on a criminal or outlaw)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 放逐；对罪犯或法外之徒判处流放，迫使其离境。

collocations.en: banished the offender from the country
exiled the offender for ten years

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħakem xieher lill-ħati u ordnalu jitlaq mill-pajjiż.
formal.en: In the story, the ruler banished the offender and ordered him to leave the country.
formal.zh: 在故事中，统治者放逐了罪犯，命令他离开该国。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fil-ktieb, il-ħakem bagħat lill-ħati l-ħabs? Pawlu: Le, xieher lill-ħati għal għaxar snin.
colloquial.en: Sara: In the book, did the ruler send the offender to prison? Pawlu: No, he exiled the offender for ten years.
colloquial.zh: Sara：书里的统治者把罪犯关进监狱了吗？Pawlu：没有，他判处罪犯流放十年。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 书里的统治者把罪犯关进监狱了吗？
messages.en: In the book, did the ruler send the offender to prison?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, xieher lill-ħati għal għaxar snin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, xieher lill-ħati għal għaxar snin.
messages.zh: 没有，他判处罪犯流放十年。
messages.en: No, he exiled the offender for ten years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事中的罪犯被命令离开国境，在地图上画出离境箭头，用 xieher 记住“判处放逐”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move about from place to place without a fixed destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有固定目的地地四处走动、漫游或游荡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mar minn post għal ieħor mingħajr destinazzjoni fissa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四处漫游；没有明确目的地地游荡。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġatur xiel fit-toroq tar-raħal mingħajr destinazzjoni fissa.
formal.en: The traveller wandered about the village streets without a fixed destination.
formal.zh: 那位旅人在村子的街道间漫游，没有固定的目的地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Pawlu wara l-ikel? Rita: Xiel ftit ħdejn il-baħar, imbagħad mar id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Pawlu go after lunch? Rita: He wandered about by the sea for a while, then went home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗午饭后去哪儿了？丽塔：他在海边随意走了一会儿，然后就回家了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗午饭后去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go after lunch?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xiel ftit ħdejn il-baħar, imbagħad mar id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Xiel ftit ħdejn il-baħar, imbagħad mar id-dar.
messages.zh: 他在海边随意走了一会儿，然后就回家了。
messages.en: He wandered about by the sea for a while, then went home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xiel 连到一幅画面：旅人没有目的地，在街巷间随意走动，用“走走停停地漫游”记住它。

gloss_zh: 得体的；整洁的；配得上的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Decent or neat in appearance or conduct, or worthy of recognition or respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容外表或举止得体、整洁，也可表示值得认可或尊重、配得上的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun deċenti jew pulit fid-dehra jew fl-imġiba, jew li jistħoqqlu rikonoxximent jew rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得体的；端正的；符合基本礼仪或行为要求的。
整洁的；齐整的。
值得的；配得上的；值得认可或尊重的。

formal.mt: Għall-intervista, il-kandidat għażel ilbies xieraq u ħejja t-tweġibiet tiegħu bir-reqqa.
formal.en: For the interview, the candidate chose decent attire and prepared his answers carefully.
formal.zh: 为了参加面试，这位应聘者选择了得体的衣着，并认真准备了回答。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-qmis xieraq għall-intervista? Lara: Iva, jidher pulit u jmur tajjeb mal-qalziet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this shirt decent enough for the interview? Lara: Yes, it looks neat and goes well with the trousers.
colloquial.zh: 马克：穿这件衬衫去面试得体吗？拉拉：得体，看起来很整洁，也很配那条裤子。

messages.speaker: Mark (求职者)
messages.zh: 穿这件衬衫去面试得体吗？
messages.en: Is this shirt decent enough for the interview?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher pulit u jmur tajjeb mal-qalziet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher pulit u jmur tajjeb mal-qalziet.
messages.zh: 得体，看起来很整洁，也很配那条裤子。
messages.en: Yes, it looks neat and goes well with the trousers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 xieraq：穿着得体、外表整洁、获奖实至名归；遇到句子时再判断具体是哪一义。

gloss_zh: 使成为合伙人；使加入；报名参加

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone an associate or to enrol someone in an activity or course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人成为合伙人或合作成员，也可指让某人报名加入某项活动或课程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal lil xi ħadd bħala sieħeb, jew irreġistrah f'attività jew f'kors.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sb. into an associate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人成为合伙人、合作伙伴或共同参与的成员。
报名参加某事；登记加入某项活动、课程或组织。

collocations.en: made his brother an associate in the business
collocations.zh: 让他的兄弟成为生意上的合伙人

collocations.en: enrolled his daughter in a course
collocations.zh: 给他的女儿报名参加课程

formal.mt: Is-sid xierek lil ħuh fin-negozju u qasam miegħu r-responsabbiltajiet tat-tmexxija.
formal.en: The owner made his brother an associate in the business and shared the management responsibilities with him.
formal.zh: 店主让他的兄弟成为生意上的合伙人，并与他分担管理职责。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Pawlu għadu jmexxi l-ħanut waħdu? Mark: Le, xiĕrek lil ħuh fin-negozju. Issa jmexxuh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does Pawlu still run the shop on his own? Mark: No, he made his brother an associate in the business. They run it together now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗还在独自经营那家店吗？马克：没有，他让兄弟成为生意上的合伙人了。现在他们一起经营。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还在独自经营那家店吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu still run the shop on his own?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, xiĕrek lil ħuh fin-negozju. Issa jmexxuh flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Le, xiĕrek lil ħuh fin-negozju. Issa jmexxuh flimkien.
messages.zh: 没有，他让兄弟成为生意上的合伙人了。现在他们一起经营。
messages.en: No, he made his brother an associate in the business. They run it together now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xierek 想成“把一个人带进来”：带进生意成为伙伴，或登记进入课程；用这两个场景分别记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scheduled period during which an employee is assigned to work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 员工按排班安排需要工作的一个时段，如早班、晚班或夜班。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' xogħol assenjat lil ħaddiem skont skeda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作班次；排班中规定的一段工作时间。

formal.mt: Skont l-iskeda, ix-xift ta' filgħodu jibda fis-sitta u jintemm fis-sagħtejn ta' waranofsinhar.
formal.en: According to the schedule, the morning shift starts at six and ends at two in the afternoon.
formal.zh: 根据排班表，早班从六点开始，到下午两点结束。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema xift għandek għada? Mark: Għandi x-xift ta' billejl, allura se nistrieħ waranofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which shift are you working tomorrow? Mark: I have the night shift, so I will rest in the afternoon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你明天上哪个班？马克：我上夜班，所以打算下午休息。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你明天上哪个班？
messages.en: Which shift are you working tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi x-xift ta' billejl, allura se nistrieħ waranofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi x-xift ta' billejl, allura se nistrieħ waranofsinhar.
messages.zh: 我上夜班，所以打算下午休息。
messages.en: I have the night shift, so I will rest in the afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 xift，就想象排班表上划出的一格时间：早班一格、夜班一格，记住它指工作时段。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who works scheduled shifts, which may fall at different times of day or night.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照班次安排工作的人员，其工作时段可能在白天或夜间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem bix-xift, f'ħinijiet stabbiliti matul il-ġurnata jew il-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮班工作者；按照排定班次上班的员工。

collocations.zh: 轮班员工的工作时间表

formal.mt: Kull xiftjatur għandu jirċievi l-iskeda tiegħu minn qabel sabiex ikun jista' jippjana l-ħin tal-mistrieħ.
formal.en: Each shiftworker should receive their schedule in advance so that they can plan their rest time.
formal.zh: 每位轮班员工都应提前收到自己的排班表，以便安排休息时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu qed jorqod issa? Rita: Hu xiftjatur u llum spiċċa jaħdem fis-sebgħa ta' filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu sleeping now? Rita: He is a shiftworker, and today he finished work at seven in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么现在在睡觉？丽塔：他是轮班员工，今天早上七点才下班。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么现在在睡觉？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu sleeping now?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu xiftjatur u llum spiċċa jaħdem fis-sebgħa ta' filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu xiftjatur u llum spiċċa jaħdem fis-sebgħa ta' filgħodu.
messages.zh: 他是轮班员工，今天早上七点才下班。
messages.en: He is a shiftworker, and today he finished work at seven in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xift 和 xiftjatur 配成一张学习卡：前者是排班表里的时段，后者是按这张表来上班的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of having a small piece chipped off or of being cracked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体边缘崩掉小块，或表面出现裂纹的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' oġġett li għandu biċċa żgħira maqlugħa jew qasma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 崩缺、磕掉小块的状态，尤其指物体边缘受损。
开裂、有裂纹的状态。

collocations.en: chipping at the rim of the cup
cracking on the surface of the tile

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġie nnutat xigħir fit-tarf tal-platt u qasma żgħira fin-nofs.
formal.en: During the inspection, chipping was noted at the edge of the plate and a small crack in the centre.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，盘子边缘有崩缺，中央还有一条小裂纹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara dan ix-xigħir fit-tarf tat-tazza? Mark: Iva, hemm biċċa żgħira nieqsa. Ejja nużaw tazza oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see this chipping at the rim of the cup? Mark: Yes, a small piece is missing. Let's use another cup.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到杯口这里的崩缺了吗？马克：看到了，缺了一小块。我们换个杯子吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dan ix-xigħir fit-tarf tat-tazza?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dan ix-xigħir fit-tarf tat-tazza?
messages.zh: 你看到杯口这里的崩缺了吗？
messages.en: Can you see this chipping at the rim of the cup?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm biċċa żgħira nieqsa. Ejja nużaw tazza oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm biċċa żgħira nieqsa. Ejja nużaw tazza oħra.
messages.zh: 看到了，缺了一小块。我们换个杯子吧。
messages.en: Yes, a small piece is missing. Let's use another cup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用受损杯子记 xigħir：杯口少一小块是崩缺，杯身出现细线是开裂；把两个状态分别画在词卡上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of suing, a formal indictment, or, in a separate sense, wandering about.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指提起诉讼的行为或正式的公诉指控；另有独立义项，表示漫游、四处游荡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tressaq kawża, akkuża formali, jew, f'tifsira separata, ġiri minn post għal ieħor bla destinazzjoni fissa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起诉；向法院提起诉讼的行为。
正式公诉指控；起诉书中提出的指控。
漫游；没有固定目的地的四处游荡。

collocations.en: the suing of a person in court

formal.mt: Il-qorti eżaminat ix-xili u semgħet ix-xhieda qabel ħadet id-deċiżjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The court examined the indictment and heard the witnesses before reaching its decision.
formal.zh: 法院审查了公诉指控并听取证人证言，然后作出裁决。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif qattajt waranofsinhar? Lara: Bi ftit xili bla skop fit-toroq tal-belt. Ma kelli ebda destinazzjoni f'moħħi.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did you spend the afternoon? Lara: With a bit of aimless wandering through the city streets. I had no destination in mind.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你下午怎么过的？拉拉：在城里的街道上随意逛了逛，心里没有想去的地方。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你下午怎么过的？
messages.en: How did you spend the afternoon?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bi ftit xili bla skop fit-toroq tal-belt. Ma kelli ebda destinazzjoni f'moħħi.
messages.mt_standard: Bi ftit xili bla skop fit-toroq tal-belt. Ma kelli ebda destinazzjoni f'moħħi.
messages.zh: 在城里的街道上随意逛了逛，心里没有想去的地方。
messages.en: With a bit of aimless wandering through the city streets. I had no destination in mind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xili 做两张场景卡：法院卡区分“起诉行为”和“正式指控”，街道卡记“漫游”；不要强行把三义串成词源故事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take something away secretly, trying not to be noticed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 趁人不注意，偷偷把某物拿走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu xi ħaġa bil-moħbi, waqt li jipprova ma jiġix innutat.

sense_translations.en_definition: to take away in a furtive manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷偷摸摸地拿走某物。

formal.mt: Skont ix-xhud, ir-raġel ximek il-portmoni minn fuq il-mejda waqt li ħadd ma kien qed iħares.
formal.en: According to the witness, the man furtively took the wallet from the table while nobody was looking.
formal.zh: 据证人所述，那名男子趁无人留意，偷偷拿走了桌上的钱包。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-kejk li ħallejt hawn? Mark: Ħija ximek il-kejk waqt li konna fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the cake I left here go? Mark: My brother sneaked the cake away while we were in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我放在这里的蛋糕去哪儿了？Mark：我们在厨房的时候，我弟弟偷偷把蛋糕拿走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar il-kejk li ħallejt hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar il-kejk li ħallejt hawn?
messages.zh: 我放在这里的蛋糕去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the cake I left here go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ximek il-kejk waqt li konna fil-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ximek il-kejk waqt li konna fil-kċina.
messages.zh: 我们在厨房的时候，我弟弟偷偷把蛋糕拿走了。
messages.en: My brother sneaked the cake away while we were in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ximek 联想成桌上钱包悄悄消失的画面，重点记住“拿走”时还带着躲避目光的动作。

gloss_zh: 一味照搬的人；盲目模仿者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who copies someone else's actions or work without independent judgment or originality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏独立判断或创意，只会一味照搬他人行为或作品的人，含贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li timita l-għemil jew ix-xogħol ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr ħsieb indipendenti jew oriġinalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不加思考、一味照搬他人的模仿者，含贬义。

formal.mt: Fir-reċensjoni tiegħu, il-kritiku sejjaħ lill-awtur ximjottatur għax ix-xogħol ma wera ebda idea oriġinali.
formal.en: In his review, the critic called the author a slavish copycat because the work showed no original idea.
formal.zh: 评论家在书评中称作者为一味照搬的模仿者，因为作品没有表现出任何原创想法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejjaħtlu ximjottatur? Ben: Għax kull darba jieħu l-ideat tiegħi u lanqas ibiddel id-dettalji.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you call him a copycat? Ben: Because every time he takes my ideas, he doesn't even change the details.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么说他是个只会照搬的人？Ben：因为他每次都拿我的点子，连细节都不改。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个只会照搬的人？
messages.en: Why did you call him a copycat?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba jieħu l-ideat tiegħi u lanqas ibiddel id-dettalji.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba jieħu l-ideat tiegħi u lanqas ibiddel id-dettalji.
messages.zh: 因为他每次都拿我的点子，连细节都不改。
messages.en: Because every time he takes my ideas, he doesn't even change the details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ximjottatur 记成“站在复印机旁的人”：这里说的是照搬他人的人，不是模仿出来的作品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An imitation that follows another person's work or example mechanically and lacks originality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 机械地追随他人作品或做法、缺乏原创性的模仿行为或模仿成果，含贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imitazzjoni li ssegwi x-xogħol jew l-eżempju ta' ħaddieħor b'mod mekkaniku u mingħajr oriġinalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺乏独立思考或创意的机械模仿；一味照搬。

collocations.zh: 缺乏原创性的机械模仿

collocations.en: a slavish imitation of a style
collocations.zh: 对某种风格的生硬照搬

formal.mt: Il-ġurija qieset il-pittura bħala ximjottatura ta' xogħol magħruf, għax il-kompożizzjoni u d-dettalji kienu kważi identiċi.
formal.en: The jury regarded the painting as a slavish imitation of a well-known work because its composition and details were almost identical.
formal.zh: 评审团认为这幅画是对一件知名作品的机械模仿，因为构图和细节几乎完全相同。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan id-disinn jogħġbok? Tom: Il-kuluri sbieħ, imma jidher ximjottatura tad-disinn li rajna lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you like this design? Tom: The colours are nice, but it looks like a slavish imitation of the design we saw yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你喜欢这个设计吗？Tom：颜色很漂亮，不过看起来是在照搬我们昨天看过的设计。

messages.speaker: Nina (设计师)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个设计吗？
messages.en: Do you like this design?

messages.speaker: Tom (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kuluri sbieħ, imma jidher ximjottatura tad-disinn li rajna lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kuluri sbieħ, imma jidher ximjottatura tad-disinn li rajna lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 颜色很漂亮，不过看起来是在照搬我们昨天看过的设计。
messages.en: The colours are nice, but it looks like a slavish imitation of the design we saw yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ximjottatura 想成两幅几乎重合的画，记住它指“照搬这件事或照搬的成果”，与指人的词区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young monkey; also, disparagingly, a person who slavishly copies others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指年幼的猴子；也可贬指只会一味照搬他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xadina żgħira fl-età; ukoll, b'sens dispreġġjattiv, persuna li timita lil ħaddieħor bla ħsieb indipendenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年幼的猴子；幼猴。
不加思考、一味照搬他人的人，含贬义。

collocations.en: a young monkey beside its mother

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara edukattiva fiż-żoo, l-istudenti osservaw ximmjott jilgħab ħdejn ommu.
formal.en: During the educational visit to the zoo, the students observed a young monkey playing beside its mother.
formal.zh: 在动物园的教学参观中，学生们观察了一只在母猴身旁玩耍的幼猴。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil ħuk ximmjott? Luqa: Għax jikkopja kulma nagħmel, anki l-mod kif nitkellem!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you calling your brother a copycat? Luqa: Because he copies everything I do, even the way I speak!
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么说你弟弟是个跟着照搬的人？Luqa：因为我做什么他都学，连我说话的样子都学！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil ħuk ximmjott?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil ħuk ximmjott?
messages.zh: 你为什么说你弟弟是个跟着照搬的人？
messages.en: Why are you calling your brother a copycat?

messages.speaker: Luqa (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jikkopja kulma nagħmel, anki l-mod kif nitkellem!
messages.mt_standard: Għax jikkopja kulma nagħmel, anki l-mod kif nitkellem!
messages.zh: 因为我做什么他都学，连我说话的样子都学！
messages.en: Because he copies everything I do, even the way I speak!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ximmjott 配两张学习卡：一张画幼猴，一张画照搬别人的人；靠动物或人物语境判断具体义项。

gloss_zh: 散布他人的负面传闻；制造丑闻；诬蔑

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spread damaging rumours about someone, create a scandal about them, or make false accusations against them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散布关于某人的负面传闻，使其卷入丑闻，或以虚假指控诬蔑对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixerred xnigħat ħżiena dwar xi ħadd, iqajjem skandlu dwaru, jew jagħmel akkużi foloz kontrih.

sense_translations.en_definition: to spread negative rumours about sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 散布关于某人的负面传闻。
制造或挑起关于某人的丑闻。
以虚假的言论或指控诬蔑、诽谤某人。

collocations.en: spread damaging rumours about a colleague
collocations.zh: 散布关于一名同事的负面传闻

collocations.en: spread damaging rumours about the neighbour
collocations.zh: 散布关于邻居的负面传闻

formal.mt: Fir-rapport intqal li impjegat xina' fuq kollega u li dan għamel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The report stated that an employee had spread damaging rumours about a colleague and that this had harmed her reputation.
formal.zh: 报告指出，一名员工散布了关于一位女同事的负面传闻，损害了她的名誉。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Anna rrabjat ma' Pawlu? Ivan: Għax xina' fuqha mal-ħbieb tagħha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Anna get angry with Pawlu? Ivan: Because he spread damaging rumours about her among her friends.
colloquial.zh: Marta：Anna 为什么生 Pawlu 的气？Ivan：因为他在她的朋友中散布关于她的负面传闻。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: Anna 为什么生 Pawlu 的气？
messages.en: Why did Anna get angry with Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Ivan (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他在她的朋友中散布关于她的负面传闻。
messages.en: Because he spread damaging rumours about her among her friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xina' 想成一条伤害名誉的消息被传开；依语境区分负面传闻、制造丑闻与虚假诬蔑三种意思。

gloss_zh: 频繁散布负面传闻；反复说人坏话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spread negative rumours repeatedly or habitually.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复或习惯性地散布关于他人的负面传闻，强调行为经常发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixerred xnigħat ħżiena ta' spiss jew b'mod ripetut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常或反复散布负面传闻。

collocations.en: repeatedly spread negative rumours about colleagues
collocations.zh: 反复散布关于同事们的负面传闻

collocations.en: repeatedly spread negative rumours among the neighbours
collocations.zh: 经常在邻居之间散布负面传闻

formal.mt: Għal diversi xhur, l-impjegat xinna' fuq il-kollegi tiegħu, u dan ħoloq nuqqas ta' fiduċja fit-tim.
formal.en: For several months, the employee repeatedly spread negative rumours about his colleagues, creating distrust within the team.
formal.zh: 几个月来，这名员工反复散布关于同事的负面传闻，导致团队内部缺乏信任。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex m'għadekx tafdah? Sam: Għax xinna' fuq sħabu għal xhur sħaħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why don't you trust him anymore? Sam: Because he kept spreading negative rumours about his friends for months.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你为什么不再信任他了？Sam：因为他连续几个月都在散布关于朋友们的负面传闻。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不再信任他了？
messages.en: Why don't you trust him anymore?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xinna' fuq sħabu għal xhur sħaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xinna' fuq sħabu għal xhur sħaħ.
messages.zh: 因为他连续几个月都在散布关于朋友们的负面传闻。
messages.en: Because he kept spreading negative rumours about his friends for months.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 xinna' 时，想象日历上接连多天都出现传闲话的气泡，把“频繁、反复”作为这个词的记忆重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bright flash or sparkle; also a horseshoe vetch, a plant of the genus Hippocrepis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指明亮的小闪光；另一个义项指马蹄豆属（Hippocrepis）的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tleqqija żgħira u qawwija; ukoll, pjanta tal-ġeneru Hippocrepis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪光；闪烁的亮光。
马蹄豆属（Hippocrepis）植物的名称，可指该属及其所属物种。

formal.mt: Hekk kif ir-raġġ tax-xemx laqat il-ħġieġ, deher xintill ta' dawl fuq il-ħajt.
formal.en: As the sunbeam struck the glass, a sparkle of light appeared on the wall.
formal.zh: 阳光照到玻璃上时，墙上出现了一闪亮光。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Xi jfisser xintill f'dan il-ktieb tal-pjanti? David: Hawn ifisser pjanta tal-ġeneru Hippocrepis.
colloquial.en: Ella: What does xintill mean in this plant book? David: Here it means a plant of the genus Hippocrepis.
colloquial.zh: Ella：这本植物书里的 xintill 是什么意思？David：这里指马蹄豆属的一种植物。

messages.speaker: Ella (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser xintill f'dan il-ktieb tal-pjanti?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser xintill f'dan il-ktieb tal-pjanti?
messages.zh: 这本植物书里的 xintill 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does xintill mean in this plant book?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 这里指马蹄豆属的一种植物。
messages.en: Here it means a plant of the genus Hippocrepis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xintill 做一张双面卡：正面画一闪亮光，背面写植物属名 Hippocrepis；读到植物语境时切换到背面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species Hippocrepis multisiliquosa, a particular species of horseshoe vetch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物物种 Hippocrepis multisiliquosa 的马耳他语名称，指马蹄豆属中的这一特定物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem Malti tal-ispeċi ta' pjanta Hippocrepis multisiliquosa, li tagħmel parti mill-ġeneru Hippocrepis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多荚马蹄豆，学名为 Hippocrepis multisiliquosa 的植物物种。

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-ispeċi, ix-xintill komuni ġie rreġistrat bl-isem xjentifiku Hippocrepis multisiliquosa.
formal.en: In the species list, xintill komuni was recorded under the scientific name Hippocrepis multisiliquosa.
formal.zh: 在物种名录中，多荚马蹄豆以学名 Hippocrepis multisiliquosa 登记。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-isem xjentifiku tax-xintill komuni? Mark: Hippocrepis multisiliquosa; hekk insibuh fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the scientific name of xintill komuni? Mark: Hippocrepis multisiliquosa; that's how we find it in the guide.
colloquial.zh: Maja：xintill komuni 的学名是什么？Mark：Hippocrepis multisiliquosa；我们在指南里用这个名字查它。

messages.speaker: Maja (自然观察爱好者)
messages.zh: xintill komuni 的学名是什么？
messages.en: What is the scientific name of xintill komuni?

messages.speaker: Mark (自然观察向导)
messages.zh: Hippocrepis multisiliquosa；我们在指南里用这个名字查它。
messages.en: Hippocrepis multisiliquosa; that's how we find it in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语 xintill komuni 与完整学名 Hippocrepis multisiliquosa 配对背诵，像给植物贴上专属名牌一样记住具体物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species known scientifically as Hippocrepis biflora.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 学名为 Hippocrepis biflora 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Hippocrepis biflora.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学名为 Hippocrepis biflora 的植物。

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-pjanti, ix-xintill żgħir huwa mniżżel bl-isem xjentifiku Hippocrepis biflora.
formal.en: In the plant list, xintill żgħir is listed under the scientific name Hippocrepis biflora.
formal.zh: 在植物名录中，xintill żgħir 以学名 Hippocrepis biflora 列出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Mark: Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub xintill żgħir, jew Hippocrepis biflora.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the plant in this photo called? Mark: The label says xintill żgħir, or Hippocrepis biflora.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这株植物叫什么？马克：标签上写着 xintill żgħir，也就是 Hippocrepis biflora。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里的这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's the plant in this photo called?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub xintill żgħir, jew Hippocrepis biflora.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub xintill żgħir, jew Hippocrepis biflora.
messages.zh: 标签上写着 xintill żgħir，也就是 Hippocrepis biflora。
messages.en: The label says xintill żgħir, or Hippocrepis biflora.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组当作植物标签来记，并与学名 Hippocrepis biflora 配对，不凭字面猜植物特征。

gloss_zh: 向外张望；探望外面的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of looking out, for example through a window.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向外张望的动作，例如透过窗户看外面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħares 'il barra, pereżempju minn tieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向外看或探头张望的动作。

formal.mt: Ix-xirfien mit-tieqa ppermetta lill-osservatur jara min kien qed jasal.
formal.en: Looking out of the window allowed the observer to see who was arriving.
formal.zh: 从窗户向外张望，使观察者看清了正在到来的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan ix-xirfien kollu mit-tieqa? Mark: Qed nistenna lil ħija; għandu jasal daqt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why all this looking out of the window? Mark: I'm waiting for my brother; he should arrive soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么老是从窗户往外张望？马克：我在等我兄弟，他应该快到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么老是从窗户往外张望？
messages.en: Why all this looking out of the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistenna lil ħija; għandu jasal daqt.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistenna lil ħija; għandu jasal daqt.
messages.zh: 我在等我兄弟，他应该快到了。
messages.en: I'm waiting for my brother; he should arrive soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在窗边等人，把 xirfien 记成“向外张望这件事”，注意它是动作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shopping, or the act of buying something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 购物活动，或购买某件东西的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li wieħed imur jixtri, jew l-att li jixtri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 购物；选购所需物品的活动。
购买某物的行为。

formal.mt: Qabel ix-xiri ta' dar, ix-xerrej għandu jaqra bir-reqqa d-dokumenti kollha.
formal.en: Before purchasing a house, the buyer should read all the documents carefully.
formal.zh: 购买房屋之前，买方应仔细阅读全部文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tagħmel ix-xiri llum? Mark: Iva. Għamilt lista biex ma ninsa xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you doing the shopping today? Mark: Yes. I've made a list so I don't forget anything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天要去采购吗？马克：是的。我列了清单，免得漏买东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你今天要去采购吗？
messages.en: Are you doing the shopping today?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Għamilt lista biex ma ninsa xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Għamilt lista biex ma ninsa xejn.
messages.zh: 是的。我列了清单，免得漏买东西。
messages.en: Yes. I've made a list so I don't forget anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用购物清单作画面：xiri 既能指整趟购物，也能指购买一件东西的行为，两义一起记。

gloss_zh: 恶魔学；魔鬼历史与神话研究

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of demons and of the history and mythology of the devil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究恶魔以及魔鬼相关历史与神话的学问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju tad-demonji u tal-istorja u l-mitoloġija tax-xitan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶魔学；以恶魔及其相关观念为研究对象的学问。

sense_translations.en_definition: study of the history and mythology of the devil
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对魔鬼相关历史与神话的研究。

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju tax-xitanoloġija jeżamina kif ix-xitan jiġi deskritt f'testi storiċi u f'rakkonti mitoloġiċi.
formal.en: This study of demonology examines how the devil is described in historical texts and mythological narratives.
formal.zh: 这项恶魔学研究考察历史文本与神话叙事如何描述魔鬼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex inhu l-ktieb li qed taqra? Mark: Dwar ix-xitanoloġija; jitkellem fuq l-istorja u l-mitoloġija tax-xitan.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the book you're reading about? Mark: Demonology; it discusses the history and mythology of the devil.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你正在读的书讲什么？马克：恶魔学，讲的是魔鬼相关的历史与神话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar xiex inhu l-ktieb li qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar xiex inhu l-ktieb li qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你正在读的书讲什么？
messages.en: What's the book you're reading about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar ix-xitanoloġija; jitkellem fuq l-istorja u l-mitoloġija tax-xitan.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar ix-xitanoloġija; jitkellem fuq l-istorja u l-mitoloġija tax-xitan.
messages.zh: 恶魔学，讲的是魔鬼相关的历史与神话。
messages.en: Demonology; it discusses the history and mythology of the devil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本研究魔鬼故事的学术书，把 xitanoloġija 与“恶魔学、历史、神话”三个提示相连。

gloss_zh: 新生而青嫩的；来自新栽树木的

teaching_sense.en_definition: New and green, especially of material from a newly planted tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容新生、青嫩的，尤其指来自新栽树木的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġdid u għadu aħdar, speċjalment meta jkun ġej minn siġra li għadha kemm tħawlet.

sense_translations.en_definition: new, green, from a newly planted tree
sense_translations.zh_definition: 新生的、青嫩的；来自新栽树木的。

collocations.mt: fergħa minn siġra ġdida, b'injam xitli
collocations.en: a branch from a new tree, with green wood
collocations.zh: 新栽树木上木质尚青嫩的枝条

formal.mt: L-injam minn din is-siġra li għadha kemm tħawlet huwa xitli.
formal.en: The wood from this newly planted tree is new and green.
formal.zh: 这棵新栽树木的木材尚且新鲜青嫩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-injam ġej minn siġra li għadha kemm tħawlet? Mark: Iva, għadu xitli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this wood come from a newly planted tree? Mark: Yes, it's still new and green.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这木材是从一棵刚栽下的树上来的吗？马克：是的，还很新鲜青嫩。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-injam ġej minn siġra li għadha kemm tħawlet?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-injam ġej minn siġra li għadha kemm tħawlet?
messages.zh: 这木材是从一棵刚栽下的树上来的吗？
messages.en: Does this wood come from a newly planted tree?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺老师)
messages.zh: 是的，还很新鲜青嫩。
messages.en: Yes, it's still new and green.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xitli 配上刚栽小树和青嫩木材的画面，记住它是描述状态的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend the winter in a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个地方度过冬季；过冬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi x-xitwa f'xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 度过冬季；过冬。

collocations.en: spent the winter with the family

formal.mt: Matul dik is-sena, Pawlu xitta f'Malta mal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: That year, Pawlu spent the winter in Malta with his family.
formal.zh: 那一年，保罗与家人一起在马耳他过冬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn xitta Pawlu s-sena l-oħra? Mark: F'Malta, mal-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Pawlu spend the winter last year? Mark: In Malta, with his family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗去年在哪里过冬？马克：在马耳他，和家人一起。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗去年在哪里过冬？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu spend the winter last year?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在马耳他，和家人一起。
messages.en: In Malta, with his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把冬季日历放在马耳他地图上：xitta 表示“过冬”这个动作，例句中表示他过了冬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Meat that has been cooked by roasting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过烘烤而做熟的肉；烤肉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laħam imsajjar billi jinxtewa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烤熟的肉；烤肉。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, ġiet servuta xiwa bil-patata u l-ħaxix.
formal.en: Roasted meat with potatoes and vegetables was served for lunch.
formal.zh: 午餐供应了配土豆和蔬菜的烤肉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi trid għall-ikla? Mark: Platt xiwa bil-patata, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: What would you like to eat? Mark: A plate of roasted meat with potatoes, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想吃什么？马克：请给我一盘配土豆的烤肉。

messages.speaker: Maja (服务员)
messages.zh: 你想吃什么？
messages.en: What would you like to eat?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一盘配土豆的烤肉。
messages.en: A plate of roasted meat with potatoes, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用餐盘作记忆图：xiwa 是盘里已经烤好的肉，把它与表示烤制过程的 xiwi 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of roasting or grilling, or of scorching something with heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烘烤、烧烤的过程，或使某物受热灼焦的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-ikel jinxtewa fil-forn jew fuq gradilja, jew li bih xi ħaġa tinħaraq fil-wiċċ bis-sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烘烤；通过烤制使食物熟透的过程。
烧烤；在烤架上用热源烤制食物的过程。
灼焦；高温使物体表面焦化或受损的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispeċifika l-ħin meħtieġ għax-xiwi tal-laħam fil-forn.
formal.en: The recipe specifies the time required for roasting the meat in the oven.
formal.zh: 食谱注明了在烤箱中烘烤肉类所需的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għax-xiwi tal-laħam, se tuża l-forn jew il-gradilja? Mark: Il-gradilja. Tista' ġġibli l-platt?
colloquial.en: Maja: For cooking the meat, are you going to use the oven or the grill? Mark: The grill. Can you bring me the plate?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：烤肉的时候，你打算用烤箱还是烤架？马克：烤架。你能把盘子拿给我吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax-xiwi tal-laħam, se tuża l-forn jew il-gradilja?
messages.mt_standard: Għax-xiwi tal-laħam, se tuża l-forn jew il-gradilja?
messages.zh: 烤肉的时候，你打算用烤箱还是烤架？
messages.en: For cooking the meat, are you going to use the oven or the grill?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 烤架。你能把盘子拿给我吗？
messages.en: The grill. Can you bring me the plate?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xiwi 连到加热过程：烤箱中烘烤、烤架上烧烤、热过头灼焦；它是过程名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A meal of roasted or grilled meat, or a barbecue gathering where such food is served.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以烤肉为主要食物的一餐，也可指一起吃烧烤的聚餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikla ta' laħam mixwi, jew laqgħa fejn jittiekel dan l-ikel.

sense_translations.en_definition: a meal consisting of roasted or grilled meats
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以烘烤或炙烤肉类为主的一餐。
一次烧烤或烧烤聚餐。

formal.mt: L-għaqda se torganizza xiwja għall-membri tagħha nhar is-Sibt.
formal.en: The association will organize a barbecue for its members on Saturday.
formal.zh: 协会将于星期六为会员举办烧烤聚餐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Norganizzaw xiwja nhar il-Ħadd? Mark: Iva! Jien inġib il-laħam u int ġib il-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we organize a barbecue on Sunday? Mark: Yes! I'll bring the meat, and you bring the bread.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们星期天组织一次烧烤怎么样？马克：好啊！我带肉，你带面包。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们星期天组织一次烧烤怎么样？
messages.en: Shall we organize a barbecue on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Jien inġib il-laħam u int ġib il-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Jien inġib il-laħam u int ġib il-ħobż.
messages.zh: 好啊！我带肉，你带面包。
messages.en: Yes! I'll bring the meat, and you bring the bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xiwja 和周末围坐吃烤肉的画面绑定：既记住一餐烤肉，也记住烧烤聚餐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone become very thin or skinny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人变得消瘦或瘦弱，强调造成身体变瘦的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd isir irqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变得消瘦；使变得瘦弱。

collocations.en: the lack of food made the boy skinny
collocations.zh: 食物不足使男孩变得瘦弱

formal.mt: Il-mard fit-tul xixxem lill-pazjent, li kellu bżonn appoġġ waqt l-irkupru.
formal.en: The prolonged illness made the patient very thin, and he needed support during recovery.
formal.zh: 长期患病使这名患者十分消瘦，他在康复期间需要支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-mard xixxem lil Mark sew. Pawlu: Veru, imma issa qed jiekol aħjar u jħossu aktar b'saħħtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: The illness made Mark really skinny. Pawlu: True, but now he's eating better and feeling stronger.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这场病让马克瘦了好多。保罗：是啊，不过他现在吃得好些了，也感觉更有力气了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这场病让马克瘦了好多。
messages.en: The illness made Mark really skinny.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, imma issa qed jiekol aħjar u jħossu aktar b'saħħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, imma issa qed jiekol aħjar u jħossu aktar b'saħħtu.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过他现在吃得好些了，也感觉更有力气了。
messages.en: True, but now he's eating better and feeling stronger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“疾病使人消瘦”记住 xixxem：重点是某种原因使人变瘦，而不只是描述人很瘦。

gloss_zh: 非常年老的；年纪极大的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very old, especially when describing a person's advanced age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人年纪非常大，强调已经很年老。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna u ħafna żmien, speċjalment meta jingħad għal persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常年老的；年纪极大的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar kien xiħ għakka, iżda kien għadu jiftakar b'mod ċar il-ġrajjiet ta' żgħożitu.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour was very old, but he still remembered the events of his youth clearly.
formal.zh: 故事里的邻居已经非常年老，但他仍然清楚地记得年轻时的往事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu n-nannu tiegħek? Rita: Xiħ għakka, imma għadu jħobb joqgħod jitkellem magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your grandfather? Rita: Very old, but he still enjoys sitting and chatting with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爷爷近来怎么样？丽塔：年纪很大了，不过他还是喜欢坐着跟我们聊天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷近来怎么样？
messages.en: How is your grandfather?

messages.speaker: Rita (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Xiħ għakka, imma għadu jħobb joqgħod jitkellem magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Xiħ għakka, imma għadu jħobb joqgħod jitkellem magħna.
messages.zh: 年纪很大了，不过他还是喜欢坐着跟我们聊天。
messages.en: Very old, but he still enjoys sitting and chatting with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xiħ għakka 当作整块短语记忆，联想一位白发老人讲述很久以前的往事，突出“非常年老”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With awareness of what one is doing or of the relevant facts.
