teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在清楚自己所做之事或相关事实的情况下，知情地、明知地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'għarfien ta' dak li wieħed qed jagħmel jew tal-fatti rilevanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 知情地；在明知有关情况的前提下。

collocations.zh: 在知情的情况下接受风险

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddikjara li l-awtur ta xjentement informazzjoni falza.
formal.en: The report states that the author knowingly gave false information.
formal.zh: 报告指出，作者明知信息虚假仍予以提供。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li bagħat l-informazzjoni żbaljata xjentement? Mark: Le, naħseb li għamel żball.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think he knowingly sent the incorrect information? Mark: No, I think he made a mistake.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得他明知信息有误还发出去了吗？马克：不，我觉得他是弄错了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li bagħat l-informazzjoni żbaljata xjentement?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li bagħat l-informazzjoni żbaljata xjentement?
messages.zh: 你觉得他明知信息有误还发出去了吗？
messages.en: Do you think he knowingly sent the incorrect information?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 不，我觉得他是弄错了。
messages.en: No, I think he made a mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成“知道情况还这样做”：xjentement 修饰动作，突出做事时知情，不必然表示恶意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Knowing about a fact, situation, or possible consequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 知道某个事实、情况或可能后果的；有所意识的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaf b'fatt, b'sitwazzjoni jew b'konsegwenza possibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 知情的；知道或意识到某种情况的。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant ikkonferma li kien xjenti tar-riskju qabel ma beda l-attività.
formal.en: The participant confirmed that he was aware of the risk before starting the activity.
formal.zh: 参与者确认，他在开始活动之前已经知道相关风险。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inti xjenti li l-laqgħa tibda fit-tmienja? Mark: Iva, se nasal ftit qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you aware that the meeting starts at eight? Mark: Yes, I'll arrive a little early.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你知道会议八点开始吗？马克：知道，我会提前一点到。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Inti xjenti li l-laqgħa tibda fit-tmienja?
messages.mt_standard: Inti xjenti li l-laqgħa tibda fit-tmienja?
messages.zh: 你知道会议八点开始吗？
messages.en: Are you aware that the meeting starts at eight?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 知道，我会提前一点到。
messages.en: Yes, I'll arrive a little early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xjenti 放在“这个人知道风险”的句子里记忆：它描述人的知情状态，可搭配具体知道的内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pure and not mixed with other substances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保持本身成分、没有混入其他物质的；纯正而未掺杂的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pur, mingħajr taħlit ma' sustanzi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纯的；未掺入其他物质的。

formal.mt: Il-produttur jiddeskrivi l-prodott bħala għasel xkett, mingħajr ebda taħlita.
formal.en: The producer describes the product as pure honey, without any admixture.
formal.zh: 生产者将该产品描述为没有任何掺杂的纯蜂蜜。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan għasel xkett? Rita: Iva, huwa għasel biss, mingħajr xejn miżjud.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this pure honey? Rita: Yes, it's just honey, with nothing added.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这是纯蜂蜜吗？丽塔：是的，只有蜂蜜，没有添加其他东西。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这是纯蜂蜜吗？
messages.en: Is this pure honey?

messages.speaker: Rita (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa għasel biss, mingħajr xejn miżjud.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa għasel biss, mingħajr xejn miżjud.
messages.zh: 是的，只有蜂蜜，没有添加其他东西。
messages.en: Yes, it's just honey, with nothing added.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一罐只装蜂蜜、没有掺入别的东西的蜂蜜：用 għasel xkett 这个短语记住“纯、未掺杂”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who shoots with a shotgun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用霰弹枪射击的人；霰弹枪射手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tispara b'xkubetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 霰弹枪射手；使用霰弹枪射击的人。

collocations.zh: 受过训练的霰弹枪射手
经验丰富的霰弹枪射手

formal.mt: Ix-xkubettier ħa sehem fil-kompetizzjoni u laqat il-mira fl-ewwel prova.
formal.en: The shotgunner took part in the competition and hit the target on the first attempt.
formal.zh: 这名霰弹枪射手参加了比赛，并在第一次尝试时击中了目标。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ħdejn l-għalliem? Mark: Dak Pawlu, xkubettier b'esperjenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's that next to the instructor? Mark: That's Pawlu, an experienced shotgunner.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：教练旁边那个人是谁？马克：那是保罗，一位经验丰富的霰弹枪射手。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 教练旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who's that next to the instructor?

messages.speaker: Mark (观众)
messages.zh: 那是保罗，一位经验丰富的霰弹枪射手。
messages.en: That's Pawlu, an experienced shotgunner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给比赛中拿霰弹枪的射手贴上 xkubettier 标签，记住这个词指使用枪的人，而不是射击动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fire a gun or shoot at something with a gun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扣动枪械开火，或使用枪向某个目标射击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jispara b'arma tan-nar, jew jispara lejn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用枪射击；开枪。

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, it-tiratur xkubettja lejn il-mira taħt is-superviżjoni tal-għalliem.
formal.en: During training, the shooter fired at the target under the instructor's supervision.
formal.zh: 训练期间，射手在教练监督下向目标开枪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu xkubettja diġà? Mark: Iva, xkubettja darbtejn u issa qed jistenna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Pawlu fired yet? Mark: Yes, he fired twice and now he's waiting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗已经开过枪了吗？马克：是的，他开了两枪，现在正在等。

messages.speaker: Maja (射击学员)
messages.zh: 保罗已经开过枪了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu fired yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (射击学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xkubettja darbtejn u issa qed jistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xkubettja darbtejn u issa qed jistenna.
messages.zh: 是的，他开了两枪，现在正在等。
messages.en: Yes, he fired twice and now he's waiting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xkubettja 配上“举枪向靶子射击”的动作画面；与指射手的 xkubettier 对照，记清动作和人物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gunshot: a single discharge of a gun, or the sound it makes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 枪发射一次的动作，或由此发出的枪响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sparatura waħda minn arma tan-nar, jew il-ħoss tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一声枪响；一次枪击。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud iddikjara li sema' xkubettjatura ftit qabel nofsillejl.
formal.en: The witness stated that he heard a gunshot shortly before midnight.
formal.zh: 证人陈述，他在午夜前不久听见了一声枪响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Kienet xkubettjatura? Mark: Ma nafx. Jien ukoll smajtu, imma ma rajt xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that noise? Was it a gunshot? Mark: I don't know. I heard it too, but I didn't see anything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见那个声音了吗？是枪响吗？马克：不知道。我也听见了，但什么都没看见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那个声音了吗？是枪响吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that noise? Was it a gunshot?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Jien ukoll smajtu, imma ma rajt xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Jien ukoll smajtu, imma ma rajt xejn.
messages.zh: 不知道。我也听见了，但什么都没看见。
messages.en: I don't know. I heard it too, but I didn't see anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象远处突然传来“砰”的一声，把整个词与“一声枪响”的画面相连，再用 tisma' xkubettjatura 练习“听见枪响”。

gloss_zh: 未明确指称的人体部位；用于表示“受够了”的惯用语

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unspecified part of the human body, used in the expression 'nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi' to mean being completely fed up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个未明确指称的人体部位；在 nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi 这个表达中，用来表示“我实在受够了”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti mhux speċifikata tal-ġisem tal-bniedem, użata fl-espressjoni 'nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi' biex turi li xi ħadd xeba' għalkollox.

sense_translations.en_definition: An undefined part of the human body ('nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi', I am fed up to the back teeth)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 未明确指称的人体部位；见惯用语 nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi，意思是“我实在受够了，烦透了”。

collocations.en: I am completely fed up with the noise
collocations.zh: 我实在受够了这些噪声

collocations.en: I am completely fed up with waiting

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'xmienaq' tidher fl-espressjoni 'nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi', li tesprimi dwejjaq kbir b'sitwazzjoni.
formal.en: The word 'xmienaq' appears in the expression 'nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi', which expresses being thoroughly fed up with a situation.
formal.zh: xmienaq 一词见于表达 nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi，用来表示对某种情况已经烦透了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadhom jagħmlu dak l-istorbju? Pawlu: Iva, u nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi. Ma nistax nikkonċentra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are they still making that noise? Pawlu: Yes, and I'm completely fed up. I can't concentrate.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们还在制造那种噪声吗？保罗：是啊，我实在受够了。我都没法集中精神。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 他们还在制造那种噪声吗？
messages.en: Are they still making that noise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi. Ma nistax nikkonċentra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi. Ma nistax nikkonċentra.
messages.zh: 是啊，我实在受够了。我都没法集中精神。
messages.en: Yes, and I'm completely fed up. I can't concentrate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词条 xmienaq 和整句 nħossni xbajt sa xmnieqi 配对记忆，联想“忍耐已经到极限”；不要把这个未明确指称的部位硬记成某个具体器官。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bunch or a small root; the diminutive form of 'xenxul'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小束东西或一条小根；是 xenxul 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għanqud żgħir jew għerq żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'xenxul'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small bunch or root (the diminutive form of 'xenxul')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小束或小根；为 xenxul 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Għall-attività tal-klassi, kull student ġab xnejxel ta' ħxejjex u kiteb l-isem tagħhom.
formal.en: For the class activity, each student brought a small bunch of herbs and wrote down their name.
formal.zh: 在课堂活动中，每位学生都带来了一小束香草，并写下了香草的名称。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm għandek bżonn ħxejjex għas-soppa? Toni: Xnejxel biss. Tpoġġih ħdejn il-borma, jekk jogħġbok?
colloquial.en: Rita: How many herbs do you need for the soup? Toni: Just a small bunch. Could you put it beside the pot, please?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：煮汤需要多少香草？托尼：一小束就够了。请把它放在锅旁边，好吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 煮汤需要多少香草？
messages.en: How many herbs do you need for the soup?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Xnejxel biss. Tpoġġih ħdejn il-borma, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Xnejxel biss. Tpoġġih ħdejn il-borma, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 一小束就够了。请把它放在锅旁边，好吗？
messages.en: Just a small bunch. Could you put it beside the pot, please?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手指比出“一小束”的大小来记 xnejxel，再把它和已给出的 xenxul 配对；另画一条小根，提醒自己它还有“小根”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clover, used as a general plant name without specifying a particular species.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 三叶草的通称，本词本身不限定某一个具体物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ġenerali għall-pjanti tas-silla, mingħajr ma tissemma speċi partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三叶草。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu l-weraq u l-fjuri tax-xnien li dehru fir-ritratti tal-ktieb.
formal.en: The students compared the clover leaves and flowers shown in the book's photographs.
formal.zh: 学生们比较了书中照片所展示的三叶草叶片和花。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'xnien' bl-Ingliż? Mark: 'Clover'. Hawn għandna ritratt tiegħu fil-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'xnien' mean in English? Mark: 'Clover'. We have a picture of it here in the book.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：xnien 用英语怎么说？马克：Clover，就是三叶草。书里这里有它的照片。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: xnien 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: What does 'xnien' mean in English?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: Clover，就是三叶草。书里这里有它的照片。
messages.en: 'Clover'. We have a picture of it here in the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在三叶草图片旁写上 xnien，分别指着叶和花读 weraq tax-xnien、fjuri tax-xnien，让词形与植物画面一起进入记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small white clover, the plant species Trifolium nigrescens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Trifolium nigrescens 的小白三叶草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' xnien magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Trifolium nigrescens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小白三叶草，学名为 Trifolium nigrescens。

collocations.en: a photograph of small white clover
a specimen of small white clover

formal.mt: Fuq it-tikketta tal-kampjun hemm miktub 'xnien abjad' u l-isem xjentifiku Trifolium nigrescens.
formal.en: The specimen label gives the name 'xnien abjad' and the scientific name Trifolium nigrescens.
formal.zh: 标本标签上写着马耳他语名称 xnien abjad，以及学名 Trifolium nigrescens。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema ritratt għandna npoġġu ħdejn 'xnien abjad'? David: Dan li għandu t-tikketta Trifolium nigrescens.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which photograph should we put beside 'xnien abjad'? David: This one labelled Trifolium nigrescens.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们该把哪张照片放在 xnien abjad 旁边？戴维：这张，标着 Trifolium nigrescens 的。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema ritratt għandna npoġġu ħdejn 'xnien abjad'?
messages.mt_standard: Liema ritratt għandna npoġġu ħdejn 'xnien abjad'?
messages.zh: 我们该把哪张照片放在 xnien abjad 旁边？
messages.en: Which photograph should we put beside 'xnien abjad'?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan li għandu t-tikketta Trifolium nigrescens.
messages.mt_standard: Dan li għandu t-tikketta Trifolium nigrescens.
messages.zh: 这张，标着 Trifolium nigrescens 的。
messages.en: This one labelled Trifolium nigrescens.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用白色卡片记 abjad“白色的”，卡片上同时写 xnien abjad 和 Trifolium nigrescens，把中文名、马耳他语名和学名固定配成一组。

gloss_zh: 黄花三叶草；啤酒花状三叶草（Trifolium campestre）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hop trefoil, the clover species Trifolium campestre.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Trifolium campestre 的黄花三叶草，英语称 hop trefoil。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' xnien magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Trifolium campestre.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄花三叶草，又可描述为啤酒花状三叶草，学名为 Trifolium campestre。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudenta użat l-isem 'xnien isfar' flimkien mal-isem xjentifiku Trifolium campestre.
formal.en: In her report, the student used the name 'xnien isfar' together with the scientific name Trifolium campestre.
formal.zh: 这名女学生在报告中同时使用了马耳他语名称 xnien isfar 和学名 Trifolium campestre。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jissejjaħ 'xnien isfar' bl-Ingliż? Ben: 'Hop trefoil'. Niżżel ukoll Trifolium campestre fin-noti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is 'xnien isfar' called in English? Ben: 'Hop trefoil'. Write Trifolium campestre in your notes too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：xnien isfar 用英语叫什么？本：Hop trefoil。笔记里也记上 Trifolium campestre。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: xnien isfar 用英语叫什么？
messages.en: What is 'xnien isfar' called in English?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Hop trefoil'. Niżżel ukoll Trifolium campestre fin-noti.
messages.mt_standard: 'Hop trefoil'. Niżżel ukoll Trifolium campestre fin-noti.
messages.zh: Hop trefoil。笔记里也记上 Trifolium campestre。
messages.en: 'Hop trefoil'. Write Trifolium campestre in your notes too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 isfar“黄色的”写在黄色词卡上，再并排写 xnien isfar、hop trefoil 和 Trifolium campestre，借颜色提示记住这组对应名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Subterranean clover, the plant species Trifolium subterraneum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Trifolium subterraneum 的地下三叶草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' xnien magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Trifolium subterraneum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地下三叶草，学名为 Trifolium subterraneum。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi kampjun tax-xnien midfun taħt l-isem xjentifiku Trifolium subterraneum.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a specimen of subterranean clover under the scientific name Trifolium subterraneum.
formal.zh: 目录以学名 Trifolium subterraneum 收录了一份地下三叶草标本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-paġna hija dwar ix-xnien midfun? Paul: Iva. Ara, hemm miktub Trifolium subterraneum taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this page about subterranean clover? Paul: Yes. Look, Trifolium subterraneum is written below the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这一页介绍的是地下三叶草吗？保罗：是的。你看，照片下面写着 Trifolium subterraneum。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-paġna hija dwar ix-xnien midfun?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-paġna hija dwar ix-xnien midfun?
messages.zh: 这一页介绍的是地下三叶草吗？
messages.en: Is this page about subterranean clover?

messages.speaker: Paul (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Ara, hemm miktub Trifolium subterraneum taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Ara, hemm miktub Trifolium subterraneum taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 是的。你看，照片下面写着 Trifolium subterraneum。
messages.en: Yes. Look, Trifolium subterraneum is written below the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 midfun“埋着的”当作名称记忆提示，画一张埋在土里的词卡，卡上写 xnien midfun 和“地下三叶草”；这个画面只用于助记名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suffocated clover, also called small-cluster clover, the species Trifolium suffocatum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Trifolium suffocatum 的密簇三叶草；英语名称包括 suffocated clover 和 small-cluster clover。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' xnien magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Trifolium suffocatum u bl-ismijiet Ingliżi 'suffocated clover' u 'small-cluster clover'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 密簇三叶草，学名为 Trifolium suffocatum；英语也称 suffocated clover 或 small-cluster clover。

formal.mt: Il-lista tagħti 'xnien moħbi' bħala l-isem Malti ta' Trifolium suffocatum, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala 'small-cluster clover'.
formal.en: The list gives 'xnien moħbi' as the Maltese name for Trifolium suffocatum, known in English as 'small-cluster clover'.
formal.zh: 这份列表将 xnien moħbi 列为 Trifolium suffocatum 的马耳他语名称，其英语名称之一是 small-cluster clover。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex għandna żewġ ismijiet bl-Ingliż ħdejn 'xnien moħbi'? Luqa: 'Suffocated clover' u 'small-cluster clover' jirreferu għall-istess speċi, Trifolium suffocatum.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why do we have two English names beside 'xnien moħbi'? Luqa: 'Suffocated clover' and 'small-cluster clover' refer to the same species, Trifolium suffocatum.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：为什么 xnien moħbi 旁边有两个英语名称？卢卡：Suffocated clover 和 small-cluster clover 指同一个物种，也就是 Trifolium suffocatum。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandna żewġ ismijiet bl-Ingliż ħdejn 'xnien moħbi'?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandna żewġ ismijiet bl-Ingliż ħdejn 'xnien moħbi'?
messages.zh: 为什么 xnien moħbi 旁边有两个英语名称？
messages.en: Why do we have two English names beside 'xnien moħbi'?

messages.speaker: Luqa (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Suffocated clover' u 'small-cluster clover' jirreferu għall-istess speċi, Trifolium suffocatum.
messages.mt_standard: 'Suffocated clover' u 'small-cluster clover' jirreferu għall-istess speċi, Trifolium suffocatum.
messages.zh: Suffocated clover 和 small-cluster clover 指同一个物种，也就是 Trifolium suffocatum。
messages.en: 'Suffocated clover' and 'small-cluster clover' refer to the same species, Trifolium suffocatum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 moħbi“藏起来的”设计翻卡练习：正面写 xnien moħbi，背面藏着“密簇三叶草”和 Trifolium suffocatum；翻卡时再复习两个英语名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The clover species Trifolium pratense, commonly called red clover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 红车轴草，学名 Trifolium pratense，指这一特定的车轴草属植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' xnien bl-isem xjentifiku Trifolium pratense, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala red clover.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红车轴草（学名 Trifolium pratense）。

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu, l-isem xnien tal-għelieqi jidher ħdejn l-isem xjentifiku Trifolium pratense.
formal.en: In the catalogue, the name xnien tal-għelieqi appears beside the scientific name Trifolium pratense.
formal.zh: 目录中，马耳他语名称 xnien tal-għelieqi 列在学名 Trifolium pratense 旁边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jissejjaħ red clover bil-Malti? Pawlu: Xnien tal-għelieqi. Niżżel l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is red clover called in Maltese? Pawlu: Xnien tal-għelieqi. Write the name beside the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：红车轴草用马耳他语怎么说？保罗：Xnien tal-għelieqi。把这个名称写在照片旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 红车轴草用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: What is red clover called in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Xnien tal-għelieqi. Niżżel l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Xnien tal-għelieqi. Niżżel l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: Xnien tal-għelieqi。把这个名称写在照片旁边。
messages.en: Xnien tal-għelieqi. Write the name beside the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张红车轴草图片卡，把 xnien tal-għelieqi 与 Trifolium pratense 并排写，整组认读，避免与其他车轴草名称混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The clover species Trifolium stellatum, commonly called starry clover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 星状车轴草，学名 Trifolium stellatum，指这一特定的车轴草属植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' xnien bl-isem xjentifiku Trifolium stellatum, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala starry clover.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 星状车轴草（学名 Trifolium stellatum）。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-kampjun tagħti żewġ ismijiet: xnien tal-istilla u Trifolium stellatum.
formal.en: The specimen label gives two names: xnien tal-istilla and Trifolium stellatum.
formal.zh: 标本标签列出两个名称：xnien tal-istilla 和 Trifolium stellatum。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema ritratt hu tax-xnien tal-istilla? Mark: Dan hawn. Taħtu hemm miktub Trifolium stellatum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which photograph shows starry clover? Mark: This one here. Trifolium stellatum is written underneath it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：哪张照片拍的是星状车轴草？马克：这里这张。下面写着 Trifolium stellatum。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 哪张照片拍的是星状车轴草？
messages.en: Which photograph shows starry clover?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hawn. Taħtu hemm miktub Trifolium stellatum.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hawn. Taħtu hemm miktub Trifolium stellatum.
messages.zh: 这里这张。下面写着 Trifolium stellatum。
messages.en: This one here. Trifolium stellatum is written underneath it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 xnien tal-istilla 的词卡角落画一颗星，联想英文 starry clover；星号只是记忆提示，认植物仍要核对学名 Trifolium stellatum。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The clover species Trifolium angustifolium, commonly called narrow clover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 狭叶车轴草，学名 Trifolium angustifolium，指这一特定的车轴草属植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' xnien bl-isem xjentifiku Trifolium angustifolium, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala narrow clover.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭叶车轴草（学名 Trifolium angustifolium）。

collocations.en: the scientific name of narrow clover

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt tax-xnien tal-werqa rqiqa, bl-isem xjentifiku Trifolium angustifolium taħtu.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of narrow clover, with the scientific name Trifolium angustifolium underneath.
formal.zh: 指南收录了一张狭叶车轴草的照片，下方标有学名 Trifolium angustifolium。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif nikteb narrow clover bil-Malti? Toni: Ikteb xnien tal-werqa rqiqa, u żid Trifolium angustifolium ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do I write narrow clover in Maltese? Toni: Write xnien tal-werqa rqiqa, and add Trifolium angustifolium beside it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：狭叶车轴草用马耳他语怎么写？托尼：写 xnien tal-werqa rqiqa，再在旁边加上 Trifolium angustifolium。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 狭叶车轴草用马耳他语怎么写？
messages.en: How do I write narrow clover in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb xnien tal-werqa rqiqa, u żid Trifolium angustifolium ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb xnien tal-werqa rqiqa, u żid Trifolium angustifolium ħdejh.
messages.zh: 写 xnien tal-werqa rqiqa，再在旁边加上 Trifolium angustifolium。
messages.en: Write xnien tal-werqa rqiqa, and add Trifolium angustifolium beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长名称分成 xnien／tal-werqa／rqiqa 三段朗读，再与“狭叶车轴草”和 narrow clover 配对；分段帮助记拼写，完整名称一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The clover species Trifolium tomentosum, commonly called woolly clover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绒毛车轴草，学名 Trifolium tomentosum，指这一特定的车轴草属植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' xnien bl-isem xjentifiku Trifolium tomentosum, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala woolly clover.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绒毛车轴草（学名 Trifolium tomentosum）。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tal-kampjuni, xnien tar-raba' huwa elenkat bl-isem xjentifiku Trifolium tomentosum.
formal.en: In the specimen register, woolly clover is listed under the scientific name Trifolium tomentosum.
formal.zh: 在标本登记册中，绒毛车轴草以学名 Trifolium tomentosum 列出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din it-tikketta tgħid xnien tar-raba'. X'inhu bl-Ingliż? David: Woolly clover. L-isem xjentifiku hu Trifolium tomentosum.
colloquial.en: Sara: This label says xnien tar-raba'. What is it in English? David: Woolly clover. The scientific name is Trifolium tomentosum.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个标签写着 xnien tar-raba'。英语叫什么？戴维：Woolly clover，也就是绒毛车轴草。学名是 Trifolium tomentosum。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tikketta tgħid xnien tar-raba'. X'inhu bl-Ingliż?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tikketta tgħid xnien tar-raba'. X'inhu bl-Ingliż?
messages.zh: 这个标签写着 xnien tar-raba'。英语叫什么？
messages.en: This label says xnien tar-raba'. What is it in English?

messages.speaker: David (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Woolly clover. L-isem xjentifiku hu Trifolium tomentosum.
messages.mt_standard: Woolly clover. L-isem xjentifiku hu Trifolium tomentosum.
messages.zh: Woolly clover，也就是绒毛车轴草。学名是 Trifolium tomentosum。
messages.en: Woolly clover. The scientific name is Trifolium tomentosum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xnien tar-raba' 与“绒毛车轴草／woolly clover”做成双面词卡，抄写时特别保留 raba' 末尾的撇号，并用学名核对对应关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of spreading rumours or passing unverified claims from person to person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散布谣言的行为，指在人与人之间传播未经证实的说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tixrid ta' għajdut jew ta' stejjer mhux ivverifikati minn persuna għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散布谣言；传播未经证实的传闻这一行为。

collocations.en: the spreading of rumours about the neighbours
to stop the spreading of rumours

formal.mt: L-iskola talbet lill-istudenti biex iwaqqfu x-xnigħ u jivverifikaw l-informazzjoni qabel jaqsmuha ma' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: The school asked students to stop spreading rumours and verify information before sharing it with others.
formal.zh: 学校要求学生停止传谣，并在向他人转述信息之前核实内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt li l-ħanut se jagħlaq. Ngħid lil kulħadd? Mark: L-ewwel staqsi lis-sid. Ix-xnigħ jista' jagħmel il-ħsara.
colloquial.en: Maja: I heard the shop is going to close. Shall I tell everyone? Mark: Ask the owner first. Spreading rumours can cause harm.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我听说这家店要关门了。要告诉大家吗？马克：先问问店主。传谣可能造成伤害。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li l-ħanut se jagħlaq. Ngħid lil kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li l-ħanut se jagħlaq. Ngħid lil kulħadd?
messages.zh: 我听说这家店要关门了。要告诉大家吗？
messages.en: I heard the shop is going to close. Shall I tell everyone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel staqsi lis-sid. Ix-xnigħ jista' jagħmel il-ħsara.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel staqsi lis-sid. Ix-xnigħ jista' jagħmel il-ħsara.
messages.zh: 先问问店主。传谣可能造成伤害。
messages.en: Ask the owner first. Spreading rumours can cause harm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句未经核实的话从一个人传到另一个人，每传一次就默念 xnigħ；重点记住它表示“传谣这个行为”，是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling sorry for something wrong one has done and wishing to make amends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己做错了事而感到懊悔、产生悔改之意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss dispjaċir għal xi ħaġa ħażina li jkun għamel u jixtieq jirranġaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悔悟的；对自己的过错感到懊悔的。

collocations.zh: 为自己的所作所为感到懊悔

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, Mark qal li kien xogħfan għal dak li għamel u wiegħed li se jirranġa l-ħsara.
formal.en: In his letter, Mark said he was repentant for what he had done and promised to repair the damage.
formal.zh: 马克在信中表示，他对自己的所作所为深感懊悔，并承诺弥补造成的损害。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Jien xogħfan għal dak li għedtlek ilbieraħ. Maja: Grazzi talli tlabt skuża. Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I am repentant for what I said to you yesterday. Maja: Thank you for apologising. Let's talk calmly.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我为昨天对你说的话感到懊悔。玛雅：谢谢你道歉。我们心平气和地谈谈吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien xogħfan għal dak li għedtlek ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Jien xogħfan għal dak li għedtlek ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 我为昨天对你说的话感到懊悔。
messages.en: I am repentant for what I said to you yesterday.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli tlabt skuża. Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli tlabt skuża. Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 谢谢你道歉。我们心平气和地谈谈吧。
messages.en: Thank you for apologising. Let's talk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xogħfan 放进“做错事后低头道歉”的场景来记：它描写人的悔悟状态，可用 Jien xogħfan 练习“我感到懊悔”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing strong surprise, distress, or dismay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人强烈惊讶、难受或愕然的；令人震惊的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqanqal sorpriża kbira, dieqa jew skantament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人震惊的；使人惊愕或深感不安的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddeskriva l-kundizzjonijiet fil-bini bħala xokkanti u talab titjib immedjat.
formal.en: The report described the conditions in the building as shocking and called for immediate improvements.
formal.zh: 报告将楼内状况描述为令人震惊，并要求立即改善。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt ir-ritratti tal-bini abbandunat? Toni: Iva, il-kundizzjoni tiegħu hi xokkanti. Ma stennejtx daqshekk ħsara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the photographs of the abandoned building? Toni: Yes, its condition is shocking. I did not expect so much damage.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看过那栋废弃建筑的照片吗？托尼：看过，它的状况令人震惊。我没想到损坏这么严重。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过那栋废弃建筑的照片吗？
messages.en: Did you see the photographs of the abandoned building?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kundizzjoni tiegħu hi xokkanti. Ma stennejtx daqshekk ħsara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kundizzjoni tiegħu hi xokkanti. Ma stennejtx daqshekk ħsara.
messages.zh: 看过，它的状况令人震惊。我没想到损坏这么严重。
messages.en: Yes, its condition is shocking. I did not expect so much damage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看到一条消息后惊得睁大眼睛，把这条消息标成 aħbar xokkanti；记住这个形容词描写引起震惊的消息或事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ruddy or reddish appearance, especially the redness of a person's face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 红润或泛红的外观，尤其指人的脸部呈现的红色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dehra ħamra jew ħamranija, speċjalment il-ħmura ta' wiċċ persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红润；呈现红润色泽的状态。
脸部发红；面部呈现的红色。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-personaġġ, l-awtriċi semmiet ix-xoqor ta' wiċċu wara l-mixja twila.
formal.en: In her description of the character, the author mentioned the redness of his face after the long walk.
formal.zh: 作者在描写这个人物时，提到了他长途步行后脸部泛红的样子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm ix-xoqor fuq ħaddejja? Għadni kemm spiċċajt niġri. Mark: Iva, ftit. Poġġi hawn u strieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are my cheeks still red? I have just finished running. Mark: Yes, a little. Sit here and rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的脸颊还红着吗？我刚跑完步。马克：是的，还有一点。坐这儿休息一下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm ix-xoqor fuq ħaddejja? Għadni kemm spiċċajt niġri.
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm ix-xoqor fuq ħaddejja? Għadni kemm spiċċajt niġri.
messages.zh: 我的脸颊还红着吗？我刚跑完步。
messages.en: Are my cheeks still red? I have just finished running.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit. Poġġi hawn u strieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit. Poġġi hawn u strieħ.
messages.zh: 是的，还有一点。坐这儿休息一下吧。
messages.en: Yes, a little. Sit here and rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象跑步后双颊泛红的样子，把这片红色标为 xoqor；同时记住“红润”和“脸部发红”两个义项，它是表示状态的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electrical fault in which current takes an unintended path, potentially causing damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电流沿非预期路径流动、可能造成损坏的电路故障，即短路。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara elettrika li fiha l-kurrent jgħaddi minn mogħdija mhux maħsuba għalih u jista' jikkawża ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短路；电流沿异常路径流动的电路故障。

collocations.en: a short circuit in the circuit

formal.mt: L-elettriċista sab xort fiċ-ċirkwit u sewwa l-ħsara qabel reġa' qabbad il-provvista.
formal.en: The electrician found a short circuit and repaired the fault before reconnecting the supply.
formal.zh: 电工发现了电路短路，并在重新接通电源前修好了故障。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex intefa d-dawl? Mark: Jista' jkun hemm xort. Inċemplu lill-elettriċista.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the light go out? Mark: There may be a short circuit. Let's call the electrician.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：灯为什么灭了？马克：可能短路了。我们给电工打电话吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 灯为什么灭了？
messages.en: Why did the light go out?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun hemm xort. Inċemplu lill-elettriċista.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun hemm xort. Inċemplu lill-elettriċista.
messages.zh: 可能短路了。我们给电工打电话吧。
messages.en: There may be a short circuit. Let's call the electrician.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把电流误走近路、灯突然熄灭的画面与 xort 配对，记住它表示“短路”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sailing boat of the type known as a speronara.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为斯佩罗纳拉的帆船；该词指具体的船型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' dgħajsa tal-qlugħ magħrufa bħala speronara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斯佩罗纳拉式帆船，一种特定类型的帆船。

collocations.zh: 斯佩罗纳拉式帆船的模型
斯佩罗纳拉式帆船的船帆

formal.mt: Il-mudell tax-xprunara juri l-forma tad-dgħajsa u l-pożizzjoni tal-qlugħ tagħha.
formal.en: The model of the speronara shows the shape of the boat and the position of its sails.
formal.zh: 这艘斯佩罗纳拉式帆船的模型展示了船体形状及船帆的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tip ta' dgħajsa hi dik fil-mudell? Mark: Dik xprunara. Ara l-qlugħ tagħha!
colloquial.en: Maja: What type of boat is that model? Mark: That's a speronara. Look at its sails!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个模型是哪种船？马克：那是斯佩罗纳拉式帆船。看看它的船帆！

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tip ta' dgħajsa hi dik fil-mudell?
messages.mt_standard: X'tip ta' dgħajsa hi dik fil-mudell?
messages.zh: 那个模型是哪种船？
messages.en: What type of boat is that model?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 那是斯佩罗纳拉式帆船。看看它的船帆！
messages.en: That's a speronara. Look at its sails!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一艘帆船模型贴上 xprunara 标签，把这个词作为特定船型名称整体记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become red in the cheeks, for example after drinking alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸颊变红或泛起红晕，例如饮酒后出现这种变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aħmar f'ħaddejh, pereżempju wara li jixrob l-alkoħol.

sense_translations.en_definition: to grow red-cheeked (e.g. due to alcohol)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸颊变红、泛起红晕，例如因饮酒而面颊发红。

formal.mt: Wara li xorob tazza nbid, ir-raġel xqar u ħaddejh dehru aktar ħomor.
formal.en: After drinking a glass of wine, the man became flushed, and his cheeks looked redder.
formal.zh: 喝了一杯葡萄酒后，男子的双颊泛起红晕，看起来更红了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark xqar wara dik it-tazza nbid. Lara: Iva, ħaddejh saru ħomor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark became red-cheeked after that glass of wine. Lara: Yes, his cheeks turned red.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克喝了那杯葡萄酒后脸颊泛红了。拉拉：是啊，他的双颊都红了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark xqar wara dik it-tazza nbid.
messages.mt_standard: Mark xqar wara dik it-tazza nbid.
messages.zh: 马克喝了那杯葡萄酒后脸颊泛红了。
messages.en: Mark became red-cheeked after that glass of wine.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他的双颊都红了。
messages.en: Yes, his cheeks turned red.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xqar 配上一张双颊逐渐变红的脸，重点记住它是表示“变红”这一变化的动词。

gloss_zh: 弹片；爆炸产生的金属碎片

teaching_sense.en_definition: Metal fragments scattered by an exploding shell or other explosive device.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 炮弹或其他爆炸装置爆炸时飞散的金属碎片，通常称为弹片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċiet tal-metall li jinxterdu meta tisplodi qoxra ta' kanun jew apparat splussiv ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弹片；爆炸时飞散的金属碎片。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ħsara fil-ħajt ikkawżata mix-xrapnel waqt l-isplużjoni.
formal.en: The report describes damage to the wall caused by shrapnel during the explosion.
formal.zh: 报告描述了爆炸过程中弹片对墙壁造成的损坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhuma dawk il-biċċiet tal-metall fil-vetrina? Mark: Dak xrapnel. It-tikketta tgħid li nstab wara splużjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are those pieces of metal in the display case? Mark: That's shrapnel. The label says it was found after an explosion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：展柜里的那些金属碎片是什么？马克：那是弹片。标签说是在一次爆炸后发现的。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里的那些金属碎片是什么？
messages.en: What are those pieces of metal in the display case?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak xrapnel. It-tikketta tgħid li nstab wara splużjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Dak xrapnel. It-tikketta tgħid li nstab wara splużjoni.
messages.zh: 那是弹片。标签说是在一次爆炸后发现的。
messages.en: That's shrapnel. The label says it was found after an explosion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xrapnel 与爆炸后散落的金属碎片联系起来，再用 biċċa xrapnel 记住“一块弹片”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tiny glowing particle produced by fire, friction, or an electrical discharge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由燃烧、摩擦或放电产生的微小发光颗粒，即火花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frak żgħir jixgħel li joħroġ min-nar, mill-frizzjoni jew minn skarika elettrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火花；燃烧、摩擦或放电时出现的微小亮点。

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, dehret xrara elettrika bejn iż-żewġ kuntatti.
formal.en: During the experiment, an electrical spark appeared between the two contacts.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，两个触点之间出现了一道电火花。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dik ix-xrara ħierġa min-nar? Mark: Iva, kienet żgħira imma kienet tiddi ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that spark coming out of the fire? Mark: Yes, it was small but very bright.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见火里迸出的那点火花了吗？马克：看见了，虽然很小，却特别亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见火里迸出的那点火花了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that spark coming out of the fire?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet żgħira imma kienet tiddi ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet żgħira imma kienet tiddi ħafna.
messages.zh: 看见了，虽然很小，却特别亮。
messages.en: Yes, it was small but very bright.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象黑暗中突然闪过一小点亮光，用 xrara 给这点火花命名，突出“小而亮”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of drying up or becoming stale, depending on what is being described.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物逐渐变干、干涸，或食物逐渐失去新鲜度、变陈的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinxef jew titlef il-freskezza tagħha, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干涸、干燥或逐渐失去水分的过程。
变陈、失去新鲜度的过程，尤其指食物。

collocations.en: the drying out of the soil

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina x-xrif tal-ħamrija meta tonqos ix-xita.
formal.en: The study examines the drying out of the soil when rainfall decreases.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察了降雨减少时土壤逐渐变干的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħobż m'għadux frisk. Mark: Iva, ix-xrif tal-ħobż jidher sew meta nħalluh barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: This bread is no longer fresh. Mark: Yes, the bread becoming stale is quite noticeable when we leave it out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个面包已经不新鲜了。马克：是啊，放在外面时，面包变陈的情况很明显。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个面包已经不新鲜了。
messages.en: This bread is no longer fresh.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ix-xrif tal-ħobż jidher sew meta nħalluh barra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ix-xrif tal-ħobż jidher sew meta nħalluh barra.
messages.zh: 是啊，放在外面时，面包变陈的情况很明显。
messages.en: Yes, the bread becoming stale is quite noticeable when we leave it out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 xrif：泥土失水变干，面包放久变陈；两种意思都强调逐渐发生的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of cutting something along its length.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 顺着物体的长度方向进行切割的动作，即纵切。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li taqta' xi ħaġa fid-direzzjoni tat-tul tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纵向切割；沿物体长度方向切开的动作。

formal.mt: Ix-xriħ tad-drapp għandu jsir tul il-linja mmarkata, fid-direzzjoni tat-tul tiegħu.
formal.en: The lengthwise cutting of the fabric should follow the marked line along its length.
formal.zh: 布料的纵向裁切应沿标出的线进行，方向与布料的长度方向一致。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu x-xriħ? Mark: Huwa meta taqta' xi ħaġa mit-tul, bħal din il-biċċa drapp.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does xriħ mean? Mark: It's when you cut something lengthwise, like this piece of fabric.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：xriħ 是什么意思？马克：就是沿长度方向切开东西，比如这块布。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: xriħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does xriħ mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa meta taqta' xi ħaġa mit-tul, bħal din il-biċċa drapp.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa meta taqta' xi ħaġa mit-tul, bħal din il-biċċa drapp.
messages.zh: 就是沿长度方向切开东西，比如这块布。
messages.en: It's when you cut something lengthwise, like this piece of fabric.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在长条布料上画一根顺着长边的箭头，再沿箭头想象裁开，把这一动作记作 xriħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thick, sweet liquid used to flavor drinks or food, or as a preparation for medicine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种黏稠的甜液体，可用于给饮料或食物调味，也可作为糖浆剂形式的药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likwidu ħelu u magħqud li jintuża biex jagħti togħma lix-xorb jew lill-ikel, jew bħala preparazzjoni ta' mediċina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 糖浆；黏稠的甜液体，也可指糖浆剂形式的药物。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob żewġ mgħaref xropp tal-lumi, li jitħalltu mal-ilma qabel ma jiġi servut ix-xorb.
formal.en: The recipe calls for two spoonfuls of lemon syrup, mixed with water before the drink is served.
formal.zh: 食谱要求加入两勺柠檬糖浆，与水混合后再端上饮料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit xropp tal-lumi mal-ilma? Mark: Iva, imma ftit biss. Ma rridux ħelu wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some lemon syrup in your water? Mark: Yes, but just a little. I don't want it too sweet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的水里要加一点柠檬糖浆吗？马克：要，不过一点点就好。我不想喝太甜的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的水里要加一点柠檬糖浆吗？
messages.en: Would you like some lemon syrup in your water?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ftit biss. Ma rridux ħelu wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ftit biss. Ma rridux ħelu wisq.
messages.zh: 要，不过一点点就好。我不想喝太甜的。
messages.en: Yes, but just a little. I don't want it too sweet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象勺子里缓缓流下的黏甜液体，把 xropp 与“糖浆”配对，再联记柠檬糖浆和止咳糖浆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being rough to the touch or harsh in sound, manner, or treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 触感粗糙，或声音、态度及待人方式粗厉、严厉的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa ħarxa fil-mess, fil-ħoss jew fil-mod kif wieħed jittratta lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗糙；粗厉；严厉。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi x-xrufija tal-wiċċ tal-ġebla qabel ma ġiet illustrata.
formal.en: The report describes the roughness of the stone's surface before it was polished.
formal.zh: 报告描述了石材抛光前表面的粗糙状况。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed tilbes l-ingwanti? Pawlu: Minħabba x-xrufija tal-injam; ma rridx inweġġa' jdejja.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you wearing gloves? Pawlu: Because of the roughness of the wood; I don't want to hurt my hands.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么戴手套？保罗：因为木头很粗糙，我不想弄伤手。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么戴手套？
messages.en: Why are you wearing gloves?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba x-xrufija tal-injam; ma rridx inweġġa' jdejja.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba x-xrufija tal-injam; ma rridx inweġġa' jdejja.
messages.zh: 因为木头很粗糙，我不想弄伤手。
messages.en: Because of the roughness of the wood; I don't want to hurt my hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把粗糙木板和刺耳语气放在同一画面里：一个磨手，一个刺耳，都可用这个名词记住“粗厉感”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of chewing or rumination; also, a period of careful thought about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咀嚼或反刍的行为；也指围绕某件事进行的一番仔细思考。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jintmagħad l-ikel jew li annimal jerġa' jomgħod ikel li jkun bela'; ukoll, ħsieb bir-reqqa fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次咀嚼；反刍，即将已吞下的食物返回口中再次咀嚼。
一番思考；沉思；对某事的反省。

formal.mt: Wara xtarra twila dwar il-proposta, il-kumitat iddeċieda li jitlob aktar tagħrif.
formal.en: After lengthy reflection on the proposal, the committee decided to request more information.
formal.zh: 经过对提案的长时间思考，委员会决定索取更多资料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se taċċetta l-offerta? Mark: Wara xtarra tajba, naħseb li se naċċettaha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to accept the offer? Mark: After giving it a good deal of thought, I think I'll accept it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你会接受这份邀约吗？马克：仔细想了一番之后，我想我会接受。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会接受这份邀约吗？
messages.en: Are you going to accept the offer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara xtarra tajba, naħseb li se naċċettaha.
messages.mt_standard: Wara xtarra tajba, naħseb li se naċċettaha.
messages.zh: 仔细想了一番之后，我想我会接受。
messages.en: After giving it a good deal of thought, I think I'll accept it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“嘴里慢慢嚼，脑中慢慢想”的双画面记忆，分别对应咀嚼反刍和仔细思考；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be constipated, having difficulty passing stools.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现便秘，即排便困难或排便不畅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed ikollu stitikezza, jiġifieri diffikultà biex jagħmel il-bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 便秘；排便困难。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent qal lit-tabib li xtedd għal diversi jiem wara l-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The patient told the doctor that he had been constipated for several days after the journey.
formal.zh: 患者告诉医生，他在旅程结束后便秘了好几天。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ħija għandu appuntament mat-tabib? Omm: Għax xtedd għal tlett ijiem u jrid ikellmu dwar dan.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does my brother have a doctor's appointment? Mum: Because he's been constipated for three days and wants to discuss it with the doctor.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：哥哥为什么预约了看医生？妈妈：因为他便秘三天了，想和医生谈谈这件事。

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.zh: 哥哥为什么预约了看医生？
messages.en: Why does my brother have a doctor's appointment?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xtedd għal tlett ijiem u jrid ikellmu dwar dan.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xtedd għal tlett ijiem u jrid ikellmu dwar dan.
messages.zh: 因为他便秘三天了，想和医生谈谈这件事。
messages.en: Because he's been constipated for three days and wants to discuss it with the doctor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历连续几天画着排便困难的标记，把这个动词直接连到“便秘”的身体状态来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become lit, or for a light, appliance, or other device to be switched or turned on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被点燃或亮起来；也指灯具、电器等被开启，进入工作状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tibda taqbad jew tixgħel, jew li apparat jibda jaħdem meta jinxtegħel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被点燃；亮起。
被打开开关；通电开启。
被开启；开始运行或发光。

formal.mt: Id-dawl xtegħel awtomatikament meta s-senser sab moviment fil-kuritur.
formal.en: The light switched on automatically when the sensor detected movement in the corridor.
formal.zh: 传感器检测到走廊里有移动时，灯自动亮了起来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kompjuter xtegħel? David: Iva, xtegħel, imma għadu qed jibda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the computer turn on? David: Yes, it turned on, but it's still starting up.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：电脑开机了吗？戴维：开了，不过还在启动。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 电脑开机了吗？
messages.en: Did the computer turn on?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xtegħel, imma għadu qed jibda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xtegħel, imma għadu qed jibda.
messages.zh: 开了，不过还在启动。
messages.en: Yes, it turned on, but it's still starting up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把火焰燃起、灯泡亮起、电脑开机排成三幅图，共同记住“从未亮或未运行变为开启”的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel desire or longing, including sexual desire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生想得到某物或做某事的渴望，也可指萌生性欲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iħoss xewqa għal xi ħaġa jew biex jagħmel xi ħaġa, inkluża xewqa sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生渴望或欲念；感到欲望，包括性欲。

formal.mt: Meta qara l-ittra tagħha, xteha jerġa' jaraha u jitkellem magħha.
formal.en: When he read her letter, he longed to see her again and speak with her.
formal.zh: 读到她的信时，他渴望再次见到她，与她交谈。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Mark daħal fil-ħanut tal-ħelu? Luqa: Ra l-kejk fil-vetrina u xteha jiekol xi ħaġa ħelwa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Mark go into the sweet shop? Luqa: He saw the cake in the window and felt like eating something sweet.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：马克为什么进了甜品店？卢卡：他看见橱窗里的蛋糕，就想吃点甜的。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么进了甜品店？
messages.en: Why did Mark go into the sweet shop?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ra l-kejk fil-vetrina u xteha jiekol xi ħaġa ħelwa.
messages.mt_standard: Ra l-kejk fil-vetrina u xteha jiekol xi ħaġa ħelwa.
messages.zh: 他看见橱窗里的蛋糕，就想吃点甜的。
messages.en: He saw the cake in the window and felt like eating something sweet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用看见甜点后心中冒出“好想吃”的情景记住欲望的产生；涉及人际语境时，再联系渴望或欲念。

gloss_zh: 被作为证言提出；被陈述

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be presented as evidence or expressed as a statement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项内容被作为证言或证据提出，或被明确陈述出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tingħad jew titressaq bħala xhieda, jew li tiġi ddikjarata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被作为证言或证据提出。
被陈述；被说出或声明。

collocations.en: was given in evidence in court
collocations.zh: 在法庭上被作为证言提出

collocations.en: it was stated that the door was closed

formal.mt: Matul is-seduta xtehed li l-bieb kien magħluq meta waslu l-pulizija.
formal.en: During the hearing, it was given in evidence that the door was closed when the police arrived.
formal.zh: 庭审期间，有证言指出，警方到达时门是关着的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi ntqal fil-qorti dwar il-bieb? Pietru: Xtehed li kien magħluq meta waslu l-pulizija.
colloquial.en: Nina: What was said in court about the door? Pietru: It was stated in evidence that it was closed when the police arrived.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：法庭上对那扇门是怎么说的？彼得：证言说，警方到达时门是关着的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 法庭上对那扇门是怎么说的？
messages.en: What was said in court about the door?

messages.speaker: Pietru (旁听者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xtehed li kien magħluq meta waslu l-pulizija.
messages.mt_standard: Xtehed li kien magħluq meta waslu l-pulizija.
messages.zh: 证言说，警方到达时门是关着的。
messages.en: It was stated in evidence that it was closed when the police arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象法庭记录纸上写下一句话：这句话“被作为证言提出”，也就是某项内容“被陈述”了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For information or knowledge to be communicated or passed on to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信息或知识被传达给他人，或被传授出去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħrif jew għarfien jitwassal lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被传达；被告知；知识等被传授。

collocations.en: the information was imparted to the students
the knowledge was imparted during the training
collocations.zh: 知识在培训期间得到传授

formal.mt: It-tagħrif dwar il-proċedura xteher lill-parteċipanti matul il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The information about the procedure was imparted to the participants during the meeting.
formal.zh: 会议期间，有关程序的信息被传达给与会者。

colloquial.mt: Rita: It-tagħrif il-ġdid wasal għand kulħadd? Toni: Iva, xteher lill-grupp kollu waqt il-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did everyone receive the new information? Toni: Yes, it was communicated to the whole group during the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：大家都收到新信息了吗？托尼：收到了，开会时已经传达给全组了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 大家都收到新信息了吗？
messages.en: Did everyone receive the new information?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xteher lill-grupp kollu waqt il-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xteher lill-grupp kollu waqt il-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 收到了，开会时已经传达给全组了。
messages.en: Yes, it was communicated to the whole group during the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份知识从讲解者手中传到学习者手中，始终从信息的角度记住“被传达、被传授”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become scattered or dispersed over an area instead of remaining together in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原本集中在一起的东西或人散开，分布到不同位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa jew grupp jinfirex f'postijiet differenti minflok jibqa' miġbur f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散落；散布开来。
分散；散开；消散。

collocations.en: the rice scattered across the floor

formal.mt: Wara t-tmiem tal-attività, il-grupp xtered u l-parteċipanti telqu f'direzzjonijiet differenti.
formal.en: After the activity ended, the group dispersed and the participants left in different directions.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，人群散开，参与者朝不同方向离去。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'ġara fil-kċina? Ġanni: Waqgħet il-borża u r-ross xtered mal-art kollha.
colloquial.en: Elena: What happened in the kitchen? Ġanni: The bag fell and the rice scattered all over the floor.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：厨房里发生什么了？詹尼：袋子掉了，米撒了一地。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.zh: 厨房里发生什么了？
messages.en: What happened in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqgħet il-borża u r-ross xtered mal-art kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Waqgħet il-borża u r-ross xtered mal-art kollha.
messages.zh: 袋子掉了，米撒了一地。
messages.en: The bag fell and the rice scattered all over the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一袋米撒向地面的画面与活动结束后人群散开的画面并排记忆，抓住“从集中变为分散”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cooked by grilling, or to become scorched by strong heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到烘烤而熟，或因热力过强而焦灼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissajjar fuq il-gradilja, jew jinħaraq fil-wiċċ minħabba sħana qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放在烤架上烤制。
被强热烤焦或灼伤表面。

collocations.en: the fish was grilled on the grill
the bread was scorched from too much heat

formal.mt: Il-ħut xtewa fuq il-gradilja u ġie servut mal-ħaxix.
formal.en: The fish was grilled and served with vegetables.
formal.zh: 鱼在烤架上烤熟后，配蔬菜上桌。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-ħobż xtewa żżejjed? Pawlu: Iva, ara kemm sar iswed minn taħt!
colloquial.en: Marta: Did the bread get scorched? Pawlu: Yes, look how black it is underneath!
colloquial.zh: Marta：面包是不是烤焦了？Pawlu：是啊，你看底下都黑成什么样了！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 面包是不是烤焦了？
messages.en: Did the bread get scorched?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm sar iswed minn taħt!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm sar iswed minn taħt!
messages.zh: 是啊，你看底下都黑成什么样了！
messages.en: Yes, look how black it is underneath!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烤架上的鱼：火候合适是被烤熟，火太猛则被烤焦，用同一幅画面记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To resemble one another, with the similarity understood as mutual.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彼此相像，强调双方或各方之间相互具有相似之处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikunu jixbhu lil xulxin fid-dehra jew f'xi karatteristika.

sense_translations.en_definition: resemble one another (used in a mutual sense: to resemble one another)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 彼此相像；以相互意义表示双方或各方互相相似。

formal.mt: Il-verb 'xtiebah' jesprimi xebh reċiproku, bħal dak bejn żewġ aħwa li għandhom dehra simili.
formal.en: The verb 'xtiebah' expresses mutual resemblance, such as that between two siblings who look similar.
formal.zh: 动词 xtiebah 表示彼此相像，例如两个外貌相似的兄弟姐妹之间的相像关系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'xtiebah'? Mark: Ifisser li tnejn jixbhu lil xulxin, bħal dawn iż-żewġ aħwa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'xtiebah' mean? Mark: It means that two people resemble each other, like these two siblings.
colloquial.zh: Lara：xtiebah 是什么意思？Mark：意思是两个人彼此相像，就像这两个兄弟姐妹。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: xtiebah 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'xtiebah' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tnejn jixbhu lil xulxin, bħal dawn iż-żewġ aħwa.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tnejn jixbhu lil xulxin, bħal dawn iż-żewġ aħwa.
messages.zh: 意思是两个人彼此相像，就像这两个兄弟姐妹。
messages.en: It means that two people resemble each other, like these two siblings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两张并排的人像，用双向箭头连接，提醒自己这里强调的是彼此相像的相互关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smaller through shrinking, or to become very thin when referring to a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积缩小或缩水；用于人时，表示变得非常消瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċkien fid-daqs; meta jingħad dwar persuna, isir irqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收缩；缩水；变得比原来小。
变得非常瘦；明显消瘦。

collocations.en: the fabric shrank in the wash

collocations.zh: 那个男人变得非常消瘦

formal.mt: Id-drapp xtorob wara li nħasel f'ilma sħun wisq.
formal.en: The fabric shrank after being washed in water that was too hot.
formal.zh: 布料用温度过高的水洗过之后缩水了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt lil Toni dan l-aħħar? Ben: Iva, xtorob ħafna; il-qmis qed tiġih wiesgħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you seen Toni lately? Ben: Yes, he has become very skinny; his shirt is loose on him.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你最近见过 Toni 吗？Ben：见过，他瘦了好多，衬衫穿着都宽松了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最近见过 Toni 吗？
messages.en: Have you seen Toni lately?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xtorob ħafna; il-qmis qed tiġih wiesgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xtorob ħafna; il-qmis qed tiġih wiesgħa.
messages.zh: 见过，他瘦了好多，衬衫穿着都宽松了。
messages.en: Yes, he has become very skinny; his shirt is loose on him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把缩水的布料和瘦得衣服宽松的人并排想象，两个意思都可通过原来饱满、后来缩小来记。

gloss_zh: 不规整的角；尤指建筑物的不规则转角

teaching_sense.en_definition: Uneven or irregular angles, especially those found in buildings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不均整、不规则的角，尤其指建筑物结构中的不规整转角。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Angoli mhux regolari, speċjalment fil-bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不均整或不规则的角，尤用于描述建筑物的转角。

formal.mt: Il-perit kejjel ix-xtur tal-bini qabel ma ħejja l-pjanta.
formal.en: The architect measured the building's irregular angles before preparing the plan.
formal.zh: 建筑师在绘制平面图之前，测量了建筑物的不规则转角。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex l-armarju ma joqgħodx sew hawn? Ġanni: Minħabba x-xtur fil-ħitan; din il-kamra mhix rettangolari.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why doesn't the wardrobe fit properly here? Ġanni: Because of the irregular angles in the walls; this room isn't rectangular.
colloquial.zh: Sara：衣柜为什么放在这里不合适？Ġanni：因为墙的转角不规整，这个房间不是长方形的。

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-armarju ma joqgħodx sew hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-armarju ma joqgħodx sew hawn?
messages.zh: 衣柜为什么放在这里不合适？
messages.en: Why doesn't the wardrobe fit properly here?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (木工)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba x-xtur fil-ħitan; din il-kamra mhix rettangolari.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba x-xtur fil-ħitan; din il-kamra mhix rettangolari.
messages.zh: 因为墙的转角不规整，这个房间不是长方形的。
messages.en: Because of the irregular angles in the walls; this room isn't rectangular.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把方正衣柜推入歪斜的墙角却贴不严，用建筑转角不规整的画面记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，用于标识个人所属的家庭或家族。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika persuna jew familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏；家族姓。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Xuereb bagħat l-applikazzjoni tiegħu lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Mr Xuereb sent his application to the office.
formal.zh: Xuereb 先生向办公室提交了申请。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jisimha l-għalliema l-ġdida? Adam: Marija Xuereb; Marija huwa isimha u Xuereb huwa kunjomha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's the new teacher's name? Adam: Marija Xuereb; Marija is her first name and Xuereb is her surname.
colloquial.zh: Nina：新老师叫什么名字？Adam：Marija Xuereb；Marija 是她的名，Xuereb 是她的姓。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 新老师叫什么名字？
messages.en: What's the new teacher's name?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Marija Xuereb; Marija huwa isimha u Xuereb huwa kunjomha.
messages.mt_standard: Marija Xuereb; Marija huwa isimha u Xuereb huwa kunjomha.
messages.zh: Marija Xuereb；Marija 是她的名，Xuereb 是她的姓。
messages.en: Marija Xuereb; Marija is her first name and Xuereb is her surname.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象姓名表上名与姓两个格子，把 Xuereb 放进姓氏格，并记住作为姓名使用时首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Absorbent paper used to soak up excess ink from writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于吸收书写后多余墨水的吸水性纸张。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karta li tassorbi l-linka żejda mill-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸墨纸，用于吸去纸面上多余的墨水。

collocations.en: absorb the ink with blotting paper

formal.mt: Wara li kiteb bl-linka, uża biċċa xuga biex jassorbi l-linka żejda.
formal.en: After writing in ink, he used a piece of blotting paper to absorb the excess ink.
formal.zh: 用墨水书写后，他用一片吸墨纸吸去了多余的墨水。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għad hemm ħafna linka mxarrba fuq il-karta. Leo: Hawn biċċa xuga; poġġiha bil-mod fuq il-linka.
colloquial.en: Rita: There's still a lot of wet ink on the paper. Leo: Here's a piece of blotting paper; place it gently over the ink.
colloquial.zh: Rita：纸上还有好多没干的墨水。Leo：这里有一片吸墨纸，轻轻盖在墨水上。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm ħafna linka mxarrba fuq il-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm ħafna linka mxarrba fuq il-karta.
messages.zh: 纸上还有好多没干的墨水。
messages.en: There's still a lot of wet ink on the paper.

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn biċċa xuga; poġġiha bil-mod fuq il-linka.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn biċċa xuga; poġġiha bil-mod fuq il-linka.
messages.zh: 这里有一片吸墨纸，轻轻盖在墨水上。
messages.en: Here's a piece of blotting paper; place it gently over the ink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张纸像小海绵一样吸走湿墨，看到 xuga 就联想到专门吸墨的纸。

gloss_zh: 令人震惊的事物；惊人之事

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that causes strong surprise or shock, such as an unexpected revelation or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人强烈惊讶或震惊的事物，例如出乎意料的揭露或事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li taħsad jew tissorprendi ħafna, bħal aħbar jew ġrajja mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人震惊的人、事或消息；使人大吃一惊的事物。

collocations.zh: 一件令人极为震惊的事

formal.mt: It-tmiem tar-rumanz huwa xukkjatur għall-qarrej, għax jikxef min kien il-ħati.
formal.en: The novel's ending is a shocker for the reader because it reveals who the culprit was.
formal.zh: 小说结尾揭示了罪魁祸首的身份，令读者大为震惊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak it-tmiem kien xukkjatur! Karl: Veru, qatt ma stennejt li kien ħuha.
colloquial.en: Maja: That ending was a shocker! Karl: It really was; I never expected it to be her brother.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个结局太惊人了！Karl：真是，我完全没想到会是她哥哥。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个结局太惊人了！
messages.en: That ending was a shocker!

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, qatt ma stennejt li kien ħuha.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, qatt ma stennejt li kien ħuha.
messages.zh: 真是，我完全没想到会是她哥哥。
messages.en: It really was; I never expected it to be her brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说最后一页突然揭开真凶，令你惊得合不上书；把这个词和造成震惊的事物联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden experience of strong surprise or distress caused by something unexpected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因突如其来的事情而产生的强烈惊讶、不安或心理冲击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skoss qawwi ta' sorpriża jew niket minħabba xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 震惊；突如其来的冲击。

formal.mt: L-aħbar tal-għeluq tal-fabbrika kienet xukkjatura kbira għall-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The news of the factory's closure was a great shock to the workers.
formal.zh: 工厂关闭的消息给工人们带来了巨大的冲击。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif ħadtha l-aħbar? David: Kienet xukkjatura kbira; għadni qed nipprova nifhem x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Elena: How did you take the news? David: It was a great shock; I'm still trying to understand what happened.
colloquial.zh: Elena：听到这个消息，你感觉怎么样？David：太震惊了，我还在努力弄明白发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到这个消息，你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did you take the news?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet xukkjatura kbira; għadni qed nipprova nifhem x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet xukkjatura kbira; għadni qed nipprova nifhem x'ġara.
messages.zh: 太震惊了，我还在努力弄明白发生了什么。
messages.en: It was a great shock; I'm still trying to understand what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到意外消息后愣在原地，心里像受到一下冲击，用这种震惊的感受记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small animal with spines on its back that can curl into a ball.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种背部有刺、能够蜷成球状的小动物，即刺猬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir bix-xewk fuq dahru li jista' jingħalaq f'ballun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺猬。

collocations.en: a hedgehog with spines on its back

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-ġnien, it-tfal raw xummiemu miexi ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: While observing the garden, the children saw a hedgehog walking beside the wall.
formal.zh: 孩子们观察花园时，看见一只刺猬沿着墙边行走。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm xummiemu ħdejn il-bieb! Mark: Rajtu. Ejja nħalluh jgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a hedgehog by the door! Mark: I see it. Let's let it pass.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，门边有只刺猬！Mark：我看见了。让它过去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，门边有只刺猬！
messages.en: Look, there's a hedgehog by the door!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见了。让它过去吧。
messages.en: I see it. Let's let it pass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和花园墙边蜷成小刺球的刺猬画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who fires a gun, for example in a shooting competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行射击的人，例如参加射击比赛的射手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tispara b'arma tan-nar, pereżempju f'kompetizzjoni tal-isparar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 射手；进行射击的人。

formal.mt: Kull xuter għandu jsegwi r-regoli tas-sigurtà waqt il-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: Every shooter must follow the safety rules during the competition.
formal.zh: 每位射手都必须在比赛期间遵守安全规则。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak ix-xuter ħdejn il-kowċ? David: Dak ħija. Illum qed jieħu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that shooter next to the coach? David: That's my brother. He's taking part in the competition today.
colloquial.zh: Sara：教练旁边的那位射手是谁？David：那是我哥哥。他今天来参加比赛。

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ix-xuter ħdejn il-kowċ?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ix-xuter ħdejn il-kowċ?
messages.zh: 教练旁边的那位射手是谁？
messages.en: Who is that shooter next to the coach?

messages.speaker: David (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ħija. Illum qed jieħu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ħija. Illum qed jieħu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni.
messages.zh: 那是我哥哥。他今天来参加比赛。
messages.en: That's my brother. He's taking part in the competition today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想射击赛场上瞄准靶心的选手，用人物画面记住射手义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A player who shoots the ball towards the goal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把球射向球门的球员，即射门者或射手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Plejer li jixxuttja l-ballun lejn il-lasta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 射手；在球类运动语境中指射门或出手的球员。

formal.mt: Ix-xuttjatur bagħat il-ballun lejn il-lasta, iżda l-gowler salva x-xutt.
formal.en: The shooter sent the ball towards the goal, but the goalkeeper saved the shot.
formal.zh: 射门球员把球踢向球门，但守门员扑出了这次射门。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min kien ix-xuttjatur ta' dak ix-xutt? Ben: Kien Mark, in-numru għaxra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who took that shot? Ben: It was Mark, number ten.
colloquial.zh: Lara：刚才那脚是谁射的？Ben：是十号球员Mark。

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kien ix-xuttjatur ta' dak ix-xutt?
messages.mt_standard: Min kien ix-xuttjatur ta' dak ix-xutt?
messages.zh: 刚才那脚是谁射的？
messages.en: Who took that shot?

messages.speaker: Ben (球迷)
messages.zh: 是十号球员Mark。
messages.en: It was Mark, number ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词贴在足球射门者的画面上，记住动作执行者这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small devil; the diminutive form of xitan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小魔鬼；这是 xitan 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xitan żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' xitan.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small devil (the diminutive form of 'xitan')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小魔鬼，即 xitan 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a little devil in the fairy tale

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, xwajten imqareb ħeba ċ-ċavetta biex iħawwad lir-raħħal.
formal.en: In the fairy tale, a mischievous little devil hid the key to confuse the farmer.
formal.zh: 童话中，一个淘气的小魔鬼把钥匙藏起来，让农夫摸不着头脑。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak il-karattru aħmar fl-istampa? Omm: Dak xwajten li jagħmel il-praspar fil-ħrafa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is that red character in the picture? Mum: That's a little devil who plays tricks in the fairy tale.
colloquial.zh: Nina：图里那个红色角色是谁？妈妈：那是童话里爱恶作剧的小魔鬼。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak il-karattru aħmar fl-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak il-karattru aħmar fl-istampa?
messages.zh: 图里那个红色角色是谁？
messages.en: Who is that red character in the picture?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak xwajten li jagħmel il-praspar fil-ħrafa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak xwajten li jagħmel il-praspar fil-ħrafa.
messages.zh: 那是童话里爱恶作剧的小魔鬼。
messages.en: That's a little devil who plays tricks in the fairy tale.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把童话里的魔鬼缩小成掌心大小，借此记住小魔鬼的指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sharp points on a plant; also eager suspense, especially in the expression fuq ix-xwiek.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物上的尖刺或荆棘；也可表示急切等待、悬心期待的状态，尤其用于 fuq ix-xwiek。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ponot iebsin u bil-ponta fuq pjanta; ukoll ħerqa kbira waqt stennija, speċjalment fl-espressjoni fuq ix-xwiek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物上的刺；荆棘。
急切期待、悬心等待的状态；如坐针毡般盼着消息。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar libes l-ingwanti biex jipproteġi jdejh mix-xwiek tal-ward.
formal.en: The gardener wore gloves to protect his hands from the rose thorns.
formal.zh: 园丁戴上手套，以免双手被玫瑰的刺扎伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tistenna r-riżultat? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fuq ix-xwiek biex inkun naf jekk għaddejtx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still waiting for the result? Mark: Yes, I'm on tenterhooks to find out whether I passed.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还在等结果吗？Mark：是啊，我正心急地等着知道自己有没有通过。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你还在等结果吗？
messages.en: Are you still waiting for the result?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq ix-xwiek biex inkun naf jekk għaddejtx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq ix-xwiek biex inkun naf jekk għaddejtx.
messages.zh: 是啊，我正心急地等着知道自己有没有通过。
messages.en: Yes, I'm on tenterhooks to find out whether I passed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记玫瑰尖刺，再用坐在刺上等结果的教学画面记住急切等待义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat enough to satisfy one's hunger and feel full.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进食到饥饿得到满足、自己感到饱足。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol biżżejjed biex jaqta' l-ġuħ u jħossu mimli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己饱足；吃到满足。

collocations.en: he filled himself up with soup
he filled himself up with bread

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, Pawlu xxabba' b'ikla sħuna.
formal.en: After the long walk, Pawlu satisfied his hunger with a hot meal.
formal.zh: 长途步行后，Pawlu 吃了一顿热饭，填饱了肚子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Pawlu xxabba' bis-soppa? Marija: Iva, u ma jridx aktar ħobż.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did Pawlu fill himself up with soup? Marija: Yes, and he doesn't want any more bread.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Pawlu 喝汤喝饱了吗？Marija：是啊，他也不想再吃面包了。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: Pawlu 喝汤喝饱了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu fill himself up with soup?

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ma jridx aktar ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ma jridx aktar ħobż.
messages.zh: 是啊，他也不想再吃面包了。
messages.en: Yes, and he doesn't want any more bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象喝完一碗热汤后摸摸肚子说吃饱了，突出自己得到饱足。

gloss_zh: 咒骂时提及魔鬼；被魔鬼附身；变得邪恶

teaching_sense.en_definition: To curse by invoking the devil, to become possessed, or to become evil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指咒骂时呼唤魔鬼，也可指被魔鬼附身或变得邪恶；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tisħet billi ssemmi x-xitan, tinħakem mix-xitan, jew issir ħażin.

sense_translations.en_definition: to indulge in cursing by invoking the devil
sense_translations.zh_definition: 肆意咒骂，并在咒骂中呼唤魔鬼
被附身，通常指被魔鬼或邪灵附身
变得邪恶；变得恶毒

collocations.en: he began invoking the devil and cursing
collocations.zh: 他开始呼唤魔鬼并咒骂

collocations.en: he became evil and turned cruel

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel xxajtan u beda jhedded lil dawk ta' madwaru.
formal.en: In the story, the man became evil and began threatening those around him.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个男人变得邪恶，开始威胁身边的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-karattru meta tilef il-logħba? Toni: Xxajtan u beda jisħet u jsemmi x-xitan.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the character do when he lost the game? Toni: He started cursing and invoking the devil.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个角色输掉比赛后做了什么？托尼：他开始咒骂，嘴里还提着魔鬼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个角色输掉比赛后做了什么？
messages.en: What did the character do when he lost the game?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxajtan u beda jisħet u jsemmi x-xitan.
messages.mt_standard: Xxajtan u beda jisħet u jsemmi x-xitan.
messages.zh: 他开始咒骂，嘴里还提着魔鬼。
messages.en: He started cursing and invoking the devil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项画成三格故事：开口咒骂、故事中被附身、性情变邪恶；用语境判断是哪一格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wash something with water to remove soap, dirt, or other residue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水冲洗物品，去除肥皂、污物或其他残留。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi l-ilma fuq xi ħaġa biex tneħħi s-sapun, il-ħmieġ jew fdalijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用水冲洗；漂洗，去除残留物

formal.mt: Il-kok xxakkwa l-ħaxix b'ilma nadif qabel ma beda jipprepara l-ikla.
formal.en: The cook rinsed the vegetables with clean water before preparing the meal.
formal.zh: 厨师开始做饭前，用清水冲洗了蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad hemm is-sapun f'din it-tazza? Mark: Le, Pawlu xxakkwa t-tazza darbtejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there still soap in this cup? Mark: No, Pawlu rinsed the cup twice.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个杯子里还有洗涤剂吗？马克：没有，保罗已经冲洗了两遍。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这个杯子里还有洗涤剂吗？
messages.en: Is there still soap in this cup?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 没有，保罗已经冲洗了两遍。
messages.en: No, Pawlu rinsed the cup twice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象杯壁还挂着泡沫，再用清水冲两遍；把这个词与去除残留的冲洗动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unrestrained enjoyment, or indulgence that involves a lack of moral restraint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 毫无拘束地尽情享乐；也可带贬义，指缺乏道德约束的放纵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgawdija bla rażan; jista' jfisser ukoll imġiba mingħajr rażan morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纵情享乐；毫无拘束地尽兴
放荡；缺乏道德约束的纵欲行为

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi ħajja ta' xxalar li fiha l-pjaċir jieħu post kull responsabbiltà.
formal.en: The author describes a life of licentious indulgence in which pleasure replaces every responsibility.
formal.zh: 作者描写了一种放荡无度的生活，其中享乐取代了一切责任。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kienet il-festa lbieraħ? Nina: Kienet lejla ta' xxalar: żfin, kant u daħk sa tard!
colloquial.en: Sara: How was the party yesterday? Nina: It was an evening of letting loose: dancing, singing, and laughing until late!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：昨天的派对怎么样？妮娜：大家尽情玩了一晚，跳舞、唱歌，一直笑闹到很晚！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的派对怎么样？
messages.en: How was the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet lejla ta' xxalar: żfin, kant u daħk sa tard!
messages.mt_standard: Kienet lejla ta' xxalar: żfin, kant u daħk sa tard!
messages.zh: 大家尽情玩了一晚，跳舞、唱歌，一直笑闹到很晚！
messages.en: It was an evening of letting loose: dancing, singing, and laughing until late!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一条享乐程度尺记忆：尽情玩乐是一端，放荡无度是另一端；这是名词，要结合语气判断褒贬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a coating of wax or become covered with wax.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体被涂上一层蜡，或表面被蜡覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata kisja tax-xama' jew jitgħatta bix-xama'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被上蜡；被涂蜡处理
被蜡覆盖；表面沾满蜡

collocations.en: the candlestick became covered with wax

formal.mt: Waqt ir-restawr, il-wiċċ tal-injam xxamma' b'saff irqiq ta' xama'.
formal.en: During restoration, the wooden surface was coated with a thin layer of wax.
formal.zh: 修复过程中，木质表面被涂上了一层薄蜡。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex il-gandlier kollu abjad? Ġanni: Xxamma' għax ix-xama' niżlet mix-xemgħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is the candlestick all white? Ġanni: It became covered with wax because wax dripped down from the candle.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：烛台怎么全白了？詹尼：蜡从蜡烛上滴下来，把烛台覆盖住了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 烛台怎么全白了？
messages.en: Why is the candlestick all white?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.zh: 蜡从蜡烛上滴下来，把烛台覆盖住了。
messages.en: It became covered with wax because wax dripped down from the candle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木面被上一层薄蜡，再想象烛台沾满滴蜡；两个画面都把被蜡覆盖的物体放在中心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be examined by someone or an animal sniffing at it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物被人或动物通过凑近嗅闻来察看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi eżaminat minn persuna jew annimal li jxommu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被凑近嗅闻；被闻一闻

collocations.en: the package was sniffed at by the dog
the food was sniffed at before being eaten
collocations.zh: 食物在被吃掉前被闻了闻

formal.mt: Waqt il-kontroll, il-pakkett xxammam minn kelb imħarreġ qabel ma nfetaħ.
formal.en: During the inspection, the package was sniffed at by a trained dog before it was opened.
formal.zh: 检查时，包裹在打开前先由一只受过训练的狗嗅闻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb fetaħ il-pakkett? Toni: Le, il-pakkett xxammam biss; għadu magħluq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the dog open the package? Toni: No, the package was only sniffed at; it is still closed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：狗把包裹打开了吗？托尼：没有，包裹只是被闻了闻，还封着呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗把包裹打开了吗？
messages.en: Did the dog open the package?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-pakkett xxammam biss; għadu magħluq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-pakkett xxammam biss; għadu magħluq.
messages.zh: 没有，包裹只是被闻了闻，还封着呢。
messages.en: No, the package was only sniffed at; it is still closed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象包裹放着不动，小狗凑近鼻子闻；记忆焦点放在包裹被闻，而不是小狗主动去闻。

gloss_zh: 被卷起；被向后翻卷；向后弯曲

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be rolled up, rolled back, or curved back, especially at an edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体或其边缘被卷起、向后翻卷，或向后弯曲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgerbeb 'il fuq jew lura, jew jitgħawweġ lura, speċjalment fit-tarf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被卷起；被卷拢
被向后卷起；被翻卷回去
向后弯曲；被弯折回去

collocations.en: the edge of the fabric was rolled up
the edge of the rug curled back

formal.mt: It-tarf tad-drapp xxammar lura sabiex tidher il-ħjata ta' taħtu.
formal.en: The edge of the fabric was rolled back so that the stitching underneath could be seen.
formal.zh: 布料边缘被向后翻卷，以便看清下面的缝线。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ix-xifer tat-tapit xxammar u kważi waqajt! Mark: Mela niddrittawh qabel jgħaddi xi ħadd ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: The edge of the rug curled back and I almost fell! Mark: Then let's straighten it before someone else walks past.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：地毯边卷起来了，我差点摔倒！马克：那我们赶快把它弄平，免得别人经过时也绊到。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xifer tat-tapit xxammar u kważi waqajt!
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xifer tat-tapit xxammar u kważi waqajt!
messages.zh: 地毯边卷起来了，我差点摔倒！
messages.en: The edge of the rug curled back and I almost fell!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela niddrittawh qabel jgħaddi xi ħadd ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Mela niddrittawh qabel jgħaddi xi ħadd ieħor.
messages.zh: 那我们赶快把它弄平，免得别人经过时也绊到。
messages.en: Then let's straighten it before someone else walks past.

cognitive_memory_aid: 拿纸边做三个动作来记：向上卷、向后翻卷、向后弯；共同画面是边缘离开原来的平面。

gloss_zh: 有充足空间；有地方舒展

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have enough or abundant room to sit, stay, or move comfortably.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有足够或宽裕的空间，可以舒适地坐着、待着或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollok biżżejjed spazju biex toqgħod jew tiċċaqlaq bil-kumdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有宽裕或足够的空间；有地方舒展开来

collocations.en: he had plenty of room in the large room
collocations.zh: 他在大房间里有充足空间

collocations.en: he had enough room in the back seat
collocations.zh: 他在后排座位上坐得宽裕

formal.mt: Fil-kamra l-ġdida, l-istudent xxampla sew u seta' jaħdem bil-kumdità.
formal.en: In the new room, the student had plenty of space and could work comfortably.
formal.zh: 在新房间里，这名学生有了充足空间，可以舒适地学习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Leo kien komdu fil-karozza? Pawlu: Iva, fis-sit ta' wara xxampla sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was Leo comfortable in the car? Pawlu: Yes, he had plenty of room in the back seat.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：利奥在车里坐得舒服吗？保罗：舒服，他在后排坐得很宽裕。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 利奥在车里坐得舒服吗？
messages.en: Was Leo comfortable in the car?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fis-sit ta' wara xxampla sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fis-sit ta' wara xxampla sew.
messages.zh: 舒服，他在后排坐得很宽裕。
messages.en: Yes, he had plenty of room in the back seat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐进宽敞的后排，双腿终于能舒展开；把这个词记作人有足够空间、待得舒适的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be transmitted to an audience by broadcasting, or to be publicized through advertising.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 节目、消息等被向公众播出，或产品、服务等通过广告得到宣传。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintbagħat lill-pubbliku permezz tar-radju jew it-televiżjoni, jew jiġi rreklamat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被广播；被播出
被刊登广告宣传；被推广

collocations.en: the programme was broadcast on the radio
the service was advertised in the newspaper
collocations.zh: 这项服务在报纸上刊登了广告

formal.mt: Il-programm edukattiv xxandar fuq it-televiżjoni nhar it-Tnejn filgħaxija.
formal.en: The educational programme was broadcast on television on Monday evening.
formal.zh: 这个教育节目于星期一晚上在电视上播出。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sirt taf bis-servizz il-ġdid? Mark: Xxandar fil-gazzetta, u qrajt l-avviż dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did you hear about the new service? Mark: It was advertised in the newspaper, and I read the notice this morning.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你是怎么知道这项新服务的？马克：报纸上登了广告，我今天早上读到了那则启事。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是怎么知道这项新服务的？
messages.en: How did you hear about the new service?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxandar fil-gazzetta, u qrajt l-avviż dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Xxandar fil-gazzetta, u qrajt l-avviż dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 报纸上登了广告，我今天早上读到了那则启事。
messages.en: It was advertised in the newspaper, and I read the notice this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一条消息出现在电视和报纸上：节目被播出，服务被广告宣传；共同点是信息被传给公众。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be dipped into a liquid or become thoroughly wet through soaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被浸入液体中，或因浸泡而充分湿透。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddaħħal f'likwidu jew jixxarrab sew billi jibqa' fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被浸入液体中。
被浸泡；被浸得湿透。
