collocations.en: was dipped or soaked in water
collocations.zh: 被浸入水中或被水浸透

collocations.en: was dipped or soaked in milk
collocations.zh: 被浸入牛奶中或被牛奶浸透

formal.mt: Id-drapp xxappap fl-ilma qabel ma ntuża biex jitnaddaf il-mejda.
formal.en: The cloth was soaked in water before it was used to clean the table.
formal.zh: 这块布先在水中浸湿，然后用来擦桌子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-gallettin sar artab? Mark: Għax xxappap fil-ħalib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has the biscuit gone soft? Mark: Because it was soaked in milk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：饼干怎么变软了？马克：因为它被牛奶泡过了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 饼干怎么变软了？
messages.en: Why has the biscuit gone soft?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为它被牛奶泡过了。
messages.en: Because it was soaked in milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饼干浸进牛奶后慢慢变软，把 xxappap 与“被浸入、被泡湿”的画面连起来记。

gloss_zh: 被弄得倾斜；受影响而倾向某种立场

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to lean physically towards something, or to be influenced towards a particular view or position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受外力作用而朝某物倾斜，或受影响而倾向某种观点或立场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jxaqleb lejn xi ħaġa, jew jiġi influwenzat biex jiffavorixxi fehma jew pożizzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to lean towards sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄得朝某物倾斜。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to incline towards a view or position
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受影响而倾向某种观点或立场。

collocations.en: was made to lean towards the wall
was influenced in favour of the proposal
collocations.zh: 受影响而倾向支持该提案

formal.mt: Wara li sema' l-argumenti tal-esperti, ir-rappreżentant xxaqleb favur il-proposta.
formal.en: After hearing the experts' arguments, the representative was swayed in favour of the proposal.
formal.zh: 听取专家的论证后，这位代表受其影响，倾向于支持该提案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-arblu xxaqleb lejn il-ħajt? Pawlu: Ir-riħ qawwi mbuttah f'dik id-direzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the pole tilt towards the wall? Pawlu: The strong wind pushed it in that direction.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：杆子怎么朝墙那边歪了？保罗：大风把它吹向那边了。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 杆子怎么朝墙那边歪了？
messages.en: Why did the pole tilt towards the wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 大风把它吹向那边了。
messages.en: The strong wind pushed it in that direction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxaqleb 想成“受到推动后偏向一边”：杆子偏向墙，人的看法也会偏向某个立场。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a crack or a number of cracks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体出现一道或多道裂纹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa xaqq wieħed jew aktar fuq wiċċu jew fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开裂；出现裂纹。

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ xxaqqaq minħabba l-bidla f'daqqa fit-temperatura.
formal.en: The glass cracked because of the sudden change in temperature.
formal.zh: 由于温度骤变，玻璃出现了裂纹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, il-ħġieġ xxaqqaq! Mark: Iva, hemm xaqq twil fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, the glass has cracked! Mark: Yes, there's a long crack in the middle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，玻璃裂了！马克：对，中间有一道长长的裂纹。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 看，玻璃裂了！
messages.en: Look, the glass has cracked!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 对，中间有一道长长的裂纹。
messages.en: Yes, there's a long crack in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 xxaqqaq 就想象玻璃中间出现一条裂纹，重点记“已经开裂”，不必想成完全碎掉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take pleasure in an experience or be amused by something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某种经历中感到愉快，或因某事而被逗乐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu gost b'esperjenza jew jiddeverti b'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 享受其中；感到愉快。
被逗乐；觉得有趣。

formal.mt: It-tifel xxaqqar bir-rakkont umoristiku u baqa' jitbissem sa tmiem il-qari.
formal.en: The boy was amused by the humorous story and kept smiling until the reading ended.
formal.zh: 男孩被这个幽默故事逗乐了，一直笑眯眯地听到朗读结束。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu ħa gost bl-ispettaklu? Nina: Iva, xxaqqar ħafna, speċjalment biċ-ċajt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu enjoy the show? Nina: Yes, he really enjoyed it, especially the jokes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗看演出开心吗？妮娜：开心，他看得很尽兴，尤其喜欢那些笑话。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗看演出开心吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu enjoy the show?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 开心，他看得很尽兴，尤其喜欢那些笑话。
messages.en: Yes, he really enjoyed it, especially the jokes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxaqqar 配上听笑话时露出笑容的画面：既可以是“享受其中”，也可以是“被逗乐”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be subjected to excessive work or, of land, to be worked with a harrow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因工作过多而劳累过度；也指土地受到耙耕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħejja ħafna minħabba xogħol żejjed jew, fil-każ tar-raba', jinħadem bix-xatba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被安排过多工作；劳累过度。
土地被耙耕。

collocations.zh: 因工作过多而劳累过度

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem xxattab minħabba s-sigħat twal tax-xogħol u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
formal.en: The worker was overworked because of the long working hours and needed to rest.
formal.zh: 这名工人因工作时间过长而劳累过度，需要休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu mar id-dar kmieni? Mark: Xxattab bix-xogħol illum u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu go home early? Mark: He was overworked today and needed to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么提前回家了？马克：他今天干活累过头了，需要休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么提前回家了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go home early?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxattab bix-xogħol illum u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Xxattab bix-xogħol illum u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他今天干活累过头了，需要休息。
messages.en: He was overworked today and needed to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用主语区分 xxattab 的两幅画面：人是工作过量而疲惫，土地则是经过耙耕；这是语境记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move out of proper alignment or become uneven or asymmetrical in shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偏离原本端正的位置，或形状变得不均衡、不对称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ mill-pożizzjoni dritta tiegħu jew jieħu forma li mhix simmetrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变歪；偏离端正的位置。
变得不对称。

formal.mt: Il-qafas xxattar waqt it-trasport, u għalhekk kellu jiġi aġġustat qabel l-installazzjoni.
formal.en: The frame went askew during transport and therefore had to be adjusted before installation.
formal.zh: 框架在运输途中变歪了，因此安装前必须进行调整。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-qafas xxattar? Nina: Iva, naħa minnu niżlet aktar mill-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the frame gone crooked? Nina: Yes, one side has dropped lower than the other.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：框架是不是歪了？妮娜：对，一边比另一边低了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 框架是不是歪了？
messages.en: Has the frame gone crooked?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naħa minnu niżlet aktar mill-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naħa minnu niżlet aktar mill-oħra.
messages.zh: 对，一边比另一边低了。
messages.en: Yes, one side has dropped lower than the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本端正的相框一边下沉，用 xxattar 记住“变歪”的变化，再联想到两边变得不对称。

gloss_zh: 被燎焦；被烤焦；皮肤发炎或受刺激

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be singed or scorched, or to have skin that becomes inflamed or irritated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被火或高温燎焦、烤焦，也可指皮肤发炎或受到刺激。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħaraq ħafif minn barra jew bis-sħana, jew ikollu l-ġilda infjammata jew irritata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被火焰或高温轻微燎焦，尤其指表面或毛发。
被高温烤焦或灼焦。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have inflamed or irritated skin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮肤发炎或受到刺激。

collocations.en: the bread was scorched in the oven
the skin on his face became inflamed or irritated
collocations.zh: 他脸上的皮肤发炎或受刺激了

formal.mt: Il-ħobż xxawwat fil-forn minħabba temperatura għolja wisq.
formal.en: The bread was scorched in the oven because the temperature was too high.
formal.zh: 由于温度过高，面包在烤箱里烤焦了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wiċċ Pawlu aħmar hekk? Mark: Wiċċu xxawwat wara li uża s-sapun il-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu's face so red? Mark: The skin on his face became irritated after he used the new soap.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗的脸怎么这么红？马克：他用了新肥皂后，脸上的皮肤受刺激了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗的脸怎么这么红？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu's face so red?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wiċċu xxawwat wara li uża s-sapun il-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Wiċċu xxawwat wara li uża s-sapun il-ġdid.
messages.zh: 他用了新肥皂后，脸上的皮肤受刺激了。
messages.en: The skin on his face became irritated after he used the new soap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xxawwat 配三张学习卡：毛发燎焦、面包烤焦、皮肤发红受刺激；用不同主语区分三个义项。

gloss_zh: 舒舒服服地安顿下来；在床上享受舒适；把自己裹进被窝

teaching_sense.en_definition: To settle into a cosy, comfortable position, especially by snuggling into bed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让自己舒舒服服地安顿下来，尤其指钻进被窝、享受床上的舒适。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħloq pożizzjoni komda għalih innifsu, speċjalment billi jidħol fis-sodda u jitgħatta sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让自己舒舒服服地安顿下来。
尽情享受舒适，尤指舒舒服服地躺在床上。
把自己安顿进床里、裹好被子。

collocations.zh: 他舒舒服服地钻进了被窝

collocations.en: he nestled comfortably under the blanket
collocations.zh: 他舒舒服服地裹在毯子里

collocations.en: he settled cosily on the sofa
collocations.zh: 他舒舒服服地窝在沙发上

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata twila, Pawlu xxaħxaħ fis-sodda taħt kutra sħuna u beda jaqra.
formal.en: After a long day, Pawlu snuggled into bed under a warm blanket and began to read.
formal.zh: 忙碌一天后，Pawlu 舒舒服服地钻进被窝，盖着暖和的毯子开始读书。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn mar Pawlu? Anna: Xxaħxaħ fuq is-sufan taħt il-kutra. Qed jara film.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did Pawlu go? Anna: He's settled cosily on the sofa under the blanket. He's watching a film.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 去哪儿了？Anna：他裹着毯子舒舒服服地窝在沙发上，正在看电影。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go?

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxaħxaħ fuq is-sufan taħt il-kutra. Qed jara film.
messages.mt_standard: Xxaħxaħ fuq is-sufan taħt il-kutra. Qed jara film.
messages.zh: 他裹着毯子舒舒服服地窝在沙发上，正在看电影。
messages.en: He's settled cosily on the sofa under the blanket. He's watching a film.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用钻进被窝、拉好被子、舒服躺着的连续画面串起三个相关义项。

gloss_zh: 使自己有所缺失；克扣自己的享用

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deny oneself something, such as comfort or enjoyment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让自己放弃或得不到某种东西，例如舒适或享受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaħħad lilu nnifsu minn xi ħaġa, bħal kumdità jew pjaċir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己失去某种享用或需要之物；克扣自己。

collocations.en: he deprived himself of some comforts
collocations.zh: 他舍弃了一些舒适享受

formal.mt: Għal diversi snin, Pawlu xxaħħat minn xi kumditajiet biex iħallas għall-istudji ta' ibnu.
formal.en: For several years, Pawlu deprived himself of some comforts to pay for his son's studies.
formal.zh: 几年来，Pawlu 舍弃了一些舒适享受，以支付儿子的学费。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu xxaħħat mill-vaganzi din is-sena? Ben: Ried ifaddal biex jixtri karozza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu deny himself a holiday this year? Ben: He wanted to save up to buy a car.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 今年为什么放弃度假？Ben：他想攒钱买车。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu xxaħħat mill-vaganzi din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu xxaħħat mill-vaganzi din is-sena?
messages.zh: Pawlu 今年为什么放弃度假？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu deny himself a holiday this year?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想攒钱买车。
messages.en: He wanted to save up to buy a car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象为了储蓄而划掉自己的度假计划，记住让自己少享用一些。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be likened to someone or something, or to be compared with them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因相似之处而被比作某人或某物，或被拿来与其比较。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mqabbel ma' xi ħadd jew ma' xi ħaġa, speċjalment biex jintwera xebh bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被比作某人或某物。
被拿来与某人或某物比较。

collocations.zh: 被拿来与他的兄弟比较

formal.mt: Fir-reċensjoni, il-poeta xxebbah ma' pittur minħabba l-mod kif iddeskriva l-pajsaġġ.
formal.en: In the review, the poet was likened to a painter because of the way he described the landscape.
formal.zh: 在这篇评论中，诗人因其描绘风景的方式而被比作一位画家。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark xxebbah ma' ħuh? Nina: Għax għandhom l-istess tbissima.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why was Mark compared with his brother? Nina: Because they have the same smile.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么大家把马克和他的兄弟作比较？妮娜：因为他们笑起来一个样。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么大家把马克和他的兄弟作比较？
messages.en: Why was Mark compared with his brother?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他们笑起来一个样。
messages.en: Because they have the same smile.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个人的照片并排放好，再想象有人指出相似处；用这个画面记 xxebbah 的“被比作、被比较”。

gloss_zh: 进入青春期；成为青少年

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter puberty or develop into an adolescent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入青春发育阶段，或由儿童成长为青少年。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jasal għall-pubertà jew jgħaddi mit-tfulija għall-adolexxenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进入青春期，达到青春发育阶段。
由儿童成长为青少年。

collocations.zh: 当他步入青少年阶段时

formal.mt: Meta xxebbeb, it-tifel beda juri interess akbar fl-indipendenza u fir-relazzjonijiet ma' sħabu.
formal.en: When the boy became an adolescent, he began to show greater interest in independence and relationships with his peers.
formal.zh: 这个男孩步入青少年阶段后，开始更加重视独立以及与同伴的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk għadu tifel żgħir? Lara: Le, issa xxebbeb u jrid jagħmel kollox waħdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother still a little boy? Lara: No, he's become an adolescent now and wants to do everything himself.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你弟弟还是个小孩子吗？Lara：不是了，他现在已经步入青少年阶段，什么都想自己做。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟还是个小孩子吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still a little boy?

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa xxebbeb u jrid jagħmel kollox waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa xxebbeb u jrid jagħmel kollox waħdu.
messages.zh: 不是了，他现在已经步入青少年阶段，什么都想自己做。
messages.en: No, he's become an adolescent now and wants to do everything himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上孩子走入青春期的成长画面，同时记住身体发育和成为青少年两层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become caught or entangled in a net.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被网缠住或困在网中，无法自由脱身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqabad jew jitħabbel f'xibka u ma jkunx jista' jinħeles faċilment.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be caught in a net
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被网捕住或缠住。

collocations.en: got caught in the fishing net
got caught in a net by his foot

formal.mt: Wara li xxebbek fix-xibka tas-sajd, l-għasfur inħeles bil-mod mingħajr ma weġġa'.
formal.en: After becoming caught in the fishing net, the bird was gently freed without being injured.
formal.zh: 这只鸟被渔网困住后，人们轻轻将它解救出来，没有使它受伤。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dak l-għasfur ma jistax itir? Rita: Għax xxebbek fix-xibka. Ejja nsejħu lil xi ħadd biex jgħinu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why can't that bird fly? Rita: Because it got caught in the net. Let's call someone to help it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：那只鸟为什么飞不起来？Rita：因为它被网缠住了。我们叫人来帮它吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dak l-għasfur ma jistax itir?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dak l-għasfur ma jistax itir?
messages.zh: 那只鸟为什么飞不起来？
messages.en: Why can't that bird fly?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xxebbek fix-xibka. Ejja nsejħu lil xi ħadd biex jgħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xxebbek fix-xibka. Ejja nsejħu lil xi ħadd biex jgħinu.
messages.zh: 因为它被网缠住了。我们叫人来帮它吧。
messages.en: Because it got caught in the net. Let's call someone to help it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只鸟的脚被网线缠住，把整个受困画面与这个动词一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 摊开身体躺着；沿表面蔓延

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sprawl with the body spread out, or to spread along a surface, especially of a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体舒展开来，随意摊躺；也指植物等沿某个表面伸展、蔓延。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtedd b'ġismu mifrux, jew jinfirex ma' wiċċ, speċjalment meta jkun pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舒展开身体，随意摊躺。

sense_translations.en_definition: to spread along a surface (especially of plants, such as wall-climbers)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿着某个表面伸展或蔓延，尤指攀墙植物等。

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, il-ġiżimin kiber u xxeblek mal-ħajt tal-bitħa.
formal.en: Over time, the jasmine grew and spread along the courtyard wall.
formal.zh: 随着时间推移，茉莉逐渐长大，沿着院墙蔓延开来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn mar Pawlu wara l-mixja? Mark: Daħal fis-salott u xxeblek fuq is-sufan. Għadu hemm!
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did Pawlu go after the walk? Mark: He went into the living room and sprawled on the sofa. He's still there!
colloquial.zh: Lara：散步后Pawlu去哪儿了？Mark：他进了客厅，摊躺在沙发上。现在还在那儿呢！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 散步后Pawlu去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go after the walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħal fis-salott u xxeblek fuq is-sufan. Għadu hemm!
messages.mt_standard: Daħal fis-salott u xxeblek fuq is-sufan. Għadu hemm!
messages.zh: 他进了客厅，摊躺在沙发上。现在还在那儿呢！
messages.en: He went into the living room and sprawled on the sofa. He's still there!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把沙发上摊开的四肢与墙上伸展的枝叶并排想象，两种意思都抓住向外铺展的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To push the lips forward in a pout; in fishing, to become caught on a hook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把嘴唇向前噘起，表现不满等情绪；在钓鱼语境中也指鱼被钩住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ xufftejh 'il barra biex juri dwejjaq jew nuqqas ta' qbil; fis-sajd, jinqabad b'sunnara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 噘起嘴唇，常用来表现不高兴或不满。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be hooked (used of fish in a fishing context)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 上钩，被鱼钩钩住，用于钓鱼语境中的鱼。

collocations.en: got caught on the fishing hook

formal.mt: Meta xxeffef mas-sunnara, il-paġell beda jiġbed il-linja.
formal.en: When the sea bream got hooked, it began pulling on the line.
formal.zh: 那条海鲷上钩后，开始拉扯钓线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħuk għamel dik il-wiċċata? Lara: Għax ma ħallejtux jieħu l-aħħar gallettina, u xxeffef.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did your brother make that face? Lara: Because I didn't let him take the last biscuit, and he pouted.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你弟弟为什么摆出那副表情？Lara：因为我没让他拿最后一块饼干，他就噘起嘴来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟为什么摆出那副表情？
messages.en: Why did your brother make that face?

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma ħallejtux jieħu l-aħħar gallettina, u xxeffef.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma ħallejtux jieħu l-aħħar gallettina, u xxeffef.
messages.zh: 因为我没让他拿最后一块饼干，他就噘起嘴来了。
messages.en: Because I didn't let him take the last biscuit, and he pouted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情景卡分别记忆：孩子噘嘴表示不满，水中的鱼被钩住；再靠上下文选择词义。

gloss_zh: 变老；被弄得显老或觉得衰老

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become aged, or to be made to grow or feel old.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得年老，或受到某种经历、负担等影响而衰老、感觉自己老了。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir xiħ, jew jitwassal minn xi esperjenza jew piż biex jixjieħ jew iħossu xiħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得年老，呈现衰老状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to grow or feel old
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被某种因素弄得衰老，或觉得自己变老了。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-missier xxejjaħ bl-inkwiet u beda jħossu għajjien il-ħin kollu.
formal.en: In the novel, the father was aged by worry and began to feel tired all the time.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，父亲被忧虑催老，开始总觉得疲倦。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Iz-ziju jidher ħafna akbar minn qabel. Mark: Iva, xxejjaħ bl-inkwiet ta' dawn l-aħħar snin.
colloquial.en: Rita: Uncle looks much older than before. Mark: Yes, the worries of the last few years have aged him.
colloquial.zh: Rita：叔叔看起来比以前老了很多。Mark：是啊，这几年的忧虑把他催老了。

messages.speaker: Rita (侄女)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-ziju jidher ħafna akbar minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iz-ziju jidher ħafna akbar minn qabel.
messages.zh: 叔叔看起来比以前老了很多。
messages.en: Uncle looks much older than before.

messages.speaker: Mark (侄子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xxejjaħ bl-inkwiet ta' dawn l-aħħar snin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xxejjaħ bl-inkwiet ta' dawn l-aħħar snin.
messages.zh: 是啊，这几年的忧虑把他催老了。
messages.en: Yes, the worries of the last few years have aged him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人经历岁月与忧虑后显老的前后照片，记住自然变老和被催老两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be reduced to nothing, or to suffer humiliation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被消减到不复存在、化为乌有；也指受到羞辱，尊严遭到贬损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jispiċċa fix-xejn, jew jiġi umiljat u jħoss id-dinjità tiegħu mnaqqsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被化为乌有，消减到一无所剩。
受到羞辱，尊严受到伤害。

collocations.en: was humiliated in front of everyone

formal.mt: Wara l-għargħar, l-isforz ta' xhur sħaħ xxejjen għal kollox.
formal.en: After the flood, months of effort were reduced to nothing.
formal.zh: 洪水过后，整整几个月的努力彻底化为乌有。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu telaq daqshekk kmieni? Maja: Għax xxejjen quddiem kulħadd meta bdew jidħku bih.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu leave so early? Maja: Because he was humiliated in front of everyone when they started laughing at him.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu为什么这么早就走了？Maja：因为大家开始嘲笑他，让他当众受了辱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么这么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave so early?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xxejjen quddiem kulħadd meta bdew jidħku bih.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xxejjen quddiem kulħadd meta bdew jidħku bih.
messages.zh: 因为大家开始嘲笑他，让他当众受了辱。
messages.en: Because he was humiliated in front of everyone when they started laughing at him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画努力成果归零，再画一个人当众受辱；用成果消失与尊严受损两幅图分别记义。

gloss_zh: 摇晃；飘动；用于赶人走的粗鲁表达

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wobble or flap; in the expression 'mur ixxejjer', to go to the devil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摇晃或来回摆动，也可指旗帜等飘动；表达 mur ixxejjer 用于粗鲁地叫人滚开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq minn naħa għal oħra jew jitbandal fir-riħ; fl-espressjoni 'mur ixxejjer', tintuża biex wieħed ikeċċi lil xi ħadd b'mod goff.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇晃，来回摆动或晃动不稳。

sense_translations.en_definition: to flap (used e.g. of flags in the wind)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 飘动、拍动，例如旗帜在风中摆动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to go to the devil (used in the expression 'mur ixxejjer' -- go to the devil)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于 mur ixxejjer，粗鲁地表示“滚开”或“见鬼去吧”。

formal.mt: Waqt il-maltemp, l-arblu xxejjer minn naħa għal oħra u l-bnadar baqgħu jixxejru fir-riħ.
formal.en: During the storm, the pole wobbled from side to side and the flags kept flapping in the wind.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，旗杆左右摇晃，旗帜不停地在风中飘动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi qallek meta tlabtu jitlaq? Rita: Qalli 'mur ixxejjer'. Kien irrabjat ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: What did he say when you asked him to leave? Rita: He told me to go to the devil. He was very angry.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你请他离开时，他说了什么？Rita：他叫我“见鬼去吧”。他当时非常生气。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你请他离开时，他说了什么？
messages.en: What did he say when you asked him to leave?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他叫我“见鬼去吧”。他当时非常生气。
messages.en: He told me to go to the devil. He was very angry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用旗杆摇晃、旗帜飘动记住动作义；另把整句 mur ixxejjer 作为粗鲁赶人的表达单独记忆。

gloss_zh: 被梳理纤维；经过梳棉处理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To undergo carding, a process that separates and arranges textile fibres such as flax or cotton.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指亚麻、棉花等纺织原料接受梳理，使纤维分开并整理，以便后续加工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi minn proċess ta' tqardix li jifred u jirranġa l-fibri ta' materjali bħall-kittien jew il-qoton.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be carded (used of materials such as flax, cotton etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被梳理、接受梳纤处理，用于亚麻、棉花等纺织原料。

formal.mt: Wara li xxejjet, il-qoton kien lest għall-istadju tal-għażil.
formal.en: After being carded, the cotton was ready for the spinning stage.
formal.zh: 棉花经过梳理后，就可以进入纺纱阶段了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-qoton diġà xxejjet? Rita: Iva, xxejjet bl-idejn. Issa nistgħu nibdew l-għażil.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has this cotton already been carded? Rita: Yes, it was carded by hand. Now we can start spinning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些棉花已经梳理过了吗？Rita：是的，已经手工梳理过了。现在可以开始纺纱了。

messages.speaker: Maja (纺织学徒)
messages.zh: 这些棉花已经梳理过了吗？
messages.en: Has this cotton already been carded?

messages.speaker: Rita (纺织老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xxejjet bl-idejn. Issa nistgħu nibdew l-għażil.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xxejjet bl-idejn. Issa nistgħu nibdew l-għażil.
messages.zh: 是的，已经手工梳理过了。现在可以开始纺纱了。
messages.en: Yes, it was carded by hand. Now we can start spinning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一团杂乱棉纤维经过梳理后变得松散整齐，记住这个词说的是材料被加工。

gloss_zh: 被利器穿孔；被刺出孔洞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have holes made in it by a sharp instrument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体被尖锐工具刺穿，形成孔洞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu toqob magħmula fih b'għodda bil-ponta.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be perforated with a sharp instrument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被尖锐工具刺穿或穿出孔洞

collocations.en: was perforated with a pointed tool

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-kartun xxekkek b'labra biex jinħolqu toqob żgħar.
formal.en: During the exercise, the cardboard was perforated with a needle to create small holes.
formal.zh: 练习过程中，纸板被针刺穿，形成了一些小孔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm dawn it-toqob fil-kartun? Pawlu: Il-kartun xxekkek b'labra waqt il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there these holes in the cardboard? Pawlu: The cardboard was perforated with a needle during the game.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：纸板上怎么有这些孔？保罗：玩游戏时，纸板被针刺出了孔。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 纸板上怎么有这些孔？
messages.en: Why are there these holes in the cardboard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 玩游戏时，纸板被针刺出了孔。
messages.en: The cardboard was perforated with a needle during the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“针尖穿过纸板，留下小孔”的画面绑定，重点记住物体被穿孔的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be restrained by chains or ties, or to have movement or progress hindered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被链条或绳索束缚，也可指行动或进展受到阻碍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżamm bi ktajjen jew irbit, jew isib ostaklu li jfixkel il-moviment jew il-progress tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被链条锁住或束缚
被绳索等绑住
受到某人、某事或某种情况的阻碍

collocations.en: was hindered by a lack of funds

formal.mt: Il-proġett xxekkel minħabba nuqqas ta' fondi, u x-xogħol kellu jieqaf għal xahar.
formal.en: The project was hindered by a lack of funds, and work had to stop for a month.
formal.zh: 项目因资金不足而受阻，工程不得不停工一个月。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaf ix-xogħol fuq il-ġnien? Mark: Ix-xogħol xxekkel minħabba x-xita, imma għada nkomplu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why has work on the garden stopped? Mark: The work was hindered by the rain, but we'll continue tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：花园的活怎么停了？马克：下雨耽误了进度，不过我们明天继续。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 花园的活怎么停了？
messages.en: Why has work on the garden stopped?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xogħol xxekkel minħabba x-xita, imma għada nkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xogħol xxekkel minħabba x-xita, imma għada nkomplu.
messages.zh: 下雨耽误了进度，不过我们明天继续。
messages.en: The work was hindered by the rain, but we'll continue tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚被链条或绳子拴住，无法前进；再把同一画面用于项目进度，就能记住“受阻”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose a small piece, especially from an edge, and become chipped.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体的一小块脱落，尤其是边缘被磕出缺口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef biċċa żgħira, speċjalment mit-tarf, u jibqa' b'tarf mhux sħiħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被磕掉一小块；出现崩缺

sense_translations.en_definition: to be chipped at the edges
sense_translations.zh_definition: 边缘被磕出缺口或崩掉小块

collocations.en: the rim of the cup became chipped
the plate became chipped along the side
collocations.zh: 盘子侧边崩掉了一小块

formal.mt: Waqt it-trasport, it-tarf tal-platt xxellef u tilef biċċa żgħira.
formal.en: During transport, the edge of the plate became chipped and lost a small piece.
formal.zh: 运输过程中，盘子的边缘被磕出了缺口，掉了一小块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil dan il-platt? David: Waqa' fil-friskatur u xxellef mal-ġenb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to this plate? David: It fell into the sink and became chipped along the side.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这个盘子怎么了？戴维：它掉进水槽里，边上磕掉了一小块。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这个盘子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to this plate?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 它掉进水槽里，边上磕掉了一小块。
messages.en: It fell into the sink and became chipped along the side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住杯口或盘边缺了一小角的画面：主体仍完整，边缘却崩掉了一小块。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sit or lie in the sunshine for enjoyment or to get a tan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了享受阳光或晒黑皮肤而坐着或躺着晒太阳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joqgħod bilqiegħda jew mimdud fix-xemx biex igawdiha jew jieħu kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晒太阳；进行日光浴

formal.mt: Matul il-vaganza, Pawlu xxemmex fuq il-bajja għal ftit ħin kull filgħodu.
formal.en: During the holiday, Pawlu sunbathed on the beach for a short time every morning.
formal.zh: 度假期间，保罗每天早晨都在海滩上晒一小会儿太阳。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu Pawlu? Ben: Għadu kif daħal; xxemmex ftit fuq it-terrazzin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Pawlu? Ben: He's just come inside; he sunbathed on the terrace for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗在哪儿？本：他刚进屋，之前在露台上晒了会儿太阳。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kif daħal; xxemmex ftit fuq it-terrazzin.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kif daħal; xxemmex ftit fuq it-terrazzin.
messages.zh: 他刚进屋，之前在露台上晒了会儿太阳。
messages.en: He's just come inside; he sunbathed on the terrace for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义配上“铺开毛巾、躺在海滩享受阳光”的画面，整组记作“晒太阳、日光浴”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To create a model representing an object or structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作一个表现某种物体或建筑结构的模型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel mudell li jirrappreżenta oġġett jew struttura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作某物的模型

collocations.en: made a model of a house out of clay
made a model of a bridge out of cardboard

formal.mt: Għall-proġett tal-iskola, l-istudent xxempja pont bil-kartun biex juri l-istruttura tiegħu.
formal.en: For the school project, the student made a model of a bridge out of cardboard to show its structure.
formal.zh: 为了完成学校项目，这名学生用纸板制作了桥梁模型，展示桥的结构。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mudell min għamlu? Leo: Ħija xxempja dar bit-tafal għall-proġett tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made this model? Leo: My brother made a model of a house out of clay for his project.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个模型是谁做的？利奥：我兄弟为了完成项目，用黏土做了一座房屋模型。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个模型是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this model?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija xxempja dar bit-tafal għall-proġett tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija xxempja dar bit-tafal għall-proġett tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我兄弟为了完成项目，用黏土做了一座房屋模型。
messages.en: My brother made a model of a house out of clay for his project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把眼前的大房子用黏土做成桌上的小模型；练习时把“制作模型”和模型表现的对象连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sway, lean to one side, or wobble without remaining steady.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指来回摇摆、向一侧倾斜，或因不稳而摇晃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq minn naħa għal oħra, jinklina lejn naħa waħda, jew jitħarrek mingħajr ma jibqa' stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来回摇摆；摆动
倾斜；向一侧偏斜
摇晃不稳；晃动

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, l-arblu xxengel mar-riħ u mbagħad inklina lejn il-lemin.
formal.en: During the test, the pole swayed in the wind and then leaned to the right.
formal.zh: 测试过程中，杆子随风摇摆，随后向右倾斜。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qomt minn fuq dak is-siġġu? Mark: Is-siġġu xxengel meta poġġejt fuqu; naħseb li għandu sieq maħlula.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you get up from that chair? Mark: The chair wobbled when I sat on it; I think it has a loose leg.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么从那把椅子上站起来了？马克：我一坐上去，椅子就晃了；我想有条椅腿松了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qomt minn fuq dak is-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qomt minn fuq dak is-siġġu?
messages.zh: 你怎么从那把椅子上站起来了？
messages.en: Why did you get up from that chair?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-siġġu xxengel meta poġġejt fuqu; naħseb li għandu sieq maħlula.
messages.mt_standard: Is-siġġu xxengel meta poġġejt fuqu; naħseb li għandu sieq maħlula.
messages.zh: 我一坐上去，椅子就晃了；我想有条椅腿松了。
messages.en: The chair wobbled when I sat on it; I think it has a loose leg.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个连续画面记忆：树枝随风摆、杆子向旁倾、椅腿松动晃；共同感觉是偏离稳定位置。

gloss_zh: 将……搬上舞台；制作舞台演出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prepare and present a play or other performance on a stage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 筹备并在舞台上呈现戏剧或其他表演。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħejji u jippreżenta dramm jew wirja oħra fuq palk.

sense_translations.en_definition: to stage, to produce on a stage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 将戏剧等搬上舞台；制作并呈现舞台演出

collocations.en: staged a comedy at the theatre
collocations.zh: 在剧院制作并上演一部喜剧

formal.mt: Il-grupp teatrali xxenja dramm qasir fis-sala tal-iskola quddiem l-istudenti u l-ġenituri.
formal.en: The theatre group staged a short play in the school hall for students and parents.
formal.zh: 剧团在学校礼堂为学生和家长上演了一部短剧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel il-grupp tagħkom ilbieraħ? Ben: Xxenja kummiedja fit-teatru; l-udjenza daħket ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did your group do yesterday? Ben: It staged a comedy at the theatre; the audience laughed a lot.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你们的剧团昨天做了什么？本：在剧院上演了一部喜剧，观众笑得很开心。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们的剧团昨天做了什么？
messages.en: What did your group do yesterday?

messages.speaker: Ben (剧团成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxenja kummiedja fit-teatru; l-udjenza daħket ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Xxenja kummiedja fit-teatru; l-udjenza daħket ħafna.
messages.zh: 在剧院上演了一部喜剧，观众笑得很开心。
messages.en: It staged a comedy at the theatre; the audience laughed a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象剧本经过排练，灯光亮起，整部戏呈现在舞台上；用“把戏搬上舞台”记住这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel a strong desire for something or a deep longing for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈地想要某物，或深切地渴望、思念某人或某事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa jew iħoss ħafna n-nuqqas ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈渴求；非常想要
深切渴望；思念

formal.mt: Matul ix-xhur li qatta' barra minn Malta, l-istudent xxennaq għal daru u għall-kumpanija tal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: During the months he spent outside Malta, the student longed for his home and his family's company.
formal.zh: 在马耳他以外生活的那几个月里，这名学生十分思念家乡，也渴望家人的陪伴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex mar il-forn Leo? Pawlu: Ra ritratt ta' kejk u xxennaq għal biċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Leo go to the bakery? Pawlu: He saw a picture of a cake and craved a slice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：利奥怎么去面包店了？保罗：他看到一张蛋糕的照片，特别想吃一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 利奥怎么去面包店了？
messages.en: Why did Leo go to the bakery?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ra ritratt ta' kejk u xxennaq għal biċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Ra ritratt ta' kejk u xxennaq għal biċċa.
messages.zh: 他看到一张蛋糕的照片，特别想吃一块。
messages.en: He saw a picture of a cake and craved a slice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“馋一块蛋糕”和“离家后深深想家”并排记忆：对象不同，共同点都是心里强烈地想要。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop roots and become established in the soil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物长出根部，在土壤中扎根。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel l-għeruq u qabad fil-ħamrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生根；在土壤中扎根。

formal.mt: Wara li tħawwel fil-ġnien, ix-xitel xxenxel sew u beda jikber.
formal.en: After being planted in the garden, the seedling took root well and began to grow.
formal.zh: 移栽到花园后，这株幼苗顺利生根，开始生长。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ix-xitel xxenxel? Pawlu: Iva, xxenxel sew. Diġà għandu weraq ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the seedling taken root? Pawlu: Yes, it has rooted well. It already has new leaves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这株幼苗生根了吗？保罗：生根了，而且扎得很好。已经长出新叶了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这株幼苗生根了吗？
messages.en: Has the seedling taken root?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xxenxel sew. Diġà għandu weraq ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xxenxel sew. Diġà għandu weraq ġdid.
messages.zh: 生根了，而且扎得很好。已经长出新叶了。
messages.en: Yes, it has rooted well. It already has new leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxenxel 和幼苗扎根的画面一起记：小苗站稳在土里，地下已经长出了根。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something available to other people, including by sending or posting digital content.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物提供给别人共同使用或查看，也可指发送或发布数字内容供他人观看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qasam xi ħaġa ma' oħrajn jew għamilha disponibbli għalihom, ukoll billi bagħat jew ippubblika kontenut diġitali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分享；把物品、信息或内容提供给他人共同使用或查看。

collocations.zh: 与朋友分享了一个链接

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur xxerja d-dokument mal-membri kollha tat-tim qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The coordinator shared the document with all team members before the meeting.
formal.zh: 协调员在会议前把文件分享给了全体团队成员。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min xxerja dan il-vidjo fil-grupp? Mark: Jien. Ħsibt li jogħġobkom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who shared this video in the group? Mark: I did. I thought you would like it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把这个视频分享到群里了？马克：我分享的。我觉得你们会喜欢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把这个视频分享到群里了？
messages.en: Who shared this video in the group?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我分享的。我觉得你们会喜欢。
messages.en: I did. I thought you would like it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxerja 配上手机里的分享按钮来记：点一下，让朋友也能看到同一张照片。

gloss_zh: 被弄脏；沾染或涂污，通常指血迹

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become stained or smeared with a substance, usually blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面被某种物质沾染或涂污，通常指沾上血迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tebbaħ jew tħammeġ b'xi sustanza, ġeneralment bid-demm.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be stained or smeared (usually with blood)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被沾染或涂污，通常指被血弄脏。

formal.mt: Waqt li kien qed jgħin lill-persuna midruba, il-qmis tiegħu xxermed bid-demm.
formal.en: While he was helping the injured person, his shirt became stained with blood.
formal.zh: 他在帮助伤者时，衬衫沾上了血迹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-fardal xxermed bid-demm? Toni: Iva, waqt li kont qed inħejji l-laħam. Se naħslu issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the apron get stained with blood? Toni: Yes, while I was preparing the meat. I'll wash it now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：围裙沾上血迹了吗？托尼：是啊，处理肉的时候沾上的。我现在就洗。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 围裙沾上血迹了吗？
messages.en: Did the apron get stained with blood?

messages.speaker: Toni (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waqt li kont qed inħejji l-laħam. Se naħslu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waqt li kont qed inħejji l-laħam. Se naħslu issa.
messages.zh: 是啊，处理肉的时候沾上的。我现在就洗。
messages.en: Yes, while I was preparing the meat. I'll wash it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 xxermed 时想象浅色围裙上沾了血迹，重点记住表面受到沾染或涂污。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to choke by something such as food or drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因食物、饮料等进入喉部而被呛到或噎住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: So fraqa minħabba xi ħaġa, bħal ikel jew xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某物或某种原因而被呛到、噎住。

collocations.en: choked on a piece of bread

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla, it-tifel xxerraq b'biċċa ħobż u beda jisgħol.
formal.en: During the meal, the boy choked on a piece of bread and began coughing.
formal.zh: 吃饭时，男孩被一块面包噎住，开始咳嗽。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark beda jisgħol? Toni: Xxerraq bl-ilma waqt li kien qed jidħak.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark start coughing? Toni: He choked on water while he was laughing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克怎么突然咳嗽了？托尼：他笑的时候被水呛到了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么突然咳嗽了？
messages.en: Why did Mark start coughing?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxerraq bl-ilma waqt li kien qed jidħak.
messages.mt_standard: Xxerraq bl-ilma waqt li kien qed jidħak.
messages.zh: 他笑的时候被水呛到了。
messages.en: He choked on water while he was laughing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxerraq 连到喝水时突然呛咳的情景，记住是受到某物影响而被呛到或噎住。

gloss_zh: 被纵向切开；沿长度方向被切开

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut lengthwise, along the long dimension of an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体顺着自身的长度方向被切开或剖开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inqata' mit-tul, fid-direzzjoni tat-tul tal-oġġett.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be cut along the length
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿长度方向被切开；被纵向剖开。

collocations.en: the log was cut along its length
collocations.zh: 木头被沿长度方向剖开

formal.mt: Iz-zokk xxerraħ mit-tul biex il-parti ta' ġewwa setgħet tiġi eżaminata.
formal.en: The log was cut lengthwise so that its interior could be examined.
formal.zh: 这段木头被纵向剖开，以便检查内部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan iz-zokk xxerraħ mit-tul? Pawlu: Iva, minn tarf għall-ieħor. Issa nistgħu naraw ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this log cut lengthwise? Pawlu: Yes, from one end to the other. Now we can see inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这段木头是顺着长度剖开的吗？保罗：对，从一头剖到另一头。现在能看到里面了。

messages.speaker: Maja (木工学员)
messages.zh: 这段木头是顺着长度剖开的吗？
messages.en: Was this log cut lengthwise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn tarf għall-ieħor. Issa nistgħu naraw ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn tarf għall-ieħor. Issa nistgħu naraw ġewwa.
messages.zh: 对，从一头剖到另一头。现在能看到里面了。
messages.en: Yes, from one end to the other. Now we can see inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一根长木头帮助记忆 xxerraħ：刀口顺着长边从头走到尾，就是沿长度方向剖开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scatter or disperse, becoming spread over an area or separated into different directions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散布到某个范围内，或从聚集状态分散到不同方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infirex fuq żona jew tbiegħed minn post wieħed f'direzzjonijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散落；散布到不同位置。
散开；从聚集状态分散到各处。

collocations.en: the salt scattered across the floor

formal.mt: Wara li ntemmet l-attività, il-grupp xxerred u l-parteċipanti telqu f'direzzjonijiet differenti.
formal.en: After the activity ended, the group dispersed and the participants left in different directions.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，人群散开，参与者朝不同方向离去。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm melħ mal-art kollha? Mark: Il-pakkett infetaħ u l-melħ xxerred. Se niġbru issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there salt all over the floor? Mark: The packet opened and the salt scattered. I'll gather it up now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：怎么地上到处都是盐？马克：袋子开了，盐撒得到处都是。我现在就清理。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 怎么地上到处都是盐？
messages.en: Why is there salt all over the floor?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakkett infetaħ u l-melħ xxerred. Se niġbru issa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakkett infetaħ u l-melħ xxerred. Se niġbru issa.
messages.zh: 袋子开了，盐撒得到处都是。我现在就清理。
messages.en: The packet opened and the salt scattered. I'll gather it up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 xxerred：盐粒从袋中散落，人群从广场散开；共同点都是从集中变分散。

gloss_zh: 探身向外看；探身越过某物看

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lean forward or outward in order to look out of an opening or over something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为从开口向外看，或越过某物看，而把身体向前或向外探。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mejjel ġismu 'l quddiem jew 'il barra biex iħares minn xi fetħa jew minn fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to lean in order to look out of or over sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 探出身子，以便从某处向外看或越过某物看。

collocations.en: leaned out of the window to look
leaned over the wall to look

formal.mt: Ir-raġel xxerref mit-tieqa biex jara min kien qiegħed iħabbat mal-bieb.
formal.en: The man leaned out of the window to see who was knocking at the door.
formal.zh: 男子从窗口探身向外看，想看看是谁在敲门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif rah il-qattus fil-ġnien ta' ħdejna? Toni: Xxerref minn fuq il-ħajt u rah ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he see the cat in the garden next door? Toni: He leaned over the wall and saw it beside the tree.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他怎么看到隔壁花园里的猫的？托尼：他探身越过墙头，看见猫在树旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif rah il-qattus fil-ġnien ta' ħdejna?
messages.mt_standard: Kif rah il-qattus fil-ġnien ta' ħdejna?
messages.zh: 他怎么看到隔壁花园里的猫的？
messages.en: How did he see the cat in the garden next door?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxerref minn fuq il-ħajt u rah ħdejn is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Xxerref minn fuq il-ħajt u rah ħdejn is-siġra.
messages.zh: 他探身越过墙头，看见猫在树旁边。
messages.en: He leaned over the wall and saw it beside the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxerref 想成窗边探身张望的动作，身体前倾是动作，看窗外或墙后是目的。

gloss_zh: 与人交往；使自己与某群体建立联系

teaching_sense.en_definition: To associate oneself with other people or a group by becoming involved with them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过交往或参与活动，使自己与他人或某个群体建立联系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħal f'relazzjoni ma' nies oħra jew ma' grupp billi ħa sehem magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己与他人或某个群体建立联系；参与其中并与之交往。

collocations.en: associated himself with a group of artists
collocations.zh: 与一群艺术家建立了联系

formal.mt: L-artist xxerrek ma' grupp lokali biex jieħu sehem fi proġetti kulturali.
formal.en: The artist associated himself with a local group to take part in cultural projects.
formal.zh: 这位艺术家与一个本地团体建立联系，以参与文化项目。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma' min xxerrek Mark dan l-aħħar? Pawlu: Ma' grupp ta' fotografi. Joħorġu jieħdu r-ritratti flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who has Mark been associating with lately? Pawlu: A group of photographers. They go out taking photos together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克最近在和哪些人交往？保罗：一群摄影爱好者。他们会一起出去拍照。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min xxerrek Mark dan l-aħħar?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min xxerrek Mark dan l-aħħar?
messages.zh: 马克最近在和哪些人交往？
messages.en: Who has Mark been associating with lately?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' grupp ta' fotografi. Joħorġu jieħdu r-ritratti flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ma' grupp ta' fotografi. Joħorġu jieħdu r-ritratti flimkien.
messages.zh: 一群摄影爱好者。他们会一起出去拍照。
messages.en: A group of photographers. They go out taking photos together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxerrek 和走进兴趣小组的画面绑定：认识成员、一起活动，自己就与这个群体建立了联系。

gloss_zh: 噘嘴，撅起嘴唇（可能为方言用法）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To push one's lips forward into a pout, for example to show displeasure; probably dialectal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把嘴唇向前撅起，例如用来表达不高兴；这一用法可能属于方言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ xufftejh 'il quddiem, pereżempju biex juri li mhux kuntent; aktarx użu djalettali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 噘嘴，撅起嘴唇（可能为方言用法）。

formal.mt: Meta sema' li l-ħarġa kienet tħassret, it-tifel xxettaħ xufftejh u baqa' sieket.
formal.en: When he heard that the outing had been cancelled, the boy pouted his lips and remained silent.
formal.zh: 听说出游取消后，男孩撅起嘴唇，默不作声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Leo xxettaħ xufftejh? Nina: Għax ried jibqa' jilgħab u għednielu li sar il-ħin biex nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Leo pout his lips? Nina: Because he wanted to keep playing and we told him it was time to leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：利奥为什么噘嘴？妮娜：因为他还想继续玩，我们却告诉他该走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 利奥为什么噘嘴？
messages.en: Why did Leo pout his lips?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ried jibqa' jilgħab u għednielu li sar il-ħin biex nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ried jibqa' jilgħab u għednielu li sar il-ħin biex nitilqu.
messages.zh: 因为他还想继续玩，我们却告诉他该走了。
messages.en: Because he wanted to keep playing and we told him it was time to leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子听说不能再玩，嘴唇立刻向前撅起；用这个表情记住“噘嘴”，并保留“可能为方言”的提示。

gloss_zh: 被种下；恢复精神，重新振作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be planted in soil; also, of a person, to feel refreshed and full of energy again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物被栽种到土里；也指人重新感到精神充沛、恢复活力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħawwel fil-ħamrija; jew, meta jingħad għal persuna, jerġa' jħossu frisk u mimli enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被种下，被栽种。
感到恢复活力，重新精神焕发。

formal.mt: Il-ħabaq xxettel f'rokna xemxija tal-ġnien, fejn seta' jikber b'dawl biżżejjed.
formal.en: The basil was planted in a sunny corner of the garden, where it could grow with enough light.
formal.zh: 罗勒被种在花园里阳光充足的一角，可以得到足够的光照来生长。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif baqa' miexi Mark wara dik il-mixja twila? Pawlu: Strieħ ftit fid-dell u xxettel; wara ried ikompli magħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Mark manage to keep walking after that long walk? Pawlu: He rested in the shade for a while and felt reinvigorated; afterwards he wanted to carry on with us.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：走了那么远，马克怎么还能继续走？保罗：他在阴凉处休息了一会儿，恢复了精神，之后还想跟我们继续走。

messages.speaker: Sara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif baqa' miexi Mark wara dik il-mixja twila?
messages.mt_standard: Kif baqa' miexi Mark wara dik il-mixja twila?
messages.zh: 走了那么远，马克怎么还能继续走？
messages.en: How did Mark manage to keep walking after that long walk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Strieħ ftit fid-dell u xxettel; wara ried ikompli magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Strieħ ftit fid-dell u xxettel; wara ried ikompli magħna.
messages.zh: 他在阴凉处休息了一会儿，恢复了精神，之后还想跟我们继续走。
messages.en: He rested in the shade for a while and felt reinvigorated; afterwards he wanted to carry on with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习画面分别记忆：植物被栽进土里，人休息后重新有精神；这是双义联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 被猛力抛出，被用力甩去

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be thrown with considerable force, often landing some distance away or striking a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到较大的力量而被抛出或甩出去，往往落到别处或撞到某个表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintefa' b'forza kbira, ħafna drabi għal xi distanza jew kontra xi wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被猛力抛出，被用力甩出去。

formal.mt: Waqt l-inċident, il-barmil xxewlaħ kontra l-ħajt u nkiser, iżda ħadd ma weġġa'.
formal.en: During the incident, the bucket was hurled against the wall and broke, but nobody was injured.
formal.zh: 事故中，水桶被猛力甩向墙壁并破裂，但没有人受伤。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'kien dak il-ħoss qawwi? Lara: Il-barmil xxewlaħ mal-art. Fortunatament ma kien hemm ħadd ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Mark: What was that loud noise? Lara: The bucket was hurled to the ground. Luckily nobody was beside it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：刚才那声巨响是什么？拉拉：水桶被猛力摔到了地上。幸好旁边没有人。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 刚才那声巨响是什么？
messages.en: What was that loud noise?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-barmil xxewlaħ mal-art. Fortunatament ma kien hemm ħadd ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Il-barmil xxewlaħ mal-art. Fortunatament ma kien hemm ħadd ħdejh.
messages.zh: 水桶被猛力摔到了地上。幸好旁边没有人。
messages.en: The bucket was hurled to the ground. Luckily nobody was beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水桶被一股大力甩出去，砰地撞墙；记忆重点是“被抛”和“力量很大”这两个要素。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To want or long for something, such as an experience, an opportunity, or a change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想要或盼望得到某种事物，例如一次经历、一个机会或一种改变。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu xewqa għal xi ħaġa, bħal esperjenza, opportunità jew bidla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渴望，想要，盼望得到。

formal.mt: Wara snin ta' xogħol iebes, Pawlu xxewwaq għal ħajja aktar kwieta u għal aktar ħin mal-familja.
formal.en: After years of hard work, Pawlu desired a quieter life and more time with his family.
formal.zh: 辛苦工作多年后，保罗渴望过上更安静的生活，并有更多时间陪伴家人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Mark ħa ġimgħa vaganza? Sara: Wara dak ix-xogħol kollu, xxewwaq għal ftit mistrieħ ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Mark take a week's holiday? Sara: After all that work, he longed for some rest by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克为什么休了一周假？萨拉：忙完那么多工作后，他渴望去海边休息一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么休了一周假？
messages.en: Why did Mark take a week's holiday?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dak ix-xogħol kollu, xxewwaq għal ftit mistrieħ ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Wara dak ix-xogħol kollu, xxewwaq għal ftit mistrieħ ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 忙完那么多工作后，他渴望去海边休息一下。
messages.en: After all that work, he longed for some rest by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“忙了一周，心里一直盼着海边休息”的情景，用持续的想望来记住“渴望”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop thorns or become covered with thorns as a plant grows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物在生长过程中长出刺，或变得带有棘刺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa x-xewk jew jimtela bix-xewk waqt li jikber, meta jingħad għal pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出刺，生出棘刺。

formal.mt: Hekk kif kiber, l-arbuxxell xxewwek, u l-ġardinar beda jilbes ingwanti ħoxnin meta kien jieħu ħsiebu.
formal.en: As it grew, the shrub developed thorns, and the gardener began wearing thick gloves when tending it.
formal.zh: 灌木长大后生出了刺，园丁开始在照料它时戴上厚手套。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tilbes l-ingwanti biex taqta' dik il-fergħa? Mark: Għax dan l-arbuxxell xxewwek, u ma rridx inweġġa' idejja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you wearing gloves to cut that branch? Mark: Because this shrub has grown thorns, and I don't want to hurt my hands.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：剪那根树枝为什么要戴手套？马克：因为这丛灌木长出了刺，我不想弄伤手。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tilbes l-ingwanti biex taqta' dik il-fergħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tilbes l-ingwanti biex taqta' dik il-fergħa?
messages.zh: 剪那根树枝为什么要戴手套？
messages.en: Why are you wearing gloves to cut that branch?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan l-arbuxxell xxewwek, u ma rridx inweġġa' idejja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan l-arbuxxell xxewwek, u ma rridx inweġġa' idejja.
messages.zh: 因为这丛灌木长出了刺，我不想弄伤手。
messages.en: Because this shrub has grown thorns, and I don't want to hurt my hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本光滑的灌木枝条逐渐冒出尖刺，园丁因此戴上手套；用这个变化记住“长出刺”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wander from place to place; also, to live as a tramp, moving about without a settled home.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一个地方游荡到另一个地方；也可指没有固定住所、四处流浪地生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġġerra minn post għal ieħor; jew jgħix jiġġerra mingħajr dar fissa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 游荡，漫无固定方向地走动。
过流浪生活，没有固定住所而四处漂泊。

collocations.zh: 从一个村庄游荡到另一个村庄

collocations.en: lived as a tramp without a settled home
collocations.zh: 没有固定住所，过着流浪生活

formal.mt: Għal diversi snin, ir-raġel xxewwel bla dar fissa, sakemm sab post fejn seta' jgħix b'mod stabbli.
formal.en: For several years, the man lived as a tramp without a settled home, until he found a place where he could live permanently.
formal.zh: 那名男子多年没有固定住所，过着流浪生活，直到后来找到可以安定居住的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Pawlu wara l-ikel? Nina: Xxewwel ftit fit-toroq tar-raħal u mbagħad ġie lura hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Pawlu go after lunch? Nina: He wandered around the village streets for a while and then came back here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗午饭后去哪儿了？妮娜：他在村里的街上逛了一会儿，然后就回到这里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗午饭后去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go after lunch?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxewwel ftit fit-toroq tar-raħal u mbagħad ġie lura hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Xxewwel ftit fit-toroq tar-raħal u mbagħad ġie lura hawn.
messages.zh: 他在村里的街上逛了一会儿，然后就回到这里了。
messages.en: He wandered around the village streets for a while and then came back here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用时间长短分开记忆：短时是在街上游荡，长期且没有固定住所则是过流浪生活，不能把两种情景混为一谈。

gloss_zh: 被激起反对情绪；受煽动而反对

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stirred up or incited against a person, group, or proposal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被激起针对某人、某群体或某项提议的反对情绪，或受到煽动而与其对立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqanqal jew jiġi mħeġġeġ biex joħodha kontra persuna, grupp jew proposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被激起反对情绪，受到激发而反对某人或某事。
受到煽动而反对某人或某事。

collocations.en: was stirred up against the proposal
collocations.zh: 被激起了反对该提议的情绪
受煽动而敌视自己的邻居

formal.mt: Wara diskors mimli akkużi, il-grupp xxewwex kontra l-proposta qabel ma qara d-dettalji tagħha.
formal.en: After a speech full of accusations, the group was incited against the proposal before reading its details.
formal.zh: 听完一场充满指责的讲话后，这个群体尚未阅读提议的具体内容，就受煽动而反对它。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark xxewwex kontra l-ġar tiegħu? Pawlu: Sema' xnigħa dwaru, imma wara tkellmu u ċċaraw kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why was Mark stirred up against his neighbour? Pawlu: He heard a rumour about him, but afterwards they talked and cleared everything up.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么被激得敌视自己的邻居？保罗：他听到了一条关于邻居的传言，不过后来他们谈了谈，把事情都说清楚了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark xxewwex kontra l-ġar tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark xxewwex kontra l-ġar tiegħu?
messages.zh: 马克为什么被激得敌视自己的邻居？
messages.en: Why was Mark stirred up against his neighbour?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sema' xnigħa dwaru, imma wara tkellmu u ċċaraw kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Sema' xnigħa dwaru, imma wara tkellmu u ċċaraw kollox.
messages.zh: 他听到了一条关于邻居的传言，不过后来他们谈了谈，把事情都说清楚了。
messages.en: He heard a rumour about him, but afterwards they talked and cleared everything up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句传言把人的情绪点燃，并使矛头指向某人；记住“被激起或被煽动”，再用 kontra 标明反对对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To resemble one another, sharing a similar appearance or other noticeable features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指两者彼此相像，在外貌或其他明显特征上具有相似之处，强调相互关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikunu jixbhu lil xulxin fid-dehra jew f'karatteristiċi oħra li jidhru.

sense_translations.en_definition: to resemble (used in a mutual sense: to resemble one another)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 彼此相像，互相相似；用于表达双方之间的相似关系。

collocations.en: the siblings resembled one another in appearance
collocations.zh: 兄弟姐妹在外貌上彼此相像

collocations.en: the two designs closely resembled one another
collocations.zh: 两个设计彼此十分相似

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ disinji xxiebhu ħafna fil-forma u fil-kuluri, għalkemm saru minn studenti differenti.
formal.en: The two designs closely resembled one another in shape and colour, although they were made by different students.
formal.zh: 两个设计虽然出自不同学生之手，但在形状和颜色上彼此十分相似。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt ir-ritratt ta' Mark u ħuh? Nina: Iva, xxiebhu ħafna f'dak ir-ritratt; għall-ewwel ħsibt li kienu tewmin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the photo of Mark and his brother? Nina: Yes, they looked very much alike in that photo; at first I thought they were twins.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看过马克和他兄弟的那张照片吗？妮娜：看过，他们在那张照片里特别像，我起初还以为他们是双胞胎。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt ir-ritratt ta' Mark u ħuh?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt ir-ritratt ta' Mark u ħuh?
messages.zh: 你看过马克和他兄弟的那张照片吗？
messages.en: Did you see the photo of Mark and his brother?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xxiebhu ħafna f'dak ir-ritratt; għall-ewwel ħsibt li kienu tewmin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xxiebhu ħafna f'dak ir-ritratt; għall-ewwel ħsibt li kienu tewmin.
messages.zh: 看过，他们在那张照片里特别像，我起初还以为他们是双胞胎。
messages.en: Yes, they looked very much alike in that photo; at first I thought they were twins.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两张相似的脸并排放在脑中，再画一条双向箭头：甲像乙，乙也像甲，用“彼此”抓住这个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To restrain oneself from doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 克制自己的冲动，使自己不去做某件事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm lilu nnifsu milli jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to stop oneself from doing sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 克制自己不做某事；忍住不去做某事。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Pawlu xxiegħeb milli jinterrompi lill-kelliem u stenna sakemm wasal imissu.
formal.en: During the meeting, Pawlu restrained himself from interrupting the speaker and waited until his turn.
formal.zh: 开会时，保罗克制住打断发言者的冲动，等到轮到自己再说。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu daħaq meta sema' ċ-ċajta? Lara: Le, xxiegħeb milli jidħaq għax il-laqgħa kienet għadha għaddejja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did Pawlu laugh when he heard the joke? Lara: No, he stopped himself from laughing because the meeting was still going on.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗听到那个笑话时笑了吗？拉拉：没有，他忍住没笑，因为会议还在进行。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗听到那个笑话时笑了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu laugh when he heard the joke?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, xxiegħeb milli jidħaq għax il-laqgħa kienet għadha għaddejja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, xxiegħeb milli jidħaq għax il-laqgħa kienet għadha għaddejja.
messages.zh: 没有，他忍住没笑，因为会议还在进行。
messages.en: No, he stopped himself from laughing because the meeting was still going on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxiegħeb 配上“笑到嘴边又忍住”的画面，记住它强调自己克制自己。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a crack or split in the surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面裂开或出现裂纹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqasam jew jifforma xaqq fil-wiċċ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裂开；出现裂纹。

formal.mt: Wara t-terremot, il-ħajt xxiegħer ħdejn it-tieqa u deher xaqq twil.
formal.en: After the earthquake, the wall cracked near the window and a long crack appeared.
formal.zh: 地震后，窗户附近的墙壁裂开了，出现了一道长裂纹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara mill-ħġieġ tat-tieqa? Mark: Laqtitu l-ballun u xxiegħer, imma ma nkisirx għal kollox.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the window glass? Mark: The ball hit it and it cracked, but it did not break completely.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：窗玻璃怎么了？马克：球打中了它，玻璃裂了，不过没有完全碎掉。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 窗玻璃怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the window glass?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Laqtitu l-ballun u xxiegħer, imma ma nkisirx għal kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Laqtitu l-ballun u xxiegħer, imma ma nkisirx għal kollox.
messages.zh: 球打中了它，玻璃裂了，不过没有完全碎掉。
messages.en: The ball hit it and it cracked, but it did not break completely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象玻璃上突然出现一道细裂纹，把这个画面与 xxiegħer 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn grey, referring to a person's hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人的头发变成灰白色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir griż jew abjad, meta jingħad dwar ix-xagħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to turn grey (used of one's hair)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 头发变灰白；头发花白。

collocations.en: the hair turned grey over the years
collocations.zh: 头发随着岁月逐渐变灰白

formal.mt: Matul is-snin, ix-xagħar ta' missieri xxieheb, iżda baqa' oħxon.
formal.en: Over the years, my father's hair turned grey, but it remained thick.
formal.zh: 这些年来，我父亲的头发变灰白了，但仍然很浓密。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan hu zijuk fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Iva. Issa xagħru xxieheb, imma t-tbissima għadha l-istess.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this your uncle in the photo? Pawlu: Yes. His hair has turned grey now, but his smile is still the same.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：照片里这位是你叔叔吗？保罗：是的。他现在头发花白了，但笑容还是一样。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里这位是你叔叔吗？
messages.en: Is this your uncle in the photo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Issa xagħru xxieheb, imma t-tbissima għadha l-istess.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Issa xagħru xxieheb, imma t-tbissima għadha l-istess.
messages.zh: 是的。他现在头发花白了，但笑容还是一样。
messages.en: Yes. His hair has turned grey now, but his smile is still the same.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把旧照片里的黑发与如今的灰白头发并排想象，用 xxieheb 记住头发颜色的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass time by occupying oneself with an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过做某种活动来消磨时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi l-ħin billi jinżamm okkupat b'xi attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消磨时间；做些事情打发时光。

formal.mt: Waqt li kien qed jistenna l-ferrovija, Mark xxiewel bil-qari ta' ktieb.
formal.en: While waiting for the train, Mark whiled away the time reading a book.
formal.zh: 等火车时，马克读了一本书来消磨时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif għadda l-ħin Mark sakemm wasalna? Lara: Xxiewel bil-logħob fuq it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Mark pass the time until we arrived? Lara: He whiled it away playing games on his phone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们到之前，马克怎么打发时间的？拉拉：他玩手机游戏消磨时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għadda l-ħin Mark sakemm wasalna?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għadda l-ħin Mark sakemm wasalna?
messages.zh: 我们到之前，马克怎么打发时间的？
messages.en: How did Mark pass the time until we arrived?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他玩手机游戏消磨时间。
messages.en: He whiled it away playing games on his phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等车时翻书或玩游戏，让等待慢慢过去；这幅画面帮助记住 xxiewel。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move something from one position to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物从一个位置移到另一个位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq xi ħaġa minn pożizzjoni għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移动；挪动；改变位置。

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet il-laqgħa, Mark xxiftja s-siġġu lejn il-ħajt biex jagħmel aktar spazju.
formal.en: Before the meeting began, Mark shifted the chair towards the wall to make more space.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，马克把椅子往墙边挪了挪，以腾出更多空间。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min xxiftja s-siġġu ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Jien. Hemm aktar dawl biex naqra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who shifted the chair next to the window? Mark: I did. There is more light there for reading.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁把椅子挪到窗边了？马克：我挪的。那里光线更好，方便看书。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把椅子挪到窗边了？
messages.en: Who shifted the chair next to the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Hemm aktar dawl biex naqra.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Hemm aktar dawl biex naqra.
messages.zh: 我挪的。那里光线更好，方便看书。
messages.en: I did. There is more light there for reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxiftja 和英语 shift 的词形联系起来，再想象把椅子从桌边挪到窗边。

gloss_zh: 拙劣地模仿；生硬地学样

teaching_sense.en_definition: To copy someone's behaviour or manner in a poor or unconvincing way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 模仿别人的行为或方式，但模仿得拙劣、不自然。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimita l-imġiba jew il-mod ta' xi ħadd b'mod fqir jew mhux konvinċenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拙劣地模仿；生硬地照着别人的样子做。

collocations.zh: 拙劣地模仿了那位演员
生硬地模仿了老师的手势

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, l-istudent xximjotta l-attur famuż, iżda l-vuċi u l-ġesti tiegħu dehru sfurzati.
formal.en: During the rehearsal, the student poorly imitated the famous actor, but his voice and gestures seemed forced.
formal.zh: 排练时，那个学生拙劣地模仿了那位著名演员，声音和手势都显得很生硬。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark kien tajjeb meta għamel bħall-attur? Sara: Le, xximjotta l-attur u l-ġesti dehru sfurzati.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was Mark good when he acted like the actor? Sara: No, he imitated the actor poorly and the gestures looked forced.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克学那个演员学得好吗？萨拉：不好，他模仿得很拙劣，手势看起来很生硬。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark kien tajjeb meta għamel bħall-attur?
messages.mt_standard: Mark kien tajjeb meta għamel bħall-attur?
messages.zh: 马克学那个演员学得好吗？
messages.en: Was Mark good when he acted like the actor?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, xximjotta l-attur u l-ġesti dehru sfurzati.
messages.mt_standard: Le, xximjotta l-attur u l-ġesti dehru sfurzati.
messages.zh: 不好，他模仿得很拙劣，手势看起来很生硬。
messages.en: No, he imitated the actor poorly and the gestures looked forced.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象模仿演员时只学到夸张动作、表演却很生硬，用这个场景记住 xximjotta 的贬义。

gloss_zh: 变得干瘦；变得憔悴瘦削

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become very thin, sometimes with a gaunt appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得很瘦，有时显出憔悴、瘦削的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir irqiq ħafna, xi drabi b'dehra ta' għeja jew dgħufija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得很瘦；变得干瘦。
变得憔悴瘦削；瘦得显出疲惫或虚弱的样子。

formal.mt: Wara l-marda twila, ir-raġel xxixxem u wiċċu deher għajjien.
formal.en: After the long illness, the man became gaunt and his face looked tired.
formal.zh: 久病之后，那个男人变得憔悴瘦削，脸上显出疲惫的神色。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt lil Pawlu dan l-aħħar? Mark: Iva, xxixxem ħafna minn meta marad.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you seen Pawlu lately? Mark: Yes, he has become very thin since he fell ill.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你最近见过保罗吗？马克：见过，他自从生病以后瘦了很多。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最近见过保罗吗？
messages.en: Have you seen Pawlu lately?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xxixxem ħafna minn meta marad.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xxixxem ħafna minn meta marad.
messages.zh: 见过，他自从生病以后瘦了很多。
messages.en: Yes, he has become very thin since he fell ill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“衣服变宽松”和“脸颊变瘦削”两个画面记住 xxixxem，分别对应干瘦与憔悴瘦削。

gloss_zh: 使震惊；使受到强烈冲击

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to feel strong surprise, distress, or dismay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到强烈的惊讶、不安或震惊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss sorpriża qawwija, dwejjaq jew biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使震惊；使惊愕；使受到强烈的心理冲击。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar l-inċident xxokkja lill-pubbliku minħabba d-dettalji serji li kien fih.
formal.en: The report about the incident shocked the public because of the serious details it contained.
formal.zh: 那份事故报告披露的严重情况使公众感到震惊。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kulħadd baqa' sieket? Mark: Il-kumment ta' Pawlu xxokkja lil kulħadd. Ħadd ma stenna kliem bħal dak.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did everyone go quiet? Mark: Pawlu's comment shocked everyone. Nobody expected words like that.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：大家怎么都不说话了？马克：保罗的那句话让所有人都震惊了。谁也没想到他会说那样的话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家怎么都不说话了？
messages.en: Why did everyone go quiet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumment ta' Pawlu xxokkja lil kulħadd. Ħadd ma stenna kliem bħal dak.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumment ta' Pawlu xxokkja lil kulħadd. Ħadd ma stenna kliem bħal dak.
messages.zh: 保罗的那句话让所有人都震惊了。谁也没想到他会说那样的话。
messages.en: Pawlu's comment shocked everyone. Nobody expected words like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxokkja 与英语 shock 的词形联系起来，想象听到意外消息后全场突然安静的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop an electrical short circuit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指电线、电器或电路发生短路。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu short circuit f'ċirkwit elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生短路。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tekniku jindika li l-apparat xxortja waqt it-test.
formal.en: The technical report indicates that the appliance short-circuited during the test.
formal.zh: 技术报告指出，该电器在测试期间发生了短路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaf jaħdem l-apparat? Mark: It-tekniku qal li xxortja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the appliance stop working? Mark: The technician said it short-circuited.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电器为什么不工作了？Mark：技术员说它短路了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 电器为什么不工作了？
messages.en: Why did the appliance stop working?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 技术员说它短路了。
messages.en: The technician said it short-circuited.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxortja 放进“电器突然停机，技术员判断短路”的画面中，连同 Il-kejbil xxortja 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove water or moisture from something by wiping or drying it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过擦拭或其他干燥方式，除去物体上的水分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi l-ilma jew l-umdità minn xi ħaġa billi jimsaħha jew jagħmilha niexfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦拭；擦干；使干燥。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, Lara xxotta l-mejda b'ċarruta nadifa.
formal.en: After cleaning, Lara wiped the table dry with a clean cloth.
formal.zh: 清洁之后，Lara 用一块干净的布把桌子擦干了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xxotta l-platti, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Iva, għandi xugaman nadif hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Dry the dishes, please. Mark: Yes, I have a clean towel here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：请把盘子擦干。Mark：好，我这里有一条干净的毛巾。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 请把盘子擦干。
messages.en: Dry the dishes, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我这里有一条干净的毛巾。
messages.en: Yes, I have a clean towel here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象洗完盘子后用毛巾擦去水珠，把 xxotta 与“湿盘子变干”的动作绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hit a target with a shot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过射击击中目标，强调射中这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jolqot mira bi sparatura.

sense_translations.en_definition: to shoot (to hit with a shot)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 射中；以射击击中目标。

collocations.en: hit the target with a shot
hit the can with a shot

formal.mt: Waqt il-kompetizzjoni, l-atleta xxottja l-mira mill-ewwel tentattiv.
formal.en: During the competition, the athlete hit the target with a shot on the first attempt.
formal.zh: 比赛中，这名运动员第一次尝试就射中了目标。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu xxottja l-mira? Mark: Iva, laqatha mill-ewwel!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu hit the target with his shot? Mark: Yes, he hit it on the first try!
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 射中目标了吗？Mark：射中了，他第一次就打中了！

messages.speaker: Maja (观赛朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 射中目标了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu hit the target with his shot?

messages.speaker: Mark (观赛朋友)
messages.zh: 射中了，他第一次就打中了！
messages.en: Yes, he hit it on the first try!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“瞄准、射击、命中靶心”三个连续画面记 xxottja；再与 xxotta“擦干”对照，注意拼写中多出的 j。

gloss_zh: 加高建筑；放松；削弱或阻碍

teaching_sense.en_definition: To raise the height of a building; to relax; or to undermine or hinder something, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境表示加高建筑、放松休息，或削弱及阻碍某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħolli binja; jirrilassa; jew idgħajjef jew ifixkel xi ħaġa, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加高建筑物；提高建筑物的高度。
放松；休息。
削弱；妨碍；阻碍。

collocations.en: raise the height of the building

formal.mt: Il-bennej xxoxxa l-binja b'sular ieħor, kif juri l-pjan.
formal.en: The builder raised the building by one additional storey, as shown in the plan.
formal.zh: 建筑工人按照图纸，为建筑物加高了一层。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi għamel Pawlu wara x-xogħol? Mark: Xxoxxa ftit fuq is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do after work? Mark: He relaxed on the sofa for a while.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 下班后做了什么？Mark：他在沙发上放松了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 下班后做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do after work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在沙发上放松了一会儿。
messages.en: He relaxed on the sofa for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xxoxxa 配三张独立卡片：“楼房加高”“沙发放松”“工作受阻”。分别记住语境，避免把三个义项硬套成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To absorb liquid, especially ink, with blotting paper in order to dry a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用吸墨纸吸去液体，尤其是墨水，使表面变干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jassorbi likwidu, speċjalment linka, b'karta assorbenti biex il-wiċċ jinxef.

sense_translations.en_definition: to blot, to dry with a blotting paper
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸干；用吸墨纸吸去水分或墨水。

formal.mt: L-istudent xxuga l-linka żejda b'karta assorbenti qabel għalaq il-pitazz.
formal.en: The student blotted the excess ink with blotting paper before closing the notebook.
formal.zh: 学生合上笔记本之前，用吸墨纸吸去了多余的墨水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm qatra linka fuq il-karta. Mark: Xxuga l-linka b'din il-karta assorbenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a drop of ink on the paper. Mark: Blot the ink with this blotting paper.
colloquial.zh: Maja：纸上有一滴墨水。Mark：用这张吸墨纸把墨水吸干。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 纸上有一滴墨水。
messages.en: There's a drop of ink on the paper.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 用这张吸墨纸把墨水吸干。
messages.en: Blot the ink with this blotting paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把吸墨纸轻压在墨滴上，纸吸走墨水；用这个具体动作记 xxuga，并与一般的 xxotta“擦干”区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material brought up from the stomach and expelled through the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从胃中经口吐出的东西，即呕吐物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li joħroġ mill-istonku minn ġol-ħalq meta wieħed jirremetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呕吐物；从胃里吐出的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li joħroġ mill-istonku minn ġol-ħalq meta wieħed jirremetti.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem naddaf ix-xħita mill-art u mbagħad ħasel iż-żona kollha.
formal.en: The worker cleaned the vomit off the floor and then washed the whole area.
formal.zh: 工作人员清除了地板上的呕吐物，随后清洗了整片区域。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Hemm xħita ħdejn is-sufan. Ġanni: Rajtha; se nġib il-barmil u nnaddaf.
colloquial.en: Marija: There's vomit next to the sofa. Ġanni: I saw it; I'll get the bucket and clean it up.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：沙发旁边有呕吐物。詹尼：我看见了；我去拿桶来清理。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 沙发旁边有呕吐物。
messages.en: There's vomit next to the sofa.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha; se nġib il-barmil u nnaddaf.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha; se nġib il-barmil u nnaddaf.
messages.zh: 我看见了；我去拿桶来清理。
messages.en: I saw it; I'll get the bucket and clean it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“地上有东西，需要拿桶清理”的场景：xħita 在本条中是呕吐出来的物质，是一个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人家族姓氏的专有名称，书写时首字母大写为Zahra。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏：Zahra。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Zahra ppreżentat ir-rapport waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Ms Zahra presented the report during the meeting.
formal.zh: Zahra女士在会议期间提交了报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jinkiteb il-kunjom tiegħek? | Anna: Zahra, b'Z kbira.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you spell your surname? | Anna: Zahra, with a capital Z.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的姓怎么写？ | Anna：Zahra，开头是大写Z。

messages.speaker: Maja (接待员)
messages.zh: 你的姓怎么写？
messages.en: How do you spell your surname?

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: Zahra，开头是大写Z。
messages.en: Zahra, with a capital Z.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象表格的“姓氏”栏填着Zahra，再配上“Zahra先生”的称呼，记住它是姓氏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk with one's feet dragging along the ground instead of lifting them clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时脚拖着地面，没有充分抬脚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi billi jkaxkar saqajh mal-art minflok jerfagħhom sew.

sense_translations.en_definition: to walk by dragging one's feet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖着脚走路；双脚擦着地面向前移动。

collocations.en: walked along the corridor dragging his feet

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, ir-raġel zakkak sal-bank u qagħad bilqiegħda.
formal.en: After the long walk, the man shuffled to the bench and sat down.
formal.zh: 长途步行后，那名男子拖着脚走到长椅旁坐下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark kien għajjien meta wasal id-dar? | Anna: Iva, zakkak sas-sufan u raqad mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Mark tired when he got home? | Anna: Yes, he shuffled to the sofa and fell asleep straight away.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark到家时很累吗？ | Anna：是啊，他拖着脚走到沙发旁，马上就睡着了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark kien għajjien meta wasal id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Mark kien għajjien meta wasal id-dar?
messages.zh: Mark到家时很累吗？
messages.en: Was Mark tired when he got home?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, zakkak sas-sufan u raqad mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, zakkak sas-sufan u raqad mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 是啊，他拖着脚走到沙发旁，马上就睡着了。
messages.en: Yes, he shuffled to the sofa and fell asleep straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鞋底一直擦着地板前进，把这个词和“脚不抬高、拖地走”的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname identifying a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示个人家族姓氏的专有名称，书写时首字母大写为Zammit。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏：Zammit。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Zammit ikkonferma l-parteċipazzjoni tiegħu fil-konferenza permezz ta' ittra.
formal.en: Mr Zammit confirmed his participation in the conference by letter.
formal.zh: Zammit先生通过信函确认了自己将参加会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-prenotazzjoni fuq liema kunjom hi? | Mark: Fuq Zammit, għal erba' persuni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What surname is the reservation under? | Mark: Zammit, for four people.
colloquial.zh: Maja：预订登记的是哪个姓？ | Mark：Zammit，四个人。

messages.speaker: Maja (餐厅接待员)
messages.zh: 预订登记的是哪个姓？
messages.en: What surname is the reservation under?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: Zammit，四个人。
messages.en: Zammit, for four people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Zammit写在餐厅预订卡的姓氏栏，特别留意中间两个m，连同大写Z一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The singing sounds made by birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟儿发出的鸣唱声，也可指鸟儿鸣唱这一活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kant tal-għasafar jew il-ħoss li jagħmlu meta jgħannu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟儿的鸣唱；鸟鸣声。

formal.mt: Kmieni filgħodu, iz-zamzim tal-għasafar kien jinstema' fil-ġnien kollu.
formal.en: Early in the morning, birdsong could be heard throughout the garden.
formal.zh: 清晨，整个花园里都能听到鸟儿的鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' z-zamzim barra? | Mark: Iva, hemm għasafar fis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear the birdsong outside? | Mark: Yes, there are birds in the tree beside the window.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听到外面的鸟鸣了吗？ | Mark：听到了，窗边的树上有鸟。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到外面的鸟鸣了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the birdsong outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm għasafar fis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm għasafar fis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 听到了，窗边的树上有鸟。
messages.en: Yes, there are birds in the tree beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读zamzim时配上清晨树上鸟儿轮番鸣唱的画面；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 容易跛行的；有跛行倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to limp when walking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时容易出现跛行、一瘸一拐的情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jimxi b'mod mhux indaqs, b'pass differenti fuq sieq waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有跛行倾向的；走路容易一瘸一拐的。

collocations.en: a man who tends to limp
a horse that tends to limp

formal.mt: Ir-raġel zappapi mexa bil-mod tul il-kuritur u waqaf ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: The man, who tended to limp, walked slowly along the corridor and stopped beside the door.
formal.zh: 那名走路容易跛行的男子沿走廊缓慢行走，在门边停了下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan iż-żiemel jimxi dejjem hekk? | Mark: Iva, hu zappapi; ejja nimxu bil-mod miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this horse always walk like that? | Mark: Yes, he tends to limp; let's walk slowly with him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这匹马走路一直这样吗？ | Mark：是的，它容易跛行；我们陪它慢慢走吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (骑马学员)
messages.zh: 这匹马走路一直这样吗？
messages.en: Does this horse always walk like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (马房工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu zappapi; ejja nimxu bil-mod miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu zappapi; ejja nimxu bil-mod miegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，它容易跛行；我们陪它慢慢走吧。
messages.en: Yes, he tends to limp; let's walk slowly with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象左右脚落地节奏不一致，把zappapi贴在人物描述卡上，记住它是表示跛行倾向的形容词。

gloss_zh: 工兵（负责修筑工事或战壕的士兵）
