teaching_sense.en_definition: A soldier whose work includes constructing fortifications or trenches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承担修筑防御工事或挖掘战壕等任务的士兵，即工兵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suldat li xogħlu jinkludi l-bini ta' fortifikazzjonijiet jew it-tħaffir ta' trinek.

sense_translations.en_definition: a sapper (soldier who constructs fortifications or trenches)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 工兵，指负责修筑防御工事或战壕的士兵。

collocations.zh: 一名工兵修筑防御工事

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju militari, iz-zappatur ħadem mat-tim biex iħaffer trinka u jibni fortifikazzjonijiet.
formal.en: During the military exercise, the sapper worked with the team to dig a trench and build fortifications.
formal.zh: 军事演习期间，这名工兵与团队一起挖掘战壕并修筑防御工事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħmel zappatur? | Mark: Hu suldat li jibni fortifikazzjonijiet jew iħaffer trinek.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does a sapper do? | Mark: He is a soldier who builds fortifications or digs trenches.
colloquial.zh: Maja：工兵是做什么的？ | Mark：他是修筑防御工事或挖掘战壕的士兵。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 工兵是做什么的？
messages.en: What does a sapper do?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu suldat li jibni fortifikazzjonijiet jew iħaffer trinek.
messages.mt_standard: Hu suldat li jibni fortifikazzjonijiet jew iħaffer trinek.
messages.zh: 他是修筑防御工事或挖掘战壕的士兵。
messages.en: He is a soldier who builds fortifications or digs trenches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把zappatur和“士兵拿工具挖战壕、筑工事”的画面绑定，用具体工作场景记住工兵这一身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hand tool used to loosen soil, remove weeds, or dig into the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于松土、除草或挖地的手工具，可指锄头或镐锄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-idejn li tintuża biex tħoll il-ħamrija, tneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin jew tħaffer l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锄头，用于松土、除草等农事的工具。
镐锄，用于刨挖地面、破开较硬土层的工具。

collocations.en: to remove weeds with a hoe

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żrigħ, il-bidwi uża zappuna biex iħoll il-ħamrija u jneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin.
formal.en: Before sowing, the farmer used a hoe to loosen the soil and remove weeds.
formal.zh: 播种前，农民用锄头松土并清除杂草。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi ż-zappuna? Irrid inneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin. Pawlu: Qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb tal-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the hoe? I want to remove the weeds. Pawlu: It's beside the garden gate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：锄头在哪里？我想除草。保罗：在花园门旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi ż-zappuna? Irrid inneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi ż-zappuna? Irrid inneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin.
messages.zh: 锄头在哪里？我想除草。
messages.en: Where is the hoe? I want to remove the weeds.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 在花园门旁边。
messages.en: It's beside the garden gate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zappuna 配上锄头刨土的画面，连记“松土、除草、挖地”三个用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who digs the ground using a mattock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用镐锄挖地的人，重点在于操作者而非工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħaffer l-art b'zappuna.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who digs with a mattock
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用镐锄刨挖土地的人。

collocations.en: a person digging with a mattock in the field
collocations.zh: 在田里用镐锄挖地的人

formal.mt: Iz-zappunar ħaffer l-art b'zappuna biex iħejji post għat-tħawwil.
formal.en: The mattock digger dug the ground with a mattock to prepare a place for planting.
formal.zh: 挖土工用镐锄挖地，为栽种准备一块地方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak iż-zappunar fl-għalqa? Toni: Hu ħija. Qed iħaffer post għas-siġra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that person digging with a mattock in the field? Toni: He's my brother. He's digging a place for the tree.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：田里那个用镐锄挖地的人是谁？托尼：是我兄弟。他正在挖一个种树的地方。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 田里那个用镐锄挖地的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that person digging with a mattock in the field?

messages.speaker: Toni (田地主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ħija. Qed iħaffer post għas-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ħija. Qed iħaffer post għas-siġra.
messages.zh: 是我兄弟。他正在挖一个种树的地方。
messages.en: He's my brother. He's digging a place for the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zappuna 的工具图片与 zappunar 的持锄人物图片并排记忆：前者是工具，后者是挖地的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk unevenly, with a limp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时步态不均，一瘸一拐地行走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi b'pass mhux indaqs, bħalma jagħmel min ma jistax jirfes sew fuq sieq waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跛行，一瘸一拐地走路。

formal.mt: Wara li weġġa' siequ waqt il-logħba, Mark beda jzapzap u ħareġ mill-grawnd.
formal.en: After hurting his foot during the game, Mark began to limp and left the pitch.
formal.zh: 马克在比赛中伤到脚后，开始一瘸一拐地走，并离开了球场。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed timxi hekk? Luqa: Ilbieraħ weġġajt sieqi. Illum bdejt nzapzap.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you walking like that? Luqa: I hurt my foot yesterday. Today I started limping.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么这样走路？卢卡：我昨天伤到脚了，今天开始一瘸一拐地走。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这样走路？
messages.en: Why are you walking like that?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilbieraħ weġġajt sieqi. Illum bdejt nzapzap.
messages.mt_standard: Ilbieraħ weġġajt sieqi. Illum bdejt nzapzap.
messages.zh: 我昨天伤到脚了，今天开始一瘸一拐地走。
messages.en: I hurt my foot yesterday. Today I started limping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 zapzap，就用手指模拟一轻一重的脚步，把重复字形和跛行的动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏 Zarb，用于标识个人所属的家族；作为姓名使用时首字母大写。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika persuna jew familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Zarb。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Zarb bagħat it-talba tiegħu bil-miktub lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Mr Zarb sent his request to the office in writing.
formal.zh: Zarb 先生向办公室提交了书面请求。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhu kunjomok? Daniel: Zarb. Jisimni Daniel Zarb.
colloquial.en: Marija: What's your surname? Daniel: Zarb. My name is Daniel Zarb.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你姓什么？丹尼尔：Zarb。我叫 Daniel Zarb。

messages.speaker: Marija (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: Daniel (来访者)
messages.zh: Zarb。我叫 Daniel Zarb。
messages.en: Zarb. My name is Daniel Zarb.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着 Daniel Zarb 的名牌，把 Zarb 放进“姓氏”一栏，并记住姓名中的大写 Z。

gloss_zh: 爱啾啾叫的；常发雏鸟般细叫声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to make short, high-pitched cheeping sounds like a young bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易或经常发出像雏鸟一样短促、尖细的啾啾声的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel ħsejjes qosra u rqaq bħal għasfur żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱发出啾啾细叫声的，像刚长羽毛的幼鸟那样。

formal.mt: L-għasfur żgħir kien zejjiezi u kien jagħmel ħsejjes qosra u rqaq meta jersaq xi ħadd lejn il-bejta.
formal.en: The young bird was prone to cheeping and made short, high-pitched sounds when someone approached the nest.
formal.zh: 这只幼鸟爱啾啾叫，每当有人靠近鸟巢时，就会发出短促、尖细的声音。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-għasfur zejjiezi ħafna! Ben: Iva, isma' dawk il-ħsejjes irqaq.
colloquial.en: Nina: This bird really likes to cheep! Ben: Yes, listen to those high-pitched little sounds.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这只鸟真爱啾啾叫！本：是啊，听听那些尖细的小叫声。

messages.speaker: Nina (观鸟爱好者)
messages.zh: 这只鸟真爱啾啾叫！
messages.en: This bird really likes to cheep!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，听听那些尖细的小叫声。
messages.en: Yes, listen to those high-pitched little sounds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 zejjiezi 配一只不断张嘴细叫的雏鸟，记成“爱啾啾叫的”这一声音特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or institution where coins are produced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制造硬币的建筑或机构，即铸币厂或铸币机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew istituzzjoni fejn jinħadmu l-muniti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铸币厂或铸币机构，即制造硬币的场所或机构。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif jinħadmu l-muniti fiz-zekka u kif tiġi ċċekkjata l-kwalità tagħhom.
formal.en: The report describes how coins are produced at the mint and how their quality is checked.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了铸币厂制造硬币以及检查硬币质量的过程。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Fejn isiru l-muniti? Mark: Fiz-zekka. Hemm jinħadmu l-muniti.
colloquial.en: Eva: Where are coins made? Mark: At the mint. That's where coins are produced.
colloquial.zh: 伊娃：硬币在哪里制造？马克：在铸币厂。那里就是制造硬币的地方。

messages.speaker: Eva (学生)
messages.zh: 硬币在哪里制造？
messages.en: Where are coins made?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 在铸币厂。那里就是制造硬币的地方。
messages.en: At the mint. That's where coins are produced.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zekka 想成一座不断产出硬币的工厂，看到这个词就联想“硬币制造机构”。

gloss_zh: 爱传闲话的人；搬弄是非者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who spreads gossip about other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 传播他人闲话或流言的人，通常带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xxerred it-tpaċpiċ dwar ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱传播闲话、散布流言或搬弄是非的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-zekziek tal-viċinat ixerred stejjer dwar nies oħra mingħajr ma jiċċekkja jekk humiex veri.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbourhood gossip-monger spreads stories about other people without checking whether they are true.
formal.zh: 故事中，街坊里那个爱传闲话的人未经核实，就四处传播关于别人的传闻。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nista' nafda lil dak ir-raġel b'sigriet? Rita: Aħjar le. Hu zekziek u jgħid kollox lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can I trust that man with a secret? Rita: Better not. He's a gossip-monger and tells everyone everything.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我能把秘密告诉那个男人吗？丽塔：最好别。他爱传闲话，什么都告诉别人。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nafda lil dak ir-raġel b'sigriet?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nafda lil dak ir-raġel b'sigriet?
messages.zh: 我能把秘密告诉那个男人吗？
messages.en: Can I trust that man with a secret?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le. Hu zekziek u jgħid kollox lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le. Hu zekziek u jgħid kollox lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 最好别。他爱传闲话，什么都告诉别人。
messages.en: Better not. He's a gossip-monger and tells everyone everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zekziek 画成四处转述闲话的人物，记住它是给“人”贴的名词标签。

gloss_zh: 爱说闲话的；爱传流言的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to gossip or spread talk about other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有谈论或传播他人闲话倾向的，通常带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jzekzek u jxerred it-tpaċpiċ dwar ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱说闲话的，倾向于谈论或传播别人私事的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-ġar bħala raġel zekzieki li spiss jitkellem dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: The author describes the neighbour as a gossipy man who often talks about other people's private lives.
formal.zh: 作者把这位邻居描写成一个爱说闲话的男人，经常谈论别人的私生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Paul dejjem jitkellem dwar il-ġirien. Toni: Iva, hu zekzieki ħafna. Ejja nibdlu s-suġġett.
colloquial.en: Lara: Paul is always talking about the neighbours. Toni: Yes, he's very gossipy. Let's change the subject.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗总在议论邻居。托尼：是啊，他特别爱说闲话。我们换个话题吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗总在议论邻居。
messages.en: Paul is always talking about the neighbours.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu zekzieki ħafna. Ejja nibdlu s-suġġett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu zekzieki ħafna. Ejja nibdlu s-suġġett.
messages.zh: 是啊，他特别爱说闲话。我们换个话题吧。
messages.en: Yes, he's very gossipy. Let's change the subject.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zekzieki 放进“这个人很爱说闲话”的句子里，与指人的名词 zekziek 对照，记住它描述人的倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hissing sound, or the activity of gossiping about other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嘶嘶作响的声音；也指谈论他人私事、传播闲言碎语的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss bħal tissif, jew diskors dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出嘶嘶声；嘶嘶作响。
说闲话；谈论他人私事或传播闲言碎语。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi z-zekzik tas-serp meta xi ħadd resaq lejn il-gaġġa.
formal.en: The report describes the snake's hissing when someone approached the cage.
formal.zh: 报告描述了有人靠近笼子时蛇发出的嘶嘶声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx tibqa' hawn? Rita: Hemm wisq zekzik dwar il-ġirien. Nippreferi nitkellem fuq xi ħaġa oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to stay here? Rita: There's too much gossiping about the neighbours. I'd rather talk about something else.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不想继续待在这里？丽塔：这里议论邻居的闲话太多了。我更想聊点别的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想继续待在这里？
messages.en: Why don't you want to stay here?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm wisq zekzik dwar il-ġirien. Nippreferi nitkellem fuq xi ħaġa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm wisq zekzik dwar il-ġirien. Nippreferi nitkellem fuq xi ħaġa oħra.
messages.zh: 这里议论邻居的闲话太多了。我更想聊点别的。
messages.en: There's too much gossiping about the neighbours. I'd rather talk about something else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zekzik 配上两幅学习图：一幅是蛇发出嘶嘶声，一幅是人凑在一起说闲话；通过场景区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who clashes cymbals together to make a sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容将两片铙钹相互碰击、使其发声的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li ddoqq iċ-ċimbali billi tħabbathom ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敲击铙钹的；用来形容将铙钹相互碰击的人。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi mużiċist zenzien li jdoqq iċ-ċimbali waqt il-marċ.
formal.en: The text describes a musician who clashes cymbals during the march.
formal.zh: 课文描述了一位在进行曲演奏时敲击铙钹的乐手。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser zenzien hawn? Pawlu: Jiddeskrivi lil dak ir-raġel li qed iħabbat iċ-ċimbali ma' xulxin.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does zenzien mean here? Pawlu: It describes that man who is clashing the cymbals together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 zenzien 是什么意思？保罗：它形容那个正在碰击铙钹的男子。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 zenzien 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does zenzien mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiddeskrivi lil dak ir-raġel li qed iħabbat iċ-ċimbali ma' xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Jiddeskrivi lil dak ir-raġel li qed iħabbat iċ-ċimbali ma' xulxin.
messages.zh: 它形容那个正在碰击铙钹的男子。
messages.en: It describes that man who is clashing the cymbals together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 zenzien 时，把注意力放在拿着两片铙钹的演奏者身上：本条形容的是敲钹的人，记忆画面以人物为中心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing a clashing sound, such as the sound made when cymbals strike together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出铿锵碰击声的，例如铙钹相互碰击时发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jipproduċi ħoss bħal dak taċ-ċimbali meta jitħabtu ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出铿锵碰击声的；发出类似铙钹相撞声音的。

collocations.en: an instrument that produces a clashing sound
collocations.zh: 发出铿锵碰击声的乐器

collocations.en: an object that produces a clashing sound
collocations.zh: 发出铿锵碰击声的物体

formal.mt: L-istudent għażel strument zenzieni biex joħloq ħoss ta' metall jitħabbat waqt ir-rappreżentazzjoni.
formal.en: The student chose an instrument that produces a clashing sound to create the sound of colliding metal during the performance.
formal.zh: 这名学生选择了一件能发出铿锵碰击声的乐器，用于在表演中制造金属相撞的声音。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex sejjaħtlu strument zenzieni? Mark: Għax meta ndoqqu jagħmel ħoss bħal ċimbali jitħabtu ma' xulxin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you call it a clashing-sounding instrument? Mark: Because when I play it, it makes a sound like cymbals clashing together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么说这件乐器会发出铿锵碰击声？马克：因为我演奏它时，它会发出像铙钹相撞一样的声音。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说这件乐器会发出铿锵碰击声？
messages.en: Why did you call it a clashing-sounding instrument?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax meta ndoqqu jagħmel ħoss bħal ċimbali jitħabtu ma' xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax meta ndoqqu jagħmel ħoss bħal ċimbali jitħabtu ma' xulxin.
messages.zh: 因为我演奏它时，它会发出像铙钹相撞一样的声音。
messages.en: Because when I play it, it makes a sound like cymbals clashing together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 zenzieni 配一件正在发出金属碰击声的乐器，旁边写上“会发出铿锵声的”，用声音特征帮助记住形容词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A clashing sound, especially a sound like cymbals striking together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体相互碰击时发出的铿锵声，尤指类似铙钹相撞的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss li jinstema' meta oġġetti jitħabtu ma' xulxin, bħal dak taċ-ċimbali.

sense_translations.en_definition: clashing sound (e.g. the sound of cymbals)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 铿锵的碰击声，例如铙钹相互碰击时的声音。

formal.mt: Iż-zenzin taċ-ċimbali mmarka t-tmiem tas-silta mużikali.
formal.en: The clash of the cymbals marked the end of the musical passage.
formal.zh: 铙钹的铿锵声标志着这一乐段的结束。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt dak iż-zenzin qawwi? Toni: Iva, kienu ċ-ċimbali. Il-banda qed tagħmel prova.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear that loud clashing sound? Toni: Yes, it was the cymbals. The band is rehearsing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见刚才那声响亮的碰击声了吗？托尼：听见了，是铙钹的声音。乐队正在排练。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见刚才那声响亮的碰击声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that loud clashing sound?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienu ċ-ċimbali. Il-banda qed tagħmel prova.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienu ċ-ċimbali. Il-banda qed tagħmel prova.
messages.zh: 听见了，是铙钹的声音。乐队正在排练。
messages.en: Yes, it was the cymbals. The band is rehearsing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zenzin 记成演奏结束时耳边响起的一声“锵”：这是声音名词，可以用“听见一阵铿锵声”的场景来复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing, when speaking of certain kinds of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸣唱、啼鸣，用于描述某些种类的鸟发出歌唱般的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal ċerti tipi ta' għasafar meta joħorġu għana.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used of certain types of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱；啼鸣，用于某些种类的鸟。

collocations.en: sang at dawn, of a bird

formal.mt: L-għasfur zeplet mas-sebħ waqt li l-osservatur kien qed jieħu n-noti.
formal.en: The bird sang at dawn while the observer was taking notes.
formal.zh: 观察者做记录时，那只鸟在黎明中鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Smajt l-għasfur ħdejn it-tieqa? Ġanni: Iva, zeplet kmieni dalgħodu u qajjimni.
colloquial.en: Lina: Did you hear the bird near the window? Ġanni: Yes, it sang early this morning and woke me up.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你听见窗边那只鸟的叫声了吗？詹尼：听见了，它今天一大早就鸣唱，把我叫醒了。

messages.speaker: Lina (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见窗边那只鸟的叫声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the bird near the window?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, zeplet kmieni dalgħodu u qajjimni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, zeplet kmieni dalgħodu u qajjimni.
messages.zh: 听见了，它今天一大早就鸣唱，把我叫醒了。
messages.en: Yes, it sang early this morning and woke me up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zeplet 放进“清晨窗边，一只鸟开口鸣唱”的画面中；记住动作的主角是某些鸟，整句联想比孤立背词更清楚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏 Zerafa，可音译为“泽拉法”，用于人名中的姓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala parti minn isem persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏：Zerafa（泽拉法）。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Zerafa se jattendi l-laqgħa bħala rappreżentant tal-iskola.
formal.en: Mr Zerafa will attend the meeting as a representative of the school.
formal.zh: 泽拉法先生将作为学校代表出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'kunjom għandek? Mark: Zerafa. Jien Mark Zerafa.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's your surname? Mark: Zerafa. I'm Mark Zerafa.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你姓什么？马克：泽拉法。我叫马克·泽拉法。

messages.speaker: Anna (新同学)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 泽拉法。我叫马克·泽拉法。
messages.en: Zerafa. I'm Mark Zerafa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着“Mark Zerafa”的姓名卡，把 Zerafa 框在姓氏栏中；作为姓氏书写时首字母大写，用姓名卡帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing, as certain types of birds do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某些种类的鸟鸣唱，发出歌唱般的啼鸣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal ċerti tipi ta' għasafar meta joħorġu għana.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used of certain types of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱；啼鸣，用于某些种类的鸟。

collocations.en: sang on a branch, of a bird

formal.mt: L-għasfur zerzer fuq fergħa waqt l-osservazzjoni ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The bird sang on a branch during the morning observation.
formal.zh: 在上午的观察过程中，那只鸟站在树枝上鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex waqaft taħt is-siġra? David: Għax għasfur zerzer fuq fergħa u ridt nisimgħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you stop under the tree? David: Because a bird sang on a branch and I wanted to listen to it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么在树下停住了？戴维：因为一只鸟在树枝上鸣唱，我想听听。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在树下停住了？
messages.en: Why did you stop under the tree?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għasfur zerzer fuq fergħa u ridt nisimgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għasfur zerzer fuq fergħa u ridt nisimgħu.
messages.zh: 因为一只鸟在树枝上鸣唱，我想听听。
messages.en: Because a bird sang on a branch and I wanted to listen to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zerzer 写在“树枝上的鸟正在鸣唱”的动作卡上，朗读 l-għasfur zerzer，用主语加动作的短句记住它是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The singing of birds, understood as their vocal activity or the sound it produces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟的鸣唱活动，或由此发出的鸟鸣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għana tal-għasafar jew il-ħoss li jagħmlu meta jgħannu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟的鸣唱；鸟鸣声。

formal.mt: Matul il-mixja edukattiva, l-istudenti waqfu biex jisimgħu ż-zerzir tal-għasafar.
formal.en: During the educational walk, the students stopped to listen to the birds singing.
formal.zh: 在教学步行活动中，学生们停下来聆听鸟儿的鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'qed tisma' daqshekk bil-kwiet? Samwel: Iż-zerzir tal-għasafar fil-ġnien. Iftaħ it-tieqa u tismagħhom ukoll.
colloquial.en: Rita: What are you listening to so quietly? Samwel: The birds singing in the garden. Open the window and you'll hear them too.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你这么安静地在听什么？萨姆韦尔：花园里的鸟鸣。打开窗户，你也能听见。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 你这么安静地在听什么？
messages.en: What are you listening to so quietly?

messages.speaker: Samwel (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-zerzir tal-għasafar fil-ġnien. Iftaħ it-tieqa u tismagħhom ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iż-zerzir tal-għasafar fil-ġnien. Iftaħ it-tieqa u tismagħhom ukoll.
messages.zh: 花园里的鸟鸣。打开窗户，你也能听见。
messages.en: The birds singing in the garden. Open the window and you'll hear them too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zerzir 写在一段花园鸟鸣录音的标签上，记成可以“听见”的鸟鸣声；再与动作句里的 zerzer 对照，帮助区分名词和动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bird called a starling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸟，中文称为椋鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bħala zerzur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 椋鸟。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw zerzur fuq fergħa.
formal.en: During the birdwatching activity, the students saw a starling on a branch.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们看见一只椋鸟停在树枝上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-ħajt. X'inhu? | Mark: Dak zerzur. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that bird on the wall. What is it? | Mark: That's a starling. Let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看墙上那只鸟。那是什么鸟？ | Mark：那是椋鸟。我们在这里看看它吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-ħajt. X'inhu?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-ħajt. X'inhu?
messages.zh: 看墙上那只鸟。那是什么鸟？
messages.en: Look at that bird on the wall. What is it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak zerzur. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Dak zerzur. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.zh: 那是椋鸟。我们在这里看看它吧。
messages.en: That's a starling. Let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zerzur 配上树枝上一只椋鸟的画面，反复用“看见椋鸟”练习记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing a lot of sugar or having a strongly sweet taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容食物或饮料含糖多，或具有明显的甜味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ħafna zokkor jew li għandu togħma ħelwa ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含糖多的；糖味浓的；甜腻的。

formal.mt: Fil-kwestjonarju, il-parteċipanti indikaw kemm-il darba fil-ġimgħa jixorbu xorb zokkri.
formal.en: In the questionnaire, participants indicated how often they consume sugary drinks each week.
formal.zh: 在问卷中，参与者填写了自己每周饮用含糖饮料的频率。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit minn dan il-meraq? | Ben: Le, grazzi. Għalija huwa zokkri wisq. Nippreferi l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some of this juice? | Ben: No, thanks. It's too sugary for me. I prefer water.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想喝一点这个果汁吗？ | Ben：不了，谢谢。对我来说太甜了。我更想喝水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想喝一点这个果汁吗？
messages.en: Would you like some of this juice?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Għalija huwa zokkri wisq. Nippreferi l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Għalija huwa zokkri wisq. Nippreferi l-ilma.
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。对我来说太甜了。我更想喝水。
messages.en: No, thanks. It's too sugary for me. I prefer water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象喝下一口甜得发腻的饮料，用 zokkri 标记那种“糖味太浓”的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small container used to hold sugar for serving with tea, coffee, or other food and drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盛放供取用的糖的小容器，常放在茶或咖啡旁边。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent żgħir li fih jinżamm iz-zokkor biex jintuża mat-te, mal-kafè jew ma' ikel u xorb ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 糖罐；供餐桌上取糖用的糖钵。

collocations.en: the lid of the sugar bowl

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, tqiegħdet zukkariera ħdejn il-kikkri tal-kafè.
formal.en: Before the meeting, a sugar bowl was placed beside the coffee cups.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，工作人员在咖啡杯旁放了一只糖罐。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tista' tgħaddili z-zukkariera, jekk jogħġbok? | Pawlu: Żgur. Qiegħda ħdejn il-ħalib.
colloquial.en: Anna: Could you pass me the sugar bowl, please? | Pawlu: Of course. It's next to the milk.
colloquial.zh: Anna：麻烦把糖罐递给我，好吗？ | Pawlu：当然。它就在牛奶旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (客人)
messages.zh: 麻烦把糖罐递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the sugar bowl, please?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (主人)
messages.zh: 当然。它就在牛奶旁边。
messages.en: Of course. It's next to the milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zukkariera 想成咖啡杯旁带盖的小糖罐，取糖时就在心里念一次。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Zucchini or courgette, a vegetable usually eaten while young and tender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西葫芦，一种通常在幼嫩时食用的瓜类蔬菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix magħruf ukoll bħala qarabagħli, li normalment jittiekel meta jkun għadu żgħir u tari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西葫芦；英语 zucchini 和 courgette 所指的蔬菜。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aqta' z-zukkini f'biċċiet żgħar u żidu mas-soppa.
formal.en: For this recipe, cut the zucchini into small pieces and add it to the soup.
formal.zh: 按这份食谱，把西葫芦切成小块，再加入汤中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'se nagħmlu biz-zukkini llejla? | Sam: Nistgħu nqattgħuh u nsajruh mal-għaġin.
colloquial.en: Rita: What shall we do with the zucchini tonight? | Sam: We can chop it up and cook it with pasta.
colloquial.zh: Rita：今晚我们怎么做西葫芦？ | Sam：可以把它切碎，和意大利面一起煮。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 今晚我们怎么做西葫芦？
messages.en: What shall we do with the zucchini tonight?

messages.speaker: Sam (室友)
messages.zh: 可以把它切碎，和意大利面一起煮。
messages.en: We can chop it up and cook it with pasta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zukkini 与切西葫芦做汤的厨房画面绑定，看到瓜块就回想这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes someone else to walk unsteadily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使另一个人走路不稳的人，重点在于造成他人的步态不稳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil persuna oħra timxi b'mod instabbli.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who causes another to walk unsteadily
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使另一个人走路不稳的人。

collocations.en: someone who causes another person to walk unsteadily
the role of someone who causes another person to walk unsteadily
collocations.zh: 使别人走路不稳者的角色

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rakkont, il-karattru ġie deskritt bħala zuppjatur għax ġiegħel lil persuna oħra timxi b'mod instabbli.
formal.en: In the analysis of the story, the character was described as someone who caused another person to walk unsteadily.
formal.zh: 在故事分析中，这个角色被描述为使另一个人走路不稳的人。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser zuppjatur f'din is-sentenza? | Toni: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd ieħor jimxi b'mod instabbli.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does zuppjatur mean in this sentence? | Toni: A person who causes someone else to walk unsteadily.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这句话里的 zuppjatur 是什么意思？ | Toni：指使另一个人走路不稳的人。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 zuppjatur 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does zuppjatur mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd ieħor jimxi b'mod instabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd ieħor jimxi b'mod instabbli.
messages.zh: 指使另一个人走路不稳的人。
messages.en: A person who causes someone else to walk unsteadily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个人和一支因果箭头：zuppjatur 指造成别人走不稳的那个人，记住施事身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of having difficulty walking normally because of a problem affecting a leg or foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腿或脚出现问题而不能正常行走的状态，表现为跛行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha persuna ma tkunx tista' timxi b'mod normali minħabba problema f'riġel jew f'sieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跛行；因腿脚问题而行走不正常的状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddeskriva zuppjatura ħafifa waqt il-mixi.
formal.en: The report described slight lameness while walking.
formal.zh: 报告描述了行走时出现的轻微跛行。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għadek timxi b'zuppjatura? | David: Iva, ftit. Illum se nimxi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are you still walking with a limp? | David: Yes, a little. I'll walk slowly today.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你走路还是有点跛吗？ | David：是的，还有一点。今天我会慢慢走。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你走路还是有点跛吗？
messages.en: Are you still walking with a limp?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit. Illum se nimxi bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit. Illum se nimxi bil-mod.
messages.zh: 是的，还有一点。今天我会慢慢走。
messages.en: Yes, a little. I'll walk slowly today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zuppjatura 放在“跛行状态”的图卡上，想象左右步伐不均，记住它是状态名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin walking with a limp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始一瘸一拐地走路，强调跛行的开始。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jimxi b'zuppjatura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始跛行；开始一瘸一拐地走路。

formal.mt: Wara li waqa' fit-taraġ, ir-raġel zzappap u mexa bil-mod lejn il-bieb.
formal.en: After falling on the stairs, the man started limping and walked slowly towards the door.
formal.zh: 在楼梯上摔倒后，那名男子开始跛行，慢慢走向门口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaf jiġri Mark? | Luke: Wara li żelaq, zzappap. Issa qiegħed jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark stop running? | Luke: After he slipped, he started limping. He's resting now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 为什么不跑了？ | Luke：他滑了一下后就开始跛行了。现在正在休息。

messages.speaker: Sara (队友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么不跑了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop running?

messages.speaker: Luke (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara li żelaq, zzappap. Issa qiegħed jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Wara li żelaq, zzappap. Issa qiegħed jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他滑了一下后就开始跛行了。现在正在休息。
messages.en: After he slipped, he started limping. He's resting now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用连续两幅画记 zzappap：先正常走，随后开始一瘸一拐，重点记住“开始”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be limp, lacking firmness or strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈现松软、无力或软垂的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun mitluq u bla saħħa jew fermezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呈松软无力的状态；软垂。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, id-driegħ tal-karattru zzoppja u baqa' mdendel ma' ġenbu.
formal.en: In the story, the character's arm was limp and hung by his side.
formal.zh: 在故事中，人物的手臂软垂无力，耷拉在身体一侧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser meta naqraw li driegħ il-karattru zzoppja? | Adam: Li kien mitluq u mdendel bla saħħa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does it mean when we read that the character's arm was limp? | Adam: It means it was loose and hanging without strength.
colloquial.zh: Nina：读到人物的手臂 zzoppja，是什么意思？ | Adam：意思是手臂松软无力地垂着。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser meta naqraw li driegħ il-karattru zzoppja?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser meta naqraw li driegħ il-karattru zzoppja?
messages.zh: 读到人物的手臂 zzoppja，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean when we read that the character's arm was limp?

messages.speaker: Adam (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li kien mitluq u mdendel bla saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Li kien mitluq u mdendel bla saħħa.
messages.zh: 意思是手臂松软无力地垂着。
messages.en: It means it was loose and hanging without strength.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象布偶的手臂松软地垂下来，把 zzoppja 与“软垂无力”的姿态一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut back branches or other parts of a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剪去植物的部分枝条等，对植物进行修剪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' xi friegħi jew partijiet oħra ta' pjanta biex jirranġaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修剪植物；修枝。
修枝者；从事植物修剪的人。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar żabbar is-siġra u neħħa l-friegħi niexfa.
formal.en: The gardener pruned the tree and removed the dry branches.
formal.zh: 园丁修剪了树木，并除去了干枯的枝条。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min żabbar id-dielja? Mark: Ġie żabbar tas-sengħa dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who pruned the grapevine? Mark: A skilled pruner came this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁修剪了葡萄藤？Mark：今天早上来了一位熟练的修枝工。

messages.speaker: Maja (花园主人)
messages.zh: 谁修剪了葡萄藤？
messages.en: Who pruned the grapevine?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 今天早上来了一位熟练的修枝工。
messages.en: A skilled pruner came this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把同一画面分成“修枝动作”和“拿剪刀的人”：żabbar 作动词表示修剪，作名词表示修枝者，依句中位置辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aloe plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 芦荟，一种植物的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bħala aloe.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芦荟。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-botanika, l-istudenti osservaw żabbara u ddeskrivew il-weraq tagħha.
formal.en: In the botany lesson, the students observed an aloe and described its leaves.
formal.zh: 植物学课上，学生们观察了一株芦荟，并描述了它的叶子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-pjanta ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Dik żabbara. Xtrajtha lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that plant by the window? Mark: That's an aloe. I bought it yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：窗边那是什么植物？Mark：那是芦荟，我昨天买的。

messages.speaker: Maja (来访朋友)
messages.zh: 窗边那是什么植物？
messages.en: What's that plant by the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.zh: 那是芦荟，我昨天买的。
messages.en: That's an aloe. I bought it yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给窗台上的一盆芦荟贴上 żabbara 标签，每次想起这幅画面就说“盆栽芦荟”；把完整词形作为植物名称记住。

gloss_zh: 来自 Żabbar 的；用于修枝的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who comes from Żabbar, or something that prunes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人来自 Żabbar，或形容某物具有修枝功能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Ħaż-Żabbar, meta jirreferi għal persuna; jew li jiżbor, meta jirreferi għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自 Żabbar 的，用于形容人。
具有修枝功能的；用于修剪枝条的，用于形容物。

collocations.zh: 一位来自 Żabbar 的艺术家

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-wirja jippreżenta lil Mark bħala artist żabbari.
formal.en: The exhibition programme introduces Mark as an artist from Żabbar.
formal.zh: 展览节目册将 Mark 介绍为一位来自 Żabbar 的艺术家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-apparat għal xiex jintuża? Mark: Huwa apparat żabbari: jintuża biex jaqta' l-friegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this equipment used for? Mark: It's pruning equipment: it's used to cut branches.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这台设备是做什么用的？Mark：这是修枝设备，用来剪枝条。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这台设备是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this equipment used for?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa apparat żabbari: jintuża biex jaqta' l-friegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa apparat żabbari: jintuża biex jaqta' l-friegħi.
messages.zh: 这是修枝设备，用来剪枝条。
messages.en: It's pruning equipment: it's used to cut branches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 żabbari 画两张标签：人物旁写“来自 Żabbar”，机器旁写“用于修枝”。先看它修饰人还是物，再选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexual intercourse outside marriage, or masturbation, depending on the sense intended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依具体义项，指婚姻关系之外的性交，或指自慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att sesswali barra ż-żwieġ, jew masturbazzjoni, skont is-sens maħsub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非婚性交；婚姻关系之外的性行为。
自慰；对自身进行性刺激的行为。

collocations.en: żabbib in the sense of masturbation

formal.mt: F'din is-sentenza, il-kelma 'żabbib' tirreferi għal att sesswali barra ż-żwieġ; fis-sentenza li jmiss, tirreferi għall-masturbazzjoni.
formal.en: In this sentence, the word 'żabbib' refers to sexual intercourse outside marriage; in the next sentence, it refers to masturbation.
formal.zh: 在这句话中，żabbib 指非婚性交；在下一句话中，它指自慰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'żabbib' hawn? Mark: Hawn tfisser masturbazzjoni. Maja: U fl-eżempju l-ieħor? Mark: Hemm tfisser att sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'żabbib' mean here? Mark: Here it means masturbation. Maja: And in the other example? Mark: There it means sexual intercourse outside marriage.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 żabbib 是什么意思？Mark：这里指自慰。Maja：那另一个例子呢？Mark：那个例子里指非婚性交。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 żabbib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żabbib' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 这里指自慰。
messages.en: Here it means masturbation.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 那另一个例子呢？
messages.en: And in the other example?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tfisser att sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tfisser att sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
messages.zh: 那个例子里指非婚性交。
messages.en: There it means sexual intercourse outside marriage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żabbib 的两个义项分写在两张卡上：一张写“非婚性行为”，一张写“自慰”，阅读时靠上下文选卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fill something by stuffing material into it, or to make a space or passage congested.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西塞入某个容器使其填满，或使某个空间、通道拥塞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Timla xi ħaġa billi ddaħħal ħafna materjal fiha, jew tagħmel spazju jew passaġġ imblukkat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西塞进去；塞满。
使拥塞；使堵塞。

collocations.en: he stuffed the bag with clothes
he congested the passage with boxes
collocations.zh: 他用箱子把通道堵住了

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żadam il-passaġġ bil-kaxxi, u b'hekk għamel id-dħul fil-maħżen diffiċli.
formal.en: The worker congested the passage with boxes, making access to the storeroom difficult.
formal.zh: 工人把箱子堆在通道里，造成堵塞，使人难以进入储藏室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-borża ma tingħalaqx? Mark: Pawlu żadamha bil-ħwejjeġ. Maja: Mela nneħħu ftit minnhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why won't the bag close? Mark: Pawlu stuffed it with clothes. Maja: Then let's take some of them out.
colloquial.zh: Maja：袋子怎么合不上？Mark：Pawlu 往里面塞满了衣服。Maja：那我们拿一些出来吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 袋子怎么合不上？
messages.en: Why won't the bag close?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 往里面塞满了衣服。
messages.en: Pawlu stuffed it with clothes.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们拿一些出来吧。
messages.en: Then let's take some of them out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“袋子塞满、通道堵满”两幅画记住 żadam：共同点都是东西太多，把空间占住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pack things closely together or stuff material into a container or space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西紧密地装在一起，或把材料塞进容器、空间中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed l-affarijiet qrib ħafna ta' xulxin, jew timla kontenitur jew spazju b'materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西紧密装填；压紧装入。
塞入；塞满。

collocations.en: he packed the box tightly with books
collocations.zh: 他把书紧紧装进箱子里

collocations.en: he stuffed the bag with papers

formal.mt: L-assistent żadd il-kaxxa bil-kotba sakemm ma baqax spazju vojt fiha.
formal.en: The assistant packed the box tightly with books until no empty space remained inside.
formal.zh: 助手把书紧紧装进箱子里，直到里面没有空隙。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min żadd din il-kaxxa bil-kotba? Pawlu: Jien. Ridt indaħħalhom kollha. Sara: Issa tqila wisq biex nerfagħha waħdi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who packed this box so tightly with books? Pawlu: I did. I wanted to fit them all in. Sara: Now it's too heavy for me to lift on my own.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁把这个箱子塞得满满都是书？Pawlu：我。我想把书全装进去。Sara：现在太重了，我一个人搬不动。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把这个箱子塞得满满都是书？
messages.en: Who packed this box so tightly with books?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我。我想把书全装进去。
messages.en: I did. I wanted to fit them all in.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa tqila wisq biex nerfagħha waħdi.
messages.mt_standard: Issa tqila wisq biex nerfagħha waħdi.
messages.zh: 现在太重了，我一个人搬不动。
messages.en: Now it's too heavy for me to lift on my own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 żadd 时想象把书一本本紧挤进箱子，最后连空隙也没有；用“紧装、塞满”固定动作画面。

gloss_zh: 使鼻塞；造成鼻塞的黏液

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make the nose blocked or congested.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使鼻腔堵塞，造成鼻塞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel l-imnieħer misdud.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause the nose to be congested
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使鼻子堵塞；引起鼻塞。
造成鼻塞的鼻腔黏液。

collocations.en: the mucus causing congestion in the nose
collocations.zh: 鼻腔内造成堵塞的黏液

formal.mt: It-trab żaddam imnieħer Mark. Hawnhekk, 'żaddam' huwa verb li jfisser li xi ħaġa għamlet l-imnieħer misdud.
formal.en: The dust made Mark's nose congested. Here, 'żaddam' is a verb meaning that something caused the nose to become blocked.
formal.zh: 灰尘使 Mark 鼻塞。这里的 żaddam 是动词，表示某种东西使鼻子发生堵塞。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan iż-żaddam qed idejjaqni. Sara: Għandek bżonn maktur? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: This mucus blocking my nose is bothering me. Sara: Do you need a tissue? Mark: Yes, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这些堵住鼻子的黏液让我很难受。Sara：你需要纸巾吗？Mark：需要，麻烦你了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些堵住鼻子的黏液让我很难受。
messages.en: This mucus blocking my nose is bothering me.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你需要纸巾吗？
messages.en: Do you need a tissue?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 需要，麻烦你了。
messages.en: Yes, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żaddam 画两张鼻子图：动词图写“使鼻塞”，名词图指向“堵鼻黏液”，把词性和含义一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Filled by stuffing, or blocked and congested.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被东西塞满的，或处于堵塞、不通畅状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mimli b'affarijiet imdaħħlin fih, jew misdud.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞满的；装得满满的。
堵塞的；不通畅的。

formal.mt: Il-basket żaddami bil-ħwejjeġ tqiegħed ħdejn il-bieb qabel il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The basket stuffed with clothes was placed beside the door before the journey.
formal.zh: 出发前，塞满衣服的篮子被放在门边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed titkellem hekk? Mark: Għandi mnieħri żaddami llum. Sara: Trid maktur?
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you sound like that? Mark: My nose is congested today. Sara: Would you like a tissue?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你说话怎么这个声音？Mark：我今天鼻子堵了。Sara：要纸巾吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你说话怎么这个声音？
messages.en: Why do you sound like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天鼻子堵了。
messages.en: My nose is congested today.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 要纸巾吗？
messages.en: Would you like a tissue?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żaddami 放在篮子和鼻子两幅图下面：篮子“塞满了”，鼻子“堵住了”，记它描述的是状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arouse excitement or stir someone's feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人兴奋，或激起某人的情绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqanqal l-eċċitament jew is-sentimenti ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使兴奋；激起情绪。

collocations.zh: 它让支持者们兴奋起来

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat żaf lill-partitarji, li bdew iċapċpu hekk kif tħabbar.
formal.en: The result excited the supporters, who began clapping as soon as it was announced.
formal.zh: 结果让支持者们兴奋起来，消息一公布，他们就开始鼓掌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tfal qed jaqbżu bil-ferħ? Mark: L-avviż tal-ħarġa żaf lit-tfal kollha. Maja: Mela qed jistennewha bil-ħerqa!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are the children jumping for joy? Mark: The announcement of the outing excited all the children. Maja: Then they're really looking forward to it!
colloquial.zh: Maja：孩子们怎么高兴得直跳？Mark：出游的通知让所有孩子都兴奋起来了。Maja：看来他们都很期待啊！

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.zh: 孩子们怎么高兴得直跳？
messages.en: Why are the children jumping for joy?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 出游的通知让所有孩子都兴奋起来了。
messages.en: The announcement of the outing excited all the children.

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.zh: 看来他们都很期待啊！
messages.en: Then they're really looking forward to it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听见出游消息后孩子们兴奋跳起，把 żaf 连到“消息使人兴奋”的因果画面上。

gloss_zh: 类似定音鼓的传统乐器；纸莎草

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional musical instrument resembling a kettle-drum; in a separate sense, the papyrus plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种外形类似定音鼓的传统乐器；另一个独立义项指纸莎草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tradizzjonali li jixbah tanbur f'forma ta' borma; f'sens ieħor, il-pjanta tal-papiru.

sense_translations.en_definition: a traditional musical instrument resembling a kettle-drum
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种类似定音鼓的传统乐器。
纸莎草；纸莎草植物。

collocations.zh: 他演奏 żafżafa 这种乐器

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi ż-żafżafa bħala strument mużikali tradizzjonali li jixbah tanbur f'forma ta' borma.
formal.en: The catalogue describes the żafżafa as a traditional musical instrument resembling a kettle-drum.
formal.zh: 目录将 żafżafa 描述为一种类似定音鼓的传统乐器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-pjanta wkoll tissejjaħ żafżafa? Mark: Iva, hawn il-kelma tfisser il-pjanta tal-papiru. Maja: Mela għandi niddistingwiha mill-istrument.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this plant also called żafżafa? Mark: Yes, here the word means the papyrus plant. Maja: Then I need to distinguish it from the instrument.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种植物也叫 żafżafa 吗？Mark：是的，这里这个词指纸莎草。Maja：那我得把它和乐器的意思区分开。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这种植物也叫 żafżafa 吗？
messages.en: Is this plant also called żafżafa?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn il-kelma tfisser il-pjanta tal-papiru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn il-kelma tfisser il-pjanta tal-papiru.
messages.zh: 是的，这里这个词指纸莎草。
messages.en: Yes, here the word means the papyrus plant.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 那我得把它和乐器的意思区分开。
messages.en: Then I need to distinguish it from the instrument.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żafżafa 配一张双图词卡：左边是类似定音鼓的乐器，右边是纸莎草；两图只帮助区分词义，不表示来源关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing a wet sound like that of something oozing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出类似黏稠液体渗出、流动时湿黏声音的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħoss bħal dak ta' likwidu magħqud li joħroġ bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出黏稠液体渗流般声音的。

collocations.zh: 发出湿黏渗流声的材料

formal.mt: Il-materjal żafżafi għamel ħoss ta' likwidu magħqud hekk kif il-ħaddiem għafsu.
formal.en: The material made a thick, oozing noise as the worker squeezed it.
formal.zh: 工人挤压这种材料时，它发出了黏稠液体渗流般的声音。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss taħt saqajk? Pawlu: It-tajn żafżafi; kull pass jagħmel ħoss. Sara: Mela ngħaddi minn fuq il-ġebel.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that noise under your feet? Pawlu: The mud makes an oozing noise; every step makes a sound. Sara: Then I'll walk over the stones.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你脚底下是什么声音？Pawlu：这泥会发出湿黏渗流声，每走一步都响。Sara：那我踩着石头过去。

messages.speaker: Sara (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 你脚底下是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise under your feet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tajn żafżafi; kull pass jagħmel ħoss.
messages.mt_standard: It-tajn żafżafi; kull pass jagħmel ħoss.
messages.zh: 这泥会发出湿黏渗流声，每走一步都响。
messages.en: The mud makes an oozing noise; every step makes a sound.

messages.speaker: Sara (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 那我踩着石头过去。
messages.en: Then I'll walk over the stones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚踩湿泥时黏液挤动的声音，把 żafżafi 贴在这幅有声音的画面上，记住它强调发出的湿黏声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A field pea plant or its seed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 田间种植的豌豆植物，亦可指其种子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-piżelli li titkabbar fl-għelieqi, jew iż-żerriegħa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 田豌豆。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw pjanta taż-żafżfa u eżaminaw iż-żrieragħ tagħha.
formal.en: The students observed a field pea plant and examined its seeds.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一株田豌豆，并检查了它的种子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi din il-pjanta? Toni: Din żafżfa. Ara l-imżiewed tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What plant is this? Toni: This is a field pea. Look at its pods.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是什么植物？托尼：这是田豌豆。看看它的豆荚。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这是什么植物？
messages.en: What plant is this?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺老师)
messages.zh: 这是田豌豆。看看它的豆荚。
messages.en: This is a field pea. Look at its pods.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żafżfa 配上一幅田间豌豆图，再分别指认植株、豆荚和种子，建立具体的词义联想。

gloss_zh: 液体或空气从孔口渗出时的声响

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sound made as liquid or air slowly escapes through an opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体或空气从小孔、缝隙等开口缓慢渗出时发出的声响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss li jsir meta likwidu jew arja joħorġu bil-mod minn fetħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: noise produced when liquid or air oozes through an aperture
sense_translations.zh_definition: 液体或空气从孔口缓慢渗出时产生的声响。

collocations.en: the sound of air seeping out
a seeping sound from a small opening

formal.mt: It-tekniku sema' żafżif ħdejn il-valv u sab li l-arja kienet qed toħroġ minn fetħa żgħira.
formal.en: The technician heard a seeping sound near the valve and found that air was escaping through a small opening.
formal.zh: 技术员听见阀门附近有渗漏声，发现空气正从一个小孔漏出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tisma' dak iż-żafżif ħdejn il-pajp? Mark: Iva, hemm l-arja ħierġa minn toqba żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that seeping sound near the pipe? Mark: Yes, air is escaping through a small hole.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听见管子旁边那个漏气声了吗？马克：听见了，有空气从一个小孔漏出来。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 你听见管子旁边那个漏气声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that seeping sound near the pipe?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm l-arja ħierġa minn toqba żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm l-arja ħierġa minn toqba żgħira.
messages.zh: 听见了，有空气从一个小孔漏出来。
messages.en: Yes, air is escaping through a small hole.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 żafżif 时想象耳朵贴近漏气小孔：这个名词指渗出时的声音，注意把声音与液体或空气本身区分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wobble or sway unsteadily, as a spinning top may do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不稳定地摇晃或左右摆动，像旋转中的陀螺那样。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq minn naħa għal oħra mingħajr stabbiltà, bħal ġugarell li jdur u jibda jitlef il-bilanċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇晃，晃动，尤指像旋转中的陀螺那样摆动。

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, il-ġugarell żagrag waqt li kien idur u mbagħad waqaf.
formal.en: In the experiment, the toy wobbled as it spun and then stopped.
formal.zh: 实验中，玩具在旋转时摇晃，随后停了下来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt kif żagrag il-ġugarell? Pawlu: Iva, beda jitbandal minn naħa għal oħra u mbagħad waqa'.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see how the toy wobbled? Pawlu: Yes, it started swaying from side to side and then fell over.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看到玩具刚才怎么晃了吗？保罗：看到了，它开始左右摇摆，然后倒下了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到玩具刚才怎么晃了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how the toy wobbled?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, beda jitbandal minn naħa għal oħra u mbagħad waqa'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, beda jitbandal minn naħa għal oħra u mbagħad waqa'.
messages.zh: 看到了，它开始左右摇摆，然后倒下了。
messages.en: Yes, it started swaying from side to side and then fell over.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żagrag 配上陀螺快停时左右晃动的画面，读词时轻轻摆动手掌，用动作记住摇晃这一动词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Zagreb, the capital and largest city of Croatia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 萨格勒布，克罗地亚的首都及最大城市。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-belt kapitali u l-akbar belt tal-Kroazja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Zagreb (the capital and largest city of Croatia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 萨格勒布，克罗地亚的首都及最大城市。

formal.mt: Żagreb hija l-belt kapitali u l-akbar belt tal-Kroazja.
formal.en: Zagreb is the capital and largest city of Croatia.
formal.zh: 萨格勒布是克罗地亚的首都及最大城市。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn tixtieq tmur għall-vaganza? David: Nixtieq inżur Żagreb, il-kapitali tal-Kroazja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where would you like to go on holiday? David: I'd like to visit Zagreb, the capital of Croatia.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想去哪里度假？戴维：我想去克罗地亚首都萨格勒布看看。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where would you like to go on holiday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想去克罗地亚首都萨格勒布看看。
messages.en: I'd like to visit Zagreb, the capital of Croatia.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Żagreb、Zagreb、萨格勒布写在同一张地图卡片上，并标注克罗地亚首都；实际书写地名时注意大写 Ż。

gloss_zh: 闲荡消磨时间；生活没有目标

teaching_sense.en_definition: To waste time idling about, or to live without a sense of purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无所事事地闲荡、浪费时间；也可指生活缺乏目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħli l-ħin mingħajr ma jagħmel xi ħaġa utli, jew jgħix bla skop fil-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲荡，无所事事地消磨或浪费时间。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have no purpose in life
sense_translations.zh_definition: 生活没有目标，缺乏人生方向。

formal.mt: Il-karattru żagħbel għal snin sħaħ, bla skop fil-ħajja, sakemm sab xogħol li tah direzzjoni.
formal.en: The character drifted through life for years without a purpose, until he found work that gave him direction.
formal.zh: 这个人物多年漫无目标地度日，直到找到一份让他有了方向的工作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'għamel Luqa llum? Ġanni: Żagħbel il-ġurnata kollha u ħalla x-xogħol għal għada.
colloquial.en: Marija: What did Luqa do today? Ġanni: He idled about all day and left the work until tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：卢卡今天做了什么？詹尼：他整天无所事事，把工作留到明天了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 卢卡今天做了什么？
messages.en: What did Luqa do today?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Żagħbel il-ġurnata kollha u ħalla x-xogħol għal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Żagħbel il-ġurnata kollha u ħalla x-xogħol għal għada.
messages.zh: 他整天无所事事，把工作留到明天了。
messages.en: He idled about all day and left the work until tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面记 żagħbel：一张是整天闲荡，一张是人生没有方向；分别对应浪费眼前时间和缺乏长远目标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of idling about, or of playing and moving about in a lively, carefree way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无所事事地闲荡这一活动；也可指轻松活泼的嬉戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività ta' min jgħaddi l-ħin bla ma jagħmel xejn utli, jew ta' min jilgħab u jiċċaqlaq bil-ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲荡，无所事事地消磨时间。
嬉戏，欢快活泼地玩耍。

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkuntrasta ż-żagħbil bla skop tal-adult maż-żagħbil ferrieħi tat-tfal fil-ġnien.
formal.en: The author contrasts the adult's aimless idling with the children's cheerful frolicking in the garden.
formal.zh: 作者把成年人的漫无目的的闲荡，与孩子们在花园里欢快的嬉戏作了对照。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm hemm żagħbil fil-ġnien illum! Paul: Iva, it-tfal qed jiġru u jilagħbu bil-ferħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: There's so much frolicking in the garden today! Paul: Yes, the children are running around and playing happily.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：今天花园里真是嬉闹不停！保罗：是啊，孩子们正高兴地跑来跑去、玩耍呢。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 今天花园里真是嬉闹不停！
messages.en: There's so much frolicking in the garden today!

messages.speaker: Paul (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tfal qed jiġru u jilagħbu bil-ferħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tfal qed jiġru u jilagħbu bil-ferħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，孩子们正高兴地跑来跑去、玩耍呢。
messages.en: Yes, the children are running around and playing happily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żagħbil 当作活动名称来记：既可画成无聊闲荡，也可画成孩子嬉戏；根据上下文判断是哪一种场景。

gloss_zh: 用藏红花染色；染成黄色

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dye something with saffron or to colour it yellow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用藏红花给某物染色，或将某物染成黄色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżbogħ xi ħaġa biż-żagħfran jew jagħtiha kulur isfar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to dye with saffron or with a yellow colour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用藏红花染色，或用黄色染料染成黄色。

collocations.en: dyed the cloth yellow or with saffron
collocations.zh: 将布料染黄或用藏红花染色

collocations.en: dyed the silk yellow or with saffron
collocations.zh: 将丝绸染黄或用藏红花染色

formal.mt: Għad-dimostrazzjoni, l-artiġjan żagħfar biċċa drapp abjad biż-żagħfran u ħalliha tinxef.
formal.en: For the demonstration, the craftsperson dyed a piece of white cloth with saffron and left it to dry.
formal.zh: 演示时，手工艺人用藏红花给一块白布染色，然后让它晾干。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min żagħfar dan id-drapp? Toni: Jien. Użajt żebgħa safra għall-kostum.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who dyed this cloth yellow? Toni: I did. I used yellow dye for the costume.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁把这块布染黄了？托尼：我染的。我用了黄色染料，准备做戏服。

messages.speaker: Marta (戏服设计师)
messages.zh: 谁把这块布染黄了？
messages.en: Who dyed this cloth yellow?

messages.speaker: Toni (戏服制作助理)
messages.zh: 我染的。我用了黄色染料，准备做戏服。
messages.en: I did. I used yellow dye for the costume.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象白布进入染液后变黄，用这个动作记 żagħfar；再并列记住两种表达重点：用藏红花染色，或染成黄色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The addition of saffron to food during cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烹饪时向食物中加入藏红花这一操作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żieda taż-żagħfran mal-ikel waqt it-tisjir.

sense_translations.en_definition: addition of saffron (in a culinary context)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在烹饪中加入藏红花。

collocations.en: the addition of saffron to rice

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispeċifika li ż-żagħfir għandu jsir lejn tmiem it-tisjir.
formal.en: The recipe specifies that saffron should be added towards the end of cooking.
formal.zh: 食谱明确说明，应在烹饪接近结束时加入藏红花。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'żagħfir' f'din ir-riċetta? Pawlu: Ifisser li żżid iż-żagħfran mal-ikel.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'żagħfir' mean in this recipe? Pawlu: It means adding saffron to the food.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份食谱里的“żagħfir”是什么意思？Pawlu：就是往食物里加入藏红花。

messages.speaker: Lara (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 这份食谱里的“żagħfir”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żagħfir' mean in this recipe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (厨师)
messages.zh: 就是往食物里加入藏红花。
messages.en: It means adding saffron to the food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象食谱中“加入藏红花”的那一步：żagħfir 指添加这一操作，把动作场景和名词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the colour of saffron; yellow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈藏红花色的；黄色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-kulur taż-żagħfran; isfar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有藏红花颜色的；藏红花色的。
黄色的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun tad-drapp għandu kulur żagħfrani.
formal.en: The fabric sample has a saffron-yellow colour.
formal.zh: 这块布料样品呈藏红花黄色。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Liema drapp trid? Leo: Dak żagħfrani, ħdejn id-drapp abjad.
colloquial.en: Marta: Which fabric would you like? Leo: The saffron-coloured one, next to the white fabric.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你想要哪块布料？Leo：藏红花色的那块，就在白色布料旁边。

messages.speaker: Marta (店员)
messages.zh: 你想要哪块布料？
messages.en: Which fabric would you like?

messages.speaker: Leo (顾客)
messages.zh: 藏红花色的那块，就在白色布料旁边。
messages.en: The saffron-coloured one, next to the white fabric.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给一块布涂上藏红花黄色，再默念 drapp żagħfrani，用颜色画面记住这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 使某物减少或变小的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lessens something or makes it smaller.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的数量、程度或大小减少的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tnaqqas jew iċċekken xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物减少或变小的人。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, iż-żagħgħar huwa l-persuna li tnaqqas id-daqs tal-oġġett.
formal.en: In this exercise, the 'żagħgħar' is the person who reduces the size of the object.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，“żagħgħar”指缩小物体尺寸的人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: 'Żagħgħar' hawn jirreferi għal persuna? Mark: Iva, għal xi ħadd li jnaqqas jew iċekken xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does 'żagħgħar' refer to a person here? Mark: Yes, someone who lessens something or makes it smaller.
colloquial.zh: Nina：“żagħgħar”在这里指一个人吗？Mark：对，指使某物减少或变小的人。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: “żagħgħar”在这里指一个人吗？
messages.en: Does 'żagħgħar' refer to a person here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għal xi ħadd li jnaqqas jew iċekken xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għal xi ħadd li jnaqqas jew iċekken xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 对，指使某物减少或变小的人。
messages.en: Yes, someone who lessens something or makes it smaller.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把大模型缩小：żagħgħar 指负责缩小的那个人，记忆重点放在“人”这个名词身份。

gloss_zh: 贬称：被指性道德不端者、女性化男子或男同性恋者、娼妓、卑劣者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A derogatory term for a person judged sexually immoral, an effeminate man, a catamite, a homosexual man, a prostitute, or an evil or base person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 侮辱性称呼，可指被认为性道德不端的人、女性化男子、男童性伴侣、男同性恋者、娼妓，或邪恶卑劣的人；这些是不同的贬损用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma dispreġġjattiva għal persuna meqjusa bla morali sesswali, raġel meqjus effeminat, tifel użat bħala sieħeb sesswali minn raġel, raġel omosesswali, prostituta, jew persuna ħażina u baxxa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a person of doubtful sexual morals
sense_translations.zh_definition: （贬称）被认为性道德可疑或不端的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: an effeminate man, catamite, or homosexual
sense_translations.zh_definition: （贬称）被认为女性化的男子、男童性伴侣，或男同性恋者。
（粗俗侮辱语）娼妓；被辱称为淫妇或荡妇的人。
（贬称）邪恶、卑劣的人。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-djalogu, 'żagħka' hija identifikata bħala kelma dispreġġjattiva li tintuża biex toffendi persuna.
formal.en: In the analysis of the dialogue, 'żagħka' is identified as a derogatory word used to insult a person.
formal.zh: 在对这段对话的分析中，“żagħka”被认定为用于侮辱他人的贬损词语。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fil-ktieb sibt il-kelma 'żagħka'. Hija insult? David: Iva, hija kelma offensiva; aħjar ma tużahiex biex tindirizza lil xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: I found the word 'żagħka' in the book. Is it an insult? David: Yes, it is offensive; it is better not to use it to address someone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我在书里看到了“żagħka”这个词。它是骂人的话吗？David：是的，它带有侮辱性，最好不要用它称呼别人。

messages.speaker: Sara (读者)
messages.zh: 我在书里看到了“żagħka”这个词。它是骂人的话吗？
messages.en: I found the word 'żagħka' in the book. Is it an insult?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija kelma offensiva; aħjar ma tużahiex biex tindirizza lil xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija kelma offensiva; aħjar ma tużahiex biex tindirizza lil xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 是的，它带有侮辱性，最好不要用它称呼别人。
messages.en: Yes, it is offensive; it is better not to use it to address someone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żagħka 的词卡画一个“侮辱语”标记，再把各个义项分开记；能在阅读中辨认，也要记住它的贬损语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant known as hawthorn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为山楂的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala hawthorn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山楂；山楂树这一植物。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-weraq taż-żagħrun u kitbu deskrizzjoni fil-pitazz.
formal.en: The students observed the hawthorn leaves and wrote a description in their notebooks.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了山楂叶，并在笔记本中写下描述。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Toni: Dan iż-żagħrun. Ara l-isem fuq it-tabella.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is this plant called? Toni: This is hawthorn. Look at the name on the sign.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这株植物叫什么？Toni：这是山楂。你看牌子上的名字。

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Toni (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan iż-żagħrun. Ara l-isem fuq it-tabella.
messages.mt_standard: Dan iż-żagħrun. Ara l-isem fuq it-tabella.
messages.zh: 这是山楂。你看牌子上的名字。
messages.en: This is hawthorn. Look at the name on the sign.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象植物园里一株山楂，名牌上并排写着 żagħrun、hawthorn、山楂，用同一株植物连接三种语言。

gloss_zh: 容易发出低沉振鸣声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to produce a low, steady or rhythmic vibrating sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易发出低沉、持续或有节奏的振动声的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel ħoss baxx u kontinwu jew ritmiku ta' vibrazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易发出低沉、持续或有节奏的振鸣声的。

collocations.en: a motor that tends to thrum
collocations.zh: 容易发出低沉振鸣声的马达

collocations.en: an appliance that tends to thrum
collocations.zh: 容易发出低沉振鸣声的设备

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-mutur bħala żagżagi minħabba l-ħoss baxx u ritmiku li jagħmel waqt it-tħaddim.
formal.en: The report describes the motor as prone to thrumming because of the low, rhythmic sound it makes during operation.
formal.zh: 报告将这台马达描述为容易发出振鸣声，因为它运行时会产生低沉而有节奏的声音。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-mutur żagżagi, hux? Ben: Iva, malli nixegħluh jibda jagħmel dak il-ħoss baxx.
colloquial.en: Anna: This motor tends to thrum, doesn't it? Ben: Yes, as soon as we switch it on, it starts making that low sound.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这台马达容易嗡嗡振鸣，对吧？本：对，一打开就开始发出那种低沉的声音。

messages.speaker: Anna (维修学徒)
messages.zh: 这台马达容易嗡嗡振鸣，对吧？
messages.en: This motor tends to thrum, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Ben (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, malli nixegħluh jibda jagħmel dak il-ħoss baxx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, malli nixegħluh jibda jagħmel dak il-ħoss baxx.
messages.zh: 对，一打开就开始发出那种低沉的声音。
messages.en: Yes, as soon as we switch it on, it starts making that low sound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一台常常低声嗡鸣的马达，用 żagżagi 描述它容易振鸣的特性；记住这是修饰事物的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a plant blossom or bring it into bloom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使植物开花，或促使其进入开花状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel pjanta tagħti l-fjuri jew iwassalha biex twarrad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使开花；促使绽放。

formal.mt: It-temp sħun żahhar il-ġnien, u l-ġardinar irreġistra d-data tal-ewwel fjuri.
formal.en: The warm weather made the garden blossom, and the gardener recorded the date of the first flowers.
formal.zh: 温暖的天气使花园绽放，园丁记录了首批花朵开放的日期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hawn fjuri! Ninu: Iva, it-temp sħun żahhar il-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at all these flowers! Ninu: Yes, the warm weather made the garden blossom.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，这里开了这么多花！Ninu：是啊，温暖的天气让花园开花了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，这里开了这么多花！
messages.en: Look at all these flowers!

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，温暖的天气让花园开花了。
messages.en: Yes, the warm weather made the garden blossom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“温暖天气让花园开花”的画面：żahhar 表示使开花，练习时把促成开花的原因和植物一起说出来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blossom or individual flower on a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物上开放的一朵花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjura li tidher fuq pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一朵花；花朵。

formal.mt: L-istudenta pinġiet żahra bajda fuq fergħa u kitbet deskrizzjoni qasira taħt it-tpinġija.
formal.en: The student drew a white blossom on a branch and wrote a short description below the drawing.
formal.zh: 这名学生画了一朵枝上的白花，并在图画下方写了一段简短描述。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ara dik iż-żahra bajda! Sam: Sabiħa ħafna. Se nieħu ritratt tagħha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Look at that white blossom! Sam: It is very beautiful. I am going to take a photo of it.
colloquial.zh: Rita：看那朵白花！Sam：真漂亮。我要给它拍张照。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 看那朵白花！
messages.en: Look at that white blossom!

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sabiħa ħafna. Se nieħu ritratt tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Sabiħa ħafna. Se nieħu ritratt tagħha.
messages.zh: 真漂亮。我要给它拍张照。
messages.en: It is very beautiful. I am going to take a photo of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准枝上的单独一朵花，给照片标注 żahra；用“一朵”的具体画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Blossoming or in bloom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正处于开花状态的；正在绽放的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun qed iwarrad jew jagħti l-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在开花的；绽放的。

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt juri arbuxxell żahri ħdejn id-daħla tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The photograph shows a blossoming shrub beside the garden entrance.
formal.zh: 照片展示了花园入口旁一株正在开花的灌木。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Liema arbuxxell qed tpinġi? Ben: Dak żahri ħdejn il-bieb. Jogħġbuni ħafna l-fjuri tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Elena: Which shrub are you drawing? Ben: The blossoming one next to the door. I really like its flowers.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你在画哪株灌木？Ben：门旁边正在开花的那株。我很喜欢它的花。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.zh: 你在画哪株灌木？
messages.en: Which shrub are you drawing?

messages.speaker: Ben (绘画学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak żahri ħdejn il-bieb. Jogħġbuni ħafna l-fjuri tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak żahri ħdejn il-bieb. Jogħġbuni ħafna l-fjuri tiegħu.
messages.zh: 门旁边正在开花的那株。我很喜欢它的花。
messages.en: The blossoming one next to the door. I really like its flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给正在开花的灌木挂上“绽放中”的牌子：żahri 描述开花状态，和 arbuxxell 一起读来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a surface with a layer of fine or soft hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某个表面覆上一层细毛或柔软的毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi wiċċ b'saff ta' xagħar fin jew pil artab.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cover with thin or soft hair
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使覆上细毛或柔软的毛。

collocations.en: covered the surface with fine hair
covered the stem with soft hair

formal.mt: Saff ta' pil fin żajbar iz-zokk tal-pjanta.
formal.en: A layer of fine hair covered the plant's stem.
formal.zh: 一层细毛覆盖了这株植物的茎。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kif dan il-pil fin żajbar iz-zokk! Ninu: Iva, ħassejtu artab meta missejtu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how this fine hair has covered the stem! Ninu: Yes, it felt soft when I touched it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看，这些细毛把茎都覆盖了！尼努：是啊，我摸的时候觉得软软的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kif dan il-pil fin żajbar iz-zokk!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kif dan il-pil fin żajbar iz-zokk!
messages.zh: 你看，这些细毛把茎都覆盖了！
messages.en: Look how this fine hair has covered the stem!

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我摸的时候觉得软软的。
messages.en: Yes, it felt soft when I touched it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给光滑的植物茎披上一层细软毛毯，用这个覆盖动作记住动词。

gloss_zh: 稀疏的头发（尤常用复数）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sparse hair on the head, especially referred to using the plural form of this noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指头上稀疏的头发；这个名词尤其常以复数形式使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xagħar skars fuq ir-ras; dan in-nom jintuża l-aktar fil-plural.

sense_translations.en_definition: thinning hair (this noun is used especially in the plural form)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 稀疏、渐稀的头发；这个名词尤其常以复数形式使用。

collocations.en: a thin covering of sparse hair

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-personaġġ, l-awtur isemmi żajbra rqiqa fuq rasu.
formal.en: In the description of the character, the author mentions a thin covering of sparse hair on his head.
formal.zh: 在人物描写中，作者提到他头上薄薄的一层稀发。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'żajbra' f'din l-istorja? Toni: Tfisser xagħar skars; il-kelma tintuża l-aktar fil-plural.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'żajbra' mean in this story? Toni: It means sparse hair; the word is mostly used in the plural.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的“żajbra”是什么意思？托尼：就是稀疏的头发；这个词主要用复数形式。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的“żajbra”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żajbra' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser xagħar skars; il-kelma tintuża l-aktar fil-plural.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser xagħar skars; il-kelma tintuża l-aktar fil-plural.
messages.zh: 就是稀疏的头发；这个词主要用复数形式。
messages.en: It means sparse hair; the word is mostly used in the plural.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用头顶只剩薄薄一层头发的画面记忆，并给词卡加上“尤常用复数”的提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Downy in texture or covered with fine, soft hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地如绒毛般柔软的，或表面覆有细软毛的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra ratba bħal pil fin, jew li hu miksi b'pil artab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绒毛状的；具有绒毛般柔软质感的。
表面覆有柔软毛发的。

collocations.en: a stem covered with soft hair

formal.mt: Iz-zokk żajbri tal-pjanta huwa miksi b'pil fin u artab.
formal.en: The plant's downy stem is covered with fine, soft hair.
formal.zh: 这株植物的茎覆有细软的绒毛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan iz-zokk żajbri? Mark: Iva, messu bil-mod u tħoss il-pil artab.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this stem downy? Mark: Yes, touch it gently and you'll feel the soft hair.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这根茎有绒毛吗？马克：有，轻轻摸一下就能感觉到软毛。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这根茎有绒毛吗？
messages.en: Is this stem downy?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, messu bil-mod u tħoss il-pil artab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, messu bil-mod u tħoss il-pil artab.
messages.zh: 有，轻轻摸一下就能感觉到软毛。
messages.en: Yes, touch it gently and you'll feel the soft hair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把指尖轻触植物细绒毛的感觉与这个形容词相连，同时记住质感和覆盖状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To visit a person or place frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常去探望某人，或频繁到访某个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżur lil xi ħadd jew xi post ta' spiss.

sense_translations.en_definition: to visit someone/ some place frequently
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常探望某人，或频繁到访某个地方。
访客；来访的人。

collocations.zh: 经常探望他的叔伯舅父

formal.mt: Matul is-sajf, Pawlu żajjar lil zijuh kull ġimgħa.
formal.en: During the summer, Pawlu visited his uncle every week.
formal.zh: 夏天期间，保罗每周都去探望他的叔叔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu żajjar lil zijuh dan is-sajf? Rita: Iva, mar għandu kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu visit his uncle regularly this summer? Rita: Yes, he went to see him every week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今年夏天经常去看他叔叔吗？丽塔：是啊，每周都去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu żajjar lil zijuh dan is-sajf?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu żajjar lil zijuh dan is-sajf?
messages.zh: 保罗今年夏天经常去看他叔叔吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu visit his uncle regularly this summer?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，每周都去。
messages.en: Yes, he went to see him every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上每周都有一次探访；另做一张名词卡，把同形词记为“访客”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a habit of visiting people or places frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 习惯于经常探望别人或到某处走访的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-drawwa li jżur nies jew postijiet ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯常来访的；习惯于经常探访的。

formal.mt: Il-ġar żajjari kien jiġi għand il-familja kull nhar ta' Ħadd.
formal.en: The neighbour, who was in the habit of visiting, would come to see the family every Sunday.
formal.zh: 这位经常来访的邻居每逢星期日都会来看望这家人。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ħuk żajjari ħafna! Toni: Iva, kważi kuljum jgħaddi għal kafè.
colloquial.en: Lina: Your brother is always visiting! Toni: Yes, he drops by for coffee almost every day.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你哥哥真爱串门啊！托尼：是啊，他几乎每天都过来喝杯咖啡。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥真爱串门啊！
messages.en: Your brother is always visiting!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kważi kuljum jgħaddi għal kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kważi kuljum jgħaddi għal kafè.
messages.zh: 是啊，他几乎每天都过来喝杯咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, he drops by for coffee almost every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象那个几乎天天来喝咖啡的朋友，用“爱串门”记住描述习惯的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of visiting people or places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 探望他人或到某处走访这一活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li wieħed iżur nies jew postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 探访；走访；拜访这一活动。

formal.mt: Iż-żajran regolari lill-qraba jgħin biex jinżammu r-rabtiet tal-familja.
formal.en: Regular visits to relatives help maintain family ties.
formal.zh: 定期探望亲属有助于维系家庭关系。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandna ħafna żajran lill-qraba dan il-weekend? Pawlu: Iva, is-Sibt għand in-nanna u l-Ħadd għand iz-zija.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are we doing a lot of visiting relatives this weekend? Pawlu: Yes, Grandma's on Saturday and Auntie's on Sunday.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这周末我们要走访很多亲戚吗？保罗：是啊，周六去奶奶家，周日去姑妈家。

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna ħafna żajran lill-qraba dan il-weekend?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna ħafna żajran lill-qraba dan il-weekend?
messages.zh: 这周末我们要走访很多亲戚吗？
messages.en: Are we doing a lot of visiting relatives this weekend?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-Sibt għand in-nanna u l-Ħadd għand iz-zija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-Sibt għand in-nanna u l-Ħadd għand iz-zija.
messages.zh: 是啊，周六去奶奶家，周日去姑妈家。
messages.en: Yes, Grandma's on Saturday and Auntie's on Sunday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把周末探亲行程整体圈起来，记作“探访这项活动”，突出它是活动名词。

gloss_zh: 使凸出；造成凸出的东西；大肚腩

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause something to stick out or bulge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物向外突出或鼓起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel xi ħaġa toħroġ 'il barra jew tintefaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物向外凸出、突出或鼓起。
使某物向外凸出或鼓起的东西。
向外鼓起的大肚子；大肚腩。

formal.mt: Il-kartiera ħoxna żakkar il-but tal-ġakketta.
formal.en: The thick wallet made the jacket pocket bulge.
formal.zh: 厚厚的钱包把夹克口袋撑得鼓了起来。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ktieb żakkar il-but kollu! Sara: Oħorġu u poġġih fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Mark: This book has made the whole pocket bulge! Sara: Take it out and put it in the bag.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书把整个口袋都撑鼓了！萨拉：拿出来放进包里吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书把整个口袋都撑鼓了！
messages.en: This book has made the whole pocket bulge!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 拿出来放进包里吧。
messages.en: Take it out and put it in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厚钱包撑鼓口袋：分别记住使其凸出的动作、造成凸出的物件，以及大肚腩这个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sticking out beyond the surrounding surface or outline.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 超出周围表面或轮廓而向外凸出的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ 'il barra mill-wiċċ jew mil-linja ta' madwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向外凸出的；突出的；鼓出的。

formal.mt: Il-ġebel żakkari fil-ħajt jista' jfixkel il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The stones jutting out from the wall may obstruct the passage.
formal.zh: 墙上向外突出的石块可能妨碍通行。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-but tiegħek żakkari daqshekk? Ninu: Għandi kartiera ħoxna fih.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is your pocket bulging so much? Ninu: I've got a thick wallet in it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你的口袋怎么鼓得这么厉害？尼努：里面装着一个厚钱包。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的口袋怎么鼓得这么厉害？
messages.en: Why is your pocket bulging so much?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.zh: 里面装着一个厚钱包。
messages.en: I've got a thick wallet in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中沿墙面画一条直线，越过直线伸出来的石块就是“凸出的”，用来记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of walking in a showy way to attract attention or display confidence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了引人注目或显示自信而招摇、大摇大摆地走路的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mixi b'mod li jiġbed l-attenzjoni jew juri kunfidenza żejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招摇地走路，刻意以走路的姿态引人注目。
大摇大摆地走路，表现得十分自负或神气。

collocations.en: walking ostentatiously in front of people

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żakkir tal-karattru jiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' dawk li jarawh.
formal.en: In the story, the character's swaggering attracts the attention of those who see him.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物大摇大摆的步态引起了旁观者的注意。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Rajt dak iż-żakkir fit-triq? Pawlu: Iva, qisu ried lil kulħadd iħares lejh!
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you see that swaggering in the street? Pawlu: Yes, it was as if he wanted everyone to look at him!
colloquial.zh: Marta：你看到刚才街上那大摇大摆的走路样子了吗？Pawlu：看到了，简直像是想让所有人都看他！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到刚才街上那大摇大摆的走路样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that swaggering in the street?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qisu ried lil kulħadd iħares lejh!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qisu ried lil kulħadd iħares lejh!
messages.zh: 看到了，简直像是想让所有人都看他！
messages.en: Yes, it was as if he wanted everyone to look at him!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把街道当成舞台，大摇大摆地走；用这个画面记住 żakkir 指走路招摇的行为。

gloss_zh: 大量喝酒；演奏 żambura 传统民间乐器

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drink a large amount of alcohol, or to play the traditional folk instrument called the żambura.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量饮用酒精饮品；也指演奏名为 żambura 的传统民间乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixrob ħafna alkoħol, jew idoqq l-istrument folkloristiku tradizzjonali msejjaħ żambura.

sense_translations.en_definition: to drink a lot of alcohol
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量喝酒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to play the 'żambura', a traditional folk instrument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 演奏名为 żambura 的传统民间乐器。

collocations.en: he played the żambura during the concert
collocations.zh: 他在音乐会上演奏了 żambura

formal.mt: Waqt il-kunċert ta' mużika folkloristika, il-mużiċist żambar u l-udjenza semgħet il-ħoss taż-żambura.
formal.en: During the folk music concert, the musician played the żambura, and the audience heard the instrument's sound.
formal.zh: 在民间音乐会上，乐手演奏了 żambura，观众聆听了这种乐器的声音。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu żambar ilbieraħ fil-festa? Toni: Iva, xorob ħafna alkoħol.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did Pawlu drink heavily at the party yesterday? Toni: Yes, he drank a lot of alcohol.
colloquial.zh: Marta：Pawlu 昨天在聚会上喝了很多酒吗？Toni：是的，他喝了很多酒。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 昨天在聚会上喝了很多酒吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu drink heavily at the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他喝了很多酒。
messages.en: Yes, he drank a lot of alcohol.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żambar 配两幅学习画面：酒杯对应大量喝酒，乐器对应演奏 żambura；靠上下文选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who drinks a lot of alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人大量喝酒、嗜酒或贪杯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jixrob ħafna alkoħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容喝酒很多、经常贪杯的人。
形容嗜酒、贪杯的人，带有贬义。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-protagonist bħala raġel żambari li jixrob ħafna alkoħol.
formal.en: In the novel, the author describes the protagonist as a heavy-drinking man who consumes a lot of alcohol.
formal.zh: 在小说中，作者把主人公描写成一个大量饮酒的嗜酒男子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser li karattru huwa żambari? Mark: Ifisser li jixrob ħafna alkoħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does it mean when a character is described as żambari? Mark: It means that he drinks a lot of alcohol.
colloquial.zh: Lara：说一个人物 żambari 是什么意思？Mark：意思是他喝很多酒。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 说一个人物 żambari 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean when a character is described as żambari?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 意思是他喝很多酒。
messages.en: It means that he drinks a lot of alcohol.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żambari 放在人名旁作人物标签，记成“这个人很贪杯”；注意这里学习的是形容人的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Zambia, a country in Southern Africa whose official name is the Republic of Zambia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赞比亚，位于非洲南部的国家，正式名称为赞比亚共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika taż-Żambja.
