sense_translations.en_definition: Zambia (a country in Southern Africa; official name: Repubblika taż-Żambja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞比亚，非洲南部的国家；正式名称为赞比亚共和国。

formal.mt: Ir-Repubblika taż-Żambja hija pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika.
formal.en: The Republic of Zambia is a country in Southern Africa.
formal.zh: 赞比亚共和国是位于非洲南部的国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tixtieq tmur? Mark: Nixtieq inżur iż-Żambja. Maja: Nista' nurik fejn tinsab fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where would you like to go? Mark: I'd like to visit Zambia. Maja: I can show you where it is on the map.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想去哪里？Mark：我想去赞比亚看看。Maja：我可以在地图上指给你看它的位置。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里？
messages.en: Where would you like to go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想去赞比亚看看。
messages.en: I'd like to visit Zambia.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nurik fejn tinsab fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nurik fejn tinsab fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 我可以在地图上指给你看它的位置。
messages.en: I can show you where it is on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在非洲南部的地图旁写下“Żambja＝赞比亚”，再用“去赞比亚旅行”的句子巩固国家名称。

gloss_zh: 赞比亚的；赞比亚人，通常指男性

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Zambia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于赞比亚、来自赞比亚或与赞比亚有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej miż-Żambja jew li għandu x'jaqsam maż-Żambja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Zambian (of, from or relating to Zambia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞比亚的；来自赞比亚或与赞比亚有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Zambian (native or inhabitant of Zambia) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞比亚人，即赞比亚本地人或居民，通常指男性。

collocations.en: a Zambian man who lives here
collocations.zh: 一位住在这里的赞比亚男子

formal.mt: Għall-proġett tal-klassi, l-istudenti qraw test ta' kittieb Żambjan.
formal.en: For the class project, the students read a text by a Zambian writer.
formal.zh: 为了完成课堂项目，学生们阅读了一位赞比亚作家的文章。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn hu l-ġar il-ġdid? Pawlu: Hu Żambjan. Lara: Nixtieq insir nafu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the new neighbour from? Pawlu: He's Zambian. Lara: I'd like to get to know him.
colloquial.zh: Lara：新来的邻居是哪里人？Pawlu：他是赞比亚人。Lara：我想认识一下他。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 新来的邻居是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is the new neighbour from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 他是赞比亚人。
messages.en: He's Zambian.

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 我想认识一下他。
messages.en: I'd like to get to know him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对记忆 Żambja“赞比亚”和 Żambjan“赞比亚的／赞比亚人”；用“赞比亚作家”和“一位赞比亚人”区分词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alcoholic drink made from anise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种以茴香制成的酒精饮品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika magħmula mill-aniżetta.

sense_translations.en_definition: an alcoholic drink made from anise (cf. sambuca)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以茴香制成的酒精饮品，可参照意大利茴香酒 sambuca 理解。

formal.mt: Il-lista tax-xorb tinkludi ż-żambur, xarba alkoħolika magħmula mill-aniżetta.
formal.en: The drinks list includes żambur, an alcoholic drink made from anise.
formal.zh: 酒水单上列有 żambur，即一种以茴香制成的酒精饮品。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm f'dan il-flixkun? Rita: Żambur, xarba alkoħolika magħmula mill-aniżetta. Mark: Mela dan huwa flixkun żambur.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's in this bottle? Rita: Żambur, an alcoholic drink made from anise. Mark: So this is a bottle of anise spirit.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个瓶子里装的是什么？Rita：Żambur，一种用茴香制成的酒。Mark：那这就是一瓶茴香酒了。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个瓶子里装的是什么？
messages.en: What's in this bottle?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: Żambur，一种用茴香制成的酒。
messages.en: Żambur, an alcoholic drink made from anise.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 那这就是一瓶茴香酒了。
messages.en: So this is a bottle of anise spirit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象酒瓶标签上画着茴香，并写着 żambur；用“一瓶茴香酒”的画面把词形与酒类含义连起来。

gloss_zh: 一种传统乐器；含茴香酒的混合饮品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional musical instrument, or a mixed drink containing the anise spirit called żambur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种传统乐器；也指含有 żambur 茴香酒的混合饮品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tradizzjonali, jew xarba mħallta li fiha ż-żambur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种传统乐器。

sense_translations.en_definition: a mixed drink that includes anise spirit (i.e. żambur)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种含有茴香酒，即 żambur 的混合饮品。

collocations.en: to prepare a mixed drink containing anise spirit
collocations.zh: 调制一杯含茴香酒的混合饮品

collocations.en: a glass of the mixed drink żambura
collocations.zh: 一杯 żambura 混合饮品

formal.mt: Fil-programm tal-kunċert, iż-żambura hija ppreżentata bħala strument mużikali tradizzjonali.
formal.en: In the concert programme, the żambura is presented as a traditional musical instrument.
formal.zh: 在音乐会节目册中，żambura 被介绍为一种传统乐器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi ż-żambura fuq il-lista tax-xorb? Rita: Hija xarba mħallta li fiha ż-żambur. Maja: Mela hawn il-kelma tirreferi għal xarba.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the żambura on the drinks list? Rita: It's a mixed drink containing żambur. Maja: So here the word refers to a drink.
colloquial.zh: Maja：酒水单上的 żambura 是什么？Rita：是一种含有 żambur 茴香酒的混合饮品。Maja：所以这里这个词指的是饮品。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 酒水单上的 żambura 是什么？
messages.en: What's the żambura on the drinks list?

messages.mt_spoken: Hija xarba mħallta li fiha ż-żambur.
messages.mt_standard: Hija xarba mħallta li fiha ż-żambur.
messages.zh: 是一种含有 żambur 茴香酒的混合饮品。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hawn il-kelma tirreferi għal xarba.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hawn il-kelma tirreferi għal xarba.
messages.zh: 所以这里这个词指的是饮品。

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żambura 画两张词义卡：音乐会上的传统乐器，酒水单上的混合饮品；饮品卡再注明含 żambur 茴香酒。

gloss_zh: 握持；任职或占有的期限

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of holding something, or the holding of a position or property over a period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 握住、持有某物的行为；也指在一段时期内担任职位或占有财产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iżomm xi ħaġa, jew li jkollu kariga jew proprjetà għal perjodu ta' żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 握持、持有或保持某物的行为。
担任职位或占有财产的状态或期限；任期、占有期。

collocations.en: a period of holding or tenure

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħidma tad-direttur matul il-perjodu ta' żamma tal-kariga.
formal.en: The report describes the director's work during his tenure of office.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了该主任任职期间的工作。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandi żamma soda fuq il-ħabel? Pawlu: Iva, qed iżżommu sew. Marta: Tajjeb, issa nħossni aktar ċerta.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do I have a firm hold on the rope? Pawlu: Yes, you're holding it securely. Marta: Good, I feel more confident now.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我把绳子握牢了吗？Pawlu：是的，你握得很稳。Marta：好，现在我更有把握了。

messages.speaker: Marta (学员)
messages.zh: 我把绳子握牢了吗？
messages.en: Do I have a firm hold on the rope?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教练)
messages.zh: 是的，你握得很稳。
messages.en: Yes, you're holding it securely.

messages.speaker: Marta (学员)
messages.zh: 好，现在我更有把握了。
messages.en: Good, I feel more confident now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“手握绳子”记 żamma 的握持义，再用“任期内持有职位”记任职义；这是帮助区分用法的学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep a firm hold on someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抓紧某人或某物，保持握持而不松开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa sew mingħajr ma jitlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓住；握住不放

formal.mt: Waqt is-salvataġġ, ir-raġel żammam mal-ħabel sakemm waslet l-għajnuna.
formal.en: During the rescue, the man held on to the rope until help arrived.
formal.zh: 救援过程中，那名男子一直抓着绳子，直到救援人员赶到。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irnexxielu ma jaqax? Toni: Żammam mal-fergħa sakemm għennieh missieru.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he manage not to fall? Toni: He held on to the branch until his father helped him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他怎么才没掉下去？托尼：他一直抓着树枝，直到他爸爸来帮他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他怎么才没掉下去？
messages.en: How did he manage not to fall?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他一直抓着树枝，直到他爸爸来帮他。
messages.en: He held on to the branch until his father helped him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时想象双手紧抓绳子，重点是抓住以后持续不松手。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to play the fife, a small transverse flute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人爱吹奏小型横笛，有经常吹奏的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħabta jdoqq il-fifra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱吹奏横笛的；有吹奏横笛倾向的

collocations.en: a man inclined to play the fife
a musician inclined to play the fife

formal.mt: Il-mużiċist żammari għażel il-fifra għall-wirja tal-iskola.
formal.en: The musician, who was fond of playing the fife, chose that instrument for the school performance.
formal.zh: 这位爱吹横笛的乐手为学校演出选择了横笛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem iġib il-fifra? Mark: Għax hu żammari; malli jsib ftit ħin, jibda jdoqq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does Pawlu always bring his fife? Mark: Because he loves playing it; whenever he has a little time, he starts playing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么保罗总带着横笛？马克：因为他爱吹横笛，一有空就开始吹。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么保罗总带着横笛？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu always bring his fife?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu żammari; malli jsib ftit ħin, jibda jdoqq.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu żammari; malli jsib ftit ħin, jibda jdoqq.
messages.zh: 因为他爱吹横笛，一有空就开始吹。
messages.en: Because he loves playing it; whenever he has a little time, he starts playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词配给总带横笛的人，记住它描述爱吹奏的习惯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who detains someone or keeps something from being released or returned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扣留他人，或扣住物品而不予放行、交还的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li żżomm lil xi ħadd milli jitlaq jew lil xi ħaġa milli tingħata lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扣留他人或物品的人；拘留者

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika liż-żammej tad-dokumenti u jispjega għaliex dawn ma ngħatawx lura.
formal.en: The report identifies the person detaining the documents and explains why they were not returned.
formal.zh: 报告指出了扣留文件的人，并说明这些文件未被交还的原因。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu ż-żammej tad-dokumenti tiegħi? David: Ir-raġel fl-uffiċċju; għadu ma tahomx lura.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is holding back my documents? David: The man in the office; he still has not returned them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁扣着我的文件？戴维：办公室里的那个男子，他还没把文件还回来。

messages.speaker: Nina (文件持有人)
messages.zh: 谁扣着我的文件？
messages.en: Who is holding back my documents?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raġel fl-uffiċċju; għadu ma tahomx lura.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raġel fl-uffiċċju; għadu ma tahomx lura.
messages.zh: 办公室里的那个男子，他还没把文件还回来。
messages.en: The man in the office; he still has not returned them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件被某个人扣住，词语指扣留者本人，而不是扣留动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who holds someone or something, or who detains someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 握住、持有某人或某物的人，也可指扣留他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li żżomm lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew li ma tħallix lil xi ħadd jitlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 握住、扶住或持有某人或某物的人
扣留他人、使其不能离开的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żammiem tal-priġunier joqgħod ħdejn il-bieb biex ma jħallihx joħroġ.
formal.en: In the story, the person detaining the prisoner stands by the door to prevent him from leaving.
formal.zh: 故事中，拘押囚犯的人站在门旁，防止囚犯离开。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jkun iż-żammiem tal-ħabel waqt il-logħba? Ben: Jien. Se nżommu sew waqt li int torbot it-tarf.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will hold the rope during the game? Ben: I will. I will hold it firmly while you tie the end.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：游戏时谁来抓着绳子？本：我来。你系绳头时，我会把它抓牢。

messages.speaker: Sara (游戏伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun iż-żammiem tal-ħabel waqt il-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun iż-żammiem tal-ħabel waqt il-logħba?
messages.zh: 游戏时谁来抓着绳子？
messages.en: Who will hold the rope during the game?

messages.speaker: Ben (游戏伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Se nżommu sew waqt li int torbot it-tarf.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Se nżommu sew waqt li int torbot it-tarf.
messages.zh: 我来。你系绳头时，我会把它抓牢。
messages.en: I will. I will hold it firmly while you tie the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅人物画记忆：一人抓绳，一人看守；共同点都是执行握持或扣留的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lively, playful movement involving jumping, running about, or romping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着玩耍兴致蹦跳、跑动或嬉闹的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħob mimli qbiż, ġiri u ċajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欢蹦乱跳；兴高采烈地跳跃玩耍
活泼嬉闹；跑跳打闹

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħin liberu, il-bitħa kienet mimlija żanik u daħk tat-tfal.
formal.en: During free time, the yard was full of children's romping and laughter.
formal.zh: 自由活动时间，院子里满是孩子们的嬉闹和笑声。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhu dan iż-żanik kollu fil-kamra? Leo: It-tfal qed jilagħbu; se ngħidilhom joħorġu fil-bitħa.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is all this romping in the room? Leo: The children are playing; I will tell them to go out into the yard.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：房间里怎么闹腾成这样？利奥：孩子们在玩，我会叫他们到院子里去。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 房间里怎么闹腾成这样？
messages.en: What is all this romping in the room?

messages.speaker: Leo (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfal qed jilagħbu; se ngħidilhom joħorġu fil-bitħa.
messages.mt_standard: It-tfal qed jilagħbu; se ngħidilhom joħorġu fil-bitħa.
messages.zh: 孩子们在玩，我会叫他们到院子里去。
messages.en: The children are playing; I will tell them to go out into the yard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子在院子里又跑又跳，把这个名词记成一片活泼嬉闹的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play an old-fashioned instrument or a folk instrument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 演奏老式乐器或民间乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idoqqu strument antik jew strument tal-mużika folkloristika.

sense_translations.en_definition: to play an old-fashioned or folk instrument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 演奏老式乐器或民间乐器

collocations.en: played a folk instrument during the celebration
collocations.zh: 在庆典期间演奏了民间乐器

formal.mt: Waqt il-wirja kulturali, il-mużiċist żanqar fuq strument antik quddiem l-udjenza.
formal.en: During the cultural performance, the musician played an old-fashioned instrument before the audience.
formal.zh: 文化演出期间，乐手在观众面前演奏了一件老式乐器。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għamel in-nannu fil-festa? Ġanni: Żanqar fuq l-istrument antik tiegħu, u kulħadd beda jċapċap.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did Grandpa do at the celebration? Ġanni: He played his old-fashioned instrument, and everyone started clapping.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：爷爷在庆典上做什么了？詹尼：他演奏了自己的老式乐器，大家都鼓起掌来。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷在庆典上做什么了？
messages.en: What did Grandpa do at the celebration?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Żanqar fuq l-istrument antik tiegħu, u kulħadd beda jċapċap.
messages.mt_standard: Żanqar fuq l-istrument antik tiegħu, u kulħadd beda jċapċap.
messages.zh: 他演奏了自己的老式乐器，大家都鼓起掌来。
messages.en: He played his old-fashioned instrument, and everyone started clapping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把动词放进民间庆典画面：乐手拿起老式乐器演奏，记住这是动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The playing of a folk instrument, or strumming the strings of an instrument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 民间乐器的演奏活动，或拨扫乐器琴弦的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-daqq ta' strument folkloristiku, jew id-daqq billi wieħed jgħaddi subgħajh fuq il-kordi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民间乐器的演奏
拨弦；扫弦演奏

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-wirja jinkludi kant u żanqir fuq strumenti folkloristiċi.
formal.en: The performance programme includes singing and the playing of folk instruments.
formal.zh: 演出节目包括歌唱和民间乐器演奏。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Minn fejn ġej dan iż-żanqir? Sam: Mill-kamra ta' ħija; qed jipprova ritmu ġdid fuq il-kitarra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is that strumming coming from? Sam: From my brother's room; he is trying out a new rhythm on the guitar.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这拨弦声是从哪儿来的？萨姆：我哥哥的房间，他正在吉他上试一种新节奏。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 这拨弦声是从哪儿来的？
messages.en: Where is that strumming coming from?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mill-kamra ta' ħija; qed jipprova ritmu ġdid fuq il-kitarra.
messages.mt_standard: Mill-kamra ta' ħija; qed jipprova ritmu ġdid fuq il-kitarra.
messages.zh: 我哥哥的房间，他正在吉他上试一种新节奏。
messages.en: From my brother's room; he is trying out a new rhythm on the guitar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想手指扫过琴弦的画面和声音，同时记住它也可指民间乐器演奏这项活动。

gloss_zh: 嗡嗡作响的；常穿新衣的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Buzzing; also describing someone who tends to wear new clothes very often.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容嗡嗡作响的状态；也形容一个人经常穿新衣的习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jżanżan; jew, dwar persuna, li għandha ħabta tilbes ħwejjeġ ġodda ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗡嗡作响的

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to wear new clothes very often
sense_translations.zh_definition: 常常穿新衣的；有频繁穿新衣习惯的

collocations.en: a man who very often wears new clothes

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma 'żanżani' tiddeskrivi raġel li kważi f'kull laqgħa jidher bi ħwejjeġ ġodda.
formal.en: In the text, the word 'żanżani' describes a man who appears in new clothes at almost every meeting.
formal.zh: 文中，żanżani 一词形容一名几乎每次见面都穿新衣的男子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss żanżani ħdejn it-tieqa? Toni: Iva, hemm dubbiena. Niftaħ it-tieqa biex toħroġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that buzzing sound by the window? Toni: Yes, there is a fly. I will open the window to let it out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见窗边那个嗡嗡声了吗？托尼：听见了，有只苍蝇。我把窗户打开让它出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss żanżani ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss żanżani ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你听见窗边那个嗡嗡声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that buzzing sound by the window?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm dubbiena. Niftaħ it-tieqa biex toħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm dubbiena. Niftaħ it-tieqa biex toħroġ.
messages.zh: 听见了，有只苍蝇。我把窗户打开让它出去。
messages.en: Yes, there is a fly. I will open the window to let it out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立记忆卡：一张画嗡嗡作响的声音，一张画常穿新衣的人；分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A net placed over a bed or across an opening to keep mosquitoes out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 罩在床上或装在开口处，用来阻挡蚊子的网。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xibka li titqiegħed fuq sodda jew ma' fetħa biex iżżomm in-nemus barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚊帐；用于阻挡蚊子的网。

collocations.en: a mosquito net over the bed
a mosquito net for the window

formal.mt: Waħħal żanżariera fuq is-sodda biex iżżomm in-nemus 'il bogħod matul il-lejl.
formal.en: Fit a mosquito net over the bed to keep mosquitoes away during the night.
formal.zh: 在床上装好蚊帐，以便夜间阻挡蚊子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm ħafna nemus hawn. Għandek żanżariera? Rita: Iva, se nqegħedha fuq is-sodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: There are lots of mosquitoes here. Do you have a mosquito net? Rita: Yes, I'll put it over the bed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里蚊子好多。你有蚊帐吗？丽塔：有，我这就把它罩在床上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħafna nemus hawn. Għandek żanżariera?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħafna nemus hawn. Għandek żanżariera?
messages.zh: 这里蚊子好多。你有蚊帐吗？
messages.en: There are lots of mosquitoes here. Do you have a mosquito net?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我这就把它罩在床上。
messages.en: Yes, I'll put it over the bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和床上撑起的一层细网一起记：人睡在里面，蚊子留在外面，就是蚊帐。

gloss_zh: 嗡鸣；低沉单调的声音；试穿新衣

teaching_sense.en_definition: A humming, droning, or buzzing sound; in a separate sense, the act of trying on a new item of clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嗡嗡声或低沉、持续而单调的声音；另一个独立义项是试穿一件新衣服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss baxx u kontinwu, bħall-ħoss tan-naħal jew ta' magna; f'tifsira oħra, il-prova ta' ħwejjeġ ġodda fuq il-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻柔而持续的嗡鸣声。
低沉、持续而单调的声音。
嗡嗡声，如昆虫振翅时发出的声音。

sense_translations.en_definition: trying on a new item of clothing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 试穿一件新衣服。

collocations.zh: 机器持续而单调的低鸣声

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, iż-żanżin tan-naħal kien jinstema' qrib il-fjuri.
formal.en: During the observation, the buzzing of bees could be heard near the flowers.
formal.zh: 观察期间，可以听到花朵附近蜜蜂的嗡嗡声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' dak iż-żanżin? Mark: Iva, ġej mill-fann. Se nitfih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that humming? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the fan. I'll turn it off.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那个嗡嗡声了吗？马克：听到了，是风扇发出来的。我把它关掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到那个嗡嗡声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that humming?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 听到了，是风扇发出来的。我把它关掉。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the fan. I'll turn it off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张场景卡分别记忆：蜜蜂或机器持续嗡鸣；另放一张新衣试穿卡，避免把独立义项混在一起。

gloss_zh: 雏鸟吃下的一小口食物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small amount of food eaten by a fledgling, such as a single little mouthful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雏鸟吃下的一小份食物，通常可理解为小小的一口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont żgħir ta' ikel li jiekol ferħ ta' għasfur.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small amount of food eaten by a fledgling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 雏鸟吃下的一小份食物；雏鸟的一小口食物。

collocations.en: a small mouthful eaten by a fledgling
collocations.zh: 雏鸟吃下的一小口食物

collocations.en: another little mouthful for a fledgling
collocations.zh: 雏鸟再吃的一小口食物

formal.mt: Wara li kiel żaqqa żgħira, il-ferħ tal-għasfur baqa' jistenna aktar ikel fil-bejta.
formal.en: After eating a small mouthful, the fledgling remained in the nest waiting for more food.
formal.zh: 雏鸟吃下一小口食物后，仍在巢里等着更多食物。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Il-ferħ kiel xi ħaġa? Pawlu: Iva, kiel żaqqa żgħira u reġa' fetaħ ħalqu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Did the fledgling eat anything? Pawlu: Yes, it ate a small mouthful and opened its mouth again.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：雏鸟吃东西了吗？保罗：吃了，它吃下一小口，又张开了嘴。

messages.speaker: Lina (观鸟者)
messages.zh: 雏鸟吃东西了吗？
messages.en: Did the fledgling eat anything?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kiel żaqqa żgħira u reġa' fetaħ ħalqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kiel żaqqa żgħira u reġa' fetaħ ħalqu.
messages.zh: 吃了，它吃下一小口，又张开了嘴。
messages.en: Yes, it ate a small mouthful and opened its mouth again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象巢里的雏鸟张开小嘴，只吞下一丁点食物；把这个词固定记成雏鸟的一小口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who feeds another person or an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容给其他人或动物喂食的个体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitma' lil persuna oħra jew lil annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂食的；形容给别人或动物喂食的个体。

collocations.en: a parent that feeds its young

formal.mt: L-għasfur żaqqej iġib l-ikel fil-bejta u jitma' lill-frieħ regolarment.
formal.en: The bird that feeds the young brings food to the nest and feeds the fledglings regularly.
formal.zh: 负责喂食的鸟把食物带回巢中，定时给雏鸟喂食。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi jfisser 'żaqqej' hawn? Pawlu: Jiddeskrivi l-għasfur li jitma' lill-frieħ.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'żaqqej' mean here? Pawlu: It describes the bird that feeds the fledglings.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这里的 żaqqej 是什么意思？保罗：它形容给雏鸟喂食的那只鸟。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 żaqqej 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żaqqej' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 它形容给雏鸟喂食的那只鸟。
messages.en: It describes the bird that feeds the fledglings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面焦点放在递出食物的一方：这个形容词描述喂食者，可配合亲鸟喂雏鸟的图片记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greedy person, especially someone who eats excessively or always wants more food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贪心的人，尤其指吃得过多或总想多吃的贪吃者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna rgħiba, speċjalment waħda li tiekol iżżejjed jew dejjem trid aktar ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪心的人；总想多占或多得的人。
贪吃的人；吃得过量的人。

collocations.en: to behave like a greedy person

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, iż-żaqqieq ħa l-akbar porzjon u ħalla ftit ikel għall-oħrajn.
formal.en: In the story, the greedy person took the largest portion and left little food for the others.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个贪心的人拿走了最大的一份，只给其他人留下一点食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħallejt xi gallettini għalina, jew illum sirt żaqqieq? Mark: Ħallejt nofshom! Ejja ħudu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you leave us any biscuits, or have you become a glutton today? Mark: I left half of them! Come and have some.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你给我们留饼干了吗，还是今天变成大馋鬼了？马克：我留了一半呢！来拿几块吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejt xi gallettini għalina, jew illum sirt żaqqieq?
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejt xi gallettini għalina, jew illum sirt żaqqieq?
messages.zh: 你给我们留饼干了吗，还是今天变成大馋鬼了？
messages.en: Did you leave us any biscuits, or have you become a glutton today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我留了一半呢！来拿几块吧。
messages.en: I left half of them! Come and have some.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把整盘点心都拉到自己面前：既可帮助记住贪心的人，也能联想到贪吃的大馋鬼。

gloss_zh: 使物体发出吱嘎声的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something squeak or creak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让某个物体发出吱吱声或吱嘎声的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha wieħed iġiegħel xi ħaġa tagħmel ħoss irqiq jew ħoss ta' tħakkik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物体发出吱吱声或吱嘎声的动作。

collocations.en: deliberately making something squeak or creak
collocations.zh: 故意让物体发出吱嘎声

collocations.en: the act of making the door creak
collocations.zh: 把门弄得吱嘎作响的动作

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, iż-żaqżieq tal-bieb sar billi l-attur ċaqalqu bil-mod.
formal.en: During the rehearsal, the actor made the door creak by moving it slowly.
formal.zh: 排练时，演员通过缓慢移动门扇，让门发出吱嘎声。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Waqqaf iż-żaqżieq tal-bieb, jekk jogħġbok. Toni: Tajjeb, se nħallih magħluq.
colloquial.en: Rita: Please stop making the door creak. Toni: All right, I'll leave it closed.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：请别再把门弄得吱嘎响了。托尼：好，我会让它关着。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 请别再把门弄得吱嘎响了。
messages.en: Please stop making the door creak.

messages.speaker: Toni (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，我会让它关着。
messages.en: All right, I'll leave it closed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时给画面加上一只推动旧门的手：重点是把东西弄响的动作，与单纯听到响声分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to make a creaking sound when moved or used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容移动或使用时容易发出吱嘎声的物体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jagħmel ħoss ta' tħakkik meta jiċċaqlaq jew jintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易发出吱嘎声的；动起来往往吱嘎作响的。

collocations.zh: 一扇容易吱嘎作响的门
一架容易吱嘎作响的梯子

formal.mt: Il-bieb żaqżieqi kien jagħmel ħoss kull darba li jinfetaħ.
formal.en: The creaky door made a noise every time it was opened.
formal.zh: 那扇容易吱嘎作响的门每次打开时都会发出声音。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-bieb żaqżieqi ħafna! Rita: Iva, kull darba li niftħu jinstema' fil-kamra kollha.
colloquial.en: Mark: This door is really creaky! Rita: Yes, every time I open it, you can hear it throughout the room.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这扇门真容易吱嘎响！丽塔：是啊，我每次打开它，整个房间都能听见。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 这扇门真容易吱嘎响！
messages.en: This door is really creaky!

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull darba li niftħu jinstema' fil-kamra kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull darba li niftħu jinstema' fil-kamra kollha.
messages.zh: 是啊，我每次打开它，整个房间都能听见。
messages.en: Yes, every time I open it, you can hear it throughout the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给旧门贴一张容易吱嘎响的标签：这个词描述物体的特性，可以和门、梯子的图片一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The creaking sound or process produced when something moves or bears weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体移动或承重时发出的吱嘎声，也指吱嘎作响这一现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss ta' tħakkik li tagħmel xi ħaġa meta tiċċaqlaq jew iġġorr piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吱嘎作响；物体发出的吱嘎声。

formal.mt: Fil-kwiet tal-lejl, iż-żaqżiq tat-taraġ kien jinstema' ċar kull darba li xi ħadd jitla'.
formal.en: In the quiet of the night, the creaking of the stairs could be heard clearly whenever someone went upstairs.
formal.zh: 夜深人静时，每当有人上楼，楼梯的吱嘎声都能听得清清楚楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak iż-żaqżiq? Pawlu: Iva, ġej mit-taraġ. Mark qed jitla'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that creaking? Pawlu: Yes, it's coming from the stairs. Mark is coming up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那阵吱嘎声了吗？保罗：听到了，是楼梯传来的。马克正在上楼。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵吱嘎声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that creaking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mit-taraġ. Mark qed jitla'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mit-taraġ. Mark qed jitla'.
messages.zh: 听到了，是楼梯传来的。马克正在上楼。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the stairs. Mark is coming up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 闭眼想象脚踩旧楼梯时听到的吱嘎声：这个名词把注意力放在声音或作响现象本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat people harshly and unjustly by using power over them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用权力严酷、不公地对待他人，压制或欺压他们。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża s-setgħa tiegħu biex jaħqar lil ħaddieħor u jittrattah b'mod inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫；以权势欺压他人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħakkiem żarab lill-poplu u ċaħħdu mil-libertà.
formal.en: In the story, the ruler oppressed the people and deprived them of freedom.
formal.zh: 故事中，统治者压迫民众，剥夺了他们的自由。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex in-nies irribellaw fir-rakkont? Mark: Għax il-ħakkiem żarab lill-poplu għal ħafna snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the people rebel in the story? Mark: Because the ruler oppressed them for many years.
colloquial.zh: Maja：故事里的人们为什么反抗？Mark：因为统治者压迫了他们很多年。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的人们为什么反抗？
messages.en: Why did the people rebel in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-ħakkiem żarab lill-poplu għal ħafna snin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-ħakkiem żarab lill-poplu għal ħafna snin.
messages.zh: 因为统治者压迫了他们很多年。
messages.en: Because the ruler oppressed them for many years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żarab 放进“统治者欺压民众”的故事画面中，记住核心是借权势压迫他人。

gloss_zh: 使磨散、脱线；拆开衣物的线

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make fabric fray or to undo the threads of a garment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使织物边缘散开、脱线，或把衣物的线拆开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoll il-ħjut ta' drapp jew ta' biċċa ħwejjeġ, jew jagħmel tarf ta' drapp jinħall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使织物、绳子等的纤维磨散或脱线。

sense_translations.en_definition: to undo the threads of a garment
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆开衣物的线，使其织线或缝线松解。

collocations.en: frayed the edge of the fabric
undid the threads of the dress

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat żarad il-ħjut tal-libsa biex ineħħi l-parti bil-ħsara.
formal.en: The tailor undid the threads of the dress to remove the damaged section.
formal.zh: 裁缝拆开了连衣裙的线，以便去掉损坏的部分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħajjat żarad il-ħjut tal-libsa? Nina: Biex ineħħi l-parti mqatta' u jsewwiha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the tailor undo the threads of the dress? Nina: To remove the torn section and repair it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：裁缝为什么拆开连衣裙的线？Nina：为了去掉破损的部分，再把它修好。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 裁缝为什么拆开连衣裙的线？
messages.en: Why did the tailor undo the threads of the dress?

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ineħħi l-parti mqatta' u jsewwiha.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ineħħi l-parti mqatta' u jsewwiha.
messages.zh: 为了去掉破损的部分，再把它修好。
messages.en: To remove the torn section and repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象布边的线一根根散开，再想象裁缝主动拆线；用同一个“线被松开”的画面串联两个义项。

gloss_zh: 苦痛、困苦；该词仅作为姓氏留存

teaching_sense.en_definition: Distress or suffering; this word survives only as a family surname.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示苦痛或困苦的名词；该词仅作为姓氏留存，学习时应区分词义说明与姓氏用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tfisser tbatija jew dwejjaq u li teżisti biss bħala kunjom.

sense_translations.en_definition: Distress. This word survives only as a family surname
sense_translations.zh_definition: 苦痛；困苦。该词仅作为姓氏留存。

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'żarb' tfisser tbatija, iżda teżisti biss bħala kunjom.
formal.en: The word 'żarb' means distress, but survives only as a surname.
formal.zh: “żarb”意为苦痛，但仅作为姓氏留存。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk Żarb huwa kunjom? Pawlu: Iva. Il-kelma tfisser tbatija, iżda teżisti biss bħala kunjom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Żarb a surname here? Pawlu: Yes. The word means distress, but survives only as a surname.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 Żarb 是姓氏吗？Pawlu：是的。这个词意为苦痛，但仅作为姓氏留存。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 Żarb 是姓氏吗？
messages.en: Is Żarb a surname here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Il-kelma tfisser tbatija, iżda teżisti biss bħala kunjom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Il-kelma tfisser tbatija, iżda teżisti biss bħala kunjom.
messages.zh: 是的。这个词意为苦痛，但仅作为姓氏留存。
messages.en: Yes. The word means distress, but survives only as a surname.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żarb 记成一张双面学习卡：一面写“苦痛”，另一面写“仅作姓氏留存”，避免当作日常普通名词使用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area enclosed by a low wall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由矮墙围起来的一块地方或空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post imdawwar b'ħajt baxx.

sense_translations.en_definition: place enclosed by a low wall
sense_translations.zh_definition: 由矮墙围起来的地方。

collocations.en: an area enclosed by a low wall beside the house
collocations.zh: 房屋旁由矮墙围起的地方

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi żarba ħdejn id-dar, imdawra b'ħajt baxx tal-ġebel.
formal.en: The plan shows an area beside the house enclosed by a low stone wall.
formal.zh: 平面图显示，房屋旁有一块由低矮石墙围起的地方。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn inpoġġu l-qsari? Toni: Fiż-żarba ħdejn id-dar, wara l-ħajt baxx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we put the plant pots? Toni: In the enclosed area beside the house, behind the low wall.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们把花盆放在哪里？Toni：放在房子旁边那块围起来的地方，就在矮墙后面。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 我们把花盆放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the plant pots?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fiż-żarba ħdejn id-dar, wara l-ħajt baxx.
messages.mt_standard: Fiż-żarba ħdejn id-dar, wara l-ħajt baxx.
messages.zh: 放在房子旁边那块围起来的地方，就在矮墙后面。
messages.en: In the enclosed area beside the house, behind the low wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一圈低矮石墙，把 żarba 写在墙内的空地上；它指围起来的地方，记忆重点是“矮墙加空间”。

gloss_zh: 鞋子在行走时发出声响

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a sound while walking, said of shoes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鞋子随着行走而发出声响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss waqt il-mixi, meta jingħad dwar iż-żarbun.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a sound (used of shoes while walking)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出声响，专指鞋子在行走时发出的声音。

collocations.en: the shoes made a sound while walking
collocations.zh: 鞋子在行走时发出了声响

collocations.en: the shoes made a sound on the tiles
collocations.zh: 鞋子踩在瓷砖上发出了声响

formal.mt: Meta daħal fis-sala, iż-żarbun tiegħu żarban fuq l-art tal-injam.
formal.en: When he entered the hall, his shoes made a sound on the wooden floor.
formal.zh: 他走进大厅时，鞋子踩在木地板上发出了声响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss fil-kuritur? Mark: Iż-żarbun tiegħi żarban waqt li kont miexi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that sound in the corridor? Mark: My shoes made a sound as I was walking.
colloquial.zh: Lara：走廊里刚才是什么声音？Mark：是我走路时鞋子发出的声音。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 走廊里刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound in the corridor?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żarbun tiegħi żarban waqt li kont miexi.
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żarbun tiegħi żarban waqt li kont miexi.
messages.zh: 是我走路时鞋子发出的声音。
messages.en: My shoes made a sound as I was walking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安静走廊里有人走过，耳朵听到鞋子的声响；用“鞋随步响”的画面记住 żarban。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting on shoes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把鞋穿到脚上的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jilbes iż-żraben.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿鞋；把鞋穿上的动作。

collocations.en: the time for putting on shoes

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jinkludi ż-żarbin mingħajr għajnuna biex it-tifel jitgħallem jilbes iż-żraben waħdu.
formal.en: The exercise includes putting on shoes without help so that the boy learns to do it by himself.
formal.zh: 这项练习包括独立穿鞋，让男孩学会自己把鞋穿好。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ifisser 'żarbin'? Pawlu: Ifisser l-att li tilbes iż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'żarbin' mean? Pawlu: It means the act of putting on shoes.
colloquial.zh: Nina：“żarbin”是什么意思？Pawlu：指把鞋穿上的动作。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: “żarbin”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żarbin' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 指把鞋穿上的动作。
messages.en: It means the act of putting on shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żarbin 配上一段“脚伸进鞋里”的小动画，记住它是动作名词；与 żarban 的“鞋子发声”画面分别记忆。

gloss_zh: 松散的线头；脱出的织线

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loose threads, especially on clothing or other fabric items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 松散或脱出的线，尤其指衣物和其他织物上的线头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħjut maħlula, speċjalment fil-ħwejjeġ jew f'oġġetti oħra tad-drapp.

sense_translations.en_definition: loose threads (especially of clothes and other fabric-based things)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 松散的线头，尤其指衣物及其他织物制品上的散线。

formal.mt: Waqt il-kontroll tal-libsa, il-ħajjata neħħiet iż-żarda minn mal-keffa.
formal.en: While checking the dress, the seamstress removed the loose threads along the hem.
formal.zh: 女裁缝检查连衣裙时，去除了裙边处松散的线头。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn żarda mal-keffa tal-qmis. Rita: Ġib l-imqass u naqtagħha bil-galbu.
colloquial.en: Sara: There are loose threads along the hem of the shirt. Rita: Bring the scissors and I'll trim them carefully.
colloquial.zh: Sara：衬衫下摆这里有散线。Rita：把剪刀拿来，我小心地剪掉。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.zh: 衬衫下摆这里有散线。
messages.en: There are loose threads along the hem of the shirt.

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 把剪刀拿来，我小心地剪掉。
messages.en: Bring the scissors and I'll trim them carefully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衣服折边上翘起的一小簇线头，把 żarda 贴在这些散线上；再用 żarad 的“拆线动作”帮助区分名词与动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crop grown on agricultural land; also the act of sowing seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 农田中种植的作物；也指把种子播入土中的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanti li jitkabbru fl-għelieqi bħala prodott agrikolu; ukoll l-att li jitqiegħdu ż-żrieragħ fil-ħamrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作物；农田中种植的一批农作物。
播种；把种子播入土中以便生长的行为。

formal.mt: Iż-żargħa taż-żrieragħ saret wara x-xita, meta l-ħamrija kienet niedja.
formal.en: The sowing of the seeds took place after the rain, when the soil was moist.
formal.zh: 播种在雨后进行，当时土壤湿润。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhi ż-żargħa din is-sena? Ġużeppi: Tajba ħafna; il-pjanti kibru sew wara x-xita.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is the crop this year? Ġużeppi: Very good; the plants grew well after the rain.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今年的作物长得怎么样？朱塞佩：很好，雨后植株长得很不错。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 今年的作物长得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the crop this year?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajba ħafna; il-pjanti kibru sew wara x-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Tajba ħafna; il-pjanti kibru sew wara x-xita.
messages.zh: 很好，雨后植株长得很不错。
messages.en: Very good; the plants grew well after the rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用田地里的前后两幅画来记：先把种子播下是“播种”，后来长成的一片植物是“作物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes an assembled object or structure apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把组装好的物件或结构拆成各个部分的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tifred il-partijiet ta' oġġett jew struttura li jkunu magħqudin flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆卸者；从事拆解物件或结构的人。

formal.mt: Iż-żarmatur tal-makkinarju neħħa kull parti b'attenzjoni u poġġieha f'kaxxa separata.
formal.en: The machinery dismantler carefully removed each part and placed it in a separate box.
formal.zh: 机械拆卸人员小心地取下每个零件，并分别装入箱中。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jifred il-partijiet ta' din il-magna? Rita: Iż-żarmatur jasal dalgħodu; ħalli l-magna kif inhi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is going to take this machine apart? Rita: The dismantler is coming this morning; leave the machine as it is.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁来拆这台机器？丽塔：拆卸人员今天上午来，先让机器保持原样。

messages.speaker: Mark (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jifred il-partijiet ta' din il-magna?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jifred il-partijiet ta' din il-magna?
messages.zh: 谁来拆这台机器？
messages.en: Who is going to take this machine apart?

messages.speaker: Rita (主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żarmatur jasal dalgħodu; ħalli l-magna kif inhi.
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żarmatur jasal dalgħodu; ħalli l-magna kif inhi.
messages.zh: 拆卸人员今天上午来，先让机器保持原样。
messages.en: The dismantler is coming this morning; leave the machine as it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着工具逐件拆开机器的工作人员，把整个词与“做拆卸工作的人”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 移除物件；拆卸；卸下挽具

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of removing objects, taking something apart, or removing an animal's harness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 移走物件、拆开某物，或给牲畜卸下挽具的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jitneħħew oġġetti, li jinfirdu l-partijiet ta' xi ħaġa, jew li jitneħħa x-xedd minn fuq annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移除物件；把物件从原处取走。
拆卸；把装配好的物件或结构拆开。
卸下挽具；取下套在牲畜身上的牵引装具。

collocations.en: the removal of objects from the room

formal.mt: Iż-żarmatura tal-magna bdiet wara li t-tekniku skonnettja l-provvista tal-elettriku.
formal.en: The dismantling of the machine began after the technician disconnected the electricity supply.
formal.zh: 技术人员切断电源后，机器拆卸工作才开始。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nista' nieħu ż-żiemel fl-istalla? Toni: Stenna ftit; l-ewwel irridu nagħmlu ż-żarmatura tiegħu u nneħħulu x-xedd.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can I take the horse into the stable? Toni: Wait a moment; first we need to unharness it and take off its harness.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我可以把马牵进马厩吗？托尼：等一下，我们得先给它卸下挽具。

messages.speaker: Anna (骑马学员)
messages.zh: 我可以把马牵进马厩吗？
messages.en: Can I take the horse into the stable?

messages.speaker: Toni (马厩管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; l-ewwel irridu nagħmlu ż-żarmatura tiegħu u nneħħulu x-xedd.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; l-ewwel irridu nagħmlu ż-żarmatura tiegħu u nneħħulu x-xedd.
messages.zh: 等一下，我们得先给它卸下挽具。
messages.en: Wait a moment; first we need to unharness it and take off its harness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项串成取下东西的动作：移走物件、拆下机器部件、卸下马的挽具；注意这是行为名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put seeds into the soil so that they can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把种子播入土中，使其能够生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qiegħed iż-żrieragħ fil-ħamrija biex ikunu jistgħu jikbru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 播种；把种子播撒或种入土中。
结籽；植物产生种子。

collocations.en: sowed the seeds in the soil

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żarra' l-qamħ fil-ħamrija niedja wara l-ewwel xita.
formal.en: The farmer sowed wheat in the moist soil after the first rain.
formal.zh: 第一场雨后，农民把小麦播入湿润的土壤中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħaxix diġà żarra'? Pawlu: Iva, ara ż-żrieragħ fil-parti ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has this grass already produced seeds? Pawlu: Yes, look at the seeds at the top.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这草已经结籽了吗？保罗：对，看上面的那些种子。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 这草已经结籽了吗？
messages.en: Has this grass already produced seeds?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara ż-żrieragħ fil-parti ta' fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara ż-żrieragħ fil-parti ta' fuq.
messages.zh: 对，看上面的那些种子。
messages.en: Yes, look at the seeds at the top.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用种子的两个方向来记：人把种子放进土里是“播种”，植物长出新的种子是“结籽”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To subject people to harsh or unjust treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以严酷或不公正的方式对待他人，使其受到压迫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għakkes lin-nies jew ittrattahom b'mod aħrax jew inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫；以严酷或不公正的方式对待他人。
使加重；使问题、困难或不良情况更加严重。

formal.mt: Il-ħakkiem żarrab lill-poplu b'ordnijiet ħorox u pieni inġusti.
formal.en: The ruler oppressed the people with harsh orders and unjust punishments.
formal.zh: 统治者用严苛的命令和不公正的惩罚压迫人民。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-taħwid fl-iskeda żarrab il-problema? Mark: Iva, issa għandna saħansitra inqas ħin biex inlestu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the confusion in the schedule aggravate the problem? Mark: Yes, now we have even less time to finish.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：日程上的混乱让问题更严重了吗？马克：是的，现在我们完成工作的时间更少了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 日程上的混乱让问题更严重了吗？
messages.en: Did the confusion in the schedule aggravate the problem?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandna saħansitra inqas ħin biex inlestu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandna saħansitra inqas ħin biex inlestu.
messages.zh: 是的，现在我们完成工作的时间更少了。
messages.en: Yes, now we have even less time to finish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象重担继续往下压：压在人身上联想到“压迫”，压在已有问题上联想到“使情况加重”。

gloss_zh: 使磨散；拆开衣物缝线；使织物散线的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make the threads of fabric separate or become loose, especially at an edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使织物的线散开或松脱，尤其指边缘磨散、起毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoll jew fired il-ħjut tad-drapp, speċjalment mat-tarf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使磨散、起毛或散线；使织物的线逐渐松散。

sense_translations.en_definition: to undo the threads holding a garment
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆开缝合衣物的线；拆除把衣物各部分缝在一起的缝线。
使织物散线、磨散或起毛的人。

collocations.en: frayed the edge of the fabric
undid the threads holding the shirt together

formal.mt: Il-ħajjât żarrad il-ħjut li kienu jżommu l-kmiem mal-ġisem tal-qmis sabiex ibiddel id-drapp.
formal.en: The tailor undid the threads attaching the sleeves to the body of the shirt in order to replace the fabric.
formal.zh: 裁缝拆开了把袖子与衬衫衣身缝在一起的线，以便更换布料。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min żarrad it-tarf ta' din il-biċċa drapp? Toni: Jien; ridt nagħmel dekorazzjoni bil-ħjut maħlula.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who frayed the edge of this piece of fabric? Toni: I did; I wanted to make a decoration with the loose threads.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：谁把这块布的边缘弄散了？托尼：是我，我想用散开的线做装饰。

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Min żarrad it-tarf ta' din il-biċċa drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Min żarrad it-tarf ta' din il-biċċa drapp?
messages.zh: 谁把这块布的边缘弄散了？
messages.en: Who frayed the edge of this piece of fabric?

messages.speaker: Toni (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; ridt nagħmel dekorazzjoni bil-ħjut maħlula.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; ridt nagħmel dekorazzjoni bil-ħjut maħlula.
messages.zh: 是我，我想用散开的线做装饰。
messages.en: I did; I wanted to make a decoration with the loose threads.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住“线被松开”的画面：布边散线是一个动词义，拆掉衣物缝线是另一个；作名词时指造成散线的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to develop loose or separated threads, especially along an edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易出现线头松脱、边缘磨散或散线现象的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li l-ħjut tiegħu jinħallu jew jinfirdu, speċjalment mat-tarf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易磨散、起毛或散线的；形容织物的线容易松散。

collocations.en: an edge that tends to fray

formal.mt: Dan id-drapp huwa żarradi, għalhekk it-truf għandhom jinħietu b'attenzjoni biex il-ħjut ma jinħallux.
formal.en: This fabric tends to fray, so the edges should be sewn carefully to keep the threads from coming loose.
formal.zh: 这种布料容易散线，因此应仔细缝好边缘，防止线头松脱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-drapp żarradi? Rita: Iva, il-ħjut fit-tarf jinħallu malajr; aħjar tinħiet it-tarf qabel tużah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this fabric tend to fray? Rita: Yes, the threads at the edge come loose quickly; it is better to sew the edge before using it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种布容易散线吗？丽塔：是的，边上的线很快就会松开，最好先把边缝好再用。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种布容易散线吗？
messages.en: Does this fabric tend to fray?

messages.speaker: Rita (布店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħjut fit-tarf jinħallu malajr; aħjar tinħiet it-tarf qabel tużah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħjut fit-tarf jinħallu malajr; aħjar tinħiet it-tarf qabel tużah.
messages.zh: 是的，边上的线很快就会松开，最好先把边缝好再用。
messages.en: Yes, the threads at the edge come loose quickly; it is better to sew the edge before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象布店标签写着“这种布容易散线”，用这句话记住它描述材料的倾向，是形容词，不是拆线动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show one's knowledge through what one says or does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语或行动展示自己知道的内容，显露知识或学识。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri dak li jaf permezz ta' dak li jgħid jew jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 展示知识；显露自己的学识。

formal.mt: L-istudent żarġaġ waqt id-diskussjoni billi spjega l-ideat b'eżempji ċari.
formal.en: The student displayed his knowledge during the discussion by explaining the ideas with clear examples.
formal.zh: 这名学生在讨论中用清楚的例子解释观点，展示了自己的知识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar Pawlu fid-diskussjoni? Toni: Żarġaġ; spjega s-suġġett u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu do in the discussion? Toni: He displayed his knowledge; he explained the topic and answered all the questions.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 在讨论中表现如何？Toni：他展示了自己的知识，讲解了主题，还回答了所有问题。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu 在讨论中表现如何？
messages.en: How did Pawlu do in the discussion?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żarġaġ; spjega s-suġġett u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Żarġaġ; spjega s-suġġett u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha.
messages.zh: 他展示了自己的知识，讲解了主题，还回答了所有问题。
messages.en: He displayed his knowledge; he explained the topic and answered all the questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课堂上有人把知识讲得清清楚楚，让别人看见他懂什么；用这个展示学识的场景记住 żarġaġ，不额外附加“炫耀”的贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process in which seeds or plants begin to produce new shoots.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 种子或植物开始长出嫩芽的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih iż-żrieragħ jew il-pjanti jibdew joħorġu r-rimjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萌芽；种子或植物开始长出嫩芽。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw iż-żarġin taż-żrieragħ u kitbu meta dehru l-ewwel rimjiet.
formal.en: The students observed the sprouting of the seeds and recorded when the first shoots appeared.
formal.zh: 学生观察了种子的萌发，并记录第一批嫩芽出现的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dawn ir-rimjiet żgħar! Dan hu ż-żarġin? Pawlu: Iva, iż-żrieragħ bdew jikbru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at these little shoots! Is this sprouting? Pawlu: Yes, the seeds have started to grow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看这些小嫩芽！这就是发芽吗？保罗：对，种子开始生长了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dawn ir-rimjiet żgħar! Dan hu ż-żarġin?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dawn ir-rimjiet żgħar! Dan hu ż-żarġin?
messages.zh: 看这些小嫩芽！这就是发芽吗？
messages.en: Look at these little shoots! Is this sprouting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 对，种子开始生长了。
messages.en: Yes, the seeds have started to grow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词配上种子冒出嫩芽的画面，记住它说的是“萌发过程”，而不是一颗种子。

gloss_zh: 容易发出拨弦般颤响的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to produce a sharp, vibrating sound like a plucked string.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容容易发出像拨动琴弦那样尖锐而带颤动的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jagħmel ħoss qawwi u jivvibra bħal korda meta tindaqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易发出拨弦般尖锐颤响的

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni, il-ħoss żarżari tal-istrument jinstema' b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In the recording, the instrument's twanging sound can be heard clearly.
formal.zh: 在这段录音中，可以清楚听到乐器发出的拨弦般颤响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħoss żarżari ġej mill-kitarra? Pawlu: Iva, isma' kif tivvibra l-korda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that twanging sound coming from the guitar? Pawlu: Yes, listen to how the string vibrates.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个拨弦般的颤响是吉他发出来的吗？保罗：是啊，听听琴弦是怎么振动的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个拨弦般的颤响是吉他发出来的吗？
messages.en: Is that twanging sound coming from the guitar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，听听琴弦是怎么振动的。
messages.en: Yes, listen to how the string vibrates.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拨一下琴弦后声音仍在颤动，把 żarżari 和这种带颤音的音色联系起来；它是描述声音特征的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A repeated rattling noise or a continuous buzzing sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体反复碰撞产生的咔嗒声，或持续振动产生的嗡嗡声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ripetut ta' oġġetti li jaħbtu ma' xulxin, jew ħoss kontinwu bħal dak ta' insett li jtir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物体反复碰撞、震动产生的咔嗒声或哗啦声
昆虫或其他振动物体发出的嗡嗡声

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, instema' ż-żarżir tan-naħal qrib il-fjuri.
formal.en: During the observation in the garden, the buzzing of bees was heard near the flowers.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，可以听到花朵附近蜜蜂的嗡嗡声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan iż-żarżir fil-borża? Mark: Huma ċ-ċwievet tiegħi; qed jaħbtu ma' xulxin.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that rattling in the bag? Mark: It's my keys; they're knocking against each other.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：包里什么东西在哗啦响？马克：是我的钥匙，它们碰在一起了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 包里什么东西在哗啦响？
messages.en: What's that rattling in the bag?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma ċ-ċwievet tiegħi; qed jaħbtu ma' xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Huma ċ-ċwievet tiegħi; qed jaħbtu ma' xulxin.
messages.zh: 是我的钥匙，它们碰在一起了。
messages.en: It's my keys; they're knocking against each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个声音画面记 żarżir：摇动钥匙时的哗啦声，以及蜜蜂飞过时的嗡嗡声；两个义项都指声音。

gloss_zh: 爱管闲事的人；自不量力的人；冒失自大的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who interferes in other people's affairs or acts with an exaggerated view of their own ability or importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱插手他人事务，或高估自己的能力、地位而冒失行事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tindaħal fi ħwejjeġ ħaddieħor jew taħseb li taf jew tista' tagħmel aktar milli fil-fatt taf jew tista'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱管闲事、插手他人事务的人
高估自身能力、自不量力的人
自以为是、冒失越分的人

collocations.en: a meddler who interferes in everything

collocations.mt: żatat li jaħseb li jaf kollox
collocations.en: a presumptuous person who thinks he knows everything

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żatat jagħti pariri lil kulħadd, anki dwar xogħol li ma jifhimx fih.
formal.en: In the story, the meddler gives advice to everyone, even about work he does not understand.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个爱管闲事的人对谁都要指点一番，连自己不懂的工作也不例外。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed isejħulu żatat? David: Għax qed jgħid lil kulħadd kif jagħmel ix-xogħol mingħajr ma jaf x'inhu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are they calling him a meddler? David: Because he's telling everyone how to do the work without knowing what it involves.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他们为什么说他爱管闲事？戴维：因为他连工作内容都不懂，就在教所有人该怎么做。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 他们为什么说他爱管闲事？
messages.en: Why are they calling him a meddler?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed jgħid lil kulħadd kif jagħmel ix-xogħol mingħajr ma jaf x'inhu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed jgħid lil kulħadd kif jagħmel ix-xogħol mingħajr ma jaf x'inhu.
messages.zh: 因为他连工作内容都不懂，就在教所有人该怎么做。
messages.en: Because he's telling everyone how to do the work without knowing what it involves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żatat 想成一位总抢着指点别人的人：既爱插手，又可能高估自己。记住这是带批评意味的人物称呼。

gloss_zh: 提出供考虑；冒失自大的人；爱管闲事的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put forward an idea, proposal, or possibility for others to consider.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把想法、提议或可能的做法提出来，供他人考虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ressaq idea, proposta jew possibbiltà biex ħaddieħor jikkunsidraha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提出想法或建议，供他人考虑
自以为是、冒失越分的人
爱管闲事、插手他人事务的人

collocations.en: he put forward an idea for consideration
collocations.zh: 他提出了一个想法供考虑

collocations.en: he put forward a proposal for consideration
collocations.zh: 他提出了一项建议供考虑

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, il-membru żattat proposta biex il-librerija tiftaħ aktar kmieni.
formal.en: During the meeting, the member put forward a proposal for the library to open earlier.
formal.zh: 会议期间，这位成员提出一项建议，供大家考虑让图书馆提早开放。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'żattat Mark fil-laqgħa? Ġorġ: Idea biex nagħmlu l-kors filgħaxija; għadna rridu niddiskutuha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did Mark put forward at the meeting? Ġorġ: An idea to hold the course in the evening; we still need to discuss it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克在会上提出了什么建议？乔治：把课程安排在晚上的想法，我们还要讨论一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克在会上提出了什么建议？
messages.en: What did Mark put forward at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Idea biex nagħmlu l-kors filgħaxija; għadna rridu niddiskutuha.
messages.mt_standard: Idea biex nagħmlu l-kors filgħaxija; għadna rridu niddiskutuha.
messages.zh: 把课程安排在晚上的想法，我们还要讨论一下。
messages.en: An idea to hold the course in the evening; we still need to discuss it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 żattat 分设两张记忆卡：动词卡画一项提案被摆上桌；名词卡画一个冒失插话的人。依句中词性选择意义。

gloss_zh: 侵扰的；爱干涉的；冒失自大的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Interfering in other people's affairs or acting with unwelcome familiarity or excessive confidence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容行为侵扰他人、爱插手别人的事，或表现得过分自信而冒失越分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jindaħal fi ħwejjeġ ħaddieħor jew juri kunfidenza żejda b'mod li jdejjaq lil oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侵扰他人、越过私人界限的
爱管闲事、干涉他人事务的
自以为是、冒失越分的

formal.mt: Il-kumment żattati dwar il-ħajja privata tal-kollega ħoloq skumdità waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The intrusive comment about the colleague's private life caused discomfort during the meeting.
formal.zh: 那句涉及同事私生活、越过界限的评论，让会议现场的人感到不自在。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dak il-kumment kien żattati, hux? Toni: Iva, ma kellux jindaħal fil-ħajja privata tagħha.
colloquial.en: Elena: That comment was intrusive, wasn't it? Toni: Yes, he shouldn't have interfered in her private life.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：那句话有点越界了，是吧？托尼：是啊，他不该干涉她的私生活。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.zh: 那句话有点越界了，是吧？
messages.en: That comment was intrusive, wasn't it?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma kellux jindaħal fil-ħajja privata tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma kellux jindaħal fil-ħajja privata tagħha.
messages.zh: 是啊，他不该干涉她的私生活。
messages.en: Yes, he shouldn't have interfered in her private life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人跨过写着“私人空间”的界线发表评论，用 żattati 描述这种越界、干涉或冒失自大的态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unwanted interference in other people's affairs, or behavior showing excessive confidence and insufficient respect for boundaries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不受欢迎地插手他人事务的行为，或过分自信、不尊重界限的冒失表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Indħil mhux mixtieq fi ħwejjeġ ħaddieħor, jew imġiba li turi kunfidenza żejda u nuqqas ta' rispett lejn il-limiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 插手他人事务、爱管闲事的行为
自以为是、冒失越分的态度或行为

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont juri kif iż-żattit fil-ħajja privata tal-oħrajn jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-ħbiberiji.
formal.en: The story shows how meddling in other people's private lives can damage friendships.
formal.zh: 这个故事展示了干涉他人私生活如何损害友谊。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan iż-żattit fil-pjanijiet tiegħi qed idejjaqni. Luqa: Għidilhom li trid tiddeċiedi int.
colloquial.en: Marija: This meddling in my plans is bothering me. Luqa: Tell them you want to decide for yourself.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：他们这样干涉我的计划，让我很烦。卢卡：告诉他们，你想自己做决定。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan iż-żattit fil-pjanijiet tiegħi qed idejjaqni.
messages.mt_standard: Dan iż-żattit fil-pjanijiet tiegħi qed idejjaqni.
messages.zh: 他们这样干涉我的计划，让我很烦。
messages.en: This meddling in my plans is bothering me.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 告诉他们，你想自己做决定。
messages.en: Tell them you want to decide for yourself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żattit 记成“插手这件事本身”：画面里有人伸手改动别人的计划。这里命名的是干涉或冒失行为，而非某个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of going to see people or places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 前往看望他人或到某些地方走访的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tmur tara nies jew postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 探访他人或走访某些地方的活动

formal.mt: L-għaqda torganizza żawran lill-morda biex toffrilhom kumpanija u appoġġ.
formal.en: The association organizes visits to sick people to offer them company and support.
formal.zh: 协会组织探望病人的活动，为他们提供陪伴和支持。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek ħin għal ftit żawran lill-qraba nhar il-Ħadd? Ben: Iva, nistgħu nibdew min-nanna wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you have time to do a little visiting with relatives on Sunday? Ben: Yes, we can start with Grandma in the afternoon.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：星期天你有时间去看看亲戚吗？本：有啊，我们可以下午先去看奶奶。

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ħin għal ftit żawran lill-qraba nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ħin għal ftit żawran lill-qraba nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 星期天你有时间去看看亲戚吗？
messages.en: Do you have time to do a little visiting with relatives on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nibdew min-nanna wara nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nibdew min-nanna wara nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 有啊，我们可以下午先去看奶奶。
messages.en: Yes, we can start with Grandma in the afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żawran 配上一张探访行程表：先看奶奶，再看亲戚。用连续登门看望的画面，记住它表示探访活动。

gloss_zh: 凄苦的；离群或流寓异乡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Miserable in condition, or living apart from others or in exile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容处境凄苦，或远离他人生活、流寓异乡的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'qagħda ta' miżerja, jew jgħix maqtugħ minn oħrajn jew fl-eżilju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处境凄苦、可怜的
与他人分开生活或流寓异乡的

collocations.zh: 在流寓异乡中离群生活

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist jgħix żawwali fl-eżilju, 'il bogħod minn familtu u minn pajjiżu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist lives apart in exile, far from his family and homeland.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公流寓异乡，离群独居，远离家人和故土。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dak ir-raġel żawwali għandu lil xi ħadd iżuru? Pietru: Iva, il-ġara tmur tarah kuljum u tiħodlu xi ikel.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does that poor, miserable man have anyone who visits him? Pietru: Yes, his neighbor goes to see him every day and takes him some food.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那个处境凄苦的男人，有人去看望他吗？彼得：有啊，邻居每天都去看他，还给他带些吃的。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel żawwali għandu lil xi ħadd iżuru?
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel żawwali għandu lil xi ħadd iżuru?
messages.zh: 那个处境凄苦的男人，有人去看望他吗？
messages.en: Does that poor, miserable man have anyone who visits him?

messages.speaker: Pietru (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ġara tmur tarah kuljum u tiħodlu xi ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ġara tmur tarah kuljum u tiħodlu xi ikel.
messages.zh: 有啊，邻居每天都去看他，还给他带些吃的。
messages.en: Yes, his neighbor goes to see him every day and takes him some food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅远离家园、独自生活的画面记 żawwali，同时分别记住“处境凄苦”和“离群或流寓异乡”两个义项，按上下文判断。

gloss_zh: 小阴茎；żobb 的指小形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small penis; a diminutive form of the noun 'żobb'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指小阴茎，是名词 żobb 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pene żgħir; forma diminuttiva tan-nom 'żobb'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小阴茎，名词 żobb 的指小形式。

formal.mt: F'din in-nota lingwistika, 'żbajjeb' huwa spjegat bħala forma diminuttiva ta' 'żobb' u jfisser pene żgħir.
formal.en: In this linguistic note, 'żbajjeb' is explained as a diminutive form of 'żobb', meaning a small penis.
formal.zh: 这则语言学说明将 żbajjeb 解释为 żobb 的指小形式，意思是小阴茎。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'żbajjeb'? Mark: Tfisser pene żgħir; hija forma diminuttiva ta' 'żobb'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'żbajjeb' mean? Mark: It means a small penis; it is a diminutive form of 'żobb'.
colloquial.zh: Maja：żbajjeb 这个词是什么意思？Mark：意思是小阴茎，是 żobb 的指小形式。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: żbajjeb 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'żbajjeb' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser pene żgħir; hija forma diminuttiva ta' 'żobb'.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser pene żgħir; hija forma diminuttiva ta' 'żobb'.
messages.zh: 意思是小阴茎，是 żobb 的指小形式。
messages.en: It means a small penis; it is a diminutive form of 'żobb'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żobb 与 żbajjeb 配成一对词卡，后一张画一个表示“小”的箭头，记住其指小含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cast a vote against a person, such as a candidate in an election.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在选举等投票过程中对某人投反对票。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti vot kontra persuna, bħal kandidat f'elezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人投反对票。

collocations.zh: 对该候选人投了反对票

formal.mt: Fil-votazzjoni għall-presidenza, id-delegat żballotta lill-kandidat minħabba nuqqas ta' fiduċja fih.
formal.en: In the vote for the presidency, the delegate voted against the candidate because he lacked confidence in him.
formal.zh: 在主席选举中，这位代表因不信任该候选人而投了反对票。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ivvota favur il-kandidat? Lara: Le, żballotta lill-kandidat għax ma qabilx mal-proposti tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark vote for the candidate? Lara: No, he voted against the candidate because he disagreed with his proposals.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 投票支持那位候选人了吗？Lara：没有，他不赞同候选人的提议，所以投了反对票。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 投票支持那位候选人了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark vote for the candidate?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, żballotta lill-kandidat għax ma qabilx mal-proposti tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, żballotta lill-kandidat għax ma qabilx mal-proposti tiegħu.
messages.zh: 没有，他不赞同候选人的提议，所以投了反对票。
messages.en: No, he voted against the candidate because he disagreed with his proposals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象候选人照片旁的一张反对票，把 żballotta 和“投票反对这个人”的完整动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To disband a group or cease operating as a group; also, for a vessel, to lean to one side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使团体解散或作为团体停止活动；也指船身向一侧倾斜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixxolji grupp jew tieqaf teżisti bħala grupp; għal bastiment, tmil lejn naħa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解散团体，或团体停止共同活动。
指船身向一侧倾斜。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-vapur żbanda lejn il-lemin wara li ċċaqalqet it-tagħbija.
formal.en: The report indicates that the ship listed to starboard after the cargo shifted.
formal.zh: 报告指出，货物移位后，船身向右舷倾斜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-grupp għadu jdoqq flimkien? Mark: Le, żbanda wara l-aħħar kunċert.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the group still play together? Mark: No, it disbanded after the last concert.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个乐队还在一起演出吗？Mark：没有了，最后一场音乐会后就解散了。

messages.speaker: Maja (乐迷)
messages.zh: 那个乐队还在一起演出吗？
messages.en: Does the group still play together?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有了，最后一场音乐会后就解散了。
messages.en: No, it disbanded after the last concert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żbanda 画两幅独立小图：成员散开的乐队和向一边歪的船，分别记住解散与倾侧。

gloss_zh: 提取存款；赢光庄家的钱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To withdraw money from a bank; also, in gambling, to win all the money available from the bank.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从银行提取款项；也指赌博时赢光庄家可支付的钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġbed flus mill-bank; fil-logħob tal-azzard, tirbaħ il-flus kollha li jkollu l-bank.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提取款项，从银行取钱。
在赌博中赢光庄家的钱。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont, il-plejer żbanka l-bank u l-logħob kellu jieqaf.
formal.en: According to the account, the player broke the bank and play had to stop.
formal.zh: 据记述，那位玩家赢光了庄家的钱，赌局只得停止。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għandu flus kontanti għall-ħlas? Lara: Iva, dalgħodu żbanka mitt ewro.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Mark have cash for the payment? Lara: Yes, he withdrew one hundred euros this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 有现金付款吗？Lara：有，他今天早上取了一百欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 有现金付款吗？
messages.en: Does Mark have cash for the payment?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，他今天早上取了一百欧元。
messages.en: Yes, he withdrew one hundred euros this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面记 żbanka：银行柜台取出现金，以及赌桌上赢光庄家筹码；注意两种语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave a vessel and go ashore; to land or arrive on land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离开船只到岸上；登陆或抵达陆地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinżel minn bastiment għal fuq l-art; tasal l-art jew fuq ix-xatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下船，离开船只登岸。
登陆，上岸，抵达陆地。

formal.mt: It-tim żbarka fuq il-gżira kmieni filgħodu biex jibda l-istudju tal-kosta.
formal.en: The team landed on the island early in the morning to begin its study of the coast.
formal.zh: 团队清晨登上那座岛，开始研究海岸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għadu fuq il-vapur? Lara: Le, għadu kemm żbarka; qed jistenniena mal-moll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark still on the ship? Lara: No, he has just disembarked; he is waiting for us by the quay.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 还在船上吗？Lara：没有，他刚下船，正在码头边等我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 还在船上吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still on the ship?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu kemm żbarka; qed jistenniena mal-moll.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu kemm żbarka; qed jistenniena mal-moll.
messages.zh: 没有，他刚下船，正在码头边等我们。
messages.en: No, he has just disembarked; he is waiting for us by the quay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żbarka 记成脚从船板踏上岸的瞬间；镜头看离船就是下船，看到达就是登陆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of applying paint to a surface or dye to a material to give it colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给表面涂上油漆或给材料染色的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tagħti kulur lil wiċċ biż-żebgħa jew li tiżbogħ materjal bħal drapp.

sense_translations.en_definition: the activity of painting or dying
sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂漆、刷色或染色的活动。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħriġ fiż-żbigħ tad-drapp u fl-għażla tal-kuluri.
formal.en: The course includes training in fabric dyeing and colour selection.
formal.zh: 课程包括布料染色和颜色选择方面的训练。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tagħmlu d-dar għada? Mark: Se nibdew iż-żbigħ tal-ħitan tas-salott.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to do at home tomorrow? Mark: We are going to start painting the living room walls.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们明天准备在家做什么？Mark：我们准备开始粉刷客厅的墙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们明天准备在家做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do at home tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.zh: 我们准备开始粉刷客厅的墙。
messages.en: We are going to start painting the living room walls.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一边刷墙、一边给布染色，两幅画面都在“给东西上颜色”，共同对应名词 żbigħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a person, object, or arrangement to lose its balance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人、物体或某种安排失去平衡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel persuna, oġġett jew arranġament jitlef il-bilanċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使失去平衡，使不均衡。

collocations.zh: 使装载的货物失去平衡

formal.mt: It-tqegħid ta' kaxxa tqila fuq naħa waħda żbilanċja t-tagħbija tal-vettura.
formal.en: Placing a heavy box on one side unbalanced the vehicle's load.
formal.zh: 把一个重箱子放在一侧，使车辆装载的货物失去了平衡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karrettun qed ixaqleb? Mark: Dak il-barmil tqil żbilanċja t-tagħbija. Ejja npoġġuh fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the cart tilting? Mark: That heavy bucket unbalanced the load. Let's put it in the middle.
colloquial.zh: Maja：小推车为什么歪了？Mark：那个重桶让载重失去了平衡。我们把它放到中间吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺工人)
messages.zh: 小推车为什么歪了？
messages.en: Why is the cart tilting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-barmil tqil żbilanċja t-tagħbija. Ejja npoġġuh fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-barmil tqil żbilanċja t-tagħbija. Ejja npoġġuh fin-nofs.
messages.zh: 那个重桶让载重失去了平衡。我们把它放到中间吧。
messages.en: That heavy bucket unbalanced the load. Let's put it in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天平一边突然加上重物而歪斜，把 żbilanċja 记成“某物使原来的平衡被打破”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of cutting back plant growth, or of cutting wool from sheep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剪除植物部分枝条的活动；也指从羊身上剪取羊毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtugħ ta' friegħi mill-pjanti, jew il-qtugħ tas-suf minn fuq in-nagħaġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修枝，修剪植物的枝条。
剪毛，尤指给羊剪毛。

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' taħriġ jinkludi sessjoni dwar iż-żbir tas-siġar u oħra dwar iż-żbir tan-nagħaġ.
formal.en: The training programme includes one session on tree pruning and another on sheep shearing.
formal.zh: 培训计划包括一节树木修枝课程和另一节剪羊毛课程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tagħmel fil-ġnien illum? Mark: Se nagħmel ftit żbir tas-siġar; hemm xi friegħi niexfa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to do in the garden today? Mark: I am going to do some tree pruning; there are a few dry branches.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天准备在花园里做什么？Mark：我准备给树修修枝，有几根枯枝。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你今天准备在花园里做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do in the garden today?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħmel ftit żbir tas-siġar; hemm xi friegħi niexfa.
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħmel ftit żbir tas-siġar; hemm xi friegħi niexfa.
messages.zh: 我准备给树修修枝，有几根枯枝。
messages.en: I am going to do some tree pruning; there are a few dry branches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żbir 配一把剪刀：剪树枝是修枝，剪羊身上的毛是剪毛；用剪的对象区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fade or become less strong in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指颜色逐渐变淡，失去原有的鲜艳程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-qawwa tal-kulur u jsir aktar ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 褪色；颜色逐渐变淡。

formal.mt: Il-kulur tad-drapp żbjadixxa wara espożizzjoni twila għax-xemx.
formal.en: The colour of the fabric faded after prolonged exposure to sunlight.
formal.zh: 这块布料的颜色在长时间日晒后变淡了。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex dan il-flokk jidher daqshekk ċar? Pawlu: Il-kulur żbjadixxa għax ħallejtu fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why does this T-shirt look so pale? Pawlu: The colour faded because I left it in the sun.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这件T恤的颜色怎么这么淡？保罗：我把它放在太阳底下，颜色晒褪了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-flokk jidher daqshekk ċar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-flokk jidher daqshekk ċar?
messages.zh: 这件T恤的颜色怎么这么淡？
messages.en: Why does this T-shirt look so pale?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我把它放在太阳底下，颜色晒褪了。
messages.en: The colour faded because I left it in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件鲜艳的衣服晒久后颜色越来越淡，用这幅画面记住“褪色”；这是情景记忆法，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flow or lead into another place, or to express feelings or worries that one has been keeping inside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指水流汇入某处、道路通向某处；也指把积压在心里的话或烦恼倾吐出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi għal ġo post ieħor, bħal ilma jew passaġġ; jew jgħid dak li jkun ilu jżomm f'qalbu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to flow or lead into (of a river, stream, road, etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指河流、溪流等流入或汇入某处，或道路等通向某处。
把压在心里的话说出来；倾吐心事或烦恼。

collocations.en: the passage led into the square
got what was on his mind off his chest

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ dejjaq żbokka fi pjazza kbira quddiem il-knisja.
formal.en: The narrow passage led into a large square in front of the church.
formal.zh: 这条狭窄的通道通向教堂前的一座大广场。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tkellimt ma' Mark dwar dak li ġara? Luqa: Iva, fl-aħħar żbokkajt dak li kelli f'qalbi, u issa nħossni aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you talk to Mark about what happened? Luqa: Yes, I finally got what was on my mind off my chest, and now I feel better.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你跟马克谈过发生的事了吗？卢卡：谈过了，我终于把心里压着的话说出来了，现在感觉好多了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkellimt ma' Mark dwar dak li ġara?
messages.mt_standard: Tkellimt ma' Mark dwar dak li ġara?
messages.zh: 你跟马克谈过发生的事了吗？
messages.en: Did you talk to Mark about what happened?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fl-aħħar żbokkajt dak li kelli f'qalbi, u issa nħossni aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fl-aħħar żbokkajt dak li kelli f'qalbi, u issa nħossni aħjar.
messages.zh: 谈过了，我终于把心里压着的话说出来了，现在感觉好多了。
messages.en: Yes, I finally got what was on my mind off my chest, and now I feel better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面并排记忆：水流进入大海，心事通过说话释放出来。它们分别提示空间流向和倾吐心事两个义项，并非词源说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pay out money, including making a disbursement or paying a sum one would rather not spend.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把钱支付出去，可用于正式拨款，也可用于日常所说的掏钱、花上一笔钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħallas jew joħroġ somma flus, sew bħala ħlas uffiċjali kif ukoll għal spiża personali.

sense_translations.en_definition: to pay out, to fork out, to disburse, to shell out
sense_translations.zh_definition: 支付或拨付款项；掏钱，尤其指不得不花上一笔钱。

collocations.en: paid out the money for the repairs

formal.mt: Il-kunsill żborża għaxart elef ewro għat-tiswija tas-saqaf taċ-ċentru.
formal.en: The council disbursed ten thousand euros to repair the centre's roof.
formal.zh: 议会拨付了一万欧元，用于修缮该中心的屋顶。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm ħallast għat-tiswija tal-karozza? Mark: Żborżajt mitejn ewro, aktar milli kont qed nistenna.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much did you pay to repair the car? Mark: I shelled out two hundred euros, more than I was expecting.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：修车花了多少钱？马克：我掏了两百欧元，比预想的还多。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 修车花了多少钱？
messages.en: How much did you pay to repair the car?

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Żborżajt mitejn ewro, aktar milli kont qed nistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Żborżajt mitejn ewro, aktar milli kont qed nistenna.
messages.zh: 我掏了两百欧元，比预想的还多。
messages.en: I shelled out two hundred euros, more than I was expecting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象付维修费时把一叠钞票交出去：正式场合是“拨付款项”，日常聊天是“掏了一笔钱”，都抓住钱付出去的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose control of one's behaviour, or to be mentally deranged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指行为或情绪失去控制；另一义为精神失常，须根据上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-kontroll tal-imġiba jew tal-emozzjonijiet tiegħu; jew ikun fi stat ta' taqlib mentali serju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失去控制；情绪或行为失控。
精神失常；处于精神紊乱的状态。

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, ir-raġel żboxxla u kellu jieqaf għal ftit biex jerġa' jikkalma.
formal.en: During the discussion, the man lost control and had to pause for a while to calm down again.
formal.zh: 讨论期间，这名男子失去了控制，需要暂停片刻，让自己重新冷静下来。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex telaq Mark mil-laqgħa? Pawlu: Żboxxla u beda jgħajjat, imbagħad ħareġ biex jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did Mark leave the meeting? Pawlu: He lost control and started shouting, then went outside to calm down.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：马克为什么离开会议了？保罗：他失控大喊起来，后来出去让自己冷静一下。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么离开会议了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Żboxxla u beda jgħajjat, imbagħad ħareġ biex jikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Żboxxla u beda jgħajjat, imbagħad ħareġ biex jikkalma.
messages.zh: 他失控大喊起来，后来出去让自己冷静一下。
messages.en: He lost control and started shouting, then went outside to calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“争论中突然大喊”的情景记住失控义，再单独记精神失常义；不要把一次情绪失控自动理解成精神失常。

gloss_zh: 做水泥找平层；抹平粗糙墙面

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prepare a cement screed, or to smooth a rough wall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指施工时制作水泥找平层，或将粗糙的墙面抹平、磨平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħejji saff tas-siment biex jillivella art, jew iwitti wiċċ ta' ħajt aħrax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作或铺设水泥找平层。
将粗糙的墙面磨平或抹平，使表面平滑。

collocations.zh: 做了地面的水泥找平层

collocations.en: prepared the screed before laying the tiles
collocations.zh: 在铺瓷砖前做了找平层

formal.mt: Il-bennej żbozza l-art qabel ma beda jqiegħed il-madum.
formal.en: The builder prepared the floor screed before starting to lay the tiles.
formal.zh: 建筑工人在开始铺瓷砖之前，先做了地面的水泥找平层。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-ħajt għadu aħrax? Toni: Le, il-bennej żbozza l-ħajt dalgħodu; issa l-wiċċ huwa lixx.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the wall still rough? Toni: No, the builder smoothed the wall this morning; the surface is smooth now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：墙面还很粗糙吗？托尼：不，建筑工人今天上午已经抹平了，现在表面很光滑。

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.zh: 墙面还很粗糙吗？
messages.en: Is the wall still rough?

messages.speaker: Toni (装修工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-bennej żbozza l-ħajt dalgħodu; issa l-wiċċ huwa lixx.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-bennej żbozza l-ħajt dalgħodu; issa l-wiċċ huwa lixx.
messages.zh: 不，建筑工人今天上午已经抹平了，现在表面很光滑。
messages.en: No, the builder smoothed the wall this morning; the surface is smooth now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把施工现场分成脚下和身旁两处：脚下做水泥找平层，身旁把粗墙抹平；用两个具体操作记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tear something into pieces, or to ruin it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把东西撕成碎片；也可指使某物遭到严重破坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqatta' xi ħaġa f'biċċiet, jew jagħmlilha ħsara kbira u jħassarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕成碎片；撕碎。
毁坏；使遭到严重破坏。

formal.mt: Il-kelb żbrana l-borża u xerred il-karti mal-art.
formal.en: The dog tore the bag to pieces and scattered the papers across the floor.
formal.zh: 狗把袋子撕烂了，纸张散落了一地。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif inhu l-ġnien wara l-maltemp? Ġorġ: Il-maltemp żbrana l-ġnien; irridu nirranġawh.
colloquial.en: Anna: How is the garden after the storm? Ġorġ: The storm ruined the garden; we need to put it right.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：暴风雨过后，花园怎么样了？乔治：暴风雨把花园毁坏了，我们得好好修整一下。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 暴风雨过后，花园怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the garden after the storm?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (花园主人)
messages.zh: 暴风雨把花园毁坏了，我们得好好修整一下。
messages.en: The storm ruined the garden; we need to put it right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象纸袋被撕成碎片，再想象花园被风雨毁坏：前者帮助记“撕碎”，后者帮助记“毁坏”，共同突出严重破坏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To graze skin or scrape a surface through contact or friction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指接触或摩擦造成皮肤表面擦伤，或刮擦某个表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jobrox il-ġilda jew wiċċ ta' xi ħaġa minħabba kuntatt jew ħakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦伤皮肤；刮擦或擦破物体表面。

collocations.en: scraped the skin against the wall

formal.mt: It-tifel żbrixxa l-irkoppa meta waqa' fil-bitħa tal-iskola.
formal.en: The boy grazed his knee when he fell in the school playground.
formal.zh: 男孩在学校操场跌倒时擦伤了膝盖。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Għaliex għandek demm fuq il-minkeb? Ben: Żbrixxajt il-minkeb mal-ħajt waqt li kont qed nilgħab.
colloquial.en: Mum: Why is there blood on your elbow? Ben: I scraped my elbow against the wall while I was playing.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你的手肘怎么流血了？本：我玩的时候，手肘蹭到墙上擦伤了。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 你的手肘怎么流血了？
messages.en: Why is there blood on your elbow?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Żbrixxajt il-minkeb mal-ħajt waqt li kont qed nilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Żbrixxajt il-minkeb mal-ħajt waqt li kont qed nilgħab.
messages.zh: 我玩的时候，手肘蹭到墙上擦伤了。
messages.en: I scraped my elbow against the wall while I was playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象膝盖或手肘蹭过粗糙墙面，表皮被擦破的感觉；把这个词和“表面摩擦、擦伤”一起记忆。
