gloss_zh: 增加；获得加薪；家中添员

teaching_sense.en_definition: To increase or be increased, to get a pay rise, or to gain a new family member.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指数量或程度增加；也可指获得加薪，或家庭增添一名成员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar fin-numru jew fil-kwantità; jieħu żieda fil-paga; jew ikollu membru ġdid fil-familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；被提高或增多。
获得加薪；工资提高。
家中增添一名成员；家庭添员。

collocations.en: a new member joined the family

formal.mt: Matul din is-sena, żdied in-numru tal-istudenti li jattendu l-kors.
formal.en: During this year, the number of students attending the course increased.
formal.zh: 今年，参加这门课程的学生人数增加了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejrin l-affarijiet għandkom? Mark: Tajjeb! Żdied membru fil-familja: twieldet bintna. Maja: Awguri! U fuq ix-xogħol? Mark: Żdied ukoll is-salarju tiegħi dan ix-xahar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are things with your family? Mark: Good! We have a new family member: our daughter was born. Maja: Congratulations! And at work? Mark: My salary went up this month too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们家最近怎么样？马克：很好！家里添了新成员，我们的女儿出生了。玛雅：恭喜！工作上呢？马克：这个月我的工资也涨了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们家最近怎么样？
messages.en: How are things with your family?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Żdied membru fil-familja: twieldet bintna.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Żdied membru fil-familja: twieldet bintna.
messages.zh: 很好！家里添了新成员，我们的女儿出生了。
messages.en: Good! We have a new family member: our daughter was born.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 恭喜！工作上呢？
messages.en: Congratulations! And at work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żdied ukoll is-salarju tiegħi dan ix-xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Żdied ukoll is-salarju tiegħi dan ix-xahar.
messages.zh: 这个月我的工资也涨了。
messages.en: My salary went up this month too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三个加号帮助记忆：人数加一、工资增加、家里添一人。三种情景都围绕“比原来更多”，再分别记住各自搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fail to give someone or something the care or attention needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有给予某人或某事应有的照料或关注；疏忽对待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jagħtix lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa l-kura jew l-attenzjoni meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疏忽；忽视；没有妥善照料或关注。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li s-sid żdinga l-manutenzjoni tad-dar għal diversi snin.
formal.en: The report shows that the owner neglected the maintenance of the house for several years.
formal.zh: 报告显示，房主多年来一直疏于维护房屋。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ġnien jinsab f'dan l-istat? Toni: Ħija żdinga l-ġnien waqt li kont imsiefer.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the garden in this state? Toni: My brother neglected the garden while I was abroad.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：花园怎么变成这样了？托尼：我出国期间，我哥哥没有好好照料花园。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 花园怎么变成这样了？
messages.en: Why is the garden in this state?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija żdinga l-ġnien waqt li kont imsiefer.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija żdinga l-ġnien waqt li kont imsiefer.
messages.zh: 我出国期间，我哥哥没有好好照料花园。
messages.en: My brother neglected the garden while I was abroad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花园因无人照料而杂草丛生，把 żdinga 与“该照顾却没照顾”这一画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To complete the customs procedures needed for goods to enter or leave a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为货物完成进出口所需的海关手续，使其获准通关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-proċeduri tad-dwana meħtieġa biex il-merkanzija tidħol f'pajjiż jew toħroġ minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为货物办理海关放行手续；清关。

formal.mt: L-importatur żdogana l-merkanzija qabel ma bagħatha lejn il-maħżen.
formal.en: The importer cleared the goods through customs before sending them to the warehouse.
formal.zh: 进口商先为货物办理清关，然后将其运往仓库。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-pakkett għadu għand id-dwana? Mark: Le, il-kurrier żdogana l-pakkett dalgħodu u se jġibu għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the parcel still at customs? Mark: No, the courier cleared the parcel through customs this morning and will bring it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：包裹还在海关吗？马克：没有，快递员今天早上已经办好清关，明天会送来。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 包裹还在海关吗？
messages.en: Is the parcel still at customs?

messages.speaker: Mark (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-kurrier żdogana l-pakkett dalgħodu u se jġibu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-kurrier żdogana l-pakkett dalgħodu u se jġibu għada.
messages.zh: 没有，快递员今天早上已经办好清关，明天会送来。
messages.en: No, the courier cleared the parcel through customs this morning and will bring it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象包裹在海关盖章后获准继续运送，用“办完手续才放行”的情景记住 żdogana。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply paint to a surface to give it colour or a new finish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把颜料或油漆涂在物体表面，使其着色或焕新。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Japplika ż-żebgħa fuq wiċċ biex jagħtih il-kulur jew dehra ġdida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂色；涂刷油漆。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żeba' l-ħitan tal-klassi bojod qabel il-bidu tas-sena skolastika.
formal.en: The worker painted the classroom walls white before the start of the school year.
formal.zh: 工人在学年开始前把教室的墙壁刷成了白色。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min żeba' l-bieb blu? Pawlu: Missieri. Għażel dan il-kulur ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who painted the door blue? Pawlu: My father. He chose this colour yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把门漆成蓝色了？保罗：我爸爸。他昨天选了这个颜色。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁把门漆成蓝色了？
messages.en: Who painted the door blue?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 我爸爸。他昨天选了这个颜色。
messages.en: My father. He chose this colour yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żeba' 放进“刷子把白墙刷成蓝色”的画面中记忆；抄写时连词尾的撇号一起保留。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply colour or a coating to something by colouring, painting, varnishing, or dyeing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过着色、刷漆、涂清漆或染色等方式，给物体施加颜色或涂层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti kulur jew kisja lil xi ħaġa billi japplika żebgħa, verniċ jew materjal ieħor adattat.

sense_translations.en_definition: to colour, paint, varnish, dye (apply colour to, in any context)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 着色、刷漆、涂清漆或染色；泛指在各种情境下给物体施加颜色。

formal.mt: L-artiġjan żebagħ id-drapp aħmar u ħallieh jinxef qabel ma użah.
formal.en: The craftsperson dyed the fabric red and left it to dry before using it.
formal.zh: 工匠把布料染成红色，晾干后才使用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-drapp kien abjad, hux? Toni: Iva, ħija żebagħ id-drapp blu għall-purtieri l-ġodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: This fabric used to be white, didn't it? Toni: Yes, my brother dyed the fabric blue for the new curtains.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块布原来是白色的，对吧？托尼：对，我哥哥把它染成了蓝色，准备用来做新窗帘。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块布原来是白色的，对吧？
messages.en: This fabric used to be white, didn't it?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħija żebagħ id-drapp blu għall-purtieri l-ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħija żebagħ id-drapp blu għall-purtieri l-ġodda.
messages.zh: 对，我哥哥把它染成了蓝色，准备用来做新窗帘。
messages.en: Yes, my brother dyed the fabric blue for the new curtains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“墙壁刷漆、布料染色、桌面上清漆”三幅画面记忆 żebagħ，理解它可用于不同的施色情境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make butter, or to spread butter on something such as bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作黄油，或把黄油涂抹在面包等食物上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-butir, jew jidlek il-ħobż jew ikel ieħor bil-butir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作黄油。
涂抹黄油，例如在面包上抹黄油。

formal.mt: Matul id-dimostrazzjoni, il-bidwi żebbed il-krema biex juri kif isir il-butir.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the farmer made butter from the cream to show how butter is produced.
formal.zh: 演示期间，农民用奶油制作黄油，展示黄油的制作过程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min żebbed il-ħobż għall-kolazzjon? Mark: Jien. Trid ftit ġamm ukoll?
colloquial.en: Nina: Who buttered the bread for breakfast? Mark: I did. Would you like some jam too?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁给早餐的面包抹了黄油？马克：我抹的。你还要一点果酱吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 谁给早餐的面包抹了黄油？
messages.en: Who buttered the bread for breakfast?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.zh: 我抹的。你还要一点果酱吗？
messages.en: I did. Would you like some jam too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕黄油记两个动作：先把奶油制成黄油，再把黄油抹上面包；两种情景都配上 żebbed。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To string beads, count rosary beads, or look at someone with a sharp, fixed stare.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把珠子串起来；数玫瑰经念珠；也可指用锐利而紧盯的目光看某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi ż-żibeġ minn ħajta, jgħodd iż-żibeġ tal-kuruna tar-rużarju, jew iħares fiss u b'għajnejn jaqtgħu lejn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把珠子穿在线上；串珠。

sense_translations.en_definition: to count the beads of a rosary
sense_translations.zh_definition: 数玫瑰经念珠的珠粒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give sb. a beady-eyed look
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锐利、紧盯的目光看某人；瞪视某人。

collocations.en: strung the beads on a thread
gave his companion a beady-eyed look

formal.mt: L-artiġjan żebbeġ iż-żibeġ fuq ħajta twila biex jagħmel ġiżirana.
formal.en: The craftsperson strung the beads on a long thread to make a necklace.
formal.zh: 工匠把珠子穿在一根长线上，制作项链。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min żebbeġ dawn iż-żibeġ? Maja: Ħija. Għamel brazzuletta għal ommi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who strung these beads? Maja: My brother. He made a bracelet for my mother.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些珠子是谁串的？玛雅：我哥哥。他给我妈妈做了一条手链。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些珠子是谁串的？
messages.en: Who strung these beads?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥。他给我妈妈做了一条手链。
messages.en: My brother. He made a bracelet for my mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 żebbeġ 画三张学习卡：穿珠子的手、数念珠的手、紧盯人的眼睛；这是记义联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sells butter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以出售黄油为业的人；黄油商贩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbigħ il-butir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖黄油的人；黄油商。

collocations.en: the butter seller at the market

formal.mt: Iż-żebbied tas-suq ibigħ il-butir f'pakketti żgħar u jżommu fil-friġġ.
formal.en: The butter seller at the market sells butter in small packets and keeps it refrigerated.
formal.zh: 市场里的黄油商出售小包装黄油，并将黄油冷藏保存。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn xtrajt dan il-butir? Toni: Mingħand iż-żebbied fis-suq. Għandu butir tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you buy this butter? Toni: From the butter seller at the market. He has very good butter.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块黄油是在哪里买的？托尼：在市场的黄油商那里买的。他的黄油很好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块黄油是在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy this butter?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mingħand iż-żebbied fis-suq. Għandu butir tajjeb ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Mingħand iż-żebbied fis-suq. Għandu butir tajjeb ħafna.
messages.zh: 在市场的黄油商那里买的。他的黄油很好。
messages.en: From the butter seller at the market. He has very good butter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象市场里专门卖黄油的摊主，把人物标签写成 żebbied；记住这个词指卖黄油的人。

gloss_zh: 爱涂画或染色的；有涂染倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to paint things or apply dye, often as a habit or preference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于给物品涂画、上色或染色的，常体现为习惯或偏好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħabta jpinġi jew jiżbogħ l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有涂画、上色或染色倾向的。

collocations.en: a boy who is inclined to paint things
collocations.zh: 爱给东西涂画上色的男孩

collocations.en: a disposition inclined towards painting or dyeing

formal.mt: It-tifel żebbiegħi għażel li jiżbogħ il-kaxxi tal-injam b'kuluri differenti.
formal.en: The boy, who liked painting things, chose to paint the wooden boxes in different colours.
formal.zh: 那个爱给东西上色的男孩选择把木盒涂成不同的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk tassew żebbiegħi; dejjem irid jiżbogħ xi ħaġa! Luqa: Iva, illum irid jagħmel din il-kaxxa ħamra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Your brother really likes painting things; he always wants to paint something! Luke: Yes, today he wants to paint this box red.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你弟弟真爱给东西上色，总想找点什么来涂！卢卡：是啊，今天他想把这个盒子涂红。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk tassew żebbiegħi; dejjem irid jiżbogħ xi ħaġa!
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk tassew żebbiegħi; dejjem irid jiżbogħ xi ħaġa!
messages.zh: 你弟弟真爱给东西上色，总想找点什么来涂！
messages.en: Your brother really likes painting things; he always wants to paint something!

messages.speaker: Luqa (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum irid jagħmel din il-kaxxa ħamra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum irid jagħmel din il-kaxxa ħamra.
messages.zh: 是啊，今天他想把这个盒子涂红。
messages.en: Yes, today he wants to paint this box red.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个总拿着画笔、见到盒子就想上色的孩子，用这个习惯画面记住爱涂染的意思。

gloss_zh: 橄榄园；产橄榄者；珠子商或串珠人

teaching_sense.en_definition: An olive grove; something that yields olives; or a person who sells or strings beads, depending on the sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指橄榄园、产橄榄的树木等，或出售珠子、从事串珠的人；具体意思由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġnien bis-siġar taż-żebbuġ; xi ħaġa li tagħti ż-żebbuġ; jew persuna li tbigħ iż-żibeġ jew tgħaddihom minn ħajta, skont is-sens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种有橄榄树的园地；橄榄园。
产橄榄者；指会结橄榄的树木等。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who sells or strings beads
sense_translations.zh_definition: 出售珠子的人，或从事串珠的人。

collocations.en: a walk in the olive grove

formal.mt: Il-bidwi jieħu ħsieb iż-żebbieġ u jiġbor iż-żebbuġ meta jkun misjur.
formal.en: The farmer tends the olive grove and harvests the olives when they are ripe.
formal.zh: 农民照料橄榄园，并在橄榄成熟时采收。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mort timxi llum? Pawlu: Fiż-żebbieġ ta' zijuwi. Hemm ħafna siġar u dell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you go for a walk today? Pawlu: In my uncle's olive grove. There are lots of trees and plenty of shade.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天去哪里散步了？保罗：去我叔叔的橄榄园了。那里树很多，也很遮阴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天去哪里散步了？
messages.en: Where did you go for a walk today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fiż-żebbieġ ta' zijuwi. Hemm ħafna siġar u dell.
messages.mt_standard: Fiż-żebbieġ ta' zijuwi. Hemm ħafna siġar u dell.
messages.zh: 去我叔叔的橄榄园了。那里树很多，也很遮阴。
messages.en: In my uncle's olive grove. There are lots of trees and plenty of shade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żebbieġ 分成三张义项卡：橄榄园、结橄榄的树、卖珠或串珠的人；读句子时用场景选择意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A counting tool with beads that slide along rods or wires, used to perform arithmetic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用杆或线上可移动的算珠进行计数和算术运算的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'żibeġ li jiżżerżqu fuq vireg jew wajers, użata għall-għadd u għall-kalkoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 算盘；利用移动算珠进行计数和计算的工具。

formal.mt: L-għalliema użat żebbieġa biex turi lill-istudenti kif iżidu żewġ numri.
formal.en: The teacher used an abacus to show the students how to add two numbers.
formal.zh: 老师用算盘向学生演示如何将两个数相加。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif se ngħodd dawn kollha? Mark: Uża ż-żebbieġa; ċaqlaq żibġa għal kull oġġett.
colloquial.en: Lara: How am I going to count all these? Mark: Use the abacus; move one bead for each item.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这么多东西，我怎么数呀？马克：用算盘吧，每数一件就拨一颗算珠。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这么多东西，我怎么数呀？
messages.en: How am I going to count all these?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża ż-żebbieġa; ċaqlaq żibġa għal kull oġġett.
messages.mt_standard: Uża ż-żebbieġa; ċaqlaq żibġa għal kull oġġett.
messages.zh: 用算盘吧，每数一件就拨一颗算珠。
messages.en: Use the abacus; move one bead for each item.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与一排可拨动的算珠联系起来，想象每拨一珠就数一件物品，记住它表示算盘。

gloss_zh: 珠子般小而圆亮的，多形容眼睛

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a small, round, bead-like appearance, especially when describing eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈现小而圆、像珠子一样的外观，主要用于描写眼睛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu dehra ta' żibeġ żgħar u tondi, l-aktar meta jiġu deskritti l-għajnejn.

sense_translations.en_definition: beady (used mainly in relation to the eyes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 珠子般小而圆亮的，主要用于形容眼睛。

collocations.zh: 眼睛像小珠子一样的仓鼠

formal.mt: Fl-illustrazzjoni jidher ġurdien żebbieġi, b'għajnejn żgħar, tondi u jleqqu.
formal.en: The illustration shows a beady-eyed mouse with small, round, shiny eyes.
formal.zh: 插图中有一只老鼠，眼睛小而圆亮，像两颗小珠子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dak il-ħamster żebbieġi! Pawlu: Iva, għajnejh qishom żewġ żibeġ żgħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that beady-eyed hamster! Paul: Yes, its eyes look like two little beads.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看那只眼睛圆溜溜的仓鼠！保罗：是啊，它的眼睛像两颗小珠子。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看那只眼睛圆溜溜的仓鼠！
messages.en: Look at that beady-eyed hamster!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għajnejh qishom żewġ żibeġ żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għajnejh qishom żewġ żibeġ żgħar.
messages.zh: 是啊，它的眼睛像两颗小珠子。
messages.en: Yes, its eyes look like two little beads.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仓鼠脸上两颗圆亮的小眼睛，把珠子般的视觉印象与这个形容词一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 橄榄；橄榄果的集合称呼

teaching_sense.en_definition: Olives considered collectively: small fruits with a stone, eaten as food or used to produce oil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对橄榄果的集合称呼，指可供食用或榨油、内有果核的小果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frott taż-żebbuġ meqjus flimkien, b'għadma ġewwa, li jittiekel jew jintuża biex isir iż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橄榄；此处可统指供食用或榨油的橄榄果。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, żid ftit żebbuġ bla għadam u kuċċarina żejt taż-żebbuġ.
formal.en: For this recipe, add some pitted olives and a teaspoon of olive oil.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，加入少许去核橄榄和一茶匙橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid ftit żebbuġ mal-ħobż? David: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Hemm żebbuġ bla għadam?
colloquial.en: Maria: Would you like some olives with the bread? David: Yes, please. Are there any pitted olives?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：要不要来点橄榄配面包？戴维：好的，谢谢。有去核橄榄吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (主人)
messages.zh: 要不要来点橄榄配面包？
messages.en: Would you like some olives with the bread?

messages.speaker: David (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Hemm żebbuġ bla għadam?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Hemm żebbuġ bla għadam?
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。有去核橄榄吗？
messages.en: Yes, please. Are there any pitted olives?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żebbuġ 想成餐桌上一碟橄榄，再联想到旁边的橄榄油瓶，成组记住食物和常用搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One olive: a small fruit with a stone, eaten as food or used to produce oil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一颗橄榄果，内有果核，可供食用或榨油。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta waħda taż-żebbuġ, b'għadma ġewwa, li tittiekel jew tintuża biex isir iż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橄榄；一颗橄榄果。

formal.mt: Poġġi żebbuġa waħda fuq kull biċċa ħobż qabel isservi.
formal.en: Place one olive on each piece of bread before serving.
formal.zh: 上桌前，在每片面包上放一颗橄榄。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Baqa' żebbuġa waħda fil-platt. Tridha? Ġanni: Ħudha int; jien diġà kilt biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Emma: There's one olive left on the plate. Do you want it? John: You have it; I've already had enough.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：盘子里还剩一颗橄榄，你要吗？约翰：你吃吧，我已经吃够了。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 盘子里还剩一颗橄榄，你要吗？
messages.en: There's one olive left on the plate. Do you want it?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħudha int; jien diġà kilt biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Ħudha int; jien diġà kilt biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 你吃吧，我已经吃够了。
messages.en: You have it; I've already had enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żebbuġa 與盘里最后一颗橄榄联系起来，用 żebbuġa waħda 这个短语强化一颗的记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who treats someone or something with scorn or contempt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以轻蔑或鄙视的态度看待他人或事物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħares lejn ħaddieħor jew lejn xi ħaġa bi stmerrija jew disprezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻蔑或鄙视他人、事物的人。

collocations.zh: 不尊重他人、满怀轻蔑的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żeblieħ jirrifjuta li jisma' l-ideat tal-oħrajn u jidħaq bl-isforzi tagħhom.
formal.en: In the story, the scorner refuses to listen to other people's ideas and mocks their efforts.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个轻蔑他人的人拒绝听取别人的想法，还嘲笑他们的努力。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex sejjaħtlu żeblieħ? Toni: Għax jidħaq b'kulħadd u jitkellem bħallikieku ħadd ma jiswa xejn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you call him a scorner? Tony: Because he laughs at everyone and talks as if nobody is worth anything.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么说他是个轻蔑别人的人？托尼：因为他嘲笑所有人，说起话来仿佛别人都一文不值。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个轻蔑别人的人？
messages.en: Why did you call him a scorner?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jidħaq b'kulħadd u jitkellem bħallikieku ħadd ma jiswa xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jidħaq b'kulħadd u jitkellem bħallikieku ħadd ma jiswa xejn.
messages.zh: 因为他嘲笑所有人，说起话来仿佛别人都一文不值。
messages.en: Because he laughs at everyone and talks as if nobody is worth anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讨论中那个总翻白眼、嘲笑别人努力的人；这个名词指持轻蔑态度的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing scorn or contempt towards someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在态度、言语或举止中表现出轻蔑、鄙视的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri stmerrija jew disprezz lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现出轻蔑或鄙视的。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem wieġeb b'ton żeblieħi li wera nuqqas ta' rispett lejn il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The speaker replied in a contemptuous tone that showed a lack of respect for the participants.
formal.zh: 发言者以轻蔑的语气作答，表现出对与会者的不尊重。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dak il-kumment kien żeblieħi. Ben: Għandek raġun; stajt ma naqbilx mingħajr ma nweġġa' lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Martha: That comment was scornful. Ben: You're right; I could have disagreed without hurting anyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：那句话带着轻蔑。贝恩：你说得对，我本来可以表达不同意见而不伤害任何人。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 那句话带着轻蔑。
messages.en: That comment was scornful.

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; stajt ma naqbilx mingħajr ma nweġġa' lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; stajt ma naqbilx mingħajr ma nweġġa' lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我本来可以表达不同意见而不伤害任何人。
messages.en: You're right; I could have disagreed without hurting anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词贴在轻蔑的语气和鄙视的评论上，记住它用来描述态度或表达方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of attacking someone with abusive or degrading words that damage their reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用辱骂或贬损性的言辞攻击他人、损害其名誉的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tattakka lil xi ħadd bi kliem offensiv jew degradanti li jagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诋毁；以恶意辱骂或贬损言辞损害他人名誉。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ikkundanna l-kampanja ta' żebliħ kontra l-voluntiera u talab li d-diskussjoni ssir b'rispett.
formal.en: The committee condemned the campaign of vilification against the volunteers and called for respectful discussion.
formal.zh: 委员会谴责了针对志愿者的诋毁行动，并要求以尊重他人的方式展开讨论。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt x'kitbu fuqu? Dak hu żebliħ. Samwel: Iva, qed jinsultawh minflok jiddiskutu dak li qal.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you see what they wrote about him? That's vilification. Samuel: Yes, they're insulting him instead of discussing what he said.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你看到他们写了什么来攻击他吗？那是在诋毁他。萨穆埃尔：是啊，他们在辱骂他，而没有讨论他说的话。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt x'kitbu fuqu? Dak hu żebliħ.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt x'kitbu fuqu? Dak hu żebliħ.
messages.zh: 你看到他们写了什么来攻击他吗？那是在诋毁他。
messages.en: Did you see what they wrote about him? That's vilification.

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jinsultawh minflok jiddiskutu dak li qal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jinsultawh minflok jiddiskutu dak li qal.
messages.zh: 是啊，他们在辱骂他，而没有讨论他说的话。
messages.en: Yes, they're insulting him instead of discussing what he said.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人用一连串恶意言辞抹黑他人名誉，将这种攻击行为整体记作诋毁，并与表示人的 żeblieħ 区分。

gloss_zh: 爱跳舞的；会跳舞的；有规律地律动的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fond of dancing, able to dance, or showing regular rhythmic movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人喜欢跳舞或具备跳舞的能力，也可形容动作有规律、有节奏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jiżfen, jaf jiżfen, jew juri moviment regolari u ritmiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜欢跳舞的；爱好舞蹈的
会跳舞的；具有跳舞能力的
呈现有规律、有节奏的运动的

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel huwa deskritt bħala żeffieni għax iħobb jiżfen kull meta jisma' l-mużika.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is described as fond of dancing because he likes to dance whenever he hears music.
formal.zh: 故事把这个男孩描写成一个爱跳舞的人，因为他一听到音乐就喜欢跳舞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk iħobb jiżfen? Pawlu: Iva, żeffieni ħafna! Malli tibda l-mużika, iqum jiżfen.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your brother like dancing? Pawlu: Yes, he loves it! As soon as the music starts, he gets up to dance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥喜欢跳舞吗？保罗：喜欢，他特别爱跳！音乐一响，他就站起来跳舞。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥喜欢跳舞吗？
messages.en: Does your brother like dancing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żeffieni ħafna! Malli tibda l-mużika, iqum jiżfen.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żeffieni ħafna! Malli tibda l-mużika, iqum jiżfen.
messages.zh: 喜欢，他特别爱跳！音乐一响，他就站起来跳舞。
messages.en: Yes, he loves it! As soon as the music starts, he gets up to dance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“一听音乐就跳舞”的画面，再联系“会跳舞”和“有节奏地运动”两个相关义项。

gloss_zh: 柏油或沥青铺面工；爱管闲事的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A worker who coats surfaces with tar or pitch; also, a person who pries into other people's affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以柏油或沥青涂覆表面为业的人；也指喜欢打探、干涉别人私事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li jiksa l-uċuħ bil-qatran jew biż-żift; ukoll persuna li tindaħal fi ħwejjeġ ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. whose job is to surface with tar or pitch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以柏油或沥青涂覆、铺设表面为职业的人
爱打探别人私事、爱管闲事的人

collocations.en: a busybody who interferes in everything
collocations.zh: 什么事都要插手的好事者

formal.mt: Iż-żeffiet kesa l-wiċċ tas-saqaf biż-żift biex jipprevjeni d-dħul tal-ilma.
formal.en: The tar worker coated the roof surface with pitch to prevent water from entering.
formal.zh: 柏油工用沥青涂覆屋顶表面，以防雨水渗入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ġar reġa' staqsieni fejn sejra u ma' min. Lara: Kemm hu żeffiet! Dejjem irid ikun jaf kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: The neighbour asked me again where I was going and who with. Lara: What a busybody! He always wants to know everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：邻居又问我要去哪儿、跟谁一起去。拉拉：真爱管闲事！他总想什么都知道。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġar reġa' staqsieni fejn sejra u ma' min.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġar reġa' staqsieni fejn sejra u ma' min.
messages.zh: 邻居又问我要去哪儿、跟谁一起去。
messages.en: The neighbour asked me again where I was going and who with.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu żeffiet! Dejjem irid ikun jaf kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu żeffiet! Dejjem irid ikun jaf kollox.
messages.zh: 真爱管闲事！他总想什么都知道。
messages.en: What a busybody! He always wants to know everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立场景记忆：屋顶上涂沥青的工人，以及总打听邻居私事的人；不要把两义误当成同一职业。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the practical ability to coat a surface with tar or pitch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具备用柏油或沥青涂覆表面的实际技能的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jiksa wiċċ bil-qatran jew biż-żift.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to tar or pitch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具备涂柏油或沥青的能力的

collocations.en: a worker able to apply tar or pitch
collocations.zh: 会涂柏油或沥青的工人

collocations.en: a man skilled in applying tar or pitch
collocations.zh: 具备涂柏油或沥青技能的男人

formal.mt: Għal dan ix-xogħol hemm bżonn ħaddiem żeffieti li jaf jiksa l-wiċċ b'saff uniformi ta' żift.
formal.en: This job requires a worker skilled in applying pitch who can coat the surface with an even layer.
formal.zh: 这项工作需要一名会涂沥青的工人，能够在表面均匀涂上一层沥青。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Taf lil xi ħadd żeffieti biex jgħinni bis-saqaf? Pawlu: Iva, naf ħaddiem li jaf jagħmel dan ix-xogħol tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you know anyone who can apply pitch to help me with the roof? Pawlu: Yes, I know a worker who can do that job well.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你认识会涂沥青的人吗？我想找人帮忙处理屋顶。保罗：认识，我知道一个工人，这活儿他做得很好。

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf lil xi ħadd żeffieti biex jgħinni bis-saqaf?
messages.mt_standard: Taf lil xi ħadd żeffieti biex jgħinni bis-saqaf?
messages.zh: 你认识会涂沥青的人吗？我想找人帮忙处理屋顶。
messages.en: Do you know anyone who can apply pitch to help me with the roof?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naf ħaddiem li jaf jagħmel dan ix-xogħol tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naf ħaddiem li jaf jagħmel dan ix-xogħol tajjeb.
messages.zh: 认识，我知道一个工人，这活儿他做得很好。
messages.en: Yes, I know a worker who can do that job well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工人把屋顶沥青涂得均匀，记住这个形容词强调“有这门手艺”，而非单纯指工人的身份。

gloss_zh: 扭动身体的人；动来动去的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who wiggles or repeatedly moves their body in small twisting movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不断小幅扭动身体、动来动去的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħarrek ġisimha b'movimenti żgħar ta' tidwir jew titħarrek ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭动身体的人；身体不断小幅摆动的人

collocations.en: someone who wiggles on the chair
collocations.zh: 在椅子上扭来扭去的人

collocations.en: a wiggler who cannot sit still

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel jissejjaħ żeglieg għax jibqa' jitħarrek fuq is-siġġu matul il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is called a wiggler because he keeps moving about on his chair during the lesson.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个男孩被称为动来动去的人，因为他上课时一直在椅子上扭动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħija ma jieqaf qatt jitħarrek fuq is-siġġu. Lara: Dak żeglieg! Forsi għandu bżonn iqum ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: My brother never stops moving about on his chair. Lara: He's a real wiggler! Perhaps he needs to get up for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我弟弟坐在椅子上就没停止过扭动。拉拉：他可真坐不住！也许他需要起来活动一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ma jieqaf qatt jitħarrek fuq is-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ma jieqaf qatt jitħarrek fuq is-siġġu.
messages.zh: 我弟弟坐在椅子上就没停止过扭动。
messages.en: My brother never stops moving about on his chair.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak żeglieg! Forsi għandu bżonn iqum ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Dak żeglieg! Forsi għandu bżonn iqum ftit.
messages.zh: 他可真坐不住！也许他需要起来活动一下。
messages.en: He's a real wiggler! Perhaps he needs to get up for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住椅子上扭来扭去的那个人：这个词是名词，回答“谁在扭动”，把注意力放在动作的执行者上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moving with small twisting movements or wriggling motions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以小幅扭转、摆动或蠕动的方式活动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitħarrek b'movimenti żgħar ta' tidwir jew jitgħawweġ waqt li jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小幅摆动、扭来扭去的
扭曲着身体活动的；蠕动的

formal.mt: L-istudent osserva dudu żegliegi li kien qed jiċċaqlaq bil-mod fuq il-ħamrija niedja.
formal.en: The student observed a wriggling worm moving slowly over the damp soil.
formal.zh: 学生观察到一条蠕动的虫子，正缓缓爬过湿润的泥土。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tifel daqshekk żegliegi llum? Pawlu: Ilu bilqiegħda ħafna; ħa noħorġu nimxu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the boy so wiggly today? Pawlu: He's been sitting for a long time; let's go out for a short walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这孩子今天怎么总扭来扭去？保罗：他坐得太久了；咱们出去走一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 这孩子今天怎么总扭来扭去？
messages.en: Why is the boy so wiggly today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilu bilqiegħda ħafna; ħa noħorġu nimxu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ilu bilqiegħda ħafna; ħa noħorġu nimxu ftit.
messages.zh: 他坐得太久了；咱们出去走一会儿吧。
messages.en: He's been sitting for a long time; let's go out for a short walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把孩子扭动和虫子蠕动并排想象：这个词是形容词，描述“怎样动”，可分别对应小幅摆动和身体扭曲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Repeated small twisting or side-to-side movements of the body or part of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或身体某个部位反复轻微扭动、左右摆动的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċaqliq żgħir u ripetut tal-ġisem jew ta' parti minnu, b'tidwir jew moviment minn naħa għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭动；身体或某个部位来回摆动的动作。

formal.mt: Iż-żeglig kontinwu tat-tifel għamilha diffiċli għall-fotografu biex jieħu ritratt ċar.
formal.en: The child's constant wiggling made it difficult for the photographer to take a clear picture.
formal.zh: 孩子不停地扭动，让摄影师很难拍出清晰的照片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: B'dan iż-żeglig kollu ma nistax nieħulek ritratt! Leo: Tajjeb, se noqgħod kwiet għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: I can't take your picture with all this wiggling! Leo: All right, I'll stay still for a moment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你这样扭来扭去，我没法给你拍照！利奥：好吧，我会安静不动一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: B'dan iż-żeglig kollu ma nistax nieħulek ritratt!
messages.mt_standard: B'dan iż-żeglig kollu ma nistax nieħulek ritratt!
messages.zh: 你这样扭来扭去，我没法给你拍照！
messages.en: I can't take your picture with all this wiggling!

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se noqgħod kwiet għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se noqgħod kwiet għal ftit.
messages.zh: 好吧，我会安静不动一会儿。
messages.en: All right, I'll stay still for a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拍照时孩子扭来扭去，把 żeglig 和这种反复的小幅摆动联系起来；它是动作的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Abundance, proliferation, or an increase in the number or quantity of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物大量存在的丰盛状态，或其数量增多、繁衍增生的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Abbundanza ta' xi ħaġa, jew tkattir jew żieda fin-numru jew fil-kwantità tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量存在；充足丰盛的状态。
增生；繁衍；数量不断增多的现象。
增加；数量或总量的增长。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi żegħda ta' pjanti selvaġġi fl-għalqa wara x-xita.
formal.en: The report describes a proliferation of wild plants in the field after the rain.
formal.zh: 报告描述了雨后田里野生植物大量生长的现象。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rajt iż-żegħda ta' pjanti fil-ġnien? Toni: Iva, wara x-xita mtela kollox bl-aħdar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you seen the abundance of plants in the garden? Toni: Yes, after the rain everything turned green.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你看见花园里长了那么多植物吗？托尼：看见了，下过雨以后到处都绿了。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 你看见花园里长了那么多植物吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the abundance of plants in the garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wara x-xita mtela kollox bl-aħdar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wara x-xita mtela kollox bl-aħdar.
messages.zh: 看见了，下过雨以后到处都绿了。
messages.en: Yes, after the rain everything turned green.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后植物越长越多，最后满园都是绿色；用这个画面串起 żegħda 的“丰盛、增生、增加”三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat someone with indulgent affection, caress them, flatter them, or gently coax them to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以宠爱、爱抚、奉承或温柔哄劝的方式对待某人；具体意思由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri mħabba jew għożża lil xi ħadd, imissu bil-ħlewwa, ifaħħru biex jogħġbu, jew iħajru bil-ħlewwa jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宠爱；娇养；给予格外周到或纵容的照顾。
爱抚；温柔地抚摸。
奉承；用讨好的赞美使人高兴。
哄劝；用温柔、耐心或讨好的方式劝人做某事。

formal.mt: Il-missier żegħel lit-tifel bi kliem ħelu sakemm ikkalma u aċċetta li jidħol fil-klassi.
formal.en: The father coaxed the boy with gentle words until he calmed down and agreed to enter the classroom.
formal.zh: 父亲用温柔的话哄劝男孩，直到他平静下来，愿意走进教室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-qattus mar ħdejn Leo? Sara: Leo żegħel lill-qattus, u issa ma jridx jitlaq minn ħdejh!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the cat go over to Leo? Sara: Leo petted the cat, and now it doesn't want to leave his side!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：猫为什么跑到利奥旁边去了？萨拉：利奥抚摸了它，现在它都不愿意离开他身边了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 猫为什么跑到利奥旁边去了？
messages.en: Why did the cat go over to Leo?

messages.speaker: Sara (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Leo żegħel lill-qattus, u issa ma jridx jitlaq minn ħdejh!
messages.mt_standard: Leo żegħel lill-qattus, u issa ma jridx jitlaq minn ħdejh!
messages.zh: 利奥抚摸了它，现在它都不愿意离开他身边了！
messages.en: Leo petted the cat, and now it doesn't want to leave his side!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żegħel 放进四幅小画面：宠孩子、摸小猫、说好话奉承、温柔哄劝；按对象和目的选择中文意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes the amount or number of something greater.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过添加、补充或其他行为，使某物数量或总量增加的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li żżid in-numru jew il-kwantità ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who increases the quantity of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物的数量或总量增加的人。

collocations.en: a person who increases the quantity
a person who increases the supplies

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kelma żegħied tirreferi għall-persuna li żiedet il-kwantità ta' ross fil-borma.
formal.en: In this example, the word żegħied refers to the person who increased the amount of rice in the pot.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，żegħied 指的是增加锅里米量的那个人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Żegħied huwa xi ħadd li jżid il-kwantità ta' xi ħaġa? Mark: Iva, bħal min iżid aktar ross fil-borma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is a żegħied someone who increases the quantity of something? Mark: Yes, like someone who adds more rice to the pot.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：żegħied 是指使某种东西数量增加的人吗？马克：对，比如往锅里再加些米的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (马耳他语学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Żegħied huwa xi ħadd li jżid il-kwantità ta' xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Żegħied huwa xi ħadd li jżid il-kwantità ta' xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: żegħied 是指使某种东西数量增加的人吗？
messages.en: Is a żegħied someone who increases the quantity of something?

messages.speaker: Mark (马耳他语教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bħal min iżid aktar ross fil-borma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bħal min iżid aktar ross fil-borma.
messages.zh: 对，比如往锅里再加些米的人。
messages.en: Yes, like someone who adds more rice to the pot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只手不断往锅里加米，再把镜头转向加米的人；żegħied 记的是“使数量增加的人”，不是增加本身。

gloss_zh: 促使增生的；使数量增加的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing something to proliferate or to become greater in number or quantity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能促使某物增生、繁衍，或使其数量、总量增加的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża t-tkattir ta' xi ħaġa jew iżid in-numru jew il-kwantità tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使增生或繁衍的；导致数量不断增多的。
使数量或总量增加的；具有增量作用的。

collocations.en: an effect that causes proliferation or increase
collocations.zh: 促使增生或增加的作用

collocations.en: a factor that causes proliferation or increase
collocations.zh: 促使增生或增加的因素

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-aġġettiv żegħiedi jiddeskrivi fattur li jwassal għal żieda fin-numru ta' pjanti.
formal.en: In this example, the adjective żegħiedi describes a factor that leads to an increase in the number of plants.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，形容词 żegħiedi 描述一种会使植物数量增加的因素。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser effett żegħiedi? Pawlu: Effett li jġiegħel xi ħaġa titkattar jew tiżdied fil-kwantità.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does effett żegħiedi mean? Pawlu: An effect that makes something proliferate or increase in quantity.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：effett żegħiedi 是什么意思？保罗：指一种使某物增生或使其数量增加的作用。

messages.speaker: Nina (马耳他语学生)
messages.zh: effett żegħiedi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does effett żegħiedi mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (马耳他语教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Effett li jġiegħel xi ħaġa titkattar jew tiżdied fil-kwantità.
messages.mt_standard: Effett li jġiegħel xi ħaġa titkattar jew tiżdied fil-kwantità.
messages.zh: 指一种使某物增生或使其数量增加的作用。
messages.en: An effect that makes something proliferate or increase in quantity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出一个因素指向“数量变多”的箭头，把 żegħiedi 写在因素旁；它描述“能促使增加的”性质，属于形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who caresses someone or something, or who flatters another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱抚他人或动物的人；也指说好听的话奉承别人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmelles lil xi ħadd jew lil xi annimal, jew li tfaħħar lil ħaddieħor biex tingħoġob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抚、轻柔抚摸他人或动物的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tmelles lil xi ħadd jew lil xi annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说好听的话讨好别人的人；奉承者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tfaħħar lil ħaddieħor biex tingħoġob.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-impjegat jidher bħala żegħiel li jfaħħar lill-kap biex jikseb favuri.
formal.en: In the story, the employee appears as a flatterer who praises the boss to obtain favors.
formal.zh: 故事中的雇员是个奉承者，靠称赞上司来谋求好处。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem ifaħħar lill-kap? Toni: Għax hu żegħiel; irid li l-kap jagħtih xogħol aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Pawlu always praise the boss? Toni: Because he's a flatterer; he wants the boss to give him a better job.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么保罗总是称赞上司？托尼：因为他爱奉承人，想让上司给他更好的工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 为什么保罗总是称赞上司？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu always praise the boss?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu żegħiel; irid li l-kap jagħtih xogħol aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu żegħiel; irid li l-kap jagħtih xogħol aħjar.
messages.zh: 因为他爱奉承人，想让上司给他更好的工作。
messages.en: Because he's a flatterer; he wants the boss to give him a better job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景并记：手上轻轻爱抚，嘴上说话奉承；这个名词指做这些事的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing affection through a gentle, caressing touch or manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容触碰或举止轻柔，带有爱抚、抚慰意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi għożża b'mess jew b'ġest ta' tmellis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抚的；带有轻柔抚摸或亲昵抚慰意味的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħlewwa ta' tmellisa.

formal.mt: Il-missier serraħ lit-tifel b'mess żegħieli fuq rasu.
formal.en: The father reassured the boy with a caressing touch on his head.
formal.zh: 父亲轻柔地抚摸男孩的头，让他安心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif irnexxielek tikkalma l-kelb? Mark: B'mess żegħieli fuq rasu; wara ftit waqaf jitriegħed.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you manage to calm the dog? Mark: With a caressing touch on his head; after a while he stopped trembling.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你是怎么让狗平静下来的？马克：轻柔地摸摸它的头，过了一会儿它就不发抖了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是怎么让狗平静下来的？
messages.en: How did you manage to calm the dog?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: B'mess żegħieli fuq rasu; wara ftit waqaf jitriegħed.
messages.mt_standard: B'mess żegħieli fuq rasu; wara ftit waqaf jitriegħed.
messages.zh: 轻柔地摸摸它的头，过了一会儿它就不发抖了。
messages.en: With a caressing touch on his head; after a while he stopped trembling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只手轻轻抚摸小狗的头：这个形容词描述动作中的温柔爱意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave in a showy way in order to attract attention or impress other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以招摇、夸耀的方式行事，借此吸引注意或让别人对自己留下深刻印象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod li jiġbed l-attenzjoni u juri kemm hu importanti jew kemm għandu affarijiet sbieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现出炫耀、招摇或刻意卖弄的行为。

collocations.en: showed off in front of the guests

formal.mt: Waqt ir-riċeviment, Mark żegżeg quddiem il-mistednin u tkellem il-ħin kollu dwar il-ġid tiegħu.
formal.en: During the reception, Mark behaved ostentatiously in front of the guests and talked constantly about his wealth.
formal.zh: 在招待会上，马克在宾客面前大肆炫耀，不停地谈论自己的财富。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt kif żegżeg Mark bil-ħwejjeġ il-ġodda? Nina: Iva, ried lil kulħadd iħares lejh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see how Mark showed off his new clothes? Nina: Yes, he wanted everyone to look at him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看见马克怎么炫耀他的新衣服了吗？妮娜：看见了，他想让所有人都看他。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif żegżeg Mark bil-ħwejjeġ il-ġodda?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif żegżeg Mark bil-ħwejjeġ il-ġodda?
messages.zh: 你看见马克怎么炫耀他的新衣服了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how Mark showed off his new clothes?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ried lil kulħadd iħares lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ried lil kulħadd iħares lejh.
messages.zh: 看见了，他想让所有人都看他。
messages.en: Yes, he wanted everyone to look at him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人穿着新衣服故意走到人群中央，把 żegżeg 记作“做出炫耀的举动”，注意它是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who plays a musical instrument badly or without sufficient skill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 演奏乐器时技术不足、表现蹩脚的人，称呼带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddoqq strument mużikali ħażin jew mingħajr ħila biżżejjed.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who plays an instrument incompetently
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乐器演奏技术很差的人；蹩脚的乐手。

formal.mt: Fir-reċensjoni, il-kritiku sejjaħ lill-vjolinista żegżieg minħabba l-ħafna noti żbaljati.
formal.en: In the review, the critic called the violinist an incompetent player because of the many wrong notes.
formal.zh: 在评论中，乐评人因为那位小提琴手拉错了许多音，称他为蹩脚的演奏者。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien żegżieg bil-kitarra; kull darba niżbalja! Sara: Għadek qed titgħallem. Ejja nippruvaw aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm a terrible guitar player; I make mistakes every time! Sara: You're still learning. Let's try more slowly.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我的吉他弹得真蹩脚，每次都出错！萨拉：你还在学呢。我们放慢一点试试。

messages.speaker: Mark (吉他学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien żegżieg bil-kitarra; kull darba niżbalja!
messages.mt_standard: Jien żegżieg bil-kitarra; kull darba niżbalja!
messages.zh: 我的吉他弹得真蹩脚，每次都出错！
messages.en: I'm a terrible guitar player; I make mistakes every time!

messages.speaker: Sara (吉他教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek qed titgħallem. Ejja nippruvaw aktar bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Għadek qed titgħallem. Ejja nippruvaw aktar bil-mod.
messages.zh: 你还在学呢。我们放慢一点试试。
messages.en: You're still learning. Let's try more slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象台上有人拿着乐器却不断弹错音，用 żegżieg 给这个“演奏蹩脚的人”贴上记忆标签；它指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showy behaviour intended to attract attention or impress others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为吸引注意或使别人赞叹而表现出的炫耀、招摇作态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba li tiġbed l-attenzjoni billi persuna turi żżejjed dak li għandha jew kemm hi importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浮夸、招摇或刻意炫耀的行为。

collocations.en: showing off in front of people

formal.mt: L-organizzaturi talbu li ċ-ċerimonja ssir b'sempliċità u mingħajr żegżig bla bżonn.
formal.en: The organizers asked for the ceremony to be held simply and without unnecessary ostentation.
formal.zh: 组织者要求仪式从简，避免没有必要的炫耀排场。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan iż-żegżig kollu għal ikla żgħira? Pawlu: Għandek raġun; mejda sempliċi tkun biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why all this showing off for a small dinner? Pawlu: You're right; a simple table setting will be enough.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：一顿小聚餐，为什么要这样摆排场？保罗：你说得对，餐桌布置简单一点就够了。

messages.speaker: Nina (聚餐主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan iż-żegżig kollu għal ikla żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan iż-żegżig kollu għal ikla żgħira?
messages.zh: 一顿小聚餐，为什么要这样摆排场？
messages.en: Why all this showing off for a small dinner?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (聚餐主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; mejda sempliċi tkun biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; mejda sempliċi tkun biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 你说得对，餐桌布置简单一点就够了。
messages.en: You're right; a simple table setting will be enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żegżig 想成宴会上过分铺张的炫耀场面；与动词 żegżeg 对照记忆，这里说的是“炫耀这种行为”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unpleasant smell produced by something rotting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 东西腐烂时散发出的难闻气味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riħa ħażina li toħroġ minn xi ħaġa li tkun qed titħassar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐烂产生的臭味；腐臭。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riħa ta' taħsir.

collocations.en: a smell of rot from the rubbish

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, instabet żehma qawwija ġejja mill-frott imħassar fil-maħżen.
formal.en: During the inspection, a strong smell of rot was found to be coming from spoiled fruit in the storeroom.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，储藏室里的腐烂水果散发出浓烈的腐臭味。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi din iż-żehma fil-kċina? Ben: Hemm xi patata mħassra fil-borża; se noħroġha issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this smell of rot in the kitchen? Ben: There are some rotten potatoes in the bag; I'll take them out now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：厨房里这股腐臭味是怎么回事？本：袋子里有些烂土豆，我现在就拿出去。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 厨房里这股腐臭味是怎么回事？
messages.en: What's this smell of rot in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi patata mħassra fil-borża; se noħroġha issa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi patata mħassra fil-borża; se noħroġha issa.
messages.zh: 袋子里有些烂土豆，我现在就拿出去。
messages.en: There are some rotten potatoes in the bag; I'll take them out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想打开一袋烂土豆时扑鼻而来的气味，把这个名词与腐烂的臭味绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A neigh: a cry made by a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马发出的一声嘶鸣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajta ta' żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一声马嘶；马的嘶鸣声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajta li jagħmel żiemel.

formal.mt: Qabel ma nfetaħ il-bieb tal-istalla, instemgħet żehra qawwija minn ġewwa.
formal.en: Before the stable door was opened, a loud neigh was heard from inside.
formal.zh: 马厩的门打开之前，里面传来响亮的一声马嘶。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajt dik iż-żehra? Karl: Iva, ġejja mill-istalla; iż-żiemel qiegħed hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear that neigh? Karl: Yes, it's coming from the stable; the horse is there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听到那声马嘶了吗？卡尔：听到了，是从马厩传来的，马就在那里。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 你听到那声马嘶了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that neigh?

messages.speaker: Karl (马场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġejja mill-istalla; iż-żiemel qiegħed hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġejja mill-istalla; iż-żiemel qiegħed hemm.
messages.zh: 听到了，是从马厩传来的，马就在那里。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the stable; the horse is there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放马厩里传来的一声嘶鸣：记住它指马叫的声音，而不是马本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of increasing an amount or adding something extra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量增多的过程，或在原有基础上额外添加的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih ammont jikber jew li bih tiżdied xi ħaġa oħra ma' dak li diġà hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；数量、程度等变大的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih ammont jew livell jikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 额外添加；在已有数量之外再加入一些。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żieda ta' xi ħaġa oħra ma' dak li diġà hemm.

collocations.en: the addition of extra water to the mixture

formal.mt: Iż-żejdien ta' ilma mat-taħlita għandu jsir bil-mod sabiex tinkiseb il-konsistenza mixtieqa.
formal.en: The addition of extra water to the mixture should be done slowly to achieve the desired consistency.
formal.zh: 应缓慢地向混合物中额外加水，以达到所需的稠度。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed inħallsu aktar din il-ġimgħa? Ivan: Minħabba ż-żejdien fil-prezzijiet tal-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are we paying more this week? Ivan: Because of the increase in vegetable prices.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：为什么我们这周花的钱更多了？伊万：因为蔬菜涨价了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed inħallsu aktar din il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed inħallsu aktar din il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 为什么我们这周花的钱更多了？
messages.en: Why are we paying more this week?

messages.speaker: Ivan (室友)
messages.zh: 因为蔬菜涨价了。
messages.en: Because of the increase in vegetable prices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象量杯里的水位逐渐上升，再添一勺水：两个画面分别提示增加和额外添加。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add oil to something, or to cook food in oil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 往某物中加入油，或使用油来烹调食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżid iż-żejt ma' xi ħaġa, jew isajjar l-ikel fiż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加入油；往某物中添加油。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iżid iż-żejt ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用油烹调；把食物放在油中煎炒等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isajjar l-ikel fiż-żejt.

collocations.en: added oil to the frying pan

formal.mt: Il-kok żejjet it-taġen qabel ma żied il-basal imqatta'.
formal.en: The cook added oil to the frying pan before adding the chopped onion.
formal.zh: 厨师先往平底锅里加油，再加入切好的洋葱。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Żejjet it-taġen diġà? Paul: Iva, żidt ftit żejt; issa nistgħu nżidu l-basal.
colloquial.en: Lina: Have you already added oil to the frying pan? Paul: Yes, I added a little oil; now we can add the onion.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你已经往平底锅里加油了吗？保罗：加了，我放了一点油，现在可以放洋葱了。

messages.speaker: Lina (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 你已经往平底锅里加油了吗？
messages.en: Have you already added oil to the frying pan?

messages.speaker: Paul (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żidt ftit żejt; issa nistgħu nżidu l-basal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żidt ftit żejt; issa nistgħu nżidu l-basal.
messages.zh: 加了，我放了一点油，现在可以放洋葱了。
messages.en: Yes, I added a little oil; now we can add the onion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把做饭动作分成先往锅里加油、再用油烹调两步，用同一个厨房画面记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a bird to make a short, high-pitched cheeping sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鸟发出短促、尖细的啾啾声或叽叽声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss qasir u rqiq, bħal dak ta' fellus jew għasfur żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啾啾叫；叽叽叫，用于鸟类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss qasir u rqiq, kif jagħmel għasfur.

formal.mt: L-għasfur żgħir żejjeż fil-bejta meta resqet ommu bl-ikel.
formal.en: The young bird cheeped in the nest when its mother approached with food.
formal.zh: 鸟妈妈带着食物靠近时，幼鸟在巢里啾啾叫了起来。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Leo: Iva, il-fellus żejjeż; forsi għandu l-ġuħ.
colloquial.en: Emma: Did you hear that sound? Leo: Yes, the chick cheeped; perhaps it's hungry.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：你听到那个声音了吗？利奥：听到了，小鸡叽叽叫了一声，可能饿了。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Leo (养鸡的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fellus żejjeż; forsi għandu l-ġuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fellus żejjeż; forsi għandu l-ġuħ.
messages.zh: 听到了，小鸡叽叽叫了一声，可能饿了。
messages.en: Yes, the chick cheeped; perhaps it's hungry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小鸡张着小嘴叽叽叫，把词义连到鸟类短促尖细的叫声上。

gloss_zh: 增加某物的人；使数量增多者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who increases an amount or makes something greater.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的数量、程度或数值增加的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li żżid ammont jew tagħmel xi ħaġa akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加某物的人；使数量、程度或数值变大的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li żżid xi ħaġa jew tkabbar l-ammont tagħha.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-bejjiegħ huwa deskritt bħala żejjied tal-prezzijiet li kull xahar jitlob aktar għall-istess oġġetti.
formal.en: In the story, the seller is described as someone who raises prices, asking more each month for the same goods.
formal.zh: 故事把这位商人描写成一个不断提价的人，每个月都对同样的商品收取更高的价格。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-bejjiegħ veru żejjied tal-prezzijiet! Sam: Iva, l-istess borża llum tiswa ewro aktar.
colloquial.en: Rita: This seller really is someone who keeps raising prices! Sam: Yes, the same bag costs one euro more today.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个商人可真是个总在提价的人！萨姆：是啊，同样一袋东西今天贵了一欧元。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个商人可真是个总在提价的人！
messages.en: This seller really is someone who keeps raising prices!

messages.speaker: Sam (一起购物的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-istess borża llum tiswa ewro aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-istess borża llum tiswa ewro aktar.
messages.zh: 是啊，同样一袋东西今天贵了一欧元。
messages.en: Yes, the same bag costs one euro more today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把价签上的数字往上改：这个名词记的是增加数值的人。

gloss_zh: 趋于增加的；容易过量的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to increase, or tending to go beyond a suitable amount or degree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈现增加趋势的，或容易超过适当数量、程度的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jiżdied jew jaqbeż il-kwantità jew il-limitu xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 趋于增加的；有增长倾向的。
容易过量或过度的；有超出适当限度倾向的。

collocations.zh: 容易导致过量进食的食欲

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi andament żejjiedi fil-konsum tal-ilma matul ix-xhur tas-sajf.
formal.en: The report describes an increasing trend in water consumption during the summer months.
formal.zh: 报告描述了夏季几个月用水量呈增长趋势的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-aptit żejjiedi qed iġegħelni niekol wisq. Pawlu: Ħu porzjon iżgħar u ara jekk ikunx biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: This excessive appetite is making me eat too much. Pawlu: Take a smaller portion and see whether it is enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种过旺的食欲让我吃得太多了。保罗：先取少一点，看看够不够。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-aptit żejjiedi qed iġegħelni niekol wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-aptit żejjiedi qed iġegħelni niekol wisq.
messages.zh: 这种过旺的食欲让我吃得太多了。
messages.en: This excessive appetite is making me eat too much.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu porzjon iżgħar u ara jekk ikunx biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu porzjon iżgħar u ara jekk ikunx biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 先取少一点，看看够不够。
messages.en: Take a smaller portion and see whether it is enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象数量箭头不断上升：上升表示趋增，越过限度便表示过量，用同一幅图记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose trade is selling oil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以售卖油为业的人；卖油的商贩或商人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tbigħ iż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖油的人；油商。

collocations.en: an oil seller at the market
to buy from the oil seller

formal.mt: Iż-żejjiet fis-suq ibigħ żejt taż-żebbuġa fi fliexken ta' daqsijiet differenti.
formal.en: The oil seller at the market sells olive oil in bottles of different sizes.
formal.zh: 市场里的油商售卖装在不同大小瓶子里的橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn xtrajt dan iż-żejt? Mark: Mingħand iż-żejjiet fis-suq. Lara: Għada mmur nixtri flixkun ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you buy this oil? Mark: From the oil seller at the market. Lara: I'll go and buy a bottle tomorrow too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这油你在哪儿买的？马克：向市场里的卖油人买的。拉拉：明天我也去买一瓶。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这油你在哪儿买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy this oil?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 向市场里的卖油人买的。
messages.en: From the oil seller at the market.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天我也去买一瓶。
messages.en: I'll go and buy a bottle tomorrow too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放在市场摊位旁来记：摊后站着卖油的人，词义指人，别只想到瓶里的油。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Oily in appearance or feel, or giving off oil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观或触感带油的，或会向外渗出油的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher jew jinħass biż-żejt, jew li minnu joħroġ iż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带油的；油腻的。
渗出油的；向外冒油的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu wiċċ żejjieti, u fuq il-karta ta' taħtu dehru qtar taż-żejt.
formal.en: The sample has an oily surface, and drops of oil appeared on the paper beneath it.
formal.zh: 样品表面带油，其下方的纸上出现了油滴。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan il-ġebel jidher żejjieti? Toni: Qed joħroġ iż-żejt minnu. Nina: Mela npoġġi karta taħtu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do these stones look oily? Toni: Oil is seeping out of them. Nina: Then I'll put some paper underneath.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些石块为什么看起来油油的？托尼：有油从里面渗出来。妮娜：那我在下面垫张纸。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 这些石块为什么看起来油油的？
messages.en: Why do these stones look oily?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 有油从里面渗出来。
messages.en: Oil is seeping out of them.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 那我在下面垫张纸。
messages.en: Then I'll put some paper underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两帧画面记忆：第一帧表面油亮，第二帧油滴渗出，分别对应带油与渗油两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An action or effort that is futile and brings no useful result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 付出了努力却没有实际成效的行动；徒劳之举。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħidma jew sforz li jsir għalxejn u ma jagħti ebda riżultat utli.

sense_translations.en_definition: something done in vain, a futile course of action
sense_translations.zh_definition: 白做的事情；无法取得成效的做法；徒劳之举。

collocations.en: an effort that was in vain
to end up being a futile effort

formal.mt: It-tentattiv li jissewwa l-apparat mingħajr il-partijiet meħtieġa kien żejt fil-bażwa.
formal.en: The attempt to repair the device without the necessary parts was futile.
formal.zh: 在缺少必要零件的情况下尝试修理设备，是徒劳之举。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Erġajt ippruvajt insewwi r-radju, imma kien kollu żejt fil-bażwa. Sara: Forsi l-ewwel irridu nsibu l-parti l-ġdida.
colloquial.en: Mark: I tried fixing the radio again, but it was all in vain. Sara: Maybe we need to find the new part first.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我又试着修收音机了，可全是白费力气。萨拉：也许我们得先找到新零件。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Erġajt ippruvajt insewwi r-radju, imma kien kollu żejt fil-bażwa.
messages.mt_standard: Erġajt ippruvajt insewwi r-radju, imma kien kollu żejt fil-bażwa.
messages.zh: 我又试着修收音机了，可全是白费力气。
messages.en: I tried fixing the radio again, but it was all in vain.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi l-ewwel irridu nsibu l-parti l-ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi l-ewwel irridu nsibu l-parti l-ġdida.
messages.zh: 也许我们得先找到新零件。
messages.en: Maybe we need to find the new part first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语当作白忙一场的标签：想象修了半天仍然不响的收音机，整块记忆其徒劳义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing oil or having an oily surface or feel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含油的，或表面、触感带油的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih iż-żejt jew li għandu wiċċ jew mess biż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含油的；带油的；油腻的。

formal.mt: Il-klijent talab li l-ikel ikun inqas żejti u li z-zalza titqiegħed f'kontenitur separat.
formal.en: The customer requested less oily food and asked for the sauce to be placed in a separate container.
formal.zh: 顾客要求食物少油一些，并将酱汁另装在一个容器里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-ikel żejti wisq għalija. Ben: Trid ftit insalata minfloku? Lara: Iva, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: This food is too oily for me. Ben: Would you like some salad instead? Lara: Yes, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这食物对我来说太油了。本：要换成一点沙拉吗？拉拉：好的，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这食物对我来说太油了。
messages.en: This food is too oily for me.

messages.speaker: Ben (服务员)
messages.zh: 要换成一点沙拉吗？
messages.en: Would you like some salad instead?

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐盘上的油光和头发上的油光，把两个日常画面连起来，记住它描述油腻的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who comes from Żejtun; in a separate sense, oily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人来自Żejtun；另一个独立义项表示带油或油腻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi persuna minn Żejtun; f'tifsira oħra, li fih jew fuqu ż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自Żejtun的；用于形容出身于该地的人。
带油的；油腻的。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Żejtuni tkellem dwar il-ħajja ta' kuljum f'Żejtun waqt laqgħa mal-qarrejja.
formal.en: The writer from Żejtun spoke about everyday life in Żejtun during a meeting with readers.
formal.zh: 这位来自Żejtun的作家在读者见面会上谈到了当地的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek Żejtuni? Pawlu: Iva, minn Żejtun. Maja: Mela forsi jaf lil kuġini li joqgħod hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your new friend from Żejtun? Pawlu: Yes, from Żejtun. Maja: Then perhaps he knows my cousin who lives there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的新朋友是Żejtun人吗？保罗：是的，来自Żejtun。玛雅：那他也许认识住在那里的我表哥。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的新朋友是Żejtun人吗？
messages.en: Is your new friend from Żejtun?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，来自Żejtun。
messages.en: Yes, from Żejtun.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela forsi jaf lil kuġini li joqgħod hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Mela forsi jaf lil kuġini li joqgħod hemm.
messages.zh: 那他也许认识住在那里的我表哥。
messages.en: Then perhaps he knows my cousin who lives there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张分开的记忆卡：人物卡写来自Żejtun，食物卡画油光；靠所修饰的对象判断义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The small, high-pitched cheeping sounds made by birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟发出的细小、尖细的啾啾叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss irqiq li jagħmlu l-għasafar meta jżaqżqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟的啾啾声；鸟发出的细小鸣叫声。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni jinstema' ż-żejż tal-għasafar flimkien mal-ħoss ħafif tar-riħ.
formal.en: The recording captures the cheeping of birds together with the soft sound of the wind.
formal.zh: 录音中可以听到鸟儿的啾啾声，以及轻轻的风声。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed tisma' ż-żejż tal-għasafar? Toni: Iva, ġej mis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa. Nina: Ejja nisimgħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you hear the birds cheeping? Toni: Yes, it's coming from the tree beside the window. Nina: Let's listen for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听到鸟儿的啾啾声了吗？托尼：听到了，是窗边那棵树上传来的。妮娜：我们听一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到鸟儿的啾啾声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the birds cheeping?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，是窗边那棵树上传来的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the tree beside the window.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们听一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's listen for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 闭眼想象窗边传来细小的啾啾声，把这个词贴在声音上，记住它是叫声这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For certain birds, to sing or chirp; in another sense, to use vulgar language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某些鸟鸣唱、啾叫；另一个义项指人说粗话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal ċerti għasafar meta jkantaw, u f'tifsira oħra għal min jitkellem bi kliem vulgari.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used of certain types of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱；啾叫，用于某些种类的鸟。
说粗话；使用粗俗语言。

collocations.en: he used vulgar language in anger

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-għasfur żekżek għal ftit minuti qabel tar lejn siġra oħra.
formal.en: During the observation, the bird sang for a few minutes before flying to another tree.
formal.zh: 观察期间，那只鸟鸣叫了几分钟，随后飞向另一棵树。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark żekżek hekk? Pawlu: Irrabja għax tilef iċ-ċwievet. Sara: Jista' jitlob l-għajnuna mingħajr kliem vulgari.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark use such vulgar language? Pawlu: He got angry because he lost his keys. Sara: He can ask for help without using vulgar language.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么那样说粗话？保罗：他丢了钥匙，生气了。萨拉：他可以好好求助，不用说粗话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么那样说粗话？
messages.en: Why did Mark use such vulgar language?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他丢了钥匙，生气了。
messages.en: He got angry because he lost his keys.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jitlob l-għajnuna mingħajr kliem vulgari.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jitlob l-għajnuna mingħajr kliem vulgari.
messages.zh: 他可以好好求助，不用说粗话。
messages.en: He can ask for help without using vulgar language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个发声场景来区分：树上的鸟在鸣唱，生气的人在说粗话；看主语和语境选择意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tends to speak or behave rudely toward others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常对别人说话不客气或举止无礼的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha t-tendenza titkellem jew iġġib ruħha b'nuqqas ta' rispett lejn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who tends to be rude
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于对人无礼的人；说话常常不客气的人。

collocations.en: someone who is rude to customers
to behave like a rude person

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lill-bejjiegħ bħala żekżiek li spiss iwieġeb lill-klijenti b'nuqqas ta' rispett.
formal.en: The report describes the salesman as a rude person who often answers customers disrespectfully.
formal.zh: 报告将这名销售员描述为一个说话无礼的人，他经常不尊重地回应顾客。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tmur f'dak il-ħanut? Toni: Il-bejjiegħ żekżiek; kull darba jkellimni ħażin.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why don't you want to go back to that shop? Toni: The salesman is a rude person; he speaks to me rudely every time.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你为什么不想再去那家店？Toni：那个销售员说话很无礼，每次都对我很不客气。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tmur f'dak il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tmur f'dak il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想再去那家店？
messages.en: Why don't you want to go back to that shop?

messages.speaker: Toni (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bejjiegħ żekżiek; kull darba jkellimni ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bejjiegħ żekżiek; kull darba jkellimni ħażin.
messages.zh: 那个销售员说话很无礼，每次都对我很不客气。
messages.en: The salesman is a rude person; he speaks to me rudely every time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词和“开口总是不客气的人”这一人物形象绑定，记住它指人，而不是单指无礼的语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rude in speech or behaviour, or easily made angry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容说话或行为无礼，也可形容容易动怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem jew iġib ruħu b'nuqqas ta' rispett, jew li jirrabja malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无礼的；说话或行为不尊重别人的。
易怒的；很容易发脾气的。

formal.mt: L-impjegat uża ton żekżieki meta wieġeb lill-klijent li talab spjegazzjoni.
formal.en: The employee used a rude tone when answering the customer who asked for an explanation.
formal.zh: 那位顾客要求解释时，员工用无礼的语气作了回答。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex hu daqshekk żekżieki llum? Rita: Jirrabja għal kull ħaġa żgħira; aħjar inkellmuh meta jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why is he so irascible today? Rita: He gets angry over every little thing; we'd better talk to him when he calms down.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：他今天怎么这么容易发火？Rita：一点小事他就生气，我们最好等他平静下来再和他说。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 他今天怎么这么容易发火？
messages.en: Why is he so irascible today?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jirrabja għal kull ħaġa żgħira; aħjar inkellmuh meta jikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Jirrabja għal kull ħaġa żgħira; aħjar inkellmuh meta jikkalma.
messages.zh: 一点小事他就生气，我们最好等他平静下来再和他说。
messages.en: He gets angry over every little thing; we'd better talk to him when he calms down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分别记义：对别人说话冲是“无礼”，一点小事就发火是“易怒”，不要把两个意思完全混同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making excuses to explain or avoid doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为解释某种情况或逃避某件事而找借口、作推托的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li wieħed iġib skużi biex jispjega xi ħaġa jew jevita li jagħmilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 找借口；作推托的行为。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer talab li jieqaf iż-żekżik u li kull membru tat-tim iwettaq ix-xogħol miftiehem.
formal.en: The manager asked for the excuse-making to stop and for every team member to carry out the agreed work.
formal.zh: 经理要求停止找借口，并要求每位团队成员完成约定的工作。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Għadek ma rranġajtx kamartek? Biżżejjed żekżik! Ben: Tajjeb, nibda issa u npoġġi l-ħwejjeġ f'posthom.
colloquial.en: Mum: You still haven't tidied your room? Enough excuses! Ben: All right, I'll start now and put the clothes away.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你还没整理房间？别再找借口了！Ben：好，我现在就开始，把衣服收好。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek ma rranġajtx kamartek? Biżżejjed żekżik!
messages.mt_standard: Għadek ma rranġajtx kamartek? Biżżejjed żekżik!
messages.zh: 你还没整理房间？别再找借口了！
messages.en: You still haven't tidied your room? Enough excuses!

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nibda issa u npoġġi l-ħwejjeġ f'posthom.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nibda issa u npoġġi l-ħwejjeġ f'posthom.
messages.zh: 好，我现在就开始，把衣服收好。
messages.en: All right, I'll start now and put the clothes away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象任务还没动手，理由却说了一串；把 żekżik 记成“找借口这件事”，注意它在这里是名词。

gloss_zh: 负责打结的人；犯错的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose task is to make knots; in a separate sense, a person who makes an error.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指负责打结的人；另一个独立义项指犯错的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tagħmel l-għoqiedi; f'tifsira oħra, persuna li tiżbalja.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. whose task is to make knots
sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责打结的人；以打结为任务的人。
犯错的人；出现差错的人。

collocations.en: a person tasked with tying knots in ropes
someone who makes errors in calculations

formal.mt: Iż-żelliem fit-tim għandu jagħmel l-għoqiedi kollha skont l-istruzzjonijiet u jiċċekkja kull waħda.
formal.en: The team's knot-tier must make all the knots according to the instructions and check each one.
formal.zh: 团队中负责打结的人必须按说明打好所有绳结，并逐个检查。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min ħawwad iċ-ċifri f'dan il-kont? David: Jien iż-żelliem din id-darba; ktibt tletin flok tlettax.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who mixed up the figures in this bill? David: I'm the one who made the error this time; I wrote thirty instead of thirteen.
colloquial.zh: Anna：是谁把这张账单上的数字弄错了？David：这次是我犯了错，我把十三写成了三十。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 是谁把这张账单上的数字弄错了？
messages.en: Who mixed up the figures in this bill?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien iż-żelliem din id-darba; ktibt tletin flok tlettax.
messages.mt_standard: Jien iż-żelliem din id-darba; ktibt tletin flok tlettax.
messages.zh: 这次是我犯了错，我把十三写成了三十。
messages.en: I'm the one who made the error this time; I wrote thirty instead of thirteen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开制作两张人物卡：一张是负责打绳结的人，一张是算错数字的人；这是两个义项，不必编造共同来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a knot or knots tied in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某物打了一个或多个结。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għoqda jew għoqiedi marbutin fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打了结的；带有绳结的。

formal.mt: Il-ħabel żelliemi għandu jinħall qabel ma jitkejjel it-tul kollu tiegħu.
formal.en: The knotted rope should be untied before its full length is measured.
formal.zh: 在测量绳子的总长度之前，应先解开绳上的结。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma nistax niġbed il-ħajt minn ġot-toqba? Sara: Il-ħajt żelliemi; ħoll l-għoqda l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why can't I pull the thread through the hole? Sara: The thread is knotted; undo the knot first.
colloquial.zh: Nina：为什么我没法把线从孔里拉过去？Sara：线打结了，先把结解开。

messages.speaker: Nina (手工学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax niġbed il-ħajt minn ġot-toqba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax niġbed il-ħajt minn ġot-toqba?
messages.zh: 为什么我没法把线从孔里拉过去？
messages.en: Why can't I pull the thread through the hole?

messages.speaker: Sara (手工老师)
messages.zh: 线打结了，先把结解开。
messages.en: The thread is knotted; undo the knot first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根线被绳结卡住，拉不过小孔；把 żelliemi 贴在线的状态上，记成形容词“打了结的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that causes a person to slip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会使人滑倒的东西或致滑因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li ġġiegħel lil persuna tiżloq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人滑倒的东西；致滑之物。

collocations.en: Slipping hazard! Watch out for the water!
Slipping hazard! Hold on to the handrail!

formal.mt: L-avviż ħdejn it-taraġ jgħid: 'Żellieq! Oqogħdu attenti għaż-żejt imxerred fuq l-art.'
formal.en: The notice beside the stairs reads: 'Slipping hazard! Watch out for the oil spilled on the floor.'
formal.zh: 楼梯旁的告示写着：“有致滑物！当心洒在地上的油。”

colloquial.mt: Luca: Żellieq! Attent, hemm l-ilma mal-art! Marta: Grazzi talli għedtli; nimxi bil-mod u nżomm mal-poġġaman.
colloquial.en: Luca: Slipping hazard! Careful, there's water on the floor! Marta: Thanks for telling me; I'll walk slowly and hold on to the handrail.
colloquial.zh: Luca：有致滑物！小心，地上有水！Marta：谢谢你提醒我，我会慢慢走，扶着扶手。

messages.speaker: Luca (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 有致滑物！小心，地上有水！
messages.en: Slipping hazard! Careful, there's water on the floor!

messages.speaker: Marta (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli għedtli; nimxi bil-mod u nżomm mal-poġġaman.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli għedtli; nimxi bil-mod u nżomm mal-poġġaman.
messages.zh: 谢谢你提醒我，我会慢慢走，扶着扶手。
messages.en: Thanks for telling me; I'll walk slowly and hold on to the handrail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在脚下那摊使人打滑的油或水，用“造成滑倒的东西”记义，并借提醒同伴的场景辅助回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surface on which a person can easily slip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人在上面行走或踩踏时容易滑倒的表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ li fuqu persuna tista' tiżloq faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易使人滑倒的表面；湿滑的地面。

collocations.en: a slippery surface near the door
a slippery patch on the tiles
collocations.zh: 瓷砖上的一处湿滑表面

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, baqgħet żellieqa ħdejn il-bieb, u għalhekk tqiegħed sinjal ta' twissija.
formal.en: After cleaning, a slippery patch remained near the door, so a warning sign was put up.
formal.zh: 清洁后，门旁仍有一处湿滑地面，因此放置了警示牌。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Attent, hemm żellieqa ħdejn il-bieb tal-kċina. Ġorġ: Rajtha; se nixxotta l-art qabel ma jgħaddi xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Elena: Careful, there's a slippery patch by the kitchen door. Ġorġ: I've seen it; I'll dry the floor before anyone walks past.
colloquial.zh: Elena：小心，厨房门旁有一处湿滑的地方。Ġorġ：我看见了，我会在有人经过之前把地面擦干。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Attent, hemm żellieqa ħdejn il-bieb tal-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Attent, hemm żellieqa ħdejn il-bieb tal-kċina.
messages.zh: 小心，厨房门旁有一处湿滑的地方。
messages.en: Careful, there's a slippery patch by the kitchen door.

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha; se nixxotta l-art qabel ma jgħaddi xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha; se nixxotta l-art qabel ma jgħaddi xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 我看见了，我会在有人经过之前把地面擦干。
messages.en: I've seen it; I'll dry the floor before anyone walks past.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房门口有一块需要擦干的滑地面，把 żellieqa 记作这“一处湿滑表面”，用具体地点帮助记住名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who daubs or smears a substance over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种物质涂抹或抹在表面上的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tidlek jew iċċappas xi sustanza fuq wiċċ ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹或抹涂某种物质的人。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-attività, iż-żellieġ huwa l-persuna li ċċappas iż-żebgħa fuq il-kartun.
formal.en: In the description of the activity, the dauber is the person who smears paint onto the cardboard.
formal.zh: 在这项活动的说明中，涂抹者是指把颜料抹到硬纸板上的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu ż-żellieġ li ħalla l-kolla ma' kullimkien? Mark: Jien! Inaddaf il-mejda malli nwaħħal din l-aħħar biċċa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who's the person who smeared glue everywhere? Mark: Me! I'll clean the table as soon as I stick this last piece on.
colloquial.zh: Lara：是谁把胶水抹得到处都是？Mark：是我！我把最后这一块粘好就擦桌子。

messages.speaker: Lara (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu ż-żellieġ li ħalla l-kolla ma' kullimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu ż-żellieġ li ħalla l-kolla ma' kullimkien?
messages.zh: 是谁把胶水抹得到处都是？
messages.en: Who's the person who smeared glue everywhere?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Inaddaf il-mejda malli nwaħħal din l-aħħar biċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Inaddaf il-mejda malli nwaħħal din l-aħħar biċċa.
messages.zh: 是我！我把最后这一块粘好就擦桌子。
messages.en: Me! I'll clean the table as soon as I stick this last piece on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一个手拿刷子或胶水、正在往表面涂抹的人；用“做涂抹动作的人”记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make the loud rumbling sound of thunder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出雷鸣声；指天空中打雷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-ħoss qawwi tar-ragħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打雷；发出雷鸣声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-ħoss tar-ragħad.

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl żelżel bil-qawwa, u x-xita baqgħet nieżla sas-sebħ.
formal.en: It thundered loudly during the night, and the rain continued until dawn.
formal.zh: 夜间雷声大作，雨一直下到黎明。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Smajt dak il-ħoss ilbieraħ filgħaxija? Pawlu: Iva, żelżel bil-qawwa u qomt minn fuq is-sodda.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you hear that noise yesterday evening? Pawlu: Yes, it thundered loudly and I got out of bed.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你听见昨晚那个声音了吗？保罗：听见了，雷声很大，我都起床了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见昨晚那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that noise yesterday evening?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żelżel bil-qawwa u qomt minn fuq is-sodda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żelżel bil-qawwa u qomt minn fuq is-sodda.
messages.zh: 听见了，雷声很大，我都起床了。
messages.en: Yes, it thundered loudly and I got out of bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żelżel 中重复的字母组合想成接连滚来的两阵雷声，用雷鸣画面记住“打雷”；这只是学习联想。

gloss_zh: 引起肿胀的东西；惯于奉承的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that causes swelling; also, a person who tends to flatter others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某处肿胀的东西；也指惯于奉承别人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li ġġiegħel parti tintefaħ; ukoll, persuna li għandha t-tendenza li tfaħħar iżżejjed lil ħaddieħor biex tingħoġob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起肿胀的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li ġġiegħel parti tintefaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于奉承、说讨好话的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha t-tendenza li tfaħħar iżżejjed lil ħaddieħor biex tingħoġob.

collocations.en: something that causes swelling of the skin

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, is-sustanza ġiet deskritta bħala żembieħ tal-ġilda.
formal.en: In the report, the substance was described as something that causes swelling of the skin.
formal.zh: 报告将这种物质描述为会引起皮肤肿胀的东西。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex jgħid li kull idea tal-kap hija perfetta? Mark: Għax hu żembieħ; dejjem jgħid dak li l-kap irid jisma'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does he say every idea the boss has is perfect? Mark: Because he is a flatterer; he always says what the boss wants to hear.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他为什么说老板的每个想法都完美？马克：因为他是个爱奉承的人，总说老板爱听的话。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex jgħid li kull idea tal-kap hija perfetta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex jgħid li kull idea tal-kap hija perfetta?
messages.zh: 他为什么说老板的每个想法都完美？
messages.en: Why does he say every idea the boss has is perfect?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu żembieħ; dejjem jgħid dak li l-kap irid jisma'.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu żembieħ; dejjem jgħid dak li l-kap irid jisma'.
messages.zh: 因为他是个爱奉承的人，总说老板爱听的话。
messages.en: Because he is a flatterer; he always says what the boss wants to hear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 żembieħ 画两张名词卡：一张是引起肿胀的东西，一张是满口讨好话的人。两义分开记，不把联想当成词源。

gloss_zh: 容易肿胀的；有膨胀倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to swell or increase in volume.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有肿胀或体积膨大倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jintefaħ jew jiżdied fil-volum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易肿胀的；有膨胀倾向的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jintefaħ.

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, għandu jiġi vverifikat jekk il-materjal huwiex żembieħi meta jiġi f'kuntatt mal-ilma.
formal.en: Before use, it should be checked whether the material tends to swell when it comes into contact with water.
formal.zh: 使用前，应检查这种材料接触水后是否容易膨胀。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-materjal huwa żembieħi? Toni: Iva, jintefaħ meta jixxarrab, allura ħallilu ftit spazju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this material tend to swell? Toni: Yes, it swells when it gets wet, so leave it a little space.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这种材料容易膨胀吗？托尼：是的，弄湿后会膨胀，所以给它留一点空间。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
