messages.zh: 这种材料容易膨胀吗？
messages.en: Does this material tend to swell?

messages.speaker: Toni (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jintefaħ meta jixxarrab, allura ħallilu ftit spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jintefaħ meta jixxarrab, allura ħallilu ftit spazju.
messages.zh: 是的，弄湿后会膨胀，所以给它留一点空间。
messages.en: Yes, it swells when it gets wet, so leave it a little space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żembieħi 写在“容易鼓起来”的材料标签上，提醒自己它描述膨胀倾向，是形容词，并不表示已经肿胀。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Swelling or an increase in volume; also, excessive filling out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肿胀或体积膨大的现象；也指过度填充。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tintefaħ jew tiżdied fil-volum; ukoll, mili eċċessiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肿胀；膨胀。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tintefaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过度填充；填得过满。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mili eċċessiv ta' xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport irreġistra żembiħ fis-sieq tal-lemin wara l-waqgħa.
formal.en: The report recorded swelling in the right foot after the fall.
formal.zh: 报告记录了跌倒后右脚出现的肿胀。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma tingħalaqx il-borża? Ben: Minħabba ż-żembiħ tagħha; imlejnieha wisq u rridu nneħħu xi ħwejjeġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why won't the bag close? Ben: Because it has been overfilled; we put too much in it and need to take some clothes out.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：袋子为什么合不上？本：因为装得太满了；我们塞了太多东西，得拿出几件衣服。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅行同伴)
messages.zh: 袋子为什么合不上？
messages.en: Why won't the bag close?

messages.speaker: Ben (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba ż-żembiħ tagħha; imlejnieha wisq u rridu nneħħu xi ħwejjeġ.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba ż-żembiħ tagħha; imlejnieha wisq u rridu nneħħu xi ħwejjeġ.
messages.zh: 因为装得太满了；我们塞了太多东西，得拿出几件衣服。
messages.en: Because it has been overfilled; we put too much in it and need to take some clothes out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“肿起来的脚”和“塞得鼓鼓的袋子”两个画面记 żembiħ：分别对应肿胀与过度填充，都是名词意义。

gloss_zh: 使人疏忽；使人怠于尽责

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to become careless or neglectful in carrying out their duties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人在履行职责时变得疏忽或懈怠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd isir traskurat fit-twettiq ta' dmirijietu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to be remiss
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人疏忽职责；使某人怠于尽责。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jittraskura dmirijietu.

collocations.en: caused the worker to become remiss
caused the student to become neglectful

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' superviżjoni żemmel lill-impjegat fit-twettiq ta' dmirijietu.
formal.en: The lack of supervision caused the employee to become remiss in carrying out his duties.
formal.zh: 缺乏监督使这名员工在履行职责时变得懈怠。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Pawlu m'għadux jiċċekkja x-xogħol tiegħu? David: In-nuqqas ta' superviżjoni żemmel lil Pawlu; issa jittraskura dmirijietu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why doesn't Pawlu check his work anymore? David: The lack of supervision made Pawlu neglectful; now he neglects his duties.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗为什么不再检查自己的工作了？戴维：缺乏监督使保罗变得懈怠；现在他疏于履行职责。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu m'għadux jiċċekkja x-xogħol tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu m'għadux jiċċekkja x-xogħol tiegħu?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不再检查自己的工作了？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pawlu check his work anymore?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nuqqas ta' superviżjoni żemmel lil Pawlu; issa jittraskura dmirijietu.
messages.mt_standard: In-nuqqas ta' superviżjoni żemmel lil Pawlu; issa jittraskura dmirijietu.
messages.zh: 缺乏监督使保罗变得懈怠；现在他疏于履行职责。
messages.en: The lack of supervision made Pawlu neglectful; now he neglects his duties.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 żemmel 时画一条因果箭头：“缺少督促→某人疏于尽责”。重点记住“使别人变得疏忽”这一动作关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who rides a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑马的人；骑手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirkeb żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑马的人；骑手。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tirkeb żiemel.

collocations.en: a rider on a white horse

formal.mt: Iż-żemmiel mexxa ż-żiemel bil-mod tul il-mogħdija quddiem il-pubbliku.
formal.en: The rider guided the horse slowly along the path in front of the spectators.
formal.zh: 骑手在观众面前引导着马沿小径缓缓前行。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min hu dak iż-żemmiel fuq iż-żiemel abjad? Luqa: Hu ħija; ilu jirkeb iż-żwiemel minn meta kien żgħir.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who is that rider on the white horse? Luqa: He's my brother; he has been riding horses since he was little.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：骑着白马的那个骑手是谁？卢卡：是我哥哥；他从小就骑马。

messages.speaker: Marta (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak iż-żemmiel fuq iż-żiemel abjad?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak iż-żemmiel fuq iż-żiemel abjad?
messages.zh: 骑着白马的那个骑手是谁？
messages.en: Who is that rider on the white horse?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ħija; ilu jirkeb iż-żwiemel minn meta kien żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ħija; ilu jirkeb iż-żwiemel minn meta kien żgħir.
messages.zh: 是我哥哥；他从小就骑马。
messages.en: He's my brother; he has been riding horses since he was little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żemmiel 标在马背上的人身旁，明确记成“骑马的人”。复习时指向骑手，帮助自己锁定这个词的人物名词意义。

gloss_zh: 马的；与马有关的；像马的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to horses, or resembling a horse in appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于马或与马有关的；也可形容外观像马的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maż-żwiemel, jew li jixbah żiemel fid-dehra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马的；与马有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maż-żwiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像马的；外形似马的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jixbah żiemel.

formal.mt: Il-katalogu jinkludi tagħmir żemmieli għall-kura u t-taħriġ taż-żwiemel.
formal.en: The catalogue includes equine equipment for the care and training of horses.
formal.zh: 目录收录了用于照料和训练马匹的用具。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan l-annimal fit-tpinġija għandu profil żemmieli, hux? Samwel: Iva, rasu tixbah dik ta' żiemel, speċjalment minn naħa.
colloquial.en: Elena: This animal in the drawing has a horse-like profile, doesn't it? Samwel: Yes, its head resembles a horse's, especially from the side.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：画里这只动物的侧面轮廓很像马，对吧？萨姆韦尔：是的，它的头像马头，尤其从侧面看。

messages.speaker: Elena (美术学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-annimal fit-tpinġija għandu profil żemmieli, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-annimal fit-tpinġija għandu profil żemmieli, hux?
messages.zh: 画里这只动物的侧面轮廓很像马，对吧？
messages.en: This animal in the drawing has a horse-like profile, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rasu tixbah dik ta' żiemel, speċjalment minn naħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rasu tixbah dik ta' żiemel, speċjalment minn naħa.
messages.zh: 是的，它的头像马头，尤其从侧面看。
messages.en: Yes, its head resembles a horse's, especially from the side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żemmieli 配两幅图：马匹用具表示“与马有关的”，马形轮廓表示“像马的”。把两个形容词义并排记忆。

gloss_zh: 雨水猛烈击打；采摘水果并放进篮子

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pelt with rain; also, to pick fruit and place it in a basket.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指雨水猛烈落下、击打；也指采摘水果并把它放进篮子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xita bil-qawwa; ukoll, jiġbor il-frott u jqiegħdu f'qoffa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雨水猛烈击打；下起猛烈的雨。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel xita bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to pick fruit and put it in a basket
sense_translations.zh_definition: 采摘水果并把水果放进篮子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiġbor il-frott u jqiegħdu f'qoffa.

collocations.en: picked the apples and put them in a basket

formal.mt: Wara li żenbel fuq l-għelieqi matul il-lejl, il-ħaddiema stennew li l-art tinxef qabel daħlu fil-ġnien.
formal.en: After rain pelted the fields during the night, the workers waited for the ground to dry before entering the orchard.
formal.zh: 夜间大雨猛烈打在田野上，工人们等地面干了才进入果园。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min żenbel it-tuffieħ dalgħodu? Ġorġ: Missieri; ġabru mis-siġar u poġġieh fil-qoffa ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who picked the apples and put them in a basket this morning? Ġorġ: My father; he picked them from the trees and put them in the basket by the door.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：今天早上是谁把苹果摘下来装进篮子的？乔治：我父亲；他从树上摘了苹果，放进门边的篮子里。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 今天早上是谁把苹果摘下来装进篮子的？
messages.en: Who picked the apples and put them in a basket this morning?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri; ġabru mis-siġar u poġġieh fil-qoffa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri; ġabru mis-siġar u poġġieh fil-qoffa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 我父亲；他从树上摘了苹果，放进门边的篮子里。
messages.en: My father; he picked them from the trees and put them in the basket by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 żenbel 做两格画：第一格是暴雨击打田野，第二格是摘果后放入篮子。第二义要把“采摘”和“装篮”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large basket used for holding or carrying things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛放或搬运物品的大篮子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoffa kbira li tintuża biex iżżomm jew iġġorr l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大篮子。

collocations.en: a large basket full of fruit

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem poġġa ż-żenbil mimli frott ħdejn il-mejda.
formal.en: The worker placed the large basket full of fruit beside the table.
formal.zh: 工人把装满水果的大篮子放在桌子旁边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi dan iż-żenbil? Mark: Ħdejn il-bieb, jekk jogħġbok; wara nimlewh bil-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put this large basket? Mark: Beside the door, please; we'll fill it with vegetables later.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个大篮子放在哪里？马克：请放在门旁边；我们待会儿用它装蔬菜。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个大篮子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this large basket?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb, jekk jogħġbok; wara nimlewh bil-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb, jekk jogħġbok; wara nimlewh bil-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 请放在门旁边；我们待会儿用它装蔬菜。
messages.en: Beside the door, please; we'll fill it with vegetables later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żenbil 和一个装满水果的大篮子一起记，重点记住它强调篮子较大。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play an instrument without producing a recognizable or tuneful melody.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 弹奏乐器时不成曲调，发出杂乱而缺乏旋律的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idoqq strument mingħajr melodija ċara jew pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不成调地演奏或弹奏。

collocations.en: played tunelessly for a few minutes
collocations.zh: 不成调地弹奏了几分钟

formal.mt: Qabel il-lezzjoni, l-istudent żenger fuq il-kitarra mingħajr ma daqq melodija ċara.
formal.en: Before the lesson, the student played the guitar tunelessly without producing a clear melody.
formal.zh: 上课前，学生不成调地拨弄吉他，没有弹出清晰的旋律。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark daqq xi kanzunetta? Pawlu: Le, żenger ftit fuq il-kitarra u mbagħad waqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark play a song? Pawlu: No, he played tunelessly on the guitar for a bit and then stopped.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克弹了什么歌吗？保罗：没有，他只是乱弹了一会儿吉他，然后就停了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克弹了什么歌吗？
messages.en: Did Mark play a song?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, żenger ftit fuq il-kitarra u mbagħad waqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Le, żenger ftit fuq il-kitarra u mbagħad waqaf.
messages.zh: 没有，他只是乱弹了一会儿吉他，然后就停了。
messages.en: No, he played tunelessly on the guitar for a bit and then stopped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人拨着吉他却怎么也听不出曲调，用这个动作记 żenger，强调弹得不成调。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who rocks a child in a cradle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摇动摇篮来安抚或哄睡孩子的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbandal tarbija fil-benniena.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who rocks a child in a cradle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇动摇篮哄孩子的人。

collocations.en: the person who rocks the baby in its cradle
to work as someone who rocks children in cradles
collocations.zh: 做摇摇篮哄孩子的工作

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żengiel bandal il-benniena bil-mod sakemm it-tarbija raqdet.
formal.en: In the story, the person tending the cradle rocked it gently until the baby fell asleep.
formal.zh: 故事里，摇摇篮的人轻轻摇动摇篮，直到婴儿睡着。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'żengiel' f'din l-istorja? Mark: Hu min ibandal lit-tarbija fil-benniena biex jikkalmaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'żengiel' mean in this story? Mark: It's someone who rocks the baby in its cradle to soothe it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的 żengiel 是什么意思？马克：就是摇动摇篮来安抚婴儿的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 żengiel 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żengiel' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu min ibandal lit-tarbija fil-benniena biex jikkalmaha.
messages.mt_standard: Hu min ibandal lit-tarbija fil-benniena biex jikkalmaha.
messages.zh: 就是摇动摇篮来安抚婴儿的人。
messages.en: It's someone who rocks the baby in its cradle to soothe it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 żengiel 时把画面焦点放在摇篮旁边的人身上：它指摇摇篮的人，而非摇动这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of rocking or swinging back and forth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来回摇动或摆动的动作，例如摇篮的摇动或秋千的摆动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' xi ħaġa li titbandal 'il quddiem u lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇动；例如摇篮来回晃动的动作。
摆动；例如秋千来回荡动的动作。

formal.mt: Iż-żengil bil-mod tal-benniena għen lit-tarbija torqod.
formal.en: The gentle rocking of the cradle helped the baby fall asleep.
formal.zh: 摇篮轻缓的摇动帮助婴儿入睡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex raqdet daqshekk malajr? Mark: Naħseb li ż-żengil tal-benniena kkalmaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did she fall asleep so quickly? Mark: I think the rocking of the cradle soothed her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：她怎么这么快就睡着了？马克：我想是摇篮的摇动让她安静下来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 她怎么这么快就睡着了？
messages.en: Why did she fall asleep so quickly?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 我想是摇篮的摇动让她安静下来了。
messages.en: I think the rocking of the cradle soothed her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żengil 配上来回箭头记忆：摇篮在摇、秋千在荡，两种场景都突出往返的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tuneless strumming on a string instrument, without a clear melody.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在弦乐器上不成调地拨弦所产生的声音或这种拨奏行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqq bla melodija ċara fuq strument tal-kordi.

sense_translations.en_definition: tuneless strumming on a string instrument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在弦乐器上不成调地拨弦；这种杂乱的拨奏声。

collocations.zh: 响亮而不成调的拨弦声

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, instema' żengir fuq il-kitarra minflok melodija ċara.
formal.en: During the rehearsal, tuneless guitar strumming was heard instead of a clear melody.
formal.zh: 排练时，传来的是不成调的吉他拨弦声，而非清晰的旋律。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss mill-kamra ta' Mark? Pawlu: Dak żengir fuq il-kitarra; għadu qed jitgħallem idoqq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that noise coming from Mark's room? Pawlu: That's tuneless guitar strumming; he's still learning to play.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克房间里传来的是什么声音？保罗：那是不成调的吉他拨弦声；他还在学着弹。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss mill-kamra ta' Mark?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss mill-kamra ta' Mark?
messages.zh: 马克房间里传来的是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise coming from Mark's room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak żengir fuq il-kitarra; għadu qed jitgħallem idoqq.
messages.mt_standard: Dak żengir fuq il-kitarra; għadu qed jitgħallem idoqq.
messages.zh: 那是不成调的吉他拨弦声；他还在学着弹。
messages.en: That's tuneless guitar strumming; he's still learning to play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用词性配对记忆：żenger 是不成调地弹这个动作，żengir 是弦乐器的这种乱弹或声音。

gloss_zh: 诱使他人发生婚外性行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: To induce someone to engage in sexual intercourse outside marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引诱或促使某人发生婚姻以外的性行为，带有道德评价色彩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħajjar lil xi ħadd ikollu x'jaqsam sesswalment barra ż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诱使某人行淫，即发生婚姻以外的性行为。

collocations.en: induced someone to engage in sex outside marriage
collocations.zh: 诱使某人发生婚外性行为

collocations.en: induced his friend to engage in sex outside marriage
collocations.zh: 诱使他的朋友发生婚外性行为

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-raġel żenna lil sieħbu biex ikollu relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
formal.en: In the novel, the man induced his friend to enter a sexual relationship outside marriage.
formal.zh: 小说中，这名男子诱使他的朋友发生婚姻以外的性关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'żenna' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ifisser li ħajjar lil xi ħadd jagħmel sess barra ż-żwieġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'żenna' mean in this sentence? Mark: It means that he induced someone to have sex outside marriage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 żenna 是什么意思？马克：意思是他诱使某人发生婚姻以外的性行为。

messages.speaker: Maja (成年学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 żenna 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żenna' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ħajjar lil xi ħadd jagħmel sess barra ż-żwieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ħajjar lil xi ħadd jagħmel sess barra ż-żwieġ.
messages.zh: 意思是他诱使某人发生婚姻以外的性行为。
messages.en: It means that he induced someone to have sex outside marriage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żenna 记成一个带宾语的动作：有人诱使另一个人发生婚外性行为，重点在诱使他人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person characterized by excessive sexual desire or lustful behavior.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出强烈色欲或好色行为的人，通常带贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li turi xewqa sesswali eċċessiva jew imġiba żienja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好色之徒；色欲强烈并表现出好色行为的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-personaġġ huwa deskritt bħala żennej minħabba l-imġiba sesswali eċċessiva tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the character is described as a lecherous person because of his excessive sexual behavior.
formal.zh: 小说因这个人物过度的好色行为而将他描写成一个好色之徒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-awtur isejjaħlu żennej? Mark: Għax il-personaġġ dejjem jitkellem b'mod mimli xewqa sesswali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the author call him a lecherous person? Mark: Because the character always speaks in a lustful way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：作者为什么称他为好色之徒？马克：因为这个人物说话总是充满色欲。

messages.speaker: Maja (成年学生)
messages.zh: 作者为什么称他为好色之徒？
messages.en: Why does the author call him a lecherous person?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-personaġġ dejjem jitkellem b'mod mimli xewqa sesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-personaġġ dejjem jitkellem b'mod mimli xewqa sesswali.
messages.zh: 因为这个人物说话总是充满色欲。
messages.en: Because the character always speaks in a lustful way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给文学人物贴上好色之徒的标签来记 żennej：它指人，并且通常包含负面评价。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come out forcefully in a jet or in spurts, as a liquid does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像液体一样，以急流或一股股的形式有力地喷出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ bil-qawwa f'ġett jew fi spurti, bħalma jagħmel likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷出；喷涌；以急流或一股股的形式涌出。

formal.mt: Meta nkiser il-pajp, l-ilma żennen mit-toqba u xarrab l-art.
formal.en: When the pipe broke, water spurted from the hole and soaked the floor.
formal.zh: 水管破裂时，水从破口喷出，浸湿了地面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-art kollha mxarrba? Mark: L-ilma żennen minn pajp miksur; issa għalaqt il-vit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the whole floor wet? Mark: Water spurted from a broken pipe; I've turned off the tap now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么整个地面都湿了？马克：水从破水管里喷出来了；我现在已经关上水龙头了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 怎么整个地面都湿了？
messages.en: Why is the whole floor wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma żennen minn pajp miksur; issa għalaqt il-vit.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma żennen minn pajp miksur; issa għalaqt il-vit.
messages.zh: 水从破水管里喷出来了；我现在已经关上水龙头了。
messages.en: Water spurted from a broken pipe; I've turned off the tap now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水管破口突然喷出一股水，用这幅有冲力的画面记 żennen，突出喷涌的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formation of a projecting part resembling a spout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形成一个向外突出的、形似壶嘴的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-formazzjoni ta' parti li toħroġ 'il barra u tixbah żennuna.

sense_translations.en_definition: producing a formation like a spout
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形成或产生类似壶嘴的突起。

collocations.en: the process of forming a spout-like projection
collocations.zh: 形成壶嘴状突起的过程

collocations.en: the formation of a spout-like projection at the edge
collocations.zh: 边缘处壶嘴状突起的形成

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju bit-tafal, iż-żennien huwa l-formazzjoni ta' parti li toħroġ mit-tarf u tixbah żennuna.
formal.en: In this clay exercise, żennien is the formation of a part that projects from the edge and resembles a spout.
formal.zh: 在这个黏土练习中，żennien 指在边缘形成一个向外伸出的壶嘴状部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser iż-żennien f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Ifisser li tifforma parti qisha żennuna fit-tarf tat-tafal.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does żennien mean in this exercise? Pawlu: It means forming a spout-like part at the edge of the clay.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个练习里的 żennien 是什么意思？保罗：就是在黏土边缘形成一个像壶嘴的部分。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个练习里的 żennien 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does żennien mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (美术老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tifforma parti qisha żennuna fit-tarf tat-tafal.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tifforma parti qisha żennuna fit-tarf tat-tafal.
messages.zh: 就是在黏土边缘形成一个像壶嘴的部分。
messages.en: It means forming a spout-like part at the edge of the clay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用手把黏土边缘捏出一个小壶嘴，用这个动作记住“形成壶嘴状突起”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a shape that resembles a spout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像壶嘴或流嘴的，常用来描述向外伸出的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għamla li tixbah żennuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呈壶嘴状的；形状像流嘴的。

formal.mt: Il-mudell għandu tarf żennieni li joħroġ 'il barra mill-bqija tal-oġġett.
formal.en: The model has a spout-shaped edge that projects beyond the rest of the object.
formal.zh: 这个模型有一个呈壶嘴状的边缘，向外突出于物体的其余部分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif niddeskrivi dan it-tarf? Mark: Tista' tgħid li huwa żennieni, għax jixbah żennuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: How can I describe this edge? Mark: You can say it is spout-shaped, because it resembles a spout.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这个边缘该怎么描述？马克：可以说它呈壶嘴状，因为它看起来像一个壶嘴。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个边缘该怎么描述？
messages.en: How can I describe this edge?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħid li huwa żennieni, għax jixbah żennuna.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħid li huwa żennieni, għax jixbah żennuna.
messages.zh: 可以说它呈壶嘴状，因为它看起来像一个壶嘴。
messages.en: You can say it is spout-shaped, because it resembles a spout.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把物体轮廓想成一个伸出的小壶嘴，看到 żennieni 就联想“形状像壶嘴的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A projecting outlet on a jug or kettle for pouring liquid, or a nozzle through which liquid or air is directed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水罐或水壶上供液体倒出的壶嘴，也指引导液体或气体喷出的喷嘴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' buqar jew kitla minn fejn jitferra' l-likwidu, jew parti li tidderieġi l-ħruġ ta' likwidu jew arja.

sense_translations.en_definition: spout (usually of a jug or kettle)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 壶嘴；通常指水罐或水壶上供液体倒出的突出部分。
喷嘴；引导液体或气体喷出的出口部件。

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-bexxiexa, iċċekkja li ż-żennuna tkun nadifa u li l-ilma joħroġ minnha sew.
formal.en: Before using the sprayer, check that the nozzle is clean and that water flows through it properly.
formal.zh: 使用喷雾器之前，请检查喷嘴是否干净，以及水能否正常从中喷出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-ilma qed jinżel mal-ġenb tal-buqar? Toni: Iż-żennuna għandha xaqq żgħir. Nużaw buqar ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the water running down the side of the jug? Toni: The spout has a small crack. Let's use another jug.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水怎么沿着水罐侧面流下来了？托尼：壶嘴有一道小裂缝。我们换个水罐吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-ilma qed jinżel mal-ġenb tal-buqar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-ilma qed jinżel mal-ġenb tal-buqar?
messages.zh: 水怎么沿着水罐侧面流下来了？
messages.en: Why is the water running down the side of the jug?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żennuna għandha xaqq żgħir. Nużaw buqar ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żennuna għandha xaqq żgħir. Nużaw buqar ieħor.
messages.zh: 壶嘴有一道小裂缝。我们换个水罐吧。
messages.en: The spout has a small crack. Let's use another jug.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水从一个突出的“小嘴”出来：倒水时是壶嘴，喷洒时是喷嘴，两义一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flow slowly in a small, thin stream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体以少量、细流的方式缓缓流动或流下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċirkola jew jinżel bil-mod fi fluss irqiq u żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涓涓地流；以少量细流缓缓流下。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, l-ilma żenżen minn xaqq fil-ħajt u nġabar f'għadira żgħira.
formal.en: After the rain, water trickled through a crack in the wall and collected in a small puddle.
formal.zh: 雨后，水从墙上的一道裂缝中细细流出，积成了一小摊。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif imtliet din l-iskutella? Ben: L-ilma żenżen mill-vit il-lejl kollu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did this bowl fill up? Ben: Water trickled from the tap all night.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个碗怎么装满水了？本：水从水龙头细细流了一整夜。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这个碗怎么装满水了？
messages.en: How did this bowl fill up?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 水从水龙头细细流了一整夜。
messages.en: Water trickled from the tap all night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复的音节当作细水不断流动的节拍，想象一条细细水线，记住这是流动的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The slow movement of liquid in a small, thin stream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体以少量细流缓缓流动的过程或现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment bil-mod ta' likwidu fi fluss irqiq u żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涓涓流动；液体细细流下的过程或现象。

formal.mt: Iż-żenżin kontinwu tal-ilma mill-pajp ħalla l-art ta' taħtu mxarrba.
formal.en: The continuous trickling of water from the pipe left the ground beneath it wet.
formal.zh: 水不断从管道中细细流出，使下方的地面一直湿着。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tisma' ż-żenżin tal-ilma? Karl: Iva, ġej mill-vit tal-kċina. Se nagħlqu sew.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you hear the water trickling? Karl: Yes, it's coming from the kitchen tap. I'll close it properly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听见细细的流水声了吗？卡尔：听见了，是厨房的水龙头。我去把它关紧。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见细细的流水声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the water trickling?

messages.speaker: Karl (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-vit tal-kċina. Se nagħlqu sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-vit tal-kċina. Se nagħlqu sew.
messages.zh: 听见了，是厨房的水龙头。我去把它关紧。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the kitchen tap. I'll close it properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把细水流动的整个画面命名为 żenżin；与表示动作的 żenżen 配对，区分名词和动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing or chirp, said of certain kinds of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某些种类的鸟发出鸣唱声或啁啾声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikanta jew jagħmel għajat ħafif, meta jingħad għal ċerti tipi ta' għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used of certain types of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱；啁啾，指某些种类的鸟发出叫声。

formal.mt: Kmieni filgħodu, għasfur żepżep fuq fergħa ħdejn it-tieqa miftuħa.
formal.en: Early in the morning, a bird chirped on a branch beside the open window.
formal.zh: 清晨，一只鸟在敞开的窗户旁的树枝上啁啾鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'kien dak il-ħoss ħdejn it-tieqa? Sam: Għasfur żepżep fuq il-fergħa. Għadu hemm!
colloquial.en: Lina: What was that sound by the window? Sam: A bird chirped on the branch. It's still there!
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：窗边刚才是什么声音？萨姆：一只鸟在树枝上叫了。它还在那里呢！

messages.speaker: Lina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 窗边刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound by the window?

messages.speaker: Sam (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Għasfur żepżep fuq il-fergħa. Għadu hemm!
messages.mt_standard: Għasfur żepżep fuq il-fergħa. Għadu hemm!
messages.zh: 一只鸟在树枝上叫了。它还在那里呢！
messages.en: A bird chirped on the branch. It's still there!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żep-żep 的重复节奏想成鸟儿两声短鸣，用声音联想记动作；这是记忆法，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The singing or chirping sounds made by birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟儿发出的鸣唱声或啁啾声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss tal-kant jew tal-għajat ħafif tal-għasafar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟鸣；鸟儿鸣唱或啁啾的声音。

formal.mt: Iż-żepżip tal-għasafar kien jinstema' fil-ġnien matul is-sigħat bikrin ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: Birdsong could be heard in the garden during the early morning hours.
formal.zh: 清晨时分，花园里可以听见鸟儿的鸣唱声。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'qed tisma' hekk bil-kwiet? Leo: Iż-żepżip tal-għasafar. Ejja oqgħod ħdejja u isma'.
colloquial.en: Marta: What are you listening to so quietly? Leo: The birds singing. Come sit beside me and listen.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你这么安静地在听什么？利奥：鸟儿的鸣唱声。来坐我旁边听听。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你这么安静地在听什么？
messages.en: What are you listening to so quietly?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żepżip tal-għasafar. Ejja oqgħod ħdejja u isma'.
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żepżip tal-għasafar. Ejja oqgħod ħdejja u isma'.
messages.zh: 鸟儿的鸣唱声。来坐我旁边听听。
messages.en: The birds singing. Come sit beside me and listen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清晨闭眼听鸟叫，把听到的声音叫作 żepżip，并与表示“鸟儿鸣唱”的 żepżep 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show a brief sparkle or gleam, said of a person's eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人的眼睛或目光短暂地闪出亮光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri leħħa qasira ta' dawl, meta jingħad għall-għajnejn ta' persuna.

sense_translations.en_definition: to glint (used of a person's eyes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪光；闪亮，指人的眼睛或目光闪出光芒。

collocations.zh: 她的眼睛因喜悦而闪亮

formal.mt: Meta semgħet li kienet rebħet il-premju, għajnejha żerqu bil-ferħ.
formal.en: When she heard that she had won the prize, her eyes sparkled with joy.
formal.zh: 当她听说自己获奖时，眼睛里闪出了喜悦的光芒。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt għajnejn Lara meta fetħet ir-rigal? Mark: Iva, għajnejha żerqu bil-ferħ. Kien eżatt dak li xtaqet.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you see Lara's eyes when she opened the present? Mark: Yes, her eyes sparkled with joy. It was exactly what she wanted.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你看到劳拉打开礼物时的眼神了吗？马克：看到了，她的眼睛高兴得闪闪发亮。那正是她想要的东西。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt għajnejn Lara meta fetħet ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt għajnejn Lara meta fetħet ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 你看到劳拉打开礼物时的眼神了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Lara's eyes when she opened the present?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għajnejha żerqu bil-ferħ. Kien eżatt dak li xtaqet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għajnejha żerqu bil-ferħ. Kien eżatt dak li xtaqet.
messages.zh: 看到了，她的眼睛高兴得闪闪发亮。那正是她想要的东西。
messages.en: Yes, her eyes sparkled with joy. It was exactly what she wanted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收到心爱礼物时眼睛忽然一亮，把 żeraq 和眼中的短暂亮光连起来记；这里专指人的眼睛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to seeds or to the activity of sowing them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与种子或播撒种子的活动有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maż-żrieragħ jew maż-żrigħ tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与种子或播种有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċess żergħi, mill-għażla taż-żrieragħ sat-tqegħid tagħhom fil-ħamrija.
formal.en: The report describes the sowing process, from selecting the seeds to placing them in the soil.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了播种过程，从挑选种子到将种子放入土壤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm f'din il-kaxxa? Pawlu: Materjal żergħi għall-ġnien: żrieragħ u trejs żgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's in this box? Pawlu: Material for sowing in the garden: seeds and small trays.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个箱子里有什么？保罗：花园播种用的材料，有种子和小育苗盘。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个箱子里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Materjal żergħi għall-ġnien: żrieragħ u trejs żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Materjal żergħi għall-ġnien: żrieragħ u trejs żgħar.
messages.zh: 花园播种用的材料，有种子和小育苗盘。
messages.en: Material for sowing in the garden: seeds and small trays.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把种子袋和播种步骤放在同一张学习卡上，用 żergħi 给两者贴上“与种子、播种有关”的标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 0, indicating that there are no units of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字零，即某物的数量为零，没有任何单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 0, li jindika li ma hemm ebda unità ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 零；数字0。

formal.mt: Fit-tmienja ta' filgħodu, it-temperatura kienet żero gradi Celsius.
formal.en: At eight in the morning, the temperature was zero degrees Celsius.
formal.zh: 早上八点，气温为零摄氏度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm għandna punti s'issa? Mark: Żero, imma għad għandna ċans nirbħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many points do we have so far? Mark: Zero, but we still have a chance to win.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们目前得了多少分？马克：零分，不过我们还有机会赢。

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.zh: 我们目前得了多少分？
messages.en: How many points do we have so far?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żero, imma għad għandna ċans nirbħu.
messages.mt_standard: Żero, imma għad għandna ċans nirbħu.
messages.zh: 零分，不过我们还有机会赢。
messages.en: Zero, but we still have a chance to win.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 żero 就在脑中画一个数字0，再配上“零分”和“零度”两个场景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The blue colour of the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天空所呈现的蓝色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kulur blu tas-sema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天空的蓝色。

collocations.en: the light blue of the sky

formal.mt: Fil-pittura, iż-żerq tas-sema jikkuntrasta mal-abjad tas-sħab.
formal.en: In the painting, the blue of the sky contrasts with the white of the clouds.
formal.zh: 画中，天空的蓝色与云朵的白色形成对比。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħares lejn iż-żerq tas-sema llum! David: Kemm hu sabiħ! Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at the blue of the sky today! David: It's so beautiful! Let's take a photo.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看今天这天空的蓝色！大卫：真美！我们拍张照片吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看今天这天空的蓝色！
messages.en: Look at the blue of the sky today!

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
messages.zh: 真美！我们拍张照片吧。
messages.en: It's so beautiful! Let's take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żerq 写在蓝天照片的蓝色区域里，记住它指“天空的蓝色”这一名词概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something a blue colour, for example by painting or dyeing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过涂画、染色等方式使某物呈蓝色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta kulur blu lil xi ħaġa, pereżempju biż-żebgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物染成或涂成蓝色。

formal.mt: L-artist żerraq l-isfond tal-pittura biex jagħti l-impressjoni ta' sema miftuħ.
formal.en: The artist coloured the background of the painting blue to give the impression of an open sky.
formal.zh: 画家把画作的背景涂成蓝色，以营造开阔天空的感觉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min żerraq l-isfond tat-tpinġija? Ben: Jien! Ridt li jidher bħas-sema.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who coloured the background of the drawing blue? Ben: I did! I wanted it to look like the sky.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把这幅画的背景涂蓝了？本：我！我想让它看起来像天空。

messages.speaker: Sara (美术老师)
messages.zh: 谁把这幅画的背景涂蓝了？
messages.en: Who coloured the background of the drawing blue?

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.zh: 我！我想让它看起来像天空。
messages.en: I did! I wanted it to look like the sky.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画笔把白色背景刷成蓝色：żerraq 记的是“使它变蓝”的动作，搭配具体物品练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing many seeds, or containing many seeds when used of fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生大量种子的；形容果实时，也指里面有很多籽的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jipproduċi ħafna żrieragħ, jew li jkun fih ħafna żrieragħ meta jingħad għall-frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生大量种子的；结籽多的。
多籽的；含有很多种子的。

formal.mt: Dan il-ħaxix hu żerriegħi: jipproduċi ħafna żrieragħ li jistgħu jinġabru għaż-żrigħ.
formal.en: This vegetation produces many seeds, which can be collected for sowing.
formal.zh: 这种草本植物结籽很多，可以收集这些种子用于播种。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-bettieħ żerriegħi ħafna! Pawlu: Iva, neħħi ż-żrieragħ b'kuċċarina qabel tiekol.
colloquial.en: Maja: This melon has so many seeds! Pawlu: Yes, remove the seeds with a spoon before eating.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个甜瓜的籽真多！保罗：是啊，吃之前用勺子把籽挖掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个甜瓜的籽真多！
messages.en: This melon has so many seeds!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, neħħi ż-żrieragħ b'kuċċarina qabel tiekol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, neħħi ż-żrieragħ b'kuċċarina qabel tiekol.
messages.zh: 是啊，吃之前用勺子把籽挖掉。
messages.en: Yes, remove the seeds with a spoon before eating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 一边想植物结出许多种子，一边想切开的甜瓜满是籽；用这两幅图记住 żerriegħi 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who seduces someone, drawing them into romantic or sexual involvement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以魅力或言行诱使他人投入恋爱或性关系的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħajjar lil xi ħadd jidħol magħha f'relazzjoni romantika jew sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勾引他人、使他人受到情爱诱惑的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru ewlieni hu żerriek li juża kliem ħelu biex jiġbed lin-nies lejh.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character is a seducer who uses sweet words to draw people to him.
formal.zh: 小说的主人公是个诱惑者，靠甜言蜜语吸引别人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'karattru jilgħab Mark fid-dramm? Nina: Żerriek li jħajjar lil mara tibda relazzjoni miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What character does Mark play in the play? Nina: A seducer who entices a woman into starting a relationship with him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克在剧里演什么角色？妮娜：一个诱惑者，勾引一名女子与他交往。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 马克在剧里演什么角色？
messages.en: What character does Mark play in the play?

messages.speaker: Nina (剧团成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żerriek li jħajjar lil mara tibda relazzjoni miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Żerriek li jħajjar lil mara tibda relazzjoni miegħu.
messages.zh: 一个诱惑者，勾引一名女子与他交往。
messages.en: A seducer who entices a woman into starting a relationship with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żerriek 放在戏剧人物卡上，写下“用魅力勾引别人的人”，借具体角色记住它是指人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Attractive in a way that tempts someone, including by romantic or sexual appeal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有吸引力、让人心动或受到诱惑的，也可指带有情爱或性吸引力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġbed u jħajjar lil xi ħadd, ukoll b'mod romantiku jew sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诱人的；让人很想接受、拥有或尝试的。
富有诱惑力的；具有情爱或性吸引力的。

formal.mt: Fil-film, l-attur juża leħen żerrieki biex jesprimi l-interess romantiku tal-karattru.
formal.en: In the film, the actor uses a seductive voice to express the character's romantic interest.
formal.zh: 影片中，演员用富有诱惑力的嗓音表达角色的爱慕之意。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-telefon għandu prezz żerrieki. Sara: Veru, imma għandek bżonn telefon ġdid?
colloquial.en: Mark: This phone has a tempting price. Sara: True, but do you need a new phone?
colloquial.zh: 马克：这部手机的价格真诱人。萨拉：确实，不过你需要新手机吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这部手机的价格真诱人。
messages.en: This phone has a tempting price.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, imma għandek bżonn telefon ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Veru, imma għandek bżonn telefon ġdid?
messages.zh: 确实，不过你需要新手机吗？
messages.en: True, but do you need a new phone?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“诱人的价格”和“撩人的嗓音”两张卡记 żerrieki：前者让人想买，后者体现情爱吸引力。

gloss_zh: 啼鸣；鸣唱（用于某些鸟类）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing or make a songlike call, used of certain kinds of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某些鸟类发出鸣唱般的叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanta jew għamel għana, meta jingħad għal ċerti tipi ta' għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used of certain types of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱，啼鸣（用于某些鸟类）。

collocations.en: sang at dawn, of a bird

formal.mt: Mas-sebħ, l-għasfur żerżer minn fuq fergħa qrib it-tieqa.
formal.en: At dawn, the bird sang from a branch near the window.
formal.zh: 黎明时，鸟儿在窗边的一根树枝上鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Smajt dak l-għasfur? Żerżer eżatt issa! Maja: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-fergħa ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Ben: Did you hear that bird? It sang just now! Maja: Yes, it's on the branch beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 本：你听到那只鸟了吗？它刚才叫得像在唱歌！玛雅：听到了，它就在窗旁的树枝上。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dak l-għasfur? Żerżer eżatt issa!
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dak l-għasfur? Żerżer eżatt issa!
messages.zh: 你听到那只鸟了吗？它刚才叫得像在唱歌！
messages.en: Did you hear that bird? It sang just now!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-fergħa ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-fergħa ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 听到了，它就在窗旁的树枝上。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the branch beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清晨窗外一只鸟在枝头鸣唱，把 żerżer 与这段鸟鸣联系起来，并记住它用于某些鸟类。

gloss_zh: 滑梯；滑道；滑的；使滑动的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slide or other structure that allows things to slide down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让人或物体沿着向下滑动的设施，例如滑梯或滑道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura li tippermetti lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa tiżżerżaq 'l isfel.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that enables things to slide down
sense_translations.zh_definition: 让人或物体向下滑动的东西，例如滑梯或滑道。
表面滑的；容易让人或物体滑动的。
使人或物体发生滑动的。

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola hemm żerżieq għat-tfal.
formal.en: There is a slide for children in the school garden.
formal.zh: 学校花园里有一座供儿童使用的滑梯。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn hu ż-żerżieq? Pawlu: Hemm, ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where is the slide? Pawlu: Over there, next to the tree.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：滑梯在哪里？保罗：在那边，树旁边。

messages.speaker: Lina (孩子)
messages.zh: 滑梯在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the slide?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 在那边，树旁边。
messages.en: Over there, next to the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żerżieq 写在滑梯图旁：作名词记滑梯、滑道；作形容词时联系表面滑或使东西滑动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing something that causes sliding or slopes downward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容会使人或物体滑动，或者具有向下坡度的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa tiżżerżaq, jew li għandu inklinazzjoni 'l isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或物体滑动的。
向下倾斜的；具有下坡坡度的。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ żerżieqi jwassal għall-bitħa ta' taħt.
formal.en: The downward-sloping passage leads to the lower courtyard.
formal.zh: 这条向下倾斜的通道通往下方的庭院。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kaxxa qed tiżżerżaq? Mark: Għax il-wiċċ żerżieqi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the box sliding? Mark: Because the surface makes it slide.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：箱子为什么在滑动？马克：因为这个表面会使它滑动。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 箱子为什么在滑动？
messages.en: Why is the box sliding?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为这个表面会使它滑动。
messages.en: Because the surface makes it slide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用斜面上箱子下滑的画面记 żerżieqi：斜面向下倾斜，也会使箱子滑动，对应两个形容词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An insect referred to as a cricket or a grasshopper, depending on the sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种昆虫的名称，可指蟋蟀，也可指蚱蜢；阅读时须结合语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' insett li, skont it-tifsira, jissejjaħ cricket jew grasshopper bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蟋蟀。
蚱蜢；蝗虫一类的昆虫。

collocations.en: a cricket or grasshopper in the grass

formal.mt: L-istudent osserva żerżier fil-ħaxix u kiteb nota dwaru.
formal.en: The student observed a grasshopper in the grass and wrote a note about it.
formal.zh: 学生观察了草丛中的一只蚱蜢，并写下了有关它的记录。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'hemm fil-kaxxa? Toni: Hemm żerżier żgħir.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is in the box? Toni: There is a small cricket.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：盒子里有什么？托尼：有一只小蟋蟀。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 盒子里有什么？
messages.en: What is in the box?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 有一只小蟋蟀。
messages.en: There is a small cricket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żerżier 放进昆虫图卡，配上蟋蟀和蚱蜢两幅图；特别看清结尾 ier，避免与鸟叫声 żerżir 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or movement of sliding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或物体滑动这一动作或运动过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-moviment ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li tiżżerżaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑动；滑行这一动作或过程。

formal.mt: Iż-żerżiq tal-kaxxa waqaf meta l-kaxxa laħqet it-tarf tal-mejda.
formal.en: The sliding of the box stopped when the box reached the edge of the table.
formal.zh: 箱子滑到桌边时停止了滑动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qed tosserva? David: Iż-żerżiq tal-kaxxa fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are you observing? David: The sliding of the box across the table.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你在观察什么？戴维：箱子在桌面上的滑动。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你在观察什么？
messages.en: What are you observing?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 箱子在桌面上的滑动。
messages.en: The sliding of the box across the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记 żerżieq 和 żerżiq：前者画滑梯，后者画运动箭头；用箭头提醒自己 żerżiq 指滑动过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cheeping sound made by birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟发出的啾啾叫声，指声音本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss li jagħmlu l-għasafar meta jżerżru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟的啾啾叫声；鸟鸣。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti semgħu żerżir mill-bejta.
formal.en: During the observation, the students heard cheeping from the nest.
formal.zh: 观察期间，学生们听到了从鸟巢传来的啾啾声。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss? Ben: Iva, hu ż-żerżir tal-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Ella: Can you hear that sound? Ben: Yes, it is the birds' cheeping.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：你听到那个声音了吗？本：听到了，是鸟的啾啾声。

messages.speaker: Ella (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，是鸟的啾啾声。
messages.en: Yes, it is the birds' cheeping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żerżir 配一幅鸟巢和声音波纹图，记它表示鸟叫声；再与表示昆虫的 żerżier 对照拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a children's game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种儿童游戏的名称；本词条所给信息未说明具体玩法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' logħba tat-tfal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种儿童游戏的名称。

collocations.zh: 我们玩 żerżuqija 这种游戏

formal.mt: Fil-programm tal-attivitajiet tat-tfal issemmiet il-logħba taż-żerżuqija.
formal.en: The game called żerżuqija was mentioned in the children's activity programme.
formal.zh: 儿童活动安排中提到了名为 żerżuqija 的游戏。

colloquial.mt: Mila: Kif jisimha din il-logħba? Leo: Din il-logħba jisimha żerżuqija.
colloquial.en: Mila: What is this game called? Leo: This game is called żerżuqija.
colloquial.zh: 米拉：这个游戏叫什么？利奥：这个游戏叫 żerżuqija。

messages.speaker: Mila (孩子)
messages.zh: 这个游戏叫什么？
messages.en: What is this game called?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个游戏叫 żerżuqija。
messages.en: This game is called żerżuqija.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żerżuqija 写在儿童游戏盒的名称标签上，先整体记为游戏名，不根据相似拼写猜测玩法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hedge sparrow; in a separate sense, a nail around which cotton is wound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指林岩鹨这种鸟；另一个独立词义是供棉线绕在上面的钉子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir; f'tifsira oħra, musmar li madwaru jitkebbeb il-qoton.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 林岩鹨，即英语所称的 hedge sparrow。

sense_translations.en_definition: a nail around which cotton is rolled
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供棉线绕在上面的钉子。

collocations.en: a hedge sparrow in the garden
cotton wound around a winding nail

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem dawwar il-qoton madwar żerżur.
formal.en: The worker wound the cotton around a winding nail.
formal.zh: 工人把棉线绕在绕棉钉上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema għasfur rajt fil-ġnien? Karl: Rajt żerżur ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Which bird did you see in the garden? Karl: I saw a hedge sparrow next to the tree.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你在花园里看到了什么鸟？卡尔：我在树旁看到了一只林岩鹨。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在花园里看到了什么鸟？
messages.en: Which bird did you see in the garden?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在树旁看到了一只林岩鹨。
messages.en: I saw a hedge sparrow next to the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żerżur 做双面词卡：一面画林岩鹨，一面画缠着棉线的钉子；借花园与绕棉场景区分两个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Variation in colour across a surface, forming patches, markings, or contrasting areas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同一表面上呈现不同颜色，形成色斑、纹理或相互对比的色块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Varjazzjoni fil-kulur fuq wiċċ wieħed, b'tikek, marki jew żoni ta' kuluri differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂色；同一表面上不同颜色交错形成的斑驳变化。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ż-żewq tal-weraq, fejn żoni ħodor jalternaw ma' żoni bojod.
formal.en: The report describes the variegation of the leaves, where green areas alternate with white areas.
formal.zh: 报告描述了叶片的杂色斑纹，其中绿色区域与白色区域交替出现。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara ż-żewq ta' dawn il-weraq! Toni: Iva, kull werqa għandha tikek ħodor u bojod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at the variegation of these leaves! Toni: Yes, each leaf has green and white patches.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看这些叶片上交错的颜色！托尼：是啊，每片叶子都有绿色和白色的斑块。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看这些叶片上交错的颜色！
messages.en: Look at the variegation of these leaves!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull werqa għandha tikek ħodor u bojod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull werqa għandha tikek ħodor u bojod.
messages.zh: 是啊，每片叶子都有绿色和白色的斑块。
messages.en: Yes, each leaf has green and white patches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一片绿白相间的叶子，把 żewq 记成同一表面上的杂色斑纹，重点是颜色交错。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of having many colours or a rich, colourful appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有多种颜色或呈现丰富、绚丽色彩的特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li għandha ħafna kuluri jew dehra rikka fil-kuluri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 色彩丰富的特质；绚丽多彩。

formal.mt: Iż-żewqa tal-kostumi tagħti lill-wirja dehra ferrieħa u tiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The colourfulness of the costumes gives the exhibition a cheerful appearance and attracts visitors' attention.
formal.zh: 服装的绚丽色彩使展览显得欢快，并吸引参观者的注意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Togħġobni ż-żewqa ta' dawn il-fjuri. Mark: Lili wkoll; l-aħmar, l-isfar u l-vjola jidhru sbieħ flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: I like the colourfulness of these flowers. Mark: Me too; the red, yellow and purple look lovely together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我喜欢这些花缤纷的色彩。马克：我也是，红色、黄色和紫色搭配起来真好看。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢这些花缤纷的色彩。
messages.en: I like the colourfulness of these flowers.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lili wkoll; l-aħmar, l-isfar u l-vjola jidhru sbieħ flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Lili wkoll; l-aħmar, l-isfar u l-vjola jidhru sbieħ flimkien.
messages.zh: 我也是，红色、黄色和紫色搭配起来真好看。
messages.en: Me too; the red, yellow and purple look lovely together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一束红黄紫交织的鲜花，用 żewqa 概括整束花的缤纷感，记住它表示色彩丰富这一特质。

gloss_zh: 用多种颜色美化事物的人；彩饰者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who decorates or embellishes something using a variety of colours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运用多种颜色装饰或美化物品、空间等的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li żżejjen jew issebbaħ xi ħaġa b'kuluri differenti.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who embellishes with varied colours
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用多种颜色进行装饰、美化的人；彩饰者。

collocations.en: a decorator who embellishes halls with varied colours
collocations.zh: 用多种颜色装饰大厅的人

collocations.en: a decorator who embellishes theatre sets with varied colours
collocations.zh: 为舞台布景进行彩色装饰的人

formal.mt: Iż-żewwieq uża l-aħmar, il-blu u d-deheb biex isebbaħ is-sett tal-palk.
formal.en: The decorator used red, blue and gold to embellish the stage set.
formal.zh: 彩饰者使用红色、蓝色和金色来美化舞台布景。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min għamel dawn id-disinji bil-kuluri fuq il-ħajt? Rita: Iż-żewwieq; għażel kuluri li jaqblu mal-kamra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who made these colourful designs on the wall? Rita: The decorator; he chose colours that suit the room.
colloquial.zh: 马克：墙上这些彩色图案是谁做的？丽塔：是彩饰师，他选了适合这个房间的颜色。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għamel dawn id-disinji bil-kuluri fuq il-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Min għamel dawn id-disinji bil-kuluri fuq il-ħajt?
messages.zh: 墙上这些彩色图案是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made these colourful designs on the wall?

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żewwieq; għażel kuluri li jaqblu mal-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żewwieq; għażel kuluri li jaqblu mal-kamra.
messages.zh: 是彩饰师，他选了适合这个房间的颜色。
messages.en: The decorator; he chose colours that suit the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拿着多色颜料盘装饰墙面的人，把 żewwieq 牢牢记成做彩色美化工作的人。

gloss_zh: 能起装饰作用的；颜色多变的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to decorate or embellish something, or showing variation in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有装饰、美化作用的；也可指呈现不同颜色或色彩变化的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jżejjen jew isebbaħ xi ħaġa, jew li juri varjazzjoni fil-kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有装饰能力的；能起美化作用的。
颜色多变的；呈现色彩差异或变化的。

collocations.zh: 呈现多种色彩变化的布料

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur għażel drapp żewwieqi b'żoni ta' kuluri differenti biex iżejjen is-sala.
formal.en: The designer chose fabric with areas of different colours to decorate the hall.
formal.zh: 设计师选择了带有不同色块的多彩布料来装饰大厅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-drapp żewwieqi jogħġbok għall-purtieri? Nina: Iva, il-kuluri differenti tiegħu jagħmlu l-kamra aktar ferrieħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like this fabric with varied colours for the curtains? Nina: Yes, its different colours make the room more cheerful.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢用这块多彩布料做窗帘吗？妮娜：喜欢，它丰富的颜色能让房间更有欢快的气氛。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢用这块多彩布料做窗帘吗？
messages.en: Do you like this fabric with varied colours for the curtains?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kuluri differenti tiegħu jagħmlu l-kamra aktar ferrieħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kuluri differenti tiegħu jagħmlu l-kamra aktar ferrieħa.
messages.zh: 喜欢，它丰富的颜色能让房间更有欢快的气氛。
messages.en: Yes, its different colours make the room more cheerful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一块多彩窗帘记 żewwieqi：既能美化房间，又呈现色彩变化；这是描述特征的形容词。

gloss_zh: 婚姻介绍人；为新人主持婚礼的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who brings people together with a view to marriage, or who conducts a couple's marriage ceremony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为促成婚姻而介绍双方认识的人；也可指为一对新人主持结婚仪式的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tlaqqa' nies bil-ħsieb li jiżżewġu, jew li tmexxi ċ-ċerimonja taż-żwieġ ta' koppja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婚姻介绍人；为促成婚姻而牵线搭桥的人。
为一对新人主持结婚仪式的人。

collocations.en: a matchmaker who introduces people to one another
collocations.zh: 介绍双方认识的婚姻介绍人

collocations.en: an officiant who conducts the marriage ceremony

formal.mt: Qabel iċ-ċerimonja, iż-żewwieġ iltaqa' mal-koppja biex jispjega kif kien se jmexxi ż-żwieġ.
formal.en: Before the ceremony, the marriage officiant met the couple to explain how he would conduct the wedding.
formal.zh: 仪式开始前，婚礼主持人与这对新人见面，说明他将如何主持婚礼。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min laqqagħhom lil dawk it-tnejn? Pawlu: Żewwieġ li jaf li t-tnejn iridu jiżżewġu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who introduced those two to each other? Pawlu: A matchmaker who knows that they both want to get married.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：是谁介绍他们俩认识的？保罗：一位知道他们双方都有结婚意愿的婚姻介绍人。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 是谁介绍他们俩认识的？
messages.en: Who introduced those two to each other?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewwieġ li jaf li t-tnejn iridu jiżżewġu.
messages.mt_standard: Żewwieġ li jaf li t-tnejn iridu jiżżewġu.
messages.zh: 一位知道他们双方都有结婚意愿的婚姻介绍人。
messages.en: A matchmaker who knows that they both want to get married.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żewwieġ 放进两个画面：婚前替双方牵线，婚礼上主持仪式；两义都指帮助婚姻成事的人。

gloss_zh: 促成婚姻的；促成配对或结合的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Helping to bring about marriage or the pairing or joining of two parties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有助于促成婚姻，或使双方形成配对、结合的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħin biex iwassal għaż-żwieġ jew biex żewġ partijiet jingħaqdu jew jiffurmaw par.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促成婚姻的；有助于使双方结婚的。
促成配对或结合的；使双方结成一对或连接起来的。

collocations.en: an aim of bringing about marriage
a process leading to pairing or coupling
collocations.zh: 促成配对或结合的过程

formal.mt: Il-laqgħat kellhom għan żewwieġi: li jgħinu lil persuni li jixtiequ jiżżewġu jsiru jafu lil xulxin.
formal.en: The meetings had an aim of bringing about marriage: to help people who wished to marry get to know one another.
formal.zh: 这些聚会旨在促成婚姻，帮助有结婚意愿的人彼此认识。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tipprova tlaqqa' lil ħuk ma' ħabibti? Lara: Għandi ħsieb żewwieġi; it-tnejn qalu li jixtiequ jiżżewġu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you trying to introduce your brother to my friend? Lara: I have marriage in mind; they both said they would like to get married.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么想介绍你哥哥和我朋友认识？拉拉：我是想促成一段婚姻，他们俩都说过想结婚。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tipprova tlaqqa' lil ħuk ma' ħabibti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tipprova tlaqqa' lil ħuk ma' ħabibti?
messages.zh: 你为什么想介绍你哥哥和我朋友认识？
messages.en: Why are you trying to introduce your brother to my friend?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħsieb żewwieġi; it-tnejn qalu li jixtiequ jiżżewġu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħsieb żewwieġi; it-tnejn qalu li jixtiequ jiżżewġu.
messages.zh: 我是想促成一段婚姻，他们俩都说过想结婚。
messages.en: I have marriage in mind; they both said they would like to get married.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żewwieġi 配一支指向成双的箭头：它形容能促成婚姻或配对的事物，重点在导向结合。

gloss_zh: 二；两个（置于名词前的长定语形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The long attributive form of tnejn, meaning two, used before a noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词 tnejn（二）的长定语形式，用在名词前表示数量为二，如 żewġt itfal（两个孩子）。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma attributtiva twila ta' tnejn, użata qabel nom, bħal f'żewġt itfal.

sense_translations.en_definition: long attributive form of of tnejn (“two”)
sense_translations.zh_definition: tnejn（“二”）的长定语形式，用于名词前表示两个。

formal.mt: Il-kors se jdum żewġt ijiem.
formal.en: The course will last two days.
formal.zh: 课程将持续两天。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm hemm tfal fil-kamra? Ġanni: Hemm żewġt itfal.
colloquial.en: Marija: How many children are in the room? Ġanni: There are two children.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：房间里有几个孩子？詹尼：有两个孩子。

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.zh: 房间里有几个孩子？
messages.en: How many children are in the room?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (助教)
messages.zh: 有两个孩子。
messages.en: There are two children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żewġt itfal 和 żewġt ijiem 成组朗读，分别配两个孩子和两张日历页，记住 żewġt 放在名词前表示二。

gloss_zh: 使眼中闪光；转动眼珠，翻白眼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone's eyes glimmer, or to roll one's eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人的眼睛显出闪亮的神采；也指转动自己的眼珠或翻白眼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel għajnejn xi ħadd ileqqu, jew li jdawwar għajnejh.

sense_translations.en_definition: to induce a glimmer in sb.'s eyes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人的眼中泛起光芒、显出闪亮的神采
转动眼珠；翻白眼

collocations.zh: 喜悦使他的眼睛闪起光来

collocations.en: he rolled his eyes in annoyance

formal.mt: Il-ferħ tal-laqgħa żeġġeġ għajnejh hekk kif ra lil ħuh wara ħafna snin.
formal.en: The joy of the reunion made his eyes glimmer when he saw his brother after many years.
formal.zh: 多年后再次见到兄弟时，重逢的喜悦使他的眼睛闪起光来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu żeġġeġ għajnejh? Lara: Għax reġgħu qalulu l-istess ċajta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu roll his eyes? Lara: Because they told him the same joke again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么翻白眼？拉拉：因为他们又给他讲了同一个笑话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么翻白眼？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu roll his eyes?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他们又给他讲了同一个笑话。
messages.en: Because they told him the same joke again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把注意力放在眼睛：高兴时眼中闪光，烦躁时转眼翻白眼；靠上下文区分这个动词的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light, quick movement from place to place; in a separate sense, a person who makes glass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻快地从一处移动到另一处的活动；另一个独立义项是制造玻璃的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċaqliq ħafif u mgħaġġel minn post għal ieħor; f'tifsira oħra, persuna li tagħmel il-ħġieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻快地来回移动、掠动或飞来飞去的活动
制造玻璃的人；玻璃制造工

collocations.zh: 技艺熟练的玻璃制造工

formal.mt: Iż-żeġġieġ tal-għasafar bejn il-friegħi żied sens ta' ħajja fix-xena deskritta mill-awtur.
formal.en: The flitting of birds among the branches added a sense of life to the scene described by the author.
formal.zh: 鸟儿在枝叶间轻快飞动，为作者描写的场景增添了生气。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min għamel dan il-vażun tal-ħġieġ? Maja: Żeġġieġ tas-sengħa; rajtu jaħdem fil-ħanut tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who made this glass vase? Maja: A skilled glass-maker; I saw him working in his shop.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个玻璃花瓶是谁做的？玛雅：一位手艺很好的玻璃工；我在他的店里看过他工作。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个玻璃花瓶是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this glass vase?

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żeġġieġ tas-sengħa; rajtu jaħdem fil-ħanut tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Żeġġieġ tas-sengħa; rajtu jaħdem fil-ħanut tiegħu.
messages.zh: 一位手艺很好的玻璃工；我在他的店里看过他工作。
messages.en: A skilled glass-maker; I saw him working in his shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开记两幅画面：枝间轻快飞动的鸟，以及制作玻璃花瓶的工匠；两项都是名词，但所指完全不同。

gloss_zh: 眼睛闪亮的；眼中闪着光的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Glimmering or twinkling, used to describe someone's eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人的眼睛闪亮、眼中泛着光或闪着神采。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jleqqu jew iteptep fihom id-dawl, meta jingħad dwar l-għajnejn.

sense_translations.en_definition: glimmering or twinkling (used of one's eyes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪亮的、闪着光的，用于形容人的眼睛

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tiddeskrivi lit-tifel b'għajnejn żeġġieġi waqt li jiftaħ ir-rigal tiegħu.
formal.en: The author describes the boy with twinkling eyes as he opens his present.
formal.zh: 作者描写男孩打开礼物时，眼睛闪着光。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt l-għajnejn żeġġieġi ta' ħuk? Lara: Iva, feraħ ħafna meta ra r-rigal!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see your brother's twinkling eyes? Lara: Yes, he was so happy when he saw the present!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到你弟弟那双闪亮的眼睛了吗？拉拉：看到了，他一见到礼物就高兴极了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到你弟弟那双闪亮的眼睛了吗？
messages.en: Did you see your brother's twinkling eyes?

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, feraħ ħafna meta ra r-rigal!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, feraħ ħafna meta ra r-rigal!
messages.zh: 看到了，他一见到礼物就高兴极了！
messages.en: Yes, he was so happy when he saw the present!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子拆礼物时眼睛亮起来，把这个形容词与“眼中闪光”的样子一起记，重点是眼睛呈现的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short dance, expressed with the diminutive form of żifna.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小段舞蹈；是 żifna 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żifna qasira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' żifna.

sense_translations.en_definition: a short dance (the diminutive form of 'żifna')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小段舞；żifna 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a little dance after the meal

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festa jinkludi żfejna mit-tfal qabel il-kunċert.
formal.en: The celebration programme includes a short dance by the children before the concert.
formal.zh: 庆祝活动的节目包括音乐会开始前由孩子们表演的一小段舞蹈。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Nagħmlu żfejna qabel nitilqu? Lara: Iva, kanzunetta waħda u mbagħad immorru.
colloquial.en: Toni: Shall we have a little dance before we leave? Lara: Yes, one song and then we'll go.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：我们走之前跳一小段舞好吗？拉拉：好，跳一首歌的时间，然后就走。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们走之前跳一小段舞好吗？
messages.en: Shall we have a little dance before we leave?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kanzunetta waħda u mbagħad immorru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kanzunetta waħda u mbagħad immorru.
messages.zh: 好，跳一首歌的时间，然后就走。
messages.en: Yes, one song and then we'll go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żfejna 想成临走前只跳一首歌的小段舞；本词条是名词，记住短短一段的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of moving the body rhythmically, usually to music.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常伴随音乐，有节奏地活动身体的行为或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha wieħed iċaqlaq ġismu b'ritmu, ġeneralment mal-mużika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跳舞；舞蹈这一活动。

formal.mt: Il-kors joffri lezzjonijiet taż-żfin għal dawk li jibdew, b'enfasi fuq ir-ritmu u l-koordinazzjoni.
formal.en: The course offers dancing lessons for beginners, with an emphasis on rhythm and coordination.
formal.zh: 该课程为初学者提供舞蹈课，重点训练节奏感和身体协调能力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tiġi għal-lezzjoni taż-żfin miegħi? Mark: Iva, inħobb iż-żfin, imma għadni qed nitgħallem il-passi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like to come to the dancing lesson with me? Mark: Yes, I enjoy dancing, but I'm still learning the steps.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想和我一起去上舞蹈课吗？马克：想啊，我喜欢跳舞，不过还在学舞步。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我一起去上舞蹈课吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come to the dancing lesson with me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inħobb iż-żfin, imma għadni qed nitgħallem il-passi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inħobb iż-żfin, imma għadni qed nitgħallem il-passi.
messages.zh: 想啊，我喜欢跳舞，不过还在学舞步。
messages.en: Yes, I enjoy dancing, but I'm still learning the steps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象音乐响起、大家随节拍移动身体，用 żfin 统称跳舞这项活动，再用舞蹈课这一搭配巩固。

gloss_zh: 把纽扣弄出圈外的儿童游戏

teaching_sense.en_definition: A children's game in which players try to get a button out of a circle made with a whip-toy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种儿童游戏：孩子们设法把纽扣弄出用鞭形玩具画成的圆圈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba tat-tfal li fiha jippruvaw joħorġu buttuna minn ċirku magħmul b'ġugarell forma ta' frosta.

sense_translations.en_definition: A game in which children try to get a button out of a circle made by a whip-toy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种儿童游戏，玩法是设法把纽扣弄出用鞭形玩具画成的圆圈。

collocations.zh: 我们玩把纽扣弄出圈外的游戏
这种纽扣出圈游戏的规则

formal.mt: Fil-logħba taż-żgajjar, it-tfal jippruvaw joħorġu buttuna minn ċirku magħmul b'ġugarell forma ta' frosta.
formal.en: In żgajjar, children try to get a button out of a circle made with a whip-toy.
formal.zh: 在 żgajjar 游戏中，孩子们设法把纽扣弄出用鞭形玩具画成的圆圈。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif nilagħbu żgajjar? Ninu: Nippruvaw noħorġu buttuna minn ċirku magħmul b'ġugarell forma ta' frosta.
colloquial.en: Lina: How do we play żgajjar? Ninu: We try to get a button out of a circle made with a whip-toy.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：żgajjar 怎么玩？尼努：我们要设法把纽扣弄出用鞭形玩具画成的圆圈。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: żgajjar 怎么玩？
messages.en: How do we play żgajjar?

messages.speaker: Ninu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nippruvaw noħorġu buttuna minn ċirku magħmul b'ġugarell forma ta' frosta.
messages.mt_standard: Nippruvaw noħorġu buttuna minn ċirku magħmul b'ġugarell forma ta' frosta.
messages.zh: 我们要设法把纽扣弄出用鞭形玩具画成的圆圈。
messages.en: We try to get a button out of a circle made with a whip-toy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住三个画面：鞭形玩具画圈、圈内一粒纽扣、孩子设法让纽扣出圈；把整套画面贴上 żgajjar 标签。

gloss_zh: 变得松垮；变得摇晃不稳

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become loose and unstable, especially through wear or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得松垮、摇晃而不牢固，常用来描述磨损或使用后的物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir maħlul u mhux sod, speċjalment minħabba l-użu jew it-tkagħbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得松垮、摇晃不稳。

formal.mt: Is-siġġu żganga wara snin ta' użu u kellu bżonn tiswija.
formal.en: The chair became rickety after years of use and needed repair.
formal.zh: 这把椅子使用多年后变得松垮，需要修理。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan is-siġġu qed jitbandal. Pawlu: Iva, żganga. Aħjar ma noqogħdux fuqu.
colloquial.en: Sara: This chair is wobbling. Pawlu: Yes, it has become rickety. We'd better not sit on it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这把椅子在晃。保罗：是啊，它已经松垮了。我们最好别坐上去。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这把椅子在晃。
messages.en: This chair is wobbling.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żganga. Aħjar ma noqogħdux fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żganga. Aħjar ma noqogħdux fuqu.
messages.zh: 是啊，它已经松垮了。我们最好别坐上去。
messages.en: Yes, it has become rickety. We'd better not sit on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一把原本牢固的旧椅子，用久后接头松开、坐上去左右摇晃；żganga 记的是变松垮这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release something from a hook or undo its hooked connection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把挂在钩上的东西解下，或使钩接的部分脱开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqlagħ xi ħaġa minn ganċ jew jiftaħ rabta magħmula b'ganċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使脱钩；把某物从钩上解下。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żganċa l-katina mill-ganċ qabel ma fetaħ il-bieb.
formal.en: The worker unhooked the chain from the hook before opening the door.
formal.zh: 工人在开门之前，把链条从钩上解了下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-katina għadha mwaħħla mal-ganċ? Mark: Le, Pawlu żganċa l-katina. Issa tista' tiftaħ il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the chain still attached to the hook? Mark: No, Pawlu unhooked the chain. You can open the door now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：链条还挂在钩上吗？马克：没有，保罗已经把链条解下来了。现在可以开门了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 链条还挂在钩上吗？
messages.en: Is the chain still attached to the hook?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Pawlu żganċa l-katina. Issa tista' tiftaħ il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Pawlu żganċa l-katina. Issa tista' tiftaħ il-bieb.
messages.zh: 没有，保罗已经把链条解下来了。现在可以开门了。
messages.en: No, Pawlu unhooked the chain. You can open the door now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手把链条向上一提，再从钩口移出来；用这个完整的脱钩动作记住 żganċa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flow out suddenly or forcefully in a strong stream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体突然或有力地大量涌出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ f'daqqa jew bil-qawwa fi fluss qawwi, bħall-ilma minn pajp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涌出；喷涌而出。

formal.mt: Meta nfetaħ il-valv, l-ilma żgorga mill-pajp.
formal.en: When the valve was opened, water gushed from the pipe.
formal.zh: 阀门打开时，水从管道中喷涌而出。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'ġara lill-pajp? Mark: Infaqa', u l-ilma żgorga minnu. Għalaqt il-valv minnufih.
colloquial.en: Lina: What happened to the pipe? Mark: It burst, and water gushed out of it. I closed the valve straight away.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：管子怎么了？马克：它爆裂了，水从里面喷了出来。我马上关了阀门。

messages.speaker: Lina (住户)
messages.zh: 管子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the pipe?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Infaqa', u l-ilma żgorga minnu. Għalaqt il-valv minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Infaqa', u l-ilma żgorga minnu. Għalaqt il-valv minnufih.
messages.zh: 它爆裂了，水从里面喷了出来。我马上关了阀门。
messages.en: It burst, and water gushed out of it. I closed the valve straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żgorga 配上阀门打开、水柱猛然冲出的画面，记住它强调水流涌出的力量和流量。

gloss_zh: 使降级；使品质或地位降低

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lower someone's rank or status, or reduce the quality of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低某人的级别或地位，或使某物的品质下降。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-grad jew il-pożizzjoni ta' xi ħadd, jew il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使降级；降低地位、品质或价值。

collocations.zh: 降低了那名军官的军衔

formal.mt: Il-kmandant żgrada lill-uffiċjal wara l-investigazzjoni.
formal.en: The commander degraded the officer in rank after the investigation.
formal.zh: 调查结束后，指挥官降低了那名军官的军衔。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex l-uffiċjal issa għandu grad aktar baxx? Pawlu: Il-kmandant żgrada lill-uffiċjal wara l-investigazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the officer have a lower rank now? Pawlu: The commander degraded the officer in rank after the investigation.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那名军官现在为什么军衔更低了？保罗：调查结束后，指挥官给他降了级。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-uffiċjal issa għandu grad aktar baxx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-uffiċjal issa għandu grad aktar baxx?
messages.zh: 那名军官现在为什么军衔更低了？
messages.en: Why does the officer have a lower rank now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 调查结束后，指挥官给他降了级。
messages.en: The commander degraded the officer in rank after the investigation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一把表示级别或品质的梯子，再画箭头向下一格；用这个降低层级的画面记 żgrada。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove the shell or outer covering from something, such as peas or beans.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去掉某物的外壳或外层包覆物，例如剥出豆荚里的豆粒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi l-qoxra jew il-kisja ta' barra minn xi ħaġa, bħall-piżelli jew il-fażola.

sense_translations.en_definition: to shell (to remove the outer covering or shell of something)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 去壳；去掉某物的外层包覆物或外壳。

formal.mt: Il-kok żgrana l-piżelli qabel ma sajjarhom.
formal.en: The cook shelled the peas before cooking them.
formal.zh: 厨师先把豌豆从豆荚里剥出来，然后再烹煮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min żgrana l-piżelli? Ninu: Missieri żgrana l-piżelli dalgħodu; issa lesti biex insajruhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who shelled the peas? Ninu: My father shelled the peas this morning; they're ready for us to cook now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁剥的豌豆？尼努：我爸爸今天早上剥的；现在可以拿来煮了。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 谁剥的豌豆？
messages.en: Who shelled the peas?

messages.speaker: Ninu (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri żgrana l-piżelli dalgħodu; issa lesti biex insajruhom.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri żgrana l-piżelli dalgħodu; issa lesti biex insajruhom.
messages.zh: 我爸爸今天早上剥的；现在可以拿来煮了。
messages.en: My father shelled the peas this morning; they're ready for us to cook now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手掰开豆荚，豆粒落进碗里，外壳留在另一边；把去掉外层、留下里面的动作记作 żgrana。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clean something by removing grease from its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清除物体表面的油脂，使其干净。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa x-xaħam jew il-grass minn fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 除去油脂；清除表面的油污。

collocations.en: removed the grease from the frying pan

formal.mt: Qabel ma beda t-tiswija, it-tekniku żgrassa l-partijiet tal-magna.
formal.en: Before starting the repair, the technician degreased the machine parts.
formal.zh: 开始维修前，技术员清除了机器零件上的油脂。

colloquial.mt: Marta: It-taġen għadu mimli xaħam? Pawlu: Le, ħija żgrassa t-taġen u ħaslu sew.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is the frying pan still covered in grease? Pawlu: No, my brother removed the grease and washed it thoroughly.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：煎锅上还全是油吗？保罗：没有，我哥哥已经把油脂清掉，还把锅洗干净了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 煎锅上还全是油吗？
messages.en: Is the frying pan still covered in grease?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħija żgrassa t-taġen u ħaslu sew.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħija żgrassa t-taġen u ħaslu sew.
messages.zh: 没有，我哥哥已经把油脂清掉，还把锅洗干净了。
messages.en: No, my brother removed the grease and washed it thoroughly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象擦去机器表面一层油膜的动作，把 żgrassa 与“清除油脂”连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove grease or fat from something, or to skim material from the surface of a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去除某物中的油脂，或撇去液体表面的浮油等物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa x-xaħam minn xi ħaġa, jew neħħa dak li jkun f'wiċċ likwidu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to remove grease or fat from
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从某物中除去油脂或脂肪。
撇去液体表面的浮油或其他表层物。

collocations.en: skimmed the fat from the broth
collocations.zh: 撇去了肉汤表面的浮油

collocations.en: removed the excess fat from the sauce
collocations.zh: 去除了酱汁中多余的油脂

formal.mt: Il-kok żgraxxa l-brodu qabel ma żied il-ħaxix.
formal.en: The cook skimmed the fat from the broth before adding the vegetables.
formal.zh: 厨师先撇去肉汤表面的浮油，再加入蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad hemm ħafna xaħam f'wiċċ is-soppa? Toni: Le, missieri żgraxxa s-soppa b'kuċċarina.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there still a lot of fat on top of the soup? Toni: No, my father skimmed the soup with a spoon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：汤面上还有很多油吗？托尼：没有，我爸爸用勺子把浮油撇掉了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm ħafna xaħam f'wiċċ is-soppa?
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm ħafna xaħam f'wiċċ is-soppa?
messages.zh: 汤面上还有很多油吗？
messages.en: Is there still a lot of fat on top of the soup?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 没有，我爸爸用勺子把浮油撇掉了。
messages.en: No, my father skimmed the soup with a spoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中放一锅汤，用勺子轻轻撇去浮油；这个画面帮助同时记住“去脂”和“撇去表层物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to express strong confidence that something is true or will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话者十分确信某事属实或将会发生，相当于“肯定、必定”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri ċertezza jew fiduċja qawwija li xi ħaġa hi vera jew se sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肯定；必定；无疑。
保证；使人确信或放心的承诺。

formal.mt: Din il-bidla żgurament se ttejjeb is-servizz mogħti lill-istudenti.
formal.en: This change will surely improve the service provided to students.
formal.zh: 这项改变肯定会改善为学生提供的服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taħseb li jasal fil-ħin? Mark: Żgurament! Telaq kmieni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you think he will arrive on time? Mark: Surely! He left very early.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你觉得他能准时到吗？马克：肯定能！他很早就出发了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得他能准时到吗？
messages.en: Do you think he will arrive on time?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 肯定能！他很早就出发了。
messages.en: Surely! He left very early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象说话时坚定地点头，用 żgurament 表达“肯定”；另把名词义“保证”单独记在旁边。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat small in size; little or diminutive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容尺寸有点小，或显得小巧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ftit żgħir fid-daqs; ta' daqs ċkejken.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点小的；尺寸偏小的。
小巧的；体积或尺寸很小的。

formal.mt: Il-mużew għandu ġnien żgħajjar fejn il-viżitaturi jistgħu jistrieħu.
formal.en: The museum has a little garden where visitors can rest.
formal.zh: 博物馆有一个小巧的花园，供参观者休息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-ktieb jidħol fil-borża tiegħi? David: Iva, huwa żgħajjar u ma jiħux ħafna spazju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Will this book fit in my bag? David: Yes, it is rather small and does not take up much space.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这本书能放进我的包吗？戴维：能，它挺小的，占不了多少地方。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书能放进我的包吗？
messages.en: Will this book fit in my bag?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa żgħajjar u ma jiħux ħafna spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa żgħajjar u ma jiħux ħafna spazju.
messages.zh: 能，它挺小的，占不了多少地方。
messages.en: Yes, it is rather small and does not take up much space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一本小巧的书放进手提包，用尺寸画面记住 żgħajjar，重点是“小、偏小”。

gloss_zh: 丰盛；某物充足或大量存在的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of having a large or plentiful amount of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种东西数量丰富、充足或大量存在的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat li jkun hemm ħafna minn xi ħaġa, fi kwantità abbundanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥有大量某物；某物十分丰富、充足的状态。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħsad, kien hemm żgħid ta' frott fis-suq tar-raħal.
formal.en: After the harvest, there was an abundance of fruit at the village market.
formal.zh: 收获之后，村里的市场上水果十分丰富。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Hemm biżżejjed ikel għal kulħadd? Ġużi: Iva, hemm żgħid ta' ikel fuq il-mejda!
colloquial.en: Rita: Is there enough food for everyone? Ġużi: Yes, there is an abundance of food on the table!
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：食物够大家吃吗？朱泽：够，桌上的食物丰盛得很！

messages.speaker: Rita (聚餐客人)
messages.zh: 食物够大家吃吗？
messages.en: Is there enough food for everyone?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (聚餐主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm żgħid ta' ikel fuq il-mejda!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm żgħid ta' ikel fuq il-mejda!
messages.zh: 够，桌上的食物丰盛得很！
messages.en: Yes, there is an abundance of food on the table!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐桌摆满食物、水果堆满篮子，把 żgħid 记成“数量丰富的状态”，按名词学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small blossom; the diminutive form of 'żahra'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一朵小花，是 żahra 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjur żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'żahra'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small blossom (the diminutive form of 'żahra')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一朵小花（żahra 的指小形式）。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa tidher żhajra bajda ħdejn werqa ħadra.
formal.en: The picture shows a small white blossom beside a green leaf.
formal.zh: 图中，一朵白色小花出现在一片绿叶旁边。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Ara dik iż-żhajra ħdejn il-bieb! Leo: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ħalliha tikber hemm.
colloquial.en: Emma: Look at that little blossom beside the door! Leo: How lovely it is! Let it grow there.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：看门边那朵小花！利奥：真漂亮！就让它在那里长着吧。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 看门边那朵小花！
messages.en: Look at that little blossom beside the door!

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ħalliha tikber hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ħalliha tikber hemm.
messages.zh: 真漂亮！就让它在那里长着吧。
messages.en: How lovely it is! Let it grow there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żahra 与 żhajra 并排写，再在后者旁画一朵小花，用大小对照记住它的指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of stinking or giving off an unpleasant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体发臭、散发难闻气味的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat li xi ħaġa tinten jew toħroġ riħa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发臭；散发臭味的状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport semma ż-żhim taż-żibel bħala problema li kienet teħtieġ soluzzjoni malajr.
formal.en: The report identified the stinking of the rubbish as a problem requiring a quick solution.
formal.zh: 报告指出，垃圾发臭是一个需要尽快解决的问题。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Minn fejn ġej dan iż-żhim? Ben: Miż-żibel. Se noħorġu issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is this stinking coming from? Ben: From the rubbish. I will take it out now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这股臭味是从哪里来的？本：垃圾那里。我现在就把它拿出去。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 这股臭味是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this stinking coming from?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 垃圾那里。我现在就把它拿出去。
messages.en: From the rubbish. I will take it out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开垃圾桶时捂住鼻子的反应，把 żhim 与“发臭的状态”相连，并记住此处按名词学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The characteristic calling sound made by a horse; neighing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马发出的特有叫声，即马嘶或嘶鸣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss karatteristiku li jagħmel iż-żiemel meta jgħajjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马嘶；马的嘶鸣。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fl-istalla, l-istudenti semgħu ż-żhir taż-żiemel.
formal.en: During their visit to the stable, the students heard the horse's neighing.
formal.zh: 参观马厩时，学生们听到了马的嘶鸣声。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Samwel: Iva, dak iż-żhir ġej mill-istalla.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you hear that sound? Samwel: Yes, that neighing is coming from the stable.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你听到那个声音了吗？萨姆韦尔：听到了，那阵马嘶声是从马厩传来的。

messages.speaker: Anna (农场访客)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Samwel (农场工作人员)
messages.zh: 听到了，那阵马嘶声是从马厩传来的。
messages.en: Yes, that neighing is coming from the stable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在马厩外听见一声马嘶，把听觉画面与 żhir 绑定，记住它指马的叫声。
