teaching_sense.en_definition: The unpleasant smell of excrement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 粪便或排泄物散发的臭味，指气味本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-riħa ħażina tal-ħmieġ tal-bniedem jew tal-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粪臭；排泄物散发的臭味。

collocations.en: a smell of excrement coming from the drains

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie nnutat li żhuma qawwija kienet ġejja mid-drenaġġ ħdejn il-bini.
formal.en: The report noted that a strong smell of excrement was coming from the drains beside the building.
formal.zh: 报告指出，建筑旁的排水道传出浓重的粪臭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġejja din iż-żhuma? Mark: Naħseb mid-drenaġġ. Ejja nitbiegħdu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is this smell of excrement coming from? Mark: I think it's coming from the drains. Let's move a little farther away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这股粪臭是从哪里来的？马克：我想是排水道。我们走远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这股粪臭是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this smell of excrement coming from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想是排水道。我们走远一点吧。
messages.en: I think it's coming from the drains. Let's move a little farther away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象经过排水道时捂住鼻子，把 żhuma 与“闻到粪臭”的场景绑定，记住它表示气味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dairy fat made from cream, used for spreading on bread and for cooking or baking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由奶油制成的乳制脂肪，常用于涂面包、烹饪或烘焙，即黄油。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott tax-xaħam magħmul mill-krema tal-ħalib, li jintuża biex jindilek fuq il-ħobż u fit-tisjir jew fil-ħami.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄油；常用来涂面包或制作菜肴、糕点的乳制品。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, uża mitt gramma żibda bla melħ u ħalliha tirtab qabel tħallatha maz-zokkor.
formal.en: For this recipe, use one hundred grams of unsalted butter and let it soften before mixing it with the sugar.
formal.zh: 制作这道食谱时，使用一百克无盐黄油，待其软化后再与糖混合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid iż-żibda fuq il-ħobż? Pawlu: Iva, ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like butter on your bread? Pawlu: Yes, just a little, please.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的面包上要涂黄油吗？保罗：要，请涂一点点就好。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 你的面包上要涂黄油吗？
messages.en: Would you like butter on your bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.zh: 要，请涂一点点就好。
messages.en: Yes, just a little, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żibda 写在想象中的黄油盒上，再想象用刀涂面包，以早餐动作记住“黄油”。

gloss_zh: 有黄油味的；具有黄油特质的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the taste, richness, or texture of butter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有黄油般的味道、浓郁感或质地的，用于描述食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma, konsistenza jew għana bħal taż-żibda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有黄油味的；具有黄油般浓郁口感或质地的。

collocations.zh: 带有浓郁黄油风味的面包

formal.mt: Dan il-biskutt żibdi għandu togħma rikka u jitfarrak faċilment meta jinkiser.
formal.en: This buttery biscuit has a rich flavor and crumbles easily when broken.
formal.zh: 这款黄油味浓郁的饼干风味醇厚，掰开时容易掉碎屑。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif inhu l-biskutt? Maja: Żibdi ħafna! Jogħġobni mat-te.
colloquial.en: Mark: How is the biscuit? Maja: Very buttery! I like it with tea.
colloquial.zh: 马克：饼干怎么样？玛雅：黄油味很浓！我喜欢配茶吃。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 饼干怎么样？
messages.en: How is the biscuit?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 黄油味很浓！我喜欢配茶吃。
messages.en: Very buttery! I like it with tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 żibda“黄油”与 żibdi“黄油般的”并排做词卡：看到黄油盒记名词，尝到浓香记形容词。

gloss_zh: 酒鬼；废物、没用的家伙（贬称）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disparaging word for a drunkard, also used as an insult suggesting that a person is worthless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贬称酒鬼的词，也可用于辱骂某人是毫无价值、没有用处的家伙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' disprezz għal persuna li tisker ta' spiss, jew insult li jippreżenta lil xi ħadd bħala bla siwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酒鬼；对经常醉酒之人的贬称。

sense_translations.en_definition: derogatory term for a person, suggesting worthlessness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对人的侮辱性称呼，相当于“废物”“没用的家伙”，暗示其毫无价值。

collocations.zh: 那个废物；那个酒鬼（贬称，具体含义依语境）

collocations.en: to insult someone by calling them a żibla
collocations.zh: 用 żibla 辱骂某人是酒鬼或废物

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kelma 'żibla' tintuża dwar raġel li jisker ta' spiss; f'kuntest ieħor tista' tkun insult li jfisser persuna bla siwi.
formal.en: In the story, the word 'żibla' is used for a man who frequently gets drunk; in another context it can be an insult meaning a worthless person.
formal.zh: 故事中，żibla 一词用于称呼一个经常醉酒的男人；在其他语境中，它也可以是辱骂某人毫无价值的称呼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħlu żibla? Mark: Ried jinsultah u jgħid li ma jiswa għal xejn. Il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna li tisker ta' spiss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he call him a żibla? Mark: He wanted to insult him and say he was worthless. The word can also mean someone who frequently gets drunk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么骂那个人是 żibla？马克：他想侮辱那个人，说他是个废物。这个词也可以指经常醉酒的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么骂那个人是 żibla？
messages.en: Why did he call him a żibla?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jinsultah u jgħid li ma jiswa għal xejn. Il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna li tisker ta' spiss.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jinsultah u jgħid li ma jiswa għal xejn. Il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna li tisker ta' spiss.
messages.zh: 他想侮辱那个人，说他是个废物。这个词也可以指经常醉酒的人。
messages.en: He wanted to insult him and say he was worthless. The word can also mean someone who frequently gets drunk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żibla 词卡画两个语境框：“醉酒的人”和“被骂没用的人”，同时标注贬义，靠上下文选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small decorative piece, often with a hole so that it can be threaded onto a string.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作装饰的小珠粒，通常有孔，可以穿在线上制作项链等饰品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir ta' tiżjin, spiss imtaqqab biex ikun jista' jidħol f'ħajta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珠子；可用于串成项链等饰物的小珠粒。

collocations.en: to thread a bead onto a string

formal.mt: Għaddi l-ħajta mit-toqba ta' kull żibġa biex tifforma ġiżirana.
formal.en: Pass the string through the hole in each bead to make a necklace.
formal.zh: 将线穿过每颗珠子的孔，串成一条项链。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tini dik iż-żibġa l-ħamra? Nina: Hawn hi. Se tpoġġiha f'nofs il-ġiżirana?
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you pass me that red bead? Nina: Here it is. Are you going to put it in the middle of the necklace?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：能把那颗红珠子递给我吗？妮娜：给你。你要把它放在项链正中间吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (手工课同学)
messages.zh: 能把那颗红珠子递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me that red bead?

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hi. Se tpoġġiha f'nofs il-ġiżirana?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hi. Se tpoġġiha f'nofs il-ġiżirana?
messages.zh: 给你。你要把它放在项链正中间吗？
messages.en: Here it is. Are you going to put it in the middle of the necklace?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿起一颗红珠子并把线穿过小孔，边做动作边说 żibġa，让词形对应一颗具体珠子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a shape or appearance like a bead.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外形或样子像珠子的，强调珠粒般的形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għamla jew dehra bħal dik ta' żibġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形似珠子的；呈珠子状的。

formal.mt: Id-disinn jinkludi buttun żibġi fuq kull komma, li jagħti dehra dekorattiva lill-ilbies.
formal.en: The design includes a bead-like button on each sleeve, giving the garment a decorative touch.
formal.zh: 该设计在每只袖子上配有一枚珠子状纽扣，为衣服增添装饰效果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-buttun jidher bħal żibġa. Lara: Iva, huwa żibġi u jaqbel mal-ġiżirana tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Nina: This button looks like a bead. Lara: Yes, it's bead-like and matches your necklace.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这枚纽扣看起来像颗珠子。拉拉：对，是珠子状的，和你的项链很配。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这枚纽扣看起来像颗珠子。
messages.en: This button looks like a bead.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa żibġi u jaqbel mal-ġiżirana tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa żibġi u jaqbel mal-ġiżirana tiegħek.
messages.zh: 对，是珠子状的，和你的项链很配。
messages.en: Yes, it's bead-like and matches your necklace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żibġa“珠子”和 żibġi“珠子状的”配成图卡：一边画珠子，一边画外形像珠子的纽扣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Plus; used between numbers or quantities to indicate addition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示加法的“加”或“加上”，连接需要相加的数字或数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża bejn numri jew kwantitajiet biex turi li għandhom jingħaddu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加；加上，用于表示两个数或数量相加。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-matematika, tnejn żid tlieta jagħmlu ħamsa.
formal.en: In the mathematics exercise, two plus three equals five.
formal.zh: 在这道数学练习中，二加三等于五。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm jagħmlu erbgħa żid tnejn? Pawlu: Sitta! Għoddithom fuq subgħajja.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is four plus two? Pawlu: Six! I counted them on my fingers.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：四加二等于多少？保罗：六！我是掰着手指数出来的。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 四加二等于多少？
messages.en: What is four plus two?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.zh: 六！我是掰着手指数出来的。
messages.en: Six! I counted them on my fingers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在算式“2 + 3”中把加号换写成 żid，朗读 tnejn żid tlieta，记住本词条表示连接数字的“加”。

gloss_zh: 解开绳结；理开绳索或钓线的扭结

teaching_sense.en_definition: To undo a knot or straighten out a kink in a rope or fishing line.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 解开绳索或钓线上的结，或理开其中扭曲、打弯的部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħoll għoqda jew tiddritta liwja f'ħabel jew fix-xlief tas-sajd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to undue a knot or a kink in a rope or fishing line
sense_translations.zh_definition: 解开绳索或钓线上的结，或理开其扭结、弯折处。

collocations.en: to undo a knot in a rope
to straighten out a kink in fishing line

formal.mt: Fil-kuntest tas-sajd, il-verb 'żiden' jiddeskrivi l-azzjoni li tħoll għoqda jew tiddritta liwja fix-xlief.
formal.en: In a fishing context, the verb 'żiden' describes the action of undoing a knot or straightening out a kink in the line.
formal.zh: 在钓鱼语境中，动词 żiden 描述解开钓线上的结或理开扭曲处的动作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser 'żiden' meta nitkellmu dwar ħabel? Mark: Ifisser tħoll għoqda jew tiddritta liwja fih, bħal din hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'żiden' mean when we're talking about a rope? Mark: It means undoing a knot or straightening out a kink in it, like this one here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：说到绳子时，żiden 是什么意思？马克：就是解开绳结或理开扭曲的地方，像这里这一处。

messages.speaker: Lara (钓鱼初学者)
messages.zh: 说到绳子时，żiden 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żiden' mean when we're talking about a rope?

messages.speaker: Mark (钓鱼教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser tħoll għoqda jew tiddritta liwja fih, bħal din hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser tħoll għoqda jew tiddritta liwja fih, bħal din hawn.
messages.zh: 就是解开绳结或理开扭曲的地方，像这里这一处。
messages.en: It means undoing a knot or straightening out a kink in it, like this one here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钓线打结后，用手慢慢解开并把弯曲处理直；把这一整套动作与 żiden 绑定，记住“解结、理顺”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something plentiful or cause it to grow or occur in abundance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种事物变得丰富，或使其大量生长、出现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġab abbundanza ta' xi ħaġa jew wassal biex xi ħaġa tikber fi kwantità kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使丰富；使大量生长或出现。

formal.mt: Il-kompost żiegħed il-ħdura fil-ġnien tal-iskola.
formal.en: The compost made the greenery abundant in the school garden.
formal.zh: 堆肥使学校花园里的草木更加繁茂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm kiber il-ħaxix! Pawlu: Iva, l-ilma żiegħed il-ħaxix f'din ir-rokna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how much the grass has grown! Pawlu: Yes, the water made the grass grow abundantly in this corner.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，草长得多茂盛！保罗：是啊，水让这个角落的草大量生长。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，草长得多茂盛！
messages.en: Look how much the grass has grown!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-ilma żiegħed il-ħaxix f'din ir-rokna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-ilma żiegħed il-ħaxix f'din ir-rokna.
messages.zh: 是啊，水让这个角落的草大量生长。
messages.en: Yes, the water made the grass grow abundantly in this corner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象浇水后草木铺满花园，把这个词记成“使某物变得大量而丰富”，注意其中的使动意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small marine fish with a head resembling a horse's head and a curled tail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种头部形似马头、尾巴能够卷曲的小型海鱼，即海马。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta żgħira tal-baħar b'ras li tixbah ras ta' żiemel u b'denb li jitgħawweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海马，一种头部形似马头的小型海鱼。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw żiemel il-baħar fl-akkwarju u pinġew il-forma ta' denbu.
formal.en: The students observed a seahorse in the aquarium and drew the shape of its tail.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了水族箱里的海马，并画出了它尾巴的形状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik il-ħuta bid-denb imkebbeb! Mark: Dak żiemel il-baħar. Qisu għandu ras ta' żiemel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that fish with the curled tail! Mark: That's a seahorse. It looks as though it has a horse's head.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看那条尾巴卷起来的鱼！马克：那是海马，脑袋看起来像马头。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 看那条尾巴卷起来的鱼！
messages.en: Look at that fish with the curled tail!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak żiemel il-baħar. Qisu għandu ras ta' żiemel.
messages.mt_standard: Dak żiemel il-baħar. Qisu għandu ras ta' żiemel.
messages.zh: 那是海马，脑袋看起来像马头。
messages.en: That's a seahorse. It looks as though it has a horse's head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“海里长着马头的小鱼”作画面记忆，整组词对应海马，并和表示河马的词组区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large mammal with a broad mouth and short legs that spends much of its time in water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种嘴宽、腿短、体形庞大且经常待在水中的哺乳动物，即河马。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu kbir b'ħalq wiesa' u saqajn qosra li jqatta' ħafna ħin fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 河马，一种体形庞大、经常在水中活动的哺乳动物。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher żiemel tax-xmara b'rasu barra mill-ilma.
formal.en: The photograph shows a hippopotamus with its head above the water.
formal.zh: 照片中有一只河马，头露在水面上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak l-annimal kbir fl-ilma? David: Dak żiemel tax-xmara. Ara kemm għandu ħalq wiesa'!
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that big animal in the water? David: That's a hippopotamus. Look how wide its mouth is!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：水里那只大动物是什么？戴维：那是河马。看，它的嘴多宽！

messages.speaker: Nina (孩子)
messages.zh: 水里那只大动物是什么？
messages.en: What's that big animal in the water?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak żiemel tax-xmara. Ara kemm għandu ħalq wiesa'!
messages.mt_standard: Dak żiemel tax-xmara. Ara kemm għandu ħalq wiesa'!
messages.zh: 那是河马。看，它的嘴多宽！
messages.en: That's a hippopotamus. Look how wide its mouth is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组和“河里露出大脑袋的河马”绑定记忆；海马小而卷尾，河马大而嘴宽。

gloss_zh: 马的；马类的；松懈的；怠慢的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to horses; in a separate sense, slack or careless in carrying out duties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示与马有关或属于马类；另一个义项表示做事松懈、怠慢职责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maż-żwiemel; f'tifsira oħra, li hu laxk jew traskurat fil-qadi ta' dmirijietu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马的；与马有关的；马类的。
松懈的；疏忽职责的；怠慢的。

formal.mt: Id-disinn juri l-proporzjonijiet ta' ġisem żiemli.
formal.en: The drawing shows the proportions of an equine body.
formal.zh: 这幅图展示了马身体各部分的比例。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għad hemm dawk il-kaxxi fil-bieb? Toni: Il-ħaddiem kien żiemli u ħalliehom hemm. Se nneħħihom jien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are those boxes still in the doorway? Toni: The worker was remiss and left them there. I'll move them myself.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：那些箱子怎么还放在门口？托尼：那个工人做事怠慢，把箱子留在那里了。我来搬走。

messages.speaker: Marija (店长)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għad hemm dawk il-kaxxi fil-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għad hemm dawk il-kaxxi fil-bieb?
messages.zh: 那些箱子怎么还放在门口？
messages.en: Why are those boxes still in the doorway?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħaddiem kien żiemli u ħalliehom hemm. Se nneħħihom jien.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħaddiem kien żiemli u ħalliehom hemm. Se nneħħihom jien.
messages.zh: 那个工人做事怠慢，把箱子留在那里了。我来搬走。
messages.en: The worker was remiss and left them there. I'll move them myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 建立两张独立记忆卡：一张画马表示“马类的”，一张画没完成的工作表示“怠慢的”，由语境选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause harm or damage to someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物受到伤害、损失或不良影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel ħsara lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤害；损害；使受到不良影响。

formal.mt: It-tniġġis żien lill-uċuħ tar-raba' qrib il-fabbrika.
formal.en: The pollution harmed the crops near the factory.
formal.zh: 污染损害了工厂附近的庄稼。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tmexxi l-pjanta minn hemm? Luqa: Is-sħana minn dak il-forn żien lill-pjanta. Hawn tkun aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you moving the plant from there? Luqa: The heat from that oven harmed the plant. It'll do better here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把植物从那里搬走？卢卡：那个烤箱散出的热气伤到了植物。放这里会好些。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tmexxi l-pjanta minn hemm?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tmexxi l-pjanta minn hemm?
messages.zh: 你为什么把植物从那里搬走？
messages.en: Why are you moving the plant from there?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sħana minn dak il-forn żien lill-pjanta. Hawn tkun aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sħana minn dak il-forn żien lill-pjanta. Hawn tkun aħjar.
messages.zh: 那个烤箱散出的热气伤到了植物。放这里会好些。
messages.en: The heat from that oven harmed the plant. It'll do better here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“热气伤到盆栽”的场景记忆，把 żien 和“造成伤害或损害”的动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Covered in tar, or resembling tar in appearance or texture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面覆盖或沾有焦油的；也可表示外观或质地像焦油的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miksi biż-żift, jew li jixbah iż-żift fid-dehra jew fil-konsistenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表面覆盖焦油的；沾满焦油的。
像焦油的；具有焦油般外观或质地的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun kien fih materjal żifti, skur u jwaħħal.
formal.en: The sample contained a dark, sticky, tarlike material.
formal.zh: 样本中含有一种深色、黏稠、像焦油的材料。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex ma nistax inpoġġi l-basket hawn? Ġanni: Dan il-wiċċ żifti; il-basket jitħammeġ.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why can't I put the basket here? Ġanni: This surface is covered in tar; the basket will get dirty.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：为什么不能把篮子放在这里？詹尼：这个表面沾着焦油，篮子会弄脏。

messages.speaker: Elena (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax inpoġġi l-basket hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax inpoġġi l-basket hawn?
messages.zh: 为什么不能把篮子放在这里？
messages.en: Why can't I put the basket here?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (维修工人)
messages.zh: 这个表面沾着焦油，篮子会弄脏。
messages.en: This surface is covered in tar; the basket will get dirty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象黑而黏的焦油：沾在表面上是“覆有焦油”，用来描述相似质地则是“像焦油”。

gloss_zh: 微不足道的东西；表示恼怒的感叹语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something insignificant; also used as an exclamation of annoyance, usually in the form iż-żigg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指微不足道的东西；也用于表达恼怒，通常采用带定冠词的形式 iż-żigg。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa bla importanza; jintuża wkoll bħala esklamazzjoni ta' dwejjaq, ġeneralment fil-forma iż-żigg.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微不足道的东西；无关紧要的小事。

sense_translations.en_definition: an exclamation of annoyance (usually preceded by the definite article "iż-żigg")
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示恼怒或不耐烦的感叹语，通常带定冠词，形式为 iż-żigg，可依语境译为“真烦！”或“可恶！”。

formal.mt: Fid-diskussjoni, dak id-dettall tqies bħala żigg bla importanza għall-konklużjoni.
formal.en: In the discussion, that detail was regarded as a trivial matter with no bearing on the conclusion.
formal.zh: 在讨论中，那个细节被视为对结论无关紧要的小事。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Iż-żigg! Il-kompjuter reġa' waqaf. Rita: Kont salvajt ix-xogħol? Mark: Iva, għall-inqas ma tlift xejn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Damn! The computer froze again. Rita: Had you saved your work? Mark: Yes, at least I didn't lose anything.
colloquial.zh: 马克：可恶！电脑又卡住了。丽塔：你保存工作了吗？马克：保存了，至少什么都没丢。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 可恶！电脑又卡住了。
messages.en: Damn! The computer froze again.

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 你保存工作了吗？
messages.en: Had you saved your work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 保存了，至少什么都没丢。
messages.en: Yes, at least I didn't lose anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幕记忆：指着小事说“微不足道”，遇到电脑卡住喊“Iż-żigg!”表达恼怒；留意后一用法的定冠词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to have nasal congestion; also, to infect someone with flu.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人出现鼻塞；另一个义项是使某人感染流感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kawża sadd fl-imnieħer lil xi ħadd; f'tifsira oħra, infetta lil xi ħadd bl-influwenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使鼻塞；使鼻腔出现堵塞不通的感觉。
使感染流感；把流感传染给某人。

collocations.en: the dust caused Mark's nasal congestion
the virus infected the whole family with flu

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-virus żikkem lill-familja kollha bl-influwenza.
formal.en: The report describes how the virus infected the whole family with flu.
formal.zh: 报告描述了病毒如何使全家感染流感。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark qed jitkellem hekk? Pawlu: It-trab żikkem lil Mark waqt li konna qed innaddfu. Għandu mnieħru misdud.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does Mark sound like that? Pawlu: The dust made Mark's nose blocked while we were cleaning. His nose is congested.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克说话怎么是这个声音？保罗：我们打扫时，灰尘让他鼻塞了。他现在鼻子不通。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 马克说话怎么是这个声音？
messages.en: Why does Mark sound like that?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-trab żikkem lil Mark waqt li konna qed innaddfu. Għandu mnieħru misdud.
messages.mt_standard: It-trab żikkem lil Mark waqt li konna qed innaddfu. Għandu mnieħru misdud.
messages.zh: 我们打扫时，灰尘让他鼻塞了。他现在鼻子不通。
messages.en: The dust made Mark's nose blocked while we were cleaning. His nose is congested.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“让别人鼻子堵住”记住使动义，再单独记“使染上流感”；鼻塞义本身不等于已经感染流感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nasal congestion, or symptoms associated with flu.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子堵塞的状态，也可指流感症状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imnieħer misdud, jew sintomi marbuta mal-influwenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻塞；鼻子堵塞、不通气的状态。
流感症状；患流感时出现的不适表现。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta żikma qawwija u diffikultà biex jieħu n-nifs minn imnieħru.
formal.en: The patient reported severe nasal congestion and difficulty breathing through his nose.
formal.zh: 患者报告有严重鼻塞，并且难以用鼻子呼吸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titkellem hekk? Pawlu: Għandi żikma u ma nistax nieħu n-nifs sew minn imnieħri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you sound like that? Pawlu: I have a blocked nose and can't breathe properly through it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说话怎么这个声音？保罗：我鼻塞了，用鼻子呼吸不太顺畅。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你说话怎么这个声音？
messages.en: Why do you sound like that?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi żikma u ma nistax nieħu n-nifs sew minn imnieħri.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi żikma u ma nistax nieħu n-nifs sew minn imnieħri.
messages.zh: 我鼻塞了，用鼻子呼吸不太顺畅。
messages.en: I have a blocked nose and can't breathe properly through it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żikma 和捏住鼻子说话的画面一起记：先联想鼻塞，再扩展到流感症状。

gloss_zh: 什么也没有；没有任何人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nothing or not anything; in reference to people, no one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示没有任何东西；指人时表示没有任何人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xejn; meta jirreferi għan-nies, ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 什么也没有；没有任何东西。
没有人；没有任何人。

formal.mt: Fit-tweġiba tiegħu, l-awtur juża l-pronom 'żilċ' biex jindika li ma nstab xejn.
formal.en: In his answer, the author uses the pronoun 'żilċ' to indicate that nothing was found.
formal.zh: 作者在回答中使用代词 żilċ，表示什么也没有找到。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'sibt fil-kaxxa? Mark: Żilċ. Lara: U min ġie jgħinek? Mark: Żilċ. Kelli nagħmel kollox waħdi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you find in the box? Mark: Nothing. Lara: And who came to help you? Mark: No one. I had to do everything myself.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在盒子里找到了什么？马克：什么也没有。拉拉：那有谁来帮你？马克：没有人。我只好全都自己做。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在盒子里找到了什么？
messages.en: What did you find in the box?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 什么也没有。
messages.en: Nothing.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那有谁来帮你？
messages.en: And who came to help you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有人。我只好全都自己做。
messages.en: No one. I had to do everything myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żilċ 配上两个空画面：空盒子对应什么也没有，空房间对应没有任何人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The gloss or polished finish of a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体表面的光泽，或经过抛光形成的光亮效果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tleqqija jew il-finitura tleqq ta' wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 光泽；表面呈现的光亮。
抛光效果；表面经过打磨或擦拭后呈现的光亮。

collocations.en: to give wood a polished finish
collocations.zh: 使木材表面呈现抛光效果

formal.mt: Wara l-illustrar, il-wiċċ tal-mejda kiseb żilġa sabiħa.
formal.en: After polishing, the surface of the table acquired a beautiful gloss.
formal.zh: 经过抛光后，桌面呈现出漂亮的光泽。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara x'żilġa għandha din il-mejda! Toni: Iva, għadni kemm illustrajtha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at the gloss on this table! Toni: Yes, I've just polished it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：看这张桌子的光泽！托尼：是啊，我刚把它擦亮。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 看这张桌子的光泽！
messages.en: Look at the gloss on this table!

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 是啊，我刚把它擦亮。
messages.en: Yes, I've just polished it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚擦亮的桌面反射灯光，用 żilġa 记住表面的光泽和抛光效果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Southern Africa, officially called the Republic of Zimbabwe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于非洲南部的国家，正式名称为津巴布韦共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika taż-Żimbabwe.

sense_translations.en_definition: Zimbabwe (a country in Southern Africa; official name: Repubblika taż-Żimbabwe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 津巴布韦，位于非洲南部的国家；正式名称为津巴布韦共和国。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi taqsima dwar ir-Repubblika taż-Żimbabwe, pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika.
formal.en: The report includes a section on the Republic of Zimbabwe, a country in Southern Africa.
formal.zh: 报告包含一个介绍津巴布韦共和国的章节，该国位于非洲南部。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn tinsab iż-Żimbabwe? David: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Zimbabwe? David: In Southern Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：津巴布韦在哪里？戴维：在非洲南部。我们在地图上找找吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 津巴布韦在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Zimbabwe?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在非洲南部。我们在地图上找找吧。
messages.en: In Southern Africa. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Żimbabwe 与英文 Zimbabwe 并排写在非洲南部的地图旁，联记中文津巴布韦。

gloss_zh: 津巴布韦的；津巴布韦人（通常指男性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Zimbabwe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于津巴布韦、来自津巴布韦或与津巴布韦有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu miż-Żimbabwe jew għandu x'jaqsam maż-Żimbabwe.

sense_translations.en_definition: Zimbabwean (of, from or relating to Zimbabwe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 津巴布韦的；来自津巴布韦或与该国有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Zimbabwean (native or inhabitant of Zimbabwe) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 津巴布韦人；出生于或居住在津巴布韦的人，通常指男性。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi intervista ma' kittieb Żimbabwen dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The programme includes an interview with a Zimbabwean writer about his work.
formal.zh: 节目包含一次对津巴布韦作家的采访，内容涉及他的作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu dan il-kittieb? Mark: Hu Żimbabwen, miż-Żimbabwe. Maja: Nixtieq naqra ktieb tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is this writer from? Mark: He's Zimbabwean, from Zimbabwe. Maja: I'd like to read one of his books.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这位作家来自哪里？马克：他是津巴布韦人，来自津巴布韦。玛雅：我想读一本他的书。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.zh: 这位作家来自哪里？
messages.en: Where is this writer from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是津巴布韦人，来自津巴布韦。
messages.en: He's Zimbabwean, from Zimbabwe.

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.zh: 我想读一本他的书。
messages.en: I'd like to read one of his books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡区分：Żimbabwe 写国家名称，Żimbabwen 写津巴布韦的或津巴布韦人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mussel referred to by the scientific name Lioberus agglutinans.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指以 Lioberus agglutinans 为学名的一种贻贝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' mollusk magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Lioberus agglutinans.

sense_translations.en_definition: Lioberus agglutinans, a genus of mussels
sense_translations.zh_definition: Lioberus agglutinans；一种贻贝类软体动物的名称。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-kampjun tagħti l-isem 'żinżel tal-baħar' u l-isem xjentifiku Lioberus agglutinans.
formal.en: The specimen label gives the name 'żinżel tal-baħar' and the scientific name Lioberus agglutinans.
formal.zh: 标本标签标有马耳他语名称 żinżel tal-baħar，以及学名 Lioberus agglutinans。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan fil-ritratt? Pawlu: Żinżel tal-baħar. L-isem xjentifiku hu Lioberus agglutinans. Lara: Se nikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet fin-noti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this in the photograph? Pawlu: It's a mussel called żinżel tal-baħar. Its scientific name is Lioberus agglutinans. Lara: I'll write both names in my notes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这个是什么？保罗：是一种叫 żinżel tal-baħar 的贻贝，学名是 Lioberus agglutinans。拉拉：我会把这两个名称都记在笔记里。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这个是什么？
messages.en: What's this in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Żinżel tal-baħar. L-isem xjentifiku hu Lioberus agglutinans.
messages.mt_standard: Żinżel tal-baħar. L-isem xjentifiku hu Lioberus agglutinans.
messages.zh: 是一种叫 żinżel tal-baħar 的贻贝，学名是 Lioberus agglutinans。
messages.en: It's a mussel called żinżel tal-baħar. Its scientific name is Lioberus agglutinans.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet fin-noti tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se nikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet fin-noti tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我会把这两个名称都记在笔记里。
messages.en: I'll write both names in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一枚贻贝，把 żinżel tal-baħar 与 Lioberus agglutinans 同贴旁边，整组联记名称。

gloss_zh: 宝瓶座；水瓶座；盛液体的宽口深壶

teaching_sense.en_definition: Aquarius, either the constellation or the zodiac sign.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指天文学中的宝瓶座，也可指黄道星座中的水瓶座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem il-kostellazzjoni taż-Żir jew tas-sinjal taż-żodijaku bl-istess isem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宝瓶座；天文学中的星座名称。
水瓶座；黄道十二星座之一的名称。

sense_translations.en_definition: pitcher (a wide-mouthed, deep vessel for holding liquids)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛液体的宽口深壶；一种口宽、容器较深的盛液器皿。

formal.mt: Il-mappa tas-sema turi l-kostellazzjoni taż-Żir; f'kuntest ieħor, in-nom 'żir' jindika reċipjent fond b'fetħa wiesgħa għal-likwidi.
formal.en: The sky map shows the constellation Aquarius; in another context, the noun 'żir' denotes a deep, wide-mouthed vessel for liquids.
formal.zh: 星图标出了宝瓶座；在另一种语境中，名词 żir 指一种盛液体的宽口深壶。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu s-sinjal tiegħek? David: Iż-Żir. Nina: U dak iż-żir fuq il-mejda? David: Dak reċipjent għall-ilma!
colloquial.en: Nina: What's your zodiac sign? David: Aquarius. Nina: And that żir on the table? David: That's a vessel for water!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你是什么星座？戴维：水瓶座。妮娜：那桌上的那个 żir 呢？戴维：那个是盛水的壶！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是什么星座？
messages.en: What's your zodiac sign?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 水瓶座。
messages.en: Aquarius.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那桌上的那个 żir 呢？
messages.en: And that żir on the table?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个是盛水的壶！
messages.en: That's a vessel for water!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格图分别画星图、星座卡和宽口水壶，按语境区分 Żir 与 żir，不把联想当作词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attempt to take hold of something; also, to seduce someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 试图抓住或握住某物；也可表示诱惑某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprova jaqbad jew iżomm xi ħaġa; ukoll, jisseduċi lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 试图抓住或握住。
诱惑某人；试图使某人产生情欲或亲密关系的兴趣。

collocations.en: tried to get hold of the rope

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel żirek biex iżomm il-ħabel, iżda ma rnexxilux jaqbdu.
formal.en: In the story, the man tried to get hold of the rope but did not manage to grasp it.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子试图抓住绳子，但没有成功。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel ir-raġel meta waqa' l-ħabel? Mark: Żirek biex iżommu, imma ma laħqux.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the man do when the rope fell? Mark: He tried to get hold of it, but he couldn't reach it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：绳子掉下来时，那个人做了什么？马克：他试图抓住它，但够不着。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 绳子掉下来时，那个人做了什么？
messages.en: What did the man do when the rope fell?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żirek biex iżommu, imma ma laħqux.
messages.mt_standard: Żirek biex iżommu, imma ma laħqux.
messages.zh: 他试图抓住它，但够不着。
messages.en: He tried to get hold of it, but he couldn't reach it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żirek 做两张情境卡：伸手试抓绳子，以及诱惑某人；分别记义，不推断词源联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Seduction: the use of charm or attraction to draw someone into romantic or sexual interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过魅力或吸引力引起他人恋爱或性爱兴趣的诱惑、引诱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu tas-seħer jew tal-ġibda biex tqajjem interess romantiku jew sesswali f'xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诱惑；以魅力引起他人恋爱或性爱兴趣的引诱。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, l-awtriċi teżamina ż-żirka bħala mezz biex il-karattri jiksbu l-influwenza fuq xulxin.
formal.en: In her analysis of the novel, the author examines seduction as a means by which the characters gain influence over one another.
formal.zh: 在对这部小说的分析中，作者探讨了人物如何通过诱惑获得对彼此的影响力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din ix-xena dwar iż-żirka? Toni: Iva, qed jipprova jiġbidha lejh bil-kliem ħelu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this scene about seduction? Toni: Yes, he's trying to attract her with sweet talk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一幕讲的是诱惑吗？托尼：是的，他想用甜言蜜语吸引她。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这一幕讲的是诱惑吗？
messages.en: Is this scene about seduction?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jipprova jiġbidha lejh bil-kliem ħelu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jipprova jiġbidha lejh bil-kliem ħelu.
messages.zh: 是的，他想用甜言蜜语吸引她。
messages.en: Yes, he's trying to attract her with sweet talk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żirka 与小说中用甜言蜜语吸引对方的场景相连，记住它指“诱惑、引诱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Zirconium, the chemical element named by this word.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锆的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-element kimiku żirkonju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锆，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-laboratorju, il-kampjun huwa identifikat bħala żirkonju u jingħata numru ta' referenza.
formal.en: In the laboratory report, the sample is identified as zirconium and assigned a reference number.
formal.zh: 实验室报告将该样品鉴定为锆，并为其分配了一个参考编号。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm f'dan il-kampjun? Mark: Skont it-tikketta, fih żirkonju.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's in this sample? Mark: According to the label, it contains zirconium.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份样品里有什么？马克：根据标签，里面含有锆。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这份样品里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this sample?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 根据标签，里面含有锆。
messages.en: According to the label, it contains zirconium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żirkonju 写在想象中的元素样品标签上，并与英语 zirconium、中文“锆”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Handsome in appearance, or well appointed with attractive furnishings and fittings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人外貌俊美；也可形容场所陈设美观、布置精良。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra sabiħa, jew li hu mgħammar u mżejjen tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 俊美的；英俊的，形容人的外貌。
陈设美观且配备完善的；布置精良的。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi raġel żjin bilqiegħda f'salott żjin, imżejjen b'għamara eleganti.
formal.en: The story describes a handsome man sitting in a well-appointed sitting room furnished with elegant furniture.
formal.zh: 故事描写了一位英俊男子，坐在一间布置精良、配有雅致家具的客厅里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'salott żjin għandek! Pawlu: Grazzi! Għażilt l-għamara kollha jien.
colloquial.en: Nina: What a well-appointed sitting room you have! Pawlu: Thanks! I chose all the furniture myself.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的客厅布置得真好！保罗：谢谢！所有家具都是我自己挑的。

messages.speaker: Nina (来访朋友)
messages.zh: 你的客厅布置得真好！
messages.en: What a well-appointed sitting room you have!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (主人)
messages.zh: 谢谢！所有家具都是我自己挑的。
messages.en: Thanks! I chose all the furniture myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 żjin：人是“英俊”，客厅是“布置精良”；看清它修饰的对象再选中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wet, messy material such as muck, mud, slime, or partly melted snow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 湿而脏乱的物质，可指污泥、泥浆、黏液或半融化的雪泥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal imxarrab u maħmuġ, bħal tajn, ħama, materjal li jwaħħal jew borra nofsha mdewba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污泥；湿而脏的泥状污物。
泥；泥浆，指土与水混合而成的湿泥。
黏液；黏滑的泥状物。
雪泥；半融化的雪与水混合形成的稀软物。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, iż-żlieq għatta parti mill-mogħdija u ħammeġ iż-żraben tal-mixi.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, mud covered part of the path and dirtied the walking shoes.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，泥浆覆盖了部分小路，弄脏了步行者的鞋。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex iż-żraben tiegħek daqshekk maħmuġin? Luqa: Dħalt fiż-żlieq ħdejn il-bieb tal-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are your shoes so dirty? Luqa: I stepped into some mud near the garden gate.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你的鞋为什么这么脏？卢卡：我在花园门旁踩进了泥里。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 你的鞋为什么这么脏？
messages.en: Why are your shoes so dirty?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 我在花园门旁踩进了泥里。
messages.en: I stepped into some mud near the garden gate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żlieq 想成鞋底沾上的湿软物：污泥、泥浆、黏液或雪泥；这里记的是物质本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slimy in texture or covered with slime; also slushy, with the wet, soft consistency of partly melted snow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地黏滑或覆有黏液的；也指像半融雪一样湿软、呈雪泥状的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ jew konsistenza tiżloq u twaħħal, jew li hu artab u mxarrab bħal borra nofsha mdewba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黏滑的；覆有黏液或具有黏滑质地的。
雪泥状的；像半融雪一样湿软稀烂的。

formal.mt: Il-ġebla ħdejn l-għadira kienet miksija b'saff żlieqi ta' materjal aħdar.
formal.en: The stone beside the pond was covered with a slimy layer of green material.
formal.zh: 池塘旁的石头上覆盖着一层黏滑的绿色物质。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan is-saff aħdar żlieqi ħafna. David: Iva, ħassejtu jeħel ma' subgħajja meta missejtu.
colloquial.en: Elena: This green layer is very slimy. David: Yes, I felt it sticking to my fingers when I touched it.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这层绿色的东西很黏滑。戴维：是的，我摸它时，感觉它黏在手指上。

messages.speaker: Elena (自然观察小组成员)
messages.zh: 这层绿色的东西很黏滑。
messages.en: This green layer is very slimy.

messages.speaker: David (自然观察小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħassejtu jeħel ma' subgħajja meta missejtu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħassejtu jeħel ma' subgħajja meta missejtu.
messages.zh: 是的，我摸它时，感觉它黏在手指上。
messages.en: Yes, I felt it sticking to my fingers when I touched it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手感记 żlieqi：摸起来黏滑，或像半融雪那样湿软；它是描述质地的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crust or hardened surface layer; also a cataract affecting the eye.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体表面形成的一层硬皮或结壳；也指眼睛的白内障。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoxra jew saff iebes fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa; ukoll katarretta fl-għajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硬皮；结壳，指表面形成的较硬一层。
眼睛的白内障。

formal.mt: Wara li nixef it-tajn, iffurmat żlieġa iebsa fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: After the mud dried, a hard crust formed on its surface.
formal.zh: 泥干燥后，表面形成了一层硬壳。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex it-tajn hawn fuq hu iebes? Ġanni: Għax nixef u għamel żlieġa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the mud hard on top? Ġanni: Because it dried and formed a crust.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么泥的表面是硬的？詹尼：因为它干了，结了一层壳。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tajn hawn fuq hu iebes?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tajn hawn fuq hu iebes?
messages.zh: 为什么泥的表面是硬的？
messages.en: Why is the mud hard on top?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (园丁)
messages.zh: 因为它干了，结了一层壳。
messages.en: Because it dried and formed a crust.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“泥面干后结硬壳”记 żlieġa 的结壳义，再把“白内障”作为独立眼科义项记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slipping, or the property of a surface that makes it easy for someone or something to slip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生滑动或打滑的动作；也指表面容易使人或物打滑的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tiżloq, jew il-karatteristika ta' wiċċ li fuqu wieħed jista' jiżloq faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑动；打滑，指失去稳固接触而滑移的动作。
滑溜、容易使人或物打滑的性质；湿滑性。

formal.mt: L-avviż iwissi li l-ilma fuq il-madum iżid ir-riskju ta' żliq.
formal.en: The notice warns that water on the tiles increases the risk of slipping.
formal.zh: 告示提醒，瓷砖上的积水会增加打滑的风险。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod? Samwel: Hemm riskju ta' żliq; l-art għadha mxarrba.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you walking slowly? Samwel: There's a risk of slipping; the floor is still wet.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么走得这么慢？萨姆韦尔：有打滑的风险，地板还湿着。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking slowly?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm riskju ta' żliq; l-art għadha mxarrba.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm riskju ta' żliq; l-art għadha mxarrba.
messages.zh: 有打滑的风险，地板还湿着。
messages.en: There's a risk of slipping; the floor is still wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象湿地板上脚底一滑来记 żliq：既可指“打滑”这个动作，也可指表面“容易打滑”的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dimming, making something less clear, or tarnishing a surface so that it loses its shine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光线变暗、使事物不清楚，或表面失去光泽的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih id-dawl jonqos, xi ħaġa ssir inqas ċara, jew wiċċ jitlef it-tleqqija tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变暗；使光亮减弱。
使模糊；使内容或意思变得难以理解。
使失去光泽；表面变得暗淡。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ż-żliġ tal-fidda bħala bidla fid-dehra tal-wiċċ, li jsir inqas ileqq.
formal.en: The report describes the tarnishing of silver as a change in the appearance of the surface, which becomes less shiny.
formal.zh: 报告将银失去光泽描述为其表面外观的变化，即表面变得不那么明亮。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ifisser iż-żliġ tal-fidda? Karl: Ifisser li l-fidda titlef it-tleqqija tagħha.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does the tarnishing of silver mean? Karl: It means that the silver loses its shine.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：银失去光泽是什么意思？卡尔：就是银不再像原来那么亮了。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 银失去光泽是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the tarnishing of silver mean?

messages.speaker: Karl (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-fidda titlef it-tleqqija tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-fidda titlef it-tleqqija tagħha.
messages.zh: 就是银不再像原来那么亮了。
messages.en: It means that the silver loses its shine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格画面记 żliġ：灯光暗下来、意思模糊起来、银器失去光泽；共同记住“清亮程度下降”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To free someone by removing the shackles that restrain them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 解开束缚某人的镣铐，使其恢复行动自由。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-qajd minn fuq xi ħadd biex ikun jista' jiċċaqlaq liberament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解开镣铐；使摆脱锁链束缚

formal.mt: Il-gwardjan żmalja lill-priġunier qabel ma dan daħal fil-kamra tal-eżami mediku.
formal.en: The guard unshackled the prisoner before he entered the medical examination room.
formal.zh: 看守在囚犯进入体检室之前解开了他的镣铐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-priġunier jista' jimxi liberament issa? Mark: Għax il-gwardjan żmalja lill-priġunier ftit ilu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can the prisoner walk freely now? Mark: Because the guard unshackled him a little while ago.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个囚犯现在为什么能自由走动了？马克：因为看守刚才解开了他的镣铐。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-priġunier jista' jimxi liberament issa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-priġunier jista' jimxi liberament issa?
messages.zh: 那个囚犯现在为什么能自由走动了？
messages.en: Why can the prisoner walk freely now?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-gwardjan żmalja lill-priġunier ftit ilu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-gwardjan żmalja lill-priġunier ftit ilu.
messages.zh: 因为看守刚才解开了他的镣铐。
messages.en: Because the guard unshackled him a little while ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmalja 配上一幅镣铐打开、双手恢复自由的画面，重点记住解除束缚这个动作。

gloss_zh: 给……上珐琅；施加搪瓷涂层

teaching_sense.en_definition: To coat an object or surface with enamel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体或表面上施加珐琅或搪瓷涂层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesa oġġett jew wiċċ b'saff ta' enamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给物体上珐琅；在表面施加搪瓷涂层

collocations.zh: 给金属表面施加搪瓷涂层

formal.mt: L-artiġjan żmalta l-wiċċ tal-metall b'saff uniformi ta' enamel blu.
formal.en: The craftsperson enamelled the metal surface with an even layer of blue enamel.
formal.zh: 工匠在金属表面均匀地施加了一层蓝色珐琅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sar daqshekk ileqq dan il-ġojjell? Pawlu: L-artiġjan żmalta l-wiċċ tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did this piece of jewellery become so shiny? Pawlu: The craftsperson enamelled its surface.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这件首饰怎么变得这么有光泽？保罗：工匠给它的表面上了珐琅。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sar daqshekk ileqq dan il-ġojjell?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sar daqshekk ileqq dan il-ġojjell?
messages.zh: 这件首饰怎么变得这么有光泽？
messages.en: How did this piece of jewellery become so shiny?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 工匠给它的表面上了珐琅。
messages.en: The craftsperson enamelled its surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 żmalta 时想象工匠为金属披上一层光亮珐琅，把词义和施加涂层的动作连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove or reduce the magnetism of an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消除或减弱物体的磁性，使其退磁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa jew naqqas il-manjetiżmu ta' oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使消磁；消除或减弱物体的磁性

formal.mt: It-tekniku żmanjetizza l-għodda tal-azzar qabel ma użaha ħdejn il-komponenti sensittivi.
formal.en: The technician demagnetized the steel tool before using it near the sensitive components.
formal.zh: 技术员先给钢制工具消磁，然后才在敏感元件附近使用它。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan it-tornavit m'għadux jiġbed il-viti? David: It-tekniku żmanjetizza t-tornavit dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why doesn't this screwdriver attract screws anymore? David: The technician demagnetized it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这把螺丝刀怎么不再吸螺丝了？戴维：技术员今天早上给它消了磁。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tornavit m'għadux jiġbed il-viti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tornavit m'għadux jiġbed il-viti?
messages.zh: 这把螺丝刀怎么不再吸螺丝了？
messages.en: Why doesn't this screwdriver attract screws anymore?

messages.speaker: David (维修师傅)
messages.zh: 技术员今天早上给它消了磁。
messages.en: The technician demagnetized it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 żmanjetizza 联想螺丝刀消磁后吸不住螺丝的画面，记住这是实施消磁的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of removing or reducing the magnetism of an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消除或减弱物体磁性的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitneħħa jew jitnaqqas il-manjetiżmu ta' oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退磁；消磁；磁性被消除或减弱的过程

formal.mt: Wara ż-żmanjetizzazzjoni, it-tekniku kejjel il-manjetiżmu li kien għad fadal fl-għodda.
formal.en: After demagnetization, the technician measured the magnetism remaining in the tool.
formal.zh: 消磁之后，技术员测量了工具中残留的磁性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi ż-żmanjetizzazzjoni? Mark: Hija proċess li jneħħi jew inaqqas il-manjetiżmu ta' oġġett.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is demagnetization? Mark: It is a process that removes or reduces an object's magnetism.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是消磁？马克：就是消除或减弱物体磁性的过程。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是消磁？
messages.en: What is demagnetization?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija proċess li jneħħi jew inaqqas il-manjetiżmu ta' oġġett.
messages.mt_standard: Hija proċess li jneħħi jew inaqqas il-manjetiżmu ta' oġġett.
messages.zh: 就是消除或减弱物体磁性的过程。
messages.en: It is a process that removes or reduces an object's magnetism.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmanjetizzazzjoni 写在消磁工序的标签上，与表示动作的 żmanjetizza 对照记忆：这里命名的是过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin malfunctioning or cease operating as it should.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指机器、设备等开始运转失常，不能正常工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beda jaħdem ħażin jew ma baqax jaħdem kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不再正常运转；发生故障

formal.mt: Il-mutur żmanġa waqt it-test, u t-tekniku waqqaf il-magna biex jeżaminah.
formal.en: The motor began malfunctioning during the test, and the technician stopped the machine to examine it.
formal.zh: 测试期间电动机开始运转失常，技术员停下机器进行检查。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex l-arloġġ qed juri l-ħin ħażin? Toni: Żmanġa lbieraħ; irridu nieħduh għat-tiswija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is the clock showing the wrong time? Toni: It started malfunctioning yesterday; we need to take it for repair.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：时钟为什么显示的时间不对？托尼：昨天就出毛病了，我们得把它送去修。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-arloġġ qed juri l-ħin ħażin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-arloġġ qed juri l-ħin ħażin?
messages.zh: 时钟为什么显示的时间不对？
messages.en: Why is the clock showing the wrong time?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 昨天就出毛病了，我们得把它送去修。
messages.en: It started malfunctioning yesterday; we need to take it for repair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmanġa 想成时钟突然走不准的提示词，记住它表示工作失常，未必已经完全停机。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut or shape material roughly, before any fine finishing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过粗凿或粗劈使材料初步成形，尚未进行精细加工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qata' jew ta forma mhux fina lil materjal, qabel l-irfinar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗凿；粗劈；对材料进行初步砍削成形

formal.mt: Il-bennej żmarra l-blokka tal-ġebel biex jagħtiha l-forma meħtieġa qabel l-irfinar.
formal.en: The builder rough-hewed the block of stone to give it the required shape before finishing it.
formal.zh: 建筑工人先粗凿石块，使其初步达到所需形状，然后再进行精加工。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-ġebla lesta biex titqiegħed fil-ħajt? Toni: Għadha le. Il-bennej żmarra l-ġebla biss; għad trid tiġi rfinata.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this stone ready to go into the wall? Toni: Not yet. The builder has only rough-hewed it; it still needs finishing.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这块石头可以砌进墙里了吗？托尼：还不行。工人只是粗凿了一下，还需要精加工。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-ġebla lesta biex titqiegħed fil-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-ġebla lesta biex titqiegħed fil-ħajt?
messages.zh: 这块石头可以砌进墙里了吗？
messages.en: Is this stone ready to go into the wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (石匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadha le. Il-bennej żmarra l-ġebla biss; għad trid tiġi rfinata.
messages.mt_standard: Għadha le. Il-bennej żmarra l-ġebla biss; għad trid tiġi rfinata.
messages.zh: 还不行。工人只是粗凿了一下，还需要精加工。
messages.en: Not yet. The builder has only rough-hewed it; it still needs finishing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmarra 对应到石块上粗大的凿痕：先凿出大致形状，细磨留到后面，就能记住粗加工的意思。

gloss_zh: 虚张声势地叫嚷；气势汹汹地说话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak loudly and aggressively in an attempt to sound powerful or intimidating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大声而咄咄逼人地说话，试图显得强势或吓住别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkellem b'leħen għoli u b'arroganza biex jidher b'saħħtu jew ibeżża' lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚张声势地大声叫嚷；气势汹汹地说话

collocations.zh: 在会议上虚张声势地叫嚷
当着众人的面气势汹汹地叫嚷

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant żmarġassa waqt il-laqgħa, iżda ma ppreżenta ebda argument ċar.
formal.en: The representative blustered during the meeting but presented no clear argument.
formal.zh: 那位代表在会上气势汹汹地叫嚷，却没有提出任何清晰的论点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex kien qed jgħajjat daqshekk? Pawlu: Żmarġassa biex ibeżżagħna, imma ħadd ma beża'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why was he shouting so much? Pawlu: He blustered to scare us, but nobody was frightened.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他为什么喊得那么凶？保罗：他虚张声势，想吓唬我们，可谁也没怕。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 他为什么喊得那么凶？
messages.en: Why was he shouting so much?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Żmarġassa biex ibeżżagħna, imma ħadd ma beża'.
messages.mt_standard: Żmarġassa biex ibeżżagħna, imma ħadd ma beża'.
messages.zh: 他虚张声势，想吓唬我们，可谁也没怕。
messages.en: He blustered to scare us, but nobody was frightened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到 żmarġassa，就想象有人拍桌高喊、拼命摆出强硬架势，把声音很大和虚张声势一起记住。

gloss_zh: 变得凌乱；使船失去桅杆

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become untidy; in a separate nautical sense, to remove or bring down a vessel's mast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得凌乱、不整齐；另有航海义，指卸去或弄倒船的桅杆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar diżordinat; f'tifsira oħra marbuta mal-baħar, neħħa jew waqqa' l-arblu ta' bastiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得凌乱；变得不整齐
卸去或弄倒船的桅杆；使船失去桅杆

formal.mt: Ir-riħ qawwi żmatta d-dgħajsa, u l-ekwipaġġ talab l-għajnuna biex jirritorna lejn il-port.
formal.en: The strong wind dismasted the boat, and the crew requested assistance to return to port.
formal.zh: 强风刮倒了小船的桅杆，船员请求援助以返回港口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara hawn wara l-festa? David: Il-post żmatta; hemm karti u tazzi kullimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened here after the party? David: The place became untidy; there are papers and cups everywhere.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：聚会后这里怎么了？戴维：变得乱糟糟的，到处都是纸和杯子。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 聚会后这里怎么了？
messages.en: What happened here after the party?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-post żmatta; hemm karti u tazzi kullimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Il-post żmatta; hemm karti u tazzi kullimkien.
messages.zh: 变得乱糟糟的，到处都是纸和杯子。
messages.en: The place became untidy; there are papers and cups everywhere.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 żmatta 分别画两张记忆卡：一张是聚会后凌乱的房间，一张是失去桅杆的船；用场景区分两个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate a body into parts by cutting off or detaching its limbs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将身体的肢体切断或分离，使身体分成若干部分；也可用于人体模型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' jew jifred ir-riġlejn u d-dirgħajn minn ġisem, jew minn mudell ta' ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肢解；将肢体从身体上切断或分离

collocations.zh: 拆下了解剖模型的肢体

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tal-anatomija, l-għalliem żmembra l-mudell biex juri kif il-partijiet tal-ġisem jingħaqdu flimkien.
formal.en: During the anatomy lesson, the teacher dismembered the model to show how the parts of the body fit together.
formal.zh: 解剖课上，老师拆下模型的肢体，展示身体各部分如何连接。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min żmembra l-mudell? Mark: L-għalliem, biex jurina l-partijiet waħda waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who dismembered the model? Mark: The teacher, to show us the parts one by one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把模型的肢体拆下来了？马克：老师，为了把各个部分逐一展示给我们看。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 谁把模型的肢体拆下来了？
messages.en: Who dismembered the model?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem, biex jurina l-partijiet waħda waħda.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem, biex jurina l-partijiet waħda waħda.
messages.zh: 老师，为了把各个部分逐一展示给我们看。
messages.en: The teacher, to show us the parts one by one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象解剖模型的手臂和腿被逐一拆下，用这个画面记住 żmembra 的“肢解、分离肢体”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To polish or grind glass to make its surface or edges smoother.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过研磨或抛光加工玻璃，使其表面或边缘更加平滑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Illixxa jew ippolixxa l-ħġieġ billi ħakk il-wiċċ jew it-truf tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨光；研磨或抛光玻璃

collocations.en: ground the edges of the glass

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żmerilja t-truf tal-ħġieġ qabel ma waħħlu fil-qafas.
formal.en: The worker ground the edges of the glass before fitting it into the frame.
formal.zh: 工人在将玻璃装进框架前，先磨平了玻璃边缘。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sar daqshekk lixx it-tarf tal-ħġieġ? Toni: Il-ħaddiem żmerilja t-tarf qabel ġabu hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the edge of the glass become so smooth? Toni: The worker ground the edge before bringing it here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：玻璃边缘怎么变得这么光滑了？托尼：工人把边缘磨平后才拿到这里来。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sar daqshekk lixx it-tarf tal-ħġieġ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sar daqshekk lixx it-tarf tal-ħġieġ?
messages.zh: 玻璃边缘怎么变得这么光滑了？
messages.en: How did the edge of the glass become so smooth?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħaddiem żmerilja t-tarf qabel ġabu hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħaddiem żmerilja t-tarf qabel ġabu hawn.
messages.zh: 工人把边缘磨平后才拿到这里来。
messages.en: The worker ground the edge before bringing it here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 żmerilja 时想象玻璃的粗糙边缘逐渐被磨平，把“玻璃、研磨、光滑”三个提示串成一个画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sell goods off, especially to clear remaining stock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将货物出售掉，尤其指为了清理剩余库存而出售。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biegħ il-merkanzija, speċjalment biex ineħħi l-istokk li kien fadal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出售掉；清售货物或存货

collocations.en: sold off the goods at a reduced price

formal.mt: Qabel għalaq il-ħanut, is-sid żmerċa l-istokk li kien fadal bi prezzijiet imnaqqsa.
formal.en: Before closing the shop, the owner sold off the remaining stock at reduced prices.
formal.zh: 关店前，店主降价清售了剩余库存。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad fadal xi kutri fil-ħanut? Pawlu: Le, is-sid żmerċa kollox ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are there any blankets left in the shop? Pawlu: No, the owner sold everything off yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：店里还剩毯子吗？保罗：没有了，店主昨天把所有货都清售了。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 店里还剩毯子吗？
messages.en: Are there any blankets left in the shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 没有了，店主昨天把所有货都清售了。
messages.en: No, the owner sold everything off yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmerċa 和店铺清空货架的画面连在一起：货物一批批卖掉，最后库存清完，便能记住“清售”。

gloss_zh: 很久很久以前；遥远的过去

teaching_sense.en_definition: A time in the very distant past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 距离现在非常久远的过去时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żmien imbiegħed ħafna fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遥远的过去；很久很久以前的时期

collocations.zh: 来自遥远的过去；从很久以前起

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jibda fi żmien żemżem, f'raħal żgħir imdawwar bl-għelieqi.
formal.en: The story begins in the far past, in a small village surrounded by fields.
formal.zh: 故事始于很久很久以前，地点是一个被田野环绕的小村庄。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-senduq kemm hu qadim? Nannu: Ilu għand il-familja minn żmien żemżem!
colloquial.en: Maja: How old is this chest? Grandpa: It has been in the family since the distant past!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个箱子有多老了？爷爷：咱们家很久很久以前就有它了！

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 这个箱子有多老了？
messages.en: How old is this chest?

messages.speaker: Nannu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilu għand il-familja minn żmien żemżem!
messages.mt_standard: Ilu għand il-familja minn żmien żemżem!
messages.zh: 咱们家很久很久以前就有它了！
messages.en: It has been in the family since the distant past!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmien żemżem 整体配上童话开头“很久很久以前”，再想象一个传了许多代的旧箱子，帮助记住遥远的时间感。

gloss_zh: 使非军事化；解除军事设施或部署

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove military forces, weapons, or installations from an area so that it becomes demilitarized.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 撤除某地区的军队、武器或军事设施，使该地区非军事化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-forzi, l-armi jew il-faċilitajiet militari minn żona biex ma tibqax tintuża għal skopijiet militari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使非军事化；撤除军队、武器或军事设施

formal.mt: Skont il-ftehim, il-gvern żmilitalizza ż-żona tal-fruntiera u neħħa l-faċilitajiet militari minnha.
formal.en: Under the agreement, the government demilitarized the border area and removed its military installations.
formal.zh: 根据协议，政府使边境地区非军事化，并撤除了当地的军事设施。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad hemm suldati fuq il-gżira? Mark: Le, il-gvern żmilitalizza l-gżira wara l-ftehim.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are there still soldiers on the island? Mark: No, the government demilitarized the island after the agreement.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：岛上还有士兵吗？马克：没有了，达成协议后政府使该岛非军事化了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 岛上还有士兵吗？
messages.en: Are there still soldiers on the island?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-gvern żmilitalizza l-gżira wara l-ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-gvern żmilitalizza l-gżira wara l-ftehim.
messages.zh: 没有了，达成协议后政府使该岛非军事化了。
messages.en: No, the government demilitarized the island after the agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用地图记 żmilitalizza：某片地区的军队撤走，军事设施也移除。把注意力放在“地区变为非军事区”这个结果上。

gloss_zh: 排除爆炸危险；掐除；去掉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an explosive device safe; also, to nip off or remove a small part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使爆炸装置失去爆炸危险；也指掐掉或去除一个小部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-periklu ta' splużjoni minn bomba; ukoll, qata' jew neħħa parti żgħira minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排除爆炸危险；使爆炸装置失效
掐掉；剪除或去掉一个部分

collocations.zh: 排除了炸弹的爆炸危险

collocations.en: nipped off the tip of the shoot

formal.mt: L-ispeċjalista żmiċċa l-bomba, u wara l-awtoritajiet fetħu t-triq mill-ġdid.
formal.en: The specialist defused the bomb, and the authorities then reopened the road.
formal.zh: 专家排除了炸弹的爆炸危险，随后当局重新开放了道路。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex din ir-rimja m'għadhiex bil-ponta? Ġanni: Il-ġardinar żmiċċa l-ponta dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does this shoot no longer have its tip? Ġanni: The gardener nipped the tip off this morning.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这根嫩枝的尖端怎么没了？詹尼：园丁今天早上把尖端掐掉了。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 这根嫩枝的尖端怎么没了？
messages.en: Why does this shoot no longer have its tip?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.zh: 园丁今天早上把尖端掐掉了。
messages.en: The gardener nipped the tip off this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żmiċċa 配两张词义卡：一张是专家排除炸弹危险，另一张是掐掉嫩枝尖端。分别记住两个用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release soldiers or military units from mobilized service so that they can return to civilian life or peacetime status.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 解除士兵或军事单位的动员状态，使其复员、回归平民生活或恢复和平时期状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħeles lis-suldati jew lill-unitajiet militari mis-servizz ta' mobilitazzjoni biex jerġgħu għall-ħajja ċivili jew għas-servizz ta' żmien il-paċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使军人复员；解除部队的动员状态

collocations.zh: 解除了预备役人员的动员

formal.mt: Wara t-tmiem tal-kunflitt, il-gvern żmobilita lir-riżervisti, li mbagħad reġgħu lura għax-xogħol ċivili tagħhom.
formal.en: After the conflict ended, the government demobilized the reservists, who then returned to their civilian jobs.
formal.zh: 冲突结束后，政府解除了预备役人员的动员，他们随后返回原来的平民工作岗位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk reġa' beda jaħdem fil-ħanut? Pawlu: Iva, il-gvern żmobilita lir-riżervisti x-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has your brother started working in the shop again? Pawlu: Yes, the government demobilized the reservists last month.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你哥哥又开始在店里工作了吗？保罗：是的，政府上个月解除了预备役人员的动员。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥又开始在店里工作了吗？
messages.en: Has your brother started working in the shop again?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-gvern żmobilita lir-riżervisti x-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-gvern żmobilita lir-riżervisti x-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: 是的，政府上个月解除了预备役人员的动员。
messages.en: Yes, the government demobilized the reservists last month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收到复员通知的士兵收拾行李、回家上班，用这个人物行动记 żmobilita：解除动员，恢复日常生活。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To finish a work shift, or to get down from a horse or another mount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结束一班工作、下班；也可指从马等坐骑上下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ttemm ix-xift tax-xogħol, jew li tinżel minn fuq żiemel jew annimal ieħor li tkun qed tirkeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结束当班工作；下班。
从坐骑上下来；下马。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żmonta mix-xogħol fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija wara xift twil.
formal.en: The worker finished his shift at six in the evening after a long shift.
formal.zh: 这名工人上了很长一班，于傍晚六点下班。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Diġà żmontajt mix-xogħol? Mark: Iva, għadni kif żmontajt. Niltaqgħu għal kafè?
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished your shift already? Mark: Yes, I've just finished. Shall we meet for coffee?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你已经下班了吗？Mark：是啊，刚下班。我们见面喝杯咖啡吧？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你已经下班了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished your shift already?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kif żmontajt. Niltaqgħu għal kafè?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kif żmontajt. Niltaqgħu għal kafè?
messages.zh: 是啊，刚下班。我们见面喝杯咖啡吧？
messages.en: Yes, I've just finished. Shall we meet for coffee?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“工人下班”和“骑手下马”画成两格图：一个离开岗位，一个离开坐骑，用两个具体场景区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prune a plant very heavily by cutting away a large amount of its growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对植物进行大幅度修剪，剪去大量枝条或生长部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żabar pjanta b'mod qawwi billi qata' ħafna mill-friegħi jew mit-tkabbir tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大幅修剪植物；重剪，剪去大量枝条

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar żmonġa s-siġra u neħħa parti kbira mill-friegħi tagħha.
formal.en: The gardener pruned the tree drastically and removed a large proportion of its branches.
formal.zh: 园丁对这棵树进行了重剪，剪去了很大一部分枝条。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex l-arbuxxell jidher daqshekk żgħir illum? Toni: Il-ġardinar żmonġa l-arbuxxell dalgħodu; qata' ħafna friegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the shrub look so small today? Toni: The gardener pruned the shrub drastically this morning; he cut off lots of branches.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这丛灌木今天怎么看着这么小？托尼：园丁今天早上给它做了重剪，剪掉了很多枝条。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-arbuxxell jidher daqshekk żgħir illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-arbuxxell jidher daqshekk żgħir illum?
messages.zh: 这丛灌木今天怎么看着这么小？
messages.en: Why does the shrub look so small today?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġardinar żmonġa l-arbuxxell dalgħodu; qata' ħafna friegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġardinar żmonġa l-arbuxxell dalgħodu; qata' ħafna friegħi.
messages.zh: 园丁今天早上给它做了重剪，剪掉了很多枝条。
messages.en: The gardener pruned the shrub drastically this morning; he cut off lots of branches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmonġa 配上修剪前后对比图：原来枝叶茂密，后来大量枝条被剪去。用明显的外形变化记住“重剪”的力度。

gloss_zh: 使失去原有性质；改变本来面貌

teaching_sense.en_definition: To alter something so that it loses its natural or original character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改变某物，使其失去天然性质或原有的特征与面貌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tbiddel xi ħaġa b'mod li titlef in-natura jew il-karattru oriġinali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使失去天然性质或原有特征；使变质、失真。

formal.mt: L-adattament żnatura l-karattru oriġinali tar-rumanz billi neħħa l-kunflitt ewlieni.
formal.en: The adaptation distorted the novel's original character by removing its central conflict.
formal.zh: 这一改编删去了核心冲突，使小说失去了原有的面貌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ġiet iz-zalza? Pawlu: Iz-zokkor żnatura t-togħma tagħha. Id-darba li jmiss inżid inqas.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the sauce turn out? Pawlu: The sugar distorted its flavour. Next time I'll add less.
colloquial.zh: Lara：酱汁做得怎么样？Pawlu：糖把它原来的味道都改了。下次我少放一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 酱汁做得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the sauce turn out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-zokkor żnatura t-togħma tagħha. Id-darba li jmiss inżid inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Iz-zokkor żnatura t-togħma tagħha. Id-darba li jmiss inżid inqas.
messages.zh: 糖把它原来的味道都改了。下次我少放一点。
messages.en: The sugar distorted its flavour. Next time I'll add less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一碗酱汁加糖过多，原味消失：用“改变之后失去本来特征”这个画面记住动词。

gloss_zh: 使非国有化；将国有资产转为私有

teaching_sense.en_definition: To transfer a state-owned business or asset out of state ownership into private ownership.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将国有企业或资产从国家所有转为私人所有，使其非国有化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tittrasferixxi impriża jew assi minn proprjetà tal-istat għal proprjetà privata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使非国有化；把国有企业或资产转为私人所有。

collocations.zh: 将一家银行转为私人所有

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-ktieb, il-gvern żnazzjonalizza l-kumpanija billi biegħ l-ishma kollha tiegħu lil investituri privati.
formal.en: In the textbook example, the government denationalized the company by selling all its shares to private investors.
formal.zh: 在课本的例子中，政府将所持股份全部出售给私人投资者，从而使该公司非国有化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-gvern fl-eżempju tal-lezzjoni? Mark: Żnazzjonalizza l-bank. Biegħ l-ishma tiegħu lil investituri privati.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the government do in the lesson's example? Mark: It denationalized the bank. It sold its shares to private investors.
colloquial.zh: Maja：课堂例子里的政府做了什么？Mark：它把银行非国有化了，把所持股份卖给了私人投资者。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 课堂例子里的政府做了什么？
messages.en: What did the government do in the lesson's example?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żnazzjonalizza l-bank. Biegħ l-ishma tiegħu lil investituri privati.
messages.mt_standard: Żnazzjonalizza l-bank. Biegħ l-ishma tiegħu lil investituri privati.
messages.zh: 它把银行非国有化了，把所持股份卖给了私人投资者。
messages.en: It denationalized the bank. It sold its shares to private investors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一根从“国家所有”指向“私人所有”的箭头，再在箭头上写这个动词，记住它表示转变所有权的动作。

gloss_zh: 非国有化；国有资产私有化

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or act of transferring a state-owned business or asset into private ownership.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把国有企业或资产转为私人所有的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-att li bih impriża jew assi jgħaddu minn proprjetà tal-istat għal proprjetà privata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非国有化；将国有企业或资产转为私人所有的过程。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi ż-żnazzjonalizzazzjoni bħala proċess li jittrasferixxi l-proprjetà ta' impriża mill-istat għal sidien privati.
formal.en: The chapter describes denationalization as a process that transfers ownership of a business from the state to private owners.
formal.zh: 这一章将非国有化描述为把企业所有权从国家转移给私人所有者的过程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi ż-żnazzjonalizzazzjoni? Toni: Hija meta impriża tal-istat tgħaddi għal proprjetà privata.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is denationalization? Toni: It is when a state-owned business passes into private ownership.
colloquial.zh: Sara：什么是非国有化？Toni：就是国有企业转为私人所有。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是非国有化？
messages.en: What is denationalization?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija meta impriża tal-istat tgħaddi għal proprjetà privata.
messages.mt_standard: Hija meta impriża tal-istat tgħaddi għal proprjetà privata.
messages.zh: 就是国有企业转为私人所有。
messages.en: It is when a state-owned business passes into private ownership.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“国家所有变成私人所有”的整段过程圈起来：动词描述执行动作，这个名词给整个过程命名。

gloss_zh: 小型编篮；żenbil 的指小形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small broom basket, expressed by the diminutive form of 'żenbil'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种小型枝草编篮；这个词是 żenbil 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żenbil żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'żenbil'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small broom basket (the diminutive form of 'żenbil')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种小型枝草编篮，是 żenbil 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small broom basket full of almonds
to carry a small broom basket

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda kien hemm żnejbel mimli lewż, ħdejn qoffa akbar tal-frott.
formal.en: On the table there was a small broom basket full of almonds, beside a larger fruit basket.
formal.zh: 桌上有一个装满杏仁的小编篮，旁边放着一个较大的水果篮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inpoġġi l-lewż? Rita: Poġġih f'dan iż-żnejbel; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall I put the almonds? Rita: Put them in this little basket; there's enough room.
colloquial.zh: Nina：杏仁放在哪里？Rita：放进这个小编篮里吧，里面有足够的空间。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 杏仁放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the almonds?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġih f'dan iż-żnejbel; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġih f'dan iż-żnejbel; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
messages.zh: 放进这个小编篮里吧，里面有足够的空间。
messages.en: Put them in this little basket; there's enough room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排画一个大编篮和一个装杏仁的小编篮，把 żnejbel 标在小篮旁，联系已给出的 żenbil 指小关系记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small fragments or chips of flint or steel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燧石或钢形成的细小碎片、碎屑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċiet żgħar jew frak taż-żnied jew tal-azzar.

sense_translations.en_definition: small fragments of flint or steel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 燧石或钢的小碎片、碎屑。

formal.mt: Fil-kaxxa nstabu żnejjed taż-żnied, li tqiegħdu f'kontenitur separat għall-eżami.
formal.en: Small fragments of flint were found in the box and placed in a separate container for examination.
formal.zh: 箱中发现了燧石小碎片，随后被放入单独的容器中以供检查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhuma dawn il-biċċiet żgħar? Mark: Dawn huma żnejjed tal-azzar. Ejjew niġbruhom bil-pinzell.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are these little pieces? Mark: They are small fragments of steel. Let's collect them with the brush.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些小碎片是什么？Mark：是钢的小碎片。我们用刷子把它们收起来吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (工作坊学员)
messages.zh: 这些小碎片是什么？
messages.en: What are these little pieces?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作坊老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn huma żnejjed tal-azzar. Ejjew niġbruhom bil-pinzell.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn huma żnejjed tal-azzar. Ejjew niġbruhom bil-pinzell.
messages.zh: 是钢的小碎片。我们用刷子把它们收起来吧。
messages.en: They are small fragments of steel. Let's collect them with the brush.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个小盒，一个装燧石碎片，一个装钢碎片；两个盒上都贴 żnejjed，记住材料与细碎形态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small path; the diminutive form of 'żenqa'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一条小径或小路；这个词是 żenqa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mogħdija żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'żenqa'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small path (the diminutive form of 'żenqa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小径、小路，是 żenqa 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small path between the fields

formal.mt: Żnejqa dejqa tgħaddi bejn l-għelieqi u twassal sal-bieb tal-ġnien.
formal.en: A narrow little path runs between the fields and leads to the garden gate.
formal.zh: 一条狭窄的小径穿过田地之间，通往花园的大门。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din iż-żnejqa twassal sal-baħar? Toni: Iva, imxi minn hawn u tasal fi ftit minuti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this little path lead to the sea? Toni: Yes, follow it and you'll get there in a few minutes.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这条小路通往海边吗？Toni：是的，沿这里走，几分钟就到了。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 这条小路通往海边吗？
messages.en: Does this little path lead to the sea?

messages.speaker: Toni (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imxi minn hawn u tasal fi ftit minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imxi minn hawn u tasal fi ftit minuti.
messages.zh: 是的，沿这里走，几分钟就到了。
messages.en: Yes, follow it and you'll get there in a few minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象田地间一条细细的小路，把 żnejqa 写在路旁；再联系已给出的 żenqa 指小关系，突出“小径”的尺度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drain someone of energy or strength, leaving them weak or exhausted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消耗某人的精力或体力，使其虚弱、疲惫不堪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tnaqqas is-saħħa jew l-enerġija ta' xi ħadd u tħallih dgħajjef jew għajjien ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使衰弱；使精力或体力耗尽。

formal.mt: Is-sħana qawwija żnervat lill-ħaddiema, li kellhom bżonn waqfa twila biex jistrieħu.
formal.en: The intense heat sapped the workers' energy, and they needed a long break to rest.
formal.zh: 酷热使工人们精疲力竭，他们需要长时间休息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex int daqshekk għajjien? Pawlu: Dan il-vjaġġ żnervani. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you so tired? Pawlu: This journey has drained me. I need to rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么这么累？Pawlu：这趟旅程把我的精力都耗尽了。我得休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么累？
messages.en: Why are you so tired?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (刚到达的旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-vjaġġ żnervani. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-vjaġġ żnervani. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 这趟旅程把我的精力都耗尽了。我得休息一会儿。
messages.en: This journey has drained me. I need to rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人的精力想成电池：酷热或长途旅行让电量不断下降，最后只想休息，用这个画面记住“使精疲力竭”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of physical weakness or lack of energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体虚弱、缺乏力气或精力的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' dgħufija fil-ġisem jew nuqqas ta' enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体力衰弱；虚弱无力。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-vjaġġatur ħass żnervatezza kbira wara l-mixja twila.
formal.en: In the narrative, the traveller felt great weakness after the long walk.
formal.zh: 在这篇叙事中，旅人在长途步行后感到十分乏力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed tħossok wara l-mixja? Pawlu: Għandi sens ta' żnervatezza; se noqgħod bilqiegħda ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you feeling after the walk? Pawlu: I feel weak; I'm going to sit down for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：走完这段路，你感觉怎么样？保罗：我觉得浑身没力气，打算坐一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 走完这段路，你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling after the walk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi sens ta' żnervatezza; se noqgħod bilqiegħda ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi sens ta' żnervatezza; se noqgħod bilqiegħda ftit.
messages.zh: 我觉得浑身没力气，打算坐一会儿。
messages.en: I feel weak; I'm going to sit down for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żnervatezza 和长途步行后四肢乏力、想坐下休息的画面连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of flint, a hard stone that can be used to make sparks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块燧石，即可用于敲击取火的坚硬石块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ġebla iebsa li tista' tintuża biex jinħolqu xrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块燧石。

collocations.en: the edge of the piece of flint

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni, l-għalliema wriet lill-istudenti żnieda u spjegat kif tista' tintuża biex jinħolqu xrar.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher showed the students a piece of flint and explained how it can be used to make sparks.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师向学生展示了一块燧石，并解释了如何用它敲出火花。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik il-ġebla żgħira? Mark: Dik żnieda. Ara t-tarf tagħha kemm hu jaqta'.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that little stone? Mark: It's a piece of flint. Look how sharp its edge is.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那块小石头是什么？马克：那是一块燧石。你看，它的边缘多锋利。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 那块小石头是什么？
messages.en: What's that little stone?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik żnieda. Ara t-tarf tagħha kemm hu jaqta'.
messages.mt_standard: Dik żnieda. Ara t-tarf tagħha kemm hu jaqta'.
messages.zh: 那是一块燧石。你看，它的边缘多锋利。
messages.en: It's a piece of flint. Look how sharp its edge is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象掌心里的一块燧石，旁边画几颗火花，用这个画面记住 żnieda。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the navel or the umbilical cord.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与肚脐或脐带有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maż-żokra jew mal-kurdun taż-żokra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脐的；与肚脐或脐带有关的。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma fil-ktieb turi l-kurdun żokri li jgħaqqad il-fetu mal-plaċenta.
formal.en: The diagram in the book shows the umbilical cord connecting the fetus to the placenta.
formal.zh: 书中的示意图展示了连接胎儿与胎盘的脐带。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser żokri f'din il-frażi? Sara: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam maż-żokra, bħal fil-frażi kurdun żokri.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does żokri mean in this phrase? Sara: It means relating to the navel, as in the phrase umbilical cord.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个短语里的 żokri 是什么意思？萨拉：意思是与肚脐有关，比如 kurdun żokri，就是脐带。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个短语里的 żokri 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does żokri mean in this phrase?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam maż-żokra, bħal fil-frażi kurdun żokri.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam maż-żokra, bħal fil-frażi kurdun żokri.
messages.zh: 意思是与肚脐有关，比如 kurdun żokri，就是脐带。
messages.en: It means relating to the navel, as in the phrase umbilical cord.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人体示意图的肚脐位置贴上 żokri，再连到脐带图像，记住它表示与脐有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely hard and difficult to break or cut.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常坚硬、难以敲碎或切开的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iebes ħafna u diffiċli biex jitkisser jew jinqata'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常坚硬的。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema sabu blat żonqri u kellhom jużaw tagħmir apposta biex jaqtgħuh.
formal.en: The workers encountered very hard rock and had to use special equipment to cut it.
formal.zh: 工人们遇到了非常坚硬的岩石，必须使用专门设备才能将其切开。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex mhux qed jirnexxilek tkissru? Mark: Dan il-blat żonqri; għandi bżonn għodda oħra.
colloquial.en: Toni: Why can't you break it? Mark: This rock is very hard; I need another tool.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：你怎么敲不开它？马克：这块岩石太硬了，我需要换个工具。

messages.speaker: Toni (工友)
messages.zh: 你怎么敲不开它？
messages.en: Why can't you break it?

messages.speaker: Mark (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-blat żonqri; għandi bżonn għodda oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-blat żonqri; għandi bżonn għodda oħra.
messages.zh: 这块岩石太硬了，我需要换个工具。
messages.en: This rock is very hard; I need another tool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锤子敲下去，岩石纹丝不动，把 żonqri 和非常坚硬的触感一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small belly; a diminutive form of żaqq.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小肚子，是 żaqq（肚子）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żaqq żgħira; forma diminuttiva tal-kelma żaqq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small belly (the diminutive form of 'żaqq')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小肚子；żaqq（肚子）的指小形式。

formal.mt: Fl-illustrazzjoni, it-tarbija tidher bi żqajqa tonda u b'idejha mgħollija.
formal.en: In the illustration, the baby is shown with a round little belly and raised hands.
formal.zh: 插图中的宝宝有个圆圆的小肚子，双手举着。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara ż-żqajqa tonda ta' dan il-pupu! Nina: Iva, u l-flokk bilkemm jgħattihielu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at this doll's round little belly! Nina: Yes, and its shirt barely covers it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看这个娃娃圆圆的小肚子！妮娜：是呀，它的上衣都快盖不住了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara ż-żqajqa tonda ta' dan il-pupu!
messages.mt_standard: Ara ż-żqajqa tonda ta' dan il-pupu!
messages.zh: 看这个娃娃圆圆的小肚子！
messages.en: Look at this doll's round little belly!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 是呀，它的上衣都快盖不住了。
messages.en: Yes, and its shirt barely covers it.
