cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żaqq 的肚子画得小一点，旁边标上 żqajqa，用大小对照记住指小含义。

gloss_zh: 小肚肚（对儿童说话用语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A child's tummy, referred to with a word used when speaking to children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对儿童说话时用来称呼肚子的词，相当于“小肚肚”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma għaż-żaqq li tintuża meta wieħed jitkellem mat-tfal.

sense_translations.en_definition: tummy (this word occurs in child-directed speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小肚肚；对儿童说话时使用的肚子称呼。

formal.mt: Fil-ktieb għat-tfal, l-omm tistaqsi lit-tifla jekk iż-żqajquqa tagħha hix mimlija wara l-ikla.
formal.en: In the children's book, the mother asks the girl whether her tummy is full after the meal.
formal.zh: 在这本儿童读物中，妈妈问小女孩吃完饭后小肚肚是不是已经饱了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Iż-żqajquqa tiegħek mimlija issa? Lea: Iva, ma rridx aktar ikel!
colloquial.en: Marija: Is your tummy full now? Lea: Yes, I don't want any more food!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你的小肚肚现在吃饱了吗？莱娅：饱了，我不想再吃啦！

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 你的小肚肚现在吃饱了吗？
messages.en: Is your tummy full now?

messages.speaker: Lea (女儿)
messages.zh: 饱了，我不想再吃啦！
messages.en: Yes, I don't want any more food!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象家长轻拍孩子的小肚肚问吃饱没有，把 żqajquqa 连同对儿童说话的语气记住。

gloss_zh: 肚子鼓鼓的人（对儿童说话用语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person with a protruding belly, described with a word used when speaking to children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对儿童说话时用来指肚子向前鼓出的人的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna b'żaqq imqabbża 'l barra; kelma li tintuża meta wieħed jitkellem mat-tfal.

sense_translations.en_definition: a person with a protruding belly (this word occurs in child-directed speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 肚子向前鼓出的人；此词用于对儿童说话的语境。

collocations.en: a cheerful person with a protruding belly
collocations.zh: 一个乐呵呵、肚子鼓鼓的人

collocations.en: the person with a protruding belly in the story
collocations.zh: 故事里那个肚子鼓鼓的人

formal.mt: Fl-istorja għat-tfal, żqajququ ferrieħi jilqa' lill-mistednin b'tbissima.
formal.en: In the children's story, a cheerful person with a protruding belly welcomes the guests with a smile.
formal.zh: 在这个儿童故事里，一个乐呵呵、肚子鼓鼓的人微笑着迎接客人。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Min hu dak iż-żqajququ fl-istampa? Anna: Hu l-furnar tal-istorja; ara kemm għandu kappell kbir!
colloquial.en: Luca: Who's that person with the big tummy in the picture? Anna: He's the baker in the story; look how big his hat is!
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：图上那个肚子鼓鼓的人是谁？安娜：他是故事里的面包师，你看他的帽子多大！

messages.speaker: Luca (儿子)
messages.zh: 图上那个肚子鼓鼓的人是谁？
messages.en: Who's that person with the big tummy in the picture?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-furnar tal-istorja; ara kemm għandu kappell kbir!
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-furnar tal-istorja; ara kemm għandu kappell kbir!
messages.zh: 他是故事里的面包师，你看他的帽子多大！
messages.en: He's the baker in the story; look how big his hat is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给童话里肚子鼓鼓的整个人物贴上 żqajququ 标签，记住这个词指人，并用于对儿童说话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tall African animal with a very long neck, long legs, and a spotted coat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种生活在非洲的高大动物，脖子和腿很长，身上有斑纹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal Afrikan għoli b'għonq twil ħafna, saqajn twal u tikek fuq ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长颈鹿。

formal.mt: Iż-żrafa tuża għonqha twil biex tilħaq il-weraq fuq friegħi għoljin.
formal.en: The giraffe uses its long neck to reach leaves on high branches.
formal.zh: 长颈鹿利用长长的脖子够到高处树枝上的叶子。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Ara ż-żrafa ħdejn is-siġra! Emma: Qed tiekol il-weraq; kemm għandha għonqha twil!
colloquial.en: Ben: Look at the giraffe beside the tree! Emma: It's eating the leaves; what a long neck it has!
colloquial.zh: 本：看树旁边那只长颈鹿！艾玛：它正在吃叶子，脖子可真长呀！

messages.speaker: Ben (哥哥)
messages.zh: 看树旁边那只长颈鹿！
messages.en: Look at the giraffe beside the tree!

messages.speaker: Emma (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tiekol il-weraq; kemm għandha għonqha twil!
messages.mt_standard: Qed tiekol il-weraq; kemm għandha għonqha twil!
messages.zh: 它正在吃叶子，脖子可真长呀！
messages.en: It's eating the leaves; what a long neck it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一只伸长脖子吃树叶的长颈鹿，在脖子旁写 żrafa，把词形和鲜明的动物形象连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pair of shoes, especially suitable for a baby or small child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一双小鞋，可用于谈论婴儿或幼儿穿的小鞋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Par żgħir ta' żraben, speċjalment għal tarbija jew tifel żgħir.

sense_translations.en_definition: small pair of shoes (the diminutive form of 'żarbun')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一双小鞋；żarbun 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small pair of shoes for the baby
a small pair of leather shoes

formal.mt: Il-familja xtrat żrajben għat-tarbija qabel il-festa.
formal.en: The family bought a small pair of shoes for the baby before the celebration.
formal.zh: 这家人在庆祝活动前给宝宝买了一双小鞋。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xtrajt żrajben għat-tarbija. Lara: Liema kulur għażilt?
colloquial.en: Maja: I bought a small pair of shoes for the baby. Lara: Which colour did you choose?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我给宝宝买了一双小鞋。拉拉：你选了什么颜色？

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 我给宝宝买了一双小鞋。
messages.en: I bought a small pair of shoes for the baby.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你选了什么颜色？
messages.en: Which colour did you choose?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żrajben 和鞋盒里并排放着的两只宝宝鞋联系起来，重点记住本词表示一双小鞋，再与表示一只小鞋的 żrajbuna 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One small shoe, such as a shoe worn by a baby or young child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只小鞋，例如婴儿或幼儿穿的一只鞋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żarbuna żgħira, bħal dik li tilbes tarbija jew tifla żgħira.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small shoe (the diminutive form of 'żarbuna')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只小鞋；żarbuna 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Instabet żrajbuna ħamra ħdejn id-daħla tal-iskola.
formal.en: A small red shoe was found near the school entrance.
formal.zh: 有人在学校入口附近发现了一只红色小鞋。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hi ż-żrajbuna l-oħra? Pawlu: Hemm taħt is-siġġu, ħdejn il-basket.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the other little shoe? Pawlu: There, under the chair, next to the basket.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：另一只小鞋在哪里？保罗：在那里，椅子下面，篮子旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.zh: 另一只小鞋在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the other little shoe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 在那里，椅子下面，篮子旁边。
messages.en: There, under the chair, next to the basket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给宝宝穿鞋时手里只拿着一只小鞋，用这个单只画面记住 żrajbuna；再把它与表示一双小鞋的 żrajben 配对复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small new shoot growing from a plant, for example a vine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物长出的小嫩梢，例如葡萄藤上的新梢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rimja żgħira li toħroġ minn pjanta, pereżempju minn dielja.

sense_translations.en_definition: small shoot of a plant, such as a vine
sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物的小嫩梢，例如葡萄藤长出的嫩梢。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-pjanta, l-istudenti nnutaw żrajġen ġdid ħdejn iz-zokk.
formal.en: While observing the plant, the students noticed a new small shoot near the stem.
formal.zh: 学生们观察植物时，注意到茎旁长出了一条新的小嫩梢。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, ħareġ żrajġen ġdid mid-dielja! Mark: Iva, ilbieraħ ma kienx hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, a new little shoot has come out of the vine! Mark: Yes, it wasn't there yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，葡萄藤长出一条新的小嫩梢了！马克：是啊，昨天还没有呢。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 看，葡萄藤长出一条新的小嫩梢了！
messages.en: Look, a new little shoot has come out of the vine!

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 是啊，昨天还没有呢。
messages.en: Yes, it wasn't there yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żrajġen 贴在葡萄藤新伸出的一小截嫩梢旁，想象它刚从茎边探出头；记住指的是嫩梢，而不是种子或整株植物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking moderation or restraint, or acting recklessly without enough care for consequences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏节制或约束的；也指行事鲁莽、没有充分考虑后果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla moderazzjoni jew bla rażan, jew li jaġixxi bla ħsieb biżżejjed għall-konsegwenzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无节制的，放纵的；鲁莽的，不顾后果的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iwissi li l-infiq żregulat jista' jwassal għal diffikultajiet finanzjarji.
formal.en: The report warns that unrestrained spending can lead to financial difficulties.
formal.zh: 报告警告，无节制的开支可能导致财务困难。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan l-infiq żregulat qed iġibni fl-inkwiet. Maja: Ejja nagħmlu baġit qabel nixtru aktar.
colloquial.en: Mark: This uncontrolled spending is getting me into trouble. Maja: Let's make a budget before we buy more.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这样无节制地花钱让我陷入麻烦了。玛雅：我们先做个预算，再买更多东西吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-infiq żregulat qed iġibni fl-inkwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-infiq żregulat qed iġibni fl-inkwiet.
messages.zh: 这样无节制地花钱让我陷入麻烦了。
messages.en: This uncontrolled spending is getting me into trouble.

messages.speaker: Maja (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nagħmlu baġit qabel nixtru aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nagħmlu baġit qabel nixtru aktar.
messages.zh: 我们先做个预算，再买更多东西吧。
messages.en: Let's make a budget before we buy more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个失去控制的画面记 żregulat：购物时不停花钱对应无节制，开车时不顾后果对应鲁莽；这只是词义联想，不是词源拆解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small seed that can be planted to grow a new plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一粒小种子，可以播入土中培育新植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żerriegħa żgħira li tista' tinżera' biex tikber pjanta ġdida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一粒小种子；żerriegħa 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Għall-attività tal-klassi, kull student poġġa żrejgħa f'qasrija żgħira.
formal.en: For the class activity, each student placed a small seed in a little pot.
formal.zh: 在课堂活动中，每位学生都把一粒小种子放进了一个小花盆。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din iż-żrejgħa żgħira se ssir pjanta? Pawlu: Iva, jekk tieħu ħsiebha u jkollha l-kundizzjonijiet tajbin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Will this little seed become a plant? Pawlu: Yes, if you look after it and it has the right conditions.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这粒小种子会长成植物吗？保罗：会的，只要你好好照料它，生长条件也合适。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Din iż-żrejgħa żgħira se ssir pjanta?
messages.mt_standard: Din iż-żrejgħa żgħira se ssir pjanta?
messages.zh: 这粒小种子会长成植物吗？
messages.en: Will this little seed become a plant?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk tieħu ħsiebha u jkollha l-kundizzjonijiet tajbin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk tieħu ħsiebha u jkollha l-kundizzjonijiet tajbin.
messages.zh: 会的，只要你好好照料它，生长条件也合适。
messages.en: Yes, if you look after it and it has the right conditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指尖捏着一粒很小的种子，再轻轻放进花盆，用这个动作记住 żrejgħa；与 żrajġen 对照，前者是种子，后者是已经长出的嫩梢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The enclosing of an area with a low wall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用矮墙将一片地方围合起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għeluq ta' medda art permezz ta' ħajt baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以矮墙围合；用矮墙将某处围起来。

collocations.en: enclosing the field with a low wall
enclosing the garden with a low wall

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi żrib tal-ġnien b'ħajt baxx tal-ġebel.
formal.en: The plan includes enclosing the garden with a low stone wall.
formal.zh: 该方案包括用一道低矮的石墙将花园围起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tibnu dak il-ħajt baxx? Mark: Qed nagħmlu żrib tal-ġnien biex nuru fejn jispiċċa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you building that low wall? Mark: We're enclosing the garden with a low wall to show where it ends.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们为什么在砌那道矮墙？马克：我们在用矮墙围起花园，标明它的边界。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tibnu dak il-ħajt baxx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tibnu dak il-ħajt baxx?
messages.zh: 你们为什么在砌那道矮墙？
messages.en: Why are you building that low wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (花园主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmlu żrib tal-ġnien biex nuru fejn jispiċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmlu żrib tal-ġnien biex nuru fejn jispiċċa.
messages.zh: 我们在用矮墙围起花园，标明它的边界。
messages.en: We're enclosing the garden with a low wall to show where it ends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一块花园，四周用低矮石墙围起来，再给这个围合动作贴上 żrib；记忆重点是矮墙围起一片地方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fraying or the loosening of threads in cloth or a similar material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料等材料的线缕磨散、起毛或松脱的过程或现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tħollija jew il-firda tal-ħjut f'drapp jew materjal simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨散、起毛或毛边形成，尤指布料边缘的线缕逐渐散开。
线缕的松动、松脱或散开。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġie osservat żrid fit-truf tad-drapp u ġiet irrakkomandata tiswija.
formal.en: During the inspection, fraying was observed along the edges of the fabric, and a repair was recommended.
formal.zh: 检查时发现布料边缘出现磨散起毛，因而建议进行修补。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dan iż-żrid fit-tarf tal-kmiem. Nina: Iva, il-ħjut qed jinħallu; ejja nsewwuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at this fraying at the edge of the sleeve. Nina: Yes, the threads are coming loose; let's mend it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，袖口这里都起毛散线了。妮娜：是啊，线正在松脱，我们把它补好吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 看，袖口这里都起毛散线了。
messages.en: Look at this fraying at the edge of the sleeve.

messages.speaker: Nina (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħjut qed jinħallu; ejja nsewwuh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħjut qed jinħallu; ejja nsewwuh.
messages.zh: 是啊，线正在松脱，我们把它补好吧。
messages.en: Yes, the threads are coming loose; let's mend it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旧袖口露出几根散线：整体看是布边磨散起毛，细看是线缕松脱。用同一个画面的两个观察角度记住 żrid 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn blue or become azure in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色变蓝，或变成天空般的蔚蓝色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir blu jew jieħu lewn kaħlani bħas-sema ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变蓝；颜色转为蓝色。
变成蔚蓝色，呈现晴朗天空般的蓝色。

formal.mt: Wara li għadda s-sħab, is-sema żrieq u l-pajsaġġ deher aktar qawwi.
formal.en: After the clouds passed, the sky turned azure and the landscape looked more vivid.
formal.zh: 云层散去后，天空变得蔚蓝，景色也显得更加鲜明。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Ara kif żrieq is-sema wara x-xita! Lara: Iva, issa m'għadx hemm sħab.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Look how blue the sky has turned after the rain! Lara: Yes, there aren't any clouds now.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：看，雨后天空变得多蓝啊！拉拉：是啊，现在已经没有云了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kif żrieq is-sema wara x-xita!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kif żrieq is-sema wara x-xita!
messages.zh: 看，雨后天空变得多蓝啊！
messages.en: Look how blue the sky has turned after the rain!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，现在已经没有云了。
messages.en: Yes, there aren't any clouds now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一段雨后天空由灰转蓝的短画面记 żrieq，注意它表达变蓝这个变化；想象最后出现明亮的蔚蓝天空，就能同时记住第二个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of putting seeds into soil so that they can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把种子播入土中，使其能够生长的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li titfa' ż-żerriegħa fil-ħamrija biex tkun tista' tikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 播种；把种子播入土中的活动。

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żrigħ tal-qamħ, il-bidwi jħejji l-ħamrija. Dan ix-xogħol huwa parti mit-tħejjija għall-istaġun il-ġdid.
formal.en: Before sowing the wheat, the farmer prepares the soil. This work is part of the preparation for the new season.
formal.zh: 播种小麦之前，农民先整理土壤。这项工作是为新一季耕作所做准备的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Meta se nibdew iż-żrigħ? Pawlu: Għada filgħodu, jekk ma tagħmilx xita.
colloquial.en: Marta: When are we going to start sowing? Pawlu: Tomorrow morning, if it doesn't rain.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我们什么时候开始播种？Pawlu：明天早上，只要不下雨。

messages.speaker: Marta (农场帮手)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候开始播种？
messages.en: When are we going to start sowing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu, jekk ma tagħmilx xita.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu, jekk ma tagħmilx xita.
messages.zh: 明天早上，只要不下雨。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning, if it doesn't rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把żrigħ和一把种子撒入土中的画面连起来记；它表示“播种这件事”，搭配小麦就是“播种小麦”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Seduction, especially the act of enticing someone into sexual activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 诱惑，尤其指引诱他人参与性行为的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tħajjar lil xi ħadd, speċjalment biex jieħu sehem f'attività sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诱惑；勾引。
引诱他人参与性行为。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jittratta ż-żrik u jenfasizza l-importanza ta' kunsens ċar. L-awtur jiddeskrivi kif persuna tista' tipprova tħajjar lil oħra għal attività sesswali.
formal.en: The article discusses seduction and emphasizes the importance of clear consent. The author describes how one person may try to entice another into sexual activity.
formal.zh: 文章讨论了性引诱，并强调明确同意的重要性。作者描述了一个人可能如何试图引诱另一个人参与性行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fil-film, dak kien tentattiv ta' żrik? Mark: Iva, kien qed jipprova jħajjarha għal relazzjoni sesswali.
colloquial.en: Lara: In the film, was that an attempt at seduction? Mark: Yes, he was trying to entice her into a sexual relationship.
colloquial.zh: Lara：电影里那算是在试图勾引吗？Mark：是的，他当时想引诱她发生性关系。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-film, dak kien tentattiv ta' żrik?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-film, dak kien tentattiv ta' żrik?
messages.zh: 电影里那算是在试图勾引吗？
messages.en: In the film, was that an attempt at seduction?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien qed jipprova jħajjarha għal relazzjoni sesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien qed jipprova jħajjarha għal relazzjoni sesswali.
messages.zh: 是的，他当时想引诱她发生性关系。
messages.en: Yes, he was trying to entice her into a sexual relationship.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记żrik时想象电影中一方试图勾引另一方的情节；这个名词描述引诱行为，本身不表示对方已经同意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suitable or able to be sown as seed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够或适合当作种子播种的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinżera' bħala żerriegħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可以播种的；可供播种的。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żamm il-qamħ żrugħi f'post niexef. Dan il-qamħ se jintuża għaż-żrigħ fl-istaġun li jmiss.
formal.en: The farmer kept the wheat suitable for sowing in a dry place. This wheat will be used for sowing next season.
formal.zh: 农民把可供播种的小麦存放在干燥的地方。这些小麦将用于下一季播种。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-qamħ żrugħi? Toni: Iva, żammejtu biex niżirgħu s-sena d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can this wheat be sown? Toni: Yes, I kept it so we can sow it next year.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这些小麦可以用来播种吗？Toni：可以，我留着它，就是为了明年播种。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场帮手)
messages.zh: 这些小麦可以用来播种吗？
messages.en: Can this wheat be sown?

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żammejtu biex niżirgħu s-sena d-dieħla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żammejtu biex niżirgħu s-sena d-dieħla.
messages.zh: 可以，我留着它，就是为了明年播种。
messages.en: Yes, I kept it so we can sow it next year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把żrugħi想成种子袋上的“可播种”标签：它描述谷物能拿来播种，不表示谷物已经种下。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a coat of paint or have colour applied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被涂上一层油漆或被施加颜色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħata saff ta' żebgħa jew kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被涂漆；被上色。

formal.mt: Matul ix-xogħol ta' manutenzjoni, il-bieb żteba' mill-ġdid. Il-kulur il-ġdid huwa blu.
formal.en: During the maintenance work, the door was painted again. The new colour is blue.
formal.zh: 维护期间，门被重新刷了漆。新颜色是蓝色。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-ħajt żteba' llum? Ġużeppi: Iva, għadu mxarrab, mela tmissux.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was the wall painted today? Ġużeppi: Yes, it's still wet, so don't touch it.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这面墙是今天刷的吗？Ġużeppi：是的，漆还没干，所以别碰。

messages.speaker: Anna (住户)
messages.zh: 这面墙是今天刷的吗？
messages.en: Was the wall painted today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (油漆工)
messages.zh: 是的，漆还没干，所以别碰。
messages.en: Yes, it's still wet, so don't touch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到żteba'，就想象门上挂着“油漆未干”的牌子；句子的主角是被刷漆的门或墙。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contemptuous term for a little man.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对一个小男人的轻蔑称呼，带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' disprezz għal raġel żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （贬义）小男人；对小个子男人的轻蔑称呼。

collocations.en: to call him a little man as an insult

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-karattru juża l-kelma 'żubbaċċ' biex jinsulta raġel ieħor. Din l-għażla ta' kliem turi disprezz.
formal.en: In the text, the character uses the word 'żubbaċċ' to insult another man. This choice of words expresses contempt.
formal.zh: 文中，这个人物用“żubbaċċ”辱骂另一个男人。这样的措辞表达了轻蔑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħlu żubbaċċ? David: Ried jinsultah; dik mhix kelma sabiħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he call him a żubbaċċ? David: He wanted to insult him; that's not a nice word.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么骂那个人是“小男人”？David：他想侮辱对方；那可不是什么好听的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么骂那个人是“小男人”？
messages.en: Why did he call him a żubbaċċ?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jinsultah; dik mhix kelma sabiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jinsultah; dik mhix kelma sabiħa.
messages.zh: 他想侮辱对方；那可不是什么好听的话。
messages.en: He wanted to insult him; that's not a nice word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把żubbaċċ放进小说人物生气骂人的场景来记：“小男人”在这里带轻蔑，不能当作亲切昵称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The red-footed falcon, the bird species Falco vespertinus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 红脚隼，即学名为Falco vespertinus的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Falco vespertinus, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala red-footed falcon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红脚隼（Falco vespertinus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a red-footed falcon
a sighting of a red-footed falcon
collocations.zh: 一次红脚隼的目击记录

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi osservazzjoni ta' żumbrell u ritratt tal-għasfur. L-isem xjentifiku mogħti huwa Falco vespertinus.
formal.en: The report includes a sighting of a red-footed falcon and a photograph of the bird. The scientific name given is Falco vespertinus.
formal.zh: 报告收录了一次红脚隼的目击记录和一张该鸟的照片。所列学名为Falco vespertinus。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan żumbrell fir-ritratt? Daniel: Iva, fil-ktieb hemm l-istess għasfur bl-isem Falco vespertinus.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a red-footed falcon in the photo? Daniel: Yes, the book shows the same bird under the name Falco vespertinus.
colloquial.zh: Sara：照片里这只是红脚隼吗？Daniel：是的，书里有同样的鸟，标着学名Falco vespertinus。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟爱好者)
messages.zh: 照片里这只是红脚隼吗？
messages.en: Is this a red-footed falcon in the photo?

messages.speaker: Daniel (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fil-ktieb hemm l-istess għasfur bl-isem Falco vespertinus.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fil-ktieb hemm l-istess għasfur bl-isem Falco vespertinus.
messages.zh: 是的，书里有同样的鸟，标着学名Falco vespertinus。
messages.en: Yes, the book shows the same bird under the name Falco vespertinus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三栏鸟名卡：żumbrell、红脚隼、Falco vespertinus；反复配对这三个名称来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sooty falcon, the bird species Falco concolor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烟隼，即学名为Falco concolor的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Falco concolor, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala sooty falcon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟隼（Falco concolor）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a sooty falcon
a sighting of a sooty falcon

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi ritratt ta' żumbrell Għarbi. Taħt ir-ritratt hemm l-isem xjentifiku Falco concolor.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a photograph of a sooty falcon. Below the photograph is the scientific name Falco concolor.
formal.zh: 图录收录了一张烟隼的照片。照片下方标有学名Falco concolor。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fil-ktieb? Mark: Żumbrell Għarbi; bl-Ingliż jgħidulu sooty falcon.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's this bird in the book called? Mark: Żumbrell Għarbi; in English it's called a sooty falcon.
colloquial.zh: Nina：书里这只鸟叫什么？Mark：马耳他语叫żumbrell Għarbi，英语叫sooty falcon，也就是烟隼。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 书里这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What's this bird in the book called?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Żumbrell Għarbi; bl-Ingliż jgħidulu sooty falcon.
messages.mt_standard: Żumbrell Għarbi; bl-Ingliż jgħidulu sooty falcon.
messages.zh: 马耳他语叫żumbrell Għarbi，英语叫sooty falcon，也就是烟隼。
messages.en: Żumbrell Għarbi; in English it's called a sooty falcon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把żumbrell Għarbi作为完整鸟名配对“烟隼、Falco concolor”记忆；它与单独的żumbrell对应不同物种。

gloss_zh: 与Żurrieq村有关的称谓；来自该村的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A designation indicating a connection with the village of Żurrieq.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示与Żurrieq村有联系的称谓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li jindika rabta mar-raħal ta' Żurrieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示与Żurrieq这一村庄有关的称谓。
来自Żurrieq村的；用于形容出身于该村的人。

formal.mt: Il-programm jippreżenta kittieb żurrieqi u jagħti tagħrif dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu. L-introduzzjoni ssemmi li hu ġej minn Żurrieq.
formal.en: The programme introduces a writer from Żurrieq and provides information about his work. The introduction mentions that he comes from Żurrieq.
formal.zh: 节目介绍了一位来自Żurrieq村的作家，并提供了有关其作品的信息。开场介绍提到他来自Żurrieq村。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-kittieb żurrieqi? Pawlu: Iva, hu minn Żurrieq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that writer from Żurrieq? Pawlu: Yes, he's from Żurrieq.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那位作家来自Żurrieq村吗？Pawlu：是的，他来自Żurrieq村。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.zh: 那位作家来自Żurrieq村吗？
messages.en: Is that writer from Żurrieq?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他来自Żurrieq村。
messages.en: Yes, he's from Żurrieq.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把地名Żurrieq与词条żurrieqi并排写成记忆卡：前者指村庄，后者提示与该村的联系或人的籍贯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reduce the value of something, especially a currency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低某物的价值，尤指使货币贬值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-valur ta' xi ħaġa, speċjalment ta' munita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使贬值；降低价值。

formal.mt: Il-bank ċentrali żvaluta l-munita biex jagħmel l-esportazzjonijiet aktar kompetittivi.
formal.en: The central bank devalued the currency to make exports more competitive.
formal.zh: 中央银行使货币贬值，以提高出口商品的竞争力。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex irrabjajt waqt il-laqgħa? Pawlu: Għax il-kap żvaluta x-xogħol tagħna quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you get angry during the meeting? Pawlu: Because the manager devalued our work in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么在开会时生气了？保罗：因为主管当着大家的面贬低了我们的工作。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么在开会时生气了？
messages.en: Why did you get angry during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kap żvaluta x-xogħol tagħna quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kap żvaluta x-xogħol tagħna quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为主管当着大家的面贬低了我们的工作。
messages.en: Because the manager devalued our work in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象价值标签上的数字被往下调，把 żvaluta 与“使价值下降”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To disappear from sight or cease to be noticeable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从视线中消失，或变得无法察觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisparixxi minn quddiem l-għajnejn jew ma jibqax jinħass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消失；突然不见；不再能被察觉。

formal.mt: Id-dgħajsa żvanixxiet fiċ-ċpar u ma baqgħetx tidher mix-xatt.
formal.en: The boat vanished into the fog and could no longer be seen from the shore.
formal.zh: 小船消失在雾中，从岸上再也看不见了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn mar il-qattus? Mark: Kien hawn minuta ilu, imma issa żvanixxa!
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did the cat go? Mark: It was here a minute ago, but now it has vanished!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：猫去哪儿了？马克：一分钟前还在这里，现在却不见了！

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 猫去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the cat go?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hawn minuta ilu, imma issa żvanixxa!
messages.mt_standard: Kien hawn minuta ilu, imma issa żvanixxa!
messages.zh: 一分钟前还在这里，现在却不见了！
messages.en: It was here a minute ago, but now it has vanished!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小船进入浓雾后完全看不见，用这个消失画面记住 żvanixxa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put someone or a group in a less favorable position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某个群体处于较为不利的地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew lil xi grupp f'pożizzjoni inqas favorevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使处于不利地位；使在条件或机会方面吃亏。

collocations.zh: 使小企业处于不利地位

formal.mt: Ir-rekwiżit il-ġdid żvantaġġa lill-applikanti li ma kellhomx aċċess għall-internet.
formal.en: The new requirement disadvantaged applicants who did not have internet access.
formal.zh: 这项新要求使无法上网的申请人处于不利地位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tilmentaw dwar il-ħin tal-eżami? David: Għax il-ħin il-ġdid żvantaġġa lil dawk li jaħdmu filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you complaining about the exam time? David: Because the new time disadvantaged those who work in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们为什么对考试时间有意见？戴维：因为新时间让上午要上班的人吃亏了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tilmentaw dwar il-ħin tal-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tilmentaw dwar il-ħin tal-eżami?
messages.zh: 你们为什么对考试时间有意见？
messages.en: Why are you complaining about the exam time?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-ħin il-ġdid żvantaġġa lil dawk li jaħdmu filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-ħin il-ġdid żvantaġġa lil dawk li jaħdmu filgħodu.
messages.zh: 因为新时间让上午要上班的人吃亏了。
messages.en: Because the new time disadvantaged those who work in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同场比赛中有人被安排从更远处起跑，用“使人吃亏”记住 żvantaġġa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change from a liquid into vapor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由液态变为蒸气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinbidel minn likwidu fi fwar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒸发；由液体变为蒸气。

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, parti mill-ilma żvaporat minħabba s-sħana.
formal.en: During the experiment, some of the water evaporated because of the heat.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，一部分水因受热而蒸发了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-platt m'għadx fih ilma? Toni: Ħallejnieh fix-xemx, u l-ilma żvapura.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there no water left in the plate? Toni: We left it in the sun, and the water evaporated.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：盘子里的水怎么没了？托尼：我们把它放在太阳底下，水就蒸发了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 盘子里的水怎么没了？
messages.en: Why is there no water left in the plate?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们把它放在太阳底下，水就蒸发了。
messages.en: We left it in the sun, and the water evaporated.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żvapura 配上浅盘里的水在阳光下逐渐变少的画面，记住“蒸发”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slip away from a place or group, often without attracting attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某个地方或群体中悄悄离开，通常不引人注意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlaq minn post jew minn grupp bil-kwiet, spiss mingħajr ma jiġbed l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悄悄溜走；不引人注意地离开。

formal.mt: Waqt il-konfużjoni, ir-raġel żvara mill-folla mingħajr ma nduna ħadd.
formal.en: During the confusion, the man slipped away from the crowd without anyone noticing.
formal.zh: 混乱中，那名男子趁无人察觉从人群里溜走了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn mar Pawlu? Luqa: Żvara mill-festa mingħajr ma sellem.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did Pawlu go? Luqa: He slipped away from the party without saying goodbye.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗去哪儿了？卢卡：他没打招呼就从聚会上悄悄溜走了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 他没打招呼就从聚会上悄悄溜走了。
messages.en: He slipped away from the party without saying goodbye.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会中有人贴着门边悄悄离开，把 żvara 与“溜走的动作”连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something hidden or unknown become known or visible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使原本隐藏或不为人知的事物被知晓或被看见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel magħruf jew viżibbli dak li kien moħbi jew mhux magħruf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揭露或透露原本不为人知的事情；揭开遮盖，使某物显露。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport żvela nuqqasijiet serji fil-ġestjoni tal-proġett.
formal.en: The report revealed serious shortcomings in the management of the project.
formal.zh: 报告揭露了项目管理中的严重缺陷。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min żvela s-sigriet tal-festa? Ben: Jien, bi żball! Ħsibt li diġà kont taf.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who revealed the secret about the party? Ben: I did, by mistake! I thought you already knew.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁把聚会的秘密说出去了？本：是我，不小心说的！我以为你已经知道了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把聚会的秘密说出去了？
messages.en: Who revealed the secret about the party?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, bi żball! Ħsibt li diġà kont taf.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, bi żball! Ħsibt li diġà kont taf.
messages.zh: 是我，不小心说的！我以为你已经知道了。
messages.en: I did, by mistake! I thought you already knew.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块遮布被揭开，下面的秘密终于显露，用这一画面记住 żvela。

gloss_zh: 当众做出不道德的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: To commit an act considered immoral in public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在公众面前做出被认为不道德的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel att meqjus immorali fil-pubbliku.

sense_translations.en_definition: to commit an immoral act in public
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在公众场合做出不道德的行为。

collocations.en: committed an immoral act in public
collocations.zh: 在公众场合做出了不道德的行为

collocations.en: committed an immoral act in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 当着所有人的面做出了不道德的行为

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel żvergonja fil-pjazza, u l-awtur jiddeskrivi r-reazzjoni tan-nies.
formal.en: In the story, the man committed an immoral act in the square, and the author describes the people's reaction.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子在广场上做出了不道德的行为，作者描写了人们的反应。

colloquial.mt: Klara: Xi jfisser meta tgħid li żvergonja? Ġorġ: Jiġifieri għamel xi ħaġa immorali fil-pubbliku.
colloquial.en: Klara: What do you mean when you say he żvergonja? Ġorġ: I mean he did something immoral in public.
colloquial.zh: 克拉拉：你说他 żvergonja，是什么意思？乔治：就是他在公众场合做了不道德的事。

messages.speaker: Klara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser meta tgħid li żvergonja?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser meta tgħid li żvergonja?
messages.zh: 你说他 żvergonja，是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean when you say he żvergonja?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri għamel xi ħaġa immorali fil-pubbliku.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri għamel xi ħaġa immorali fil-pubbliku.
messages.zh: 就是他在公众场合做了不道德的事。
messages.en: I mean he did something immoral in public.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时同时抓住“行为不道德”和“发生在公众面前”两点，把它们一起配给 żvergonja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of causing someone to lose their virginity through sexual intercourse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过性交使某人失去童贞的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna titlef il-verġinità permezz ta' rapport sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破贞；通过性交使某人失去童贞的行为。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, l-awtriċi teżamina kif jiġi deskritt iż-żverġnament tal-protagonista adulta.
formal.en: In the analysis of the novel, the author examines how the deflowering of the adult protagonist is described.
formal.zh: 在对小说的分析中，作者考察了作品如何描写成年主人公失去童贞。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi tfisser il-kelma żverġnament f'dan ir-rumanz? Rita: Tfisser li persuna titlef il-verġinità permezz ta' rapport sesswali.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does the word żverġnament mean in this novel? Rita: It means a person losing their virginity through sexual intercourse.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：这本小说里的 żverġnament 是什么意思？丽塔：指一个人通过性交失去童贞。

messages.speaker: Elena (成年读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma żverġnament f'dan ir-rumanz?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma żverġnament f'dan ir-rumanz?
messages.zh: 这本小说里的 żverġnament 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word żverġnament mean in this novel?

messages.speaker: Rita (成年读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li persuna titlef il-verġinità permezz ta' rapport sesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li persuna titlef il-verġinità permezz ta' rapport sesswali.
messages.zh: 指一个人通过性交失去童贞。
messages.en: It means a person losing their virginity through sexual intercourse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żverġnament 放进小说词汇卡，正面写词，背面写“使失去童贞这一行为”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose consciousness briefly; to faint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短暂失去意识，昏倒或晕厥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef minn sensih għal żmien qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 昏倒；短暂失去意识。

formal.mt: Parteċipant żviena waqt il-laqgħa u rċieva l-ewwel għajnuna.
formal.en: A participant fainted during the meeting and received first aid.
formal.zh: 一名与会者在会议期间昏倒，并接受了急救。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaf il-kunċert? Mark: Raġel żviena bis-sħana, u sejħu għall-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the concert stop? Mark: A man fainted from the heat, and they called for help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：音乐会为什么停下来了？马克：有个男人热得昏倒了，大家叫人来帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did the concert stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Raġel żviena bis-sħana, u sejħu għall-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Raġel żviena bis-sħana, u sejħu għall-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 有个男人热得昏倒了，大家叫人来帮忙。
messages.en: A man fainted from the heat, and they called for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żviena 放进“天太热，有人突然昏倒”的画面中记忆，重点联想短暂失去意识。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move away from an intended route, direction, or proper course of action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离开原定路线、方向或正确的行事道路；偏离或走入歧途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbiegħed mir-rotta maħsuba jew mit-triq it-tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏离原定方向或路线；误入歧途。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, is-sewwieq żvija mir-rotta ppjanata u wasal tard fid-destinazzjoni.
formal.en: According to the report, the driver deviated from the planned route and arrived late at the destination.
formal.zh: 根据报告，司机偏离了计划路线，未能按时到达目的地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dam daqshekk ix-xufier? Pawlu: Żvija mir-rotta u kellu jdur lura.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the driver take so long? Pawlu: He went off the route and had to turn back.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：司机怎么花了这么长时间？保罗：他走偏了路线，只好掉头回来。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.zh: 司机怎么花了这么长时间？
messages.en: Why did the driver take so long?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żvija mir-rotta u kellu jdur lura.
messages.mt_standard: Żvija mir-rotta u kellu jdur lura.
messages.zh: 他走偏了路线，只好掉头回来。
messages.en: He went off the route and had to turn back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上原本笔直的路线突然拐偏：żvija 可指实际走偏，也可指行为偏离正道。

gloss_zh: 失血而死；使血流尽；割破静脉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bleed to death or drain blood away; also, to slash someone's veins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因失血过多而死亡，或使血液流尽；也指割破某人的静脉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imut bit-telf tad-demm jew ineħħi d-demm kollu; jista' jfisser ukoll jaqta' l-vini ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to bleed to death, bleed dry
sense_translations.zh_definition: 失血而死；使血液流尽。
割破某人的静脉。

collocations.en: bled to death after the accident

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku kkonkluda li r-raġel żvina wara l-inċident.
formal.en: The medical report concluded that the man bled to death after the accident.
formal.zh: 医疗报告认定，该男子在事故后因失血过多而死亡。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara lir-raġel fir-rumanz? David: Żvina wara l-inċident; hekk jgħid l-aħħar kapitlu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened to the man in the novel? David: He bled to death after the accident; that's what the last chapter says.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：小说里的那个男人后来怎么了？戴维：他在事故后失血而死；最后一章是这样写的。

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 小说里的那个男人后来怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the man in the novel?

messages.speaker: David (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żvina wara l-inċident; hekk jgħid l-aħħar kapitlu.
messages.mt_standard: Żvina wara l-inċident; hekk jgħid l-aħħar kapitlu.
messages.zh: 他在事故后失血而死；最后一章是这样写的。
messages.en: He bled to death after the accident; that's what the last chapter says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“血液流失”串联记忆 żvina，再区分结果义“失血而死”和动作义“割破静脉”。

gloss_zh: 以大规模拆建和开辟宽阔道路的方式改造城区

teaching_sense.en_definition: To redevelop an urban area by demolishing existing buildings and laying out broad streets or boulevards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过拆除原有建筑、开辟宽阔街道或林荫大道，对城区进行大规模改造。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibiddel żona urbana billi jwaqqa' bini eżistenti u jiftaħ toroq wesgħin jew vjalijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以拆除旧建筑、开辟宽阔街道或林荫大道的方式大规模改造城区。

collocations.en: redeveloped the city centre through demolition and broad new streets
collocations.zh: 通过拆建和开辟宽阔街道改造了市中心

collocations.en: transformed the old quarter through demolition and boulevard construction
collocations.zh: 通过拆建和修建林荫大道改造了旧城区

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-istudju, il-kunsill żvintra l-kwartier il-qadim billi waqqa' diversi blokok u fetaħ żewġ vjalijiet wesgħin.
formal.en: In the study's example, the council transformed the old quarter by demolishing several blocks and opening two broad boulevards.
formal.zh: 在该研究的示例中，市议会拆除了几个街区，并开辟两条宽阔的林荫大道，以此改造旧城区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-kunsill fil-belt tal-istorja? Mark: Żvintra ċ-ċentru: waqqa' bini qadim u fetaħ toroq wesgħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the council do in the town in the story? Mark: It transformed the centre by demolishing old buildings and opening broad streets.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的市议会对那座城做了什么？马克：它大规模改造了市中心，拆掉旧建筑，开辟了宽阔的街道。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的市议会对那座城做了什么？
messages.en: What did the council do in the town in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żvintra ċ-ċentru: waqqa' bini qadim u fetaħ toroq wesgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Żvintra ċ-ċentru: waqqa' bini qadim u fetaħ toroq wesgħin.
messages.zh: 它大规模改造了市中心，拆掉旧建筑，开辟了宽阔的街道。
messages.en: It transformed the centre by demolishing old buildings and opening broad streets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“旧街区拆开，宽阔大道铺开”的前后对照画面记 żvintra，抓住大规模城市改造这一具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is unlucky or has suffered misfortune.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运气不好或遭遇不幸的人；倒霉的人、不幸者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li jkollha xorti ħażina jew li tkun ġarrbet xi sfortuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倒霉的人；遭遇不幸的人。

collocations.zh: 我们帮助那个不幸的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żvinturat tilef daru f'għargħar u sab kenn għand il-ġirien.
formal.en: In the story, the unfortunate man lost his home in a flood and found shelter with his neighbours.
formal.zh: 故事中，这位不幸者在洪水中失去了家园，后来在邻居家得到栖身之处。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak bil-bagalja miksura? Pawlu: Dak iż-żvinturat tilef il-ferrovija wkoll. Ejja ngħinuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who's that person with the broken suitcase? Pawlu: That poor man missed the train as well. Let's help him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个提着坏行李箱的人是谁？保罗：那个倒霉的人还错过了火车。我们去帮帮他吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅客)
messages.zh: 那个提着坏行李箱的人是谁？
messages.en: Who's that person with the broken suitcase?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak iż-żvinturat tilef il-ferrovija wkoll. Ejja ngħinuh.
messages.mt_standard: Dak iż-żvinturat tilef il-ferrovija wkoll. Ejja ngħinuh.
messages.zh: 那个倒霉的人还错过了火车。我们去帮帮他吧。
messages.en: That poor man missed the train as well. Let's help him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żvinturat 记成故事里“接连碰到倒霉事的那个人”；本条按名词学习，中文落在“人”上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To loosen or remove a screw or threaded part by turning it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过旋转使螺丝或带螺纹的部件松开，或将其拧下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoll jew ineħħi kamin jew biċċa bil-kamin billi jdawwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旋松或拧下螺丝、旋盖等带螺纹的部件。

formal.mt: It-tekniku żvita l-kamin u neħħa l-pannell biex jispezzjona l-partijiet ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: The technician unscrewed the screw and removed the panel to inspect the internal parts.
formal.zh: 技术人员拧下螺丝并取下面板，以检查内部零件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min fetaħ il-vażett? David: Pawlu żvita l-għatu, għax kien issikkat ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who opened the jar? David: Pawlu unscrewed the lid because it was very tight.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁打开了罐子？戴维：保罗拧开的，盖子原来拧得很紧。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 谁打开了罐子？
messages.en: Who opened the jar?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu żvita l-għatu, għax kien issikkat ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu żvita l-għatu, għax kien issikkat ħafna.
messages.zh: 保罗拧开的，盖子原来拧得很紧。
messages.en: Pawlu unscrewed the lid because it was very tight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指转动瓶盖，盖子沿螺纹逐渐松开；żvita 的动作重点是“旋转着拧松或拧下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The development or unfolding of an event, situation, or story over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事件、局势或故事随时间发展、展开的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih ġrajja, sitwazzjoni jew storja tiżviluppa maż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发展；事件、局势或故事的展开过程。

collocations.en: the development of the story or event

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ż-żvolġiment tal-laqgħa u jispjega kif intlaħaq il-ftehim finali.
formal.en: The report describes the course of the meeting and explains how the final agreement was reached.
formal.zh: 报告描述了会议的进行过程，并说明了最终协议是如何达成的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok il-film? Mark: Iva, speċjalment iż-żvolġiment tal-istorja. Ma stajtx naħseb kif kienet se tispiċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the film? Mark: Yes, especially how the story developed. I couldn't guess how it would end.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这部电影吗？马克：喜欢，尤其喜欢故事的展开。我猜不到它会怎么结局。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment iż-żvolġiment tal-istorja. Ma stajtx naħseb kif kienet se tispiċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment iż-żvolġiment tal-istorja. Ma stajtx naħseb kif kienet se tispiċċa.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其喜欢故事的展开。我猜不到它会怎么结局。
messages.en: Yes, especially how the story developed. I couldn't guess how it would end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把故事画成一条逐步展开的时间线，用 żvolġiment 指整段发展过程，记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove the bridle from a horse or another bridled animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给马或其他戴着辔头的动物卸下辔头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi l-brilja minn fuq żiemel jew annimal ieħor li jkun liebes brilja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给马等动物卸下辔头。

formal.mt: Wara t-taħriġ, il-ħaddiem tal-istalla żvrilja ż-żiemel u ċċekkja l-kundizzjoni tal-brilja.
formal.en: After the training session, the stable worker unbridled the horse and checked the condition of the bridle.
formal.zh: 训练结束后，马厩工作人员给马卸下辔头，并检查了辔头的状况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Iż-żiemel għadu bil-brilja? Pawlu: Le, Mark żvrilja ż-żiemel wara l-mixja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does the horse still have its bridle on? Pawlu: No, Mark unbridled the horse after the ride.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马还戴着辔头吗？保罗：没有，马克骑行回来后就给它卸下了。

messages.speaker: Lara (骑马学员)
messages.zh: 马还戴着辔头吗？
messages.en: Does the horse still have its bridle on?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (马厩工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Mark żvrilja ż-żiemel wara l-mixja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Mark żvrilja ż-żiemel wara l-mixja.
messages.zh: 没有，马克骑行回来后就给它卸下了。
messages.en: No, Mark unbridled the horse after the ride.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象骑行结束后，工作人员从马头上卸下辔头；用这个完整动作记 żvrilja，并区分辔头和马鞍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Trash or waste material that is no longer wanted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不再需要、准备丢弃的垃圾或废物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li ma jkunx għadu meħtieġ u li jkun se jintrema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 垃圾；丢弃的废物。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif tal-bitħa, il-ħaddiema ġabru ż-żwal u poġġewh fil-kontenitur.
formal.en: After cleaning the yard, the workers collected the trash and put it in the container.
formal.zh: 清扫院子后，工人们把垃圾收集起来，放进了容器。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Hemm munzell żwal ħdejn il-bieb. Pawlu: Issa niġbru u npoġġuh fil-borża.
colloquial.en: Marija: There's a pile of trash beside the door. Pawlu: Let's collect it now and put it in the bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：门旁边有一堆垃圾。保罗：我们现在把它收起来，装进袋子吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 门旁边有一堆垃圾。
messages.en: There's a pile of trash beside the door.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我们现在把它收起来，装进袋子吧。
messages.en: Let's collect it now and put it in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żwal 和清扫后装进垃圾袋的画面绑定，连着记 munzell żwal「一堆垃圾」。

gloss_zh: 小小的一对；一种牧羊人圣诞牧歌

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small couple or pair; also a kind of shepherd's Christmas pastoral.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小小的一对；也指一种与牧羊人有关的圣诞牧歌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Par żgħir; ukoll tip ta' pastorali tal-Milied marbuta mar-rgħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小小的一对。

sense_translations.en_definition: A kind of shepherd's Christmas pastoral
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种牧羊人圣诞牧歌。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-kunċert jinkludi żwejjeġ, tip ta' pastorali tal-Milied marbuta mar-rgħajja.
formal.en: The concert programme includes a żwejjeġ, a kind of shepherd's Christmas pastoral.
formal.zh: 音乐会节目中包括一首 żwejjeġ，即一种牧羊人圣诞牧歌。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'poġġejt fuq l-ixkaffa? Mark: Żwejjeġ ta' figurini, waħda ħdejn l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did you put on the shelf? Mark: A small pair of figurines, one beside the other.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你在架子上放了什么？马克：小小的一对人偶，一个挨着另一个。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在架子上放了什么？
messages.en: What did you put on the shelf?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żwejjeġ ta' figurini, waħda ħdejn l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Żwejjeġ ta' figurini, waħda ħdejn l-oħra.
messages.zh: 小小的一对人偶，一个挨着另一个。
messages.en: A small pair of figurines, one beside the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żwejjeġ 准备两张记忆卡：一张画小小的一对人偶，另一张画牧羊人唱圣诞牧歌，分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small horse; the diminutive form of żiemel, meaning horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小马；是表示「马」的 żiemel 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żiemel żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva tal-kelma żiemel.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small horse (the diminutive form of 'żiemel')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小马，是 żiemel「马」的指小形式。

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fir-razzett, l-istudenti osservaw żwejmel kannella fil-mergħa.
formal.en: During the farm visit, the students observed a small brown horse in the pasture.
formal.zh: 参观农场时，学生们观察了牧场里的一匹棕色小马。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak iż-żwejmel ħdejn iċ-ċint! Toni: Iva, qed jiekol il-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that little horse beside the fence! Toni: Yes, it's eating grass.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看围栏旁边的那匹小马！托尼：是啊，它正在吃草。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 看围栏旁边的那匹小马！
messages.en: Look at that little horse beside the fence!

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，它正在吃草。
messages.en: Yes, it's eating grass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 żiemel 是「马」，再把 żwejmel 配上一匹小马的图片，成对记住普通形式与指小形式。

gloss_zh: 高羊茅；一种禾草；蓝羊茅

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant name used for tall fescue (Festuca arundinacea), fern grass (Poa rigida), or blue fescue (Festuca glauca), depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种植物名称，依语境可指高羊茅（Festuca arundinacea）、学名为 Poa rigida 的禾草，或蓝羊茅（Festuca glauca）。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li, skont il-kuntest, jirreferi għal Festuca arundinacea, Poa rigida jew Festuca glauca.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高羊茅，学名 Festuca arundinacea。
一种禾草，学名 Poa rigida，英文称 fern grass。
蓝羊茅，学名 Festuca glauca。

collocations.zh: 花园里的 żwien 禾草
一份 żwien 禾草标本

formal.mt: F'dan il-katalgu, l-isem żwien jirreferi għal Festuca glauca; l-isem xjentifiku jiddistingwi din il-pjanta mill-ispeċijiet l-oħra.
formal.en: In this catalogue, the name żwien refers to Festuca glauca; the scientific name distinguishes this plant from the other species.
formal.zh: 在本目录中，żwien 指蓝羊茅（Festuca glauca）；学名用于将这种植物与其他物种区分开来。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din il-pjanta jisimha żwien? Ġużeppi: Iva, u t-tikketta tgħid Festuca glauca.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this plant called żwien? Ġużeppi: Yes, and the label says Festuca glauca.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这种植物叫 żwien 吗？朱塞佩：对，标签上写的是 Festuca glauca。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫 żwien 吗？
messages.en: Is this plant called żwien?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园艺店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u t-tikketta tgħid Festuca glauca.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u t-tikketta tgħid Festuca glauca.
messages.zh: 对，标签上写的是 Festuca glauca。
messages.en: Yes, and the label says Festuca glauca.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żwien 想成贴在三张禾草图片上的同名标签；每张都附上学名，提醒自己必须结合语境分清三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sea fern grass, the grass species with the scientific name Catapodium marinum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种英文称为 sea fern grass 的海滨禾草，学名为 Catapodium marinum。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' ħaxix bl-isem xjentifiku Catapodium marinum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种海滨禾草，学名 Catapodium marinum，英文称 sea fern grass。

collocations.en: a specimen of sea fern grass

formal.mt: Il-kampjun ġie identifikat bħala żwien tax-xatt, bl-isem xjentifiku Catapodium marinum.
formal.en: The specimen was identified as sea fern grass, with the scientific name Catapodium marinum.
formal.zh: 该标本被鉴定为海滨禾草，学名为 Catapodium marinum。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jismu dan il-ħaxix fir-ritratt? David: Żwien tax-xatt; ħdejh hemm miktub Catapodium marinum.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this grass in the photograph called? David: Sea fern grass; Catapodium marinum is written beside it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：照片里的这种草叫什么？戴维：海滨禾草；旁边写着 Catapodium marinum。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种草叫什么？
messages.en: What is this grass in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żwien tax-xatt; ħdejh hemm miktub Catapodium marinum.
messages.mt_standard: Żwien tax-xatt; ħdejh hemm miktub Catapodium marinum.
messages.zh: 海滨禾草；旁边写着 Catapodium marinum。
messages.en: Sea fern grass; Catapodium marinum is written beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组 żwien tax-xatt 配上海边草丛的记忆画面，并把 Catapodium marinum 写在旁边，固定记住这个物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece of glass; the diminutive of żġieġa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小片玻璃；是 żġieġa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira tal-ħġieġ; il-forma diminuttiva ta' żġieġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small piece of glass (the diminutive form of 'żġieġa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小片玻璃（żġieġa 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a small piece of glass on the floor
removed a small piece of glass

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ġabar żġejġa minn fuq il-mejda b'pinzell żgħir.
formal.en: The worker collected a small piece of glass from the table with a small brush.
formal.zh: 工人用一把小刷子收起了桌上的一小片玻璃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm żġejġa mal-art. Mark: Tmisshiex; se niġborha b'pinzell u pala.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a small piece of glass on the floor. Mark: Don't touch it; I'll collect it with a brush and dustpan.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：地上有一小片玻璃。马克：别碰；我用刷子和簸箕把它收起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 地上有一小片玻璃。
messages.en: There's a small piece of glass on the floor.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmisshiex; se niġborha b'pinzell u pala.
messages.mt_standard: Tmisshiex; se niġborha b'pinzell u pala.
messages.zh: 别碰；我用刷子和簸箕把它收起来。
messages.en: Don't touch it; I'll collect it with a brush and dustpan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żġieġa 和 żġejġa 并排记：看到 żġejġa，就想象镜头拉近到一小片玻璃，突出指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of glass, either a shard or a pane used in a window.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块玻璃，可以指玻璃碎片，也可以指安装在窗户上的一块玻璃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ħġieġ, bħal framment jew biċċa ħġieġ ta' tieqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a shard or pane of glass
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块玻璃碎片，或一块窗玻璃。

collocations.en: a broken pane or piece of glass

formal.mt: It-tekniku biddel iż-żġieġa miksura tat-tieqa.
formal.en: The technician replaced the broken windowpane.
formal.zh: 技术人员更换了那块破损的窗玻璃。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dieħel ir-riħ mit-tieqa? Pawlu: Iż-żġieġa hija miksura; irridu nibdluha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is wind coming in through the window? Pawlu: The pane is broken; we need to replace it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么风从窗户里吹进来了？保罗：窗玻璃破了；我们得换一块。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 为什么风从窗户里吹进来了？
messages.en: Why is wind coming in through the window?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 窗玻璃破了；我们得换一块。
messages.en: The pane is broken; we need to replace it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一块玻璃的两幅画面记忆：装在窗框里是窗玻璃，碎落后是玻璃碎片，两个画面都对应 żġieġa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a blocked or congested nose, making it difficult to breathe through the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子堵塞，因而难以用鼻子顺畅呼吸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu mnieħru misdud u jsibha diffiċli jieħu n-nifs minn imnieħru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻塞；鼻子堵塞。

collocations.en: had a congested nose during the night
had a congested nose because of a cold

formal.mt: L-istudent żżaddam matul il-lejl u sabha diffiċli jieħu n-nifs minn imnieħru.
formal.en: The student had a congested nose during the night and found it difficult to breathe through his nose.
formal.zh: 这名学生夜间鼻塞，觉得用鼻子呼吸很困难。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif irqadt ilbieraħ? Mark: Ħażin. Żżaddamt u kelli nieħu n-nifs minn ħalqi.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did you sleep last night? Mark: Badly. My nose was blocked and I had to breathe through my mouth.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你昨晚睡得怎么样？马克：不好。我鼻塞，只好用嘴呼吸。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨晚睡得怎么样？
messages.en: How did you sleep last night?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħażin. Żżaddamt u kelli nieħu n-nifs minn ħalqi.
messages.mt_standard: Ħażin. Żżaddamt u kelli nieħu n-nifs minn ħalqi.
messages.zh: 不好。我鼻塞，只好用嘴呼吸。
messages.en: Badly. My nose was blocked and I had to breathe through my mouth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象睡觉时鼻子堵住、只能张嘴呼吸的场景，把 żżaddam 和「鼻塞」直接绑定，注意它是动词。

gloss_zh: 发出嗡嗡声或液体渗流声

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a buzzing sound or a sound like liquid oozing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出嗡嗡声，或发出类似液体缓慢渗流的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss ta' żanżin jew ħoss bħal dak ta' likwidu li joħroġ bil-mod.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a buzzing or oozing noise
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出嗡嗡声或液体渗流般的声音。

collocations.en: the motor made a buzzing noise
made a buzzing or oozing noise for a few seconds
collocations.zh: 发出了几秒钟的嗡嗡声或渗流声

formal.mt: Matul it-test, il-mutur żżafżaf għal ftit sekondi qabel ma waqaf.
formal.en: During the test, the motor made a buzzing noise for a few seconds before stopping.
formal.zh: 测试期间，马达发出了几秒钟的嗡嗡声，然后停止了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Toni: Il-fann żżafżaf meta xegħeltu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that noise? Toni: The fan buzzed when I switched it on.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：刚才是什么声音？托尼：我打开风扇时，它发出了嗡嗡声。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 我打开风扇时，它发出了嗡嗡声。
messages.en: The fan buzzed when I switched it on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żżafżaf 放进声音记忆卡：一边听马达嗡嗡，一边想象液体缓慢渗流的声响，记住它描述的是发声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wobble or move unsteadily from side to side, like a spinning top.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摇晃，像旋转中的陀螺那样不稳地左右晃动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbandal minn naħa għal oħra b'mod mhux stabbli, bħal ġugarell li jkun qed idur fuqu nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇晃；像旋转中的陀螺那样晃动。

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, il-ġugarell żżagrag waqt li kien idur u fl-aħħar waqa' fuq il-ġenb.
formal.en: During the observation, the toy wobbled as it spun and finally fell onto its side.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，玩具一边旋转一边摇晃，最后侧倒了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqa' l-ġugarell? Ben: Żżagrag waqt li kien idur, imbagħad waqa' fuq il-ġenb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the toy fall over? Ben: It wobbled as it spun, then fell onto its side.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：玩具为什么倒了？本：它转着转着晃了起来，然后就侧倒了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 玩具为什么倒了？
messages.en: Why did the toy fall over?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żżagrag waqt li kien idur, imbagħad waqa' fuq il-ġenb.
messages.mt_standard: Żżagrag waqt li kien idur, imbagħad waqa' fuq il-ġenb.
messages.zh: 它转着转着晃了起来，然后就侧倒了。
messages.en: It wobbled as it spun, then fell onto its side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象陀螺转慢后开始左右摇晃的画面，把 żżagrag 对准「晃动」这一瞬间，区别于单纯的旋转或倒下。

gloss_zh: 长出细毛；覆上柔软的毛

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered with thin or soft hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面逐渐长出细而柔软的毛，或被这样的毛覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa b'xagħar irqiq jew artab.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become covered with thin or soft hair
sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出细毛或软毛；被细软的毛覆盖。

collocations.en: his face became covered with fine hair

formal.mt: Matul l-adolexxenza, wiċċ it-tifel żżajbar b'xagħar fin.
formal.en: During adolescence, the boy's face became covered with fine hair.
formal.zh: 青春期时，男孩的脸上长出了细毛。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Innutajt li wiċċ Pawlu żżajbar? Rita: Iva, għandu ftit xagħar fin fuq ħaddejh.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you noticed that Pawlu's face has grown fine hair? Rita: Yes, he has a little fine hair on his cheeks.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你注意到Pawlu脸上长出细毛了吗？Rita：注意到了，他两颊上有一点细毛。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你注意到Pawlu脸上长出细毛了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed that Pawlu's face has grown fine hair?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu ftit xagħar fin fuq ħaddejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu ftit xagħar fin fuq ħaddejh.
messages.zh: 注意到了，他两颊上有一点细毛。
messages.en: Yes, he has a little fine hair on his cheeks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“脸上渐渐浮出一层细软绒毛”的画面配对，重点记住细软毛覆盖这一变化。

gloss_zh: 凸出；肚子发福；长出大肚腩；大摇大摆地走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To protrude, become paunchy or develop a pot belly, or walk with a swagger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某部分向外凸出、人逐渐长出大肚腩，或走路时大摇大摆、带着炫耀姿态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ 'il barra, jikber minn żaqqu jew jimxi b'arja ta' kburija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突出；向外凸出。
肚子逐渐发福；变得大腹便便。
长出凸起的大肚腩。
大摇大摆地走；以自负、炫耀的姿态行走。

collocations.en: swaggered in front of his friends
collocations.zh: 在朋友面前大摇大摆地走

formal.mt: Matul is-snin, ir-raġel żżakkar minn żaqqu u kellu bżonn qliezet usa'.
formal.en: Over the years, the man developed a paunch and needed wider trousers.
formal.zh: 这些年来，这名男子长出了大肚腩，需要穿更宽松的裤子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt kif żżakkar quddiem sħabu? Mark: Iva, beda jimxi qisu kien ir-rebbieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see how he swaggered in front of his friends? Mark: Yes, he started walking as if he were the winner.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看到他在朋友面前那副大摇大摆的样子了吗？Mark：看到了，他走起路来像自己就是赢家一样。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到他在朋友面前那副大摇大摆的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how he swaggered in front of his friends?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, beda jimxi qisu kien ir-rebbieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, beda jimxi qisu kien ir-rebbieħ.
messages.zh: 看到了，他走起路来像自己就是赢家一样。
messages.en: Yes, he started walking as if he were the winner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图分别记义：一幅是肚子向外凸起，一幅是人得意地大摇大摆；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drink a large amount of alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喝下很多酒，强调饮酒的量大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixrob ħafna alkoħol.

sense_translations.en_definition: to drink a lot of alcohol
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量饮酒；喝很多酒。

collocations.en: drank a lot of alcohol at the party
drank a lot of alcohol with friends

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla taċ-ċelebrazzjoni, il-mistieden żżambar u wara talab taxi biex imur id-dar.
formal.en: During the celebration dinner, the guest drank a lot of alcohol and afterwards requested a taxi to go home.
formal.zh: 在庆祝晚宴上，这位客人喝了很多酒，随后叫了出租车回家。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Toni ħalla l-karozza hawn? Ben: Għax żżambar fil-festa u mar id-dar b'taxi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Toni leave his car here? Ben: Because he drank a lot at the party and went home by taxi.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Toni为什么把车留在这里？Ben：因为他在聚会上喝了很多酒，坐出租车回家了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni为什么把车留在这里？
messages.en: Why did Toni leave his car here?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax żżambar fil-festa u mar id-dar b'taxi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax żżambar fil-festa u mar id-dar b'taxi.
messages.zh: 因为他在聚会上喝了很多酒，坐出租车回家了。
messages.en: Because he drank a lot at the party and went home by taxi.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会结束时桌上排着许多空酒杯，把这个词记成“酒喝得很多”，重点是酒量而非一般喝饮料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play or move about energetically, romping or cavorting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精力充沛地跑跳、嬉戏或欢闹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilgħab, jiġri jew jaqbeż bil-ħeġġa u bil-ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 活泼地跑跳嬉戏；嬉闹。
欢蹦乱跳；兴高采烈地跳跃玩闹。

formal.mt: Wara l-lezzjoni, it-tifel żżanak fil-bitħa mal-ħbieb tiegħu.
formal.en: After the lesson, the boy romped in the courtyard with his friends.
formal.zh: 下课后，男孩和朋友们在院子里跑跳嬉闹。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Leo raqad daqshekk kmieni? Adam: Żżanak mal-kelb fil-ġnien wara nofsinhar u għeja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Leo go to sleep so early? Adam: He romped with the dog in the garden this afternoon and got tired.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Leo为什么这么早就睡了？Adam：他下午在花园里和狗跑跳玩闹，玩累了。

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.zh: Leo为什么这么早就睡了？
messages.en: Why did Leo go to sleep so early?

messages.speaker: Adam (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Żżanak mal-kelb fil-ġnien wara nofsinhar u għeja.
messages.mt_standard: Żżanak mal-kelb fil-ġnien wara nofsinhar u għeja.
messages.zh: 他下午在花园里和狗跑跳玩闹，玩累了。
messages.en: He romped with the dog in the garden this afternoon and got tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放孩子和小狗在花园里追逐跳跃的短片，把这个词与开心、活泼的跑跳嬉闹一起记。

gloss_zh: 发出嗡嗡声；新衣物被试穿

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a buzzing sound; also, for a new item of clothing to be tried on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示发出嗡嗡声；也可指一件新衣物被试穿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss ta' żanżin; jingħad ukoll għal ilbies ġdid li jiġi ppruvat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出嗡嗡的声音。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be tried on (used of a new item of clothing)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被试穿，用于新衣物。

collocations.en: the motor made a buzzing sound
the new jacket was tried on

formal.mt: Il-ġakkett il-ġdid żżanżan quddiem il-mera biex il-klijent jara jekk kienx joqgħodlu sew.
formal.en: The new jacket was tried on in front of the mirror so that the customer could see whether it fitted him well.
formal.zh: 顾客在镜子前试穿了新夹克，看看是否合身。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Il-mutur żżanżan malli xgħeltu. Karl: Iva, smajt żanżin qasir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that sound? The motor buzzed as soon as I switched it on. Karl: Yes, I heard a brief buzz.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听到那个声音了吗？我一打开，电动机就嗡地响了。Karl：听到了，我听见了一阵短促的嗡嗡声。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Il-mutur żżanżan malli xgħeltu.
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Il-mutur żżanżan malli xgħeltu.
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？我一打开，电动机就嗡地响了。
messages.en: Did you hear that sound? The motor buzzed as soon as I switched it on.

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.zh: 听到了，我听见了一阵短促的嗡嗡声。
messages.en: Yes, I heard a brief buzz.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张情景卡：一张画发出嗡嗡声的电动机，一张画镜前试穿的新夹克，分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be taken apart or dismantled into separate components.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物件或装置被拆开，使原本组合在一起的部件分离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqala' f'biċċiet jew jinfired fil-partijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拆开；各组成部分被分开。
被拆卸；被拆解。

collocations.en: the motor was taken apart for repair

formal.mt: Il-mutur żżarma fil-ħanut tax-xogħol sabiex jiġu eżaminati l-partijiet ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: The motor was taken apart in the workshop so that its internal components could be examined.
formal.zh: 电动机在车间里被拆开，以检查内部部件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-armar li kien quddiem id-dar? Rita: Żżarma lbieraħ wara li spiċċa x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the scaffolding that was in front of the house? Rita: It was dismantled yesterday after the work was finished.
colloquial.zh: Mark：原来在房子前面的脚手架去哪儿了？Rita：昨天完工后就拆掉了。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-armar li kien quddiem id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-armar li kien quddiem id-dar?
messages.zh: 原来在房子前面的脚手架去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where is the scaffolding that was in front of the house?

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Żżarma lbieraħ wara li spiċċa x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Żżarma lbieraħ wara li spiċċa x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 昨天完工后就拆掉了。
messages.en: It was dismantled yesterday after the work was finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象完整机器变成桌上一排零件，记住句子的主角是“被拆开的东西”，由整体变为分开的部件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frayed or come undone, with threads or a fastening loosening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织物边缘因磨损而起毛散线，或原本系好、固定好的部分松开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħatt minn trufu u joħorġulu l-ħjut, jew jinħall minn fejn kien marbut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因磨损而起毛、散线或边缘破损。
松开；散开；原本固定好的部分脱开。

collocations.en: the edge of the fabric became frayed

formal.mt: Wara ħafna użu, it-tarf tad-drapp żżarrad u bdew joħorġu l-ħjut.
formal.en: After extensive use, the edge of the fabric became frayed and threads began to come loose.
formal.zh: 经过长期使用，布料边缘磨损散线，线头开始露出来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-pakkett infetaħ? Ben: L-għoqod żżarrad u l-ispaga nħallet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the parcel open? Ben: The knot came undone and the string loosened.
colloquial.zh: Lara：包裹怎么打开了？Ben：结松了，绳子也散开了。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 包裹怎么打开了？
messages.en: Why did the parcel open?

messages.speaker: Ben (店员)
messages.zh: 结松了，绳子也散开了。
messages.en: The knot came undone and the string loosened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把旧布边冒出线头和绳结逐渐松开的两幅图并排记忆：共同画面是原本紧密的部分散开了。

gloss_zh: 多管闲事；干涉；冒昧越分

teaching_sense.en_definition: To meddle or interfere in other people's affairs, or act presumptuously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 擅自插手别人的事情、进行干涉，或表现得冒昧而不知分寸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindaħal f'affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor jew jaġixxi b'kunfidenza żejda mingħajr ma jkun imissu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多管闲事；擅自插手别人的事情。
干涉；介入并影响他人的事务或行动。
表现得冒昧、自以为是或越过应有的分寸。

formal.mt: Il-membru żżattat fid-deċiżjoni tal-kumitat u tkellem f'ismu mingħajr awtorizzazzjoni.
formal.en: The member presumptuously interfered in the committee's decision and spoke on its behalf without authorization.
formal.zh: 这名成员擅自干涉委员会的决定，并未经授权代表委员会发言。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Anna rrabjat ma' Toni? Karl: Għax żżattat f'affarijiet tagħha mingħajr ma staqsieha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Anna get angry with Toni? Karl: Because he meddled in her affairs without asking her.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Anna为什么生Toni的气？Karl：因为他没问过她，就擅自插手她的事情。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Anna为什么生Toni的气？
messages.en: Why did Anna get angry with Toni?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax żżattat f'affarijiet tagħha mingħajr ma staqsieha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax żżattat f'affarijiet tagħha mingħajr ma staqsieha.
messages.zh: 因为他没问过她，就擅自插手她的事情。
messages.en: Because he meddled in her affairs without asking her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人正在商量事情，有人未经邀请就插话替人作主；用这个场景记住多管闲事和冒昧越分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be removed from a place or position, or banished from a community or country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被从某处或某个职位移除，或被逐出某个群体、地方或国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitneħħa minn post jew kariga, jew jitkeċċa minn komunità jew pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被移除；被撤去。
被放逐；被驱逐出某地。

formal.mt: Wara d-deċiżjoni tal-kunsill, ir-raġel żżawwal mill-belt u kellu jfittex post ieħor fejn jgħix.
formal.en: Following the council's decision, the man was banished from the city and had to find somewhere else to live.
formal.zh: 委员会作出决定后，那名男子被逐出城，必须另觅住处。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu m'għadux imexxi l-għaqda? Toni: Żżawwal mill-kariga wara l-laqgħa tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is Pawlu no longer leading the association? Toni: He was removed from office after yesterday's meeting.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗怎么不再负责协会了？托尼：昨天开会后，他被撤职了。

messages.speaker: Marija (协会成员)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么不再负责协会了？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu no longer leading the association?

messages.speaker: Toni (协会成员)
messages.zh: 昨天开会后，他被撤职了。
messages.en: He was removed from office after yesterday's meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人被移出职位框，或被送到城门之外：两幅画面分别帮助记住“被移除”和“被放逐”。

gloss_zh: 被粪肥覆盖；喝醉；处于糟糕状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of a field or similar area, to become covered with manure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指田地等被粪肥覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li raba' jew post simili jinkesa bid-demel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be covered with manure (used of a field etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被粪肥覆盖，用于田地等。
喝醉；进入醉酒状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be in a terrible state
sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于非常糟糕的状态；变得狼狈不堪。

formal.mt: Ir-raba' żżebbel qabel iż-żrigħ, u l-bidwi niżżel id-data tax-xogħol fir-reġistru.
formal.en: The farmland was covered with manure before sowing, and the farmer recorded the date of the work in the register.
formal.zh: 播种前，农田被施上了一层粪肥，农民将作业日期记入登记簿。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu Karl? Josef: Żżebbel bix-xorb fil-festa; issa qiegħed id-dar ma' ħuh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Karl? Josef: He got drunk at the party; now he's at home with his brother.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：卡尔在哪儿？约瑟夫：他在聚会上喝醉了，现在和哥哥在家。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 卡尔在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Karl?

messages.speaker: Josef (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żżebbel bix-xorb fil-festa; issa qiegħed id-dar ma' ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Żżebbel bix-xorb fil-festa; issa qiegħed id-dar ma' ħuh.
messages.zh: 他在聚会上喝醉了，现在和哥哥在家。
messages.en: He got drunk at the party; now he's at home with his brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个独立场景记忆：田地盖满粪肥、聚会有人喝醉、某人状态糟糕。先看主语和上下文，再选择对应义项。

gloss_zh: 变成珠状；果实细小不熟；呈小而圆亮的眼神；瞪眼看

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become shaped like beads; of fruit, to remain small and beady instead of ripening properly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成珠子般的形状；用于果实时，指没有正常成熟而保持细小珠状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieħu forma ta' żibeġ; dwar frott, li jibqa' żgħir bħal żibeġ u ma jimmaturax sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变成珠子般的形状；变成珠状。
瞪大眼睛看某物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be small and beady (used especially of fruit that fails to ripen properly)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 呈细小珠状，尤指果实未能正常成熟而显得细小。
显出眼睛小而圆亮的样子。
瞪大眼睛；作出瞪眼的神情。

collocations.en: grapes that remained small and beady
collocations.zh: 未正常成熟而细小如珠的葡萄

collocations.en: goggled in front of the mirror

formal.mt: Fir-rapport dwar il-ħsad, il-bidwi nnota li parti mill-għeneb żżebbeġ u ma mmaturax sew.
formal.en: In the harvest report, the farmer noted that some of the grapes had remained small and beady and had not ripened properly.
formal.zh: 农民在收成报告中指出，部分葡萄一直细小如珠，没有正常成熟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Ben żżebbeġ quddiem il-mera? Mark: Qed jagħmel wiċċ tad-daħk biex idaħħak lil oħtu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Ben goggle in front of the mirror? Mark: He's making a funny face to make his sister laugh.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本怎么在镜子前瞪起眼睛来了？马克：他在做鬼脸，想逗妹妹笑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 本怎么在镜子前瞪起眼睛来了？
messages.en: Why did Ben goggle in front of the mirror?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jagħmel wiċċ tad-daħk biex idaħħak lil oħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jagħmel wiċċ tad-daħk biex idaħħak lil oħtu.
messages.zh: 他在做鬼脸，想逗妹妹笑。
messages.en: He's making a funny face to make his sister laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张联想卡：一张画细小珠状的未熟葡萄，一张画瞪眼的脸；用画面分别记住果实义和眼神义，不把它们混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be subjected to insulting criticism or treated with scorn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到侮辱性的批评或诋毁，或遭到他人的鄙视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jiġi insultat jew immaqdar, jew jiġi ttrattat b'disprezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭到诋毁或恶意辱骂。
受到鄙视或轻蔑对待。

collocations.en: was scorned because of his opinion
collocations.zh: 因自己的观点而受到鄙视

formal.mt: Matul id-dibattitu, il-kelliem żżeblaħ fil-pubbliku minflok ma ngħata tweġibiet għall-argumenti tiegħu.
formal.en: During the debate, the speaker was vilified in public instead of receiving responses to his arguments.
formal.zh: 辩论中，发言者在公开场合遭到诋毁，他的论点却没有得到回应。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex David ma jridx jerġa' jitkellem fil-grupp? Luqa: Ilbieraħ żżeblaħ minħabba l-opinjoni tiegħu, u ħassu mweġġa'.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why doesn't David want to speak in the group again? Luqa: Yesterday he was scorned because of his opinion, and he felt hurt.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：戴维怎么不愿再在群里发言了？卢卡：昨天他因自己的观点受到鄙视，心里很受伤。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex David ma jridx jerġa' jitkellem fil-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex David ma jridx jerġa' jitkellem fil-grupp?
messages.zh: 戴维怎么不愿再在群里发言了？
messages.en: Why doesn't David want to speak in the group again?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilbieraħ żżeblaħ minħabba l-opinjoni tiegħu, u ħassu mweġġa'.
messages.mt_standard: Ilbieraħ żżeblaħ minħabba l-opinjoni tiegħu, u ħassu mweġġa'.
messages.zh: 昨天他因自己的观点受到鄙视，心里很受伤。
messages.en: Yesterday he was scorned because of his opinion, and he felt hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发言者面前出现两种伤人的反应：恶意辱骂对应“遭诋毁”，轻蔑眼神对应“受鄙视”；记住主语是承受者。

gloss_zh: 被覆上焦油；爱打听或插手别人私事

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of a surface, to be covered with a layer of tar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个表面被覆上一层焦油。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wiċċ jinkesa b'saff ta' qatran.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被涂上或铺上一层焦油。
爱打听别人的私事；好管闲事。

collocations.en: a surface that was tarred over

collocations.zh: 打听或插手别人的私事

formal.mt: Il-wiċċ tat-triq żżeffet waqt ix-xogħlijiet ta' manutenzjoni, u t-traffiku għadda minn rotta oħra.
formal.en: The road surface was tarred over during maintenance work, and traffic followed another route.
formal.zh: 维护施工期间，路面被铺上一层焦油，车辆改走其他路线。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex Mario ried ikun jaf kemm taqla'? Rita: Reġa' żżeffet fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor; għedtlu li dik hi ħaġa privata.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did Mario want to know how much you earn? Rita: He was prying into other people's affairs again; I told him that was private.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：马里奥为什么想知道你赚多少钱？丽塔：他又在打听别人的私事了，我告诉他那是隐私。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mario ried ikun jaf kemm taqla'?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mario ried ikun jaf kemm taqla'?
messages.zh: 马里奥为什么想知道你赚多少钱？
messages.en: Why did Mario want to know how much you earn?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Reġa' żżeffet fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor; għedtlu li dik hi ħaġa privata.
messages.mt_standard: Reġa' żżeffet fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor; għedtlu li dik hi ħaġa privata.
messages.zh: 他又在打听别人的私事了，我告诉他那是隐私。
messages.en: He was prying into other people's affairs again; I told him that was private.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两格记忆漫画：第一格是铺焦油的路面，第二格是追问别人隐私的人。两个义项分别记忆，用场景判断含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move with small twisting or side-to-side movements, or to be made to move in this way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以小幅度扭转或左右摆动的方式活动，或在外力作用下产生这样的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiċċaqlaq b'movimenti żgħar ta' tidwir jew minn naħa għal oħra, jew jitħarrek b'dan il-mod minn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭动；小幅度地左右摆动。
被弄得扭动；在外力作用下小幅摆动。

formal.mt: Meta l-għalliem ġibed il-ħajta, id-denb tal-pupazz żżegleg minn naħa għal oħra.
formal.en: When the teacher pulled the string, the puppet's tail was made to wiggle from side to side.
formal.zh: 老师拉动细绳时，木偶的尾巴便被带动着左右扭摆。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex it-tifel żżegleg fuq is-siġġu waqt l-istorja? Ben: Ried isib pożizzjoni aktar komda.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did the boy wiggle on his chair during the story? Ben: He wanted to find a more comfortable position.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：听故事时，那男孩为什么在椅子上扭来扭去？本：他想找个更舒服的坐姿。

messages.speaker: Marta (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tifel żżegleg fuq is-siġġu waqt l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tifel żżegleg fuq is-siġġu waqt l-istorja?
messages.zh: 听故事时，那男孩为什么在椅子上扭来扭去？
messages.en: Why did the boy wiggle on his chair during the story?

messages.speaker: Ben (助教)
messages.zh: 他想找个更舒服的坐姿。
messages.en: He wanted to find a more comfortable position.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手指做小幅左右扭动来记词，再想象拉绳让木偶尾巴扭动：前者提示“扭动”，后者提示“被带动着扭动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play about energetically and joyfully, often skipping or hopping around.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活泼欢快地嬉戏，常伴有蹦跳或四处跳跃的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jilgħab bil-ferħ u b'ħafna moviment, spiss jaqbeż minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欢快地嬉戏；活泼地玩耍。
四处蹦跳；蹦蹦跳跳地活动。

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħin tal-logħob, it-tifel żżegħber fil-ġnien flimkien ma' sħabu.
formal.en: During playtime, the boy frolicked in the garden with his friends.
formal.zh: 游戏时间里，男孩和伙伴们一起在花园中欢快地嬉戏。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Leo feraħ bir-rigal? Mark: Iva, żżegħber bil-ferħ malli fetaħ il-kaxxa!
colloquial.en: Anna: Was Leo pleased with the present? Mark: Yes, he skipped around joyfully as soon as he opened the box!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：利奥喜欢那份礼物吗？马克：喜欢，他一打开盒子就高兴得蹦来跳去！

messages.speaker: Anna (姑姑)
messages.zh: 利奥喜欢那份礼物吗？
messages.en: Was Leo pleased with the present?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żżegħber bil-ferħ malli fetaħ il-kaxxa!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żżegħber bil-ferħ malli fetaħ il-kaxxa!
messages.zh: 喜欢，他一打开盒子就高兴得蹦来跳去！
messages.en: Yes, he skipped around joyfully as soon as he opened the box!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子收到礼物后，在花园里笑着蹦来跳去。把快乐玩耍和轻快跳跃一起记住，就能区分嬉戏与普通走动。

gloss_zh: 打扮自己；把自己装扮漂亮

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make oneself look prettier or more attractive by dressing up or adding adornments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过穿戴或添加饰物，把自己打扮得更漂亮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jagħmel lilu nnifsu isbaħ billi jilbes ħwejjeġ sbieħ jew iżid xi tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打扮自己；把自己装扮得更漂亮。

collocations.en: dressed himself up for the celebration
adorned himself with a beautiful hat
collocations.zh: 戴上漂亮帽子装扮自己

formal.mt: Għaċ-ċerimonja, il-parteċipant żżejjen b'kappell sabiħ u b'żigarella kkulurita.
