formal.en: For the ceremony, the participant adorned himself with a beautiful hat and a colourful ribbon.
formal.zh: 为参加仪式，那位参与者戴上漂亮帽子，并配上彩色丝带装扮自己。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu żżejjen hekk illum? Nina: Illejla sejjer għal festa u ried jidher sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has Pawlu dressed himself up like that today? Nina: He's going to a party tonight and wanted to look nice.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗今天怎么打扮成这样？妮娜：他今晚要去参加聚会，想让自己看起来漂亮些。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天怎么打扮成这样？
messages.en: Why has Pawlu dressed himself up like that today?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illejla sejjer għal festa u ried jidher sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Illejla sejjer għal festa u ried jidher sabiħ.
messages.zh: 他今晚要去参加聚会，想让自己看起来漂亮些。
messages.en: He's going to a party tonight and wanted to look nice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门赴宴前照镜子，给自己戴好帽子、配上饰物。记忆重点放在“自己打扮自己”，把动作与镜中的本人联系起来。

gloss_zh: 被装饰；呈现杂色；变得色彩丰富

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be decorated, given varied colours, or made more colourful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到装饰，或被赋予多种颜色，使外观更加丰富多彩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa ssir imżejna jew tingħata diversi kuluri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被装饰；经过修饰而显得更美观。
呈现杂色；具有不同颜色相间的外观。
被添上色彩；变得色彩丰富。

formal.mt: Għall-wirja tal-iskola, il-pannell żżewwaq b'kuluri differenti u bi tpinġijiet tat-tfal.
formal.en: For the school exhibition, the panel was embellished with various colours and the children's drawings.
formal.zh: 为举办学校展览，展板用不同的颜色和孩子们的画作装饰起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-vażun qabel kien abjad biss? Mark: Iva, imbagħad żżewwaq bi fjuri ħomor u blu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this vase just white before? Mark: Yes, then it was decorated with red and blue flowers.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个花瓶以前只有白色吗？Mark：对，后来上面添了红色和蓝色的花朵图案。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-vażun qabel kien abjad biss?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-vażun qabel kien abjad biss?
messages.zh: 这个花瓶以前只有白色吗？
messages.en: Was this vase just white before?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imbagħad żżewwaq bi fjuri ħomor u blu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imbagħad żżewwaq bi fjuri ħomor u blu.
messages.zh: 对，后来上面添了红色和蓝色的花朵图案。
messages.en: Yes, then it was decorated with red and blue flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żżewwaq 配上一块由素白变成彩色花纹的展板，联记被装饰、呈杂色和增添色彩三个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To raise the upper end of the mizzen sail into its peaked position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将后桅帆的上端升至高位，使帆顶扬起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jgħolli t-tarf ta' fuq tal-qlugħ ta' wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 升起后桅帆的帆顶，使其上端扬起。

collocations.en: raised the peak of the mizzen sail
raised the mizzen's peak before departure
collocations.zh: 出发前升起了后桅帆的帆顶

formal.mt: Il-kaptan żżibonja l-qlugħ ta' wara qabel ma l-bastiment telaq mill-port.
formal.en: The captain raised the peak of the mizzen sail before the vessel left the harbour.
formal.zh: 船只离港之前，船长升起了后桅帆的帆顶。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel il-kaptan qabel tlaqna? Mark: Żżibonja l-qlugħ ta' wara; ara kemm hu għoli t-tarf tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the captain do before we set off? Mark: He raised the peak of the mizzen sail; look how high its end is.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们出发前，船长做了什么？Mark：他升起了后桅帆的帆顶；你看，帆的上端升得多高。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们出发前，船长做了什么？
messages.en: What did the captain do before we set off?

messages.speaker: Mark (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żżibonja l-qlugħ ta' wara; ara kemm hu għoli t-tarf tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Żżibonja l-qlugħ ta' wara; ara kemm hu għoli t-tarf tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他升起了后桅帆的帆顶；你看，帆的上端升得多高。
messages.en: He raised the peak of the mizzen sail; look how high its end is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 żżibonja 联想船尾的一面帆，其上端被缓缓拉高；记住动作重点是升起后桅帆的帆顶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop an activity or desist from continuing a course of action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 停止某项活动，或不再继续原先的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jieqaf minn attività jew ma jkomplix b'imġiba partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 停止；中止正在进行的行为；不再继续。

formal.mt: Wara l-intervent tal-medjatur, ir-raġel żżief mill-ġlied u aċċetta li jiddiskuti l-problema.
formal.en: After the mediator intervened, the man desisted from fighting and agreed to discuss the problem.
formal.zh: 调解员介入后，那名男子停止了打斗，并同意讨论问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu għadu jinsisti li mmorru llum? Mark: Le, żżief mill-insistenza meta għednielu li aħna għajjenin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Pawlu still insisting that we go today? Mark: No, he stopped insisting when we told him we were tired.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 还坚持要我们今天去吗？Mark：没有，我们告诉他我们累了以后，他就不再坚持了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għadu jinsisti li mmorru llum?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għadu jinsisti li mmorru llum?
messages.zh: Pawlu 还坚持要我们今天去吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still insisting that we go today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, żżief mill-insistenza meta għednielu li aħna għajjenin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, żżief mill-insistenza meta għednielu li aħna għajjenin.
messages.zh: 没有，我们告诉他我们累了以后，他就不再坚持了。
messages.en: No, he stopped insisting when we told him we were tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żżief 写在一张停止手势的图片旁：原本还在争执或坚持，现在收住动作、不再继续。

gloss_zh: 受到爱抚或宠爱；奉承；哄劝

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be caressed or pampered, or to use affectionate words or behaviour to flatter or coax someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到爱抚或宠爱；也指用亲昵的言语或举动奉承、哄劝别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jirċievi żegħil jew attenzjoni, jew juża kliem ħelu u mġiba affettiva biex ifaħħar lil xi ħadd jew jipperswadih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到爱抚；被温柔地抚摸。
受到宠爱；得到格外细致或迁就的照顾。
奉承；用讨人喜欢的赞美取悦对方。
哄劝；用温柔、亲昵的方式劝使对方答应。

collocations.en: acted affectionately towards his mother to coax her
used affectionate coaxing to get something
collocations.zh: 撒娇哄求以得到某样东西

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel żżiegħel ma' ommu biex jipperswadiha tħallih imur magħha.
formal.en: In the story, the boy affectionately coaxed his mother to persuade her to let him go with her.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩向母亲撒娇，想说服她让自己同行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ikkonvinċa lil ommu tixtrilu l-ġugarell? Mark: Żżiegħel magħha u qalilha kemm iħobbha.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did he convince his mother to buy him the toy? Mark: He coaxed her affectionately and told her how much he loved her.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他怎么说服妈妈给他买玩具的？Mark：他向妈妈撒娇，还说自己有多爱她。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ikkonvinċa lil ommu tixtrilu l-ġugarell?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ikkonvinċa lil ommu tixtrilu l-ġugarell?
messages.zh: 他怎么说服妈妈给他买玩具的？
messages.en: How did he convince his mother to buy him the toy?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żżiegħel magħha u qalilha kemm iħobbha.
messages.mt_standard: Żżiegħel magħha u qalilha kemm iħobbha.
messages.zh: 他向妈妈撒娇，还说自己有多爱她。
messages.en: He coaxed her affectionately and told her how much he loved her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕 żżiegħel 画两幅图：一幅是被轻抚、被宠爱，另一幅是说甜话哄人；用语境区分接受关爱和主动哄劝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a surface with a layer of tar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某物的表面涂覆一层焦油。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jgħatti wiċċ ta' xi ħaġa b'saff ta' qatran.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用焦油涂覆；在表面涂上一层焦油。

collocations.en: coated the roof surface with tar
collocations.zh: 给屋顶表面涂上了焦油

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol ta' manutenzjoni, il-ħaddiem żżiftja wiċċ il-bejt b'saff uniformi.
formal.en: During the maintenance work, the worker coated the roof surface with an even layer of tar.
formal.zh: 维修过程中，工人在屋顶表面均匀地涂了一层焦油。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-injam sar iswed? Mark: Pawlu żżiftja l-injam dalgħodu; is-saff għadu frisk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has the wood turned black? Mark: Pawlu coated the wood with tar this morning; the coating is still fresh.
colloquial.zh: Lara：木头怎么变黑了？Mark：Pawlu 今天早上给木头涂了焦油；涂层还是刚上的。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 木头怎么变黑了？
messages.en: Why has the wood turned black?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu żżiftja l-injam dalgħodu; is-saff għadu frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu żżiftja l-injam dalgħodu; is-saff għadu frisk.
messages.zh: Pawlu 今天早上给木头涂了焦油；涂层还是刚上的。
messages.en: Pawlu coated the wood with tar this morning; the coating is still fresh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żżiftja 与刷子涂出黑色焦油层的画面配对，记住这里既有涂覆动作，也明确指定焦油这种材料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To invent a story rather than recount events that actually happened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 编出一个故事，而不是叙述实际发生的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed joħloq storja mill-immaġinazzjoni minflok jirrakkonta ġrajjiet li seħħew tassew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编造故事；凭想象编出一段情节或说法。

collocations.en: made up a story about a dragon
collocations.zh: 编了一个关于龙的故事

collocations.en: made up a story to excuse himself
collocations.zh: 编了个故事为自己开脱

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju tal-kitba kreattiva, l-istudent żżinnja storja dwar gżira li ma tidhirx fuq il-mapep.
formal.en: For the creative writing exercise, the student made up a story about an island that does not appear on maps.
formal.zh: 在创意写作练习中，学生编了一个关于地图上找不到的岛屿的故事。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Veru li Pawlu ra dragun? Mark: Le, żżinnja storja biex idaħħaqna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is it true that Pawlu saw a dragon? Mark: No, he made up a story to make us laugh.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 真的看见龙了吗？Mark：没有，他编了个故事逗我们笑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 真的看见龙了吗？
messages.en: Is it true that Pawlu saw a dragon?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，他编了个故事逗我们笑。
messages.en: No, he made up a story to make us laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żżinnja 配一条想象中的龙：讲述者把不存在的情节编成故事，可用于创作，也可用于编说辞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take pleasure in adorning oneself with attractive clothes, jewellery, or other decorations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以穿戴漂亮衣物、首饰或其他饰物来打扮自己，并从中获得乐趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jieħu gost iżejjen lilu nnifsu bi ħwejjeġ sbieħ, ġojjelli jew ornamenti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜欢装扮自己；以给自己增添衣饰为乐。

collocations.en: took pleasure in adorning himself with jewellery
enjoyed adorning himself in front of the mirror
collocations.zh: 在镜子前开心地打扮自己

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żagħżugħ żżiżża bi ħwejjeġ eleganti u b'ċurkett qabel il-festa.
formal.en: In the story, the young man took pleasure in adorning himself with elegant clothes and a ring before the celebration.
formal.zh: 故事中，年轻人在庆典前兴致勃勃地穿上雅致衣服，戴上戒指，装扮自己。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark dam ħafna quddiem il-mera? Pawlu: Iva, żżiżża bil-ġojjelli u ħa gost jagħżel x'jilbes.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark spend a long time in front of the mirror? Pawlu: Yes, he enjoyed adorning himself with jewellery and choosing what to wear.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 在镜子前待了很久吗？Pawlu：对，他开心地戴首饰打扮，还很享受挑选穿什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 在镜子前待了很久吗？
messages.en: Did Mark spend a long time in front of the mirror?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żżiżża bil-ġojjelli u ħa gost jagħżel x'jilbes.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żżiżża bil-ġojjelli u ħa gost jagħżel x'jilbes.
messages.zh: 对，他开心地戴首饰打扮，还很享受挑选穿什么。
messages.en: Yes, he enjoyed adorning himself with jewellery and choosing what to wear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żżiżża 想成镜前微笑挑首饰的人：记忆时同时抓住打扮自己和享受打扮两个要点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To untie or undo something that has been tied or fastened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把已经系住、扎紧或扣住的东西解开，使其松开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iħoll xi ħaġa li tkun marbuta jew magħluqa b'rabta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解开；松开原先系住或扎紧的东西。

formal.mt: Qabel fetaħ l-ixkora, il-ħaddiem żżona l-għoqda tal-ħabel li kien iżommha magħluqa.
formal.en: Before opening the sack, the worker undid the knot in the rope that was keeping it closed.
formal.zh: 打开麻袋之前，工人先解开了扎住袋口的绳结。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħabel għadu marbut mal-kaxxa? Mark: Le, Pawlu żżona l-għoqda; issa nistgħu niftħuha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the rope still tied around the box? Mark: No, Pawlu undid the knot; now we can open it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：绳子还绑在箱子上吗？Mark：没有，Pawlu 已经解开绳结了；现在可以打开箱子了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 绳子还绑在箱子上吗？
messages.en: Is the rope still tied around the box?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Pawlu żżona l-għoqda; issa nistgħu niftħuha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Pawlu żżona l-għoqda; issa nistgħu niftħuha.
messages.zh: 没有，Pawlu 已经解开绳结了；现在可以打开箱子了。
messages.en: No, Pawlu undid the knot; now we can open it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 żżona 配一个绳结从紧到松、最后散开的连续画面，记住它表示解开原先的捆绑或系结。

gloss_zh: 扮小丑；做滑稽动作逗人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave like a clown, doing silly things to amuse other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像小丑一样做出滑稽或傻气的举动，以逗乐别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu ta' buffu u jagħmel affarijiet tad-daħk biex idaħħak lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扮小丑；以滑稽、胡闹的举动逗人发笑。

collocations.en: clowned around in front of the children
collocations.zh: 在孩子们面前做滑稽动作

collocations.en: played the clown to make his friends laugh

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, l-attur żżuffjetta quddiem it-tfal biex idaħħakhom.
formal.en: During the activity, the actor played the clown in front of the children to make them laugh.
formal.zh: 活动期间，演员在孩子们面前做出滑稽举动，逗他们发笑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd beda jidħaq? | Mark: Għax Pawlu żżuffjetta u għamel wiċċ tad-daħq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did everyone start laughing? | Mark: Because Pawlu played the clown and made a funny face.
colloquial.zh: Maja：大家怎么都笑起来了？ | Mark：因为Pawlu耍宝，还做了个鬼脸。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家怎么都笑起来了？
messages.en: Why did everyone start laughing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu żżuffjetta u għamel wiċċ tad-daħq.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu żżuffjetta u għamel wiċċ tad-daħq.
messages.zh: 因为Pawlu耍宝，还做了个鬼脸。
messages.en: Because Pawlu played the clown and made a funny face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“做鬼脸逗全场笑”的画面绑定，记住它表达扮小丑式的滑稽举动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stir up hostility, or to persist in a demand or opinion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挑起敌意或不和；也可指坚持某项要求或意见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem ostilità jew mibegħda, jew jibqa' jinsisti fuq talba jew opinjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激起敌意、反感或怨恨。
坚持某种意见或要求；执意主张。

collocations.en: stirred up hostility between the two groups
collocations.zh: 挑起两个群体之间的敌意

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-rappreżentant żżunżinja fuq il-ħtieġa ta' tweġiba bil-miktub.
formal.en: During the meeting, the representative insisted on the need for a written reply.
formal.zh: 会议期间，代表坚持要求得到书面答复。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għen biex il-ġirien jiftiehmu? | Mark: Le, żżunżinja bejniethom u kompla l-inkwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu help the neighbours get along? | Mark: No, he stirred up hostility between them, and the trouble continued.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu帮邻居们和好了吗？ | Mark：没有，他挑起了他们之间的敌意，矛盾还在继续。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: Pawlu帮邻居们和好了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu help the neighbours get along?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, żżunżinja bejniethom u kompla l-inkwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, żżunżinja bejniethom u kompla l-inkwiet.
messages.zh: 没有，他挑起了他们之间的敌意，矛盾还在继续。
messages.en: No, he stirred up hostility between them, and the trouble continued.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅场景分别记义：一幅是挑起双方敌意，另一幅是反复坚持要求；阅读时依上下文区分。
